It contains approximately 1.2 million images from 142 countries, paired with 25 million structured annotations covering scene captions, incident and location assessments, spatial relationships, and visual question answering (VQA). The VQA annotations link answers to visible evidence and include questions about both present and absent cues, multiple answer formats, and difficulty labels. Region-level annotations link caption phrases to bounding boxes and spatial relationships to the regions they connect. The test set contains 38,254 images spanning 75 countries and 28 hazard types. Gemini 3.1 Pro audited the test annotations, and human reviewers validated a stratified subset. On this benchmark, the 9B DisasterVLM model outperforms the evaluated general-purpose baselines on captioning, open-ended VQA, incident reasoning, and region-level grounding. Gains in text overlap are larger than gains in evidence scores. We plan to publicly release the dataset, trained models, and code.

</details>


### [216] [EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12149)
*Xiaozhi Zhang,Changjia Xu,Yaoyuan Yan,Haoxiang Jie,Bingjie Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoLabel是一个零样本第一人称自动标注流水线，通过显式跨模态配准与一致性诊断，整合现成模型（MonST3R几何、LocateAnything+GMC-BoT-SORT+SAM 2目标、V-HPOT手部），并报告其精度与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称自动标注需深度、相机位姿、物体与人体姿态在独立开发的模型间保持一致，但单位、坐标约定与尺度差异会导致各自合理却几何不一致的预测，缺乏显式配准与一致性诊断手段。

Method: 构建零样本流水线，不使用目标域标注训练；整合MonST3R（几何）、LocateAnything与GMC-BoT-SORT及SAM 2（目标）、V-HPOT（手部），FisheyeViT作全身兼容性演示；提供显式跨模态配准与一致性诊断；手部主评估使用H2O传感器深度，采用逐手深度锚定（相对单一全局尺度）。

Result: 20个序列上，逐手深度锚定使各序列手-深度残差中位数的均值降低23%，汇总中位残差84.6 mm（真值参考20.5 mm）；手部PA-MPJPE为14.53±1.29 mm，而绝对MPJPE为119.1±31.3 mm，显示对齐精度与度量精度差距显著。三条仅RGB序列Sim(3)对齐后相机ATE为1.40±0.29 cm。另发现滑窗实现问题：传感器初始化的深度会在优化中改变；且因锚定与残差共用同一深度图，残差衡量的是内部一致性而非独立精度。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了配准流水线的实用价值与当前局限：内部一致性较好但绝对度量精度有限，诊断指标需谨慎解读，滑窗深度优化存在实现缺陷。

Abstract: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.

</details>


### [217] [CADMA: Capacity-Aware Coverage Decomposition for Generative Model Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12243)
*Debin Meng,Zheng Gao,Ziquan Liu,Yanran Li,Ioannis Patras,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CADMA，一种容量感知的召回式评估框架，通过局部容量匹配分离几何覆盖与有效覆盖，提供多维覆盖诊断（模式丢失与模式塌缩）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有召回类指标把分布覆盖简化为几何覆盖，只能给出单一聚合分数，无法区分模式丢失与模式塌缩，且可能给覆盖差的生成分布打高分，诊断性和可解释性不足。

Method: CADMA通过真实样本与生成样本之间的局部容量匹配来评估分布覆盖，将几何覆盖与有效覆盖分离，并输出多维覆盖诊断指标。

Result: 在toy数据、真实数据集及多种生成模型上的大量实验表明，CADMA的覆盖估计更可靠，能给出比现有指标更细粒度、更可解释的多样性失效诊断信号，并缓解几何指标过于乐观的问题。

Conclusion: CADMA为生成模型的召回式评估提供了容量感知的多维诊断框架，能更好刻画模式丢失与模式塌缩等多样性失效。

Abstract: Evaluating generative models requires measuring not only sample fidelity but also how well a generated set covers the real data distribution. Recent work has therefore introduced recall-oriented metrics for distribution-level evaluation. However, existing recall metrics often reduce distributional coverage to geometry-based coverage. This simplifying assumption weakens their diagnostic value and interpretability in two ways: these metrics provide only a single aggregate score that cannot distinguish essential diversity failures such as mode dropping and mode collapse, and geometry-based coverage can provide unreliable estimates by assigning high scores to poorly covered generative distributions. We therefore introduce CADMA, a capacity-aware framework for recall-oriented evaluation and diagnosis. CADMA evaluates distributional coverage through local capacity matching between real and generated samples, separating geometry-based coverage from effective coverage. This yields multi-dimensional coverage diagnostics that quantify mode dropping and mode collapse while reducing the overly optimistic estimates produced by geometry-based metrics. Through extensive experiments on toy data, real-world datasets, and generative models, we show that CADMA provides more reliable coverage estimates and more fine-grained, interpretable diagnostic signals of diversity failures than existing metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA_NeurIPS2026.

</details>


### [218] [A forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models: an EFM3D case study for crime scene reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12259)
*Davidson Chisom Onwubiko,Shahana Bano,Carlos Francisco Moreno-García*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一个结构化法证评估框架，用EFM3D在四个模拟室内犯罪现场上做房间尺度重建、语义理解、计算性能与法证适用性评估，结论是EFM3D适合辅助性情境记录而非高保真取证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型越来越多地整合几何、语义与空间上下文用于三维场景理解，但其在法证犯罪现场重建中的适用性尚不明确，缺乏可复现的评估方法。

Method: 在罗伯特戈登大学East Lodge House法证培训基地，用Meta Project Aria Gen 1录制四个模拟室内犯罪现场；构建涵盖房间尺度重建、语义场景理解、计算性能与法证适用性四方面的评估框架，并以EFM3D为对象进行实证演示；因缺乏参考网格与专家标注三维真值，统计量按描述性输出处理；另采用七项标准的能力画像进行评估。

Result: EFM3D生成网格平均12,668±2,430个顶点、24,838±4,903个面；记录39,529条语义预测，覆盖21–24个类别，平均置信度0.40；每场景最终推理处理1,388±203个片段，速度0.69±0.01样本/秒，每段录制约需50.77±6.12分钟；能力画像显示房间几何、家具定位、场景上下文与空间关系支持较强，细尺度法证证据支持较弱。

Conclusion: EFM3D可定位为情境记录与场景复核的互补工具，而非高保真法证采集的替代方案；所提框架为在专业法证场景中评估未来自我中心基础模型提供了可复现基础。

Abstract: Foundation models increasingly combine geometry, semantics, and spatial context for three-dimensional scene understanding, but their suitability for forensic crime scene reconstruction remains unclear. This study presents a structured forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models and demonstrates it using the Egocentric Foundation Model for 3D (EFM3D). Four simulated indoor crime scenes were recorded with Meta Project Aria Gen~1 at Robert Gordon University's East Lodge House forensic training facility. The framework evaluates room-scale reconstruction, semantic scene understanding, computational performance, and forensic suitability. Across the four scenes, EFM3D generated meshes averaging $12{,}668\pm2{,}430$ vertices and $24{,}838\pm4{,}903$ faces, with 39,529 recorded semantic predictions spanning 21--24 categories at a mean confidence of 0.40. Because reference meshes and expert-labelled 3D ground truth were unavailable, these statistics are treated as descriptive outputs rather than measures of geometric or detection accuracy. Final inference runs processed $1{,}388\pm203$ snippets per scene at $0.69\pm0.01$ samples/s and required $50.77\pm6.12$ minutes per recording. A seven-criterion capability profile indicated stronger support for room geometry, furniture localisation, scene context, and spatial relationships than for fine-scale forensic evidence. The results position EFM3D as a complementary tool for contextual documentation and scene review rather than a replacement for high-fidelity forensic capture. The framework provides a reproducible basis for evaluating future egocentric foundation models in specialised forensic settings.

</details>


### [219] [TMT: Adapting CLIP to Infrared Imagery via Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12345)
*Ruofan Wang,Puzuo Wang,Xin Chen,Zibo Yu,Jungang Yang,Yi Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TMT 通过文本定义的可见-红外方向与配对图像监督，将 CLIP 适配到红外模态，在零样本分类、检索和开放词汇分割上取得领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 的图像-文本对齐在红外图像上不可靠，因为预训练数据以可见光为主；而红外-文本标注成本高，因此希望仅用配对的红外-可见图像完成适配，同时兼顾模态特有知识、场景内容保持和 CLIP 原有的图文对齐能力。

Method: 提出 TMT（文本驱动模态知识迁移）：用文本嵌入差异定义红外到可见的方向，引导可见/红外模态间知识迁移，避免抹除红外特有信息；并引入生成-感知协同监督，将 CLIP 可见图像编码器的语义对齐与扩散模型的噪声预测反馈结合，增强红外图像的语义与细节表示。

Result: 在四个源域不重叠的红外分类基准上取得最高平均零样本准确率 48.92%；在适配过程无红外-文本监督的对比方法中取得最佳红外-文本检索结果；在 CART 与 SemanticRT 上取得 CLIP 类方法中最高的开放词汇分割 mIoU。

Conclusion: 仅用配对红外-可见图像即可有效将 CLIP 迁移到红外模态，文本方向引导与生成-感知协同监督是保持图文对齐并引入红外知识的关键。

Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong performance across computer vision tasks, yet their image-text alignment is less reliable for infrared (IR) imagery because large-scale pre-training is dominated by visible-spectrum data. Due to the high cost of the infrared-text labeling, we investigate adapting CLIP to IR through only paired infrared-visible images, which requires considering modality-specific knowledge while preserving scene content and CLIP's image-text alignment. To achieve this, we propose TMT (Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer), which adapts CLIP's image encoder through a text-defined infrared-to-visible direction and supervision from paired IR-visible images. First, we found that modality discrepancy can be described by corresponding text embeddings, thus using the direction of text embedding differences to guide the knowledge transfer between visible and infrared modalities without erasing infrared-specific information. To enhance the representation of semantics and details of infrared images, we introduce Generative-Perceptual Co-Supervision that combines semantic alignment from CLIP visible image encoder with diffusion noise-prediction feedbacks. On four source-disjoint IR classification benchmarks, TMT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the compared methods (48.92%). It also achieves the best IR-text retrieval results among the compared methods without infrared-text supervision during adaptation and the highest open-vocabulary segmentation mIoU on both CART and SemanticRT among the CLIP-like methods.

</details>


### [220] [ReVMap: Vectorized Global Mapping via Connectivity-Aware Local Map Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12346)
*Hongjae Shin,Jungho Kim,Donghyuk Kwak,Myeongjun Kim,Seunghoon Yu,Jiyong Oh,Jun Won Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVMap 提出一种可靠的自底向上（local-to-global）矢量化高清地图自动标注框架，利用逐点定位不确定性引入全局先验并指导全局地图更新，在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上取得局部预测与全局建图的 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模矢量化 HD 地图人工标注成本高昂，因此出现由局部矢量化预测增量构建全局地图的自动标注方法。但现有方法忽视预测不确定性、采用启发式地图融合，容易传播错误并造成拓扑不一致。

Method: 两个核心设计：(1) 不确定性引导的先验利用——基于逐点定位不确定性将全局地图先验融入局部地图预测，提升对不准确先验的鲁棒性；(2) 连通性引导的全局修订——预测局部到全局的连通关系，并依据局部预测的可靠性进行不确定性感知的融合，选择性更新全局地图。局部预测与全局修订迭代耦合、相互促进。

Result: 在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 基准上的大量实验表明，ReVMap 在局部地图预测和全局地图构建两方面均达到 state-of-the-art 性能。

Conclusion: 以不确定性建模替代启发式融合，可有效抑制误差传播并提升全局拓扑一致性，为低成本 HD 地图自动标注提供了可靠方案。

Abstract: Large-scale annotation of vectorized high-definition (HD) maps is labor-intensive and costly, motivating local-to-global auto-labeling approaches that incrementally construct global maps from local vectorized predictions. However, existing approaches often overlook prediction uncertainty and rely on heuristic map integration, potentially propagating errors and introducing topological inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose ReVMap, a reliable local-to-global framework that iteratively refines local map predictions and global map construction through uncertainty-guided prior utilization and connectivity-guided global map revision. Specifically, ReVMap leverages point-wise localization uncertainty to incorporate global map priors into local map prediction, improving robustness against inaccurate prior information. It then predicts local-to-global connectivity and selectively updates the global map through uncertainty-aware fusion based on the reliability of local predictions. By iteratively coupling local prediction and global revision, ReVMap progressively improves both local map accuracy and global map consistency. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 benchmarks demonstrate that ReVMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both local map prediction and global map construction.

</details>


### [221] [QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12353)
*Zhizhong Fu,Wei Zhou,Zhaoyang Jiang,Yudong Lin,Songlun Li,Zhi Li,Feifan Chen,Gaoming Li,Xiaorong Ding,Yifan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QCC-WM是一个基于商式因果构造(Quotient-based Causal Construction)的视觉世界模型，用动作响应引导宏观变量的构造与递归预测，并通过共享参考商度量保证宏观预测与生成观测中的视觉变化一致性。在US-VLA数据集上四步预测ROI-MSE为0.01861，四/八/十六步LPIPS相比最强基线分别降低48.59%、41.68%、30.23%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件世界建模的关键难点在于：如何从高维观测中构造能支持动作条件下递归预测的宏观状态，同时保持其预测演化与生成观测中的视觉变化一致。

Method: 利用平移与旋转动作及其预测响应，通过因果抽象将局部视觉特征聚合为具有空间对应关系的宏观节点；在共享参考商度量下递归预测节点内容与运动；宏观预测引导未来观测生成，预测运动负责传输历史外观信息；再将生成观测与宏观目标间的节点级误差映射回对应空间区域进行校正。

Result: US-VLA数据集上四步预测ROI-MSE为0.01861；相比各预测时长下的最佳基线，四步预测及八步、十六步递归外推的LPIPS分别降低48.59%、41.68%、30.23%。消融与机制分析表明：运动引导的参考传输主要改善像素重建，节点级误差反馈进一步改善感知质量及生成观测与宏观预测的一致性。

Conclusion: 宏观层面预测可为视觉生成提供结构化约束，节点级误差回传能有效弥合宏观状态演化与像素级视觉变化之间的差距，二者互补提升预测精度与感知一致性。

Abstract: A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation.
  Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions.
  On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.

</details>


### [222] [TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12364)
*Xiangyang Wu,Chen Ju,Xu Chen,Likang Peng,Jinsong Lan,Haihong Tang,Yang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 TRIAD，一个多模态检索基准，用于评估检索系统能否满足复杂、跨层级、多约束且随对话演化的用户请求。基准包含抽象、约束、状态三条轨道共六个子集，采用统一的多正例 mAP 评测，发现现有 17 个系统、20 种配置无一全面领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索日益服务于智能体系统，用户请求可能涉及跨层级关系、多重约束并在对话中演化。此时"高度相似"的结果仍可能违背需求，且检索内容可能直接驱动下游动作而无人工筛选，因此需要新的评测基准来检验系统是否真正满足完整请求。

Method: 构建 TRIAD 基准：三条轨道——abstraction（视觉实例与不同层级概念间双向检索）、constraints（正负条件联合满足）、state（跨对话轮次整合需求并在用户修改时更新早期条件）。共六个子集，每子集 1,000 条查询，每条查询配固定 1,000 候选池，采用多正例 mAP 协议；辅以更简单的参考任务和按违反需求分组的困难负例。

Result: 评测 17 个系统的 20 种配置：无一系统在六个子集上全面领先；性能随层级距离增大而下降；约束数相同时，纯负向查询通常劣于纯正向查询；在表达同一最终意图的配对任务中，40 组配置-领域比较里有 39 组多轮检索 mAP 更低；显式推理的收益因模型和任务而异。

Conclusion: 研究结果揭示了"检索相似内容"与"满足完整请求"之间的显著差距，为多模态检索在智能体场景下的能力评估与改进指明方向。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests. The benchmark contains six subsets, each with 1,000 queries and a fixed pool of 1,000 candidates per query, evaluated using a common multi-positive mean average precision (mAP) protocol. Simpler reference tasks and hard negatives grouped by the requirements they violate help characterize specific retrieval difficulties. We evaluate 20 configurations of 17 systems and find that no system leads across all six subsets. Performance declines with hierarchical distance, and negative-only queries generally underperform positive-only queries with the same number of constraints. Across paired tasks expressing the same final intent, multi-turn retrieval yields lower mAP in 39 of 40 configuration-domain comparisons. The benefits of explicit reasoning also vary across models and tasks. These findings highlight the gap between retrieving similar content and satisfying a complete request.

</details>


### [223] [PTC-IoU: CPU-Friendly Detection Quality Estimation for Edge Video Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12405)
*Wei Geng,Hyerin Kim,Chang Lu,Zhenghao Lu,Joerg Ott*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PTC-IoU，将检测质量估计从GPU移到CPU，通过压缩检测框历史实现确定性评分，在Jetson Orin Nano上延迟从10.3ms降至2.2ms（4.7倍加速），吞吐提升13.6%，能耗降低最多95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘视频分析运行时无真值标签，检测器置信度无法反映漏检和框错位，需质量估计器决定哪些帧需上传云端。基于神经网络的质量估计器会加重已运行检测的GPU负载，而CPU算力往往空闲。

Method: 提出Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU（PTC-IoU），将检测框历史压缩成紧凑表示，利用时序一致性在CPU上进行确定性结果评分，把估计负载从GPU迁移到CPU。

Result: 在Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano上每帧估计延迟从10.3ms降至2.2ms（快4.7倍），流水线吞吐提升13.6%，估计器能耗最多降低95%，且在多个数据集上最终检测质量与神经方法相当。

Conclusion: 利用CPU空闲算力与检测框时序一致性可高效完成质量估计，在不牺牲检测质量的前提下显著降低延迟、提升吞吐并大幅节能，适合边缘端部署。

Abstract: An edge video analytics system must estimate the quality of local detections since there are no ground-truth labels available during runtime. Detectors usually provide confidence scores for their results, but these scores can not reveal every missed object or misplaced bounding box. So a quality estimator is necessary to provide a decision signal indicating which frame has potential detection failures that need to be escalated to a more powerful model in the cloud. Neural network based estimators add workload to the GPU already running detection, while CPU capacity may remain available. We present Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU (PTC-IoU), which moves this workload to CPU by compacting detection boxes histories to support deterministic result scoring. Comparing to neural counterparts, experiments on representative edge hardware, Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano, show that our method reduced per-frame estimator latency from 10.3 ms for neural counterparts to 2.2 ms (4.7x faster), increased pipelined throughput by 13.6%, and cuts estimator energy consumption by up to 95%, while maintaining competitive final detection quality verified on multiple datasets.

</details>


### [224] [PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12411)
*Harold Haodong Chen,Rui Peng,Lingteng Qiu,Kejie Qiu,Chao Xu,Zilong Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysOPSD 用可执行代码作为特权物理上下文，结合 On-Policy 自蒸馏提升视频生成的物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉逼真但物理动力学与复杂交互脆弱；SFT 受离线状态错配影响，RL 受稀疏且定义不清的物理奖励限制。

Method: 以可执行代码作为特权物理上下文，构建 PhysOPSD-Engine 将真实物理场景转译为可验证仿真程序；引入（i）双层物理特权，经中间瓶颈桥接信息差距；（ii）共享 rollout 噪声下的受控物理变化以暴露因果动态差异。

Result: 在多种骨干网络上显著提升物理合理性，仅用 3K 样本即超越 SFT 与 RL 基线，同时保持通用视频生成质量。

Conclusion: 可执行代码是比文本提示与参考视频更有效的特权上下文，为视频生成的物理一致性后训练提供可编辑、可控的新范式。

Abstract: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.

</details>


### [225] [dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12426)
*Xiaotong Li,Zhengrong Yue,Xu Huang,Jialv Zou,Minhao Jing,Wenhao Yan,Haodong Li,Hai Huang,Bo Zhao,Yan Feng,Peng Pei,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出dNaViT，一个基于冻结预训练编码器的离散原生分辨率视觉Transformer，将视觉表示为有限离散词表token，在12个理解、4个生成及编辑基准上匹配或超越专用基线，验证离散视觉词汇可作为"通用视觉货币"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散自回归建模（如next-token prediction）是语言模型的核心范式，将其扩展到视觉可使视觉与语言模型统一到同一框架，共享方法与基础设施。核心问题是：有限的离散词表能在多大程度上表征丰富的视觉世界。

Method: dNaViT构建于冻结预训练编码器之上，采用轻量残差调制与双分支目标，将重建感知线索注入语义特征；通过分组乘积量化（grouped product quantization）在不增加空间序列长度的前提下扩展离散容量；并用平衡的训练策略同时保留语义与像素级信息。

Result: 在12个视觉理解基准、4个生成基准和1个图像编辑基准上，dNaViT匹配或超过任务特定基线；同时作为通用离散视觉tokenizer，支持下游统一编码与高保真图像解码。

Conclusion: 紧凑的离散词表能够充当通用视觉"货币"，可作为多功能离散视觉tokenizer，释放完全统一的原生多模态方法的潜力。

Abstract: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.

</details>


### [226] [Occupancy Modelling of Biased Landslide Inventories: When Does Separating Occurrence from Recording Improve on Neutralisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12437)
*Abdirashid Omar,Abdikadir Ugaas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文将生态学的占据-检测模型（occupancy-detection）引入滑坡易发性建模，把多份滑坡编录视为对同一事件的不完美观测者，从而分离"滑坡是否发生"与"是否被记录"，并与传统的偏差变量中性化方法进行比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滑坡易发性模型训练所用的编录记录的是"滑坡被看到的地方"而非"滑坡发生的地方"，存在报告偏差（如道路附近更易被发现）。常规补救方法（拟合偏差描述变量并在制图时中性化）并不总是充分，需要一种能显式区分发生过程与记录过程的方法。

Method: 采用模拟报告偏差的近乎完整编录（2018北海道胆振东部、2015尼泊尔Gorkha、2010海地地震）以及三份真实Gorkha编录；建立多编录占据-检测模型，与标准中性化基线比较；用重缩放、校准斜率、移植实验及"交互间隙"预注册检验等进行评估。

Result: 占据模型在25组配对抽样中24组降低道路偏差；Gorkha的AUC提升0.08–0.14，海地提升0.03，胆振仅0.01–0.02。预测/真实滑坡率中位数为0.99（0.44–1.89），基线仅0.24–0.30；用同一锚区重缩放基线可修正中位数但误差更大（0.20–4.34）。格子级概率仍偏极端（校准斜率0.59）。与最佳中性化模型相比，胆振AUC更高（0.03–0.07），Gorkha和海地更低（0.01–0.05）。移植实验表明胆振优势源于其真实滑坡格局结构而非地形或路网。在8个低交互间隙设定中中性化至少同样准确；真实Gorkha编录为坡向偏差而非道路偏差，模型无实质增益。

Conclusion: 占据-检测方法能有效降低报告偏差并改善绝对滑坡率估计，但其相对中性化的优势具有条件性：仅在特定格局结构（如胆振）或高交互间隙下显现，且格子级校准仍不佳。真实Gorkha案例显示偏差类型（坡向vs道路）影响方法收益，"交互间隙"可作为可计算的先验判据；基于报告目录的情形仍未验证。

Abstract: Landslide susceptibility models are trained on inventories that record where landslides were seen, not where they occurred. The established remedy fits bias-describing variables and neutralises them when mapping. We adapt occupancy-detection modelling from ecology, treating several inventories as imperfect observers of one event and separating occurrence from recording, and ask when this improves on neutralisation. We use near-complete inventories of the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi, 2015 Gorkha and 2010 Haiti earthquakes with simulated reporting bias, and three real Gorkha inventories. Compared with standard practice, the occupancy model reduces road bias in 24 of 25 paired draws and raises AUC by 0.08-0.14 on Gorkha and 0.03 on Haiti, but only 0.01-0.02 on Iburi. Its median predicted-to-true landslide rate is 0.99 (range 0.44-1.89), against 0.24-0.30 for the baselines. Rescaling the baselines with the same anchor area corrects their median but leaves larger errors (range 0.20-4.34). Cell-level probabilities remain too extreme (calibration slope 0.59). Compared with the best neutralised model, AUC is higher on Iburi (by 0.03-0.07) and lower on Gorkha and Haiti (by 0.01-0.05). Transplant experiments tie the Iburi advantage to the structure of its true landslide pattern, not to its terrain or road network. In all eight settings with a low interaction gap, computable from biased records, neutralisation was at least as accurate, including a prespecified test on Haiti; a high gap did not guarantee an advantage. The real Gorkha inventories are slope-biased, not road-biased, and there the model brings no meaningful gain. Report-based catalogues remain the main untested case.

</details>


### [227] [MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12443)
*Charbel Yahchouchi,Nabyl Quignon,Noemi Roggero,Laurent Saroul,Antitza Dantcheva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoSTE将深度伪造视频检测的参数高效适配分解为并行时空专家池，并用无监督token级路由让专家自动专精互补伪造线索，在跨数据集与跨操纵泛化上取得新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造视频的伪造痕迹随操纵类型大幅变化且常混合多种时空不一致，现有参数高效适配方法依赖单一共享表征，易产生操纵特异性偏置，难以迁移到未见伪造类型。

Method: 提出Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts（MoSTE）适配框架：将适配分解为并行的空间与时间专家池，通过无监督token级路由机制将token动态分配给最相关专家；无需显式操纵标签或多阶段训练即可实现专家条件化专精，同时把CLIP表征有效迁移到视频域。

Result: 在跨数据集与跨操纵基准上，MoSTE平均泛化性能达到新SOTA，并在多种操纵族上保持强性能；专家路由与注意力分析显示专家多样性涌现，表明学到互补的时空取证特征。

Conclusion: 以混合专家替代单一共享表征、配合无监督token级路由，是提升深度伪造视频检测泛化性的有效途径。

Abstract: Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE

</details>


### [228] [LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12445)
*Yu Tang,Zhiyuan You,Zhixiao Wang,Fanghua Yu,Qingyu Zhang,Xiang Yin,Chao Dong,Jinjin Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LongSCOP，用自强制训练、潜空间校准、未来参考和 VLM 智能体选取参考帧，实现长视频外扩生成的稳定与语义一致，并发布 62K 数据和 LVO-Bench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频外扩研究多关注短视频，长视频外扩未被充分探索；迭代分块生成会带来块间不一致与误差累积导致的不稳定甚至失败，以及长时序上的语义漂移。

Method: 1) 面向长时序平滑稳定的训练配方：自强制训练（self-forcing）、潜空间校准、未来参考；2) 基于 VLM 的智能体从整段视频中自动挑选信息量最大的参考帧，以保持主体、场景、背景一致；3) 构建 62K 高质量视频片段训练集；4) 提出人专家构建的 LVO-Bench，评估长时稳定性和语义一致性。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在生成稳定性和语义连贯性上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: LongSCOP 为长视频外扩这一欠探索问题提供了稳定、语义一致且可评测的解决方案，并配套数据与基准推动后续研究。

Abstract: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

</details>


### [229] [Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct: Consensus Aggregation and Fourier-Attended Multi-Decoders for Reconstruction-based Multi-View Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12477)
*Yongho Son,Junyeong Yun,Je Hyeong Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PAR框架，通过特征扰动+共识聚合生成视图一致的伪异常，配合视图专用多解码器与傅里叶注意力，实现多视图异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图异常检测对识别单视角难以发现的缺陷至关重要，但基于重建的方法在多视图场景中研究不足，核心难点在于生成视图一致的伪异常。

Method: 三点：(1) 特征扰动策略+共识聚合模块，跨视角整合扰动特征以构建高度对齐的伪异常表示；(2) 视图专用多解码器架构，每个视图独立解码器提升表示复杂度，产生更可行、定位更准的异常图；(3) 解码器引入傅里叶注意力，强调全局频域结构而非局部token证据，防止恒等映射。

Result: 在Real-IAD数据集上，样本级、图像级和像素级异常检测均持续优于SOTA方法。

Conclusion: PAR验证了重建式方法在多视图异常检测中的潜力，通过视图一致伪异常生成与频域注意力设计有效提升检测性能。

Abstract: Multi-view anomaly detection is crucial for industrial inspection to identify defects hidden from single viewpoints. Yet, despite their strong success in single-view applications, reconstruction-based methods remain largely underexplored in multi-view settings. A key challenge in extending these methods lies in generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies. To address this, we propose PAR, a reconstruction-based framework for enhanced multi-view anomaly detection. First, we introduce a feature perturbation strategy coupled with a consensus aggregation module that integrates these perturbed features across viewpoints to mitigate view-inconsistent anomalies and construct highly aligned pseudo-anomaly representations. Second, we employ a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture; by assigning a dedicated decoder to each view, we increase the model's representational complexity, enabling the generation of highly feasible, localized anomaly maps rather than less precise, view-agnostic reconstructions. Last, we incorporate Fourier attention into the decoders to emphasize global frequency-domain structures over local token evidence, effectively preventing identity mapping. Extensive experiments on the Real-IAD dataset demonstrate that PAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in sample-level, image-level, and pixel-level anomaly detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/SpatialAILab/PAR_mvad.

</details>


### [230] [MARS: Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams for Video Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12508)
*Ahmed Y. Radwan,Shaina Raza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARS 是一种双路径视频深度伪造检测器，用多尺度外观-残差流联合建模特征差异与外观语义，在七数据集上取得最高平均 AUROC 91.43%，且仅用换脸数据训练即可迁移到全生成视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测难以跨多种篡改方法与全生成视频泛化，因为伪造痕迹随篡改方式和场景内容而变化。显式时空特征差异能捕捉这种变化，但也会被自然纹理与运动激活，因此需要与外观特征联合解读。

Method: 提出 MARS 双路径检测器：残差路径对冻结中间特征施加固定的时空高斯差分算子，并跨帧结合外观上下文建模差异；语义路径通过适配编码器归一化参数进行帧分类；再由依赖视频片段的门控融合两路预测。模型还输出有符号的 patch 级与帧级贡献。

Result: 在统一协议下评估七个数据集，MARS 平均 AUROC 达 91.43%，超过七个对比检测器。仅用换脸数据训练时，在 GenVideo 上达 93.99% AUROC，在 DF26 上达 75.50%，证明无需生成视频训练数据即可迁移。通过受控的时空移除实验对照随机控制，验证了贡献解释的忠实性。

Conclusion: 多尺度特征差异与适配外观表示的联合建模能有效提升跨篡改类型和生成视频的检测泛化能力，并提供可验证的时空解释性；代码与项目页已公开。

Abstract: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate combines their predictions. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC of 91.43\%, outperforming seven compared detectors. When trained on facial manipulations alone, MARS achieves 93.99\% AUROC on GenVideo and 75.50\% on DF26, demonstrating transfer to generated videos without generated-video training data. MARS also provides signed patch and frame contributions, whose faithfulness we evaluate through controlled spatial and temporal removal against random controls. MARS is publicly available for research: Project page: https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mars/ Github: https://github.com/VectorInstitute/mars

</details>


### [231] [EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12524)
*Jens Parslov,Marco Schouten,Dim P. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EditJudge-Bench，用 Blender 渲染的 1,382 对合成前后图像构建诊断基准，以已知 3D 场景参数为精确真值，将 VLM 评判者作为"指令是否被正确执行"的二元验证器来审计其可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 越来越多被用作图像编辑基准的自动评判者，但其可靠性理解不足。真实编辑图像缺乏受控真值，且把请求的修改与模型伪影、非预期副作用、成功程度模糊性纠缠在一起，难以审计。

Method: 构建 EditJudge-Bench：1,382 对合成前后图像，Blender 渲染；编辑按源自真实用户请求的九大类别参数化；真值来自已知 3D 场景参数。由于每个编辑均由受控场景上的已知干预生成，可将评判者评测为二元验证器，把评判感知与编辑器质量解耦。评测了 25 种评判者配置。

Result: 存在显著可靠性差距：(a) 广泛使用的 VIEScore 模板配 GPT-4o 仅达 69.0% AUROC；(b) 微调评判者得分 51.7–66.3%；旋转、形状等空间编辑仍具挑战；(c) 图文顺序等提示格式选择可致性能波动达 14.1 分。尽管仅用合成数据，本基准上的评判者排名与两个真实图像人类偏好基准强相关（ρ=0.95 和 ρ=0.71）。

Conclusion: 受控合成审计能揭示与真实评测相关的失效模式，EditJudge-Bench 可作为诊断 VLM 图像编辑评判者可靠性的有效工具。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

</details>


### [232] [WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12557)
*Yuhang Chen,Jiheng Li,Jiale Wang,Zai Wang,Guangyue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 WanderBench 视频世界模型基准（745 条源视频、键盘动作相机路线、6 维度 24 子指标）与免训练框架 WanderLand，用于评估和改进视频条件下的动态世界探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频条件生成基准多从单图或文本出发，仅评估感知质量与相机跟随，无法判断探索时是否保持主体身份、事件演进和重访地点的一致性。

Method: 构建三档难度（3–25 s）的 745 条单镜头真实/AI 生成视频，配键盘动作相机路线与 24 项人工验证子指标；并提出免训练 WanderLand：让冻结模型的每帧以同一时刻源视频为条件，重访时以自身早期静态内容为条件。

Result: 评测八个模型发现：片段变长时静态场景与画质保持，但相机控制与源动态丢失，且无一模型能保持重访地点一致；WanderLand 使五个模型在所有维度提升，源动态保真度最高提升 8.3 分。

Conclusion: WanderBench 揭示视频世界模型在长时段探索与重访一致性上的关键缺陷，WanderLand 作为免训练方案提供了普适且有效的改进途径。

Abstract: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

</details>


### [233] [GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12564)
*Isaac Xu,Devi Ayyagari,Martin Gillis,Benjamin Misiuk,Craig J. Brown,Thomas Trappenberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GHiML 框架，从 VLM 中提取概念隐变量并生成样本相关文本描述，通过交叉注意力与逐节点门控路由将文本嵌入与图像嵌入融合，用于分层多标签分类，并提出对稀疏深层层级更敏感的 d_inv 评价指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 权重中蕴含大量专家知识但难以直接用于底栖图像等专业分类领域；而专门训练的 ViT 主要依赖颜色、纹理、形状等低层视觉特征，缺乏人类识别时的高层推理。因此希望挖掘 VLM 的知识以增强视觉分类。

Method: GHiML 流程：(1) 以训练数据为条件从 VLM 提取概念隐变量；(2) 基于这些变量生成与样本相关的 caption；(3) 用交叉注意力和逐节点门控路由器将文本嵌入与图像嵌入融合。另提出 inverted HML 分数 d_inv，通过图遍历距离与基数惩罚评估分层多标签预测。

Result: 在 BenthicNet、FathomNet、iNaturalist 上，路由器相对纯视觉基线在域内底栖数据上 macro F1 最高提升 6.7 pp，d_inv 最高提升 21.1 pp，分布偏移下增益仍保持。消融显示：多标签生物层级上去除逐样本文本信号，d_inv 下降而 macro F1 不变，说明文本主要通过预测基数（cardinality）而非节点区分起作用；单标签的 iNaturalist 则损失 18.7% macro F1。

Conclusion: 结果支持这一假设：VLM 含有可被利用的专业知识，适当引导后能增强直接视觉学习不足领域的分类性能；同时揭示文本信号在不同标签结构（多标签 vs 单标签）中作用机制不同。

Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.

</details>


### [234] [Towards Reconstructing and Recognizing Objects behind Fragmented Occlusion using Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12624)
*Roman Pflugfelder,Michael Lindenbaum,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于单相机灰度图像序列的去遮挡重建框架，通过联合配准并最大化平均图像对比度来估计目标相对位置，从而在超过90%遮挡密度下重建目标，并可支持可靠分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉系统能透过树叶等碎片化遮挡感知物体，但计算机视觉在高密度碎片化遮挡下的目标重建（去遮挡）仍是基础难题；现有合成孔径技术虽有效，却局限于静态目标且需复杂校准的相机装置。

Method: 对单相机（可静止或运动）采集的运动目标灰度图像序列，联合配准各帧图像，优化对齐参数以最大化其平均图像（integrated image）的对比度；该积分图像即作为目标的重建表示。

Result: 在合成与真实视频序列上验证，可在超过90%遮挡密度下准确重建；性能与合成孔径技术相当，且所重建的积分图像作为现成分类器输入时，可在严重遮挡下实现可靠的目标分类。

Conclusion: 基于对比度最大化的序列积分重建是一种简单有效、无需复杂相机校准的去遮挡方法，可突破合成孔径技术对静态目标的限制，并支撑后续分类任务。

Abstract: Perceiving objects through fragmented occlusions, such as foliage, is a natural capability of the human visual system but remains a fundamental challenge for computer vision. This work addresses the problem of object reconstruction, or de-occlusion, in the presence of high-density, fragmented occlusions. We propose a reconstruction framework that operates on a sequence of grayscale images of a moving object, acquired by a single camera, either stationary or in motion. The algorithm estimates the object's relative positions across frames by jointly registering the images and optimizing the alignment parameters to maximize the contrast of their average, referred to as the integrated image. This integrated image serves as the reconstructed representation of the object. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real video sequences demonstrate the feasibility of accurate reconstruction under occlusion densities exceeding 90%. The proposed approach is competitive with synthetic aperture techniques, which are limited to static objects and require complex camera setup with careful calibration. Furthermore, we show that the integrated image enables reliable object classification under severe occlusion when used as input to standard, off-the-shelf classifiers.

</details>


### [235] [When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12657)
*Stefan Becker,Jens Bayer,David Münch,Wolfgang Hübner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文重新审视切片推理（sliced inference）在高分辨率图像小目标检测中的真实收益，指出其大部分增益实为分辨率效应，并提出覆盖感知的SCAHI方法以替代传统框融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有切片推理（如SAHI）的收益通常是与低分辨率基线对比得出的，混淆了"切片"与"分辨率"两个因素，因此需要以尺度为显式变量，厘清切片何时真正有价值。

Method: 在VisDrone和DOTA上，用预设定假设、仅标定调参和单次留出测试评估，比较4个家族的7种密集检测器。提出SCAHI（Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference），对所有切片通路的密集输出进行等总覆盖加权累积，并在足够细的峰值网格上读取目标以分离拥挤邻居。

Result: 发现一：切片收益主要是分辨率效应——VisDrone上高分辨率单次推理优于框融合切片，等算力下提高分辨率比增大模型更有效。发现二：切片携带互补信息被框融合浪费。SCAHI在所有YOLO检测器上均优于框融合，FCOS持平；DOTA上2048px时切片+SCAHI比最好单次推理高4.3–5.6 mAP50，仅替换SAHI合并步骤即提升2.3–4.0 mAP50。消融显示增益来自边界加权与峰值网格分辨率。

Conclusion: 切片的价值不在于简单缩小视野，而在于利用互补信息；SCAHI通过覆盖感知加权与细峰值网格释放该价值，尤其适用于图像远超单次可训练分辨率的场景（如DOTA）。

Abstract: Sliced inference such as SAHI is the standard remedy for small objects in high-resolution imagery, but its gains are usually measured against low-resolution baselines. We revisit sliced inference with scale as the explicit variable and ask when tiling actually pays off. We compare seven dense detectors from four families on VisDrone and DOTA, under pre-specified hypotheses, calibration-only tuning and a single evaluation on held-out test data. Two findings emerge. First, much of the benefit attributed to slicing is a resolution effect: on VisDrone, a single pass trained at a higher resolution outperforms tiling with box fusion (merging decoded boxes) for every detector that could be trained at that resolution, and at equal compute a higher resolution helps more than a larger model. Second, tiles carry complementary information that box fusion wastes. We introduce SCAHI (Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference), which accumulates the dense outputs of all passes with weights that give every image position the same total coverage, and reads objects off a peak grid fine enough to keep crowded neighbours apart. On identical passes, SCAHI outperforms box fusion for every YOLO detector on both datasets and matches it for FCOS. On DOTA, whose images far exceed the resolution a single pass can be trained at, tiles with SCAHI beat the best single pass for every detector, by 4.3 to 5.6 mAP50 at 2048 px, and replacing only SAHI's merge step by SCAHI adds 2.3 to 4.0 mAP50. An ablation attributes the gain to the border weighting and the resolution of the peak grid. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/scahi.

</details>


### [236] [What Breaks Scribble-Supervised Segmentation? An Audit-Informed Benchmark for Scribble Annotation Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12674)
*Minheng Wu,Di Wen,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Kailun Yang,Kunyu Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估涂鸦监督分割对标注缺陷鲁棒性的基准，设计六种受控扰动算子，并发现语义锚点破坏（类别腐化）导致的性能下降远大于几何扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有涂鸦监督分割通常在固定标注集上评估，对语义和几何不完美标注的鲁棒性缺乏认识；作者基于对12,031个PASCAL VOC 2012手工涂鸦的审计及已有研究来构建更系统的诊断协议。

Method: 引入六种受控扰动算子：类别腐化、空间偏移、方向扰动（由审计信号驱动），笔画长度缩减（源于先前研究），随机丢弃与碎片化（作为诊断对照）；每个算子同时报告请求变化与实际达成变化。在两种图像域、两种主干设置、多训练流程上评估人工与自动涂鸦，并补充MiT-B1 PFA锚点实验。

Result: 在五随机种子TEL-ResNet101 VOC实验中，mIoU从70.08降至：类别腐化1.46、空间偏移35.57、方向扰动52.20、笔画长度缩减63.24（各自最强设置）。总体上语义锚点腐化造成最大退化，几何与支撑类扰动的影响依赖流程与数据集。

Conclusion: 该基准提供了超越干净集精度的可复现标注鲁棒性诊断协议，代码已开源。

Abstract: Scribble-supervised segmentation is typically evaluated with a fixed annotation set, leaving robustness to distinct semantic and geometric imperfections poorly understood. Motivated by an audit of 12,031 manual PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) 2012 scribbles and prior work, we introduce six controlled perturbation operators. Class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation directly operationalize audit signals. Stroke-length reduction is motivated by prior scribble studies, while random dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. Each operator reports requested and achieved changes. We evaluate manual and automatic scribbles across two image domains, two principal backbone settings, and multiple training pipelines, with an additional MiT-B1 PFA anchor evaluation. In the five-seed Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC study, mean intersection over union (mIoU) drops from 70.08 to 1.46 under class corruption, compared with 35.57 for spatial offset, 52.20 for directional perturbation, and 63.24 for stroke-length reduction at their strongest settings. At the evaluated endpoints, semantic-anchor corruption produces the largest degradation, while geometric and support responses depend on the pipeline and dataset. Our benchmark provides a reproducible protocol for diagnosing annotation robustness beyond clean-set accuracy. The operator code is available at https://github.com/Wmhiram99/scribble-operator-benchmark.

</details>


### [237] [National-Scale Crop Type Mapping in Morocco Using Google AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings and the Fields of the World Field Boundary Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12681)
*Walid Elbarz,Mohamed Bourriz,Vincent Simonneaux,Hamd Ait Abdelali,François Bourzeix*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文利用Google AlphaEarth Foundations的64维预训练嵌入，配合轻量级下游分类器，实现摩洛哥全国尺度作物类型制图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统作物制图需处理原始卫星影像，计算与处理成本高；探索预训练地理空间基础模型嵌入能否直接用于大范围下游任务，以降低计算负担。

Method: 直接使用公开可得的64维AlphaEarth嵌入，训练轻量级分类器，无需处理原始影像；目标为三类作物（冬小麦、木本作物、其他作物）；全国推理时借助Fields of the World全球田块边界图将预测约束在农业地块内。

Result: 独立测试集十次重复运行平均分类精度87.17±0.42%；摩洛哥全国推理约5小时完成，主要开销来自云端嵌入检索而非模型推理。

Conclusion: 预训练嵌入表示可实现计算高效的国家级作物类型制图，具备大规模推广应用潜力。

Abstract: Recent geospatial foundation models have introduced a new paradigm for large-scale Earth observation by providing pretrained embedding representations that can be directly exploited for downstream tasks. In this work, we investigate the use of Google AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings for national-scale crop type mapping in Morocco. The proposed workflow operates directly on publicly available 64-dimensional pretrained embeddings using lightweight downstream classifiers, eliminating the need to process raw satellite imagery during model training and inference. The approach targets three crop categories, namely winter cereals, tree crops, and other crops. For nationwide inference, the Fields of the World global field boundary map is used to constrain predictions to agricultural parcels, enabling efficient large-scale mapping. Experimental evaluation on an independent test set over ten repeated runs achieved an average classification accuracy of (87.17 +/- 0.42%). Nationwide inference over Morocco was completed in approximately five hours, with the dominant computational cost arising from cloud-based retrieval of the embeddings rather than model execution. These results demonstrate the potential of pretrained embedding representations for computationally efficient national-scale crop type mapping.

</details>


### [238] [Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12686)
*Ajay Manicka,Karim Kadry,Sebastian Ruiz-Lopera,Maryam Alsharqi,Sanjana Arji,Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Nestor Uribe-Patarroyo,Brett E. Bouma,Farhad Nezami,Elazer R. Edelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于可微分正向物理模型的梯度下降反演方法，从单张OCT图像中恢复逐像素光学衰减系数，无需训练数据和分割，验证于5个体模及128例患者29,269张临床IVOCT图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像中的组织内在特性（如OCT衰减系数）与成像系统的物理过程纠缠在一起。传统方法依赖限于简化光-组织模型的闭式反演，或与特定成像配置绑定的学习方法，缺乏跨平台可移植性。作者希望直接反演成像系统的前向物理过程来恢复这些特性。

Method: 构建可微分物理正向模型，通过梯度下降从其反向推断逐像素衰减系数；该反演无需训练数据或分割，且更换正向模型或目标光学参数时优化流程保持不变；并与无梯度方法对比以说明梯度信息在高维问题上的可扩展性。

Result: 与解析解一致；在5个体外体模上验证；未经任何修改直接应用于128名患者的29,269张临床血管内OCT图像，表现可移植于不同平台与回顾性数据档案。

Conclusion: 逐像素反演在高维问题中可行，因梯度信息可扩展；该工作支持OCT图像的定量组织表征，并提供可跨成像模态与器官系统推广的框架。

Abstract: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.

</details>


### [239] [GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12699)
*Guohui Deng,Yuhang Jiang,Chengjun Wang,Zhongwen Hu,Zhaocong Wu,Linsheng Huang,Jinling Zhao,Chao Ruan,Miaozhong Xu,Chi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭示VLM在超高分辨率遥感计数上存在"计数地平线"（约5个目标），并提出无训练的GeoScope框架：用纯文本LLM将问题解析为类型化空间程序以固定区域与分辨率，VLM仅在其有效范围内接地计数，方向显式计算，并按实测极限拆分视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感中待计数或需方向关联的目标常仅占数像素，现有方法只决定VLM"看哪里"并信任其在该视图上的答案；作者证明该假设在计数任务上失效，需按VLM实际能力限制来控制视图。

Method: 1) 实测八个开源VLM的计数能力，发现"计数地平线"：单视图对象超过约5个即显著低估，且视图增大、目标变小会收窄地平线；2) 建立经验幂律响应模型，预测拆分视图可恢复的漏计与引入的虚假计数；3) 提出GeoScope：文本LLM将问题解析为类型化空间程序确定区域及分辨率，VLM仅在其有效范围内接地与计数，方向由接地框显式计算；4) 仅在超出地平线的视图上拆分；全程无需训练。

Result: XLRS-Bench上免训练提升Qwen3-VL-8B区域计数16.3分、空间关系10.5分，区域计数与按问题整体基准均为已报告最高（含训练方法）；UHR-Micro全局与区域计数分别提升16.8和36.2分（前者15.6分来自拆分）；MME-RealWorld计数提升11.4分；并指出该基准上存在一个几乎从不对却常被选中的选项，会扭曲比较。

Conclusion: VLM的计数能力存在可测量的极限，按此极限拆分视图并结合显式空间程序，可在不训练的情况下显著提升超高分辨率遥感计数与空间关系推理，并刷新多项基准最好成绩。

Abstract: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

</details>


### [240] [Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12716)
*George Shramko,Shrisudhan Govindarajan,Rudy Lam,Yizheng Xie,Daniel Rebain,David B. Lindell,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Spaghetti Splatting，将样条/曲线基元与低通核卷积后用于体渲染求解，实现曲线几何的重建与渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产系统中 3D 几何由点、线、三角形等基元表示，但直接从图像学习这些基元困难，因为它们是无限小位置的 Dirac 质量。已有工作用低通核卷积解决点与三角形，曲线（线状几何）尚未充分研究。

Method: 用折线逼近连续曲线，其卷积收敛于连续曲线的卷积；对每段做体渲染，使相连段在其连接处合成时不会重复计数。为快速训练与推理，对每段线性化相机投影，并支持高斯之外的核（如 Beta 核）。

Result: 在通用场景上与 SOTA 相当；在线状几何专用方法上更优；原生支持抗锯齿；生成可直接用于物理仿真的长连通曲线束。由于点是零长度曲线，该表示是 3DGS 的严格超集。

Conclusion: Spaghetti Splatting 将 splatting 配方推广到曲线基元，统一并扩展了 3DGS，兼具重建质量、抗锯齿与物理可用性。

Abstract: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.

</details>


### [241] [OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12727)
*Guillaume Guy,Mihajlo Grbovic,Joe Mills,Selen Uguroglu,Liwei He,Pratiksha Kadam,Nalini Kartha,Qian Aria Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OptiCover：面向 Airbnb 电商场景的可扩展封面图冷启动优化框架，结合 CLIP 视觉头、VLM 语义校验与多表面探索日志，已在生产环境上线，每日千万级换图，HomePage 互动提升 1.5%、Search 预订者增加 0.35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 封面图选择对视觉商品化至关重要但研究不足。Airbnb 房源照片多、需手动选单张静态图并跨异构场景复用；90% 以上照片无互动标签导致严重冷启动；不同表面与搜索意图下用户偏好不同；视觉吸引力强的图可能与房源语义不符；规模达数亿照片、每日数十万新上传。

Method: OptiCover 包含四部分：(i) 基于多种代理信号的候选照片生成器；(ii) 冻结 CLIP 嵌入上的轻量视觉头，做大规模语义打分；(iii) 基于 VLM 的跨模态 grounding 校验器，强制语义代表性；(iv) 探索日志模块（ELM），跨异构表面与上下文搜索意图协调随机化互动数据采集。

Result: 大量离线研究与 HomePage、Search 多场景在线实验。已上线生产，每日数千万次换图；HomePage 互动率提升 1.5%，Search 预订者数提升 0.35%，带来数百万美元增量收入。

Conclusion: 动作空间塑造（action-space shaping）与语义约束是性能提升的主要驱动因素；该框架验证了语义约束下冷启动视觉优化在超大规模电商场景的可行性与商业价值。

Abstract: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.
  We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.
  We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.

</details>


### [242] [Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12739)
*Zane K. J. Hartley,Yong En Kok,Lewis A. G. Stuart,Andrew P. French,Michael P. Pound*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Plant Orbiter 利用视频扩散模型从单张图像生成高质量 3D Gaussian Splatting 植物模型，在形态精度和高通量实用性上优于现有方法，并可扩展至文本生成 3D 植物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字表型分析需要高通量的 3D 植物形态测量，但植物形态复杂、结构细薄、存在遮挡，从 2D 转向 3D 高通量获取数字孪生仍是重大挑战。

Method: 提出 Plant Orbiter：借助视频扩散技术，从单张图像重建 3D 植物并用 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示；再结合 2D 扩散模型实现文本到 3D 植物生成。

Result: 在所有基线中取得最高 3D F-score，更准确地还原植物形态；因对齐更容易、相机布置成本更低而更适合高通量流程；文本到 3D 植物生成达到 SOTA。

Conclusion: Plant Orbiter 为高通量 3D 植物数字孪生提供了一种精度更高、更实用的单图像生成方案，并具备向文本驱动生成扩展的能力。

Abstract: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.

</details>


### [243] [Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12798)
*Lukun Wu,Jie Li,Ziqi Ren,Ruiyang Xia,Yan Gao,Xinbo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA)框架，用图像专用模型(DINOv2)和图文模型(CLIP)双教师对共享EEG编码器做层次化对比对齐，在THINGS-EEG零样本检索上达92.4% Top-1，超SOTA 12.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG视觉解码方法仅与CLIP族视觉基础模型对齐，未充分利用神经响应中的层次化视觉信息（从外观到语义），存在监督信号单一、信息利用不充分的问题。

Method: 基于"机制-范式对应"观点（层次化视觉加工对应跨范式VFM的互补偏置）：1) 双分支对比对齐，共享EEG编码器同时受冻结的多模糊CLIP与浅层DINOv2双教师监督；2) 融合检索目标学习自适应权重组合互补表征用于零样本EEG-to-image检索；3) 编码器AMSPBE结合时空间注意力与可学习头皮模式库，建模区域时间动态与滤波器组地形。

Result: THINGS-EEG零样本检索Top-1达92.4%，超此前SOTA 12.4%；空间、频谱与表征相似性分析及THINGS-MEG评估验证了有效性、生物合理性与跨模态泛化能力。

Conclusion: 跨范式VFM的互补监督能更完整地从脑活动中提取层次化视觉信息，为EEG视觉解码提供新视角与有效方案。

Abstract: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.

</details>


### [244] [2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12805)
*Aarya Bhave,Anushka Ajay Bhave*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出2D Gum-Net，一种全无监督的端到端架构，直接预测稠密弹性变形场，缓解学习型配准对真值变形场的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密非刚性配准在医学影像、结构生物学与对应估计中至关重要，但学习型方法面临真值变形场难以获取的瓶颈，尤其真实数据几乎无法得到像素级形变标注。

Method: 将原本用于冷冻电镜3D子断层对齐的Gum-Net迁移到2D弹性配准：三个模块全部2D重设计，用Dense Spatial Transformer替换刚体变换头，回归稀疏控制点网格并经双三次插值上采样为全分辨率场Φ；下采样采用DCT谱池化，以冻结基矩阵乘法实现（约50倍GPU加速），保留max/avg池化会破坏的细密准周期结构。

Result: 在接触式指纹这一困难测试平台上评估（脊线局部自相似使对应高度歧义、按压产生真实大位移弹性畸变、细节点可作精确地标供独立匹配器外部验证拓扑正确性）。仅用合成印痕训练并零样本评测真实基准，在FVC2004上结构相关性最高提升15.7%，在独立匹配器下提升真实匹配分数而冒名分数基本不变。

Conclusion: 预测的变形恢复了真实结构而未伪造对应关系，表明无监督稠密弹性配准在真实数据上可行。

Abstract: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.

</details>


### [245] [What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12852)
*Tianze Luo,Haofeng Huang,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过patch-wise PCA揭示像素空间Flow Matching中v-prediction的"带宽瓶颈"(速度的次要分量被原始噪声输入主导),解释了x-prediction的有效性,并提出Raw-injected Transformer (RiT)结合轻量原始条件解码器与输出侧shortcut,恢复有效的v-prediction。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Latent Diffusion有两阶段训练复杂度和预训练自编码器的重建瓶颈;像素空间Flow Matching虽端到端但用标准v-prediction时训练困难,已有解释(off-manifold noised targets)缺乏深入机制分析。

Method: 用patch-wise PCA识别出带宽瓶颈;通过受控实验与表征分析解释x-prediction有效的原因(参数化提供raw-input bypass,学习到的输入表征自发集中在主成分方向);在低秩观测下证明x-prediction是隐式条件均值解码器,可重建被丢弃分量;据此设计RiT:轻量raw-conditioned解码器+输出侧shortcut,将语义建模与原始状态传播分离。

Result: RiT恢复了有效的v-prediction;在ImageNet 256×256上取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 预测目标与架构带宽之间存在关键交互作用,为像素空间生成模型设计提供了新视角。

Abstract: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

</details>


### [246] [AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12855)
*Arne Schmidt,Justin Nieder,Cornelius Boehm,Julika Ribbat-Idel,Marius Teodorescu,Marie-Lisa Eich,Simon Schallenberg,Gabriel Dernbach,Katja Lingelbach,Miriam Haegele,Timo Milbich,Adam Narai,Maria Stoelben,Hans Pinckaers,Lukas Ruff,Kai Standvoss,Christian Watermann,Christiane Kuempers,Sven Perner,Verena Sailer,Jasmin Tiebach,Torsten Goldmann,Sebastian Marwitz,Johannes Braegelmann,Frederick Klauschen,Marija Pezer,Rosemarie Krupar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 新辅助治疗后的肺鳞癌肿瘤中成熟三级淋巴结构(TLS)与远端淋巴结成熟滤泡(SLS)减少，间质浆细胞密度降低，免疫-体液耦联减弱；间质浆细胞密度及淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位具预后价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟TLS与成熟淋巴结滤泡(SLS)支撑浆细胞反应并影响肺癌预后与免疫治疗获益，但新辅助治疗与未治疗肿瘤之间这一局部-区域轴（肿瘤及其近/远端淋巴结）的差异尚不清楚。

Method: 对匹配的新辅助治疗(neoLUSC, n=20)与初治(naivLUSC, n=20)肺鳞癌患者的切除肿瘤及近端、远端淋巴结H&E全片影像做分析：用Aignostics HETA模型量化各组织区间细胞密度与细胞共定位；用经病理学家标注验证的深度学习模型检测TLS与SLS并分级成熟度；在独立队列(n=458，46例治疗)中检验预后价值。

Result: neoLUSC间质浆细胞密度低72%(p=0.004)、间质淋巴细胞低48%(p=0.015)，巨噬细胞与粒细胞无显著差异；总TLS与未成熟TLS无差异，但肿瘤内成熟TLS(p=0.034)与肿瘤远端淋巴结成熟SLS(p=0.003)更低。TLS周围浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度在naivLUSC中相关(rho=0.54, p=0.017)，neoLUSC中不相关(rho=0.07)。验证队列中间质浆细胞密度(HR 0.69, p=0.011)与淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位(HR 0.66, p=0.004)关联更长生存，新辅助状态关联更短生存(HR 1.50, p=0.026)。

Conclusion: 新辅助治疗关联的是更少的成熟淋巴结构和更弱的体液免疫与肿瘤耦联，而非全面降低的免疫读数；间质浆细胞/共定位轴是潜在的预后生物标志物。

Abstract: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.

</details>


### [247] [SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12870)
*Yu Zhou,Xinyuan Xia,Xuankun Yang,Yinghao Yang,Wendi Chen,Bowen Liu,Jianhan Ma,Weicheng Duan,Jun Lv,Cewu Lu,Yanwei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统研究世界动作模型（WAM）中语言-视频对齐在引入动作学习后如何被影响，通过约4.7万小时多源视频数据与不同监督形式对比，给出一套维持对齐的数据与监督配方，并在仿真与真实任务上验证泛化优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WAM研究多聚焦架构与训练机制，默认视频预训练获得的语言-视频对齐是稳固基础；但引入动作学习可能破坏该对齐，而关于如何设计数据与监督以维持对齐的原则性指导仍然缺乏。

Method: 构建约47,000小时数据池（通用视频、自我中心视频、UMI演示、机器人演示）；系统对比"语言-视频监督""语言-视频-动作监督"及二者联合使用三种形式；分析语言标注质量对预训练语言-视频能力的影响，以及UMI与机器人演示的动作监督如何将能力扩展到语言-视频-动作建模；并进一步研究联合训练配方与模型架构，在固定训练预算下考察数据混合与规模扩展。

Result: 固定预算下，混合自我中心视频与UMI演示可提升控制泛化；模型架构影响经验利用效率；在选定配置下扩大预训练带来额外收益。仅用RoboTwin Clean演示做后训练，Easy（Clean-to-Clean）与Hard（Clean-to-Random）条件下成功率分别为88.10%与61.56%；真实世界三任务平均成功率40.00%，而最强基线为23.33%，显示未见条件下更强泛化。

Conclusion: 动作学习与语言-视频对齐需通过精心设计的数据与监督配方协同维护；混合数据、合理架构与规模扩展可共同提升WAM泛化能力，作者将公开数据、训练代码与模型权重。

Abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

</details>


### [248] [Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12875)
*Hao Gu,Jin Yao,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Click3R 提出一种用稀疏人工点击对应点交互式修正前馈三维重建模型错误的框架，通过轻量级点对应适配器注入几何约束，单次点击即可降低重建误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
