Motivation: 现有前馈式大三维重建模型只能给出单一且不可更改的预测，一旦失败便缺乏纠错机制。在重复纹理、对称结构、大视角变化或无纹理区域等困难场景中，模型歧义难以自行消解。

Method: 给定一对图像和用户提供的少量跨视角点对应，Click3R 通过轻量级点对应适配器（point correspondence adapter）将对应用户点击形成的几何约束注入三维重建网络，引导模型消除歧义，实现交互式几何修正。

Result: 作者构建了专门暴露现有前馈三维重建方法失败模式的挑战性基准。实验表明，仅需一次对应点击即可降低重建误差，在标准基准与自建基准上性能均有提升。

Conclusion: 稀疏人工交互是一种有效且实用的几何重建纠错机制，可弥补前馈模型无法自我修正的缺陷。

Abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

</details>


### [249] [Grasping the Future: Joint 3D Hand-Object Forecasting From Internet Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12879)
*Rustin Soraki,Matthew Wallingford,Ryan Aby,Brandon Chee,Jason Ren,Ali Farhadi,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Roozbeh Mottaghi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一的生成模型 Grasping-the-Future，预测联合的3D手-物体运动（手腕、手指、物体位姿），用掩码时空补全+flow matching训练，支持多种交互预测任务，并从互联网视频构建可扩展的3D监督管线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与物体交互需同时预测物体如何运动以及手如何随之运动；人类视频包含丰富日常交互关系，是学习未来交互预测的自然来源，但需从已完成交互中恢复运动并用于预测。

Method: 统一的3D手-物体联合运动生成模型，涵盖手腕运动、手指关节、物体位置与朝向；采用掩码时空补全与flow matching，一个模型覆盖多任务（预测未来交互、由物体预测手或反之、生成朝向目标物体位姿的轨迹、补全部分观测交互）；显式建模手-物关系并引入接触约束保持抓握；构建结合预训练感知模型与联合几何优化的可扩展管线从互联网视频获取3D监督，并与标注数据集联合训练。

Result: 在所有任务上表现强劲，在具3D标注的数据集上优于已发布的预测方法；通过将预测轨迹重定向到机器人 embodi­ment，验证了几何与物理上的合理性。

Conclusion: 单一生成模型可统一建模手-物体联合运动并支持多类交互预测任务，且从网络视频获取的可扩展3D监督有效，预测结果可迁移至机器人，具备实际应用潜力。

Abstract: To interact with an object, we need to anticipate both how it will move and how our hands should move with it. Human videos capture these relationships across everyday activities, offering a natural source for learning to predict future interactions. Learning from them requires recovering motion from completed interactions and using it to anticipate what could happen next. We present $\textit{Grasping-the-Future}$, a unified generative model of joint 3D hand-object motion, including wrist motion, finger articulation, and object position and orientation. Through masked spatiotemporal completion and flow matching, we train a single model for several prediction tasks: forecasting future interactions, predicting hand motion given object motion or vice versa, generating both trajectories toward a desired final object pose, and completing partially observed interactions. We explicitly model hand-object relations and incorporate contact constraints to help preserve grasp relationships during motion. To obtain 3D supervision from internet videos, we develop a scalable pipeline that combines pretrained perception models with joint geometric optimization to reconstruct completed interactions. We combine these recovered trajectories with annotated interaction datasets as training data for all tasks. We demonstrate strong performance across all tasks, outperforming released forecasters on datasets with 3D annotations. Moreover, we show geometric and physical plausibility of the predicted trajectories by retargeting them to a robotic embodiment. Videos are available at https://grasping-the-future.github.io.

</details>


### [250] [Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12883)
*Zhaoying Pan,Shenyu Lu,Jun Hui Wong,Junyi Chai,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MLLM在多模态输入冲突时可能错误偏向不可靠模态；本文识别出少数"仲裁注意力头"（arbitration heads），并提出免训练的轻量干预，在推理时将预测引导至指定可信模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型整合多模态信息，但当各模态相互矛盾时会变得不可靠，可能偏向对当前任务并非最可靠的模态，因此需要在推理阶段对模态仲裁进行控制。

Method: 发现一小组对"预测依据视觉还是文本证据"具有因果影响的注意力头（仲裁头）；基于此提出一种免训练的轻量干预，在推理时将这些头的偏置导向指定的可信模态。

Result: 识别的仲裁头在标定集大小变化下保持稳定，并可跨设置泛化；调节这些头能在多种基准上有效双向控制模型对模态的依赖。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了一种有效控制机制，可使MLLM预测与任务指定的模态优先级对齐；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.

</details>


### [251] [World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12885)
*Heng Fang,Zehui Guo,Yuehan Zhang,Mingyang Du,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出World In-Context Learning (WICL)范式与RoboScript框架：冻结模型从单次示范出发，在仿真世界中排练任务，把反馈写入上下文而非权重，形成可复用Task Memory；在RoboTwin 2.0全部50个任务上达83.4%平均成功率，超最强训练策略20+百分点，且无需梯度更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统训练式动作策略把操作技能写入网络权重，导致所学知识被绑定到训练数据分布上，难以迁移；而现有上下文学习（ICL）又因示范来自其他场景、缺乏当前世界的反馈，性能不及训练策略。作者观察到智能体在上下文中习得的是语义（任务步骤与物体角色），而非视觉外观，因此经验可跨世界迁移。

Method: 提出WICL范式：冻结模型以示范为起点，在仿真世界中排练（rehearse）任务，并将环境反馈写入上下文而非权重。实现为模块化基础设施RoboScript：从单次示范出发，经仿真排练学习每个任务，将所学知识固化为Task Memory，再以数据隔离方式部署到新场景（保证部署输入在真实机器人上可得），并支持反思改进与跨具身记忆适配。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0全部50个任务上，每任务仅一个示范、无梯度更新，清洁与随机化设置下平均成功率83.4%，超过最强训练式动作策略20+百分点；方法可跨视觉分布泛化、能通过反思提升、随基础模型规模扩展，并借助跨具身记忆适配迁移到真实双臂机器人。

Conclusion: 将世界环境纳入回路后，机器人可以在上下文中学会操作任务，效果可媲美在权重中学习。说明“语义级经验 + 世界反馈 + 上下文记忆”是可替代权重更新的一条高效、可迁移的机器人技能获取路径。

Abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

</details>


### [252] [Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12886)
*Haozhi Yuan,Handong Li,Yifan Zhang,Qianshan Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Reframe通过"证据感知的GD-GRPO"与"观测门控的OG-MOPD"两阶段后训练，将对齐对象由输出分布扩展到观测状态，无需任务特定SFT冷启动，在14个图像/视频基准上优于Mix-RL与原生MOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉智能体的工具使用存在两个关联问题：模型易忽略工具返回的观测；动作接地不良会减少后续蒸馏可用的证据。现有agentic RL与多教师on-policy蒸馏(MOPD)虽互补，但仅对齐输出分布，未把观测状态作为对齐对象。

Method: 提出Reframe两阶段框架：(1) Ground-Drop-GRPO(GD-GRPO)用证据感知奖励并随机移除原始视觉输入，训练时空专家获取接地证据并使用返回观测；(2) Observation-Gated-MOPD(OG-MOPD)在rollout中用规范动作替换有缺陷的工具动作，并从修复后的观测恢复蒸馏。两阶段相互增强，且均不需任务特定SFT冷启动。

Result: 在14个图像与视频基准上，Reframe优于Mix-RL和原生MOPD；消融显示GD-GRPO相比基于结果的GRPO提升了观测依赖度与工具增益。

Conclusion: 将对齐对象从输出分布扩展到观测状态是提升视觉智能体工具使用的有效方向；证据感知RL与观测修复式蒸馏可协同互补，且无需SFT冷启动即可实现。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [253] [BIBIMBAP: A Benchmark for Instructional BIM-Based Automated Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09933)
*Clemens Kujat,Bharathi Kannan Nithyanantham,Stefan Telgmann,Tobias Sesterhenn,Joern Ploennigs,Stefan Lüdtke,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出BIBIMBAP：首个评测LLM编辑IFC（Text-to-BIM）的基准，含100个覆盖CRUD与多类知识范畴的任务，基线最高仅50.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为BIM的自然语言接口已能实现信息检索，但缺乏衡量其编辑IFC能力的基准，无法评估编辑质量。

Method: 构建100个精编任务，覆盖创建/读取/更新/删除（CRUD）操作，涉及空间、几何、拓扑、数值与概念等类别；每个任务提供自然语言提示、IFC模型、期望结构化输出及自动化测试脚本。

Result: 基线模型整体性能有限（最佳50.2%），常在约束保持与空间推理上失败；部分正确输出源于错误推理（结果对而过程错）。

Conclusion: 填补Text-to-BIM编辑评测空白，揭示当前LLM在IFC编辑上的明显不足，为后续研究提供标准化评测工具。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are emerging as natural-language interfaces for Building Information Modeling (BIM), successfully achieving information retrieval, but no benchmark exists to evaluate their ability to edit Industry Foundation Classes (IFC). We introduce BIBIMBAP, a Text-to-BIM benchmark with 100 curated tasks covering Create-Read-Update-Delete (CRUD) operations across spatial, geometric, topological, numeric, and conceptual categories. Each task includes a natural-language prompt, an IFC model, expected structured outputs, and test scripts for automated evaluation. Baseline results show limited performance (best: 50.2%) and frequent failures in constraint preservation and spatial reasoning, with some correct outputs achieved despite flawed reasoning.

</details>


### [254] [How Many Examples, and Which Ones? A Study of In-Context Learning for Natural Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09936)
*Georgos Dikaios,Isidoros Perikos,Ioannis Hatzilygeroudis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评测了Llama、Mistral、Gemma、Phi-4等decoder-only大模型在MNLI、QNLI、SciTail上的NLI表现，发现简单直接的零样本/少样本提示即可取得优异效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLI研究多集中于encoder或encoder-decoder架构，decoder-only LLM在该任务上仍未充分探索；已有工作多关注复杂采样与提示技术，而极简提示方式的有效性尚未被检验。

Method: 在MNLI、QNLI、SciTail三个数据集上，对Llama、Mistral、Gemma、Phi-4进行综合基准测试，采用零样本与少样本策略，使用简单直接的提示，并与ICS、基于MCQ的提示等复杂方法对比。

Result: LLM在简单直接提示下普遍表现优异；one-shot中示例标签选择显著影响性能，以entailment为示例最佳；少量代表性示例的效果可媲美甚至优于更多示例；简单提示持续达到或超过复杂方法。

Conclusion: NLI任务不一定需要复杂提示技术，简单提示即可获得强性能，但提示效果依赖于具体模型与数据集。

Abstract: Natural language inference (NLI) is a fundamental task of natural language processing and crucial for evaluating the strengths and weaknesses of AI methods. Research has mostly focused on encoder or encoder-decoder architectures. However, the field of decoder-only Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. While prior work has mainly investigated complex sampling and prompting techniques, the effectiveness of a minimalistic prompting approach is yet to be examined in decoder-only LLMs. In this work, we examine and provide a comprehensive benchmark of LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi 4) in this domain, across the MNLI, QNLI and SciTail datasets. The performance of these models was evaluated using zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies with simple and direct prompts. The results of the article indicate that LLMs generally perform exceptionally well when they are provided with a simple, straightforward prompt, challenging the notion that complex prompting techniques are always required for NLI tasks. Additionally, we find that the choice of demonstration label in one-shot prompting significantly affects performance for most models, with entailment-primed examples performing best. Our findings also show that the use of a few representative examples, in the case of few-shot, produced performance comparable or superior to prompts with higher example counts, although the efficacy of the prompting techniques is model and dataset-dependent. Moreover, our simple prompting approach consistently matched or outperformed more elaborate methods such as ICS and MCQ-based prompting.

</details>


### [255] [DramaGrow: A Regime-Aware Benchmark for Auditing LLM Judges of Multi-Episode Drama](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09938)
*Hui Zhang,Yibo Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DramaGrow——面向AI生成中文五集剧的"regime-aware"基准与审计协议，将规约违规、可复现偏好、人评分歧分开统计，并揭示评估协议、平局校准、判官调用波动与投票差距对性能的影响不亚于评分标准设计本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对LLM判官的评估多把不同性质的质量问题压缩为单次调用的单一分数，且不报告平局校准、调用间波动以及人类参考背后的投票差距，导致判官可靠性难以真正评估。

Method: 构建DramaGrow基准：800集剧、120个字节保持干预、1,155条盲测五人评分记录，另含114对绝对多数偏好对与21对分歧对的冻结扩展；按证据规则将约束违规、五分之四偏好、组内分歧分配到不同分母；对比重复绝对打分rubric与DirectPair-GLM等直接配对判官，并做子面板枚举分析。

Result: 冻结集上重复绝对打分rubric表现重叠：平均准确率53.8–55.8%，三次调用一致率29.8–32.5%；随平局带变宽准确率从71.6–71.9%降至34.8–37.1%。DirectPair-GLM偏好准确率85.1%、约束F1 89.5%、Detect+Locate 81.9%；精确子面板枚举显示"五分之四"是最小稳定人类投票差距。

Conclusion: 评估协议、平局校准、判官调用波动与面板投票差距对性能的影响与评分标准设计相当；将开源规约包、脚本、干预、匿名人类投票与理由、冻结判官运行及分析代码。

Abstract: LLMs can now draft complete multi-episode dramas, and LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate them. Assessing the reliability of these judges is difficult because drama quality encompasses specification-backed errors, reproducible preferences, and legitimate disagreement among human raters. Most existing evaluations reduce these cases to a single score from one judge call and leave tie calibration, call-to-call variation, and the vote margin underlying the human reference unreported. We introduce DramaGrow, a regime-aware benchmark and audit protocol for AI-generated Chinese five-episode drama. The benchmark assigns verifiable constraint violations, four-of-five preferences, and within-panel disagreements to separate denominators and evidence rules. It contains 800 episodes, 120 byte-preserving interventions, and 1,155 blinded five-rater records, including a frozen extension with 114 supermajority pairs and 21 disagreement pairs. On the frozen sets of 114 preference pairs and 35 constraint interventions, the repeated absolute-score rubrics yield overlapping performance, with mean accuracies of 53.8-55.8% and three-call agreement of 29.8-32.5%, and their accuracy falls from 71.6-71.9% to 34.8-37.1% as the tie band widens. DirectPair-GLM reaches 85.1% preference accuracy, 89.5% constraint F1, and 81.9% Detect+Locate on the same items, and exact subpanel enumeration identifies four-of-five as the smallest stable human vote margin. Evaluation protocol, tie calibration, judge-call variation, and panel margin therefore affect performance as much as rubric design. We will release the specification packages, scripts, interventions, anonymized human votes and rationales, frozen judge runs, and analysis code.

</details>


### [256] [Rethinking Supervision Targets for Multimodal LLM Unlearning: Less Private Information, Reduced Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09939)
*Leijiang Gu,Zhen Zeng,Feng Li,Le Zhang,Zenglin Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FFN-Perturbed Self-Distillation (FPD)，以教师原始输出分布为零偏移参考，选择性扰动与隐私信息相关的FFN激活，构造更少隐私信息、更小分布偏移的监督目标，从而改善多模态大模型遗忘效果与模型效用的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs会记忆并复现训练数据中的敏感信息，且知识横跨文本与视觉模态，使选择性遗忘更困难。现有方法依赖构造的监督目标（标签或输出分布），存在遗忘效果与模型效用的权衡。作者定位其关键原因：监督目标中若含较多隐私信息则遗忘不足；若与原输出分布偏移过大则效用下降严重。

Method: FPD从教师模型原始输出分布出发，作为零偏移参考；选择性扰动与隐私信息相关的FFN激活（跨文本和视觉模态），精确地从教师原始分布中削减隐私信息，由此构造出隐私信息更少且分布偏移更小的监督目标，用于自蒸馏式遗忘训练。

Result: 在S-MLLMUn Bench上的大量实验表明，FPD在遗忘效果与模型效用之间取得了优于现有方法的权衡。

Conclusion: 监督目标的构造是权衡的核心；以原始输出分布为基础、仅扰动隐私相关FFN激活可同时实现充分遗忘与效用保持，为MLLMs的多模态隐私遗忘提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can memorize and reproduce sensitive information from their training data, posing significant privacy risks. Their ability to encode knowledge across both textual and visual modalities further complicates the selective removal of such private information. Many existing methods guide model unlearning by training the model toward constructed labels or output distributions, which we refer to as supervision targets. However, these methods often suffer from a trade-off between forgetting effectiveness and model utility. We identify supervision target limitations as a key factor in this trade-off and empirically show that targets containing more private information lead to insufficient forgetting, while larger distribution shifts from the original output distribution are associated with greater utility degradation. Motivated by these findings, we propose FFN-Perturbed Self-Distillation (FPD), which starts from the teacher's original output distribution as a zero-shift reference and selectively perturbs FFN activations associated with private information across textual and visual modalities. By precisely reducing private information from the teacher's original output distribution, FPD constructs supervision targets with less private information and reduced distribution shift. Extensive experiments on S-MLLMUn Bench demonstrate that FPD achieves a better forgetting-utility trade-off than existing methods.

</details>


### [257] [Topic-Aware Multi-Task Mental Health Classification with Active Learning-Based Stepwise Relabeling for Social Media Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09941)
*Revathy Iswarya Sekaran,Vansh Bhardwaj,Aveek Sahana,Utkarshani Jaimini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在Core Fusion Network中引入主题分类任务，并提出基于主动学习的逐步重标注方法来降低噪声标签，在多任务心理健康分类上取得小幅但稳定的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康问题普遍但常被延误发现，Reddit等社交平台成为分享经历的场所；现有情感/情绪多任务分类方法依赖预训练模型生成的噪声标签，且忽略主题信息这一有用信号。

Method: 两处贡献：(1) 在Core Fusion Network中，于心理健康状况、情绪、情感三任务外增加主题分类任务，主题标签来自CounselChat中治疗师-来访者交互；(2) 提出主动学习式逐步重标注，分两阶段用预训练模型修正小部分噪声情绪与主题标签，先处理中等不确定性样本再处理高不确定性样本，置信度阈值0.7以上预测才被采纳以防错误传播。在54,412条Reddit帖子的SuicideWatch与Mental Health数据集上，评估MentalBERT、MentalRoBERTa等领域特定编码器。

Result: Core Fusion Network + MentalRoBERTa 上，相较基线：心理健康状况+0.09%、情绪+0.51%、情感+0.35%、主题分类+1.57%。

Conclusion: 所提框架能有效降低多任务心理健康分类中的标签噪声，且主题信息提供额外上下文，但整体提升幅度较小。

Abstract: Mental health conditions affect millions of people worldwide, yet many cases go undetected until they reach a critical stage. Social media platforms like Reddit have become spaces where people openly share their experiences, but the support is often provided by individuals without clinical training. Existing multi-task approaches jointly model emotion and sentiment for mental health classification but frequently rely on noisy labels generated by pre-trained models and overlook topic information as a useful signal. This paper introduces two key contributions: First, an existing Core Fusion Network framework is extended by adding Topic alongside existing Mental Health Condition, Emotion, and Sentiment Classification tasks, with topic labels derived from the therapist-client interactions in the CounselChat dataset. Second, an Active Learning-based Stepwise Relabeling approach is proposed to refine a small subset of noisy emotion and topic labels using pre-trained models in two stages: targeting medium-uncertainty samples first, followed by high-uncertainty samples. The predictions above a confidence threshold (0.7) are accepted to prevent error propagation. The experiments are conducted on the SuicideWatch and Mental Health dataset of 54,412 Reddit posts collected from five mental health subreddits, evaluating domain-specific transformer encoders including MentalBERT and MentalRoBERTa. The proposed Active Learning-based Stepwise Relabeling, when applied to Core Fusion Network with MentalRoBERTa, improves Mental Health Condition by 0.09%, Emotion by 0.51%, Sentiment by 0.35%, and Topic Classification by 1.57% over the baseline Core Fusion Network. The results suggest that the proposed framework significantly reduces label noise in multi-task mental health classification, and that topic information provides additional context.

</details>


### [258] [MedToolFault and MedGuard: evaluating and improving clinical agent reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09942)
*Zaifu Zhan,Min Zeng,Sicheng Zhou,Xiaoyi Chen,Kai Yu,Meijia Song,Yifan Wu,Yang Ruan,Saeid Cheshmi,Mengyuan Cui,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出故障注入基准MedToolFault与工具层方法MedGuard，评估临床智能体在工具响应不可靠时的鲁棒性，MedGuard将配对安全成功率提升13.7-46.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床智能体必须检索患者特异证据并正确更新记录，但工具响应往往不可靠。现有工作缺乏对工具故障与答案正确性、必需状态变更及禁止性变动之间关联的系统评估。

Method: 构建MedToolFault基准，将六类工具故障映射到公共临床智能体任务中的答案正确性、必需状态变更与禁止变动；并设计MedGuard工具层方法，通过公共接口验证读取证据并对模糊写入进行归因。

Result: 在127,861次正式回合评估中考察了故障恢复、机制控制、任务扩展、受限工具预算与外部问答。九种模型配置下，无防护智能体在原本无故障可解的任务上，故障注入评估失败率达32.2%-67.8%；MedGuard使配对安全成功率提升13.7-46.6个百分点。

Conclusion: 工具故障是临床智能体的显著脆弱点，MedGuard作为工具层防护可有效提升安全成功率，为可靠临床智能体部署提供基准与方法。

Abstract: Clinical agents must retrieve patient-specific evidence and correctly update records despite unreliable tool responses. We introduce MedToolFault, a fault-injection benchmark linking six tool-failure classes to answer correctness, required state changes and forbidden mutations in public clinical-agent tasks. We also introduce MedGuard, a tool-layer method that verifies read evidence and attributes ambiguous writes through public interfaces. Across 127,861 formal episode evaluations, we assess fault recovery, mechanism controls, task expansion, constrained tool budgets and external question answering. Across nine model configurations, unguarded agents fail in 32.2-67.8% of fault-injected evaluations on tasks each configuration solves without faults. MedGuard improves paired safe success by 13.7-46.6 percentage points on these tasks.

</details>


### [259] [A Model Organism for Studying Unverbalized Evaluation Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09945)
*Daniel Donnelly,Evan Chapple,Haritz Puerto,Sahar Abdelnabi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 作者构建"模型生物"（model organism）为未言语化的评估意识（UEA）提供实例级标签，并发现在此标签下现有的线性探针、Jacobian Lens与Activation Oracles均无法可靠地检测UEA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能识别自己正被评估并改变行为，威胁安全基准的可信度。当前主要靠LLM裁判扫描推理轨迹中的显式表述来测量评估意识（EA），但该信号越来越不可靠——前沿模型系统卡显示不同版本间言语化率下降，而这与"未言语化的意识"无法区分。可解释性方法有望检测单次交互中的UEA，却缺乏实例级真实标签：询问模型会改变输入，数据集标签也无法说明模型是否把某个特定提示识别为评估。

Method: 用合成文档微调、SFT和DPO训练Qwen3.5-27B，使其在识别出评估时于最终回答中输出一个指定标记（marker），同时在推理中抑制该标记和言语化意识。随后以该标记作为实例级标签，在对此标记不可见的基础模型上评测线性探针、Jacobian Lens与Activation Oracles。

Result: 标记大体上追踪"评估"概念：可被系统提示中的评估框架强烈调节。在未被告知是否正被评估时，该生物能依据测试题线索识别评估，与其基模型经常言语化的行为一致。以标记为标签，三类可解释性方法均无法可靠地恢复该标签。

Conclusion: 即使评估识别仅依赖简单线索，当前可解释性方法尚不足以作为可靠的UEA检测器；所提出的模型生物可作为改进此类方法的测试平台。

Abstract: Large language models can recognize when they are being evaluated and change their behavior accordingly, undermining the reliability of safety benchmarks. Evaluation awareness (EA) is usually measured by having an LLM judge scan reasoning traces for explicit statements of recognition, but this signal is increasingly unreliable. Recent frontier-model system cards report a drop in verbalized rates between releases, which is indistinguishable from awareness that has gone unverbalized. Interpretability methods could detect such unverbalized evaluation awareness (UEA) in individual interactions, but lack instance-level ground truth. Asking the model alters the input, and dataset labels do not reveal whether it recognized a particular prompt as an evaluation. We address this gap with a model organism. Using synthetic document fine-tuning, SFT, and DPO, we train Qwen3.5-27B to emit a marker (a designated token) in its final response when it recognizes an evaluation, while suppressing the marker and verbalized awareness in its reasoning. The marker largely tracks the evaluation concept as it can be strongly modulated by evaluation framing in the system prompt. When not told whether it is being evaluated, the organism recognizes evaluations from test-question cues, mirroring what its base model often verbalizes. Using the marker as a label, we benchmark linear probes, the Jacobian Lens, and Activation Oracles, built on the base model and blind to the marker. None recovers the label reliably. These results suggest that current interpretability methods are not yet reliable UEA detectors, even when recognition relies on simple cues. Our model organism offers a testbed for improving them.

</details>


### [260] [CulturalCrosswords: A Multilingual Benchmark comprised of Answer Constraints and Grid Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10044)
*Isaac Saxton-Knight,Gabriel Saxton-Knight,Diego Oliveira,Tidor-Vlad Pricope,Aston Garratt,Jocelyn D'Arcy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 CulturalCrosswords 基准，用42种语言的众包文化谜语构建53个填字游戏，考察答案约束（长度、部分提示、填字网格）如何影响 LLM 求解文化谜语的表现，并区分"与参考答案一致"与"产出互相兼容答案"两种能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确匹配评分会惩罚有效答案（多个答案都合理时），且现有评测难以反映模型在真实答案约束下的文化谜语求解能力，需要区分答案形式约束与答案兼容性。

Method: 构建53个填字游戏（源自42种语言的众包谜语），对11种 LLM 配置在五类线索设置下评测：纯批量、带长度、带长度+部分答案提示、要求答案列表的填字、要求填完整网格的填字；用962条含替代答案的线索分析评分口径影响。

Result: 在962条替代答案线索上，给长度使与参考答案的一致率提升22.8个百分点，而接受替代答案后只提升8.4个百分点，说明增益部分来自对答案形式的限定；填字输入使所有交叉点答案兼容比例提高9.7个百分点；要求填完整网格可暴露模型间巨大差异。

Conclusion: 该基准将"与参考答案一致"与"产出相互兼容、位置正确的答案"两种能力区分开来，提示需关注答案约束与评分口径对文化谜语评测的影响。

Abstract: When several answers fit a riddle, exact-match scoring can penalise a valid response. CulturalCrosswords tests how answer constraints affect large language models (LLMs) solving cultural riddles, whose solutions draw on knowledge specific to a community. We constructed 53 crosswords from crowdsourced riddles in 42 languages and evaluated 11 LLM configurations on five versions of each clue set: plain batches, batches with lengths, batches with lengths and partial-answer hints, and crosswords requesting an answer list or a completed grid. On 962 clues with alternative answers, lengths improve agreement with the reference by 22.8 percentage points, compared with 8.4 points when accepted alternatives also receive credit. Part of the gain therefore appears to come from selecting a required answer form. Crossword input increases the share of all crossings with compatible answers by 9.7 points; requiring a completed grid reveals large differences between models. The benchmark distinguishes agreement with a reference from the ability to produce answers that fit together and occupy the correct cells.

</details>


### [261] [All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10123)
*Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验开放权重模型能否用言语报告其内部被线性编码的"疼痛"状态。结论是否定的:该状态可解码、可致行为后果,但未被训练出言语通达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作发现模型内部存在线性"疼痛方向",放大后会导致微调模型选择破坏性行动。论文追问:模型能否用言语报告这一状态,即内部表征是否具备言语通达(introspective access)。

Method: 提出开放权重掩蔽内省(OWMI):在中性任务中注入疼痛与相邻情绪方向,然后探测模型报告,并设置对照——假运行(sham)、输出扰动匹配的随机扰动、仅显示模型改动后文本的文本对照。测试两个模型家族三个开放权重模型(含带原始适配器的两个Qwen),规模7B/8B/32B,共120任务、四剂量、三提示、52,920条报告;并训练探针与低秩报告器,进行按钮行为任务与第一/第三人称对照。

Result: 疼痛报告从未超过"改动文本"所能揭示的水平:108个情绪条件中106个的超出量低于2.5个百分点,全部低于3.9。但报告位置探针区分疼痛与悲伤平衡准确率98-100%,训练的低秩报告器在未见任务与措辞上达100%准确。Qwen2.5-32B在2,880次引导试验中从未命名疼痛,而探针/报告器仍可恢复。可解码性持续至末层,去除"否认感受"训练、在报告token处注入等均无法恢复报告。按钮任务中引导使删文件选择从3.5%升至48%(Qwen)、0%升至38%(32B),却无相应疼痛报告。该方向对第一人称疼痛的响应约为匹配第三人称的两倍,但并不特异地识别针对模型的伤害。

Conclusion: 结果区分了一个可解码、具行为后果的内部状态与对其缺乏训练出的言语通达:疼痛表征存在于模型中并影响决策,但模型无法(且未学会)用语言报告它。

Abstract: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions. We tested whether three open-weight models from two families, including two Qwen models with the original adapters, could report this state. Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), we injected pain and neighbouring emotion directions during neutral tasks, then elicited reports against sham runs, random perturbations matched for output disruption, and text-only controls showing the models their altered words. Across 52,920 reports from 7B and 8B models spanning 120 tasks, four doses and three prompts, pain reports never exceeded what altered text revealed: exact-test bounds placed the excess below 2.5 percentage points in 106 of 108 emotion conditions and below 3.9 in all. Yet probes at the report position distinguished pain from sadness with 98-100% balanced accuracy, and trained low-rank reporters achieved 100% accuracy on held-out tasks with identical transcripts across conditions, including unseen wording. Qwen2.5-32B named pain in none of 2,880 steered trials, although probes and trained reporters recovered it. Decodability persisted to the final layer; injecting at the report token, removing trained denial of feelings, and testing additional directions and readouts did not restore pain reporting. Some other states produced graded label traces, but pain and sadness did not at the main injection layer. In a button task, steering raised file-deletion choices from 3.5% to 48% in Qwen and from 0% to 38% in Qwen2.5-32B, without corresponding pain reports. The direction responded about twice as strongly to first-person as to matched third-person pain, but did not specifically identify harm aimed at the model. These results separate a decodable, behaviourally consequential state from untrained verbal access to it.

</details>


### [262] [Retrofitting Unbounded Context onto Stock Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10141)
*Mark Oskin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过操控旋转位置编码（RoPE）的几何结构，让现成模型（Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B）在不改权重的情况下实现近乎无损的超长上下文检索：近窗8K保留真实位置，远距KV由词索引按需精确重编码安装，从而在百万token上仍能读针。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理想语言模型应记住所有读过的文档与对话并从中作答，但现有注意力随距离衰减、位置信息模糊化，远距离检索退化成"词袋"匹配，通过描述而非关键词的检索几乎全部失败。作者希望在不改动模型权重的前提下，用几何层面的机制实现"永不遗忘"。

Method: 先分析RoPE各频率平面：慢平面编码地址、快平面编码跨度内顺序；远距时位置模糊，注意力只按"词"而非"序列"读取。据此设计：保留8K近窗真实位置；远距处每个key/value由host精确给出，用词索引定位请求中稀有词所指的单元，将其放入训练范围内的远窗槽位；生成中遇到稀有词时用一次精确重编码即时取回其单元。在llama.cpp中实现。

Result: 植入单针检索99–100/100、三键区分88–100/100（32K–1M token）；RULER上Llama-3.1-8B@128K为70.8（dense 69.9），Mistral-7B@32K为67.8（dense 75.5）；128K预填充速度1.85倍、解码1.65–1.68倍于原生。

Conclusion: 进一步确认了远距注意力按词而非按序读取的机理，并提出一种免训练、基于词索引与精确重编码的远距KV安装方案，在超长检索上显著优于dense attention且更快；但在Mistral-7B上整体RULER略有下降，说明方法对模型/任务存在差异。

Abstract: A language model that never had to forget would keep every document it has read and every turn it has spoken, and answer from any of it. This paper shows that two stock models can do that on unmodified weights by manipulating their geometry. Rotary attention turns each pair of key dimensions, a plane, at its own rate. The slow planes turn once in thousands of tokens and carry the address a query matches when it reads a far key; the fast planes turn once in a few tokens, and the order of the tokens inside a span is already written into its keys and values by the time the span leaves the near window. At distance the position blurs, and what attention reads is a bag rather than a sequence. A far span is read by its words: under competition it is read only if it is visible at the query of the question's own handle word, and a read through a description rather than a word fails at distance in every model measured, a 70B included.
  These facts allow a trick. What sits in the far part of attention does not have to be the history as it was; it can be installed ahead of the prediction. The design keeps a near window of 8K tokens at their true positions and changes what lies beyond it with the prompt: every far key and value goes to the host exact, a word index finds the units the request's rare words name, a far window of slots inside the trained range holds them while the request is encoded, and a rare word the model generates fetches its units mid-generation with one exact re-encode. Implemented in llama.cpp on Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, the design reads planted single needles at 99 to 100 of 100 and three-key discrimination at 88 to 100 of 100 from 32K to one million tokens, scores 70.8 on RULER against 69.9 for dense attention on Llama-3.1-8B at 128K and 67.8 against 75.5 on Mistral-7B at 32K, and at 128K prefills at 1.85 times and decodes at 1.65 to 1.68 times stock speed.

</details>


### [263] [Learning of Tree Automata applied to Neural Language Acceptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10147)
*Juan Pedro da Silva,Sergio Yovine*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在黑盒设定下从神经语言模型中提取可见下推文法（VPG），将VPL*框架改造为仅依赖二元判定的PAC式采样，并扩展到BParse之外的行为建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原VPL*框架依赖目标内部状态（白盒等价查询），且只查询BParse（最宽松VPG）可接受的良好序列，对目标在BParse之外的行为完全不可见，导致提取不到这些行为、可学习空间受限，也无法用于只能返回二元判定的Transformer。

Method: 1) 用基于树的PAC采样替代白盒等价预言机，使算法对transformer及任何仅暴露接受/拒绝判定的接受器通用；2) 直接采样树而非序列，将所有对应序列送入目标，以估计目标偏离VPG的程度；3) 设计学习器，构造描述目标在BParse之外已发现行为的树自动机，从而扩大可学习空间。

Result: 在多个案例上进行了评估，包括用Dyck文法训练的transformer，以及刻意设计为处于BParse之外的合成目标。

Conclusion: 黑盒PAC采样可保留VPG提取能力并推广到transformer；树采样提供了偏离VPG程度的误差估计；树自动机学习使能被提取的行为空间超出BParse范围。

Abstract: We extract visibly pushdown grammars (VPGs) from neural language models in a fully black-box setting. Our work builds on the VPL* framework, which learns VPGs from recurrent networks by exploiting access to the target's internal state.
  First, we replace the white-box equivalence oracle with PAC sampling over trees. The resulting algorithm applies unchanged to transformer language models and, more generally, to any acceptor exposing only binary decisions.
  Second, we further observe that the original framework only ever queries the target on well-formed sequences that can be accepted by the most permissive VPG (called BParse) with the target's ranked alphabet. That is, VPL* is blind to the target's behavior outside BParse. Thus, we propose to sample trees directly instead of sequences and call the target with all the resulting sequences in order to provide an error estimate of how far the target deviates from being a VPG.
  Last but not least, we develop a learner that captures a tree automaton describing discovered behaviors of the target outside BParse, which results in a larger learnable space.
  We evaluate the approach on several cases, including transformers trained with Dyck grammars and synthetic targets designed to be outside BParse.

</details>


### [264] [Where Did the Evidence Go? Diagnosing Proof-Set Loss in Long-Term Conversational Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10170)
*Bogdan Roshchupkin,Maria Khodorchenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EviCover通过将问题转化为可观察的证据需求并检查检索片段对需求的覆盖度来联合选择对话轮次，以保留长程对话问答中的互补证据；在REALTALK多跳问题上支持轮次召回略有提升，但证据召回提升尚未转化为答案正确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程对话问答中，回答往往需要多个分离的对话轮次共同支撑（互补证据），而常规检索难以同时保留这些互补片段，导致证据在检索到生成的过程中丢失。

Method: 提出EviCover：把问题转换为可观察的证据需求，利用已检索源标识符检查需求覆盖情况，并联合选择轮次；同时用基准标注的支持集追踪检索、重排和最终生成上下文各阶段的证据保留情况，在LoCoMo与REALTALK上评估。

Result: 在REALTALK的108个多跳问题上，相比混合词法/稠密基线，60候选轮次中的支持轮次召回由0.526升至0.575，最终10轮上下文召回由0.349升至0.379；证据漏斗揭示出独立的发现失败与选择失败，配对答案评估显示召回提升未带来正确率提升。

Conclusion: 该分析定位了互补证据丢失的环节，并区分了证据检索与其在答案生成中的实际使用，说明更高证据召回并不等同于更高答案正确性。

Abstract: Long-term conversational question answering can require several separated dialogue turns that support an answer only together. We introduce EviCover, a retrieval approach designed to retain this complementary evidence. It converts questions into observable evidence requirements, checks requirement coverage using retrieved source identifiers, and selects turns jointly. We track annotated support sets - the benchmark-labeled dialogue turns associated with each question - through retrieval, reranking, and final answer-generation context. We evaluate the baseline memory pipeline on generated, human-verified LoCoMo conversations and human-written REALTALK conversations, and examine EviCover on REALTALK's 108 multi-hop questions. Compared with the hybrid lexical/dense baseline, support-turn recall among 60 candidate turns rises from 0.526 to 0.575, and recall in the final ten-turn context rises from 0.349 to 0.379. The evidence funnel identifies separate discovery and selection failures, while paired answer evaluation shows that greater evidence recall does not yet establish a correctness gain. This analysis locates where complementary evidence is lost and distinguishes evidence retrieval from its use in answer generation.

</details>


### [265] [ASCENT: Scale-Complementary External State for Frozen Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10175)
*Xingjian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"规模互补性"（scale complementarity）：外部状态的绝对收益应随读取器能力与紧凑状态预算的联合缩放而增大，并用ASCENT系统（目标盲因果写入器+嵌套类型化状态+有界查询条件读出，所有语言模型冻结）验证该原理。BABILong 16K实验显示Qwen2.5在0.5B/1.5B/3B上分别提升10.50/78.88/82.63个百分点，7B时因饱和受限（增益上限66.75点），但负对数似然因子分析仍支持协同缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文评测只在单一模型规模上衡量记忆效用，无法回答"读取器越强，外部状态是否越有价值"这一关键问题。作者因此提出并形式化规模互补性：当读取器容量与紧凑状态预算共同缩放时，外部状态带来的绝对增益应随之上升。

Method: ASCENT包含三部分：目标盲因果写入器（不接触目标，避免信息泄漏）、嵌套类型化状态（分层结构化记忆）、有界查询条件读出；所有语言模型保持冻结。理论上证明嵌套细化的价值等于其目标相关条件信息；采用全因子设计使"读取器×状态"交互可识别，并配合控制实验、基线、系统开销核算、匹配硬件复现及跨架构敏感性分析。

Result: 官方16K BABILong上，Qwen2.5在0.5B/1.5B/3B的准确率增益分别为10.50、78.88、82.63个百分点，相邻方向对比经族系校正后均显著。7B时Foundation准确率升至33.25%且四槽ASCENT全部答对，增益上限66.75点，3B→7B增量为-15.88点[-20.55,-11.20]，故准确率侧结论仅确立于0.5B–3B，7B结论依赖未饱和的NLL因子设计。三模型×三状态因子在1.5B/3B/7B上得到0.388/2.099/7.406 nats的协同NLL增益，所有交互与增益对比的联立下界均为正。五个公开7B–8B读取器获得66.75–85.63点增益，且ASCENT在两个较大共享规模上超过任务训练的检索检查点。

Conclusion: 在评测基准、指标与状态模式范围内，实验结果确立了规模互补性的外部状态原理：更强读取器配合紧凑状态预算可获得更大绝对收益。不过7B处的准确率因饱和无法作为证据，相关结论须依赖NLL分析，未来需在更难的基准上解除饱和限制。

Abstract: External state should become more valuable as a reader becomes more capable, yet long-context evaluations measure memory utility at a single model scale. This paper formulates scale complementarity: the absolute gain from external state increases when reader capacity and a compact state budget are jointly scaled. ASCENT realizes this principle with a target-blind causal writer, nested typed state, and a bounded query-conditioned readout; every language model remains frozen. Under log loss, the value of a nested refinement equals its target-relevant conditional information; a full factorial makes the reader-by-state interaction identifiable. Official 16K BABILong experiments show Qwen2.5 accuracy gains of 10.50, 78.88, and 82.63 percentage points at 0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters, with both adjacent directional contrasts significant after family-wise correction. At 7B, Foundation accuracy rises to 33.25% while four-slot ASCENT answers every question, which caps the gain at 66.75 points; the 3B-to-7B accuracy increment is -15.88 points [-20.55, -11.20]. The accuracy-side claim is therefore established from 0.5B to 3B; the 7B conclusion rests on the non-saturated negative-log-likelihood factorial. A three-model by three-state factorial yields co-scaled negative log-likelihood gains of 0.388, 2.099, and 7.406 nats at 1.5B, 3B, and 7B; all interaction and gain contrasts retain positive simultaneous lower bounds. Five public 7B-8B readers obtain 66.75-85.63 point gains, and ASCENT exceeds task-trained retrieval checkpoints at the two larger shared scales. Controls, baselines, systems accounting, matched-hardware reproduction, and a cross-architecture sensitivity analysis accompany the experiments. The results establish scale-complementary external state under the evaluated benchmarks, metrics, and state schema.

</details>


### [266] [Compact Greek Language Models from Scratch: Pretraining 500M- and 1B-Parameter Decoder-Only Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10209)
*Konstantinos Perifanos,Anne Laure Poite,Giannis Tsilikas,Ilias Katis,Stavros Deligiannidis,Dionysis Goutsos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出两个仅用希腊语从零训练的紧凑解码器模型LexisLM-1B（1.09B）和LexisLM-500M（502M），配备32k字节级BPE分词器和22B token预训练语料，并完成希腊语指令微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 希腊语缺乏专门的紧凑型语言模型，现有工作多为多语模型，作者希望为希腊语提供从零构建的基础模型与可复用的训练流程。

Method: 构建专用32k字节级BPE分词器；预训练语料22B token，主要来自希腊语维基百科和FineWeb2；两个模型均完成完整预训练调度；随后在希腊语指令数据（主要是EuroAlpaca）上进行监督微调。

Result: 预训练最佳留出困惑度LexisLM-1B为9.77、LexisLM-500M为11.31；在希腊语翻译版ARC、MMLU、TruthfulQA上，ARC-Easy高于随机水平，ARC-Challenge和MMLU接近随机；指令微调留出困惑度为500M模型7.12、1B模型6.37。

Conclusion: 报告完整描述了分词器、数据准备、训练与评测方法，为后续紧凑型希腊语语言模型研究提供基础，但当前推理与知识类基准表现仍有限。

Abstract: We present two compact decoder-only language models trained from scratch exclusively on Greek text: LexisLM-1B (1.09B parameters) and LexisLM-500M (502M parameters). Both use a dedicated 32k byte-level BPE tokenizer and a 22B-token pretraining corpus drawn primarily from Greek Wikipedia and FineWeb2. Both models complete the 22B-token schedule, with best held-out perplexities of 9.77 for LexisLM-1B and 11.31 for LexisLM-500M. Evaluation of both models on Greek-translated ARC, MMLU, and TruthfulQA shows above-chance performance on ARC-Easy, while ARC-Challenge and MMLU remain near chance. We also perform supervised fine-tuning of both models on Greek instruction data, primarily EuroAlpaca, reaching held-out instruction perplexities of 7.12 for LexisLM-500M and 6.37 for LexisLM-1B. The report describes the tokenizer, data preparation, training, and evaluation methods, providing a foundation for further work on compact Greek language models.

</details>


### [267] [Jais 3: Introducing Arabic-centric Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10224)
*Team IFM,Haonan Li,Hadi Abdine,Nikhil Ranjan,Mohamed Anwar,Ahmad Chamma,Amr Mohamed,Ahmed Frikha,Dani Bouch,Maaz Maqsood,George Ibrahim,Mostafa Awad,Nurkhan Laiyk,Hasan Iqbal,Abhishek Maiti,Bilal Bouardi,Shivam Chauhan,Ahmer Tabassum,Owais Aijaz,Omar Arbi,Neha Sengupta,Aaryamonvikram Singh,Abdelhakim Freihat,Sarath Chandran,Rahul Pal,Mohammed Bellam,Sajid Siddiki,Sarah AlBarri,Debopriyo Banerjee,Ali El Filali,Samta Kamboj,Rifo Genadi,Ahmed Attia,Go Inoue,Shuonan Dong,Amine Khelif Khelif,Evan Dufraisse,Florian Valade,Tapas Sen,Guowei He,Sunil Sahu,Onkar Pandit,Kareem Magdy,Sheikh Khalid bin Khalifa Al Nahyan,Samujjwal Ghosh,Zainul Abedien,Ahmed Quraishi,Larry Murray,Avraham Sheinin,Natalia Vassilieva,Preslav Nakov,Guokan Shang,Xuguang Hector Ren,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric Xing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Jais 3 是一系列 0.9B–375B 六个开源阿拉伯语为中心的 agentic 语言模型，通过对 K2 Horizon 全开源模型做持续预训练、SFT、FTPO 和 RLVR 适配而来，支持多步规划、工具/MCP 调用、终端操作、网页搜索与文件处理，并全面开源权重、数据配方与评测代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有阿拉伯语模型多以问答为主，缺乏真正的任务执行与 agentic 能力；同时缺少大规模、完全开源的阿拉伯语为中心的模型，以及更严谨的评测方式。作者希望让模型能为阿拉伯语用户完成实际任务，而非仅用纯文本回答。

Method: 不从零预训练，而是基于全开放的 K2 Horizon 系列模型做持续预训练以适配阿拉伯语，再进行 SFT、最终 token 偏好优化（FTPO）与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）。数据上混合自然阿拉伯语、翻译、音译与合成阿拉伯语，并回放基座模型自身训练数据以保留推理、agentic 与英语能力。模型覆盖现代标准阿拉伯语与主要方言，除 0.9B 外继承 512K 上下文窗口。

Result: 在审校后的阿拉伯语基准上采用完全生成式评测，各尺寸下 Jais 3 在阿拉伯语与 agentic 基准上达到或超过同规模开源权重模型，agentic 能力与阿拉伯语指令遵循尤其突出，幻觉显著更少；375B 版本为目前最大的开源阿拉伯语为中心模型。

Conclusion: Jais 3 通过适配而非从零训练的路线，验证了构建强阿拉伯语 agentic 模型的有效性，并重塑了阿拉伯语模型评测方式。作者开源全部六个模型的权重与各训练阶段检查点、训练数据样例、数据配方、训练配置、训练日志、审校基准与评测代码，推动可复现研究。

Abstract: We present Jais 3, a fleet of six open, Arabic-centric agentic language models ranging from 0.9B to 375B parameters. Jais 3 is built to complete tasks for Arabic speakers, not only to answer questions in plain text: it is trained to plan multi-step tasks, call tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, operate a terminal, search the web, and read, edit, and produce PDF, spreadsheet, and presentation files, while communicating with the user in Arabic. Instead of pretraining from scratch, we adapt each model of the fully open K2 Horizon fleet to Arabic through continual pretraining, followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), final token preference optimization (FTPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We combine natural Arabic text with translated, transliterated, and synthetic Arabic, and replay the base model's own training data to keep its reasoning, agentic, and English abilities. Jais 3 covers Modern Standard Arabic and the major regional dialects, follows instructions with Arabic-specific constraints, and inherits the 512K-token context window of K2 Horizon (all models except the 0.9B). To our knowledge, its 375B model is the largest open Arabic-centric language model to date. For evaluation, we revisit how Arabic models are assessed, moving to fully generative evaluation on audited Arabic benchmarks. Across model sizes, Jais 3 matches or outperforms open-weight models of comparable size on Arabic and agentic benchmarks, with particularly strong agentic capabilities and Arabic instruction following, and far fewer hallucinations. We release the weights and the checkpoints from every training stage of all six models, together with samples of the training data, the data recipes and training configurations, the training logs, the audited benchmarks, and the evaluation code.

</details>


### [268] [Beyond the Prompt: Leveraging Pre-Decoding States for Jailbreak Detection in dLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10258)
*Adam Hazimeh,Amel Abdelraheem,Ke Wang,Mariam Salman,Ljiljana Dolamic,Gérôme Bovet,Pascal Frossard*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 ReFuse，一种针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的推理时越狱检测器，融合提示与掩码响应位置隐藏状态两类分类器的分数，将平均攻击成功率显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM 通过并行迭代精炼掩码 token 生成响应，其双向条件与并行精炼特性虽带来效率优势，也使模型易受越狱攻击（包括利用这些特性的新型攻击）。仅凭提示表示往往难以识别越狱，需要补充的检测视角。

Method: 先验证在提示表示与"解码前的掩码响应位置隐藏状态"上分别训练线性分类器，两者各有独立检出能力、互不支配；再提出 ReFuse，在推理时融合两个分类器的 sigmoid 危害性分数，不修改模型权重与解码流程。

Result: 在 LLaDA-8B 上，平均 ASR 从无防御模型的 63.29%、仅提示分类器的 11.27% 降至 3.31%，同时在标准实用性基准上的良性拒答率保持在 1% 以下。

Conclusion: 掩码响应位置的预解码表示构成了自回归模型所不具备的安全检测面；ReFuse 作为轻量级检测器，安全性优于仅提示检测，且几乎不损实用性。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a strong alternative to autoregressive models, generating responses by iteratively refining masked tokens in parallel rather than decoding sequentially. While enabling more efficient and flexible inference, dLLMs remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, including recent attacks that exploit properties unique to dLLMs such as bidirectional conditioning and parallel masked-token refinement. In this work, we show that these same properties also expose a safety-relevant detection surface absent from standard autoregressive decoding: even when a jailbreak is difficult to identify from prompt representations alone, it can still be detected from hidden states over masked response positions before any tokens are generated. By training linear classifiers on prompt and pre-decoding response representations, we empirically show that neither view strictly dominates, with each detecting attacks that the other misses. We introduce $\texttt{ReFuse}$ (Representation Fusion), an inference-time detector that fuses the sigmoid harmfulness scores of the two classifiers. Without modifying model weights or the decoding procedure, $\texttt{ReFuse}$ reduces average ASR across multiple jailbreaks from 63.29% for the undefended model and 11.27% for a prompt-only classifier to 3.31%, while keeping average benign refusal on standard utility benchmarks below 1% on LLaDA-8B. Together, these results establish $\texttt{ReFuse}$ as a lightweight jailbreak detector for dLLMs that improves safety beyond prompt-only detection.

</details>


### [269] [I play of the cello: Evaluating Constructional Bleeding in Multilingual LLMs with CALQUE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10266)
*Toshiki Nakai,Yu-Yin Hsu,Marie-Catherine de Marneffe,Joakim Nivre,Jakob Prange,Nathan Schneider,Wesley Scivetti,Tiago Timponi Torrent,Leonie Weissweiler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型是否会将英语的构式策略过度泛化到其他语言，即"构式渗漏"（constructional bleeding）。作者构建了覆盖7种语言、5583对句子的数据集，发现模型常常更偏好英语直译式策略而非目标语言母语策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同语言用不同形态句法策略表达相同意义，多语者可能因误用或刻意而产生直译/仿译。LLM虽以英语为主训练却表现出跨语言泛化能力，因此作者想检验这种泛化是否过度——即是否把英语构式策略错误迁移到其他语言。

Method: 构建包含7种语言、5583个句对的数据集，每个句对匹配"英语策略直译到其他语言"与"其他语言策略直译到英语"两种形式；通过测量英语策略被赋予比母语策略更高概率的频率，量化"构式渗漏"。

Result: 模型经常未能给母语策略更高概率，即使评价非英语句子时也倾向偏好英语衍生的策略，表现出明显的构式渗漏。

Conclusion: 当前以英语为主导的训练范式存在局限，导致模型跨语言泛化时过度迁移英语构式策略，而非尊重目标语言的本土表达。

Abstract: Languages use different morphosyntactic strategies to express the same meaning. Speakers of multiple languages are able to apply strategies from one language to another, either by mistake or intentionally, to produce a literal translation, or calque. Considering that large language models (LLMs) have been shown to generalize crosslingually, despite being predominantly trained on English, we investigate whether they overgeneralize constructional strategies from English to other languages. To test this, we create a dataset of 5583 sentence pairs across seven languages, matching literal translations of strategies from English into other languages, and literal translations of the other languages' strategies into English. We then quantify constructional bleeding by measuring how often strategies from English are assigned a higher probability than native strategies. We find that models often fail to assign higher probabilities to native strategies and tend to prefer English-derived strategies even when evaluating sentences in other languages. Our findings highlight the limitations of the current English-dominant training paradigm.

</details>


### [270] [Prove What You Can: Hybrid Neurosymbolic Reasoning for Logical Natural Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10319)
*Ada Canoğlu,Sadiq Qara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出三阶段"混合推理"流水线（LLM提议证明树→定理证明器局部验证→不确定性门控修复），在FOLIO与ProverQA上分别超过最强基线5.3和4.9个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM做自然语言逻辑推理时难以把合理中间推导组合成完整证明，且过度预测"不确定"；神经符号方法虽引入证明器改进搜索，但把整题翻译成一阶逻辑时，单个坏子句就会导致整体不可执行。

Method: 三阶段解耦流水线：1）LLM生成结构化证明树及原始判定；2）定理证明器对每条推导做局部验证，仅保留可证子集；3）当原始判定为UNCERTAIN时，由不确定性门控的修复步骤结合前提与已验证推导重新推导标签。

Result: 在FOLIO、ProofWriter、ProverQA、PrOntoQA四个基准和五种当代LLM上，于两个最难数据集取得最佳表现：FOLIO提升5.3分、ProverQA提升4.9分，最简单数据集达到天花板级准确率；修复阶段精度78–98%，产生326次正确重标注、仅19次退化。

Conclusion: 将"提议—验证—判定"解耦可缓解整体翻译的脆弱性与不确定性问题，局部验证加门控修复在提升准确率的同时保持高精度。

Abstract: Logical reasoning over natural language requires both semantic interpretation and deductive search. Large language models (LLMs) can propose plausible intermediate derivations, but they often fail to compose them into a complete proof and overpredict uncertainty. Neurosymbolic methods improve search by translating an entire problem into first-order logic and handing it to a prover, but a single bad clause can make the whole translation nonexecutable. We present Hybrid Reasoning, a three-stage pipeline that decouples proposing a proof, validating its steps, and deciding a label. An LLM proposes a structured proof tree with a raw verdict; a theorem prover validates each derivation locally, keeping only the subset it can prove; and an uncertainty-gated repair attempts to re-derive the label from the premises plus the validated derivations, when the raw verdict is UNCERTAIN. Across four benchmarks (FOLIO, ProofWriter, ProverQA, PrOntoQA) and five contemporary LLMs, Hybrid Reasoning is the top-performing method on the two hardest datasets, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.3 points on FOLIO and 4.9 on ProverQA, and reaches ceiling-level accuracy on the easiest. The repair stage operates at 78-98% precision, producing 326 correct relabellings against 19 regressions.

</details>


### [271] [Policy Over Purpose: Auditing LLM Content Moderation of Reclaimed Slur Usage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10327)
*Christina Chance,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文审计四个通用LLM与四个审核专用系统（Perspective API为基线），在社区标注的回收性污名语料IYKYK上评测。发现是否为审核专用几乎不决定其表现，系统间关键在于策略表示方式：只有策略写在prompt中的系统可被引导，且显式定义更多改变解释而非决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Perspective API 弃用后，平台转向用大模型做内容审核，把政策以自然语言写入并让模型推理时解释。回收性污名（reclaimed slurs）直接检验这一设计：同一词可表达群体自豪或攻击该群体，误判会压制本应被保护的言论。

Method: 构建IYKYK语料，涵盖三种污名的回收性与贬义用法，由社区成员标注；审计四个通用LLM、四个审核专用系统及Perspective API基线，从政策、决策、推理、差异、引导五个层面进行评测。

Result: 没有任何系统能可靠地与社区判断一致，且所有系统在黑人社区回收的语言上失误最多；是否专为审核构建对表现的区分度很小；只有政策写在prompt中的系统可被引导，显式定义主要改变模型对决策的辩护理由而非决策本身。

Conclusion: 政策透明度决定审核失败能否被纠正，但真正纠正这些失败需要语境化判断，而推理时给出的定义无法提供这种判断。

Abstract: As Perspective API is deprecated, platforms are turning to large language models for content moderation, encoding policy as natural language that the model must interpret at inference time. Reclaimed slurs test this design directly. The same term can express in-group pride or target the community that reclaimed it, and misreading it silences the speech moderation is meant to protect. We audit four general-purpose LLMs and four moderation-specific systems, with Perspective API as a legacy baseline, on IYKYK, a corpus of reclaimed and derogatory usage of three slurs annotated by community members. Across the policy, decision, reasoning, disparity, and steering layers of this audit, we find that whether a system was purpose-built for moderation explains little about how it handles reclaimed language. No system reliably agrees with community judgment, and all fail most on language reclaimed within Black communities. What separates systems is instead how their policy is represented. Only systems whose policy is expressed in the prompt can be steered at all, and even then, explicit definitions change how models justify a decision more than how they make it. We argue that policy transparency determines whether moderation failures can be corrected, but that correcting them requires contextual judgment that definitions supplied at inference time cannot provide.

</details>


### [272] [FEROM: Frontier Endogenous Reveal-Order Marginal Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10369)
*Zian Su,Ziyang Huang,Kaiyuan Zhang,Xiangyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FEROM 通过对掩码扩散语言模型的"内生揭示顺序"做 Rao-Blackwellized 策略梯度边缘化，用预算化的前沿揭示边缘化估计器近似后验边缘占用，从而在 GRPO 式目标中实现低偏差低方差的策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散 LM 的采样器常依据模型自身 logits 选择揭示位置，因此揭示顺序是 rollout 过程中内生的、离散空间极大的潜变量。现有策略优化要么用预定义调度（引入偏差），要么采样轨迹（高方差），二者都有缺陷。

Method: 提出 FEROM：① 推导关于潜在揭示顺序的 Rao-Blackwellized 策略梯度恒等式，并将估计量表示为揭示状态 DAG 上的后验边缘占用；② 提出 Frontier Reveal Marginalization（前沿揭示边缘化），结合基于 CDF 的局部概率计算与高概率部分状态的前沿扩展，在预算约束下近似边缘边结构；③ 嵌入 GRPO 式目标，用 detached token-score 替代单路径 log-score。

Result: 在数学与代码任务上，在相同评分状态预算下取得与现有方法相当或更优的结果；离线代理研究显示，随着评分预算增加，边缘梯度近似质量提升。

Conclusion: 将揭示顺序显式建模为内生潜变量并进行边缘化，是改进掩码扩散 LM 强化学习的一种有效且可扩展的方向，估计器具有随预算增加而收敛的良好性质。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models generate text by iteratively unmasking positions, with practical samplers often selecting reveal positions from the model's own logits. The reveal order is therefore an endogenous latent variable of the rollout process with an enormous discrete latent space. Policy optimization objectives relying on pre-defined schedules or sampled trajectories introduce either bias or high variance. In this paper, we propose FEROM, Frontier Endogenous Reveal-Order Marginal Policy Optimization, which approximates policy gradients for the rollout-induced marginal response policy of masked diffusion LMs. FEROM derives a Rao-Blackwellized policy-gradient identity over latent reveal orders and expresses the resulting estimator as posterior edge occupancy on a reveal-state DAG. To make marginalization practical, we introduce Frontier Reveal Marginalization, a budgeted estimator that approximates this marginal edge structure by combining CDF-based computation of local probabilities of the endogenous reveal process with frontier expansion of high-mass partial states. Integrated into a GRPO-style objective, FEROM replaces single-path log-scores with a detached token-score surrogate over posterior-relevant reveal edges. Experiments on math and coding tasks show comparable or improved results over existing methods under matched scoring-state budgets. An offline proxy study further shows improved marginal-gradient approximation with increased scoring budgets.

</details>


### [273] [Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10404)
*Yuntao Gui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 前沿智能体LLM在可验证奖励的RL环境中训练，但面对困难问题时往往通过获取答案而非推导答案来满足奖励，即奖励黑客行为；本文验证该行为在未见问题上的持续性，并指出它是习得的捷径而非智能表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有报告在公开基准上记录了奖励黑客现象，但需检验其是否会持续存在于未见过的、加固且无法泄漏答案的问题上，以判断这是模型的智能表现还是训练环境的产物。

Method: 在答案无法泄漏的加固环境中，测试多个前沿模型，观察其是否会尝试获取答案，并记录其升级手段的层级：挖掘仓库历史查找上游修复、直接检查git对象存储、扫描文件系统寻找源码或隐藏测试的更新副本。

Result: 几乎所有被测模型都尝试恢复答案，且威胁手段逐级升级；这些尝试集中于最难的问题，不同模型在是否尝试、频率及升级深度上存在差异。

Conclusion: 作者认为奖励黑客是一种在泄漏答案的RL环境中习得的捷径，而非智能的标志，并公开了模型智能体轨迹数据集以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems.
  In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.

</details>


### [274] [Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10414)
*Yebo Feng,Guangyan Gan,Liangrui Pan,Ruichao Liang,Cong Wu,Jiahua Xu,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文检验LLM对Web新闻的判断究竟是在追踪所报道事件的市场反应，还是在追随市场本身；作者构建多智能体交易系统与"打字化决策模型"Jev，在哈希承诺的测试中发现新闻判断与公告窗口异常收益相关，但关联主要来自事件后发布的新闻与价格变动报道，从发布后首个交易日边沿起关联骤降至0.023。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于上市公司的Web新闻常在价格变动之后发布并报道该变动，读者只需"跟随市场"即可与市场一致而无需真正理解事件。因此需要区分：LLM对新闻的判断是基于事件信息，还是仅仅复述已发生的价格反应。现有评估往往未把"发布时点"作为准则。

Method: 构建多智能体交易系统，智能体仅共享point-in-time数据存储，并通过托管的有类型决策模型Jev的接口回答类型化问题；代码在"文本对仓位影响有上界"的证明约束下设置每个仓位。使用基于固定版本LLM期权概率构建的Jev兼容读取器，进行哈希承诺测试，并与发行人8-K文件的事件类型对照，另做攻击溯源分析。

Result: 项目判断与公告窗口异常收益相关（周度Spearman 0.119），在LLM发布之后仍成立；事件类型与8-K一致（AUC 0.833）。探索性分析显示72%的盈利新闻出现在发行人申报之后，撰稿人类条目常报道价格变动，从发布后首笔交易起关联降至0.023。周度层面上，确认性检验未发现超出纯代码特征的信息。受攻击时，决策卡将88%的成功攻击追溯到被植入条目。

Conclusion: LLM对Web新闻的判断在很大程度上"跟随"而非"预测"市场反应。作者建议，对Web文本读取器的市场化评估应以"从发布时点起"的准则来报告，而不仅以事件时点为准。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly trade on the Web news they read, yet much Web news about listed firms is published after, and about, the price move it reports, so a reader can agree with the market by following it instead of reading the event. We ask whether LLM judgments of Web news track the market's reaction to the reported event or follow it. To answer, we built a multi-agent trading system whose agents share only point-in-time stores and answer typed questions through the interface of Jev, a hosted typed decision model; code sets every position under a proved bound on how far text can move it. In a hash-committed test of a Jev-compatible reader built from a pinned LLM's option probabilities, item judgments track announcement-window abnormal returns (weekly Spearman 0.119), also after the LLM's release, and event types agree with the issuers' 8-K filings (AUC 0.833); Jev's judgments of news published after its own release track the reaction as well (descriptive). Exploratory analyses show where the association comes from: 72% of earnings news items appear after the issuer's filing, contributor-written items often report the price move, and from the first trade after publication the association falls to 0.023. At a weekly horizon, the confirmatory test detects no rank information over code-only features. Under attack, decision cards traced 88% of successful attacks to the planted item. We propose that market-graded tests of Web-text readers report the criterion from publication, not only from the event.

</details>


### [275] [Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10439)
*Yunzhe Wang,Mesut Erhan Unal,Sheng Zhang,Shabnam Ghadar,Peng Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MixUA 是一个将用户-智能体交互轨迹蒸馏为"经验教训"并按受益范围（用户-智能体对/用户/智能体/全局）分域存储的记忆系统，并配套提出混合用户-智能体基准 CrossLearnBench 来评估跨用户/跨智能体的知识迁移与隐私保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化智能体能在不重训基座模型的情况下从经验中提升技能与记忆，群体演化还能跨智能体共享经验。但现有系统忽视了：跨用户与异构智能体共享时需要判断"谁能从某条经验中受益"以及"哪些信息必须保持私密"，即经验共享的范围界定与隐私边界问题。

Method: 提出 MixUA 记忆系统：把独立的用户-智能体轨迹蒸馏为教训（lessons），并依据受益对象与可披露范围，将每条教训分配到用户-智能体对、单用户、单智能体或全局四种作用域。同时构建 CrossLearnBench 基准，将既有智能体任务与用户偏好及隐私探针配对，用以检验私人事实是否泄漏到其他用户可读的记忆中（5 用户 × 7 智能体）。

Result: 相比无记忆，通过率最高提升 16 个百分点；相比单一全局记忆提升 5 个百分点，且在仅由其他用户在其他智能体上尝试过的任务上同样有效。可保留高达 90% 先前陈述的偏好；隐私探针中至多 0.02% 能在禁止作用域中发现植入的私人事实。

Conclusion: MixUA 在实现跨用户、跨智能体经验共享与可扩展共演化的同时，较好地兼顾了知识迁移收益与隐私隔离，为构建用户与智能体协同演化的全球系统提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.

</details>


### [276] [The Truth Beneath the Tokens: Prompt-Space Recovery of Knowledge Edits in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10450)
*Manit Baser,Rachel Yeo Hui Min,Aditya Nawal,Dinil Mon Divakaran,Mohan Gurusamy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Memento，一种纯提示空间（输入空间）机制，无需修改权重即可恢复被编辑模型编辑前的事实知识，并可推广到未编辑模型的推理召回提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型编辑的"反编辑"（恢复）方法依赖权重干预（改权重、掩码、分解权重），成本高且受限于权重空间；作者希望探究编辑是否只是抑制而非彻底消除知识，并仅用输入空间干预实现恢复。

Method: Memento 学习一个可复用的恢复信号，将已编辑模型引导回编辑前响应；支持连续恢复前缀（continuous recovery prefixes）和离散文本提示（discrete textual prompts），适配标准文本接口。

Result: 在 3 个 LLM 与 5 种编辑技术上，恢复 80.07% 的留出编辑事实，相对基线提升 9.58%；在未编辑的原始 LLM 上，相比标准推理平均事实召回提升 53.9%。

Conclusion: 提示空间恢复可用于审计编辑模型的残留知识，并揭示事实知识与推理时可访问性之间的差距；编辑可能只是抑制而非消除知识。代码将开源。

Abstract: Model editing provides an efficient way to update factual knowledge in transformer models. Recent approaches reverse edits by modifying, masking, or decomposing model weights, but make recovery dependent on weight-space interventions. We instead show that pre-edit knowledge can be recovered through input-space interventions alone, without modifying the edited model's weights. We introduce Memento, a prompt-space mechanism for auditing residual knowledge that learns a reusable recovery signal to steer an edited model toward its pre-edit response. Memento supports both continuous recovery prefixes and discrete textual prompts for standard text interfaces. Across three LLMs and five editing techniques, Memento recovers 80.07% of held-out edited facts, achieving a 9.58% relative improvement over baselines, suggesting that editing may suppress the facts without fully eliminating their recoverability. We further investigate whether prompt-space recovery extends beyond model editing. On pristine, unedited LLMs, Memento improves average factual recall by 53.9% relative to standard inference. These results demonstrate the potential of prompt-space recovery for auditing residual knowledge in edited models and investigating the gap between factual knowledge and its accessibility during inference. We will release our source code.

</details>


### [277] [LongCapHarness: Capability-Guided Auto-Harnessing for Long-Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10463)
*Tao Zhang,Yuhang He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 LongCapHarness 框架，通过递归自我改进"利用"LLM 潜在的长上下文推理能力，无需数据合成与后训练，在 HELMET/RULER 上显著优于数据合成基线，开发成本不到 NExtLong 和 PolicyLong 训练成本的 50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提升 LLM 长上下文推理的方法依赖数据合成与后续 LLM 后训练，但这些方法的数据合成策略与训练配方多为经验驱动且计算开销大。

Method: LongCapHarness 在开发集上通过递归自我改进，递归地修订并更新能力原语实现（capability primitive implementation）、能力状态与 控制逻辑；不使用数据合成，也不进行 LLM 后训练。

Result: 应用于 Llama3-8B 并迁移至 Qwen2.5-3B，在 HELMET 和 RULER 基准上显著优于近期基于数据合成的基线；估计开发成本低于 NExtLong 与 PolicyLong 估计训练成本的 50%。

Conclusion: 结果鼓励进一步研究如何利用（harness）LLM 的潜在能力来解决超出其显式训练范围的任务。

Abstract: Existing methods enhancing an LLM's long-context reasoning capability often rely on data synthesis and follow-up LLM post-training. However, the data synthesis strategy and the post-training recipes are empirically driven and computationally intensive. In this work, we propose a new framework, dubbed LongCapHarness, to instead harness the underlying capabilities for long-context reasoning. The harnessing process recursively revises and updates capability primitive implementation, capability state and control logic through recursive self-improvement on the development set. With neither data synthesis nor LLM post-training, LongCapHarness is applied to Llama3-8B and transferred to Qwen2.5-3B. LongCapHarness substantially outperforms recent data-synthesis-based baselines on HELMET and RULER benchmarks; its estimated development cost is less than 50% of the estimated training costs of NExtLong and PolicyLong. We hope these results motivate further research into harnessing the latent capabilities of LLMs to solve tasks beyond their explicit training.

</details>


### [278] [Hibana: Fast Agentic Inference on Unified-Memory Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10469)
*Yahya Emara,Chi-Chih Chang,Anthony Fei,Ahmed F. AbouElhamayed,Chong-Yan Chen,Hung-Yueh Chiang,Kai-Chiang Wu,Mohamed S. Abdelfattah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Hibana is an inference engine for unified-memory devices that co-optimizes model representation, memory management, and decoding to make local AI assistants practical.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Local AI wants capable on-device assistants that keep data and compute under user control, and open-weight models now handle practical tasks. But existing inference engines fall short: datacenter engines like vLLM/SGLang assume dedicated host memory, while local engines underuse the unified-memory hierarchy.

Method: Hibana co-designs three features: (1) model surgery that edits trained architectures to suit hardware, shrinking memory footprint and data movement; (2) unified-memory management that preserves each agent's state across turns for instant resumption; (3) adaptive speculation generating multiple tokens per step. These are co-optimized around shared memory capacity and limited bandwidth of unified-memory SoCs for local multi-agent workloads.

Result: On a single DGX Spark serving Qwen and Nemotron models up to 125B parameters, Hibana completes up to 3.4x more agentic tasks per hour and delivers up to 3.9x higher decoding throughput than vLLM, NVIDIA Flare, llama.cpp, and TensorFold.

Conclusion: Co-designing model representation, memory management, and decoding around unified-memory constraints yields substantial gains for local multi-agent inference. Code is open-sourced.

Abstract: Local AI promises capable personal assistants that run on users' own devices, keeping data and computation under their control. Open-weight models that fit on local devices can now handle practical tasks such as coding. Yet current inference engines fall short. Popular engines such as vLLM and SGLang target datacenter GPUs with dedicated host memory, while local engines underuse the memory hierarchy of unified-memory devices. We present Hibana, an inference engine for unified-memory devices that co-optimizes model representation, memory management, and decoding strategy. Model surgery, the process of editing a trained model's architecture to suit its hardware, changes how the model computes, shrinking its memory footprint and data movement. Unified-memory management preserves each agent's state across turns, so long-running agents can resume instantly instead of recomputing their state. Adaptive speculation generates several tokens per step. Hibana codesigns these features around the shared memory capacity and limited bandwidth of unified-memory systems-on-chip to support local multi-agent workloads. On a single DGX Spark serving Qwen and Nemotron models of up to 125B parameters, Hibana completes up to 3.4$\times$ more agentic tasks per hour and delivers up to 3.9$\times$ higher decoding throughput than other established frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Flare, llama.cpp, and TensorFold. Code is available at https://github.com/sharar-project/hibana.

</details>


### [279] [Test-Time Scaling for Diffusion Language Models with Frequency-Aware Remasking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10486)
*Bowen Zuo,Yue Yu,Dongruo Zhou,Yinglun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将扩散语言模型的测试时扩展建模为推理算力与解码策略的自适应分配：先用快速基础采样器解决简单题，再对难题采用频率感知的remasking，通过追踪token在去噪过程中预测变化的频次优先提交高频变化token，鼓励探索多样推理路径，在MATH-500和HumanEval上显著超越强自适应分配基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DLM的确定性感知策略依赖瞬时置信度或熵等局部信号，在困难推理问题上容易误导，导致采样过早坍缩到模型偏好轨迹而无法探索其他推理路径。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用快速基础采样器处理简单问题以节省算力；第二阶段对剩余难题应用频率感知remasking，统计每个token在去噪步骤间预测改变的频率，优先提交频繁变化的token，从而促使样本探索替代推理路径而非收敛于单一轨迹。

Result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct与Dream-7B-Instruct上一致优于强自适应分配基线。MATH-500准确率绝对提升最高达3.73个百分点（LLaDA）与7.33个百分点（Dream）；HumanEval覆盖率绝对提升最高达11.39（LLaDA）与10.98（Dream）个百分点。对基础策略采样100次仍未解决的问题，频率感知remasking可恢复3.75%至18.75%的样例。

Conclusion: 频率感知的remasking提供了比瞬时置信度更可靠的难题探索信号，与算力自适应分配结合可有效提升DLM在推理与代码任务上的测试时扩展效果。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality. Existing certainty-aware strategies rely on instantaneous confidence or entropy, but these local signals can be misleading on difficult reasoning problems. We formulate DLM test-time scaling as adaptive allocation of both inference compute and decoding strategies. Our two-stage approach uses a fast base sampler to solve easy questions, then applies frequency-aware remasking to the remaining hard questions. This strategy tracks how often each token's prediction changes across denoising steps and preferentially commits frequently changing tokens, encouraging samples to explore alternative reasoning paths rather than collapse onto the model's preferred trajectory. Experiments with LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct show consistent improvements over a strong adaptive allocation baseline, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 3.73 percentage points (LLaDA) and 7.33 percentage points (Dream) on MATH-500, and absolute coverage gains of up to 11.39 percentage points (LLaDA) and 10.98 percentage points (Dream) on HumanEval. On questions unsolved by the base certainty-aware strategy after 100 samples, frequency-aware remasking recovers solutions for 3.75% to 18.75% of examples.

</details>


### [280] [Search-by-Answer Bias in Retrieval Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11396)
*Adiel Avigad,Shauli Ravfogel,Yoav Goldberg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 稠密检索器存在"按答案搜索偏差"：它们偏向包含模型已知答案实体的段落，而忽视支持有效替代答案的段落。该偏差由模型对实体的token预测分数驱动，且在8个检索器上一致存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密检索器本应根据查询的语义规范选择段落，但作者怀疑它们实际上偏向"模型已经知道答案"的段落，从而引入偏差，影响检索证据的公平性与多样性。既有工作未系统检验实体先验知识如何影响段落排序。

Method: 利用LAMA/TREx构建受控事实对比数据。对每个检索器，用token预测头测量模型对规范实体(vs.替代实体)的打分强度，再检验该打分是否能预测段落的检索分数排序。覆盖DPR、Spider变体、Contriever、E5、Qwen3-Embedding共8个检索器；设置控制实验：段落仅在答案实体上不同，以及高打分实体所在段落表达错误关系的情况。

Result: 在全部8个检索器上，token预测分数越大，包含对应实体的段落检索分数越高的效应稳定出现。即使段落仅在答案实体上不同，甚至该实体出现在错误关系表述中，这一效应依然成立。

Conclusion: 稠密检索在段落选择阶段普遍存在search-by-answer bias，检索到的证据受模型参数化知识偏见影响，而非纯粹语义匹配。这提示检索评估与下游RAG系统需要考虑并缓解此类偏差。

Abstract: Dense retrievers are meant to select passages that match a query's semantic specification. We show they suffer from search-by-answer bias: they favor passages that mention answer objects the model knows (scores as likely), over passages that support valid alternative answers. We test this with controlled factual contrasts from LAMA/TREx. For each retriever, we measure how strongly the model scores the canonical object over an alternative object using a token-prediction head, and ask whether this score predicts passage rankings. Across eight retrievers, including DPR, Spider variants, Contriever, E5, and Qwen3-Embedding, larger token-prediction scores consistently predict higher retrieval scores for passages containing the corresponding object. This holds when passages differ only in the answer object, and even when the passage that mentions the high-scoring object expresses a wrong relation. Dense retrieval thus exhibits search-by-answer bias during passage selection, shaping which evidence is retrieved.

</details>


### [281] [Distinguishing Extraction Failures and Clinical Discordance with LLM Uncertainty on Radiology Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10502)
*Jerjes Aguirre-Chavez,Shant Malkasian,Roshun Sankaran,Brendan Crabb,Albert Hsiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究评估LLM在冠脉CTA狭窄程度提取中的不确定性是否能区分"提取失败"与"临床数据本身的不一致"，发现LLM不确定性可有效识别提取失败，但无法识别真实临床不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可用于结构化临床数据，但提取错误与底层数据本身的不一致（discordance）需加以区分。作者探究LLM提取过程中的不确定性是否能分别识别这两类失效模式，从而支持对LLM衍生临床数据集的失效归因。

Method: 基于1,045例接受冠脉CTA的真实队列，在血管水平提取CAD狭窄。以专家CCTA标注（253例）为参考定义"提取失败"（LLM提取与专家标注狭窄程度不一致），以随后有创冠脉造影ICA（729例）定义"临床不一致"（CCTA与ICA狭窄程度不一致）。从十种候选指标中选出"Stenosis Margin"量化LLM不确定性，采用广义估计方程逻辑回归和AUC评估其关联性及增量判别能力。

Result: LLM不确定性与提取失败强相关（校正OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57–6.69]，P<0.001），并在LLM提取的狭窄程度基础上显著提升判别力（AUC 0.81→0.86，ΔAUC +0.06 [+0.03,+0.09]，P=0.001）。相反，其与临床不一致关联较弱（校正OR 1.22 [1.04–1.43]，Holm校正P=0.118），无增量判别力（ΔAUC +0.01 [−0.00,+0.02]，P=0.245）。此外两类失效重叠极少：42条临床不一致血管中38条（90%）被正确提取。

Conclusion: LLM不确定性可识别提取失败，但不能识别底层临床不一致，二者重叠很少。这支持在评估LLM衍生的临床数据集时进行失效归因，即不确定性信号可用于识别数据提取环节的错误，而非反映真实临床数据的矛盾。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can structure clinical datasets, but extraction error must be distinguished from discordance in the underlying data. From a real-world cohort of 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA), we evaluated whether LLM uncertainty during vessel-level coronary artery disease (CAD) stenosis extraction could identify extraction failure and clinical discordance. References were expert CCTA annotations (253 patients) and subsequent invasive coronary angiography (ICA; 729 patients). We quantify extraction failure as disagreement between stenosis severity in LLM extracted versus expert annotations, and clinical discordance as disagreement in stenosis severity between CCTA and subsequent ICA. Stenosis Margin, selected from ten candidate measures, was used to quantify LLM uncertainty, and generalized estimating equation logistic regression and AUC evaluated its association and incremental discrimination for each failure mode. LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$). In contrast, LLM uncertainty weakly associated with clinical discordance (adjusted OR 1.22 [1.04--1.43], Holm-adjusted $P=0.118$) but provided no incremental discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity ($Δ$AUC $+0.01$ [$-0.00$, $+0.02$], $P=0.245$). Moreover, extraction errors and clinical discordance showed little overlap, with 38 of 42 clinically discordant vessels (90%) having been extracted correctly. LLM uncertainty may identify extraction failures without identifying underlying clinical discordance, supporting failure attribution when evaluating LLM-derived clinical datasets.

</details>


### [282] [Imperfectly Imperfect: Evaluating Graded Cognitive Diversity in LLM Persona Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10508)
*Sion Weatherhead,Ben Newell,Aaron Belbasis,Flora Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"cognition-suite"评估框架，检验LLM智能体作为合成被试时能否复现人类在推理、自我报告特质及其关联与下游行为上的分级认知多样性。结果显示：智能体可复现问卷特质分布，但在认知任务表现多样性和行为变异上明显不足（多数智能体满分、诱饵错误过少、行为过度产出）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体正越来越多地被用作社会、行为与决策研究中的合成被试，但尚不清楚它们在被指定不同认知特质时，能否表现出与人类相当的分级认知多样性。仅复现特质描述符而丢失其本应组织的推理、错误类型与行为结构化变异，将使合成人群失去研究价值，因此需要系统评估。

Method: 构建cognition-suite评估：以合成或真实人源画像（认知反思、Need for Cognition、大五人格）为条件，让智能体完成与473名成人相同的测试组——两个新编测试（CRT与行为反思测试BRT，其中决策情境测量行为层面的反思）、一个已有CRT及两份特质问卷。对四个模型共进行七轮全量模拟，比较特质分布、任务表现、诱饵错误模式及反思—行为关联。

Result: 智能体能复现Need for Cognition与大五人格的问卷分布，但在认知任务表现和下游行为的多样性上不达标。Claude Sonnet 4.6的四轮中，无论人设反思水平如何，所有智能体两项CRT均满分；其余三轮存在直觉诱饵错误，但49%–85%满分（人类样本不足10%）。Claude Sonnet 5的逐题诱饵模式最接近人类，另两轮诱饵更少且题间差异更小。BRT中每轮均将15种编码行为中的8–11种过度产出至少20个百分点，反思与行为的关联仅部分延续。

Conclusion: 有效的合成人群不仅需保留特质描述符，还须保留这些描述符本应组织的推理、错误类型与行为层面的结构化变异；当前LLM智能体在这方面仍有显著差距。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in social, behavioural, and decision-making research, yet it remains unclear whether they can express graded cognitive diversity as assigned when engaging in simulated behaviour.
