The most frequent were unsupported specific details (dates, figures, prices, names), invented quotations, institutions or anecdotes, and conflation of separate events or people; six drafts contained errors in the wording, grading or ruling of a religious text. Rewriting cut the estimated Flesch-Kincaid grade of the English text from 14.0 to 6.1. We also release an 81-entry charity lexicon covering Modern Standard Arabic and Qatari Arabic, and describe the free, account-free website that serves the corpus (https://sadaqahjourney.com).

</details>


### [355] [Lost in Rounding: bf16 Recurrent State Makes Hybrid Reasoning Models Think Longer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12127)
*Yuchuan Weng,Xin Chen,Chi Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将混合推理模型（Mamba-2/Gated DeltaNet）的递归状态以 bf16 RTN 缓存会显著增加推理长度并降低准确率，这是舍入偏置而非精度不足所致，改用 bf16 随机舍入（SR）可基本消除该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在混合推理模型的解码过程中，递归混合器状态会被缓存在显存中。此前研究只关注 FP16/INT8 的 RTN 缓存会令模型输出变啰嗦、SR 可修复，但尚未系统考察服务引擎普遍支持的 bf16 格式对推理行为与准确率的影响。

Method: 在 6 个开源的混合推理模型和 590 道竞赛数学题上，将递归状态以 bf16 RTN 存储，测量推理长度、32K 截断率和准确率变化，并在 LiveCodeBench 上验证；随后对比 bf16 SR（含整数哈希随机数生成器）与 FP32，并做 128K 预算复测及逐头消融（按衰减带、随机头、teacher-forced KL 分组）。

Result: bf16 RTN 使 6 个模型中 5 个推理更长（几何均值 1.07–1.27 倍）、截断更频繁；Qwen3.5-9B 截断从 118 升至 223，准确率 85.6%→70.8%；代码任务掉 12.6/13.4 分。128K 预算只把差距减半（93.6% vs 86.6%），未完成运行翻倍且 85% 为重复循环。bf16 SR 在 5 个受影响模型中 4 个消除长度增长，Qwen3.5-9B 恢复至 87.6%；整数哈希 SR 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上与 FP32 持平（截断 113 vs 118，准确率均 85.6%）且保持 bf16 的内存与速度。

Conclusion: bf16 状态缓存的退化主要源于舍入偏置，SR 是低成本的修复方案，其逐头作用位置因模型而异；建议混合模型评测同时报告状态 dtype、截断率与输出长度。

Abstract: Hybrid reasoning models interleave attention with recurrent mixers such as Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet, whose state is cached between decoding steps. Prior work showed that storing this state in FP16 or INT8 with round-to-nearest (RTN) makes Mamba-2 and GDN hybrids more verbose, and that stochastic rounding (SR) fixes it. We study the other 16-bit format that serving engines expose, bf16, on six open hybrid reasoning models and 590 competition-math problems. With bf16 RTN state, five of six models reason longer (geometric-mean length 1.07x to 1.27x; also under greedy decoding in the two models tested) and hit the 32K token cap more often. On Qwen3.5-9B, cap hits rise from 118 to 223 and accuracy falls from 85.6% to 70.8%. On LiveCodeBench, both models tested also reason longer and lose 12.6 and 13.4 points of pass@1. Rerunning the capped items with a 128K budget halves the accuracy gap but does not close it (93.6% vs. 86.6%): bf16 runs that never finish are twice as common, and 85% of them are exact repetition loops. On Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, by contrast, 30 of 31 extra caps finish at 128K, so the cost there is mostly extra tokens (exploratory). Same-width bf16 SR removes the length increase in four of five affected models, restores Qwen3.5-9B to 87.6% and brings code length and pass@1 near FP32 levels, so the failure is mostly rounding bias, not missing resolution. With an integer-hash random generator, SR on Qwen3.5-9B matches FP32 on cap hits and accuracy (113 vs. 118; 85.6% for both) at the memory and decoding speed of bf16 RTN. In the Nemotron-Nano-v2 lineage, SR on 25% of heads (an intermediate-decay band) removes the effect, while random heads and the top teacher-forced-KL octiles do not; in Nemotron-3 and Qwen3.5-9B the effect is spread across heads. We recommend that evaluations of hybrid models report the state dtype, cap rate and output length alongside accuracy.

</details>


### [356] [Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12184)
*Guowei Xu,Jiaru Zou,Mete Erdogan,Haotian Ye,Pan Lu,James Zou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出受BVSR认知框架启发的科学发现框架：在创意生成阶段刻意限制任务信息以扩大探索，再基于同任务上已验证提案的结果来筛选候选，从而在12个任务上提升原创性与高效用提案比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI科学家在创意生成时通常被给予尽可能多的任务信息，这会把生成"锚定"到熟悉的方法上，抑制原创与非显然的想法。科学发现需要原创、有用且非显然的创意，因此需要新的信息使用方式。

Method: 借鉴Blind Variation and Selective Retention（BVSR）认知框架，将信息的两种角色分离：(1) 生成阶段在刻意受限的任务信息下产生提案，以拓宽探索；(2) 在候选进入昂贵的实证评估前，学习同任务上此前已验证提案及其结果，以保留有前景的候选。在5个提案模型、12个科学任务上评估，并接入现有AI科学家工作流。

Result: 限制任务信息显著提升提案的原创性与非显然性，产生比现有SOTA提示基线更多的高创造性、高效用提案；利用既往提案结果进行筛选可丢弃约一半候选同时保留多数最优提案；在基因表达分析、药物反应预测、异常检测、缩放律发现和脑活动预测中实现更强发现。

Conclusion: 有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段差异化使用信息：探索阶段约束任务特定信息，筛选阶段利用任务上积累的实证经验。

Abstract: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.

</details>


### [357] [The Deception Archive as a repository of standardized datasets for large-scale verbal deception detection research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12196)
*Caterina Borgese,Riccardo Loconte,Lucca Pfründer,Bennett Kleinberg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布"Deception Archive"，一个基于大规模系统综述构建的标准化言语欺骗数据集仓库，收录41个公开数据集、共387,995条真实或欺骗性陈述，旨在促进数据集发现、跨数据集验证与可复现评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLP与机器学习推动了言语欺骗的自动化研究，但现有言语欺骗数据集分散于各学科，难以识别、获取和复用，阻碍了跨研究比较与稳健计算模型的开发。

Method: 开展大规模系统综述，检索符合条件的公开数据集，经人工检查，并按结构化数据策展流程进行标准化处理，同时附带元数据，构建集中化、可长期扩展的"Deception Archive"仓库。

Result: 当前仓库包含41个公开数据集、387,995条真实或欺骗性陈述，在数据规模、研究主题、真值标注等方面呈现高度异质性，并作为可随时间纳入新数据集的"活"资源。

Conclusion: Deception Archive通过集中化的标准化数据集访问与元数据，便利数据集发现、跨数据集验证及计算模型的可复现评测，推动言语欺骗研究的方法规范化与资源整合。

Abstract: Computational advances in natural language processing and machine learning have substantially expanded the use of automated approaches in verbal deception research. However, existing verbal deception datasets remain fragmented across disciplines, as they are often difficult to identify, access, and reuse, limiting cross-study comparisons and the development of robust computational models. We present the Deception Archive, a curated and standardized repository of publicly available verbal deception datasets built upon a large-scale systematic review. Eligible datasets were retrieved, manually inspected, and standardized following a structured data curation workflow. The current repository comprises 41 publicly available datasets containing 387,995 truthful or deceptive statements. The archive represents a heterogeneous repository (e.g., in data size, topic of investigation, ground-truth, etc.) and a living resource for integrating newly available deception datasets over time. By providing centralized access to standardized datasets and accompanying metadata, the Deception Archive facilitates dataset discovery, cross-dataset validation, and reproducible evaluation of computational models.

</details>


### [358] [TrajLift: Lifting Memory Recall Trajectories with Latency-Modulated Heat Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12197)
*Jiawen Kang,Jinchao Li,Mingyu Cui,Junan Li,Xixin Wu,Helen Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TrajLift谱框架，将言语回忆建模为层级图上的带时间轨迹，用延迟调制热扩散统一刻画语义层级结构与检索时序，在合成与临床数据上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 言语记忆检索的词序、停顿与类别组织对阿尔茨海默病有诊断价值，但该检索过程的计算建模少有研究；核心难点在于时序与层级结构在诊断上相互纠缠，检索时间的意义依赖其层级语境。

Method: TrajLift将回忆序列视为层级图上的带时间轨迹，核心为语义层级上的"延迟调制热扩散"算子，把每个回忆词提升为同时编码多尺度层级结构与连续检索时间的表示；形式分析表明该表示可一阶分离为结构与时间成分，并具跨层级谱选择性。

Result: 在需结构-时间交互的合成基准上，深层级场景TrajLift接近完美而基线全部失败；真实临床数据上，通过联合建模时序与语义结构优于多样基线，且检索时间信息越丰富增益越大。

Conclusion: 将记忆检索视为层级图上的时间轨迹并采用延迟调制扩散建模，可有效解耦并联合利用时序与结构诊断信息，为言语回忆的计算化诊断提供新范式。

Abstract: Verbal memory retrieval carries rich diagnostic information for Alzheimer's disease through the order, hesitation, and categorical organization of recalled words, yet computational modeling of this retrieval process remains largely unexplored. A key challenge is that timing and hierarchical structure are diagnostically entangled: the diagnostic meaning of retrieval timing depends on its hierarchical context. We propose TrajLift, a spectral framework that models verbal recall as timed trajectories on a hierarchical graph. Our central mechanism is latency-modulated heat diffusion on the semantic hierarchy, a unified operator that lifts each recalled word into a representation of both multi-scale hierarchical structure and continuous retrieval timing. Formal analysis shows that the resulting representation is first-order separable into structural and temporal components with spectral selectivity across hierarchical levels. On synthetic benchmarks requiring structure-time interaction, TrajLift stays near-perfect on deep hierarchies where all baselines fail. On real-world clinical data, we show that TrajLift outperforms diverse baselines by jointly modeling timing and semantic structure, with gains that grow as retrieval timing becomes more informative.

</details>


### [359] [Prune, Don't Merge: Expert Compression of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on Multilingual Production Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12240)
*Tomas Rasymas,Povilas Kvedaras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在生产环境中比较了MoE模型的一次性专家剪枝(REAP)与专家合并(REAM)，发现剪枝显著优于合并，且损伤主要集中于输出格式契约而非内容质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型每token运行便宜但显存占用高，推高了生产部署成本。现有两种SOTA一次性专家压缩方法REAP(剪枝)和REAM(合并)仅在学校基准上评估过，缺乏真实生产任务的对比证据。

Method: 在一家网络托管公司的五个多语言生产任务(从分类到营销HTML邮件模板生成)上，使用两个30B参数模型(Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507和混合Mamba-注意力架构的Nemotron-3.5-Lightning)，在去除25%和50%专家、相同校准数据的条件下对比REAP与REAM。

Result: 剪枝占优：在相同样本上，REAP在20组比较中16组显著更好，REAM仅2组。25%压缩率下REAP保留Qwen3-30B生成质量的93.6%，REAM仅62.5%(基准上二者相差不到1分)。损伤集中在输出契约而非内容：邮件模板任务中89.8–95.2%的重大损失来自硬性失败(无效JSON、移动端布局破坏、失控生成)；多数失败的非英语领域描述会复制提示词中的英文开头短语。跨困惑度和logit散度两个诊断指标能追踪生产质量，重复循环率亦然，但n-gram多样性不能。

Conclusion: 对生产场景的MoE压缩，专家剪枝(REAP)优于专家合并(REAM)，且应重点关注输出格式的硬性失败，并可用跨困惑度、logit散度和重复循环率作为质量诊断，论文给出实用压缩指南。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts language models are cheap to run per token but expensive to hold in GPU memory, which drives the cost of serving them in production. One-shot expert compression shrinks them after a single calibration pass. Its two current state-of-the-art methods are REAP for expert pruning, which deletes the least salient experts, and REAM for expert merging, which merges them into the most salient ones. Both have been evaluated only on academic benchmarks. We compare the two on five multilingual production tasks of a web-hosting company, from classification to the generation of marketing HTML email templates, with two 30B-parameter models (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 and the hybrid Mamba-attention Nemotron-3.5-Lightning) at 25% and 50% of experts removed and the same calibration data. Pruning wins: on the same rows, REAP is significantly better in 16 of 20 comparisons and REAM in 2. At 25%, REAP keeps 93.6% of Qwen3-30B's generative quality and REAM 62.5%, although on benchmarks the two are within a point for the same model. The damage concentrates in the output contract rather than the content: 89.8-95.2% of each significant loss on email templates comes from hard-gate failures such as invalid JSON, broken mobile layouts and runaway generation, and most failed non-English domain descriptions copy the prompt's English opening phrase. Cross-perplexity and logit divergence, two diagnostics from the REAP paper, also track production quality, as does the rate of repetition loops; n-gram diversity does not. We close with practical guidance for compressing MoE models for production.

</details>


### [360] [MNN-Pocket-0.3B Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12311)
*MNN Team*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 300M 参数端侧稠密语言模型 MNN-Pocket-0.3B，支持 32K 上下文，INT4 仅 173MB，iPad Pro M5 上解码达 466 tokens/s，通过架构、数据、训练与推理系统协同设计实现同规模前沿性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧设备（手机、智能眼镜）受内存与算力限制，需要既能保持能力又极致轻量、快速、支持长上下文的语言模型，而现有小模型在能力与部署效率之间难以兼顾。

Method: 架构-数据-训练-推理协同设计：硬件感知的架构选择与依赖感知词表裁剪；四阶段预训练（约 4.1 万亿中英 token）；三阶段后训练（指令微调、多教师同策略蒸馏、量化感知训练）；MNN 推理引擎的硬件特定优化支持高效长上下文推理。

Result: INT4 部署占用 173MB，iPad Pro M5（Metal）解码吞吐最高 466 tokens/s；在同规模模型中达到前沿水平，中英知识推理、数学、代码、指令遵循表现突出，稳定超越同规模开源模型，指令遵循上甚至超过部分 0.5B 模型。

Conclusion: MNN-Pocket-0.3B 以开放权重和即用型 MNN 部署包发布，为能力可用、响应快速、内存高效的端侧语言模型应用与研究提供实用基础。

Abstract: This technical report presents MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a compact 300M-parameter dense language model designed for efficient on-device deployment and supporting context lengths of up to 32K tokens. With an INT4 deployment footprint of only 173 MB and decoding throughput of up to 466 tokens/s on iPad Pro M5 (Metal), it can be seamlessly integrated into applications on edge devices such as smartphones and smart glasses. MNN-Pocket-0.3B is developed through the co-design of its architecture, data, training pipeline, and inference system. Hardware-aware architecture selection and dependency-aware vocabulary pruning balance model capability with on-device memory and compute constraints. A four-stage pre-training pipeline covering approximately 4.1 trillion high-quality Chinese and English tokens equips the model with broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. This is followed by a three-stage post-training pipeline comprising instruction fine-tuning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and quantization-aware training. Finally, hardware-specific optimizations in the MNN inference engine enable fast, memory-efficient inference and long-context processing. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MNN-Pocket-0.3B achieves frontier-level performance among models of comparable size, with particularly strong results in Chinese and English knowledge and reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following. It consistently outperforms similarly sized open-source models and even surpasses several 0.5B-parameter models on instruction-following benchmarks. We release MNN-Pocket-0.3B with open weights and ready-to-use MNN deployment packages. We hope it will provide a practical foundation for capable, responsive, and memory-efficient edge applications while advancing research and development in on-device language models.

</details>


### [361] [More Than Just Style: Benchmarking Personality Influence in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12392)
*Yuhao Liu,Mengyu Wang,Xiao Chen,Lu Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SPACE基准框架，用受控评估协议分离LLM内在"人格倾向"与能力、指令的影响，发现人格倾向持久且影响任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM输出不仅受显式提示和指令影响，还受类似人类人格的潜在行为偏好影响；但这种影响难以与模型能力和指令效果区分开来。

Method: SPACE框架：受控评估协议 + 互补数据集（人格验证、能力评估、分层情境任务）；通过多引导条件下的受控对比，区分人格影响、能力变化与即时指令效应。

Result: 提示可改变生成风格，但模型内在人格倾向持久、难以被相反指令覆盖；这些潜在倾向对LLM任务表现有可观察到的影响。

Conclusion: 需更关注LLM的内在倾向特征及其潜在应用；代码与基准规范已开源。

Abstract: In addition to the effects of explicit input prompts and instructions, large language model outputs are influenced by underlying behavioral preferences similar to human personality tendencies. These tendencies can affect how models interpret situations and make decisions. However, their influence is difficult to disentangle from the effects of model capabilities and instructions. Therefore, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework combining a controlled evaluation protocol with complementary datasets for personality verification, capability assessment, and hierarchical situational tasks. Controlled comparisons across guidance conditions help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects. Experimental results demonstrate that although prompting can shift generation style, models' internal personality tendencies are persistent and not readily overridden by opposing instructions. Furthermore, these underlying tendencies have an observable influence on LLM task performance, highlighting the need for greater attention to these characteristics and potential applications. Training code and SPACE benchmark specifications are available at https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training.

</details>


### [362] [BDBBQ: A Human-AI Collaborative Benchmark for Bengali Social Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12407)
*Provat Saha,Ashika Habib Khan,Tahseen Tanha,Hasin Ishrak,Muhammad Iqbal Hossain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建了孟加拉语-英语双语BBQ扩展基准（61,312条实例，涵盖12个社会类别），并据此系统评测8个大语言模型在跨语言场景下的性能与社会刻板印象偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型社会偏差基准主要面向英语，对孟加拉语及孟加拉国社会文化语境的覆盖严重不足，缺乏文化扎根的公平性评估工具。

Method: 在BanglaBBQ基础上构建双语扩展数据集，包含平衡的答案排列、对比式问题框架、模糊与消歧两类上下文；通过结构检查、220项统计检验及4名标注者对150条实例的专家标注（Fleiss' κ=0.8349）验证数据质量；在490,496条实例上评测8个LLM。

Result: 发现五点：消歧上下文对孟加拉语准确率提升（+36.59pp）远大于英语（+17.71pp）；所有模型孟加拉语准确率更低，Mistral-Nemo跨语言差距最小（5.12pp）；刻板印象偏差随语言与模型而异（Gemma 2 9B在孟加拉语上升，Mistral-Nemo下降）；高准确率不必然对应低偏差；偏差在社会类别间差异显著，Qwen 2.5 7B在孟加拉语政治与外貌类别上刻板对齐更强。

Conclusion: 跨语言性能与社会偏差是LLM行为的两个独立维度，凸显了在英语中心之外构建文化扎根、语言敏感的公平性基准的必要性。

Abstract: Despite growing attention to social bias in large language models (LLMs), existing bias benchmarks provide limited coverage of culturally grounded evaluation in Bengali, particularly within Bangladesh's sociocultural context. To address this gap, we develop a bilingual extension of BanglaBBQ comprising 61,312 question-answering instances across 12 social categories in English and Bengali. The benchmark incorporates balanced answer permutations, contrasting question framings, and both ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to systematically examine model performance and stereotype-aligned bias across languages. We validate the dataset through structural checks, 220 statistical tests, and expert annotation of 150 instances by four annotators, achieving strong inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' \k{appa}=0.8349). We evaluate eight LLMs across 490,496 instances and identify five key findings. First, disambiguated contexts yield substantially greater accuracy improvements in Bengali (+36.59 percentage points) than in English (+17.71). Second, all evaluated models exhibit lower accuracy in Bengali, although Mistral-Nemo shows the smallest cross-lingual accuracy gap (5.12 percentage points). Third, stereotype-aligned bias exhibits language and model dependent variation, increasing in Bengali for Gemma 2 9B but decreasing for Mistral-Nemo. Fourth, higher accuracy does not necessarily correspond to lower stereotype-aligned bias. Finally, bias varies considerably across social categories, with Qwen 2.5 7B exhibiting stronger stereotype alignment in Bengali for Politics and Physical Appearance. These findings demonstrate that cross-lingual performance and social bias are distinct dimensions of LLM behavior and underscore the importance of culturally grounded, language-sensitive benchmarks for evaluating fairness beyond English-centric settings.

</details>


### [363] [Path-Level Structural and Semantic Alignment for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12420)
*Xindi Wang,Aifen Xiong,Baiyang Wang,Xuri Ge,Robert Mercer,Frank Rudzicz,Yifan Peng,Zhumin Chen,Hongjun Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出以完整"根到节点"标签路径为共享单元，引入PathSimNCE结构对比目标与LLM生成文档条件语义描述目标，推理时仍用标准多标签分类器，在三个基准上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HMTC方法多通过预测约束或单个标签表示与局部关系建模层次结构，结构与语义监督通常分开设计，缺乏统一的监督单元。

Method: 以根到节点的完整标签路径作为结构监督与语义监督的共享单元，训练时新增两个辅助目标：(1) PathSimNCE，用层次感知的对比目标将文档表示与层次路径对齐，对结构相关路径给予分级监督，同时保留对真实路径的显式监督；(2) 互补语义目标，使用LLM生成的、以文档为条件的同一正路径描述，提供上下文相关的细粒度标签语义。推理阶段仅保留标准多标签分类器。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上均有一致提升；结构对齐在更深层次的层次结构中收益更明显，语义对齐对细粒度标签带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 以路径为共享监督单元可统一结构与语义监督，且两种目标互补，在不同层次深度和标签粒度上各有优势。

Abstract: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.

</details>


### [364] [Can Frontier Auto Researchers Reconstruct Human Research Decisions in AI?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12429)
*Shengyun Si,Junjie Chu,Ye Leng,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoHRS 分阶段评估框架，用 152 篇 ICLR oral 论文生成 456 条研究轨迹，考察 Auto Researcher 复现人类研究决策与产物的忠实度，发现其常无法还原关键决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 harness 的 agent 系统催生了能力日益强大的 Auto Researcher，可自主完成乃至端到端执行科研流程，但其研究决策与产出同人类专家的对齐程度仍缺乏系统考察。

Method: 以「研究重构」为视角，构建 AutoHRS（AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity）分阶段评估框架，在科学工作流各阶段衡量自动研究者重建人类研究产物的忠实度；以 152 篇 ICLR oral 论文为语料，生成覆盖不同阶段的 456 条研究轨迹并进行评测。

Result: 将 AutoHRS 应用于这些轨迹后发现，现有 Auto Researcher 在研究过程的多个阶段经常无法还原关键研究决策及其相应产物。

Conclusion: 自动研究者与人类研究者在研究决策和产出上仍存在显著差距，分阶段重构式评估可揭示其具体失败环节，为未来改进提供依据。

Abstract: Scientific research has long been driven by substantial human effort, from reviewing prior work and identifying research gaps to designing specific solutions. Recent advances in harness-based agent systems have given rise to increasingly capable Auto Researchers, which can autonomously carry out these tasks and, increasingly, entire end-to-end research workflows. Yet despite their rapidly growing capabilities, how closely the research decisions and outputs produced by auto researchers align with those of human experts remains underexplored. We investigate this gap through the lens of research reconstruction and study: Given comparable research context, how similar are the research decisions and outputs produced by Auto Researchers to those of human researchers in AI research? To answer this question, we introduce AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity (AutoHRS), a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing how faithfully auto researchers reconstruct human research artifacts across different stages of the scientific workflow. Using 152 ICLR oral papers as our corpus, we generate 456 research trajectories spanning different stages of the research process. Applying AutoHRS to these trajectories, we find that current Auto Researchers frequently fail to recover key research decisions and their resulting artifacts across multiple stages of the research process.

</details>


### [365] [Phrase-Level Speculative Decoding on a Frozen Target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12464)
*Madhusudhana Naidu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出改变推测解码的"草稿单元"：用小型MLP头预测1-3词的短语（独立草稿词表中的一个条目），再映射回目标分词器token，在A5000上对Qwen3-4B实现GSM8K 2.391x、MATH-500 2.444x加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推测解码（Medusa、EAGLE-3、DFlash、DSpark）都在目标模型自身词表内起草，一个树节点=一个目标token。但BPE的分词器先按空白切分再学合并，导致任何多词字符串都不可能成为单个token，例如Qwen3-4B中"United States of America"是4个token且不存在任何相邻对条目，因此这类短语在任何"目标词表内起草"的方法中都不可达。

Method: 用一个小的MLP头读取冻结目标的隐藏状态，在独立草稿词表中预测1-3词的短语作为一个条目；通过贪心最长匹配将其展开为目标模型的token；N个候选在前缀树掩码下经一次前向验证，与树深和树宽正交。目标模型及其分词器保持冻结，候选仅在与目标自身argmax一致时才被接受，因此输出等同于贪心解码（除浮点并列情况）。

Result: A5000、batch 1下对HuggingFace generate()：21.94M参数头（占Qwen3-4B的0.545%）在GSM8K上2.391x、MATH-500上2.444x、MT-Bench上1.544x。草稿词表大小即参数预算（每条目输出层仅一行257参数）：8,000条目头为3.434M参数（0.0854%），比EAGLE-3的drafter小64倍，仍保留较大头92.3%的GSM8K每趟token数。同提示与基线对比：21.94M头在两个数学集上超过tree-16，但在所有数据集上落后于tree-60。

Conclusion: 以短语为草稿单元是一种与树深宽正交、参数极省且输出无损的推测解码思路，在数学推理任务上收益明显；在同等参数规模下优于小树宽EAGLE-3，但尚不及大验证树（tree-60），提示扩展性与验证预算之间仍有提升空间。

Abstract: Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary.
  We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking.
  On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.

</details>


### [366] [Detecting AI-Authored Text in Authentic Student Writing: Evidence from PISA 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12487)
*Nils-Jonathan Schaller,Thorben Jansen,Olaf Köller,Andrea Horbach*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文利用PISA 2025 FLA数据集（德国15岁学生的英语议论文，对比有/无gpt-4o-mini聊天机器人辅助），通过击键、剪贴板和聊天日志追溯每个字符来源，构建人写、AI生成、混合文本的标签，评估两类检测器在真实学生写作场景中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI文本检测器在"完全人工 vs 研究者设计提示生成"的对照评测中近乎完美，但真实学生写作中AI使用是自愿且往往局部的，此场景缺乏研究。

Method: 基于PISA 2025 FLA数据，用击键、剪贴板与聊天日志追踪字符级来源，生成文本级和句子级标签（人写、AI生成、混合、无痕迹但经聊天后书写）；评估两种源自顶级共享任务系统的检测器：特征型检测器和基于冻结Llama-3.1-8B嵌入的分类器。

Result: 两种检测器均能可靠区分AI与人类文本（文本macro-F1达0.96，句子0.95），且不受拼写错误影响。但特征型检测器依赖词汇复杂度，简单的"学生风格"改写提示即可攻破（gpt-4o-mini下AI召回0.92→0.60，Qwen3下0.41）；嵌入型检测器对整篇文本稳健（AI召回≥0.94），但对单句不稳健（最低0.59）。混合文本介于两类之间，无痕迹AI材料文本约95%被判定为人写。

Conclusion: 真实学生写作场景中，AI检测器整体表现良好但对词汇复杂度等表面特征过度依赖，易被简单改写规避；嵌入型方法对整篇更稳健但句子级仍有不足，且聊天后无痕迹的文本几乎无法识别。

Abstract: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.

</details>


### [367] [Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12501)
*Hieu Minh Truong,Dung D. Le*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将翻译更新按4秒分组后再合成，会改变两名翻译器之间的“完成领先”测量结果，且方向依赖于合成器：XTTS-v2上增大、Piper上减小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厘清语音合成前的文本更新分组方式是否会影响同传/流式翻译的时序（完成时间）比较结论，指出仅指定合成器不足以保证可复现的评测。

Method: 以StreamAtt及其固定音频历史基线为对象，在10个英德演讲上固定译文文本与可用时间，仅改变送入合成的更新分组方式（含4秒分组）；使用XTTS-v2、Piper及持续进行的CosyVoice 3会话进行对比，并在另一组20篇演讲上复核。

Result: 4秒分组使XTTS-v2下平均完成领先从106.6秒升至229.1秒，而Piper下从169.5秒降至146.5秒；两者均产生更短音频，播放空闲时间的不同变化解释了相反方向。该方向在20篇演讲复核组中重现。CosyVoice 3连续会话中分组则使成对音频不变，并在20个块中19个延迟完成。

Conclusion: 语音时序比较必须说明文本如何进入合成，而不只是用了哪个合成器；识别与自动词级时间仅描述输出，不能证明翻译准确性或可懂度。

Abstract: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.

</details>


### [368] [Language Defaults Before Content: A Causal Layer Map of Multilingual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12538)
*Shenbin Qian,Yves Scherrer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文通过翻译作为受控探针，利用激活修补分离多语言生成中"说什么"(内容)与"用什么语言说"(语言)信号的层级浮现过程，发现一致的三阶段模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言生成需LLM同时决定内容与输出语言，但这两者在模型输出中难以区分，缺乏对其内部机制的理解。

Method: 选取多平行语料中"某一方向翻译好、另一方向差"的片段固定内容、改变语言；用激活修补把成功运行的残差流状态写入失败运行，并与内容无关的对照比较；跨三个不同规模/架构的LLM追踪各层信号，另辅以阅读理解任务与稀疏自编码器(SAE)分析。

Result: 发现一致的三阶段模式：中间层先出现默认英语信号；下一层内容信息才变得因果可用；目标语言在更晚层才确定。英语默认先于内容的顺序在阅读理解任务中同样出现。SAE分析显示：中间层语言信号稀疏表示较弱，而后期语言区分稀疏性清晰，但在修补位置抵抗干预。

Conclusion: 给出了多语言生成中语言选择与内容信息如何浮现并相互作用的机制性解释。

Abstract: Multilingual generation requires large language models (LLMs) to determine both what to say and in what language to say it, yet these two commitments are difficult to disentangle from model outputs alone. We use translation as a controlled probe: for multi-parallel segments that a model translates well in one language direction but poorly in another, content is held fixed while language varies. Using activation patching, we write residual-stream states from successful runs into failing ones and compare content-matched states with content-independent controls, allowing us to trace content-specific and language-related signals across layers. Across three LLMs of different scales and architectures, we find a consistent three-stage pattern of multilingual generation. Intermediate layers first express a default English signal; content information becomes causally available one layer later; and the final target language is resolved only at later layers. The ordering of the English default before content also appears in a reading-comprehension task. Our sparse autoencoder analyses reveal a further dissociation: the intermediate language signal is only weakly represented by sparse features, whereas a later language distinction is clearly sparse, but resists intervention at the patched position. These results provide a mechanistic account of how language selection and content information emerge and interact during multilingual generation.

</details>


### [369] [AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12587)
*Yizhuo Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AgentOPSD 提出无评论家的递归信用分配方案，逐轮把自蒸馏的对数概率差作为证据，在对数几率空间做贝叶斯更新，从而把结果级优势重新分配到多轮交互的各个回合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可验证奖励强化学习把单一优势铺满整条轨迹，粒度过粗，无法定位长程多轮交互中决定成败的关键决策；特权自蒸馏虽提供更密监督，但未解决如何把局部师生差异沿序列转化为信用分配的问题。

Method: 将回合内"技能条件自教师 vs 学生"的 token 级对数概率差求和，作为证据在对数几率空间进行递归贝叶斯更新；由更新得到的修正量通过一个有界且保号的乘子，把结果派生的优势重新分摊到各回合。整个过程无需评论家模型。

Result: 在 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 和 7B 为策略骨干，稳定优于 GRPO 与自蒸馏基线，7B 规模成功率达 89.1%。消融显示收益来自"在回合边界聚合证据"与"使信念修正依赖历史"，而非局部差距本身。

Conclusion: 细粒度信用分配的关键在于证据的回合级聚合与历史依赖的递归信念更新；该无评论家框架为多轮智能体强化学习提供了有效且可扩展的稠密信用分配方式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.

</details>


### [370] [Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12592)
*Wannes Van den Bulck,Sofie Goethals,David Martens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文首次提出"XAIN公平性"研究方向：LLM将SHAP等XAI产物转写为叙事时，对同一预测的解释在不同社会群体间存在系统性差异；该差异应独立于预测模型与XAI产物被审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险领域，解释叙事是个人理解并申诉不利决策的主要途径；但LLM会复制社会偏见，而XAIN的公平性此前无人研究。且XAIN受限于真实XAI产物，公平性不仅涉及"说什么、怎么说"，还涉及"是否对各群体同等忠实"。

Method: 提出框架：在三种条件下（披露/隐去/反事实交换受保护属性）生成叙事，从中构造五种对比以定位差异来源。在信贷、教育、就业四个数据集的不利分类样本上，用五个LLM生成叙事，评估忠实性、特征覆盖度与情感倾向。

Result: 所有数据集、指标族与模型均出现显著差异，来源有二：忠实性差异源于特征取值——LLM产生似是而非的错误陈述，由群体间分布不均的取值触发；覆盖度与情感差异源于受保护属性本身——一旦披露，LLM对历史上受歧视或刻板印象较差的群体解释更少或语气更负面。更忠实的模型可消除忠实性差异，隐去属性多可消除其余差异，但两者单独均不足。

Conclusion: XAIN公平性需与预测模型及XAI产物分开审计；单一干预（提升忠实性或隐去属性）无法兼顾所有公平性维度。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.

</details>


### [371] [Unmasking Four Knapsack Problems in the Traveling Thief Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12597)
*Mohammed Mizan Alanazi,Mahdi Khemakhem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出 TTP 标准基准 9,720 个实例中有 4 个因租金率被四舍五入为 0.00 而退化为 0-1 背包问题，并给出修正方法与工具 ttplib。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Polyakovskiy 等（2014）的 9,720 个实例是 TTP 启发式的标准测试集，但如果某些实例的租金率被格式化为 0，则行程对目标无影响，问题退化为背包问题，导致不同方法报告相同结果、比较失去意义。作者希望揭示这一基准缺陷并加以修复。

Method: 作者逐一检查实例文件，发现租金率以两位小数保存；按生成规则应约为 0.003 的租金率被舍入为 0.00，涉及 4 个实例（其中一个属于常用的 60 个分类实例）。由于生成器使用的行程与装包未公开，原始租金率无法恢复，因此作者按同一规则对一份公开发布的参考解重新计算租金率，从而定义修正后的实例，并用已发表启发式验证其重新表现出 TTP 特性。

Result: 4 个实例实为背包问题；其中一个上 9 种已发表方法中有 5 种报告完全相同的结果。另有 949 个实例的租金率因同样的舍入被改变超过 1%。使用公开启发式测试表明，修正后的实例恢复为真正的 TTP 实例；作者还给出了修正实例上的参考结果。

Conclusion: 论文提出修正后的 TTP 基准实例、参考结果及对未来研究的建议，并发布开源 Python 库 ttplib，可在不下载整个基准的情况下加载全部 9,720 个实例（含修正版本）。

Abstract: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.

</details>


### [372] [Adapting Small Language Models to Romanized Nepali: Tokenizer Fertility, Reference Likelihood, and Generation Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12628)
*Pujan Pant,Sagar Newpane,Hari Sitaula,Manish Sakhakarmy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用同一QLoRA配方微调三个2-3B开源模型（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-3B、Gemma-2-2B）以处理罗马化尼泊尔语，发现微调显著提升性能，但似然（BPB）与重叠指标（chrF++/BLEU）对模型优劣的判断不一致，低fertility与高参考似然并不能识别输出最接近参考的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罗马化尼泊尔语在数字通信中常见，但缺乏标准拼写与资源，且尚不清楚小型开源语言模型能被可靠适配到何种程度。

Method: 对9,000条由确定性音译生成的尼泊尔语指令数据，用统一QLoRA配方、三个随机种子分别微调三个2-3B基座模型；在1,000条留出样本上用参考重叠指标（chrF++、BLEU）、字节归一化参考似然（BPB）和输出审查评估，并与两个提示下的零样本基线对比；另做同分词器的Llama-3.1-8B补充实验。

Result: 微调使chrF++从10-14升至29.0-30.6，BPB从2.23-2.41降至0.78-0.84；零样本输出有54-92%为类英语。Llama-3.2-3B在每种种子上BPB最低（比Qwen2.5-3B低0.042，95%CI 0.039-0.046），但二者在chrF++（30.51 vs 30.61）与BLEU上无法区分。Gemma-2-2B分词fertility最低（2.72 token/词）却在所有指标上最差。Llama-3.1-8B较Llama-3.2-3B的BPB降0.053，但chrF++与BLEU仅升0.68和0.58分。

Conclusion: 似然指标与重叠指标对模型差距的衡量相互矛盾；更低fertility与更高参考似然并不对应更接近参考的输出，选择模型需依赖任务层面指标而非似然或分词效率。

Abstract: Romanized Nepali, Nepali written in Latin script, is common in digital communication but has no standard spelling and few resources, and it is unclear how reliably small open language models can be adapted to it. We adapt three 2-3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Gemma-2-2B, with QLoRA on 9,000 instruction examples produced by deterministic transliteration of Nepali instruction data. Each model is trained with one shared recipe and three seeds and evaluated on 1,000 held-out examples with reference-overlap metrics, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB), and an output audit, against zero-shot baselines under two prompts. Fine-tuning raises chrF++ from 10-14 to 29.0-30.6 and lowers BPB from 2.23-2.41 to 0.78-0.84; most zero-shot outputs (54-92%) are English-like. Likelihood and overlap disagree on how far apart the models are. Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB in every seed, 0.042 below Qwen2.5-3B (95% CI 0.039-0.046), yet the two cannot be separated on chrF++ (30.51 and 30.61) or BLEU, even with paired item-level tests. Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits Romanized Nepali words least (2.72 tokens per word), scores worst on every measure. Which model gains most over its zero-shot baseline depends on the zero-shot prompt. In a supplementary comparison with an identical tokenizer, Llama-3.1-8B lowers BPB by 0.053 (0.050-0.056) relative to Llama-3.2-3B, while chrF++ and BLEU rise by only 0.68 and 0.58 points. Lower fertility and higher reference likelihood therefore did not identify the model whose outputs were closest to the references.

</details>


### [373] [How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12634)
*Dezhen Lu,Zixiang Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估用Fisher信息二阶展开 ½ΔᵀFΔ 低成本预测量化后KL散度的可靠性，并据此构建了一个量化格式筛选器，在Mistral-7B上预测准确、KL预算达标且吞吐预测误差仅0.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务系统需要为每个模型和部署选择权重量化格式，但实际测量量化带来的KL散度成本高昂。已有Hessian感知和二阶PTQ方法隐含使用 ½ΔᵀFΔ 这一二阶展开，作者想检验该"低成本筛选"在真实GPU批处理、多种量化格式下是否可靠。

Method: 在Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B、OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-32B、Qwen3-30B-A3B上，用channel-wise int8、per-tensor fp8、group-wise int4进行量化，比较预测KL与实测KL；考察扰动尺度、int4分组大小、舍入模式的影响，分析MoE的非二次响应与bf16梯度误差来源（反向传播下半段算术），并构建带trimmed预测、对齐标志和逐层格式分配的筛选器。

Result: 相对预测在16倍扰动尺度范围内成立，绝对预测呈重尾；trimmed平均使Qwen3-4B和OLMo-2的12个单元中10个误差在15%内。MoE在小平扰下呈非二次响应，int8 KL按 α^0.63 缩放。bf16逐序列梯度可致4倍预测误差，改用fp32反向可消除；batch-invariant内核吞吐为0.55倍，归约顺序变化引入0.17–0.22 nats/序列的下限。Mistral-7B上6个预测全部落在带内，3个KL预算全部满足，vLLM吞吐预测误差0.4%。

Conclusion: Fisher二阶筛子在相对比较上可靠、绝对预测需trimmed平均与误差带；MoE需特殊处理，反向传播须用fp32，归约顺序噪声构成精度下限。最终筛选器可实际用于格式选择与吞吐/质量权衡预测。

Abstract: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.

</details>


### [374] [A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12691)
*Mehmet Emre Tiryaki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出奥斯曼迪万诗歌的自动韵律识别与格律对齐任务，用隐马尔可夫模型在无标注格律数据的条件下完成扫描，在测试集上达到77.6%的整行正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奥斯曼迪万诗歌用基于音节重量的定量格律（aruz）写成，格律依赖原阿拉伯字母书写中记录的特殊字符；而现代土耳其语拼写缺少这些变音符号，现有规则扫描器在缺少学术转写信息时性能很差，因此需要能在现代拼写下工作的自动格律识别与对齐方法。

Method: 作者定义了两个任务：识别诗行所用格律，以及将格律权重与诗行音节切分对齐并识别诗人的"缺陷"与"自由"。构建了按诗人划分的52,000行语料，其中500行测试行带扫描标注，并按真实网络与OCR副本中测得的偏差率生成鲁棒性基准。模型为隐马尔可夫模型，状态对应各格律位置，在每个候选路径构成的格上解码，利用印刷格律标签通过EM训练，无需扫描标注。

Result: 在留出集上，模型77.6%的测试行完全扫描正确，对比规则扫描器26.8%、同样监督训练的神经标注器55.0%、Claude Opus 5.5少样本63.6%。代码开源，工具已在网上发布。

Conclusion: 基于格律位置HMM与EM弱监督的方法显著优于规则扫描器和神经基线，能在缺少变音符号的现代土耳其拼写下可靠完成奥斯曼诗歌的格律识别与扫描对齐。

Abstract: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.

</details>


### [375] [PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12763)
*Ding Zhu,Xiukun Wei,Tian Xie,Zhihui Zhu,Xueru Zhang,Mohammad Mahdi Khalili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PORT提出一种token级重加权框架，用于在噪声偏好数据下进行鲁棒的偏好优化，通过token对数概率的经验CDF实现仅前向的梯度范数惩罚代理，选择性抑制损坏token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏好优化效果依赖标注质量，但实际偏好数据常因标注错误和歧义而有噪声。现有鲁棒方法主要在序列级别操作，隐含地将整个响应当作统一正确或错误，忽略了被拒响应中仍有有价值推理步骤、被选响应也可能有细微错误的问题。

Method: PORT进行token级重加权，利用token对数概率的经验累积分布函数（CDF）作为梯度范数惩罚的高效前向传播代理，无需额外反向计算即可选择性抑制损坏token。并提供理论分析，证明PORT通过最小化偏差项上界来降低噪声偏好标签带来的梯度偏差。

Result: 在多种噪声设置下的实验表明，PORT持续提升鲁棒性，并优于现有序列级基线方法。

Conclusion: 细粒度的token级重加权是应对噪声偏好标注的有效途径，PORT以低计算成本实现了更强的鲁棒对齐，代码已开源。

Abstract: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT

</details>


### [376] [Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12791)
*Yuxuan Hu,Jihao Liu,Weikang Shi,Xijie Huang,Linda Wei,Mingjie Zhan,Aojun Zhou,Rui Liu,Hongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于大语言模型（LLM）的通用AutoML框架NCode，首次实现模型结构、训练超参与数据比例的联合优化，无需任务特定微调即可跨任务、跨模态泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AutoML框架领域特定，且将架构、训练超参与数据比例优化相互割裂；手工调参成本高。作者希望构建通用的、可泛化的联合优化框架。

Method: 提出NCode统一数值编码方案，将多样化的AutoML设计选择编码为离散序列，把优化过程转化为统一的排序任务；仅用单一视觉任务（有限数据）的优化轨迹训练LLM搜索器；结合强化学习引入思维链（CoT）推理以增强可解释性。

Result: 在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证、文生图等基准上取得SOTA；在十亿参数Diffusion Transformer的大规模联合优化中需896 GPU-天，达到GenEval 0.91的SOTA；分析发现优化策略由早期多样性探索转向后期锚点利用。

Conclusion: 该框架为通用、开放世界的机器学习优化提供了可扩展、可泛化且可解释的路径。

Abstract: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.

</details>


### [377] [How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12820)
*Paul Litvak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 向10篇开放获取心理学论文植入100个已知错误，测试前沿模型与两个商业AI审稿工具：最佳单系统抓出71个，最差30个，全部系统合并抓出93个；7个漏检错误全为"删除型遗漏"。系统间部分不相关使集成成为大杠杆；Refine.ink独特贡献最多但单错误成本高。未测假阳性，与真实论文错误分布的对比未知。数据与日志全部公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估前沿模型与商业AI审稿工具发现论文错误的能力，并检验集成是否能提升检出率；同时通过公开数据推动建立跨学科的综合评测基准。

Method: 在10篇开放获取心理学论文中植入100个已知错误，随后让前沿模型和两个商业AI审稿工具分别检测；汇总各系统结果做集成分析，并统计各系统漏检错误类型（插入型错误 vs 删除型遗漏）。

Result: 最佳单系统检出71/100，最差30/100；全部系统合并检出93/100。系统间检出错误仅部分相关，集成收益显著。7个任何系统都未能检出的错误全部为遗漏型（信息被删除）。Refine.ink独特检出数最多，但按单错误计成本昂贵。

Conclusion: AI系统已能发现多数植入错误，且集成是提升检出率的关键手段；但对"遗漏"类错误集体无能，是明显盲区。局限在于未测假阳性、错误分布与真实论文的差异未知。数据、错误、模型输出与实验日志公开，可作为跨学科评测基准的基础。

Abstract: One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30. Pooling every system's output caught 93. Models are only partly correlated in the errors they find, which makes ensembling a big lever for finding issues in papers. Seven errors could not be caught by any system, and all seven were omissions: information deleted from a paper rather than mistakes inserted into it. Refine.ink contributes more unique catches than any other single system, though it is expensive on a per-error basis. False positives were not measured, and how this error distribution compares to the distribution of errors in real papers remains unknown. The papers, errors, model outputs, and full experiment log are public, so that others can build on this toward a comprehensive evaluation benchmark across disciplines.

</details>


### [378] [Is Persona Generalization Predictable?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12864)
*Olina Mukherjee,Arnav Goel,Aditi Raghunathan,Jacob Mitchell Springer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现人格泛化（persona generalization）存在"在线上"（on-the-line）现象：域内与域外人格发生率在多种微调超参数下呈近似 probit 线性关系，且该直线跨模型家族与规模共享。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在一个领域微调语言模型会在其他领域引发行为改变（如涌现性错位带来的广泛不安全行为），但缺乏定量框架来预测与控制这种泛化。

Method: 在 Qwen、Llama 等模型上系统改变微调超参数（学习率、权重衰减、训练时长、可训练层选择），测量域内与域外人格发生率并拟合 probit 线性关系。

Result: 不改变可训练参数集合的训练选择（学习率、权重衰减、时长）主要使模型沿同一直线移动，通过削弱域内学习来减少迁移；改变微调层则会改变斜率——仅微调后层得到更浅斜率，在保持强域内学习的同时降低域外错位。

Conclusion: 该"在线上"现象将此前孤立、意外的观察统一进一个定量框架，可用于预测和控制行为迁移。

Abstract: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.

</details>


### [379] [HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12872)
*Haozhen Zhang,Bohan Liu,Jianzhu Bao,Qingyuan Liu,Haodong Yue,Xiao Li,Zi Pong Lim,Wenya Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HIVEMEM 是一个多模态记忆框架，通过"水平记忆扩展"（基于图的关系扩展召回）与"垂直证据组合"（按查询自适应选择证据形式）两个维度，提升长程交互中的记忆检索与利用效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体的交互历史越来越长，记忆检索成为长期交互的关键。现有记忆系统多依赖对压缩记忆的语义检索，且暴露固定/预定义的表示形式，容易漏掉相关记忆，也无法应对不同查询对异构证据需求的差异。

Method: 两方面设计：(1) 水平记忆扩展——用文本与视觉锚点把记忆片段组织成关系图，对语义召回的种子节点扩展其邻居，以补齐互补信息；(2) 垂直证据组合——每条召回记忆保留多种证据形式（紧凑摘要、描述、可定位视觉视图、原始图像、交互历史），并用一个轻量可训练选择器为每条记忆独立组合证据子集，实现查询自适应的异构多模态信息利用。

Result: 在三个多模态记忆基准上，HIVEMEM 在多个基础模型上一致提升任务表现；相比最高效的竞争多模态基线，token 消耗减少约 90%。

Conclusion: 将记忆检索从"单一语义 top-k + 固定表示"转为"图扩展召回 + 按需证据组合"，可同时提升记忆覆盖率与利用效率，是长程多模态交互记忆的一种有效范式。

Abstract: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

### [380] [Edge-Deployable LLMs for Classification and Value-of-Information Ranking of Disaster-Related Tweets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10158)
*Christopher D. Molek,K. Brent Venable,Niranjan Suri,Stephen Russell*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究用大语言模型对社交媒体推文进行分类并评估其"信息价值"(VoI)，发现小型边缘可部署模型(Qwen3 8B分类、Gemma 3 4B评估可行动性)表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人道救援与灾害响应决策依赖社交媒体上噪声大、不完整且不确定的信息。已有研究多聚焦自动分类，但少有工作考察单条帖子是否包含足够信息来支撑实际行动决策。

Method: 用七个LLM对77,484条推文按10个人道援助类别进行分类；随后将分类结果作为上下文输入，针对每条推文在六项成熟指标上评估其相对救援者可行动性的信息价值(VoI)。

Result: Qwen3(8B)为最佳分类器，除一个类别外在所有类别F1最高；Gemma 3(4B)在VoI评估任务上优于其他模型，在多数类别取得最高召回率。

Conclusion: 相对小型、可边缘部署的LLM能在资源受限环境下优先筛选可行动信息；将VoI评估纳入框架可推进从非结构化社媒流中自动提取高价值知识，并指向单张8GB GPU即可运行LLM的战术边缘应用路径。

Abstract: Humanitarian-aid and disaster relief decisions often rely on noisy, incomplete, and uncertain information from social media. Although substantial research has focused on automating the classification of such data, limited work has examined whether individual posts contain sufficient information to support decisions to act. In this study, we use large language models (LLMs) to (1) classify social media content and (2) assess its Value-of-Information (VoI) in terms of operational actionability. We evaluate seven LLMs for the classification of 77,484 tweets across 10 humanitarian-aid categories and identify the Qwen3 (8B parameters) model as the top-performing classifier, achieving the highest F1 scores in all but one category. In a second task, the classified categories serve as contextual inputs for assessing VoI with respect to responder actionability across six well established metrics for each tweet. We observed that the Gemma 3 (4B parameters) model outperformed the other models on this task, achieving the highest recall across the majority of categories. This work demonstrates that relatively small, edge-deployable LLMs can prioritize actionable information in resource-constrained environments. By integrating VoI assessment, our framework advances the automated elicitation of high-utility knowledge from unstructured social media streams for disaster-response decision-making and highlights a pathway toward tactical edge applications using LLMs that fit on a single 8 GB GPU.

</details>


### [381] [SepLRM: A Foundation Model Paradigm for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10356)
*Di Chen,Xijun Xiao,Qin Ren,Weijiang Lai,Zhijian Pan,Zhentao Pan,Pengfei Nie,Cheng Yuan,Zixuan Tan,Xuyang Liu,Tao Wang,Yunwen Huang,Hao Fang,Yichao Wang,Hao Zhang,Siyuan Wu,Hao Chen,Han Diao,Mingyu Yang,Yongkang Feng,Beihong Jin,Jinfeng Yang,Deping Xie,Peng Xu,Zheng Chai,Yuchao Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 SepLRM 推荐基础模型范式，将长序列编码复用以分离为共享 RFM 与多个垂类模型，通过 KV cache 接口实现近 100% 能力迁移并提升序列扩展 ROI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模推荐模型通过加长行为序列、扩大参数与算力提升效果，但边际收益递减、长序列编码成本高，且多个模型在不同推荐阶段和业务场景中重复执行相同编码，投入产出比恶化。

Method: 提出编码器-解码器架构的 RFM，导出与候选无关的最终层编码器状态作为共享 KV cache；各垂类模型（VM）基于该 KV 构建候选条件查询，保持与原端到端模型一致的 query-KV 交互；并联合设计缓存压缩、训练与 serving 流程以及分布式 KV 存储系统 LG-Store。

Result: 在三个大规模数据集上取得 SOTA 离线表现，迁移率约 100%；在模型迭代、推荐阶段与业务场景间展现强可迁移性；在字节跳动两个大规模工业场景部署，显著提升序列扩展 ROI，在线 A/B 测试获得一致增益。

Conclusion: 以原生 KV 接口为分离边界的推荐基础模型范式，可兼顾迁移保真度与系统效率，为长序列推荐的可扩展性与复用提供可行路径。

Abstract: Large recommendation models (LRMs) improve recommendation performance by scaling behavior sequence length, model capacity, and training compute. However, the return on investment (ROI) of continued scaling deteriorates as marginal gains diminish and long-sequence encoding costs rise, especially when this computation is repeatedly executed by distinct models for diverse recommendation stages and business scenarios. To address this issue, we propose SepLRM, a recommendation foundation model (RFM) paradigm that identifies reusable sequence encoding and reorganizes multiple end-to-end (E2E) LRMs into one RFM and multiple independently optimized vertical models (VMs). The RFM adopts an encoder-decoder architecture and exports its final-layer encoder state as the shared key-value (KV) cache that is independent of downstream task-offered candidates. Unlike candidate-specific logits or aggregated user embeddings, the KV cache preserves fine-grained behavioral information. Separation at this native KV interface also allows each VM to construct candidate-conditioned queries while retaining the same query-KV interaction as its E2E counterpart, enabling high-fidelity capability transfer. To ensure both transfer effectiveness and system efficiency, we co-design cache compression, the training and serving workflows, and LG-Store, a distributed storage system for KV caches. Experiments on three large-scale datasets show that SepLRM achieves state-of-the-art offline performance with a transfer rate of approximately 100%. It also demonstrates strong transferability across model iterations, recommendation stages, and business scenarios. Deployment in two large-scale industrial scenarios substantially improves the ROI of sequence scaling and delivers consistent gains in online A/B tests at ByteDance.

</details>


### [382] [LEGIT: Live Eligibility Gating over Identifier Tries for Constrained Decoding of Heterogeneous Pages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10357)
*Felix Fang,Zheng Liu,Robert Saliba*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式推荐系统中"整页一次性解码"场景下的合法性约束问题（LEGIT），提出用深度优先编号把实时资格过滤与去重规则转化为对 store trie 和 item trie 的区间查询，并通过 H100/B200 上 36 种实现的对比分析，最终给出 CPU 遍历 trie + GPU 推理的并行方案，把每 token 耗时从直连 GPU 实现的 5 倍降至约 1.7 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Uber Eats 的生成式搜索一次解码输出整页（店铺+菜品）结果，因此每个 Semantic ID 必须对应真实、对当前请求有配送资格且未重复出现的店铺或菜品，菜品还须归属于上方店铺。这些规则随请求和已生成 token 动态变化，现有 trie 只能保证 ID 真实，语法约束解码器无法既精确又快速地施加这类动态约束。

Method: 提出 LEGIT（live eligibility gating over identifier tries）：对 trie 叶子做深度优先编号，使"资格过滤""去重""父子归属"等规则退化为对 store trie / item trie 的区间查询；生成结果再经独立目录校验。在单张 B200 GPU、每步 1–2 个请求的设置下实现 36 个版本，结合硬件计数器与消融定位瓶颈，最终采用 CPU 走 trie、GPU 并行跑模型的无自定义 kernel 方案。

Result: 直接在 GPU 上遍历 trie 的实现使每 token 比无约束解码慢约 5 倍；计数器与消融表明开销来自 kernel 启动与 CPU-GPU 等待。最优 CPU-GPU 并行实现无需自定义 kernel，单 token 时间较直连 GPU 实现降低 65.9%，约为无约束成本的 1.7 倍；在"菜品先于店铺"的页面布局下同样最快。

Conclusion: 对随请求变化的合法性约束，关键是避免把细粒度 trie 遍历放进 GPU kernel，而应利用 CPU/GPU 并行隐藏约束检查开销；区间化 trie 编号使规则既可精确执行又能廉价检查，为整页生成式推荐的实时约束解码提供了实用方案。

Abstract: A generative recommender names each candidate with a short token sequence, a Semantic ID, and recommends by generating those tokens. Some generative recommenders, including the Uber Eats search engine we are building, write a whole results page, stores with their menu items, in one decoding pass. Every Semantic ID on such a page must name a real store or item that is eligible for the search, such as a store that delivers to the user's location, and that is not already on the page. Each item must also belong to the store above it. A trie over the catalog keeps identifiers real, but eligibility and repetition change with every request and token, and the grammar-constrained decoder we tried could not enforce these changing rules exactly and quickly. We call this constraint LEGIT, for live eligibility gating over identifier tries. Numbering trie leaves depth first turns each rule into a range lookup over one store trie and one item trie, and every generated page passes an independent catalog check. On one NVIDIA B200 GPU with one or two requests per decode step, a direct implementation that walks the trie on the GPU makes each token about 5 times as slow as unconstrained decoding. Across 36 implementations, hardware counters and ablations are consistent with kernel launches and CPU-GPU waits as the source of this slowdown. Our fastest implementation walks the trie on the CPU while the GPU runs the model, needs no custom kernel, and cuts time per output token by 65.9 percent against the direct GPU implementation, to about 1.7 times the unconstrained cost. This implementation is also the fastest on a page layout that puts each item before its store.

</details>


### [383] [Yuanbao-Reranker: Document-Grounded Synthesis and Preference Distillation for Text Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10405)
*Hongyuan Xu,Dezhi Ye,Jiahao Cao,Jie Liu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Jin Ma*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Yuanbao-Reranker 是基于 Qwen3 的通用稠密重排序模型家族（0.6B/4B/8B），通过可扩展数据合成、三阶段筛选、带教师间隔的难负样本采样及点式+铰链联合训练，在中文、多语、英文、长文和代码五大检索基准上各参数档均达最优（8B 达 74.21 Avg.）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高精度文本重排序在现代搜索、推荐与 Agentic RAG 中至关重要，但构建大规模、多样且可靠的多档排序监督较为困难，且真实检索池中易混入假负例，难以跨越不同参数规模的性能鸿沟。

Method: 基于 Qwen3 构建 0.6B/4B/8B 重排序器；用答案优先与查询类型引导的文档扎根合成生成数据，经三阶段筛选（正例支撑验证、语义去冗余、按来源×长度配额均衡）；用教师分数间隔从真实检索池中筛除潜在假负例，并采样 Hard/Medium/Moderate 负例档，形成 2.75M 条 1:3 排序组；训练时联合优化点式相关性交叉熵与有界最小间隔铰链目标（覆盖正-负与负-负对），支持跨尺度与同尺度蒸馏，再接层级自适应模型合并。

Result: 在 CMTEB-R、MMTEB-R、BEIR、MLDR、MTEB-Code 五个基准上各参数档均领先：0.6B 达 70.96 Avg.，超过 1B–4B 激活参数基线；4B 达 73.63 Avg.，超越 8B 教师（72.68）；8B 达 SOTA 74.21 Avg.，且在不同一阶段检索器上泛化增益显著。

Conclusion: 可扩展的监督数据构建流程（合成+筛选+间隔采样）配合点式-铰链联合目标与自适应合并，可在小模型上实现强重排序性能并有效跨规模知识迁移，验证了数据质量与训练目标设计对稠密重排序的关键作用。

Abstract: High-precision text reranking is a critical component in modern search, recommendation, and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. We present Yuanbao-Reranker, a family of general-purpose dense rerankers spanning 0.6B, 4B, and 8B parameter scales built upon the Qwen3 backbone. To construct diverse and reliable ranking supervision at scale, we pair answer-first and query-type-guided document-grounded synthesis with a three-stage curation funnel that verifies positive support, eliminates semantic redundancy, and enforces balanced source-by-length quotas. For each curated pair, we screen real retrieval pools with a teacher score margin to filter out potential false negatives and sample Hard, Medium, and Moderate negative tiers, yielding 2.75M $1{:}3$ ranking groups. We train the models by jointly optimizing pointwise relevance cross-entropy and a bounded minimum-gap hinge objective over both positive--negative and negative--negative pairs. This formulation transfers fine-grained teacher preferences across candidate tiers without over-constraining well-separated predictions, supporting both cross-scale and same-scale distillation followed by layerwise adaptive model merging. Across five comprehensive benchmarks spanning Chinese (CMTEB-R), multilingual (MMTEB-R), English (BEIR), long-document (MLDR), and code (MTEB-Code) retrieval, Yuanbao-Reranker consistently leads every parameter tier: the 0.6B variant reaches 70.96 Avg. to surpass 1B--4B active-parameter baselines, the 4B variant reaches 73.63 Avg. to outperform the 8B teacher (72.68), and the 8B variant achieves a state-of-the-art 74.21 Avg., with substantial gains generalizing across distinct first-stage retrievers.

</details>


### [384] [When Greedy Is Sorting: Exact and Certified Ideal Rankings for Novelty Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10576)
*Kehan Liu,Zhaoyun Chen,Xianquan Yan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究α-nDCG与ERR-IA理想排序的精确计算问题，识别出每个文档仅被一个意图判为相关时的"精确可解区"，并给出ChainMerge算法（O(G+K log G)或O(n+K log G)）替代贪心规则的Θ(nK)；同时证明意图重叠时精确优化是NP-hard，并提出LP上界与最优性证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: α-nDCG等novelty指标的理想排序（即归一化分母）一般情形是NP-hard，业界常用的贪心评估器在每个排名位置重新扫描所有剩余文档，代价为Θ(nK)。作者希望找出理想排序既精确又廉价的可解区间，并刻画其困难根源。

Method: 当每个文档至多在一个意图上被正判时，α-DCG与ERR-IA均退化为"固定预算在边际收益递减链上的经典分配"问题；作者设计指标专属的虚拟分数变换加多路归并算法ChainMerge，在已排序意图组上取全局最优top-K。对任意重叠，则用嵌套排名前缀上的多项式规模LP给出理想分数的上界并证明任意可行排序的最优性间隙；并证明α=0.5、对数折扣下即使每文档3意图、每意图2文档也是NP-hard。

Result: TREC Web 2009-2012官方判定中，64.8%的正例文档只服务单一意图，但198个完整查询仅20个全程满足；LP将189/198个贪心分母认证为全局最优，所得分数区间在全部8个配对比较组中保留原胜者；MIND-small的65,238个候选上，ChainMerge与贪心目标值完全一致且快17–1,011倍。

Conclusion: α-DCG理想排序的困难性可归结为意图重叠：无重叠时存在精确高效的ChainMerge算法，重叠时NP-hard但LP可给出可认证的最优性间隙，实用上贪心分母几乎总是最优。

Abstract: The ideal ranking that normalizes novelty metrics is NP-hard to compute in general, so widely used $α$-nDCG evaluators approximate its denominator with a greedy rule that rescans every remaining document at each rank. We identify a regime in which this ideal ranking is exact and cheap for both $α$-DCG and intent-aware expected reciprocal rank (ERR-IA). When each document is positively judged for at most one intent, each metric reduces to the classical allocation of a fixed budget across chains of decreasing marginal gains. A metric-specific virtual-score transformation followed by a multiway merge, which we call ChainMerge, returns the globally optimal top-$K$ ranking in $O(G+K\log G)$ time from $G$ preordered intent groups, or in $O(n+K\log G)$ time from $n$ globally preordered candidates, instead of the $Θ(nK)$ of the greedy rule. When intent judgments overlap, exact $α$-DCG optimization is NP-hard under the standard logarithmic discount and $α=0.5$, even when every document has three intents and every intent occurs in two documents. For arbitrary overlap, a polynomial-size LP over nested ranking prefixes upper-bounds the ideal score and certifies the optimality gap of any feasible ranking. In the official TREC Web 2009-2012 judgments, 64.8% of positive documents serve a single intent, yet only 20 of 198 complete queries do so throughout. Beyond this exact regime, the LP certifies 189 of the 198 greedy denominators as globally optimal, and the resulting score intervals preserve the winner in all eight matched comparison groups. On 65,238 MIND-small candidates, ChainMerge returns identical optimal objectives 17-1,011 times faster than the greedy rule. For $α$-DCG, these results trace the hardness of the ideal ranking to intent overlap.

</details>


### [385] [Formalizing Patient-Set Semantics for OMOP CDM-Based Clinical Trial Feasibility Assessment:A Neuro-Symbolic Methodology for Traceable Site-Feasibility Patient Counts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10681)
*Sohyeon Jeon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究提出NS-CoT神经符号流水线，用LLM解析临床试验入排标准并结合符号处理与确定性SQL编译，在OMOP CDM上估计中心可行性患者数，并评估其可审查性与对参考定义的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验中心可行性评估需要按自然语言入排标准计算符合的患者数；需明确各项概念、时序、排除、代理变量和数据可用性选择，并保证计算过程可审查、与声明定义一致。

Method: NS-CoT：LLM解释并结构化入排标准→符号化处理→确定性SQL编译；保留中间表示与执行记录。在合成OMOP CDM数据、受控基准和多中心模拟上，与直接SQL基线比较执行成功率、计数一致性、患者集一致性及站点可行性标签与排序的保持情况，并做逐层检查纠错。

Result: 性能随评估设置而变化；相比直接SQL基线，可考察执行成功、计数与患者集一致性以及参考定义下可行性标签和排序的保持；逐层检查有助于发现实现与策略错误并纠正后重评。

Conclusion: 该工作关注队列计算相对于声明参考定义的可审查性与保真度，未证明这些定义对应唯一临床真值，也未证明能改善招募、选点或试验结局。

Abstract: This study examines the interpretation and execution of natural-language eligibility criteria for clinical trial site-feasibility patient-count estimation using the OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). It treats each count as the size of a patient set produced under explicitly declared choices about clinical concepts, temporal conditions, exclusions, proxies, and available data.
  The study presents NS-CoT, a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses an LLM to interpret and structure criteria, followed by symbolic processing and deterministic SQL compilation. Intermediate representations and execution records document how criteria are translated into patient sets and counts.
  Evaluation uses synthetic OMOP CDM data, controlled benchmarks, and a multi-site simulation. Comparisons with a direct-SQL baseline examine execution success, count agreement, patient-set agreement, and preservation of reference-defined site-feasibility labels and rankings. Performance varies across evaluation settings. Layer-wise inspection also supports the identification of implementation and policy errors, followed by correction and re-evaluation.
  The work investigates the reviewability and fidelity of cohort computation relative to declared reference definitions. It does not establish that these definitions capture a unique clinical ground truth or demonstrate improved recruitment, site selection, or trial outcomes in practice.

</details>


### [386] [From User Behaviors to Satisfaction Judgments: Reasoning about User Satisfaction with AI Overviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10715)
*Xingzhu Wang,Yitong Xu,Yue Li,Daiting Shi,Jingzhou He,Jiaxin Mao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出 STaRS，一种基于 LLM 的方法，从用户行为信号出发预测用户对 AI 搜索概览（AI overviews）的满意度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 概览在搜索中日益普及，但目前评估研究主要关注回答质量，仅有少量研究从用户视角切入；且现有评估只看查询和回答内容，用户行为所携带的信息未被充分利用。

Method: 先把传统信息检索中基于行为的满意度预测方法迁移到该场景，指出其局限后提出 STaRS：核心是结构化推理流程，先逐个解释单个行为信号的含义，再综合这些含义预测用户满意度；并用强化学习优化该流程，同时以奖励塑形（reward shaping）缓解训练中的奖励稀疏问题。

Result: 在两个真实数据集上，STaRS 的满意度预测效果优于对比方法。

Conclusion: STaRS 为搜索提供方给出了一种可实际操作的方式，用来准确估计用户对 AI 概览的满意度。

Abstract: The growing presence of AI overviews in everyday search makes their effective evaluation essential. Response quality has been the primary focus of existing evaluation research, with only a small number of studies examining the user perspective. These evaluations rely on queries and response content, leaving the information conveyed by user behavior insufficiently utilized. This work investigates satisfaction prediction for AI overviews from a user-centered perspective and incorporates behavioral signals into the prediction process. Applying existing behavior-based satisfaction prediction methods from traditional information retrieval to this setting, however, presents limitations. We address these limitations with STaRS, an LLM-based approach designed specifically for predicting satisfaction with AI overviews. At its core is a structured reasoning procedure: individual behavioral signals are interpreted first, and their implications then inform the prediction of user satisfaction. Reinforcement learning further optimizes this procedure, while a reward shaping mechanism alleviates reward sparsity during training. Evaluation on two real-world datasets demonstrates that STaRS outperforms the comparison methods in satisfaction prediction, providing search providers with a practical means of accurately estimating users' satisfaction with AI overviews.

</details>


### [387] [A Tool for Anonymized Clinical Knowledge Retrieval and Speaker Interaction Analysis of Healthcare Tele-mentoring Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10922)
*Parthaw Goswami,Erfan Zareei,Amy Vogelsmeier,Dima Dandachi,Ben Casterline,Mirna Becevic,Praveen Rao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一个用于Project ECHO远程指导会话的工具，可在本地匿名化检索临床知识并分析多说话人互动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECHO远程指导会话含多年多说话人的临床知识，但存在跨会话上下文污染、参与者隐私泄露以及公平参与度难以量化的问题，且需避免云API依赖。

Method: 工具包含四项设计：(a) 复合元数据过滤器，在检索时实施严格的说话人和会话级隔离；(b) 本地部署MedGemma-4B，支持三种查询模式生成临床依据充分的回答；(c) 交互图计算介数中心性、PageRank影响力和轮流发言模式以量化参与公平性；(d) 一致的别名匿名化方案，确保任何输出不出现真实姓名。

Result: 演示中医疗提供者可交互查询多年ECHO会话、通过交互图探索参与动态、并排比较会话，并用六个无参考RAG指标评估回答质量，全程无云API依赖。

Conclusion: 该工具实现了隐私保护、会话隔离与参与度分析的统一，为临床知识检索和协作质量评估提供了可本地运行的可演示方案。

Abstract: We present a tool for anonymized retrieval of clinical knowledge and analysis of multi-speaker interactions in tele-mentoring sessions of Project ECHO (Extension for Community Healthcare Outcomes). Our tool's novel design includes: (a) a compound metadata filter that enforces strict speaker- and session-level isolation during retrieval, preventing cross-session context contamination; (b) MedGemma-4B as a locally-hosted language model for clinically grounded answer generation across three query modes; (c) interaction graphs to compute betweenness centrality, PageRank influence, and turn-taking patterns to quantify participation equity; and (d) a consistent alias-based anonymization scheme that prevents real participant names from appearing in any rendered output. During the demo, a healthcare provider (user) will interactively query multi-year ECHO sessions, explore participation dynamics through interaction graphs, compare sessions side-by-side, and assess answer quality via six reference-free RAG metrics, all without any cloud API dependency.

</details>


### [388] [DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10977)
*Minhyeong Yu,Wonduk Seo,Seunghyun Lee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出DM-Call框架，通过本地schema校验与独立决策模型对函数选择和参数正确性进行验证，并利用混合反馈（概率+文字标签）迭代修正，提升LLM函数调用准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数调用中语法合法的调用仍可能语义错误（函数选择不当或参数不匹配），仅靠直接生成难以保证可靠性。

Method: 结合本地schema验证与独立的决策模型，分别验证函数选择与参数正确性；对被拒候选累积验证概率、二值判断和schema错误，并以数值概率与文字正确性标签组成的混合反馈指导不执行外部工具的迭代改进。

Result: 在BFCL和API-Bank（首次调用）上的广泛评估表明，相比直接生成，DM-Call以适度额外开销提升了函数调用准确率。

Conclusion: 可靠的函数调用需要语法之外的语义验证，基于决策模型验证与混合反馈的迭代修正是一种有效且成本可控的方案。

Abstract: Reliable function calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to select appropriate functions and generate arguments consistent with user intent. However, syntactically valid calls may still be semantically incorrect due to inappropriate function selection or mismatched arguments. In this paper, we propose Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling (DM-Call), a framework that combines local schema validation with separate decision-model verification of function selection and argument correctness. For rejected candidates, DM-Call accumulates verification probabilities, binary judgments, and schema errors across attempts. A hybrid feedback representation further combines numerical probabilities with verbal correctness labels to guide iterative refinement without executing external tools. Extensive evaluation across BFCL and API-Bank (first-call) demonstrates DM-Call boosts function-calling accuracy versus direct generation, at modest additional cost.

</details>


### [389] [Slim Foundation Models for Latency-Critical Recommendation Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11013)
*Danyal Aftab,Anas Zafar,Assadig Abakr,Steven Davy*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SlimFM 通过结构化剪枝、LoRA 字段感知微调与语义引导融合，使在线 LLM 语义建模在 CTR 预测中变得可行：LLaMA3-8B 压缩至 4.5B 参数，保留超 99% 精度，延迟最高降低 3.4 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 可为 CTR 预测提供丰富语义先验，改善冷启动与长尾场景；但全尺寸 LLM 在线推理代价过高，现有方法只能离线缓存 LLM 输出，无法真正在线服务。
