Method: 提出 SlimFM：(1) 依赖感知结构化剪枝，将 LLaMA3-8B 压缩 44% 至 4.5B 骨干；(2) 基于 LoRA 的字段感知微调，使剪枝模型从轻量文本提示生成判别性字段级语义嵌入；(3) 语义引导融合模块，将嵌入注入传统 CTR 模型的特征交互中。

Result: 在 4 个数据集、6 种 CTR 骨干模型上，保留未压缩模型 99% 以上精度，相较现有 LLM 增强基线推理延迟最高降低 3.4 倍。

Conclusion: SlimFM 证明了经剪枝与字段级微调的 LLM 可作为高性价比在线语义编码器，为 LLM 增强 CTR 的工业落地提供可行路径。

Abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is a core component of recommendation and advertising systems. Large language models (LLMs) offer rich semantic priors that improve prediction quality, particularly in cold-start and long-tail settings. Injecting a full-scale LLM into a CTR pipeline is, however, prohibitively expensive at inference time: existing LLM-enhanced CTR methods avoid this cost by caching LLM outputs offline rather than serving the LLM online. We propose a resource-efficient pipeline, SlimFM, that makes online LLM-based semantic modeling practical: (1) dependency-aware structured pruning compresses LLaMA3-8B by 44% to a 4.5B-parameter backbone; (2) LoRA-based field-aware fine-tuning trains the pruned model to produce discriminative field-level semantic embeddings from lightweight textual prompts; (3) a semantic-guided fusion module injects these embeddings into the feature interactions of a conventional CTR model. Across four datasets and six CTR backbones, SlimFM retains over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy while reducing inference latency by up to 3.4x relative to existing LLM-enhanced baselines.

</details>


### [390] [RoutingTrie: Metadata Routing for Constrained Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11016)
*Darshan Fofadiya,Yang Liu,Shuying Sun,Kyumin Park,Juhana Kangaspunta*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RoutingTrie 在 beam selection 之前引入元数据约束，通过共享 SID trie 加字段级紧凑索引实现生成前置过滤，生产回放中 Hit@100 从 67.5% 提升至 96.1%，仅增加 1.1ms 延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索需同时满足相关性要求与请求元数据约束。现有做法依赖 catalog trie 保证 SID 合法，但仅在生成后过滤元数据，既浪费被拒候选的算力，又可能造成合格结果数量不足。

Method: 提出 RoutingTrie：维护一个共享 SID trie，并为每个元数据字段用 Dense Bitset 或 Sparse List 构建紧凑索引；给出存储开销公式以指导不同字段分布下的表示选择。解码时通过字段探测判断候选边之下是否存在所请求的值，生成组合掩码引导 beam selection。

Result: 在可配置合成基准 ShopTrie 上验证了紧凑存储与多样化元数据分布下高效 CPU/GPU 探测；生产回放中 Hit@100 由 67.5% 升至 96.1%（+28.6pp），延迟仅增加 1.1ms。

Conclusion: 将元数据约束前移至 beam 选择阶段可显著提升合格结果命中率，且存储与延迟开销低。作者将开源 ShopTrie 生成器、基准脚本及 CPU 与 Triton GPU 实现以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Advances in large language models and semantic IDs (SIDs) have brought generative retrieval (GR) into industrial applications. These systems must return items that satisfy request metadata constraints as well as relevance requirements. A catalog trie ensures SID validity, but filtering metadata only after generation wastes computation on rejected candidates and may leave too few eligible results. We propose RoutingTrie to incorporate metadata constraints before beam selection. RoutingTrie maintains one shared SID trie and builds a compact index for each metadata field using Dense Bitset or Sparse List. We derive a storage cost formula to guide the choice between these index representations for different field distributions. During decoding, field probes determine whether requested values occur below candidate edges and produce a combined mask that guides beam selection. Experiments on ShopTrie, our configurable synthetic benchmark, demonstrate compact storage and efficient CPU and GPU probing across diverse metadata distributions. In a production replay, RoutingTrie raises Hit@100 from 67.5\% to 96.1\%, a gain of 28.6 percentage points, with only 1.1 ms latency increase. We will release the ShopTrie generator, benchmark scripts, and RoutingTrie CPU and Triton GPU implementations to support reproducibility.

</details>


### [391] [PCG-RAG: Progressive Compositional Grounding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Complex Web Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11113)
*Linyao Zheng,Xuhang Shi,Zhifang Mao,Chongqi Qu,Xiuquan Hou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PCG-RAG 是一个基于渐进式组合接地（PCG）的检索增强生成框架，用于解决复杂网页问答中实体识别与跨页面证据整合的难题，在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 WebWalkerQA 上分别较最优基线提升 5.43 和 5.15 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂网页问答需从多线索描述中识别目标实体，并整合散落在长网页中的证据。单个页面往往只满足部分语义约束，且某页发现的线索会引导后续检索；但对部分支持的实体假设过早依赖会使检索偏离原始信息需求。因此系统需用部分证据引导搜索，同时寻找确立目标实体所需的证据。

Method: 提出 PCG-RAG，包含三部分：(1) 渐进式证据获取，将后续检索导向候选属性与关系的缺失证据；(2) 组合式推理，沿子问题有向无环图（DAG）将候选引导检索与基于证据的回答分离，使用临时名称使依赖检索具体化，回答任务依据已接受结果与未解决的识别条件并对照原问题评估；(3) 证据接地，将识别性与关系性源段落同受支持的中间答案结合，在最终生成时把跨网页证据连接至原始条件。

Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 WebWalkerQA 上，PCG-RAG 的准确率分别比对比的最优基线高出 5.43 和 5.15 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过渐进式证据获取、组合式推理与证据接地的协同设计，PCG-RAG 能有效利用部分证据引导检索并跨页面整合证据，显著提升复杂网页问答的准确率。

Abstract: Complex Web question answering requires retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to identify target entities from multi-clue descriptions and connect evidence scattered across long Web pages. Individual pages often support only some of the required semantic constraints, while clues discovered on one page guide subsequent searches on others. However, premature reliance on partially supported entity hypotheses can divert retrieval from the original information need. RAG systems must therefore use partial evidence to guide further searches while seeking the evidence needed to establish the intended entities. We propose PCG-RAG, a novel RAG framework based on Progressive Compositional Grounding (PCG). Progressive Evidence Acquisition directs subsequent searches toward missing evidence for candidate attributes and relations. Compositional Reasoning separates candidate-guided retrieval from evidence-based answering along a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of subquestions. Provisional names make dependent searches specific, while answering tasks use accepted results and unresolved identifying conditions, assessed against the original question. New passages connect the identifying clues to the requested relations, supporting evidence-based downstream answers. Evidence Grounding combines identifying and relational source passages with supported intermediate answers, connecting evidence across Web pages to the original conditions during final generation. On BrowseComp-Plus and WebWalkerQA, PCG-RAG improves accuracy over the leading compared baselines by 5.43 and 5.15 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [392] [Dhara: Evidence-Oriented Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11197)
*Avinash Holenarasipur Nagendra,Anand Kaniyaar Sriranga Prasad,Rahul Vishwakarma,Trupti Gavit,Anish Amol Tipnis,Yashaswini Mandayam Rangayyan,Vinod Appajanna,Kousik Sarathy Sridharan,Mohan Raghavan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Dhara——面向印度知识体系（IKS）文献的检索系统，融合混合检索、篇章/书籍级实体笔记（EN）、模糊诗节检索（FVR）与神经重排，并在 Dhara Bench 的 325 个问题上与 BM25、ColBERTv2、Gemini 等系统进行多维度对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IKS 文献中的证据分散于诗节、译文与注疏等不同位置，需将自然语言问题和记忆不全的诗节片段匹配到原文，传统单一检索方式难以胜任。

Method: 构建 Dhara 检索引擎，包含混合检索、章节与书籍级实体笔记（EN）、模糊诗节检索（FVR）及神经重排；在 Dhara Bench（325 问）上开展五组对比实验（检索表示 vs BM25、EN 贡献、重排器质量与耗时、FVR、Gemini）。

Result: BGE-M3 单向量检索在 nDCG@10、Recall@20、MRR@20 上全面优于 BM25，与 ColBERTv2 相当但延迟更低（0.108s vs 0.962s）、磁盘占用更小；加入 EN 后多数类别 nDCG@10 提升；Qwen 重排全面优于 BGE，但计算时间约为 6.72 倍；FVR 使 Verse 类别 nDCG@10 提升约 20 个百分点；Qwen+EN+FVR 管线在 10 个类别上 Recall@20 超过 Gemini，多跳问题完整证据检索更强，但 Gemini 在早期相关性上仍有优势。

Conclusion: 研究为按证据需求与资源预算选择检索方案提供了实证依据：效率优先可选 BGE-M3+EN+FVR，质量优先可加 Qwen 重排。

Abstract: Relevant evidence in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) collections may be distributed across passages in different parts of a work, including verses, translations, and commentaries. Locating it requires matching natural-language questions and partially remembered verse fragments to source passages. We present Dhara, a retrieval engine combining hybrid search, chapter- and book-level Entity Notes (EN), Fuzzy Verse Retrieval (FVR), and neural reranking. Five comparisons on the 325 questions in Dhara Bench examine retrieval representations against BM25, EN's contribution, reranker quality and computation time, FVR, and Gemini. BGE-M3 single-vector retrieval exceeds BM25 in nDCG@10, Recall@20, and MRR@20 across all categories. Its scores are broadly comparable to ColBERTv2, with mean retrieval times of 0.108 s and 0.962 s under the same hardware configuration and a smaller memory footprint for chunk storage on disk. Adding EN to a direct branch with a matched candidate count improves nDCG@10 in all twelve categories with Qwen and ten with BGE; the combined ranking is capped at the same candidate count. Qwen improves nDCG@10, Precision@5, and MRR@20 over BGE in every category, at approximately 6.72 times the overall estimated serial computation time. FVR increases Verse-category nDCG@10 by approximately 20 percentage points with either reranker. Gemini is evaluated after source mapping and manual review with relevance annotations visible. The Qwen pipeline with EN and FVR has higher Recall@20 than Gemini in ten categories and stronger complete-evidence retrieval in Multi-hop questions, while Gemini retains early-relevance advantages in several categories. The results inform retrieval choices according to evidence requirements and resource budgets.

</details>


### [393] [An Adaptive, Context-Aware, and Stacked Attention Network-Based Recommendation System to Capture Users' Temporal Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11278)
*Jung-Hsien Chiang,Chung-Yao Ma,Chi-Shiang Wang,Pei-Yi Hao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于上下文与双重注意力机制的自适应推荐系统，用以捕捉用户随时间变化的偏好，实验表明其优于多种先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统需应对海量信息下用户难以发现所需内容的困境；而用户偏好会因年龄增长和社交网络影响随时间变化，如何捕捉并适应用户动态偏好是推荐系统的难点。

Method: 以用户在定义时间区间内的交互物品构建上下文；设计两个注意力机制：上下文物品注意力模块用于捕捉上下文信息、偏好变化模式及物品重要性；多头注意力模块用于扩展偏好多样性并适应偏好变化；并利用物品时间信息建模上下文物品表示。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上与多种先进推荐方法对比，所提上下文感知模型优于传统方法，验证了注意力机制对上下文信息捕捉的有效性。

Conclusion: 利用上下文信息与双重注意力机制能有效建模用户动态偏好并提升推荐性能。

Abstract: Recommendation systems have become more important since the widespread use of the Internet. The large amount of information means that it is difficult for users to discover they really need. However, users' preferences can change over time because of the age and the impact of social networks. Recommendation systems must capture users' preferences and recommend suitable items, which is a difficult challenge. This study proposes a novel recommendation system that adapts to the changing preferences of users. By learning and adapting to users' changing preferences better recommendations are provided. This study uses context factors as additional information to model users' preferences more precisely. For the proposed recommendation system, the context is based on users' interaction items within each defined time interval. This study proposes two novel attention mechanisms for the recommendation system. The contextual item attention module captures contextual information, changing pattern in users' preference and the importance of items. The multi-head attention module extends the diversity of users' preferences and adapts to changing preferences. The recommendation performance is improved using additional item's temporal information to model the contextual item's representation. Experiments compare the proposed algorithm with several state-of-the-art recommendation methods using three real-world datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed context-aware recommendation model outperforms traditional methods and demonstrate the effectiveness with which contextual information is captured by the attention mechanism.

</details>


### [394] [IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11346)
*Xiao Chen,Dong Fang,Haitao Li,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: IntentLens将欠约束的多模态查询（参考图+模糊文本）先"接地"成与查询相关的证据，再进行用户-物品匹配，在自建两个基准上优于MLLM与检索基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能个人助理场景中，用户常给一张参考图加模糊自然语言查询，关键视觉属性、个性化偏好和物品侧约束均隐含。现有方法要么依赖历史交互+多模态特征，要么假设查询文本已充分表述，均难以处理欠约束多模态查询的精确匹配。

Method: 提出ground-then-rank框架IntentLens：共享多模态LLM调用视觉工具、用户记忆模块和物品属性检索工具，(i)从图文输入推断潜在用户意图，(ii)为每个候选项补充细粒度、以查询为条件的证据；随后用轻量排序器基于接地后的表示打分。并构建GoogleReview-MMTool与Yelp-MMTool两个欠约束多模态查询基准。

Result: 在两个基准上的大量实验表明，IntentLens优于有竞争力的MLLM基线和检索基线，并对未见类别和数据集具有较强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将模糊多模态查询先接地为证据再排序，是解决欠约束多模态推荐的有效范式；工具增强与轻量排序结合兼具效果与泛化性。

Abstract: As intelligent personal assistants are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios, recommendation paradigms are shifting from passive preference matching to inferring user intent from underspecified multimodal inputs. In practical interactions, users typically issue a reference image paired with a vague natural language query, keeping key visual attributes, personalized preferences, and item-side constraints implicit. Existing recommendation methods either leverage historical user interactions augmented with multimodal item features or assume fully articulated textual queries; both paradigms struggle to resolve underspecified multimodal queries for accurate item matching. To address this limitation, we propose IntentLens, a tool-augmented recommendation framework that grounds ambiguous multimodal queries into query-relevant evidence prior to user-item matching. IntentLens follows a ground-then-rank pipeline: a shared multimodal LLM leverages visual tools, user memory modules, and item attribute retrieval tools to (i) infer latent user intent from image-text inputs and (ii) augment each candidate item with fine-grained, query-conditioned evidence. Subsequently, a lightweight ranker scores candidates based on the grounded representations. To facilitate research in this novel setting, we construct two benchmarks with underspecified multimodal queries, namely \textsc{GoogleReview-MMTool} and \textsc{Yelp-MMTool}. Extensive experiments on these benchmarks demonstrate that IntentLens outperforms competitive MLLM and retrieval baselines, and exhibits strong generalization to unseen categories and datasets.

</details>


### [395] [Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11480)
*Shengyao Zhuang,Xueguang Ma,Matthias Petri,Jimmy Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文复现"Beyond Yes and No"的FLAN-UL2零样本排序设置，并评估Jev等决策模型的排序能力与概率校准。结果显示Jev与27B pplx-decider排序优于FLAN-UL2和三个交叉编码器，但Jev原生概率过度自信，经两参数校准后可显著改善Brier分数，并支持无参数的期望F1截断选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev等决策模型宣称其typed score返回的各级相关性概率是校准好的，而此前"Beyond Yes and No"工作虽用似然推导分数改进了零样本逐点LLM重排，却未验证校准问题。作者由此重新审视细粒度标签下的校准与排序表现。

Method: 在八个BEIR集合上复现FLAN-UL2设置以确认排序趋势，然后用相同协议评测Jev和两个开放权重决策模型；接着将Jev的原生概率与人工标注对比，用DL19上2,257对数据拟合两参数校准并迁移到DL21；最后用校准概率按期望F1选择每查询截断阈值。

Result: Jev和27B pplx-decider平均重排效果优于FLAN-UL2及三个交叉编码器；Jev原生概率过度自信（DL21上评分>0.9的对中仅66%相关）；两参数校准消除大部分偏差并有效迁移；校准后Jev的DL21 Brier分数低于FLAN-UL2和三个交叉编码器，主要因其更好区分相关与不相关对。

Conclusion: 决策模型具备较强零样本重排能力，但其概率需校准才可信；简单两参数校准即可跨数据集迁移，且基于校准概率的期望F1截断无需额外参数、优于固定top-10并媲美在DL19上调优的阈值。

Abstract: Decision models such as Jev are a new kind of relevance scorer. Their typed score primitive takes a question, an ordered set of textual relevance levels and a state, and returns a probability for each level directly, rather than token likelihoods or generated labels. Jev's vendor promises that these probabilities are calibrated. This motivates revisiting 'Beyond Yes and No', which improved zero-shot pointwise LLM reranking using likelihood-derived scores over fine-grained relevance labels but left calibration against human assessors as future work. In this paper, we first reproduce its open-model FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, confirming its ranking trends, and then run Jev and two open-weight decision models with the same protocol. Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. We then compare Jev's native probabilities with the human assessors' labels and find them overconfident: of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant. Since this is mostly an error of scale, a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of it and transfers to DL21. After calibration, Jev has a lower DL21 Brier score than FLAN-UL2 and the three cross-encoders, mainly because it separates relevant from non-relevant pairs better. Finally, with calibrated probabilities, choosing each query's cut-off by expected F1 needs no parameter of its own, beats a fixed top-10 cut and matches a cut-off threshold tuned on DL19.

</details>


### [396] [Not All Branches Are Equal: Adaptive Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11549)
*Guy Hadad,Haggai Roitman,Bracha Shapira*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 Adaptive Silhouette Tree (AST)，用自上而下分裂聚类把物品语义 ID 构造成树中的路径，动态决定分支数以最大化轮廓系数，从而对齐生成式推荐器的层级结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于残差/层次向量量化的语义 ID 方法假设各量化层级的 token 语义独立；作者认为语义 ID 应是每个 token 含义以前缀为条件的层级路径，固定码本量化与生成式推荐器隐含学习的层级结构存在失配。

Method: AST 采用自上而下的分裂式聚类构建树结构语义 ID；每个节点的分支数不固定，而是通过最大化轮廓系数（silhouette coefficient）动态确定，使密集区域划分更细、同质区域更紧凑；并提出约束变体，在分裂时强制最小概率质量，以改善长尾物品的监督信号。

Result: 在五个规模与领域各异的 Amazon Review 数据集上，AST 显著优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 使语义 ID 的构建方式与生成式推荐器固有的层级结构对齐，可获得更有效的推荐效果。

Abstract: Generative recommendation models represent items as sequences of discrete tokens known as semantic IDs. Existing approaches derive these identifiers using residual or hierarchical vector quantization, assuming that tokens carry independent semantic meaning across quantization levels. Revisiting this assumption, we argue that semantic IDs should behave as hierarchical paths where each token's meaning is conditioned on its prefix. This highlights a mismatch between conventional fixed-codebook quantization and the hierarchical structure implicitly learned by generative recommenders. Motivated by this insight, we propose Adaptive Silhouette Tree (AST), a top-down divisive clustering method that constructs semantic IDs as paths within a tree structure. Unlike prior methods with fixed branching factors, AST dynamically determines the number of branches at each node by maximizing the silhouette coefficient, enabling finer partitions in dense regions and compact groupings in homogeneous ones. We further introduce constrained variants that enforce minimum probability mass during splitting to improve supervision for long-tail items. Extensive experiments on five Amazon Review datasets of varying sizes and domains show that AST significantly outperforms strong baselines. These results demonstrate that aligning semantic ID construction with the inherent hierarchical structure of generative recommenders leads to more effective recommendations.

</details>


### [397] [Proactive Dimension-Adaptive Denoising for Graph Collaborative Filtering via Representation Coherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11801)
*Wenjun Li,Dong Zhao,Jiaying Shi,Juan Zhang,Zhaoming Pan,Zhimin Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: NDL：用「表征一致性」这一非损失信号主动识别噪声交互，并与损失信号融合驱动维度自适应掩码去噪，在三个基准上显著超越DAR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式反馈存在误点击、冲动购买等噪声，会沿用户-物品图传播并污染表征。现有显式去噪方法统一依赖训练损失估计交互可靠性，但损失是被动信号：只有在噪声已造成预测误差后才能察觉，且受训练阶段、负采样、难正样本严重混淆。

Method: 提出噪声感知维度学习(NDL)。核心为表征一致性检测(RCD)：在嵌入空间衡量交互表征与用户历史偏好质心的一致性，得到与损失无关的主动噪声信号。RCD与损失信号经活跃度感知加权融合（活跃用户更依赖一致性，冷启动用户自动回退到损失），融合估计驱动交互级维度自适应掩码，限制不可靠交互的有效表征容量。另加轻量对比正则提升嵌入均匀性，稳定RCD所依赖的几何结构。

Result: 三个公开基准上一致优于SOTA去噪方法：Recall@5较最强基线DAR分别提升Amazon-book +17.95%、Yelp +12.33%、MovieLens-1M +5.63%；无对比学习的核心变体在更稀疏数据集上已超过DAR，证实表征一致性是主要增益来源。

Conclusion: NDL仅作用于训练循环，与基于LightGCN的生产管线兼容，推理时零在线延迟、零额外参数。

Abstract: Implicit feedback in recommender systems contains noisy interactions (e.g., accidental clicks, impulse purchases) that propagate through user-item graphs and contaminate learned representations. Existing explicit denoising methods uniformly rely on training loss to estimate interaction reliability. However, loss is a fundamentally passive signal: it detects noise only after it has caused prediction errors, and it is heavily confounded by training stage, negative sampling, and hard positives. We propose Noise-aware Dimension Learning (NDL), a proactive dimension-adaptive denoising framework. NDL introduces Representation Coherence Detection (RCD), which evaluates the coherence between an interaction representation and the user's historical preference centroid in embedding space, providing an active noise signal independent of loss. RCD and the loss signal are fused via activity-aware weighting (active users rely more on coherence while cold-start users automatically fall back to loss), and the fused estimate drives an interaction-level dimension-adaptive mask that limits the effective representation capacity of unreliable interactions. A lightweight contrastive regularizer further improves embedding uniformity, stabilizing the geometry on which RCD discriminates. On three public benchmarks NDL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art denoising methods, lifting Recall@5 by +17.95% on Amazon-book, +12.33% on Yelp, and +5.63% on MovieLens-1M over the strongest baseline DAR; the core variant without contrastive learning already surpasses DAR on sparser datasets, confirming representation coherence as the primary driver of these gains. NDL is confined to the training loop and is serving-compatible with LightGCN-based production pipelines, adding no online latency or parameters at inference time. Code: https://github.com/GordonDongZHAO/NDL

</details>


### [398] [Multi-Modal Agricultural Document Understanding at the DAGRI Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11886)
*Zhefan Wang,Da Li,Keping Bi,Nanqing Dong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文是NTCIR-19 DAGRI任务的技术报告，针对农业文档（技术报告、农事历等）的复杂表格与多模态理解，分别设计三条技术管线并取得TableIE第一、MTMH-QA初始第一（修正后0.8444）、FiT-QA最高BLEU的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业文档（县级技术报告、农事历）是关键知识资源，但其复杂表格布局、文档长度差异大、多模态元素密集，给自动理解带来巨大挑战，因此通过DAGRI任务从多个维度推进文档智能。

Method: 分三个子任务：TableIE采用MinerU结构保持解析+长文档区域自适应切分+视觉-文本双模态抽取的多阶段管线；MTMH-QA采用基于DCI-Agent的智能体检索框架，通过bash命令迭代探索目录，并加入跨模型验证机制；FiT-QA采用双模态VLM管线并辅以确定性答案归一化。

Result: TableIE以0.6566的精确匹配分数获第一名；MTMH-QA修正后准确率0.8444，初始排名第一；FiT-QA取得最高BLEU分数。

Conclusion: 该体系有效应对区域结构差异、跨文件动态证据发现与多模态对齐问题，为复杂农业文档理解提供了稳健框架。

Abstract: Agricultural documents, such as prefectural technical reports and crop calendars, are critical knowledge resources. However, their complex table layouts, significant variations in document length, and dense multi-modal elements pose substantial challenges for automated understanding. To address these issues, the NTCIR-19 DAGRI (Data Analytics for aGRicultural Information) task introduced three subtasks focusing on different dimensions of document intelligence. In the Table Information Extraction (TableIE) task, we developed a multi-stage pipeline combining structure-preserving parsing via MinerU, region-adaptive segmentation for long documents, and a dual-modal (vision-text) extraction strategy for complex work schedules. This approach achieved first place with an exact match score of 0.6566. For Multi-Table Multi-Hop Question Answering (MTMH-QA) over interrelated JSON tables, we adopted an agentic search framework utilizing DCI-Agent to iteratively explore directories via bash commands, reinforced by a cross-model validation mechanism. This yielded a revised accuracy of 0.8444, initially ranked first. In the Figure and Table Question Answering (FiT-QA) task, which requires comprehending single large composite images, we implemented a dual-modal VLM pipeline enhanced by deterministic answer normalization, securing the highest BLEU score. Together, our system effectively addresses regional structural variations, dynamic cross-file evidence discovery, and multi-modal alignment, providing a robust framework for complex agricultural document understanding.

</details>


### [399] [CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11955)
*Shiqi Zhang,Yang Fei,Xiaokui Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出"上下文提示优化"(CHO)问题，系统比较了七种广告上下文提示生成策略及统一策略，并通过CHO-Bench（119万+配对评估）发现上下文提示可提升广告排序，但策略差异依赖排序器类型，预算增加收益递减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM广告需根据对话（而非明确商品搜索）匹配广告，ChatGPT Ads允许广告主提供自然语言"上下文提示"辅助排序，但如何有效构建这些提示尚不清楚。

Method: 将CHO形式化为在给定预算下构造上下文提示以提升广告排名的问题；基于营销框架设计覆盖What、Who、When的七种生成策略及一个融合全部维度的Unified策略；构建CHO-Bench，在五个数据集上用基于嵌入和基于LLM的排序器进行超过119万次配对评估。

Result: 上下文提示在离线排序器下提升广告排名；各单一策略平均增益相近，Unified无稳定优势；在特定生成-排序配置下策略差异显著，嵌入型与LLM型排序器偏好不同信息维度；增加提示预算可继续提升排名但边际收益递减。

Conclusion: 研究建立了研究LLM广告中广告侧排序优化的离线基准，并指出面向特定模型选择提示、预算感知的生成与聚合等机会。

Abstract: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.

</details>


### [400] [TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12180)
*Guofeng Tong,Xu Zhang,Guangliang Yu,Haiqiang Wang,Guannan Cong,Xing Guo,Yang Zhou,Jingjing Duan,Shuang Li,Feng Shi,Hualei Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TS-GEAR 是一个面向即时配送场景的统一生成式检索框架，通过 Geo-Semantic ID、查询-地理双目标注意力与 GMPO 三项设计解决地理可达性与集合级评估问题，已在淘宝闪购搜索广告线上部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即时配送平台（如 DoorDash、Uber Eats）存在传统电商所没有的约束：超出用户配送范围的商家是"无效候选"而非仅"排序靠后"。生成式检索虽在大规模检索中表现优异，但直接迁移面临三大挑战：(1) 现有语义 ID 仅将地理作为软信号，可达性只能依赖不可微的生成后硬截断；(2) 用户偏好在不同区域和查询间差异大，不加地理与查询条件地聚合历史行为会产生兴趣估计偏差；(3) 候选集按整体价值评估，而自回归训练逐序列独立打分，缺乏集合级信号来抑制冗余的近重复结果。

Method: 提出统一生成式检索框架 TS-GEAR，含三个组件：(1) Geo-Semantic ID：将商家 ID 拆分为地理前缀与语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非后置过滤；(2) Query-Geo Target Attention：以实时查询和位置为双目标聚合历史行为，并将每条行为自身的位置编码进注意力 key；(3) GMPO（Group Marginal Policy Optimization）：在 GRPO 框架内用去重组奖励与边际优势重写优势函数，无需额外多样性目标。

Result: 在线部署采用轻量 0.1B 骨干模型，在淘宝闪购搜索广告链路中日均服务超过 1.5 亿次查询；在 HitRate 与地理有效性上持续优于 SOTA 生成式检索方法，广告曝光提升 3.8%、广告收入提升 4.2%。

Conclusion: 将地理可达性内化为生成目标、以查询与位置双条件建模兴趣、并用集合级边际奖励优化生成策略，是生成式检索落地即时配送的有效路径，且以极小模型规模实现了显著线上收益。

Abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.

</details>


### [401] [NIFT-SQL: Customer-Supervised Table Scoring for Enterprise Text-to-SQL Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12731)
*Arjun Rao,Nishant Gopinath*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: NIFT-SQL提出用客户自有示例问题分别微调检索器与交叉编码器，再经逻辑回归融合来筛选企业跨库schema中的表，在多个基准上大幅提升参考表在top-15内的召回率，并验证零样本8B重排器的可选增强效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业文本到SQL的第一步是从跨多个数据库、数百张晦涩表中定位问题所需表，难度大；作者想知道仅用表名、列名和声明主外键、并按各客户示例问题分别训练模型，能否改善表检索效果。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 在客户问题上微调的检索器做混合搜索；(2) 微调560M交叉编码器对每张表打分，判断查询是否需要该表；(3) 在留出问题上拟合逻辑回归进行融合。另测试无监督的零样本8B重排器（按数据库路由）及其分数作为两个融合特征的高精度模式，并与按数据库分组的两路rank fusion做对比。

Result: 在BEAVER、LiveSQLBench、LiveSQLBench-Large（244–971表，四个划分、三次训练）上，参考表进入top-15的比例分别为69.2%、89.5%、85.6%，对比混合搜索的30.4%、41.0%、21.8%，以及同标签微调检索器的61.1%、81.7%、70.4%；商品化搜索下未微调交叉编码器低21点。零样本8B重排器两集合无显著差异，将其分数加入融合后达72.4%、92.5%、88.6%。rank fusion与学习式融合无显著差异。新BEAVER版本上在合成测试top-8领先同标签检索器，但真实问题上top-15落后。

Conclusion: 按客户数据分别微调检索器与必要性打分交叉编码器并进行学习式融合，可显著提升企业跨库表检索；零样本重排器可作为无须标签的增强手段；结论在部分设置（真实问题top-15）上仍有局限。

Abstract: Enterprise text-to-SQL starts with finding the tables a question needs, which is hard when a schema spans several databases and hundreds of cryptic tables. We ask whether models trained separately on each customer's example questions, reading only table names, column names, and declared keys, improve table retrieval. NIFT-SQL (Necessity-Informed Fusion for Text-to-SQL) fuses hybrid search over a retriever fine-tuned on the customer's questions with a fine-tuned 560M cross-encoder that scores every table for whether the query needs it, through a logistic regression fitted on held-out questions. On BEAVER, LiveSQLBench, and LiveSQLBench-Large (244 to 971 tables; four splits, three trainings), NIFT-SQL places every reference table in the top 15 for 69.2%, 89.5%, and 85.6% of test questions, against 30.4%, 41.0%, and 21.8% for hybrid search and 61.1%, 81.7%, and 70.4% for the fine-tuned retriever with the same labels. With off-the-shelf search, the cross-encoder without fine-tuning is 21 points lower. A zero-shot 8B reranker needs no labels and, routed by database, shows no resolved complete@15 difference on two collections; adding its scores as two fusion features gives a high-accuracy mode that reaches 72.4%, 92.5%, and 88.6%, ahead of the validation-selected zero-shot reranker variant on two collections, with no resolved difference on the third. Rank fusion of the two trained parts, grouped by database, shows no resolved difference from the learned fusion. Scored once on a newer BEAVER release, NIFT-SQL beats search and leads the label-matched retriever at top 8 on the synthetic test, but trails it at top 15 on real questions.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [402] [Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09897)
*Arpita Shanbhag,Julia Tran,Dhruv Mandala,Ayda Sultan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型中模态鸿沟的成因，提出文本token在嵌入层的信息密度远低于视觉token，导致早期层偏向处理文本表征；将视觉token替换为语义最近的文本token可提高早期层对其关注度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模态鸿沟（modality gap）的起源尚不清楚，本文欲探究嵌入层中不同模态token信息密度差异是否是这一不平衡的驱动因素。

Method: 对比文本token与视觉token在嵌入层的语义密度；进行机制分析，将视觉token位置替换为语义上最接近的文本token，观察早期层注意力变化。

Result: 文本token进入模型时语义密度显著低于视觉token，促使早期层优先处理文本表征再与视觉融合；替换为近义文本token后，早期层对这些位置的注意力增加。

Conclusion: 信息密度差异是模态鸿沟的重要来源，为缓解模态鸿沟、改进VLM多模态推理架构提供了基础与启示。

Abstract: Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.

</details>


### [403] [MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09928)
*Tuan-Kiet Doan,Van-Chien Nguyen,Trung-Hieu Tran,Quang-Hung Pham,Ngoc-Son Vu,Huy Phan,Phi Le Nguyen,Duc-Han Le,Nikola Simidjievski,Van-Tam Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MAGE，一个可动态适配多时间尺度的EEG基础模型，通过多时间尺度注意力与可训练聚合模块提升跨数据集任务性能且参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于基础模型的EEG方法多采用固定时间尺度，难以捕捉跨多个时间尺度的神经动态特征，而EEG信号天然包含多尺度信息。

Method: MAGE包含两个关键机制：(i) 新颖的多时间尺度注意力机制，可学习跨多个时间尺度的表示；(ii) 可训练的聚合模块，动态识别并适配输入信号中最具信息量的时间尺度。

Result: 在七个数据集上实验表明，MAGE持续优于现有EEG基础模型，且参数量显著更少；结果支持不同下游任务受益于不同时间尺度的假设。

Conclusion: MAGE通过多时间尺度动态适配有效提升EEG基础模型的表达与泛化能力，验证了时间尺度选择对下游任务的重要性，代码将开源。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. Specifically, MAGE combines two key mechanisms: (i) a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism, capable of learning representations across multiple temporal scales and (ii) a trainable aggregation module, that dynamically identifies and adapts to the most informative timescale of the input signal. Experimental results across seven datasets demonstrate that MAGE consistently outperforms existing EEG foundation models while using substantially fewer parameters. Moreover, our results support the hypothesis that different downstream tasks benefit from distinct temporal scales. All source code will be released.

</details>


### [404] [Causal Discovery Bench: Can LLMs Autonomously Conduct Effective Experiments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09934)
*Zhuoyang Liu,Ning Peng,Ming Shen,Zijun Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Causal-Discovery-Bench，一个无领域语义线索、可配置的结构方程模型与资源约束的可验证沙盒，用于评测LLM智能体的序贯实验设计与因果发现能力；在3,802个episode、13个模型上发现四层难度层级，94.5%的错误源于实验设计而非推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体已被用于自主研究，不仅需要基于已有证据推理，还需设计信息量大的实验、分配资源、分析序贯观测并决定何时停止并下结论。但这些能力目前缺乏有效度量手段。

Method: 构建Causal-Discovery-Bench：可验证沙盒，含可配置结构方程模型与资源约束，去除领域语义线索以隔离核心能力；在3,802个episode、来自5家厂商的13个模型上，沿7大类共40项指标分析智能体行为；并通过动作轨迹归因与消融实验定位失败来源。

Result: 智能体表现呈四层难度层级：单次实验设计、因果关系序贯探索、兼顾成本与统计功效的资源感知实验、冲突证据的自主裁决。从正确整理证据做因果推断与自主实验探索因果发现之间存在显著性能鸿沟；94.5%的错误归因于实验设计而非推断；仅放宽资源约束不能可靠解决序贯发现失败；基础统计工具在多个模型家族上显著提升表现，而高级工具在模型缺乏底层能力时收益很小。

Conclusion: 当前LLM智能体的瓶颈在于实验设计而非统计推断，且能力呈层级依赖——高级工具无法弥补基础能力缺失；需优先强化低层级实验设计与序贯决策能力。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents get actively adopted for autonomous research, they must not only reason over existing evidence, but also design informative experiments, allocate resources, analyze sequential observations, and decide when to stop and make conclusions. Yet these capabilities remain poorly measured. We introduce Causal-Discovery-Bench (https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench), a verifiable sandbox with configurable structural equation models and resource constraints to evaluate sequential experimental design and causal discovery without domain-semantic cues. Across 3,802 episodes with 13 models from 5 vendors, we analyze agent behavior along 40 metrics in seven families. Agents' performance exhibits a four-level difficulty hierarchy spanning single-experiment design, sequential exploration of causal relationships, resource-aware experimentation balancing cost and statistical power, and autonomous resolution of conflicting evidence. We identify a substantial performance gap between causal inference from correctly curated evidence and navigating causal discovery through autonomous experimentation: Analyzing agents' action trajectories attributes 94.5% of their mistakes to experimental design rather than to inference, which is further consolidated with ablation studies. Relaxing resource constraints alone does not reliably resolve failures in sequential discovery. In contrast, basic statistical tools substantially improve performance across multiple model families, while advanced tools provide little additional benefit when models lack prerequisite lower-level capabilities.

</details>


### [405] [Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09935)
*Hui Wang,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Jacob Chakareski,Ming Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"智能年龄"(AoInt)指标，以模型版本相关、客户端特定、动作效用失真刻画模型同步问题，并设计KL-AoIntSync与Param-AoIntSync两种同步策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限IoT设备缓存模型做实时决策，但频繁更新带来带宽、能耗与服务开销；决策相关差异未必随时间增长，故需更精准的同步度量。

Method: 定义AoInt为模型版本相对、客户端特定、动作效用失真，将同步建模为过时决策后悔与刷新成本的权衡；KL-AoIntSync用客户端无标签探针累积输出分布变化，Param-AoIntSync用服务器广播的标量参数变化。

Result: 在固定客户端分布、动作集与效用下建立路径级保证；数值结果显示校准后的Param-AoIntSync较Instant-Parameters策略降低联合同步成本6.15%，性能与KL-AoIntSync相当。

Conclusion: AoInt框架为IoT模型同步提供效用导向度量，Param-AoIntSync以低开销实现接近KL方法的性能，适合带宽受限场景。

Abstract: Resource-constrained IoT devices cache learned models for real-time decisions, but frequent updates incur substantial bandwidth, energy, and service overhead. Because decision-relevant model differences need not grow with elapsed time, we define Age of Intelligence (AoInt) as a model-version-relative, client-specific, and action utility distortion, and formulate synchronization as a tradeoff between stale-decision regret and refresh cost. Furthermore, we develop Kullback-Leibler-aware AoInt Synchronization (KL-AoIntSync), which accumulates output-distribution changes using client-specific unlabeled probes, whereas Parameter-aware AoInt Synchronization (Param-AoIntSync) uses a server-broadcast scalar parameter change. Then, we establish pathwise guarantees with fixed client distributions, action sets, and utilities. The numerical results show that calibrated Param-AoIntSync reduces joint synchronization cost by 6.15% relative to an Instant-Parameters policy while performing comparably to KL-AoIntSync.

</details>


### [406] [Topological Deep Learning Challenge 2026: Bridging the Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10046)
*Guillermo Bernárdez,Lev Telyatnikov,Mathilde Papillon,Marco Montagna,Louisa Cornelis,Louis Van Langendonck,Antonio Purificato,Bruno Neri,David Leko,Donatella Genovese,Eleonora Grassucci,Jan-Willem Van Looy,Johan Mathe,Lucia Testa,Luka Benić,Melanie Weber,Olga Zaghen,Pavlo Vasylenko,Raffael Theiler,Scott Mahan,Gaurav Khanal,Valentina Sánchez,Dario Loi,Gabriele Onorato,Prasanna Devadiga,Taejin Paik,Anier Velasco Sotomayor,Jonas Müller,Aarav Gupta,Riyan Patel,Grold Otieno Mboya,Pushparaj Devadiga,Adam Gohain,Dominik Filipiak,Michael Banf,Alireza Mohammadian,Amirreza Akbari,Gabriel Chaviano Díaz,Marcos Chávez Mesa,Ankit Grover,Rémi Bourgerie,Alessio Comparini,Ankit Kumar,Mohammad Yusuf,Devesh Kaushal,Francesco Orsi,Ghazal Mostofi,Kolya Lettl,Salwa Khattami,Gabriel Franco,Yelizaveta Falkouskaya,Jorge Luiz Franco,Kajal Singla,Fernando David Espinosa Iñiguez,Raj Patil,Eric Dolores-Cuenca,Luigi Petti,Chenguang Xu,Stefano Blando,Christine Zeh,Lennart Bastian,Kaden Zheng,Vihan Tiwari,Sud Athreya,Hisataka Kajita,Hugo Micheron,Rémi Devaux,Antoine Jardin,Tegan Emerson,Olga Fink,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 2026年TDL挑战赛在TopoBench中用GraphUniverse合成基准并排评测GNN与TNN：任务依赖明显，社团检测差距小，三角计数上Track 1误差为Track 2的1.85倍，但部分结构增强GNN反超TNN均值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往TDL挑战赛侧重扩充建模与数据生态，缺少GNN与TNN在统一流程下的公平比较，本文希望"弥合差距"，提供单一评测管线下的并排评估。

Method: 在TopoBench中实现近期SOTA架构，Track 1为GNN、Track 2为TNN；使用GraphUniverse生成的合成基准（可控同配性、平均度、度分布重尾程度）统一评估，涵盖图、单纯复形、胞腔复形、超图与组合域，并首次引入公开排行榜。

Result: 收到34支队伍共68份合格提交。差异强烈依赖任务：社团检测上平均准确率差距不大；三角计数上Track 1平均误差为Track 2的1.85倍，但若干结构感知GNN超过Track 2均值。

Conclusion: GNN与TNN的优劣并非普遍成立而取决于任务结构，未来应在统一基准上细粒度比较，并重视结构先验对GNN的提升。

Abstract: This paper describes the 2026 edition of the Topological Deep Learning Challenge: Bridging the Gap, hosted at the second Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) Conference. Where previous editions grew the modelling and data ecosystem of Topological Deep Learning (TDL), this edition set out to place Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) side by side under a single evaluation pipeline. Participants implemented recent state-of-the-art architectures in TopoBench, with Track 1 covering GNNs and Track 2 covering TNNs. They evaluated these implementations on shared synthetic benchmarks generated with GraphUniverse, which independently controls homophily, average degree and degree-distribution heaviness. The challenge yielded 68 qualifying submissions from 34 teams, spanning the graph, simplicial, cellular, hypergraph and combinatorial domains. For the first time, submissions were also tracked on a public leaderboard, which we summarize and analyze here. Our analysis finds that the differences between the submitted tracks are strongly task-dependent: the mean accuracy gap is modest on community detection, while on triangle counting the Track 1 mean error is 1.85 times the Track 2 mean. Several structurally informed GNNs also outperform the Track 2 mean on triangle counting.

</details>


### [407] [Attention Is Only as Good as Its Witnesses: When Higher-Order Layers Help, and When They Do Not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11937)
*Mostafa 'Neo' Mohsenvand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文从"层对其见证族做配分函数求和并在某温度下读取"这一视角解释Transformer在图上搜索与SET游戏上的失败,提出深度律与规模律,并据此设计能超越Transformer的新层,在多项任务上大幅提升学习效率与参数效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer理论上可表示图搜索与SET,但实际上图变大就停止学习、需大量不同问题才学会;高阶注意力带来提升的记录也不稳定,缺乏统一解释。

Method: 将每层视为计算见证族的配分函数并以温度读取:深度律源自逻辑——L层二步游走恰好覆盖2^L−1步(Lean验证,且顶点无名称时不可超越);规模律——最坏情况下存在性读取正确当且仅当逆温度×间隔≥候选数对数。基于此并配合两个经验证的原则构造传播层、模3指数牛顿(3^d n运算精确计算2-单纯注意力softmax)与OR-join/幂均值通道。

Result: 49顶点训练的传播层在250顶点图上各搜索深度全对;六时钟模3指数牛顿以少量发牌学会SET并从8张迁移到20张;186K参数块在CLRS-30无提示下于12个图任务中9个持平(半点内)或超越≥7300万参数模型,新采图上为8个。

Conclusion: 层读取温度的机制统一解释Transformer失败与高阶注意力成败,并指出成对层何时无效、并行层何时必须循环,为超越Transformer的架构设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: Transformers stop learning graph search as graphs grow, and learn the card game SET only after many distinct questions, although attention can represent both. We read these failures, and the uneven record of higher-order attention, from what a layer sums over: each layer we study computes the partition function of a family of witnesses and reads it at a temperature. Two laws follow. The depth law is a known result of logic, which we state for these layers: L layers over two-step walks reach exactly 2^L - 1 steps, just as a logical statement with L nested clauses of the form "there is a vertex such that" sees exactly that far. We build a construction that reaches this far, checked in Lean, and, when vertices carry no names, no such network reaches further. The size law is the cost of reading at a temperature, which logic does not have: existence is read correctly at every size, in the worst case, if and only if inverse temperature times margin is at least the logarithm of the number of candidates. Layers built on these laws, and on two principles that we test, learn where Transformers fail. One propagator layer trained on 49-vertex graphs answers every question at every search depth on 250-vertex graphs. Given the modulus 3, exponential Newton computes the softmax of 2-simplicial attention over pairs exactly in 3^d n operations for d clocks; with six clocks it learns SET from as few deals as 2-simplicial attention and transfers from 8- to 20-card tables. On CLRS-30 without hints, a 186,000-parameter block of OR-join and power-mean channels matches (within half a point) or beats a model of at least 73 million parameters on 9 of 12 graph tasks of the official test set, and on 8 of 12 with freshly drawn test graphs. The same account explains where pair layers did not help and where parallel layers must loop.

</details>


### [408] [Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10050)
*Raghav Thind,Youran Sun,Ling Liang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC)框架，针对替代约束优化中"返回决策"的真实可行性风险进行校准，指出标准共形预测的覆盖率保证无法约束该风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当优化问题使用替代约束（surrogate constraint）时，对替代约束可行的决策未必对真实约束可行。现有split conformal prediction只保证随机输入覆盖率，但真正重要的是优化器返回决策的不可行概率（selected risk），二者并不等价。

Method: SRC以目标分布下优化器返回的决策为校准对象，对学到的约束进行校准，保证以至少1-δ概率，每个被认证的margin在留出目标上的selected risk（返回决策不可行概率）≤γ。文中还从理论上说明split conformal的随机输入覆盖保证不能界定selected risk，且似然比重加权在学到的约束于返回决策处活跃时不适用。

Result: 实验显示：覆盖约90%随机输入的共形margin仅覆盖低至17%的返回决策；所有认证margin在未见目标上违反率均低于目标值；在等成本下，62次比较中有57次SRC的修正产生更少或相等的不可行解。

Conclusion: SRC适用于任何"替代模型选决策、且决策可行性可在样本实例上验证"的场景，提供了比随机输入覆盖更贴切的风险保证。

Abstract: When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-δ$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $γ$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.

</details>


### [409] [A method to automatically discover symbolic local learning rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12248)
*Andrea Perin,Fabio Anselmi,Stephane Deny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自动发现可替代反向传播的符号化局部学习规则的通用方法，并以彭罗斯图记号启发构建单项式字典，通过系数回归得到逐层多项式损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向传播缺乏生物合理性且能耗高，需要自动发现可解释、局部化的学习规则，并适用于任意网络架构与任务。

Method: 两步法：(1) 受彭罗斯图记号启发，用局部张量变量的单项式构造字典；(2) 对这些单项式的加权系数做回归，构建逐层多项式损失，使其梯度共同最小化目标全局损失。

Result: 在小型多层网络与精简数据集上测试分类、重建与自监督学习任务；发现的规则在各任务中均诱导层间非平凡的交互，显著降低全局损失；且方法偏好稀疏的单项式组合，规则比基于MLP的替代方案更易解释。

Conclusion: 该方法有望应用于节能深度学习，以及发现生物上合理的局部学习机制。

Abstract: We present a general method for discovering symbolic local learning rules that can replace backpropagation, applicable, in principle, to any deep learning architecture and task. The method automatically discovers local loss functions specific to each layer by (1) constructing a dictionary of monomials of local tensor variables, inspired by Penrose diagram notation, (2) regressing over coefficients weighting these monomials to build layerwise polynomial losses whose gradients together minimize a target global loss. We test the method on classification, reconstruction, and self-supervised learning tasks with small multilayer networks and minimal datasets. Across all tasks, the discovered rules induce non-trivial interactions between layers, which lead to significant reductions in the corresponding global losses. Furthermore, the method selects sparse combinations of monomials, finding local rules that are more interpretable than those generated by MLP-based alternatives. The potential implications of our method range from energy-efficient deep learning to the discovery of biologically plausible learning mechanisms.

</details>


### [410] [All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10051)
*S David Mis,Trevor Teolis,Ivan Dokmanić,Matti Lassas,Maarten V. de Hoop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文用概率测度视角刻画算子学习的"一致离散稳定性"，证明所有此类算子都能精确表示为由 transformer、FNO、Flowers 等推广而来的"稳定 Markov 核网络"，并给出其核的变分实现与架构设计准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子学习常用于近似函数到函数的映射，理想情况下应输入离散化改变时保持稳定（离散化不变性）。已有工作多为定性描述，缺乏定量刻画，也不清楚各类成功架构（transformer、FNO、Flowers）的稳定性能否统一理解，因而需要一个能刻画稳定算子设计空间的理论框架。

Method: 将输入函数及其离散化统一表示为概率测度，用输出变化对测度间 Wasserstein 距离的 Hölder 界来定量定义"一致离散稳定性"。据此建立表示定理：任何一致离散稳定算子都可精确写成"稳定 Markov 核网络"。进一步把网络的读出核刻画为正则化变分问题的解，通过选择不同代价函数与正则项来导出 transformer、FNO、Flowers 及其混合的核。

Result: 得到表示定理，表明稳定 Markov 核网络是一类联合推广 transformer、FNO、Flowers 等算子学习架构的抽象结构，并与它们在表达能力上等价（即可精确表示全部一致离散稳定算子）。同时证明这些网络的读出核可实现为变分问题解，特定代价与正则项选择可恢复上述各类架构的核及新组合。

Conclusion: 该工作把离散稳定算子学习归结为 Markov 核网络设计空间：设计新架构即选择对核网络的哪些部分参数化及如何参数化；变分表述提供了系统的架构设计方法与一致离散稳定性的充分条件。

Abstract: Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a Hölder bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs and regularizers recovering the kernels of transformers, FNO, Flowers, their hybrids, and beyond. This variational formulation provides a systematic approach to architecture design, together with sufficient conditions for uniform discretization stability.

</details>


### [411] [fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10082)
*Kalle Mäkelä,Tuukka Ruotsalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: fNIRSAtlas 是迄今最大的开放 fNIRS 分类基准，含 19 个公开数据集、23 个任务，提供从原始数据到评估的全自动管线与标准化跨被试/被试内基准，并揭示现有深度学习方法泛化性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fNIRS 在脑机接口与认知状态解码上有潜力，但数据集规模小且彼此孤立、评估协议不一致，阻碍了机器学习方法的可比与累积进展。

Method: 构建 fNIRSAtlas 基准：整合 19 个公开数据集的 23 个分类任务，覆盖运动执行、运动想象、心算、工作记忆、情绪识别等范式；提供从原始数据到评估的全自动流水线，并定义标准化的跨被试与被试内分类任务；在该基准上评测来自 fNIRS、其他神经影像及时间序列文献的多类基线模型。

Result: 各任务间性能差异显著；在有限数据上验证过的方法（尤其是深度学习）往往无法超出其原始评估场景泛化。

Conclusion: fNIRSAtlas 为 fNIRS 机器学习提供可扩展、开放、可复现的基准，推动更稳健、累积性的研究进展；代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark to support more robust and cumulative progress in machine learning for fNIRS data. Our code and data can be found at https://fnirsatlas.github.io.

</details>


### [412] [Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10086)
*Yingxue Zhao,Haoran Li,Haosu Zhou,Tobias Pfaff,Nan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出基于基线条件的残差代理模型 R-BiLoGo，通过部分解耦局部特征与全局几何，结合迁移学习，减少热冲压转角件加强筋代理建模所需的仿真数据量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钣金件的全局几何与局部特征共同影响材料流动，直接学习所有组合需要大量训练数据；但同一类局部特征常出现在多种全局几何上，故可通过解耦与迁移降低仿真成本。

Method: 提出 R-BiLoGo：以基线响应和加强筋引入的几何扰动为输入，输出相对基线的位移与减薄变化（残差）。先在单一全局几何上学习局部特征效应，再用迁移学习泛化到其他几何；并用四个无参数几何描述子在 4 类转角的控制变量下分析全局几何对迁移的影响。

Result: 在源几何及三个目标几何中的两个上，R-BiLoGo 误差低于层次图模型和 Transolver 模型；22 个目标中约半数用 20 个目标仿真迁移即达到或优于从零训练的 80 个仿真；相同 80 个仿真下，95% 的目标误差降低。迁移收益随表面距离和高曲率变化增大而减小，源几何更浅的目标收益也降低，该趋势在其它转角类型中以不同幅度存在。

Conclusion: 将局部特征与全局几何解耦并结合残差建模与迁移学习，可显著减少热冲压件代理模型所需的仿真数据，且迁移收益可由简单几何描述子预测。

Abstract: Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, transfer learning with 20 target simulations gave errors similar to or lower than training from scratch with 80 target simulations for about half of the targets. With the same 80 target simulations, transfer learning reduced errors for 95% of targets. The effect of the global geometry on transfer was studied with four parameter-free geometric descriptors and controlled variations across 4 corner subclasses. The benefit of transfer decreased with increasing surface distance and high-curvature change between source and target, and for targets shallower than the source. These trends were also seen in other corner types with a different magnitude.

</details>


### [413] [Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10096)
*Weizhong Huang,Jinchao Zhang,Xiawu Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoMixKV：首个在共享内存预算下跨同时驻留的多智能体 KV 缓存做混合精度联合分配的量化框架，兼顾精度与内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统协作时，同时驻留的 KV 缓存造成内存瓶颈；独立套用单模型量化策略忽视各智能体精度需求差异，可能损害集体推理质量。

Method: 以局部注意力误差界为基础，用近期 query/key/value 在线估计敏感度，无需校准数据、试量化或额外前向；共享控制器结合可量化剩余容量与字节级存储开销，联合分配各智能体-层的位宽以最小化总估计误差，并在智能体启停、新观测到来时刷新分配；位宽仅作用于新量化块，近期状态保持原生精度、已量化块不变。

Result: 在四个基准、三个 LLM 骨干、平均 2/3/4-bit 设置下精度优于量化基线；Gemma-4-31B-it 平均 3-bit 时平均准确率 68.35%，超出最强量化基线 0.59%；Qwen3-32B 上峰值 KV 内存降低 32.08%，相对 FullKV 推理加速 1.38 倍。

Conclusion: 跨智能体联合精度分配可在预算约束下有效缓解多智能体 KV 缓存内存瓶颈，同时保持甚至提升推理精度与效率。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies independently ignores differences in agents' precision needs, potentially degrading collective reasoning. We introduce Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization (CoMixKV), which combines online sensitivity estimation with joint agent-layer bit-width allocation under a shared memory budget. To our knowledge, CoMixKV is the first mixed-precision KV-cache quantization framework to jointly allocate precision across simultaneously resident agent caches under such a budget. The estimator derives sensitivity from a local attention-error bound using recent queries, keys, and values, without calibration data, trial quantization, or additional model passes. A shared controller combines these scores with remaining quantizable capacity and byte-level storage costs to minimize total estimated error. Allocations are refreshed as agents start or finish and new observations become available. Selected widths apply only to newly quantized blocks; recent states retain native precision and previously quantized blocks remain unchanged. Across four benchmarks and three LLM backbones at average 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit settings, CoMixKV achieves strong accuracy against the evaluated quantization baselines. At the average 3-bit setting on Gemma-4-31B-it, it achieves 68.35% average accuracy, exceeding the strongest quantized baseline by 0.59%. On Qwen3-32B, it reduces peak KV-cache memory by 32.08% and achieves a 1.38x inference speedup over FullKV.

</details>


### [414] [TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10145)
*Omar Ibrahim,Grant Hamblin,Benjamin Haibe-Kains*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TrialJev 是一个开源、可本地单 GPU 部署的临床试验资格评分模型，用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen 加指针头做单次前向打分，避免自回归解码，从而在保持与生成式微调模型相当（甚至略优）准确率的同时显著提速并保护患者隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验筛选需对大量"患者-试验"配对进行排序以挑出值得细审的候选，且常受患者记录不可外传的限制；生成式 LLM 逐条生成裁决既慢又需依赖外部托管 API。

Method: TrialJev 采用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型，附加指针头（pointer head）对自然语言答案选项打分，单次前向完成推理、不做自回归解码。在 TREC Clinical Trials 2021 上训练，在 TREC 2022 的 50 个未见合成患者的 6,975 个"合格/排除"配对上评测，并与同一数据微调做裁决生成的 LLM、专有 Jev API 比较，另做 A/B-logit 消融分离解码与指针头各自的贡献。

Result: 准确率：80.97%（Qwen3.5-27B）、81.84%（Qwen3.8-27B），优于生成式微调的 79.87% 与 79.93%；batch-1 匹配测量下裁决生成耗时是 TrialJev 单次推理的 2.45–2.70 倍（9B–27B）。在统一开发集拟合的决策校正下，两个 27B 模型达 80.99% 与 81.88%，对比专有 Jev API 的 81.28%，配对置信区间包含零。27B 单卡约 178 ms/配对，患者文本不出本地。消融显示效率优势主要来自"避免解码"而非指针头本身。

Conclusion: TrialJev 定位为候选试验的初筛优先排序工具，可与解释性模型和临床人工复核互补而非替代。局限在于仅用合成患者评测、计时依赖具体实现、临床有效性未经验证；适配器、指针头与模型卡已在 Hugging Face 发布。

Abstract: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [415] [Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10153)
*Xenia Konti,Arjun Tschand,Chuan Hong,Nicoleta J. Economou-Zavlanos,Michael M. Zavlanos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种面向异构特征空间的群体鲁棒学习框架，优化"最差群体超额损失"而非原始损失，并用群体专属编码器+共享隐空间高斯锚点实现知识迁移，在最差群组损失上最多降低79%、超额损失降低95%，参数量最多减少18倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床中患者接受不同检查组合，形成异构甚至完全不相交的特征空间。现有方法只对高损失患者加权，但高损失可能源于特征本身信息有限（已达其可达到的最优），并非模型不佳；当特征空间完全不相交时，现有方法退化为各自独立训练，无法跨组迁移知识。

Method: 以"群体"定义为共享同一特征空间的患者集合；不再直接优化损失，而是优化最差群体的超额损失（该群体损失与其可达到最优估计之间的差距）。为促进跨组协作，为每个群体使用专属编码器映射到共享隐空间，并在该空间用可学习的高斯锚点按结局对患者聚类。

Result: 在表格与影像医学数据集（含完全不相交特征设定）上，当群体最优损失不同或群体无法独立训练出好模型时，优于SOTA：最差群体损失最多降低79%，超额损失最多降低95%，参数量最多减少18倍。

Conclusion: 用超额损失替代原始损失可避免被特征信息量不足的群体误导，共享隐空间+高斯锚点在特征不相交时仍能实现知识迁移，从而以更少参数获得更强的群体鲁棒性。

Abstract: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.

</details>


### [416] [Projected Neural Additive Models as Universal Approximators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10186)
*Nhon N. Phan,Qiang Du,John D. Clayton,WaiChing Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为投影神经加性模型（PNAM）建立首个理论基础：证明其是通用逼近器、刻画精确表示多项式所需的最少投影数，并给出最优逼近速率；同时用结构化稀疏正则与事后符号回归恢复可解释性，在多个任务上精度不降且得到极简符号模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经加性模型（NAM）可解释但结构刚性、表达能力不足，连 χ1χ2 这样的交互项都无法逼近（交叉导数为零）；而 MLP 虽为通用逼近器却缺乏透明性。作者希望兼得二者之长。

Method: 在 NAM 中加入可学习线性变换 T 得到 PNAM，以捕捉跨变量交互；理论上证明其通用逼近性与多项式精确表示所需最小投影数 M，并针对 C^s 函数推导逼近率 O(M^{-s/(N-1)})；实践上引入结构化稀疏正则和事后符号回归，实现全局输入排序、参数剪枝及将学到的基转换为紧凑解析表达式。

Result: PNAM 是通用逼近器，并刻画了精确多项式表示所需的最小投影数；逼近率 O(M^{-s/(N-1)}) 对岭函数逼近达到最优。在纽结不变量、MNIST 与相场断裂力学实验中，PNAM 精度与同类架构持平或更优，同时能发现显著特征并给出参数量少若干数量级的符号模型。

Conclusion: 通过可学习投影打破 NAM 的加性局限，PNAM 在理论上具备通用逼近与最优逼近率，在实证上兼顾精度与可解释性，可作为可解释机器学习中替代 MLP 的有力方案。

Abstract: Neural additive models (NAMs) offer interpretability but lack expressivity due to their rigid additive structure, whereas multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) achieve universal approximation at the cost of transparency. We establish the first theoretical foundation for projected neural additive models (PNAMs), which augment NAMs with a learnable linear transformation $\boldsymbol{T}$ to capture cross-variable interactions. While standard NAMs cannot approximate even the simplest interaction term $χ_1 χ_2$ because their cross-derivatives are identically zero, we prove that PNAMs are universal approximators and characterize the minimum number of projections required for exact polynomial representation. Furthermore, we derive an approximation rate of $\mathcal{O}(M^{-s / (N - 1)})$ for $\mathcal{C}^s$ functions (i.e., functions with $s$ continuous derivatives), where $M$ denotes the number of projections and $N$ the input dimension; this rate is known to be optimal for ridge function approximation. To recover interpretability from the projected inputs, we introduce structured sparsity regularizers and post-hoc symbolic regression techniques that enable global input ranking, parameter pruning, and the conversion of learned bases into compact analytical expressions. Experiments on knot theory invariants, MNIST, and phase field fracture mechanics demonstrate that PNAMs match or surpass similar architectures in accuracy while discovering salient features and yielding symbolic models with orders of magnitude fewer parameters.

</details>


### [417] [Fast Accurate Quantum Monte Carlo without Metropolis Adjustment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10187)
*Reuben Cohn-Gordon,Gabriel Pescia,Sumner N. Hearth,Jakob Robnik,Uroš Seljak,Peter Lunts*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将计算统计中的"未调整"HMC（省去Metropolis-Hastings校正）引入量子蒙特卡洛，在高维自旋-费米子量子相变模型上验证其效率优于调整型HMC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子多体物理中的物理量可写成概率分布的期望值，可用QMC/MCMC估计。传统做法是使用带MH校正的HMC核以保证无偏收敛，但近期统计文献表明未调整HMC可能显著更高效，且其渐近偏差相对有限样本方差的误差可忽略。作者希望在QMC（尤其高维、有挑战性的模型）中检验这一结论。

Method: 把未调整HMC（去除Metropolis-Hastings接受/拒绝步骤）适配到QMC框架，选取高维自旋-费米子量子相变模型作为测试平台，与标准调整型HMC进行对比，以"每次梯度调用的有效样本量（ESS per gradient call）"作为效率指标，并检查结果精度。

Result: 在自旋-费米子量子相变模型上，未调整HMC在每次梯度调用的有效样本量上优于调整型HMC，同时保持结果准确，未调整带来的偏差相对有限样本误差较小。

Conclusion: 未调整HMC可作为QMC中更高效的采样方案，在复杂高维量子模型中兼顾效率与精度；为QMC实践提供了一种有前景的替代调整型HMC的选择。

Abstract: In quantum systems, physical quantities of interest can be expressed as expectation values of a probability distribution, which allows their estimation by Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. This approach, an instance of Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC), plays a central role in obtaining predictions of system properties relevant to condensed matter and high energy physics. The use of Hamiltonian dynamics to design a Markov kernel, known as Hybrid or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), is widespread in quantum applications. In this context, it is standard to use an HMC kernel that is ``adjusted'' with the Metropolis-Hastings (MH) criterion, so that estimates of expectations converge to their true value in the limit of infinite sample size. However, recent work in computational statistics suggests that an \emph{unadjusted} HMC kernel can be significantly more efficient, while safely maintaining an asymptotic bias which is small relative to the error arising from the variance of the finite sample size. We adapt this approach to the QMC setting, focusing on a challenging and high-dimensional \emph{spin-fermion} model of a quantum phase transition. We find that unadjusted methods outperform adjusted HMC in terms of effective sample size per gradient call, while retaining accurate results.

</details>


### [418] [Finite-Sample and Communication-Efficient Networked Information Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11032)
*Mohammadhossein Bateni,Zahra Hadizadeh,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Mahdi JafariRaviz,Shayan Taherijam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究通信受限下DAG网络中智能体的学习问题：先修补Kearns et al.(2026)有限样本证明的漏洞，再提出共享草图协议将通信从O(m)降至O(k)，并用压缩最小二乘与子空间嵌入给出统计与通信分离的风险界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SODA 2026的DAG网络学习工作沿每条边传递长度为m的完整预测向量，通信代价随样本量线性增长；且其有限样本证明存在缺陷。作者希望在保持统计精度的同时降低通信开销，并厘清统计误差与压缩误差的关系。

Method: 先重新分析full-message协议的有限样本情形，用不同论证在满足确定性M-coverage的路径上建立总体风险保证；再引入shared-sketch协议，每个智能体发送k维线性草图（k≪m），通过归约到压缩样本上的最小二乘并结合oblivious subspace embedding进行分析，对高斯草图给出显式高概率界。

Result: 证明误差可分离：统计项仍由原始样本量m控制，压缩带来的额外误差仅由草图维数k控制；对高斯草图得到显式高概率总体风险界，表明行子采样并非网络化信息聚合中唯一的通信-统计权衡方式。

Conclusion: 共享草图协议为DAG网络学习提供了通信高效的替代方案，并清晰刻画通信与统计之间的权衡；同时修正了前人有限样本分析中的证明缺口。

Abstract: Building on SODA 2026 work Kearns et al. (2026), we study learning in directed acyclic graphs in which each agent observes only a subset of the input coordinates and may use the predictions of its parents as additional features. In the finite-sample protocol, the message sent along each edge is the agent's prediction vector on a shared sample, so the communication cost is linear in the sample size $m$. In this paper we study this model under communication constraints.
  First, we revisit the finite-sample analysis of the full-message protocol. We identify a gap in the finite-sample proof of Kearns et al. (2026) and develop a different argument that establishes a finite-sample population-risk guarantee along paths satisfying deterministic $M$-coverage.
  Second, we introduce a shared-sketch protocol in which each agent sends a $k$-dimensional linear sketch of its prediction vector instead of the full $m$-dimensional message, where $k\ll m$. We analyze this protocol through a reduction to least squares on the compressed sample together with an oblivious subspace embedding argument. The resulting bound separates statistics from communication: the statistical term is still governed by the original sample size $m$, while the additional error due to compression is controlled by the sketch dimension $k$. For Gaussian sketches, we obtain an explicit high-probability population-risk bound, showing that row subsampling is not the only possible communication-statistics tradeoff for networked information aggregation.

</details>


### [419] [BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10188)
*Zhen Qin,Zhiyao Zhang,Yingbin Liang,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BiMuon 是一种几何感知的随机双层优化方法，将隐式超梯度估计与 Muon 风格的正交化矩阵更新结合，并具有 O(ε^-4) 迭代复杂度保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双层优化方法把矩阵梯度压平成向量优化，忽视了神经网络中常见的矩阵结构；同时下层曲率会引起上层几何的显著谱不平衡。这两点是本文的出发点。

Method: 在上层采用 Muon 风格的正交化更新，并与双层优化中的隐式超梯度估计相结合；进一步研究分块对角矩阵近似，基于上层进展与分块下层敏感性推导相对步长分配规则。

Result: 据作者所知，BiMuon 是首个具备 Muon 风格正交化矩阵更新且达到 O(ε^-4) 迭代复杂度的随机双层优化方法，与 Muon 类方法已知最优速率相当；在表示学习和分块双层优化任务上获得了实验支持。

Conclusion: 通过在双层优化中保留矩阵几何结构并正交化上层更新，可在不牺牲复杂度保证的情况下改善优化行为，分块近似与步长分配规则进一步提升了多矩阵参数场景的效率。

Abstract: Stochastic bilevel optimization provides a general framework for many machine learning applications, such as hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, language model alignment, and actor-critic reinforcement learning. However, most existing bilevel optimization methods treat matrix-valued gradients as flattened vectors and perform optimization in the resulting vectorized space, ignoring the matrix structures common in modern neural networks. Moreover, the lower-level (LL) problem curvature can induce significant spectral imbalance in the upper-level (UL) geometry. Such limitations of existing bilevel optimization methods motivate us to develop BiMuon, a geometry-aware stochastic bilevel optimization method that integrates implicit hypergradient estimation in bilevel optimization with Muon-style orthogonalized updates at the UL. To our knowledge, BiMuon is the first stochastic BLO method with Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates and an $O(ε^{-4})$ iteration-complexity guarantee, matching the best-known rates achieved by Muon-type methods based on matrix parameterizations. To improve computational and parallel efficiency for models with multiple matrix parameters, we further study BiMuon for blockwise diagonal matrix approximation and derive a relative stepsize allocation rule based on UL progress and blockwise LL sensitivity. We evaluate BiMuon on representation learning and blockwise bilevel optimization, providing empirical support for our methods.

</details>


### [420] [Tropical Gaussian Anticoncentration: Optimal Instance-Dependent Bounds for Online Learning in Extensive-Form Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11877)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Zhiyuan Fan,Lillian J. Ratliff,Patrick Jaillet,Gabriele Farina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明在扩展式博弈全信息在线决策中，treeplex策略空间的最小最大遗憾下界为 Ω(√(T log|V|))，与现有 KOMWU/DilEnt 上界匹配，说明对约化正规形复杂度的对数依赖不可避免。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高效算法（KOMWU、带 weight-one dilated entropy 正则的镜像下降）在 treeplex 上达到 O(√(T log|V|)) 遗憾，但此前不清楚该 log|V| 依赖是否最优。困难在于 treeplex 中的纯计划并非独立专家，其收益通过递归决策-观察结构相关。

Method: 引入 tropical Gaussian formulae——由取最大值与归一化求和递归构造且保持方差的 Gaussian 表达式，其 index count 对应子树中约化正规形续接计划数。核心分析结果：任意 index count 为 N 的 log-balanced tropical Gaussian formula 具有 Gaussian width Ω(√(log N))。证明借助球形熵剖面度量方向间的尺度相关分离，再用 Turán 定理与 Sudakov minoration 得到宽度下界，进而构造 oblivious 难例分布（合法转移结果 + Rademacher 终端收益）。

Result: 得到遗忘型难例分布下的遗憾下界 Ω(√(T log|V|))，与已知上界仅差常数因子。

Conclusion: 该对数依赖在最小最大意义下最优，DilEnt/KOMWU 对约化正规形复杂度的依赖不可回避。

Abstract: We study the minimax regret of full-information online decision making in extensive-form games. For prediction with expert advice, the optimal regret is $Θ(\sqrt{T\log K})$, where $K$ is the number of experts, or equivalently, the number of normal-form actions. For treeplex strategy spaces, existing efficient algorithms, including KOMWU and online mirror descent with the weight-one dilated entropy regularizer, achieve regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal{V}|})$, where $\mathcal{V}$ is the set of reduced normal-form strategies. We prove that this logarithmic dependence is minimax optimal in the worst-case full-information reward model. The main difficulty is that pure plans in a treeplex are not independent experts: their rewards are correlated through the recursive structure of decisions and observations. To capture this correlation, we introduce tropical Gaussian formulae, recursive Gaussian expressions built from maxima and normalized sums which preserve the variance. The index count of such a formula matches the number of reduced normal-form continuation plans in the corresponding subtree. Our main analytic result shows that every log-balanced tropical Gaussian formula with index count $N$ has Gaussian width $Ω(\sqrt{\log N})$. While a direct approach struggles to recover this lower bound, our proof uses a spherical entropy profile to measure scale-dependent separation among the Gaussian directions, and then applies Turán's theorem and Sudakov minoration to obtain the width lower bound. Applying this result to treeplexes gives an oblivious hard distribution with valid transition outcome and Rademacher terminal rewards, establishing a regret lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal{V}|})$. This matches known upper bounds up to universal constants and shows that the DilEnt/KOMWU dependence on the reduced normal-form complexity is unavoidable.

</details>


### [421] [BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10198)
*Colin Doumont,Thomas Christie,Henry Moss,Philipp Hennig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 高维贝叶斯优化(HDBO)领域缺乏统一基准,现有论文常遗漏最强基线或使用错误实现;作者推出BO-Arena统一实现并发现性能驱动因素比预想更简单,提出无需复杂GP近似的新算法,并质疑复杂方法是否真正优于简单GP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HDBO新方法层出不穷,但"当前哪个方法最强"难以回答。作者质疑现有基准实践的系统性无效:多篇已发表工作未与最强基线比较,甚至包含关键方法的错误实现;由于缺乏共享参考实现,这类错误难以在同行评审中被发现。

Method: 提出BO-Arena——一个持续维护、可扩展的软件包,提供SOTA算法的规范化(canonical)实现,支持新方法开发与严格基准测试。基于BO-Arena进行实证分析,识别出驱动HDBO性能的更简单因素,并据此设计一个不使用近期方法中复杂GP近似的新算法。

Result: 通过BO-Arena发现HDBO性能的主要驱动因素比以往认为的更简单;所提新算法在观测数量多的任务上与SOTA方法具竞争力,且无需复杂GP近似。

Conclusion: 作者质疑目前是否有充分证据表明任何更复杂方法优于简单的GP基线,呼吁以统一实现和严格基准重新审视HDBO研究现状。

Abstract: High-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (HDBO) is an increasingly crowded field with new methods proposed at every major conference, making it ever harder to answer a deceptively simple question: "Which method is currently state-of-the-art?" In this paper, we question the efficacy of benchmarking practices in the field, and find them to be systematically ineffective: multiple published works fail to benchmark against the strongest available baselines, or even include incorrect implementations of key methods. Without a shared reference implementation, such errors are difficult to detect during peer review. We therefore introduce BO-Arena, an actively maintained and extensible package providing canonical implementations of state-of-the-art algorithms, which allows researchers to develop new methods and benchmark them rigorously. Using BO-Arena, we find that what currently drives performance in HDBO is even simpler than previously thought. We use these insights to propose a new algorithm which is competitive with the state of the art on problems with many observations, without resorting to the complex GP approximations used in recent methods. Finally, we question whether there is currently sufficient evidence that any more complex method outperforms a simple Gaussian process baseline for HDBO.

</details>


### [422] [Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10202)
*Brendan O Donoghue,Nenad Tomasev,Volodymyr Mnih,Timothy Nguyen,Dalin Guo,Arun Nair,Kenneth Yang,Alexandre Frechette,Jasper Xian,Jean Tarbouriech,Pavel Tyletski,Ingrid von Glehn,Johannes Bausch,Demis Hassabis,Raia Hadsell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用离散去噪扩散训练的Transformer配合引导式测试时束搜索，可直接从数据中学习半素数分解，成功分解68位整数（此前SOTA为56位），并给出以比特长度为主导的指数级计算规模实证规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索学习型方法在半素数分解上的能力边界，检验无需数论先验、纯数据驱动的扩散模型能否推进分解规模，并厘清其扩展规律与对密码安全的影响。

Method: 以离散去噪扩散目标训练Transformer，推理时采用带引导的测试时束搜索解码因子候选；扩散模型作为生成先验给出有希望的因子候选，再由精确验证或格基后处理完成分解；并基于训练数据量、模型规模和测试时计算量拟合经验缩放律。

Result: 成功分解68位半素数，超越此前56位的最先进水平；效率不及经典算法，但无需数论先验；得出近似质量随数据、模型与测试时计算的经验缩放规律，且问题规模（比特长度）是缩放的主要驱动因素，固定精度所需计算随比特长度指数增长。

Conclusion: 学习型半素数分解取得新进展但计算成本高，对密码安全不构成威胁——分解密码相关规模整数所需计算仍不可承受；其价值在于展示扩散模型作为生成先验辅助搜索与验证的范式。

Abstract: We demonstrate that transformer architectures trained with discrete denoising diffusion and decoded via guided test-time beam search can learn to recover the prime factors of semiprime integers directly from data. Our approach establishes a new frontier for learning-based semiprime factorization, successfully factoring 68-bit integers-a substantial advance over the prior 56-bit state of the art. While computationally less efficient than classical factoring algorithms, our model requires no domain-specific number-theoretic priors and learns purely from training examples. In practice, the diffusion model acts as a generative prior, identifying promising factor candidates where exact verification or lattice-based post-processing can complete the factorization. Furthermore, we derive empirical scaling laws relating approximation quality to training data volume, model size, and test-time computation.
