We evaluate the resulting attack on three downstream-adapted VLMs across two privacy-sensitive visual question answering tasks, namely Document VQA and Medical VQA. To isolate the effect of pretraining knowledge, we additionally introduce a controlled synthetic dataset. Our approach outperforms standard reference-based attacks while requiring only a single reference-model fine-tuning run, making membership inference more practical for large VLMs.

</details>


### [459] [Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11102)
*Min Huang,Mingyan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 数学表现取决于语言模型如何接收信息、使用生成文本和提交答案；通过配对比较分离提交要求、草稿复用与候选答案可得性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学推理结果对"输入/输出接口"设置高度敏感，需厘清提交格式、草稿复用、候选答案等因素各自的独立贡献及其交互。

Method: 在65道开发题上做配对对照实验：(1)比较允许继续推导的指令与单行提交指令的格式与可解析率；(2)固定提交协议，对198道初次提交失败的问题分别提供仅题目、草稿、候选答案、二者兼有，并用Holm校正检验显著性；(3)比较保留尾部片段与前部片段；(4)在第二个补齐模型上复现；(5)在初次提交可解析的队列中检验候选与草稿的交互。

Result: 允许继续推导的指令下390次短输出调用无有效最终答案，而单行提交指令得到390个格式合法输出（389可解析）。失败题中正确率：仅题目9.09%、加草稿33.84%、加候选46.46%、两者兼有59.60%。固定候选时草稿加13.13个百分点，固定草稿时候选加25.76个百分点，Holm校正后均显著且准确率尺度上次可加。尾部片段比前部片段高10.10个百分点（Holm校正p=0.027）。第二模型方向一致。可解析队列中，有草稿时候选无增益，无草稿时增益27个百分点。

Conclusion: 生成文本具有条件性价值：失败提交仍留有可用材料，其贡献取决于同时提供了什么信息以及保留了哪些片段。

Abstract: Mathematical performance depends on how a language model receives information, uses generated text and submits an answer. We study these dependencies through paired comparisons that separate submission requirements, draft reuse and candidate availability. On 65 development problems, an instruction permitting continued derivation produced no valid final answers in 390 short-output calls; a single-line submission instruction produced 390 format-valid outputs, including 389 parseable answers. Under the fixed submission protocol, 198 problems with failed initial submissions were answered correctly in 9.09p of cases with the question alone, 33.84p with its draft, 46.46p with candidates, and 59.60p with both. Drafts added 13.13 percentage points with candidates fixed, and candidates added 25.76 points with drafts fixed; both effects were significant after Holm correction and were subadditive on the accuracy scale. Retaining a trailing excerpt outperformed retaining a leading excerpt of similar average length by 10.10 points Holm-adjusted p 0.027. A second completion model showed the same directions of input effects on the fixed materials. In a cohort with parseable initial submissions, candidates added no correct answers when the previous draft was supplied, but added 27 points when it was absent. These results establish a conditional value of generated text: a failed submission can leave useful material, whose contribution depends on what else is supplied and what is retained.

</details>


### [460] [The Fast Tree Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10466)
*Paul Burchard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"Fast Tree Transform"（快速树变换），一种定义在任意图几何上的局部聚合变换，推广了圆上的Hadamard频率变换与Haar小波变换。其纯频率部分可近似对角化图拉普拉斯矩阵，适合作为几何优化中的预条件子；完整变换仅略微冗余，能对含边缘和纹理的信号进行稀疏表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有变换多为特定结构（如圆/规则网格）设计，难以同时兼顾频率特征与局部稀疏表示；需要一种适配任意图几何、既可用于优化预条件又能稀疏表示含边缘与纹理信号的统一变换框架。

Method: 定义一种面向任意图几何的局部聚合变换（Fast Tree Transform）：其纯频率分支设计为近似对角化图拉普拉斯矩阵；完整变换在频率部分基础上叠加局部聚合/层级结构，形成仅轻微过完备的表示。

Result: 纯频率部分近似对角化图拉普拉斯矩阵，因而可作为几何优化问题的预条件子；完整变换以很小的冗余度实现对同时含边缘与纹理信号的稀疏表示。

Conclusion: 该变换统一并推广了Hadamard变换与Haar小波，兼顾频域对角化与空间稀疏性，是图信号处理与几何优化的通用工具。

Abstract: The Fast Tree Transform is a locally-aggregated transform defined for arbitrary graph geometries that generalizes both the Hadamard frequency transform and the Haar wavelet transform on the circle. The pure frequency part of the transform approximately diagonalizes the graph Laplacian; this fact makes it useful as a preconditioner in geometric optimization problems. The full transform provides an only slightly-redundant representation of signals on the graph that allows sparse representation of signals that include both edges and textures.

</details>


### [461] [Dynamic State Estimation from Sparse PMUs via Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10468)
*Huy Hoang Le,Haoguang Wang,Christian Moya,Marcos Netto,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理信息图神经算子，用少量发电机母线的稀疏间歇PMU测量，一次前向传播估计全网（含未测机）转子角与转速轨迹，物理（摇摆方程）以硬约束或带学习修正的软约束嵌入，无需状态标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统动态状态估计需要从稀疏、间歇的测量中恢复所有机组状态；传统Kalman平滑器或移动视界估计需逐场景优化、依赖精确模型与状态标签，模型误差下性能退化且代价高。

Method: 图注意力编码器处理PMU测量；将摇摆方程作为硬约束，或以带可学习修正项的软约束吸收模型误差；仅用仿真测量、无状态标签训练，采用掩码训练（隐藏一个PMU但保留于损失）；在四个输电系统上与Kalman平滑器、硬约束移动视界估计及优化基准对比。

Result: 在四个系统中，该算子是不需逐场景优化且不用状态标签的最准确估计器；仅在最小系统且大模型误差时被调优Kalman平滑器超越。仿真状态训练网络在两个最小系统更准，但在118母线不如本方法；模型误差下以极小代价匹配或超越优化基准，且在详细机组模型、仅由电压相量观测精确参数的场景下依然成立。

Conclusion: 物理信息图神经算子在无需状态标签、无需逐场景优化下实现高精度全网动态状态估计，计算高效、对模型误差鲁棒，但在小系统大模型误差下有局限。

Abstract: This paper proposes a physics-informed graph neural operator for power system dynamic state estimation. From a sparse, intermittent measurement window at a few generator buses, the operator estimates the rotor-angle and speed trajectories of all machines, unmeasured ones included, in one forward pass. A graph-attention encoder processes the measurements, and the swing equations are imposed as a hard constraint or as a soft one with a learned correction that absorbs model errors. It is trained on simulated measurements, without state labels. With several phasor measurement units, masked training hides one from the input but keeps it in the loss. On four transmission systems, simulations show that the operator is the most accurate estimator that neither optimizes per scenario nor uses state labels, except on the smallest system at large model errors, where tuned Kalman smoothers are better. Networks trained on simulated states are more accurate on the two smallest systems but not on the 118-bus system, where the operator is faster and more accurate than hard-constrained moving-horizon estimation. Under model errors, it matches or outperforms an optimization-based benchmark at a fraction of its cost. The results hold for a detailed machine model with exact parameters seen only through voltage phasors.

</details>


### [462] [Learning a Unified Cross-Model Semantic Dictionary via Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10503)
*Jinchi Zhu,Tie Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GB-SAE，将跨模型统一可解释性建模为表示分解问题，通过门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器同时学习统一共享字典与各模型私有字典，实现可共享、可复用的跨模型概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同基础模型虽学得重叠语义结构，但因架构、预训练目标和协议不同导致表示各异，阻碍统一可解释性与跨模型特征复用。现有方法只在潜空间坐标上对齐各模型独立提取的概念，概念本身仍是模型专属的，无法共享复用。

Method: 将统一跨模型可解释性视为表示分解问题：用门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器框架同时学习一个共享字典（编码跨模型公共语义结构、概念可跨模型复用）和多个私有字典（捕捉各模型特异的残差概念）。

Result: 在ViT、SigLIP、DINOv2、ConvNeXt等不同基础模型上评测，GB-SAE在重建能力、统一且忠实的可解释性、以及向未见模型和下游任务的可复用性与泛化性上均表现优越。

Conclusion: 以共享+私有字典分解的GB-SAE实现了真正可共享、可复用的跨模型统一概念，优于仅在坐标上对齐的现有方案。

Abstract: Foundation models pretrained on similar data distributions tend to learn overlapping semantic structure, but their representations are distinct due to different model architecture, pretraining objectives and protocols. This prevents unified interpretability and cross-model feature reuse. Existing approaches extract interpretable concepts from individual models and align these concepts in a shared coordinate system using cross-reconstruction objectives, but the alignment only applies to latent coordinates while the concepts themselves remain model-specific and cannot be shared or reused. This paper introduces the Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoder (GB-SAE), which casts unified cross-model interpretability as a representation factorization problem and solves it by simultaneously learning a unified shared dictionary and multiple private model-specific dictionaries via a gated bottleneck sparse autoencoder framework. The shared dictionary encodes the cross-model common semantic structure in unified concepts that are reusable across all participating models (and beyond), while each private dictionary comprises residual concepts that capture model-specific biases. We evaluate GB-SAE with distinct foundation models including ViT, SigLIP, DINOv2, and ConvNeXt. GB-SAE demonstrates superior reconstruction capability, unified and faithful interpretability, strong reusability and generalization to unseen models and downstream tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/trustAIoT/GB-SAE_NeurIPS.

</details>


### [463] [CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10511)
*Xiancai Tian,Leichao Zhang,Shenhui Zhang,Yi Shan,Hailong Li,Feng Lin,Xiaotian Yu,Aijun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CALFA-KV 结合离线校准与 Fisher 敏感度引导的高精度锚点选择，实现 1-bit KV cache 压缩并优于所有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1-bit KV cache 压缩中，量化器校准与选择性高精度存储可结合以降低重建误差，但如何选择哪些 KV 状态保留高精度尚无充分方案。

Method: 离线联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数及 K/V 向量码本以匹配冻结模型的投影注意力输出；由参考下一词交叉熵损失的梯度平方估计逐通道 Fisher 型敏感度；在线用该敏感度加权每个 KV 状态（某层某 KV 头内一个 token 的键值对）的平方重建误差，在每层每头预算下保留得分最高的状态为高精度。给出基于得分的锚点选择相对最优解的过量风险上界（风险为损失一阶变化的条件均方）。

Result: 每层每 KV 头额外 56 个 FP16 锚点时，CALFA-KV(d8b8) 在七个基准的平均分上于三个模型均超过所有名义 1-bit 基线；同预算下 CALFA-KV(d8b10) 名义索引率 1.25 bits/channel，与 BF16 差距缩至 0.90–2.01 分。

Conclusion: 校准加 Fisher 引导的锚点选择能有效提升 1-bit KV cache 压缩质量，并具备理论风险界支持。

Abstract: 1-bit key-value (KV) cache compression can combine quantizer calibration with selective high-precision storage to reduce reconstruction error. We propose Calibration and Fisher-guided Anchors for KV cache compression (CALFA-KV). Offline, we jointly fit a key center, radial normalization parameters, and K/V vector codebooks to match the frozen model's projected attention output. We also estimate channel-wise Fisher-type sensitivities from squared gradients of a reference next-token cross-entropy loss. Online, we use these sensitivities to weight the squared reconstruction errors of each KV state. Here, a KV state is one token's key-value pair within one layer and KV head. We retain the highest-scoring states at high precision under a per-layer, per-KV-head budget. Under exact restoration, we bound the excess risk of score-based anchor selection relative to the optimum at the same anchor budget, where risk is the conditional mean square of the first-order loss change. With a budget of 56 additional FP16 anchors per layer and KV head, CALFA-KV (d8b8) outperforms all evaluated nominal 1-bit baselines on the mean score across seven benchmarks for each of the three models. At the same anchor budget, CALFA-KV (d8b10) uses a nominal index rate of 1.25 bits per channel and narrows the gap to BF16 to 0.90--2.01 points on the same metric.

</details>


### [464] [FADE: Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation for Training-Free Diffusion Transformers Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10514)
*Jinlong Yang,Lizilin,Jinke Wu,Yao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FADE：基于反常扩散与Mittag-Leffler分数阶算子的免训练DiT加速框架，通过离线采样的查找表实现时空自适应参数检索，在激进跳步下保持高保真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT迭代采样计算开销大；现有特征缓存方法基于整数阶算子的特征复用/预测，难以适应DiT潜轨迹的非平稳、高曲率动态，易误差累积。

Method: 揭示DiT特征演化具有反常扩散特性与时空异质性；用反常扩散建模特征演化，采用Mittag-Leffler分数阶算子进行外推；利用该动态的跨样本稳定性，离线profiling构建多维查找表，在线以极低开销实现时空自适应参数检索，全程免训练。

Result: 在多种架构与模态上评测，取得SOTA加速效果；在激进跳步间隔下仍保持优异生成保真度，附加延迟可忽略。

Conclusion: 分数阶反常扩散建模为DiT免训练加速提供了更契合潜动态的新范式，兼具效果与效率。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as the preeminent paradigm for high-fidelity generative modeling across various modalities, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the severe computational overhead of iterative sampling. While recent feature-caching methods mitigate this latency through feature reuse or forecasting based on integer-order operators, they remain limited in adapting to the non-stationary and highly curved dynamics of DiT latent trajectories. In this work, we reveal that DiT feature evolution exhibits anomalous diffusion characteristics and a certain degree of spatiotemporal heterogeneity, rendering static, integer-order forecasting operators inadequate and prone to error accumulation. To address this, we propose Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation (FADE), a unified framework for training-free diffusion transformers acceleration. FADE models DiT feature evolution via anomalous diffusion and employs a Mittag--Leffler fractional operator to better adapt to high-curvature and non-linear latent trajectories of DiTs. Leveraging the empirical observation that these complex dynamics maintain cross-sample stability, we further construct a Look-Up Table with multiple dimensions through offline profiling. This enables negligible LUT-retrieval overhead, spatiotemporally adaptive parameter retrieval during online inference. Extensive evaluations across diverse architectures and modalities demonstrate that FADE achieves state-of-the-art acceleration, preserving exceptional generation fidelity under aggressive skip intervals with negligible latency overhead. Our project page is available at https://youngkinlon.github.io/fade-project-page/.

</details>


### [465] [Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation: Evaluating Hierarchical Policies from Non-Hierarchical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10543)
*Yunfu Deng,Josiah P. Hanna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IO-FQE，在增广的状态-option空间做拟合Q评估，实现对分层策略的离策略评估，无需option标注且消除朴素FQE的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层策略（高层选option、低层执行原始动作直至终止）的OPE研究较少；现有option级重要性采样需要option标注轨迹且方差随horizon增长；朴素地将FQE扩展到分层策略会产生有偏估计。

Method: 提出Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation（IO-FQE），在增广的状态-option空间中估计价值函数，从而无需数据中的option标注即可评估分层策略；并给出两种连续动作下的实例化实现。

Result: 在长时程分层连续控制任务（AntMaze导航、OGBench Puzzle操作）上，IO-FQE消除了朴素FQE带来的偏差，并相比option级重要性采样显著降低均方误差。

Conclusion: IO-FQE为分层策略提供了一种低偏差、低方差的OPE方案，适用于缺少option标注的数据，并在长时程连续控制任务中验证有效。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the expected return of a target policy from previously collected data without additional environment interaction. While OPE methods for flat Markovian policies are well studied, little work has addressed evaluating hierarchical policies in which a high-level policy selects temporally extended options that generate primitive actions until a termination condition is met. The primary existing approach applies per-decision importance sampling at the option level, but requires option-annotated trajectories and exhibits variance that still grows with the horizon. For non-hierarchical policies, fitted Q-evaluation (FQE) typically achieves lower error than importance sampling by leveraging the classic Bellman equation for policy evaluation; however, a naive extension of FQE to hierarchical policies results in a biased policy value estimate. In this paper, we introduce Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation (IO-FQE), which estimates a value function in the augmented state-option space; this approach enables OPE of hierarchical policies even when we lack annotations of what option was run in the data. We develop two continuous-action instantiations of IO-FQE and show on long-horizon hierarchical continuous control tasks (AntMaze navigation and OGBench Puzzle manipulation) that IO-FQE eliminates the bias incurred by a naive application of FQE to hierarchical policies and substantially lowers mean squared-error compared to option-level importance sampling.

</details>


### [466] [Dual-Granularity Learning for Regression with Continuous Noisy Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10550)
*Hui Guo,Boyu Wang,Grace Y. Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GRAIN：面向噪声标签回归的双粒度鲁棒框架，结合细粒度残差学习与粗粒度分箱对比正则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回归中的标签噪声研究较少，且噪声幅度异质：中小偏差要求对标签值敏感以做实例级修正，大偏差（损坏/离群标注）使精确标签不可信，需依赖样本间序结构。单一粒度方法难以兼顾全局结构与样本级偏差。

Method: 双粒度框架。细粒度：从鲁棒损失推导显式残差学习机制，引入实例特定辅助变量解耦标签噪声与预测信号。粗粒度：基于分箱的对比正则，强制保持与标签邻近性一致的有序特征结构。两层通过直方图桥接机制耦合，实现双向信息流。

Result: 实验表明GRAIN在多种噪声条件下持续提升鲁棒性与泛化性能。

Conclusion: 统一细粒度残差修正与粗粒度序结构正则，可有效应对异质幅度回归标签噪声，二者互补耦合优于单一粒度方法。

Abstract: Learning with noisy labels has been extensively studied for classification, yet its regression counterpart remains relatively underexplored. Unlike classification, regression involves continuous-valued targets where label noise exhibits heterogeneous magnitudes across instances, which poses conflicting requirements on the model: correcting small-to-moderate deviations requires sensitivity to label values for instance-level refinement, whereas large deviations caused by corrupted or outlying annotations render exact label values unreliable, necessitating reduced reliance on exact labels and instead leveraging ordinal structure among samples. These requirements call for methods that capture both global structure and sample-specific deviations in a unified manner. To this end, we propose GRAIN, a dual-granularity framework for robust noisy regression. At the fine-grained level, we derive an explicit residual learning mechanism from a robust loss formulation, introducing instance-specific auxiliary variables to decouple label noise from predictive signals. At the coarse-grained level, we introduce a binning-based contrastive regularization that enforces an order-preserving feature structure aligned with label proximity, addressing noise beyond the capacity of local residual refinement. The two levels are coupled via a histogram-based bridging mechanism that enables bidirectional information flow: coarse-grained structural guidance establishes a well-ordered feature space that anchors residual learning, while fine-grained residual refinement corrects instance-level deviations that structural regularization alone cannot resolve. Experimental results show that GRAIN consistently improves robustness and generalization under diverse noise conditions.

</details>


### [467] [Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10553)
*Jake Grigsby,Siddhant Agarwal,Yu Lei,Leonidas Varveropoulos,Yuke Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaBFM，一个结合 BFM（行为基础模型）与 meta-RL 的混合方法，用于在固定环境下在线适应新奖励函数，并扩展到新环境；它通过监督奖励跟随与无监督学习联合训练，测试时可在探索、利用和 ZSRL 式奖励推断之间插值，既复现监督 meta-RL 的分布内性能，又能泛化到训练集之外的奖励函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: meta-RL 需要多样的训练环境与奖励函数，而环境虽易生成，测试时可能被要求追求的目标却难以预先枚举。BFM 从无奖励数据学习策略并支持零样本 RL，近期工作表明 BFM 可在线进行任务推断而无需任务专属先验数据。作者据此把 BFM 与 meta-RL 视为固定环境下在线适应新奖励的两种替代方案，并希望将 BFM 拓展到更广范围（含新环境）以与 meta-RL 竞争。

Method: 先识别四个挑战：环境辨识、在线数据采集、测试时探索、混合奖励监督下的学习；随后逐一研究，并提出 MetaBFM 混合方法同时应对这四点。训练阶段将监督式奖励跟随与无监督学习相结合；测试阶段可在探索、利用与 ZSRL 式奖励推断之间插值。

Result: MetaBFM 能复现监督式 meta-RL 的分布内性能，同时泛化到训练集之外的奖励函数。

Conclusion: BFM 与 meta-RL 是互补的研究方向，二者优势结合可使自适应智能体从一组固定的监督目标中学到更多样的行为。

Abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) trains agents to adapt to novel tasks from test-time experience, but requires diverse training environments and reward functions. While environments are becoming cheaper to generate, it remains difficult to anticipate every objective an agent may be asked to pursue at test time. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) learn policies from reward-free data and support zero-shot RL (ZSRL): adaptation to new objectives at test time using a large reward-labeled dataset. Recent work has shown that BFM task inference can instead be performed online without prior task-specific data. We note that this capability positions BFMs and meta-RL as alternative approaches for online adaptation to new reward functions in a fixed environment. We then ask whether we can extend BFMs to compete with meta-RL more broadly, including in novel environments, and identify four challenges: environment identification, online data collection, test-time exploration, and learning from mixed reward supervision. We study each individually, then propose MetaBFM, a hybrid method that addresses all four. During training, it combines supervised reward-following with unsupervised learning; at test time, it can interpolate between exploration, exploitation, and ZSRL-style reward inference. We demonstrate that MetaBFM can recover the in-distribution performance of supervised meta-RL while generalizing to reward functions outside the training set. Our work suggests that BFMs and meta-RL are complementary research directions whose combined strengths allow adaptive agents to learn more diverse behaviors from a fixed set of supervised objectives.

</details>


### [468] [Confronting Uncertainty in Mechanism-AI Coupled Dynamical Systems via Optimal Transport and Information Geometry: Part I. Distribution Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10563)
*Pengfei Song,Yanni Xiao,Shuangshuang Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出用最优传输与信息几何的统一数学框架来处理机制-AI耦合动力系统中的不确定性，将UQ表述为概率密度空间上的能量泛函最小化，并给出Wasserstein与Fisher-Rao度量下的梯度流及基于伴随敏感性分析的数值求解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制-AI耦合动力系统广泛用于复杂生物系统研究，但噪声、稀疏和部分观测数据带来的不确定性限制了其可靠性，需要一个系统性的数学框架来刻画和处理这些不确定性。

Method: 将不确定性量化问题表述为在配备黎曼度量的概率密度空间上最小化能量泛函（损失通过微分方程评估）；在Wasserstein、Fisher-Rao等具体度量下给出能量泛函梯度流的统一描述；利用抽象伴随敏感性分析设计相应数值求解方法。

Result: 该框架将一系列面向动力系统的贝叶斯推断方法联系起来；数值实验在统一计算预算下比较了不同方法的后验近似与预测不确定性。

Conclusion: 该表述为动力系统提供了统一的几何视角，有助于理解建模过程与异质性演化，并统一了多种贝叶斯推断方法。

Abstract: Mechanism-AI coupled dynamical systems are increasingly used to study complex biological systems. However, uncertainty associated with noisy, sparse, and partially observed data limits their reliability. This paper presents a systematic mathematical formulation for treating these uncertainties from the perspective of optimal transport and information geometry. We formulate the uncertainty quantification problem as the minimization of an energy functional on a probability density space equipped with a Riemannian metric, with the loss evaluated through a differential equation, and give a unified description of the gradient flows of the energy functional under specific metrics, such as the Wasserstein and Fisher-Rao metrics. Furthermore, we present corresponding numerical methods for solving these gradient flows using abstract adjoint sensitivity analysis. The formulation connects a range of Bayesian inference methods for dynamical systems; numerical experiments compare posterior approximation and predictive uncertainty under a common computational budget. Moreover, it also provides a geometric perspective on dynamical modeling and the study of heterogeneity evolution.

</details>


### [469] [Predictive Modelling of Solid Waste Generation through Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10579)
*Mitra Tithi Dey,Punyasha Chatterjee,Amlan Chakrabarti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文基于斯里兰卡2012-2018年真实城市固废数据，对比SARIMAX、Prophet、LSTM、GRU四种时间序列模型的预测性能，并分析节假日、周末、季节、温湿度等因素对垃圾产生量的影响，最终LSTM与SARIMAX表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有城市固废（MSW）预测研究存在局限：缺乏下级行政单位的细粒度数据、数据集规模小、且常忽略节假日、周末、季节性、温度与湿度等影响固废产生的重要因素。因此需要更全面考虑这些因素并系统对比多种预测模型。

Method: 使用斯里兰卡2012-2018年真实MSW数据集，对SARIMAX、Prophet、LSTM、GRU四种主流时间序列预测模型进行对比分析；开展逐因素分析，考察节假日、工作日-周末差异、季节模式、温度与湿度对垃圾产生行为的影响；采用MAE、MAPE、RMSE和决定系数R²评估各模型性能。

Result: 节假日和周末垃圾产生量较低；夏季与冬季产生量较高，季风季与季后季相对较低；温度与湿度与垃圾产生量无直接线性关系，但其季节变化与不同季节的垃圾产生变化相关。所有模型中，LSTM和SARIMAX取得最佳的整体预测性能。

Conclusion: 综合考虑多因素的时间序列建模可有效提升MSW预测的可靠性，LSTM与SARIMAX是该场景下推荐的最佳模型，为可持续城市固废管理和资源规划提供支持。

Abstract: Reliable forecasting of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) production is pivotal for sustainable urban management, as it enables efficient resource planning, optimized collection schedules, and reduced environmental impacts. Existing works on MSW forecasting have some limitations, such as unavailability of granular data from lower administrative units, small datasets, limited or sometimes no consideration of important factors that can affect MSW generation, including holidays, weekends, seasonality, changes in temperature or humidity.
  This work presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four popularly used time series forecasting models, namely Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Prophet, Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), using a real-world MSW dataset from Sri Lanka spanning 2012-2018. A detailed factor-wise analysis is conducted to examine waste generation behaviour considering holidays, weekday-weekend variations, seasonal patterns, temperature and humidity. The results show lower waste generation during holidays and weekends, higher generation during Summer and Winter, and comparatively lower generation during Monsoon and Post-Monsoon. Temperature and humidity do not exhibit a direct linear relationship with waste generation, although their seasonal variations are associated with the changes in waste generation across different seasons. All model performances are evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and the coefficient of determination (R2). Among the evaluated models, LSTM and SARIMAX achieve the best overall forecasting performance.

</details>


### [470] [Detent: Batch-Invariant LLM Serving and RL Rollouts at Near-Stock Speed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10611)
*Peixu Xin,Runchuan Feng,Jiazhen Guo,Kan Wu,Ming Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Detent 将引擎的 kernel 选择表达为程序，只固定其中少数依赖 batch 的取值并按负载调优，从而在 vLLM/SGLang 上实现 batch 不变性（同请求不同 batch 组合下输出比特完全一致），同时保持接近 Stock 的延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复现评测、可验证推理和 on-policy RL 都要求同一请求在任何共享 batch 下输出相同比特，但现有引擎会依据 batch 选择 kernel 及其参数，不同 kernel 求和方式不同导致舍入差异；引擎的确定性模式则通过每个算子只用一种保守 kernel 来消除选择，代价是显著的延迟损失。

Method: 观察到许多快速 kernel 本身已是 batch 不变的，真正需要固定的是 kernel 选择所读取的少数 batch 相关取值。Detent 把 kernel 选择写成引擎执行的程序，自动找出该程序中最少必须固定的取值，并在部署前针对具体负载进行调优。

Result: 在 vLLM 和 SGLang 上多卡部署 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 时，Detent 具备 batch 不变性；按负载调优后，每输出 token 延迟为 Stock 的 1.04–1.17 倍，而确定性模式为 1.67–10.3 倍；在 SGLang 中达到与其确定性模式相同的 GSM8K 准确率；覆盖多引擎、多代 GPU、多种 TP 度、稠密与 MoE 模型。种子化 RL rollout（至 Llama-3.1-70B）在其他 batch 与 cache 切分下可比特级复现；基于 Detent kernel 与取值的 trainer 在每个 rollout logprob 上与日志比特一致，rollout 时间为 Stock 的 1.03 倍；BF16 GRPO 在 Stock 崩溃的情况下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 只需固定 kernel 选择中的少量 batch 相关取值即可获得 batch 不变性，比"每算子单一保守 kernel"的确定性模式代价小得多，可支撑可复现评测与稳定的大模型 RL 训练。

Abstract: Reproducible evaluation, verifiable inference and on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) need an LLM engine to give a request the same output bits whichever requests share its batch. Batch-invariant kernels exist, but engines still select each kernel and its parameters from the batch. Two kernels that compute the same sum can round it differently. The engines' deterministic modes remove the choice by keeping one conservative kernel per operator and pay for it in latency. Many fast kernels are batch-invariant by themselves, so it is enough to fix the few batch-dependent values that kernel selection reads. Detent expresses kernel selection as a program that the engine executes. It finds the fewest values in this program that must be fixed and tunes them for the workload before deployment. On multi-GPU deployments of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-30B-A3B in vLLM and SGLang, Detent is batch-invariant. Tuned per load, it serves at 1.04-1.17x the latency per output token of Stock (each engine with its standard settings), against 1.67-10.3x for the deterministic modes. In SGLang it matches the GSM8K accuracy of SGLang's deterministic mode. Detent covers multiple deployment combinations, including multiple engines, GPU generations, tensor-parallel degrees, and dense and MoE models. Seeded RL rollouts of models up to Llama-3.1-70B replay bit for bit under other batches and cache splits. A trainer on Detent's kernels and values matches every rollout logprob bit for bit at 1.03x Stock's rollout time per token. BF16 GRPO then stays stable where Stock's run collapses.

</details>


### [471] [What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10620)
*Mainul Hasan Mohsin,Mohammad Shahidur Rahman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 激活探针看似能近乎完美地监控LLM智能体间的秘密串通，但实际主要检测到的是"被告知要串通"这一指令，而非智能体的"决策"。需要能区分指令与决策的评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究宣称激活探针可近完美监控LLM多智能体间的秘密串通，但缺少能区分"被指示串通"与"自主决定串通"的基准，导致检测器可能只是在读指令而非决策，报告性能存在虚高。

Method: 构建含2,500个委员会与1,476个代码审查情节的基准，加入"收到串通指令但拒绝"的智能体以分离指令与决策；对比已发布检测器与自训探针；检验两个评测陷阱（投票后打分、公开辩论缺失）；训练基于智能体自身选择的探针；将扫描统计量改造为适用于任意规模群体的在线监控器，并形成监控器测试协议。

Result: 已发布检测器几乎无法区分串通者与拒绝者；最佳探针在去除指令后AUROC从1.00降至0.61；仅在投票后读取投票的规则可达AUROC 0.990但投票前毫无发现；57%的尝试中无串通者在公开场合为目标辩护；基于自身选择的探针在无指令时AUROC达0.73，对目标微调进权重的串通者达0.995（预注册）。

Conclusion: 现有激活探针的"完美监控"结论被高估，真正检测决策仍有希望；需采用区分指令与决策的协议，并配合在线群体监控方法，避免评测陷阱带来的虚高。

Abstract: Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

</details>


### [472] [CONSTRAINER: Promptable Graph-Structured Optimization via Constraint Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10627)
*Zeeshan Memon,Mingke Tian,Xinyuan Song,Hongwei Jin,Kibaek Kim,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CONSTRAINER，将约束集本身作为结构化输入共享表示，用算子图与 GNN 编码约束嵌入，条件化共享骨干网络求解图结构优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图结构优化的神经方法多为固定问题形式训练，难以跨相关变体复用；已有共享骨干方法主要共享实例级表示，却隐式处理可行性约束，忽视了约束集这一跨任务重叠的共享结构来源。

Method: 将约束规范解析为算子图，用图神经网络编码为不变的约束嵌入；以该嵌入条件化一个共享骨干模型进行解预测。

Result: 在电力网络优化与混合整数线性规划问题上，相比基线方法提升了求解最优性，并实现了高效的迁移学习与泛化。

Conclusion: 显式建模约束结构可有效增强图优化神经求解器跨问题变体的复用性、迁移与泛化能力。

Abstract: Neural methods for graph-structured optimization have achieved strong performance within individual problem classes, but are typically trained for fixed formulations, limiting reuse across related problem variants. Recent progress in foundation models has motivated shared neural backbones trained across multiple graph-structured optimization tasks; however, existing approaches primarily share instance-level representations while treating feasibility constraints implicitly. A key source of shared structure across constrained optimization problems is the constraint set itself, which often exhibits substantial overlap across tasks. We propose CONSTRAINER, a constraint-conditioned framework for graph-structured optimization that treats constraints as structured inputs. Constraint specifications are parsed into operator graphs and encoded using a graph neural network to produce invariant constraint embeddings, which condition a shared backbone model for solution prediction. We evaluate our approach on power grid optimization and mixed-integer linear programming problems, where it shows improved solution optimality and enables efficient transfer learning and generalization compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [473] [Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10634)
*Yan-Cheng Li,Chun-Yi Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CVSA 将稀疏注意力内核中已有的 softmax 覆盖率信号转化为闭环"验证-纠正"解码机制，无需训练或草稿模型，在接近稠密注意力质量的同时实现最高 6.21× 解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法是开环的：内核一旦选定 KV 子集就无从判断是否保留了足够的注意力质量，也没有失败后的恢复路径，导致长上下文解码质量不可控。

Method: 作者指出被选 token 上的 softmax 质量占比（coverage）与每步输出误差满足精确代数关系，因而可同时作为接受判据和恢复时的插值权重。据此提出 CVSA：对高覆盖率草稿直接接受，仅对覆盖率不足的注意力头进行恢复，全程无需采样、草稿模型或投机解码基础设施。

Result: 阈值扫描中质量波动仅 0.14 分；在 LongBench 上 7B 与 70B 模型分别与稠密注意力相差 1.13 分以内（70B 统计上持平），RULER 上仅下降 0.8 分；128K 上下文下实测解码步中位加速达 6.21×。

Conclusion: 覆盖率可作为稀疏注意力的内建质量控制信号，实现免训练的闭环正确性保障；CVSA 在不牺牲精度的前提下显著加速长上下文解码，为稀疏注意力的可靠性提供新范式。

Abstract: Sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the KV cache, but existing methods are open-loop: the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. The needed signal already exists inside the kernel. The fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens, which we call coverage, satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention (CVSA) turns coverage into a training-free, closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short, with no sampling, no draft model, and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. Quality varies by only $0.14$ points across the threshold sweep; budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. On LongBench at 7B and 70B, CVSA comes within $1.13$ points of dense attention, statistically matching it at 70B, and it loses $0.8$ points on RULER; measured median decode-step speedup reaches $6.21\times$ at 128K context.

</details>


### [474] [MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10649)
*Lorenz K. Muller,Philippe Bich,Chiara Boretti,Hyun-Min Chang,Jiawei Zhuang,Lukas Cavigelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MACaQ 是一种 MXFP4 的 W4A4 训练后量化方法，将每个线性层独立处理，通过在线逐通道缩放与 block-Hadamard 变换实现高效量化，并用 Flip-Refinement 提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有权重-激活量化方法通常需要昂贵的优化过程，并依赖跨层的基变换传播（架构特定），实现复杂且难以通用。作者希望设计一种层局部、无需跨层依赖、可流式实现的量化方案。

Method: MACaQ 独立处理每个线性层：对激活在线施加逐通道 scale 和 block-Hadamard 变换，并把对应逆变换吸收进权重，从而避免跨层依赖、支持单层驻留内存的流式实现。为超越 round-to-nearest，提出 Flip-Refinement——一种 Hessian 感知的坐标下降过程，贪心地对单个 FP4 码移动到相邻可表示值。

Result: 在 Qwen3-32B 的 vLLM 中相比纯 MXFP4 仅增加 2.3% 端到端开销；困惑度低于 DuQuant++ 和 MR-GPTQ，并在 Llama-3-8B 上以少 11 倍的量化时间达到其最佳困惑度；无需架构特定修改即可应用于图像扩散模型；64 分钟、仅用 32.5GB GPU 显存完成 122B 参数模型的量化。

Conclusion: MACaQ 以层局部设计实现了高效、通用的 W4A4 后训练量化，兼顾精度、速度与内存效率，可扩展到超大模型和扩散模型等非 LLM 架构。

Abstract: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM.

</details>


### [475] [STABLE: A Continual Learning Optimizer with Adaptive Drift Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10655)
*Xiaoyan Li,Lanpei Li,Massimo Coppola,Vincenzo Lomonaco,Antonio Carta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STABLE 是一个优化器层面的原始-对偶方法，通过自适应漂移预算控制参数漂移，从学习动态稳定性角度缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方案依赖回放缓冲、架构改动或额外正则项；作者认为遗忘是不稳定学习动态的结果，且学习动态随时间变化（如 stability gap），因此更适合在优化器层面解决。

Method: 先形式化证明：对基于距离的分类器，在局部分数稳定条件下，参数漂移有界可保证间隔（margin）侵蚀有界。据此提出 STABLE——带自适应漂移控制的原始-对偶优化器：违反漂移预算时增大对偶变量，否则减小，从而在保持稳定性的同时不牺牲可塑性。

Result: 在长程单模态任务流与基于 CLIP 的多模态任务流上，用 STABLE 训练的普通 PEFT 基线可匹敌或超越专门的持续学习方法；多模态场景下还能保持零样本迁移能力，达到或超过专用多模态持续学习方法。

Conclusion: 遗忘可通过优化器层面的动态稳定控制有效缓解，STABLE 无需回放或模型改动即可在单/多模态持续学习中取得竞争力表现，并保留零样本泛化。

Abstract: Continual learning suffers from catastrophic forgetting, leading to the loss of past knowledge and unstable adaptation across task streams. Existing approaches typically address this issue through replay buffers, architectural changes, or additional regularization terms. We argue that forgetting is a consequence of unstable learning dynamics, which may benefit from an optimizer-level solution. The main challenge is that learning dynamics are time-dependent, as demonstrated by empirical phenomena such as the stability gap. First, we formally prove that, for distance-based classifiers, bounded parameter drift guarantees bounded margin erosion under a local score-stability condition. Based on this insight, we propose STABLE, a primal-dual optimizer with adaptive drift control. STABLE enforces a drift budget by increasing the dual variable when the budget is violated and decreasing it otherwise. This results in high stability without penalizing plasticity. Experiments on long-horizon unimodal streams and CLIP-based multimodal streams show that vanilla PEFT baselines trained with STABLE match or outperform specialized continual learning methods. In the multimodal setting, STABLE further preserves zero-shot transfer, matching or exceeding dedicated multimodal continual learning methods.

</details>


### [476] [Causal Heteroscedastic Structure Learning From Incomplete Temporal data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10668)
*Abdellah Rahmani,Pascal Frossard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Cheesefill，一个基于最优传输的框架，在缺失值和异方差噪声并存的条件下联合学习多变量时间序列因果结构，通过条件归一化流建模因果机制并学习随机校正映射精化插补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时间序列因果发现面临三个挑战：缺失值（先插补后发现的流程会扭曲分布并产生虚假因果图）、即使完整数据下瞬时效应也难识别且缺失进一步纠缠插补与图恢复、真实数据存在由瞬时和滞后原因驱动方差的异方差噪声违反标准方法假设。现有方法无法同时解决这些问题，且消融表明顺序而非联合解决会显著降低性能。

Method: Cheesefill用条件归一化流参数化因果机制，并联合学习一个随机校正映射，将朴素插补精化为与推断因果机制一致的轨迹。理论上证明在随机校正映射上优化等价于Kantovich问题的条件核重构，由此神经参数化得到可处理的目标函数。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上，Cheesefill在不同缺失率条件下一致优于现有基线。

Conclusion: 联合处理缺失、瞬时效应与异方差噪声是必要的；所提最优传输框架在理论与实验中均有效，为复杂实际场景下的时间序列因果发现提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Discovering causal structures in multivariate time series (MTS) is critical in domains such as finance and neuroscience, yet remains challenging in practice due to three distinct obstacles. First, MTS are routinely corrupted by missing values, where naive impute-then-discover pipelines distort the underlying data distribution and yield spurious causal graphs. Second, identifying instantaneous effects is difficult even on complete data, and missingness further entangles imputation with graph recovery. Third, real-world data frequently exhibits heteroscedastic noise with variance driven by both instantaneous and lagged causes, violating the core assumptions of standard discovery methods. Existing approaches fail to address these challenges concurrently, typically presuming complete data, homoscedastic noise, or strictly time-lagged relationships. Crucially, we show through ablation studies that resolving these issues sequentially, rather than jointly, leads to a substantial degradation in performance. To overcome this, we introduce Cheesefill, an optimal transport framework for causal structure learning under missingness and heteroscedastic noise. Cheesefill parameterizes causal mechanisms using conditional normalizing flows and jointly learns a stochastic correction map that refines naive imputations into trajectories consistent with the inferred causal mechanisms. Theoretically, we prove that optimizing over stochastic correction maps is equivalent to a conditional kernel reformulation of the Kantorovich problem, from which our neural parameterization yields a tractable objective. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Cheesefill consistently outperforms existing baselines across diverse missingness regimes.

</details>


### [477] [Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning using Behavior Regularisation and Latent Feasibility Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10677)
*Mahesh Keswani,Parth Bhardwaj,Ankur Kumar,Raunak P. Bhattacharyya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FOCAL方法，将行为正则化策略梯度融入CVAE演员，按可行性分区优化策略，并在推理时调整潜变量先验尺度，在DSRL基准上全部任务满足约束且回报有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全离线RL需在满足安全约束下最大化回报，reachability分析刻画可行域；但常用AWR策略抽取依赖指数权重，会放大价值估计误差，而行为正则化策略梯度能更有效利用critic的动作梯度。

Method: FOCAL在CVAE演员上引入行为正则化策略梯度，采用按可行性划分的一阶目标：对判定可行转移增大回报，对判定不可行转移降低约束违反；推理时依据状态可行性动态调整潜先验尺度以调节采样保守性。

Result: 理论上证明AWR策略更新方差随优势误差指数增长，而FOCAL仅随价值估计误差方差线性增长；DSRL基准上所有任务均满足约束，回报与基线持平或更高。

Conclusion: 以可行性分区的行为正则化策略梯度替代AWR，可显著降低误差敏感性，实现安全且高回报的离线策略学习。

Abstract: Safe offline reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to learn policies that maximize return while satisfying safety constraints, using a static dataset. To characterize state-wise safety, reachability analysis identifies the feasible region, defined as the set of states from which constraints can be satisfied at every future step. Policies are commonly extracted from learned value functions with advantage-weighted regression (AWR). However, AWR relies on exponentiated weights that amplify value estimation errors, whereas behavior-regularized policy gradient methods directly utilize the action gradient of the value function and often make more effective use of learned critics. We propose Feasibility-Optimized Conditional Actor Learning (FOCAL), a method that incorporates behavior-regularized policy gradients into a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) actor. FOCAL optimizes this policy using a first-order objective partitioned by feasibility, updating the actor to increase return on transitions estimated to be feasible and to reduce constraint violations on transitions estimated to be infeasible. During inference, FOCAL dynamically adjusts the scale of the latent prior according to the estimated feasibility of the state to adjust the conservatism of action sampling. Theoretically, we show that for AWR, the policy update variance depends exponentially on the advantage error, whereas for FOCAL it scales linearly with the variance of the value estimation error. Across the DSRL benchmark, FOCAL satisfies the constraints on all evaluated tasks while achieving competitive or higher returns compared to baselines.

</details>


### [478] [A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10691)
*Aythami Bethencourt de León,Darryl D. Holm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于统计物理发展变分与几何理论，用Fisher–Rao梯度流刻画注意力权重的演化，并研究注意力与token表示的联合动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer理论多关注静态注意力，缺乏对注意力权重与token表示协同演化的动力学与收敛性刻画，作者希望借助统计物理（自由能、梯度流、Hamilton力学）给出严格理论基础。

Method: 为注意力-表示引入自由能；用Fisher–Rao梯度流描述注意力权重演化，证明softmax矩阵是唯一自由能最小元且正注意力轨迹收敛；在时变表示下用logit变量将动力学线性化并给出跟踪界与收敛条件；将表示的Hamilton动力学与同一能量驱动的注意力松弛耦合，并提出两种含value map的替代Hamiltonian。

Result: 证明softmax矩阵为唯一自由能极小点及正轨迹收敛性；给出相对瞬时softmax的跟踪界和注意力收敛到固定矩阵的充分条件；耦合系统满足能量耗散律；证明注意力流与三类耦合系统的全局适定性。

Conclusion: 文章为注意力与表示的联合演化建立了具有收敛性、能量耗散与全局适定性的统一变分/几何框架，并将注意力机制解释为能量驱动的松弛过程。

Abstract: We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

</details>


### [479] [Spectral Bias Reduction in Local Gated ReLU Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10700)
*Victorita Dolean*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文在浅层ReLU线性模型中用Gram矩阵特征值刻画各频率学习速率，提出"门控局部ReLU字典"以缓解谱偏置，并证明其对L2回归有效而对H1能量型损失无效、需额外预条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度法训练的神经网络会更快学到目标函数的低频成分（谱偏置），但哪些架构选择能缓解、哪些不能尚不清楚，缺乏统一的定量分析框架。

Method: 考虑对可训练参数线性的浅层ReLU模型，每个模式的学习速率由Gram矩阵特征值决定；将分析推广到一般对称双线性形式a(·,·)，使最小二乘回归（L2内积）与变分/物理信息损失（H1能量形式）统一处理。提出将每个ReLU特征乘以hat单位分解权重得到门控局部ReLU字典（借鉴单位分解有限元与重叠Schwarz方法），使Gram矩阵在任意局部双线性形式下呈块带状、内部块Toeplitz，由矩阵值符号函数控制谱。

Result: 两种形式行为迥异：L2回归下符号函数有正下界、比值与窗口数无关，模型规模匹配时频率相关学习速率离散度从1.9e5降至4.5；H1刚度矩阵的符号在零频处消失，门控无法改变Θ(N^2)条件数，反而反转频率顺序而非消除偏置。用同一内部模板构造的预条件子可修复谱偏置，说明仅靠架构不够。1D回归与Poisson问题实验验证该二分性质，且隐藏层参数也参与训练时回归效应依然存在。

Conclusion: 门控局部单位分解架构能显著缓解L2回归的谱偏置，但无法治愈H1能量型损失的病态问题，需配合基于同一模板的预条件；架构与数值线性代数需协同设计。

Abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods learn the low-frequency content of a target function faster than its high-frequency content. This spectral bias is well documented, but it is much less clear which architectural choices mitigate it and which cannot. We study the question for shallow ReLU models linear in their trainable parameters, where each mode is learned at a rate given by a Gram-matrix eigenvalue, and for a general symmetric bilinear form $a(\cdot,\cdot)$, so that least-squares regression ($a=$ the $L^2$ inner product) and variational or physics-informed losses ($a=$ the $H^1$ energy form) are two instances of one analysis.
  Within this framework we propose gated local ReLU dictionaries, obtained by multiplying each ReLU feature by a hat partition-of-unity weight, in the spirit of partition-of-unity finite elements and overlapping Schwarz methods. The resulting Gram matrices are block-banded for any local bilinear form, with a block-Toeplitz interior whose matrix-valued symbol governs the spectrum.
  The two forms then behave very differently. For $L^2$ regression, the symbol is bounded away from zero, the ratio is uniform in the number of windows, and the measured spread of frequency-dependent learning rates falls from $1.9\times10^{5}$ to $4.5$ at matched model size. For the $H^1$ stiffness matrix, the symbol vanishes at zero frequency: gating leaves the $Θ(N^2)$ conditioning intact and inverts the frequency ordering instead of removing the bias. A preconditioner built from the same interior stencil will fix the spectral bias, showing that architecture alone is not enough. Experiments on $1$D regression and Poisson problems confirm the dichotomy, and the regression effect persists when the hidden-layer parameters are trained as well.

</details>


### [480] [AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10705)
*Moein Salimi,Amir Qeysarbeigi,Babak Hosseini Mohtasham,Faraz Doagoye Tehrani,Mahdi Naieni,Hanieh Sartipi,Ali Nouri,Amin Aghakasiri,Reyhane Khayatzade Mahani,Mahdi Jafari Siavoshani,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AbductionBench 统一了 27 个数据集（10 个领域）的溯因推理评测框架，分离"最终答案"与"可观测推理轨迹"两层面评估 8 个 LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 溯因推理包含生成解释、区分竞争假设、随证据修订假设、决定下一步寻求何种证据等多种能力，但现有评测分散在互不相通的基准中，任务形式与打分方式各异，导致"模型擅长溯因"的结论往往只反映能力的窄小一面。

Method: 提出 AbductionBench 统一框架及其任务分类体系，在 10 个领域、27 个数据集上实例化，对 4 个模型家族的 8 个 LLM 在单选任务上评测；将最终答案评估与推理痕迹/交互历史分析相分离，把书面 trace 视为可观测输出而非内部计算的忠实反映，围绕证据使用、假设比较、不确定性、矛盾处理与答案承诺进行刻画。

Result: Jev 在紧凑证据下选择解释时可匹敌或超过小型 LLM，但在长案例上明显落后，说明候选区分与长程证据整合对系统提出不同要求；交互任务中后续步骤被判为相关的动作比例下降，且首个问题相关与最终答案正确相关联；被动任务中模型很少随新证据修订初始假设。

Conclusion: 溯因推理评测应同时考察最终答案与可观测的证据使用、假设修订和信息获取过程，二者结合才能更全面反映模型能力。

Abstract: Abductive reasoning is the inference of plausible explanations for observed evidence. Evaluating this capability requires more than a single task: a system may need to generate an explanation, discriminate among competing hypotheses, revise its hypotheses as evidence arrives, or decide what evidence to seek next. Yet these capabilities are typically evaluated through isolated benchmarks with different task formulations and scoring procedures, so claims that a model is ``good at abduction'' may reflect only a narrow aspect of this capability. We introduce AbductionBench, a unified framework whose taxonomy characterizes abductive tasks. We instantiate this framework on 27 datasets spanning ten domains and evaluate eight LLMs from four model families evaluated on single-choice selection tasks. Beyond harmonizing heterogeneous tasks, AbductionBench separates final-answer evaluation from analysis of the observable reasoning traces and interaction histories produced alongside those answers. We analyze written traces as observable model outputs rather than faithful representations of internal computation, characterizing evidence use, hypothesis comparison, uncertainty, contradiction handling, and answer commitment. Jev matches or exceeds small LLMs when selecting among explanations over compact evidence but falls substantially behind on longer cases, suggesting that candidate discrimination and extended evidence integration place different demands on a system. In interactive tasks, the proportion of actions judged relevant declines at later steps, and a relevant first question is associated with a correct final answer; in the passive task, models rarely revise their initial hypothesis as new evidence arrives. Together, these findings highlight the value of evaluating abductive reasoning through both final answers and observable evidence use, hypothesis revision, and information gathering.

</details>


### [481] [FedSGN: Federated Sparse Grassmann Newton Learning for IoT Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10718)
*Jingjing Liu,Xiansen Ju,Xianchao Xiu,Wanquan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出联邦稀疏Grassmann牛顿学习法FedSGN，用ℓ2,0范数约束消除特征冗余，提升IoT异常检测性能并降低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦PCA方法虽无需共享原始数据即可学习正常样本子空间，但存在特征冗余问题，会降低IoT异常检测性能。

Method: 对全局投影矩阵施加ℓ2,0范数约束以消除冗余，引入正交惩罚保持内在结构；设计增广拉格朗日求解器结合半光滑牛顿方案，实现客户端并行更新与Grassmann投影以增强鲁棒性。

Result: 数值实验表明该方法在整体检测性能上表现良好，同时降低了通信开销。

Conclusion: FedSGN为IoT异常检测提供了一种高效、鲁棒的联邦稀疏子空间学习方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Anomaly detection plays a critical role in securing the Internet of things (IoT). Although existing federated principal component analysis (PCA) methods can learn the subspace of normal samples without sharing raw data, they often suffer from feature redundancy that may degrade detection performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel and effective federated sparse Grassmann Newton (FedSGN) learning method for IoT anomaly detection. Technically, our FedSGN leverages the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm constraint on the global projection matrix to eliminate redundancy and introduces an orthogonality penalty to preserve the intrinsic structure. Moreover, we develop an augmented Lagrangian solver integrated with a semismooth Newton scheme to enable parallel client updates and Grassmann projection for robustness. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable overall detection performance while reducing communication overhead. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/FedSGN

</details>


### [482] [Breaking Precision Walls in First-, Second-, and Zeroth-Order Optimizers: One Constant, Set in Advance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10730)
*Lngel Kyo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"精度墙"(precision wall)概念,刻画在功率律信号衰减下优化器能恢复最弱方向的最陡衰减阈值,并给出一个由单个常数决定该墙的机制与调参法则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功率律信号衰减时,优化器可能只拟合强方向而忽略弱方向,而平均损失掩盖了这一失败;需要一种度量来量化最弱方向的恢复能力。

Method: 定义精度墙(最弱方向在固定预算内恢复至5%的最陡衰减)。在低秩矩阵感知与二次型上分析:当某常数主导分母时,Adam或嫁接Shampoo退化为步长η/c的动量下降,从而决定墙;Shampoo中将嫁接常数与阻尼匹配可恢复墙。零阶Adam中ε与由均方谱模型推出的ε*对抗,低于ε*时误差触噪声底。基于真实曲率或谱设定该常数进行预测。

Result: 按规则设定常数使墙高于同步骤默认值:两种感知形状提升1.96、1.15(Adam)和1.59、1.74(嫁接Shampoo);两个Hadamard旋转二次型提升1.12、0.73(零阶Adam),所有种子均上升;该步长的固定步动量可达同样墙。余弦调度默认值在一形状更高、另一种子匹配、规则常数下更低。逐预算重调默认步长在旋转二次型和总体逻辑回归上追平,但在1查询/步的两个对角二次型上失败(16时追平),在digits逻辑回归上超过规则。一阶逻辑回归中规则未能提升墙(默认Adam更高),零阶总体损失下ε使墙提升0.98、0.88。

Conclusion: 精度墙由单一常数主导,可通过匹配阻尼/谱设定常数来抬升;该调参法则具预测性且跨种子稳定,但在部分一阶逻辑回归场景与逐预算重调默认步长面前存在局限。

Abstract: Under power-law signal decay across directions, an optimizer can fit strong directions and miss weak ones while average loss hides it. A precision wall measures the steepest decay where the weakest direction recovers within 5% in a fixed budget. On low-rank matrix sensing and quadratics one constant sets the wall: once it dominates the denominator, Adam or grafted Shampoo is momentum descent at step $η/c$, setting the wall; in Shampoo, matching grafting's constant to damping restores the wall after three hypotheses failed. In zeroth-order Adam, $\varepsilon$ acts against $\varepsilon^\ast$ from a mean-square spectral model; below $\varepsilon^\ast$ error hits a noise floor. Set from true curvature or spectrum on new shapes, the rule raised the wall above the same-step default by a forecast amount: on two sensing shapes by $1.96, 1.15$ (Adam) and $1.59, 1.74$ (grafted Shampoo), and on two Hadamard-rotated quadratics by $1.12, 0.73$ (zeroth-order Adam, longer budget), rising on all seeds; fixed-step momentum at that step reaches those walls. A cosine-scheduled default (small constant giving weak modes large steps) is higher on one sensing shape, matched on new seeds of the other, and lower with the rule's constant. A default step retuned per budget catches up on rotated quadratics and population logistic regression, fails at 1 query/step on two diagonal quadratics (catching up at 16), and exceeds the rule on digits logistic regression (full-batch and minibatches, where gradient noise sets the $η= 0.01, 0.1$ default walls). On logistic regression the rule did not raise the first-order wall: same-step default Adam was higher (its wall on 4 new shapes at the forecast stability limit), while in zeroth order on the population loss setting $\varepsilon$ raised the wall by $0.98, 0.88$.

</details>


### [483] [Spectrogram-Based CNN Autoencoder for One-Class Anomaly Detection in Machining Vibration Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10733)
*Sebastian Zeleny,Christian Gawron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于卷积自编码器的一类异常检测框架，利用三轴振动信号的时频谱图对拉削加工进行状态监测，并提出分段垂直误差（SVE）指标以提升对颤振等短时失稳的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加工过程振动监测中异常样本稀少、类别极度不平衡，且传统重构误差对颤振等短暂失稳不敏感，因此需要仅依赖正常数据训练、又能捕捉短时异常的检测方法。

Method: 将工业拉削采集的三轴振动信号转换为时频谱图并合并为三通道输入，用卷积自编码器仅以正常数据训练，依据重构误差检测异常；用有标注验证集校准阈值、独立测试集评估；并提出基于局部残差的分段垂直误差（SVE）指标增强短时异常敏感性。

Result: 在约10,000次拉削行程数据上，强类别不平衡条件下正常与异常状态实现清晰分离；并在外部公开车削数据集上验证了流程的初步可迁移性。

Conclusion: 基于谱图的自编码器模型可为工业振动监测提供实用、可扩展的一类异常检测方案。

Abstract: This work presents a one-class anomaly detection framework for vibration-based condition monitoring in machining processes using a convolutional neural network autoencoder. Three-axis vibration signals acquired during industrial broaching are transformed into time--frequency spectrograms and combined into a compact three-channel representation, enabling convolutional feature learning on multivariate time-series data. The autoencoder is trained exclusively on normal process data and detects anomalous strokes based on reconstruction errors. Labeled validation data are used for threshold calibration and an independent test set is reserved for final performance evaluation. To improve sensitivity to short-lived process instabilities such as chatter, a localized residual-based metric termed Segmented Vertical Error (SVE) is introduced. Experimental results on approximately 10{,}000 broaching strokes show a clear separation between normal and anomalous process conditions under strong class imbalance. The processing pipeline is additionally evaluated on an external public turning dataset as a proof of concept, indicating preliminary applicability beyond the original broaching setup. The results suggest that spectrogram-based autoencoder models can provide a practical and scalable basis for one-class anomaly detection in industrial vibration monitoring.

</details>


### [484] [AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10750)
*Shrey Singhal,Nannan Huang,Haytham M. Fayek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AERO提出一种全在线RLHF算法，用Dyna式模型化强化学习架构，让基于集成的认知奖励模型（ERM）同时充当奖励后验与合成偏好标注器，通过集成投票熵+自适应阈值决定哪些上下文需要人工标注、哪些可用合成标签，从而把昂贵人工标注集中在最有信息量的地方，在减少oracle查询预算的同时保持有竞争力的对齐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF对齐LLM效果显著，但获取偏好标签的成本是主要瓶颈。现有主动探索方法虽提升样本效率，却对所有上下文均匀地查询oracle，即使某些上下文的奖励估计已足够可靠、完全可生成合成标签，造成标注浪费。

Method: 构建全在线RLHF算法，基于Dyna风格基于模型的RL框架；核心是用集成式认知奖励模型（ERM）既作探索的奖励后验，又作学习到的偏好反馈模型生成合成标签；采用Query-by-Committee的集成投票熵作为不确定性度量，配合自适应阈值机制路由决策：高分歧上下文查询oracle，低分歧上下文使用ERM合成标签。

Result: 在多种模型家族和规模上，AERO取得与在线DPO及强主动探索基线相当甚至更优的对齐性能，同时显著降低所需oracle查询预算。

Conclusion: 通过不确定性驱动的自适路由策略，将人工偏好标注预算集中到高信息量上下文，是提升RLHF标注效率的有效途径；集成奖励模型的双重用途（探索+合成标注）为在线对齐提供了紧凑高效的框架。

Abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has driven substantial improvements across a wide range of tasks, but the cost of acquiring preference labels remains the dominant bottleneck in the alignment pipeline. While many recent alignment methods improve sample efficiency through active exploration over candidate responses, they typically query the oracle uniformly across contexts, even for contexts where the learned reward estimates are already reliable enough to provide synthetic labels. We propose Adaptive Ensemble-disagreement Routing for Oracle feedback (AERO), a fully online RLHF algorithm built on a Dyna-style model-based RL architecture, in which an ensemble-based Epistemic Reward Model (ERM) serves both as a reward posterior for exploration and as a learned preference-feedback model for synthetic labeling. AERO uses ensemble vote entropy, a Query-by-Committee disagreement measure, combined with an adaptive thresholding mechanism to decide which contexts require oracle feedback and which can instead receive ERM-based synthetic preference labels, concentrating expensive labels where they are most informative. Empirical results across different model families and scales show that AERO achieves highly competitive alignment performance while reducing the required oracle-query budget compared to online DPO and strong active-exploration baselines.

</details>


### [485] [Constrained Look-ahead Guidance for Interference-Aware Flow Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10751)
*Doudou Zhang,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需反演( inversion-free )的流模型图像编辑框架，从轨迹视角出发，用一步前瞻机制评估候选更新对编辑奖励与保真奖励的影响，并在显式保真约束下进行奖励驱动修正，从而稳定地改善编辑效果与源图保真的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型生成能力强，但可控编辑困难：需要在生成轨迹中同时平衡源图保真度与编辑遵从度。现有方法依赖反演或启发式引导，二者在目标间易产生梯度干扰、难以取得良好折中。

Method: 提出基于轨迹中心视角的原则性、无需求反演（inversion-free）的流式图像编辑框架。核心是单步前瞻（one-step look-ahead）机制：通过去噪估计候选更新对编辑奖励与保真奖励的影响，据此调整当前更新；每步在显式保真约束下做奖励驱动的修正，前瞻可预判两目标在未来状态的交互，从而缓解编辑与保真目标间的梯度干扰。

Result: 实验表明，与现有强基线相比，该方法在实现更强语义编辑的同时更好地保留源图内容，取得更优的编辑-保真权衡。

Conclusion: 从轨迹层面进行前瞻式奖励评估与约束修正，是无反演流模型编辑的有效且稳定的思路，能在编辑遵从与内容保真间获得更好平衡。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models enable powerful generative modeling, but controlled editing remains challenging due to the need to balance source fidelity and edit compliance along the generative trajectory. We propose a principled, inversion-free framework for flow-based image editing from a trajectory centric perspective. Rather than relying on inversion or heuristic guidance, we introduce a one-step look-ahead mechanism that evaluates the effect of candidate updates on both edit and fidelity rewards estimated via denoising, and adjusts the current update based on this evaluation. At each step, our method applies reward-driven corrections guided by the look-ahead evaluation under an explicit fidelity constraint, resulting in stable and coherent trajectory evolution. This look-ahead design mitigates gradient interference between edit and fidelity objectives by anticipating their interaction in future states, leading to improved trade-offs. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves stronger semantic edits while better preserving source content compared to existing strong baselines.

</details>


### [486] [ConwayNet: Interpretability, Activation Coherence, and Noise Resilience via a Game-of-Life-Inspired Lateral Inhibition in Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10760)
*Yair Cohen,Scott M. Gilmore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于连续生命游戏规则的侧抑制机制，作为可微、与架构无关、参数固定不学习的激活调制层，使神经网络获得可解释、可编程的动力学特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络虽具万能逼近能力，但对噪声敏感且难以机理阐释；元胞自动机（如生命游戏）的局部规则却能产生可解释甚至可编程的动力学。作者希望弥合两者。

Method: 从层输入导出兴奋/抑制响应，并以状态条件方式混合进激活图；规则参数固定不优化，但规则取值与导数在网络训练全程塑造梯度。机制可微、架构无关，接入全连接、卷积、宽残差与图卷积网络。

Result: 激活图在空间、深度和随机种子上更一致（粗结构跨深度保留、细节逐层更新）；隐单元共激活图偏离Erdős–Rényi随机图，呈空间图布局且巨连通分量阶梯式增长；在标签噪声下，近同初始化的网络测试图像分歧减少约三十倍；显著图聚焦目标而非背景；对未见过像素噪声的鲁棒性显著提升。

Conclusion: 将元胞自动机式侧抑制引入神经网络，可在不牺牲可微性的前提下获得类CA的可解释、可编程动力学，并带来一致性、鲁棒性与可解释性收益。

Abstract: Deep neural networks achieve universal function approximation by stacking interconnected nonlinearities, but as a consequence they are sensitive to noise and resist mechanistic interpretation. In contrast, the local update rules of cellular automata, such as Conway's Game of Life, give rise to not merely interpretable but programmable dynamics. We explore a bridge between these worlds: a lateral inhibition in neural networks based on continuous Game-of-Life rules that derives inhibitory and excitatory responses from the layer input and blends them into the activation map in a state-conditioned way. The mechanism is differentiable and architecture-agnostic, and its regulation is imposed rather than learned: the rule's parameters are fixed and are not optimised, while the rule's values and derivatives shape training throughout the network. Wired into fully connected, convolutional, wide-residual and graph convolutional networks, it gives rise to several properties. Activation maps become coherent across space, depth and seeds, with coarse structure persisting through depth while fine detail is renewed at every layer. The co-activation graph of the hidden units departs from an Erdős--Rényi random graph: it is laid out on the image and its giant component grows in steps, as in a spatial graph. Networks started from nearly identical initialisations, under label noise, disagree on thirty times fewer test images. Saliency maps rest on the object rather than the background, and resilience to pixel noise not seen in training is substantially improved.

</details>


### [487] [Universal Approximation by Equivariant Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks with a Bilinear Readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10772)
*Pingbing Ming,Han Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 证明了双线性读出等变消息传递网络(BREMP)的普适逼近性，并推广到实际使用的DPA4架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等变图神经网络原子间势虽被广泛使用，但缺乏理论上的普适逼近保证，尤其在物理范围内能量逼近的充分性不明确。

Method: 构造单层等变特征，使其在同类原子置换意义下确定局部环境；球谐滤波阶数不超过距中心同距离邻居数的最大值。迭代该构造可恢复多层跳数内的环境，读出层对任何连续不变量做一致逼近；通过假设消息传递在共同层数内到达所有邻居完成能量普适逼近。DPA4通过逼近所构造的BREMP层并实现双线性读出继承结论。

Result: 在给定物理范围内，用较短层截断实现对原子能量的普适逼近；所需滤波阶数由邻居数上界控制。

Conclusion: 为等变GNN原子间势提供了严格逼近理论依据，并表明生产架构DPA4具备该普适性。

Abstract: We prove universal approximation for the bilinear-readout equivariant message-passing network (BREMP), a reference architecture for equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials. Its layers combine equivariant convolutions with affine maps, and its readout forms invariants from products of the equivariant features. We construct a one-layer feature that determines the local environment up to permutations of atoms of the same type. The construction uses spherical harmonic filters of degree no larger than the largest number of neighbors at a common distance from the center. Iterating the construction recovers the environment reachable in as many hops as there are layers, using the same bound on filter degrees at the layer cutoff. The readout approximates every continuous invariant function of the features uniformly on compact sets. Together these give universal approximation of atomic energies at a prescribed physical range using a shorter layer cutoff. We assume that, throughout the admissible class, message passing reaches all neighbors in each physical environment within a common number of layers. Finally, DPA4, an interatomic potential architecture in production use, inherits this result by approximating the BREMP layers constructed in the proof and realizing the bilinear readout.

</details>


### [488] [EEGFaceSem: An EEG Benchmark with Paired Generative Latents for Semantic Visual Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10781)
*Jun Ma,Michiel M. Spapé,Keith M. Davis,Tuukka Ruotsalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EEGFaceSem 大规模数据集，将高质量 EEG 与生成模型合成的真实感人脸图像配对，并公开每张刺激的生成潜向量，支持潜空间与神经表征的连续映射研究，同时提供单试次语义分类基准及脑监督图像编辑/生成两类应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究视觉语义神经响应受限于固定图像集合，缺乏细粒度控制，难以隔离视觉特征细粒度变化及其与感知的关系，因此需要可控、可参数化的刺激数据集。

Method: 构建 EEGFaceSem：用生成模型合成真实感人脸刺激并提供每张图像的生成潜向量；采用快速序列视觉呈现（RSVP）范式，让被试注意特定语义特征（如微笑、发色）；采集 30 名被试共 67,200 条时间锁定 EEG；设计单试次语义分类基准（单被试、跨被试、被试自适应）以及跨被试投票聚合方案；并开展脑监督图像编辑（潜空间语义方向）与脑解码标签条件化生成两项应用。

Result: 提供 30 名被试、67,200 条时间锁定 EEG 记录的大规模数据集；给出单试次语义分类在单被试/跨被试/被试自适应及跨被试投票设置下的基准结果；展示了脑监督图像编辑与脑监督图像生成两类应用的可行性。

Conclusion: EEGFaceSem 通过可控生成刺激与潜向量标注，打通视觉潜空间与 EEG 神经表征的映射，为语义级视觉显著性检测的 BCI 及脑监督生成建模提供开放基准，数据与代码已在 OSF 与 HuggingFace 公开。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used to measure brain activity for brain-computer interface applications for its non-invasive nature and high temporal resolution. However, progress in modeling the neural responses to visual semantics has been limited by a reliance on fixed image collections that lack the fine-grained control needed to isolate fine-grained changes in visual features and their relation to perception. In this work, we present EEGFaceSem, a large-scale dataset pairing high-quality EEG with photorealistic face images synthesized from a generative model. We provide the generative latent vector for each stimulus, enabling research into the continuous mapping between a visual latent space and neural representations. Each participant's brain responses were recorded while they attended to specific semantic features (e.g., smiling, hair color) in a rapid serial visual presentation paradigm. The dataset contains EEG signals from 30 participants, totaling 67,200 time-locked EEG recordings. We present benchmarks for single-trial semantic classification under single-subject, cross-subject, and subject-adapted settings, as well as for cross-subject voting that aggregates per-stimulus predictions across participants. We further demonstrate the dataset's unique utility with two complementary applications: deriving semantic directions in the latent space for brain-supervised image editing, and conditioning a generative model on brain-decoded labels for brain-supervised image generation. Our dataset paves the way for advancing brain-computer interfaces (BCI) for semantic-level visual saliency detection and brain-supervised generative modeling. Our dataset and code are openly released at OSF (https://osf.io/2guk3/) and at HuggingFace https://huggingface.co/datasets/yefllower/EEGFaceSem.

</details>


### [489] [Proximal Preference Optimization: A Unified Framework for Stable and Reward-Free Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10785)
*Qisai Liu,Zhanhong Jiang,Zahid Hasan,Soumik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出近端偏好优化框架，统一DPO的隐式奖励与PPO的信赖域稳定性，衍生P²O与PKTO两个算法，兼顾对齐质量、稳定性与理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO虽无需奖励模型但缺乏信赖域约束，多轮数据集复用时易不稳定；PPO虽稳定但依赖奖励模型。作者希望兼得二者优点。

Method: 在DPO偏好间隔中直接引入裁剪的重要性比，得到无奖励模型的P²O；PKTO进一步用KTO的前景理论效用间隔替换DPO间隔，并加入随策略漂移自适应收紧的基线与非对称加权。提供KL信赖域界、策略改进下界与多轮近端更新收敛性的统一理论分析。

Result: 在三个偏好基准、多个LLM上，P²O与PKTO的对齐质量匹配或超过DPO与KTO，且在重复数据集复用时稳定性更好。

Conclusion: 该框架有效统一了两类方法，兼顾理论保障与工程稳定性，代码已开源。

Abstract: We introduce a proximal preference optimization framework that unifies the implicit reward formulation of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with the trust-region stability of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Our framework yields two complementary algorithms. P$^2$O (Proximal Preference Optimization) introduces a clipped importance ratio directly into the DPO preference margin, producing a reward-model-free algorithm that supports safe dataset reuse, bounded policy divergence, and monotonic preference improvement guarantees. PKTO (Proximal Kahneman-Tversky Optimization) extends P$^2$O by replacing the DPO margin with KTO's prospect-theoretic utility margins, adding a self-regulating adaptive baseline that tightens the effective trust region as the policy drifts, and an asymmetric weighting that handles imbalanced or asymmetric preference datasets. We provide a unified theoretical analysis, including Kullback Leibler (KL) trust-region bounds, a policy-improvement lower bound, and convergence guarantees under multi-epoch proximal updates. Empirically, P$^2$O and PKTO match or exceed DPO and KTO in alignment quality while maintaining better stability under repeated dataset reuse across multiple LLMs on three preference benchmarks. The code base is available here.

</details>


### [490] [Generating Diverse and Verified Synthetic Clinical Notes with Labels by Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10789)
*Matthias Lehmann,Madeleine Werthebach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPARCLING，一个基于LLM的流水线，用于生成带字符级PHI标注的合成德语出院小结，作为去标识化模型的评测基准与训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床隐私法规严格，需去标识化才能使用临床数据（如NLP）。但缺少高质量基准来判断哪些去标识化模型真正适用，需要既具挑战性、多样性、临床合理性，又保证标签正确的基准。

Method: SPARCLING流水线结合结构化属性采样、模板生成与红队测试（red teaming），生成多样化的PHI标注出院小结，并提供字符级精确（character-exact）的PHI片段标注。

Result: 实验显示生成数据内容多样性优于现有公开数据集；作为基准可揭示德语临床领域去标识化器的失败模式；在合成数据上训练可得到比仅用稀缺公开数据更强的去标识化器。

Conclusion: SPARCLING可同时作为多样且标签可靠的合成基准与训练资源，提升德语临床去标识化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Under strict privacy regulations in the clinical domain, de-identification is necessary to enable the use of clinical data such as for natural language processing. However, we currently lack sophisticated ways to tell which de-identification models actually are suitable. Specifically, we need benchmarks that are challenging, diverse, and clinically plausible, all while ensuring label correctness. To this end, we present SPARCLING, an LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic discharge letters with character-exact PHI span annotations. Our pipeline combines structured attribute sampling, template generation, and red teaming to obtain diverse PHI-labeled discharge letters. In our experiments, we demonstrate this superior content diversity over existing public datasets. Further, we show SPARCLING's downstream utility as a benchmark to uncover failure modes of de-identifiers in the German clinical domain. Finally, our experiments show that training on our synthetic data can yield more capable de-identifiers than training on the scarce public data alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator.

</details>


### [491] [Zeroth-Order Riemannian Optimization on Fixed-Rank Manifolds for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10792)
*Xinjue Wang,Xiuheng Wang,Yejun Zhang,Sergiy A. Vorobyov,Esa Ollila*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出固定秩矩阵流形约束的零阶优化方法（ZO-RGD/ZO-RGD-S），用于大模型内存高效微调，性能与强前向基线竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩零阶方法要么用欧氏因子参数化导致表示不唯一，要么限制每个有限差分方向为低秩，均不够理想。

Method: 冻结预训练权重，将每步加性更新约束在固定秩矩阵流形上；构造黎曼零阶梯度估计器（随机矩阵投影到切空间并归一化以修正尺度偏差），提出ZO-RGD及其平滑变体ZO-RGD-S。

Result: 理论上证明环境有限差分与回缩对应一致、归一化估计器期望上恢复黎曼梯度、ZO-RGD在轨迹正则条件下收敛；实验在多种模型族和任务上与大模型微调强前向基线相当，部分设置更优。

Conclusion: 矩阵流形上的固定秩约束为零阶微调提供了表示唯一、全程秩受限的几何框架，兼具理论与实用竞争力。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization estimates descent directions from function values alone, which removes the activation storage required by backpropagation and makes it attractive for memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). Existing low-rank ZO methods either parameterize the additive update through Euclidean factors with a non-unique representation, or restrict each finite-difference direction to be low-rank. In this work, we propose to constrain each additive update block to a fixed-rank matrix manifold while keeping the pretrained weights frozen, so the learned update remains rank-constrained throughout fine-tuning. On this geometry, we build a Riemannian ZO gradient estimator that projects a random matrix onto the tangent space, normalizes it to correct the scale mismatch induced by projection, and further propose Zeroth-order Riemannian Gradient Descent (ZO-RGD) and its smoothed variant, ZO-RGD-S. We show that the ambient finite difference matches its retracted counterpart, the normalized estimator recovers the Riemannian gradient in expectation, and ZO-RGD converges under trajectory-regularity conditions. Experiments on LLM fine-tuning tasks show that the proposed algorithms are competitive with strong forward-only baselines across model families and tasks, with gains in several settings.

</details>


### [492] [Learning When to Think: Adaptive Internal Computation for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10822)
*Rohit Kumar Salla,Simon Stepputtis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出自适应内部计算（AIC）：一个迭代式神经网络策略，能学习在何时停止对潜在表示的细化并作出决策，从而按状态分配计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代式神经策略在每个决策上花费相同计算量，但额外处理带来的收益因状态而异，固定深度既浪费又次优。

Method: 联合训练动作选择与停止决策；用期望深度惩罚约束计算量，并以中间价值预测作为辅助监督；同时分析了理想状态下状态相关分配器相对于任何同期望深度下的状态无关停止计划的优势。

Result: 在12个基准任务上，每决策最多8步细化时AIC平均执行3.3步；在4个控制与机器人任务上相较固定8步策略降低31–44%延迟。平均奖励在7个任务上超过最佳固定深度策略，4个上略低。消融显示PickCube与AntMaze上奖励提升主要来自自适应停止，RareEvent上主要来自价值监督。

Conclusion: 状态相关的自适应计算分配优于固定深度策略，能在保持或提升奖励的同时显著降低计算开销与延迟；停止机制与辅助价值监督的贡献因任务而异。

Abstract: Iterative neural policies usually spend the same computation on every decision, although the benefit of additional processing varies across states. We introduce Adaptive Internal Computation (AIC), an iterative policy that learns when to stop refining its latent representation and act. In AIC, we train action selection and stopping jointly, an expected-depth penalty values computation and intermediate value predictions provide auxiliary supervision. We show that when only some states benefit from further refinement, an ideal state-dependent allocator outperforms every state-independent stopping schedule at the same expected depth. With at most eight refinement steps per decision, AIC executes 3.3 steps on average across twelve benchmark tasks and lowers per-decision latency by 31--44% relative to a fixed eight-step policy on four control and robotics tasks. Its mean reward exceeds the best fixed-depth policy on seven tasks and trails it on four. Ablating adaptive stopping and value supervision separately shows that stopping accounts for most of the reward gain on PickCube and AntMaze, where it also executes more refinement steps and that supervision accounts for most of it on RareEvent.

</details>


### [493] [Learning Biological Hierarchies in Single-Cell Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10838)
*Xiangyu Guo,Ricardo Henao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: scOntoFM是一个将细胞本体层级结构嵌入表征学习的生物信息学基础模型，利用LCA距离进行离线三元组采样与层级学习，在多项基准上持续提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型大多忽略细胞本体中编码的细胞类型谱系关系。

Method: 将层级细胞本体嵌入表征学习；基于本体图的LCA距离，结合高效离线三元组采样与层级细胞本体学习。

Result: 在多种细胞级和基因级基准上性能持续提升，零样本场景增益尤为显著；兼顾批次整合与生物结构保持。

Conclusion: 该方法既保留局部邻域又塑造反映本体结构的全局嵌入几何，为现有嵌入评估框架提供互补视角，支撑可扩展的生物学发现。

Abstract: Cell types are organized by taxonomic relationships that define lineages in the so-called cell ontology. However, most existing foundation models typically ignore cell-type lineages encoded in this cell ontology. We introduce a biologically informed foundation model called scOntoFM, which embeds hierarchical cell ontology into representation learning. Using Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) distances from the ontology graph, our framework pairs efficient offline triplet sampling with hierarchical cell-ontology learning. This approach jointly preserves local neighborhoods and shapes the global embedding geometry to reflect the ontology structure. Across diverse cell- and gene-level benchmarks, the model consistently improves performance, with especially strong gains in zero-shot settings. Our model also balances batch integration with biological structure preservation, providing complementary perspectives to existing embedding evaluation frameworks and supporting scalable biological discovery.

</details>


### [494] [Representing Tensors as Compositions for Efficient Computation on Sparse and Structured Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10855)
*Valérian Rey,Praneth Paruchuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种将张量及其操作统一表示函数复合的数学形式化，用作张量计算引擎的中间表示，从而简化代码结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代张量框架中，针对每种张量类型（稠密、稀疏、不规则等）与每种二元操作的组合都需单独定义，导致代码复杂度随张量类型数量呈平方级增长，难以维护和扩展。

Method: 将张量视为"从索引到值的函数"。逐元素操作实现为值域函数复合；重索引（reshape、转置）实现为索引域函数复合；归约实现为索引映射函数与归约算子（sum/product/max）的复合；再结合张量堆叠，可表示稠密、锯齿、各类稀疏模式、矩阵分解等，以及现代框架中几乎所有操作的惰性版本（含任意类型张量的einsum）。利用复合间的恒等式可在不求值的情况下重写表达式。

Result: 可仅通过重写将稀疏矩阵乘转化为只计算非零值之间的乘积，即把稀疏问题转为稠密问题；代码复杂度从 O(mn²)（m 为张量间二元操作数，n 为张量类型数）降至 O(m + k²)（k 为索引函数类型数）。

Conclusion: 该代数的核心思想是把研究重点从"张量上的操作"转移到"索引函数上的代数"，并已提供基于此代数的张量计算框架草稿实现。

Abstract: We propose a new mathematical formalism in which all kinds of tensors and of operations on those tensors are represented as simple function compositions. Tensors are functions from indices to values. An element-wise operation (e.g. an activation function) is a composition with a function applied to values; re-indexing (e.g. reshape, transposition) is a composition with a function applied to indices; and a reduction is a composition with both an index function, mapping each index to several indices, and a reduction operation (e.g. product, sum, max). Combined with tensor stacking, these compositions can represent most interesting kinds of tensors (e.g. dense, jagged, all kinds of sparsity patterns, matrix factorizations), as well as lazy versions of almost every operation available in modern tensor computation frameworks, including einsums between tensors of any kind. Identities between compositions can then be used to rewrite such expressions into equivalent ones, without evaluating them. For instance, the product of two sparse matrices can be rewritten so that only products between non-zero values are computed, turning a sparse problem into a dense one. Using this algebra as the intermediate representation of a tensor computation engine would shift the focus from defining operations on tensors (e.g. einsum between sparse tensors) to defining an algebra on index functions. This should reduce the codebase complexity from $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$, with $m$ the number of binary operations between tensors and $n$ the number of tensor types, to $\mathcal{O}(m + k^2)$, with $k$ the number of types of index functions. A draft implementation of a tensor computation framework based on this algebra is publicly available.

</details>


### [495] [Self-contained Data Cleaning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10856)
*Jordan F. Masakuna,Ahmed Yacine,Djeff K. Nkashama,Arian Soltani,Marc Frappier,Pierre M. Tardif,Froduald Kabanza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自包含的预处理框架，在早期训练阶段利用自编码器的余弦相似性动态分析识别并"硬清洗"训练集中的污染样本，无需已知污染比例，可跨模型通用地提升异常检测性能。


<details>
