TL;DR: 提出用稀疏自编码器(SAE)将地球观测基础模型的稠密嵌入分解为稀疏、近单义特征，并设计针对卫星像素的评估协议，验证SAE在重建、概念对齐与空间尺度上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测基础模型产生的全球米级嵌入不透明：每个维度纠缠多个无关物理概念，难以解释且难以评估鲁棒性。而LLM式的解释评判与空间自相关使通用评估方法不适用。

Method: 采用稀疏自编码器在过完备字典上分解AlphaEarth和Tessera嵌入；提出定制评估协议，从三方面评分：匹配稀疏度下的重建、与参考概念的对齐、空间尺度，并与包括"冻结随机字典解码器SAE"在内的基线对比；另在两个应用（土地覆盖子概念发现、基于适用域估计的OOD像素检测）上测试稀疏编码。

Result: 匹配稀疏度下SAE重建优于所有基线；特征更单义（AlphaEarth上88%特征至多对齐20个概念组中的1个，多数不对齐任何组，而原始维度中位数为12）；更多方差集中在细尺度（BatchTopK与Matryoshka在640m内占23–32%，对照9%）。随机解码器SAE也具备前两性质，说明源于稀疏性；但只有学习字典能准确重建（AlphaEarth上未解释方差少8倍）。

Conclusion: 结果表明稀疏特征在地球观测模型可解释性上有潜力，两个应用展示其用途，但尚不足以实用，是迈向可检视特征的地球观测模型的一步。

Abstract: Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

</details>


### [567] [Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11423)
*Zhijie Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究有限时域MDP中的离线策略优化，在确定性马尔可夫策略的Q函数（由已知特征线性表示、系数范数≤B）可实现假设下，给出样本量$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$、计算复杂度关于$\log(2+B)$多项式的算法，并证明精度指数2是必要的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习中，线性可实现假设下的策略优化通常面临样本效率与计算复杂度（尤其对B的多项式/对数依赖）的权衡。作者希望在仅需确定性策略上的可实现性和覆盖率条件下，实现无探索、无模拟器的离线最优策略学习，同时避免对B的多项式计算开销，并厘清精度指数的最优性。

Method: 1）数据来自单一未知马尔可夫行为策略的独立完整轨迹，配合全策略占用覆盖率；2）算法每层仅做一次凸回归；停时回报目标取自单一一致的马尔可夫见证策略；3）用共享参考设计和有界预测约束，将快速裁剪回归误差转化为原始线性预测的逐点置信度；4）用截断杠杆控制性能损失，避免在尺度$B^{-2}$上做经验协方差近似；5）置信半径向上取整以保持见证策略精确性，并给出有理数输入下的多项式时间位级实现。另提出协方差覆盖变体，具有一致近似可实现性和对B的多项式依赖。

Result: 样本复杂度为$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$，计算复杂度关于$\log(2+B)$多项式；每层一次凸回归；保证对任意固定初始状态分布成立，且可实现性与覆盖仅需对确定性策略检查。协方差覆盖变体给出一致近似可实现保证，且对B呈多项式依赖。两动作下界表明精度指数2不可改进。

Conclusion: 论文为线性可实现离线有限时域MDP提供了一个样本近最优、计算对B近对数依赖的策略优化算法，通过截断杠杆与共享设计技术处理无界系数范数问题，并在较弱的可实现性/覆盖条件下成立，同时用下界确认了$\varepsilon^{-2}$的非可改进性。

Abstract: We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most $B$. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in $\log(2+B)$. The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale $B^{-2}$. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on $B$. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent $2$ is necessary.

</details>


### [568] [CHANNELS4WORLD: An Environment-Scale Dataset for Wireless Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11428)
*Joonkyu Jang,Hyung-Joo Moon,Kwang Soon Kim,Seong-Lyun Kim,Jakob Hoydis,Robert W. Heath,,Chan-Byoung Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Channels4World：10万个室外RF场景的场景中心数据集与程序化生成方法，用于无线基础模型预训练与泛化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线基础模型需要环境广度，但现有无线数据集往往只覆盖少数站点且采样密集，环境多样性不足。

Method: 为每个场景关联生成环境与RF材质、32个基站位置、16384个UE位置，以及3.5/7 GHz对齐的变长多径与有序交互记录；发布多尺度预定义子集、组件分离访问，并按场景做确定性90K/10K划分（两频段与各组件同组）。

Result: 语料含52.43B BS-UE对、104.86B频段评估、29.14 TB打包数据；受控分析显示衍射显著影响保留链路可用性与多径结构，保留策略在聚合功率几乎无损下大幅降存储；同等训练曝光下，更广场景集合的模型在留出场景上表现更好，但等回合对照表明仅靠场景数量不能解释该增益。

Conclusion: 通过显式、可控地刻画环境广度，Channels4World支持跨部署环境泛化的无线基础模型开发与评测。

Abstract: Wireless foundation models learn reusable representations across tasks, configurations, and deployment environments. Their pretraining requires environmental breadth, yet wireless datasets often sample few sites densely. We introduce Channels4World, a scene-centered dataset of 100,000 distinct outdoor RF scenes and a procedural method for generating them. Each scene links a generated environment and RF material assignments to 32 base-station (BS) positions, 16,384 UE positions, and aligned variable-length multipath and ordered interaction records at 3.5 and 7~GHz. The corpus comprises 52.43 billion physical BS-UE pairs, 104.86 billion frequency-specific evaluations, and a 29.14-TB packaged payload. Scene identity aligns geometry, placements, channels, and interactions across frequencies, allowing environmental breadth and within-scene observation density to vary independently. The public release offers predefined subsets at multiple scales and separate access to corpus components. A deterministic 90K/10K scene-level train-test split keeps both frequencies and all scene components together. We characterize morphology, RF materials, and transceiver placement across three generation profiles. Controlled propagation and path-retention analyses show that diffraction materially affects retained-link availability and multipath structure, while the retention policy reduces storage substantially with little loss in represented aggregate power. Under matched training exposure, models trained on broader scene collections perform better on held-out scenes, although an equal-episode control shows that scene count alone cannot explain the gain. By making environmental breadth explicit and controllable, Channels4World supports the development and evaluation of wireless foundation models for generalization across deployment environments.

</details>


### [569] [Learning to Rank Propagators in Constraint Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11447)
*Matija Lojović,Mladen Nikolić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出从静态问题特征学习依赖实例的传播器优先级，将任务建模为排序学习问题，用自注意力模型结合Plackett-Luce排序目标与基于运行时差别的成对偏好训练，并将预测排名映射为Choco求解器的离散优先级；在698个困难XCSP3实例上，求解数从634提升到654，中位运行时间降低27.93%，PAR1降低12.65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传播器执行顺序对约束规划求解器性能影响显著，但现有优先级多由固定的手工启发式确定，无法适应不同实例；同时单个传播器的理想优先级不可直接观测，只能通过求解运行时间间接衡量，因此需要一种能从实例特征学习优先级的自动化方法。

Method: 方法是监督式的排序学习：从实例的静态特征出发，用自注意力模型对实例中所有传播器联合打分；训练信号来自在随机优先级分配下测得的求解运行时间所导出的成对偏好，并以Plackett-Luce排序目标进行优化；预测排名在搜索开始前被映射为Choco求解器的离散优先级等级，不修改其传播或搜索过程；此外还提出在学到的优先级与默认优先级之间选择的简单策略。

Result: 在XCSP3实例上实验表明传播器排序对求解时间影响显著。按问题类别挑出的698个最困难测试实例上，相比Choco默认优先级，学习优先级使求解实例数从634增至654，中位运行时间降低27.93%，PAR1降低12.65%；改进幅度因问题类别而异，且简单的优先级选择策略可进一步提升求解实例数。

Conclusion: 学习依赖实例的传播器优先级能有效提升约束规划性能，尤其在困难实例上收益明显，说明数据驱动方法可作为手工优先级启发式的补充。

Abstract: The order in which propagators are executed can substantially affect the performance of constraint programming solvers, yet propagator priorities are typically determined by fixed, manually designed heuristics. In this work, we explore learning instance-dependent propagator priorities from static problem features. We formulate the task as a learning-to-rank problem, addressing the challenge that the quality of a priority assignment can be measured through solver runtime, while the desired priorities of individual propagators are not directly observable. A self-attention-based model jointly scores the propagators present in an instance and is trained using pairwise preferences derived from solver runtimes measured under randomized propagator priority assignments, with a Plackett-Luce-based ranking objective. Predicted rankings are mapped to the discrete priority levels of the Choco solver before search begins, without modifying its propagation or search procedures. We evaluate the approach on XCSP3 instances and demonstrate that propagator ordering can have a substantial impact on solving time. On a test set of 698 instances, picked out as most difficult by problem class, the learned priorities increase the number of solved instances from 634 to 654, reduce median solver runtime by 27.93%, and reduce aggregate penalized runtime (PAR1) by 12.65% compared with Choco's default priorities. We further observe that improvements vary across problem classes and show that a simple policy selecting between learned and default priorities further increases the number of solved instances. These results demonstrate the potential of learning instance-dependent propagator priorities to improve constraint programming performance, particularly on difficult instances.

</details>


### [570] [When Answer Decodability Is Not a Decision: Separating Final-Answer and Imminent-Emission Signals in Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11892)
*Hyojung Han,Jongmin Kim,Seung-Hun Jeon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出发射控制双目标探针（ECDP），论证答句探针的高解码率反映的是“即将提及的候选”而非“已定决策”，答案可解码性是目标相对且依赖协议的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往把对思维链隐状态的答案探针读作“模型已决定最终回复”的证据，忽略了竞争信号：模型即将提及的候选。需区分“即将输出文本”与“已定决策”两类证据。

Method: ECDP：在同一位置分别用同一低秩读取器族拟合“即将提及项”和“最终答案”，并预先固定目标特定的零分布与阈值。在DecisionDepth（DD）rollout上测试；另在Qwen3-8B（开启thinking、留出MMLU题）上用全前缀注意力读取器覆盖所有thinking位置。设有植入信号对照。

Result: DD正确rollout（干扰项先于答案被提及）：Qwen3.5-4B对下一提及解码.966（零分布.234），最终答案仅.221（零分布.186），发射差距.696 [.648,.744]；Llama-3.1-8B为.575 [.514,.632]。但Qwen3-8B/MMLU上两目标均可解码且最终答案更强：mention-minus-answer在层22为−.398 [−.459,−.336]（467题）。匹配比较因即将提及探针无法可靠训练而未获有效统计，故未确定序反转原因。植入对照显示读取器可在十分之一剂量下恢复注入答案信号。

Conclusion: 答案候选可解码性是目标相对、协议依赖的：强答案读取本身不能证明模型何时做出承诺；探针训练失败也不代表信息缺失。ECDP可实用地区分即将发射的文本与已定决策证据。

Abstract: Answer probes applied to chain-of-thought hidden states are often read as evidence that a language model has already decided its final response. This reading overlooks a competing signal, the candidate the model is about to mention. We introduce emission-controlled dual-target probing (ECDP), which fits the same low-rank reader family separately to the imminent mention and to the final answer at identical positions, with target-specific nulls and thresholds fixed before any fit. On correct DecisionDepth (DD) rollouts in which a distractor is mentioned before the final answer, Qwen3.5-4B decodes the next mention at .966 (null .234) but the final answer only at .221 (null .186), an emission gap of .696 [.648, .744]; Llama-3.1-8B gives .575 [.514, .632]. This pattern is not universal. In a pre-specified evaluation of Qwen3-8B with thinking enabled on held-out MMLU questions, using a full-prefix attention reader over every thinking position, both targets are decodable and the final answer is read far more strongly (mention-minus-answer lift -.398 [-.459, -.336] at layer 22 over 467 questions). Model, task, positions, and reader change together between these settings, and an attempted matched comparison on DD produced no valid statistics because the imminent-mention probe did not train reliably, so we do not identify what reverses the order. On DD, planted-signal controls show that the reader recovers an injected final-answer signal at one tenth of full dose. Answer-candidate decodability is therefore target-relative and protocol-dependent: a strong answer readout does not by itself establish when a model commits, and a probe that fails to train is not evidence that the information is absent. ECDP is a practical control for distinguishing imminent text emission from evidence of a settled decision.

</details>


### [571] [How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11450)
*Cong Yu,Ziting Wang,Songlin Jiang,Sitong Zhang,Chengliang Chai,Youhe Jiang,Eiko Yoneki,Tuo Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究on-policy蒸馏(OPD)对训练-推理失配的容忍度：OPD存在经验失配预算，量化、权重陈旧与噪声失配在预算内可保质量，超限则退化；据此提出轻量准入检查与FP8配方，实现1.93倍KV缓存容量、1.62倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD需在学生模型自身生成上训练，生成成本高，系统用量化推理与异步rollout降本，但这会引入rollout引擎与训练模型间的失配。失配已知会破坏RL稳定性，但其对OPD的影响尚不清楚。

Method: 将所有失配源统一到同一尺度上度量；在三对学生-教师模型对上考察量化影响，并在其中一对上补充测试权重陈旧与注入噪声；进行OPD与RL稳定性的受控对比；分析哪些层对降精度敏感；提出轻量准入检查，用校准预算筛选rollout配置而无需完整训练；并设计模型专属FP8配方。

Result: OPD可容忍大量失配而无明显质量损失，但高水平下退化，呈现经验失配预算；质量代价与量化引入的失配均依赖模型，部分层对降精度敏感；OPD在会破坏RL的rollout配置下仍稳定；权重噪声下失配会改变生成到达的前缀，产生逐token纠正无法解决的错误；FP8配方提供至少1.93倍BF16的KV缓存token容量，FP8+异步rollout比同步BF16早1.62倍达到同等质量。

Conclusion: 失配对OPD有可量化的容忍预算，系统可借准入检查与模型专属FP8配方在预算内大幅降本提速，且OPD比RL更耐受rollout失配。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

</details>


### [572] [Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11902)
*Sung Il Choi,Junhao Cai,Dohun Kim,Changhee Joo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 spectral unlearning，将卸载目标与矩阵结构优化结合，在 LLM 卸载中同时提升记忆消除、隐私与效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 卸载方法多聚焦于设计卸载目标，却忽略了 transformer 权重本身的内在矩阵结构；标准优化器在独立的标量坐标上更新，浪费了这种结构信息。

Method: 提出一种谱更新框架，把标准卸载目标与矩阵结构优化相结合。理论上证明：对于由线性层构成、输入输出已归一化的 transformer，该谱更新对应最速下降方向。该方法可叠加在现有卸载方法之上。

Result: 在记忆化、隐私、效用三条互补轴上评估，并以调和平均汇总；光谱卸载持续优于大量基线，并缩小了与保留训练参考模型的大部分差距。

Conclusion: 权重矩阵结构应在卸载优化中被显式利用；谱卸载是一种通用、可插件化的改进，在保持效用的同时显著增强卸载与隐私效果。

Abstract: Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/.

</details>


### [573] [MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11457)
*Sunny Gupta,Raja Viswanadha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 MOMENT-DP 框架，研究优化器状态（如动量）是否会改变时间相关隐私噪声机制之间的相对效用排序，发现动量会引发机制排名反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间相关噪声能提升差分隐私优化的效用，但现有机制设计与评估只利用优化过程的部分信息（工作负载结构、学习率调度、局部曲率），忽略了持续存在的优化器状态是否提供额外、会影响机制选择的信息。

Method: 提出 MOMENT-DP，一个感知优化器状态的框架，用"优化器传递算子"刻画隐私噪声经动量式优化传播后的最终损失；该算子同时纳入曲率、学习率调度、动量和时间噪声协方差。对局部二次目标给出隐私导致最终损失的解析表达，并证明 NoiseCurve 的曲率感知二次准则恰为零动量、常数学习率的特例。

Result: 在固定曲率、调度、隐私校准和候选机制集合，仅改变动量即可引起真实的机制排名反转；该效应在逐样本裁剪的私有逻辑回归中同样存在；在研究的神经网络场景下尚不明确。

Conclusion: 优化器状态是被建模不足但决策相关的维度，评估时间相关隐私噪声机制时必须纳入考量。

Abstract: Temporally correlated noise can substantially improve the utility of differentially private optimization, yet candidate mechanisms are commonly designed or evaluated using only partial information about the optimization process, such as workload structure, learning-rate schedules, or local curvature. We study whether persistent optimizer state provides additional information that can change the relative utility of privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms.
  We introduce MOMENT-DP, an optimizer-state-aware framework that models how temporally correlated privacy noise propagates through momentum-based optimization. For locally quadratic objectives, MOMENT-DP expresses privacy-induced final loss through an optimizer transfer operator that jointly captures curvature, learning-rate scheduling, momentum, and temporal noise covariance. NoiseCurve's curvature-aware quadratic criterion is recovered exactly as the zero-momentum, constant-learning-rate special case.
  Changing only momentum while holding curvature, schedule, privacy calibration, and candidate mechanisms fixed induces genuine mechanism-ranking reversals. The effect persists outside exact quadratic dynamics in per-example-clipped private logistic regression, while remaining unresolved in the neural regime we study. These results establish optimizer state as an under-modeled, decision-relevant axis in evaluating temporally correlated privacy noise.

</details>


### [574] [One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11481)
*Shenghong Cai,Yiqun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出高效一次性（one-shot）层次联邦聚类框架，通过客户端到服务器的单向原型级通信完成分布探索与聚合，并用多粒度竞争学习机制补偿信息损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机构生物医学数据呈孤岛分布且本地分布粒度不一、存在嵌套结构；层次聚类虽适合探索此类拓扑，但递归过程计算开销巨大且易泄露隐私。

Method: 客户端本地一次性探索分布，仅向服务器单向传输原型（prototype）；服务器端进行分布聚合，并引入多粒度竞争学习机制融合小簇（clusterlets），在受限单向通信下最大化保留与挖掘全局拓扑。

Result: 可高效探索跨客户端复杂簇分布；在公开数据集上与现有SOTA方法对比，在稳健聚类、隐私保护与计算效率的平衡上表现更优。

Conclusion: 一次性原型通信在显著降低计算开销与隐私风险的同时，配合多粒度竞争学习可有效补偿信息损失，实现高效且隐私友好的层次联邦聚类。

Abstract: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [575] [Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11493)
*Lydia T. Liu,Kara Schechtman,Pengyi Shi,Angela Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将周期重训练的再入院风险预测器嵌入医院出院的排队MDP中，发现"capacity-aware"的discharge-up-to策略能自然多样化住院时长观测、消除删失偏差，学习误差比阈值策略降低24%-25%，再入院成本差异缩小38%-63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测算法被用于指导出院决策，但因历史数据不足或既往出院决策的选择效应，模型对弱势患者存在删失偏差；用有偏预测器决策会产生新的有偏训练数据，重训练后形成恶性循环。作者希望在不加显式公平约束的前提下打破这一循环。

Method: 扩展基于排队的出院马尔可夫决策过程，纳入周期性重训练的再入院风险预测器；理论分析重训练-决策闭环的收敛性，并用合成实验与合作医院患者级数据校准的仿真，对比阈值型风险策略与discharge-up-to策略。

Result: 在模型良设定下证明重复重训练下discharge-up-to策略收敛到无偏风险估计；实验中阈值策略可能持续有偏，而discharge-up-to策略使学习误差较现状策略降低24%-25%，并在校正基线风险差异后使再入院成本差异缩小38%-63%。

Conclusion: 容量感知的运营决策策略本身即可通过缓解删失偏差同时提升预测性能与公平性，说明算法公平问题可在运营决策层面而非仅靠约束或后处理来解决。

Abstract: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.

</details>


### [576] [Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12016)
*Shayan Talaei,Agam Bhatia,Arshia Soltani Moakhar,Jonas Hübotter,Amin Saberi,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD)，一种逐 token 混合策略的自蒸馏方法：学生默认生成 rollout，教师仅在下一 token 分布显著偏离处介入，从而在准确率、监督效率与抗遗忘之间取得更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中模型需内化预训练中缺失的知识、纳入更新的事实或学习新领域技能，自蒸馏是自然选择。但现有方法存在矛盾：off-policy（教师生成前缀）的 rollout 偏离学生测试时行为；fully on-policy rollout 又易漂移到低信号状态。

Method: SSD 为 per-token 混合策略的自蒸馏方法。默认由学生生成每个 rollout；教师（以源材料为条件）仅在学生下一 token 分布与其显著发散的位置介入。由此使训练 rollout 贴近学生测试时分布，同时避开全 on-policy 漂移的低信号状态，让教师在特权上下文真正改变预测处精确引导。

Result: 在三个封闭书 QA 基准（事实回忆、知识更新、技能获取）上，SSD 几乎媲美 on-policy 蒸馏，但监督 token 少用 38–69%，并在留出测试集上持续优于 off-policy 蒸馏。在遗忘压力测试中，SSD 保留最多通用能力，同时取得最佳域内准确率且监督开销低于 on-policy 基线。

Conclusion: SSD 建立了自蒸馏在准确率—效率—遗忘维度上的新帕累托前沿。

Abstract: Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised tokens and consistently outperforms off-policy distillation on the held-out test set. On a forgetting stress test, SSD retains the most general capability while also achieving the best in-domain accuracy and using less supervision than the on-policy baseline. Overall, SSD establishes a new accuracy-efficiency-forgetting Pareto frontier for self-distillation.

</details>


### [577] [Regret without Optimal-Arm Feedback under Reward-Dependent Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11494)
*Zhong Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究带有奖励相关延迟（可为无限）且回报不携带原始轮次信息的随机赌博机问题，提出平衡历史乐观（BHO）算法并给出匹配的下界与Minimax分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中（如共享服务器、异构反馈）延迟往往与奖励大小相关，且报告丢失轮次信息，导致经典的延迟分析与乐观策略不再适用，需要新的延迟项与探索机制。

Method: 对每个 c∈[0,1) 的 BHO 算法，其延迟项由最大的次优臂分位数（水平 1-cΔ_i）控制，无需最优臂反馈；并引入“待定触发平衡（pending-triggered balance）”机制维持加权截断界。

Result: 下界显示对数统计区间存在平方反比松弛代价，c=1 时线性 minimax 遗憾；当 K 增长时任何学习者的最坏遗憾为 Ω(G log K)，其中 G=max_i Δ_i h_i；在确定性奖励、唯一最优、固定有界延迟下达到历史贪婪的探索系数。

Conclusion: BHO 在奖励相关延迟与信息缺失下给出接近最优的界，实验揭示共享等待何时有益及平衡探索的代价。

Abstract: We study stochastic bandits with reward-dependent delays, possibly infinite, whose reports omit the originating round. For each $c\in[0,1)$, Balanced Historical Optimism (BHO) has a delay term controlled by the largest suboptimal-arm quantile at level $1-cΔ_i$, without requiring optimal-arm reports. Lower bounds give an inverse-square slack cost in the logarithmic statistical regime and linear minimax regret at $c=1$. A family with growing $K$ forces worst-case regret $Ω(G\log K)$ for every learner, where $G=\max_iΔ_i h_i$ is the largest gap-weighted suboptimal cutoff. Pending-triggered balance preserves BHO's weighted-cutoff bound for $c<1$ and attains the historical-greedy exploration coefficient with deterministic rewards, a unique optimum and fixed bounded delays. Gap-weighted comparisons and experiments show when shared waiting helps and what balanced exploration costs.

</details>


### [578] [Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12062)
*Povilas Kvedaras,Tomas Rasymas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向现代压缩/混合注意力架构的KV-cache翻译方法，使目标模型无需重读历史即可接管对话上下文，并在MLA、线性注意力与稀疏注意力对象上验证达到原生质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型接管他人对话通常需重读全部历史；文本交接通过丢内容来缩短重读。KV缓存翻译可让目标从完整上下文继续，但现有方法只适用于GQA，而前沿开源模型已改用MLA压缩潜变量、稀疏注意力索引键和线性注意力固定状态。

Method: 先在GQA模型对上复现KV-Lingo，再针对每类缓存对象给出捕获/注入位置与机制：MLA潜变量用逐token线性映射翻译；循环状态通过闭式校正复制或重放目标自身递归合成；精确长程回忆需token身份，从源模型第0层MLA潜变量解码token id。在16-48B规模的两对混合模型双向测试（Kimi-VL-A3B↔Kimi-Linear-48B、Qwen3.5-27B↔Qwen3.8-27B），外加稀疏注意力目标（Qwen3.8-27B→Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）。

Result: 解码token id将2-32K检索召回从0.09提至0.99，64K（训练长度8倍）达0.83-1.00。全MLA混合方向在各任务指标上处于原生质量的配对置信区间内；同形状GDN混合双向达原生水平（除6%继承自源的拒答）。64K时首token时间比重读快18.7与46.8倍。分段多轮迁移保持重预填充水平，朴素重翻译会崩溃。稀疏注意力目标上预测索引键的召回与目标自身键相当（单种子）。

Conclusion: KV缓存翻译可扩展到MLA、线性注意力和稀疏注意力缓存对象，实现接近原生的质量与极大延迟收益；对300B+混合旗舰模型的迁移以假设形式给出。

Abstract: A model that takes over another model's conversation must normally re-read the whole history; a text hand-off shortens the re-read only by dropping content. KV-cache translation instead maps the source's cache into the target's own format, so the target continues from the full context without re-reading it. It works for grouped-query attention (GQA), but open-weights frontier models now cache compressed latents (MLA), sparse-attention indexer keys and fixed-size linear-attention states. We replicate KV-Lingo on a GQA pair and then give, for each of these objects, where to capture and inject it and a mechanism that reaches native quality. We study two hybrid pairs at 16-48B scale in both directions, Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B (MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention) and Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B (Gated DeltaNet hybrids), plus a sparse-attention target (Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). MLA latents translate with token-wise linear maps; recurrent states are copied with a closed-form correction or synthesised by replaying the target's own recurrence. Exact long-range recall needs token identity: decoding token ids from the source's layer-0 MLA latent raises needle recall from 0.09 to 0.99 at 2-32K and to 0.83-1.00 at 64K, eight times the longest training prompt. The hybrid full-MLA direction is within the paired confidence interval of native quality on every task metric, and same-shape GDN hybrids reach the native level in both directions (apart from 6% refusals inherited from the source), with time to first token 18.7 and 46.8 times shorter than a re-read at 64K tokens. Segment-wise multi-turn transfer stays at the re-prefill level; naive re-translation collapses. On the sparse-attention target, predicted indexer keys recall the needle as well as the target's own keys (one seed). We state as a hypothesis how the recipes transfer to 300B+ hybrid flagships.

</details>


### [579] [JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11499)
*Xudong Wu,Guangchen Lan,Mingqi Yuan,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JoMoHa 首次用强化学习同时训练"可执行 harness 生成策略"与"任务执行策略"，实现模型与 harness 的协同进化，避免交替训练中的渐进失配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言 agent 的性能同时取决于模型权重和 harness，单独优化任一方都会受另一方制约。作者发现朴素交替训练会导致模型与 harness 逐渐不兼容，干扰任务执行并损害模型训练，造成性能下降。

Method: 提出 JoMoHa 框架，通过强化学习联合训练两个策略：一个负责生成可执行 harness，一个负责任务执行；二者协同演化，并从自身生成的轨迹中同时学习任务执行与运行时改进。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 DBBench 上优于 weight-only 与 harness-only 基线，取得最高成功率，平均 70.3%，ALFWorld 上达 97.0%；并展现出递归自我改进（RSI）能力。

Conclusion: 模型与 harness 的联合优化优于单一维度优化，JoMoHa 验证了协同演化的有效性，并开辟了通过自生成轨迹实现递归自我改进的路径。

Abstract: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

</details>


### [580] [Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11504)
*Chunwei Ma,Russell D Wolfinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MoE-Learner，用数据嵌入的变差函数(variogram)作为无需反事实的路由信号，在多种假设专属视图下选择最合适的因果专家，实现"从数据几何验证因果假设"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果推断存在训练目标(结果、倾向)与推断目标(CATE/ATE)的根本鸿沟；传统方法依赖先验假设与识别策略选择，而因果基础模型(CFM)的大规模摊销训练使隐含假设不透明。现实DGP/SCM高度多样，难以先验判断哪种因果估计策略与给定数据集兼容。

Method: 聚焦观测数据与方法特定假设之间的"兼容性"。发现数据嵌入的几何特征——变差函数(variogram)——能有效指示某因果估计策略是否适用。据此构建MoE-Learner：混合因果专家框架，将数据集在多个假设专属视图下嵌入，并用variogram作为无需反事实的路由器，评估各专家的有效性；把假设验证从先验固定选择转为可由数据几何直接检验的准则。

Result: 在IHDP、ACIC、Lalonde基准数据集上取得最佳平均排名。

Conclusion: 该方法不消除因果假设，而是将假设验证数据化；与(因果)基础模型正交，构建了从数据特征到因果估计策略的桥梁，而非又一个CFM。

Abstract: Due to the fundamental problem of causal inference -- the impossibility of observing counterfactual outcomes -- there is always a gap between the training goal (outcome, propensity) and the inference target (CATE, ATE). Traditional causal effect estimation revolves around setting assumptions, selecting identification strategies, and choosing causal estimators, while more recently, Causal Foundation Models (CFMs), built on Prior-Data-Fitted Networks (PFNs), ease this process by pretraining on massive synthetic prior datasets. Despite their success, such amortization makes causal inference less transparent, obscuring which assumptions the model implicitly relies on for a given dataset. The high diversity of real-world data-generating processes (DGPs) and Structural Causal Models (SCMs) makes it hard to know, a priori, which causal inference strategy is compatible with a given dataset. In this work, we focus on this compatibility between an observational dataset and method-specific assumptions, and find that geometric characteristics of data embeddings -- specifically, the variogram -- provide a useful signal of whether a given causal estimation strategy is appropriate. We develop MoE-Learner, a mixture-of-causal-experts framework that embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram as a counterfactual-free router to assess each expert's validity. Rather than eliminating causal assumptions, this shifts their validation from a fixed, a priori choice to a criterion that can be checked directly from data geometry. MoE-Learner achieves the best average rank on benchmark datasets (IHDP, ACIC, Lalonde). Being orthogonal to (causal) foundation models, our method builds a bridge from data characteristics to causal estimation strategy rather than proposing another CFM.

</details>


### [581] [ConvLUT: Rethinking Convolutional Architectures for Ultra-Low-Latency LUT-Based Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11507)
*Marta Andronic,Olivia Weng,Danial Zuberi,Ryan Kastner,George A. Constantinides*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ConvLUT 将查表（LUT）神经网络从 MLP 拓扑扩展到卷积网络，用于在 FPGA 上实现纳秒级推理，覆盖 CIFAR-10、VWW、KWS 三个 MLPerf Tiny 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LUT 型神经网络可实现超低延迟 FPGA 推理，但此前工作大多局限于 MLP 结构，缺少对结构化视觉与音频任务（卷积网络）的探索，且面临感受野维度瓶颈、池化层不适用等问题。

Method: 提出两类全展开、可映射为 LUT 的卷积架构：基于分层 LUT 树的标准卷积模型与 MobileNet 式深度可分离模型；四项关键技术为：(1) 统一 LUT 卷积框架，支持标准/深度/逐点卷积并显式约束 fan-in；(2) LUT 树缓解 k²c 感受野维度瓶颈；(3) 通道分区的 LUT 池化层替代空间池化；(4) 硬件感知的迭代剪枝策略保证大规模稳定收敛。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10、Visual Wake Words 和 Keyword Spotting 上取得有竞争力的精度，全展开推理延迟低于约 50 ns；CIFAR-10 上相比非逻辑型实现至少降低 8844× 延迟，并比同任务现有 MLP 式 LUT 模型精度高至少 20 个百分点。

Conclusion: ConvLUT 表明 LUT 映射卷积网络可兼顾精度与纳秒级延迟，为结构化视觉/音频任务的超低延迟 FPGA 推理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Lookup-table (LUT)-based neural networks (NNs) offer a compelling path to ultra-low-latency inference on FPGAs. However, existing LUT-based neural networks have largely been restricted to MLP-style topologies, leaving structured vision and audio tasks underexplored. We present ConvLUT, a family of fully unrolled LUT-mappable convolutional architectures targeting the MLPerf Tiny benchmarks. It is comprised of a standard convolutional model built around a hierarchical tree of LUTs and a depthwise separable model following the MobileNet design philosophy. These architectures are enabled by four key contributions: a unified LUT-based convolutional framework supporting standard, depthwise, and pointwise convolutions under explicit fan-in constraints; a LUT-tree that addresses the $k^2c$ receptive field dimensionality bottleneck; a channel-partitioned LUT pooling layer that replaces conventional spatial pooling; and a hardware-aware iterative pruning strategy for stable convergence at scale. Evaluated on CIFAR-10, Visual Wake Words, and Keyword Spotting, ConvLUT achieves competitive accuracy with fully unrolled inference latencies below $\sim 50$ ns. On CIFAR-10 it reaches at least a $8844\times$ latency reduction over non-logic-based prior implementations, and outperforms existing MLP-style LUT-based models on the same task by at least $20$ pp in test accuracy.

</details>


### [582] [A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12206)
*Miguel P. Bento*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一个标量不变量 ρ，用于衡量 Transformer 各注意力头与旋转位置编码（RoPE）的耦合能力，从而无需前向计算即可分析机制可解释性，并发现 ρ 能预测归纳头。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 LLM 的机制可解释性分析通常依赖前向传播，成本高且依赖数据。作者希望建立一种数据无关、免前向的头部分析方法，利用注意力机制中的连续对称性来刻画位置信息处理能力。

Method: 作者从注意力的连续对称性出发推导出标量不变量 ρ，用以量化每个注意力头耦合 RoPE 的程度；该指标可离线计算，用于识别与位置相关的头（positional heads）。

Result: 在四个无偏置 RoPE 模型（135M 至 7B 参数）上，ρ 与归纳头的出现呈显著负相关（Spearman 相关系数 −0.55 至 −0.74）。作为初步验证，仅对 ρ 排名前 50% 的位置头应用 YaRN 上下文扩展，其困惑度退化小于均匀应用。

Conclusion: ρ 为数据无关的 LLM 分析开辟了新方向，可作为低成本预测归纳头及选择性位置干预的有效工具。

Abstract: Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $ρ$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $ρ$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $ρ$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant.

</details>


### [583] [Detecting Common Golfing Faults Using AI and Video-Derived Biomechanical Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11515)
*Oliver Martin,Jeff Clark,Nawid Keshtmand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需标记与标定的流水线，从普通视频中检测高尔夫挥拍错误动作（over-the-top 与 early-extension），基于身体中心坐标系中的姿态与杆头追踪，用浅层梯度提升树分类可解释的生物力学量，ROC-AUC 分别达 0.975 与 0.911。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室外的动作技术目前仍靠肉眼评估，缺乏客观、可解释且易获取的量化手段；端到端深度学习方法又难以追溯判断依据。

Method: 不采用端到端学习：先追踪人体姿态与杆头，统一到以身体为中心的坐标系，提取教练会测量的生物力学特征（如杆头相对挥杆平面的高度）在已知下挥阶段的值，再用浅层 boosted trees 进行分类。

Result: 在公开来源的 160 个与 143 个挥杆样本上，OTT 与 EE 的交叉验证 ROC-AUC 分别为 0.975 和 0.911；模型最依赖的信号与教练诊断时关注的信号一致；消费级笔记本上数秒内即可处理手机视频。

Conclusion: 该可解释、轻量的流水线可发展为面向各水平球手的 App，并可推广到其他以生物力学参考评判技术的运动项目。

Abstract: Understanding how an athlete moves can improve both technique and safety, yet outside the laboratory technique is still assessed by eye. We present a pipeline that detects named golf swing faults from ordinary video, without markers or calibration. Instead of learning end to end, it tracks body pose and the clubhead in a body-centered frame, and classifies the biomechanical quantities a coach would measure, such as the height of the clubhead above the swing plane, with shallow boosted trees. We demonstrate the approach on two common faults, coming over-the-top (OTT) and early-extension (EE). On 160 swings and 143 swings from public sources it detects OTT and EE with a cross-validated ROC-AUC of 0.975 and 0.911 respectively. Because every feature is a biomechanical quantity a coach already uses, measured at a known phase of the downswing, each decision can be traced to the signals and the moments of the swing that drove it. The signals the model relies on most are the same ones a coach checks when diagnosing these faults. The pipeline processes phone video on a consumer laptop in seconds, so it could feasibly be developed into an app for golfers of all abilities and extended to other sports in which technique is judged against a biomechanical reference.

</details>


### [584] [Hydra: Towards Transferable Multi-Task Learning on Temporal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11520)
*Kiarash Shamsi,Farimah Poursafaei,Tran Gia Bao Ngo,Reihaneh Rabbany,Baris Coskunuzer,Guillaume Rabusseau,Michael M. Bronstein,Shenyang Huang,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Hydra架构，融合时序GNN的局部连接特征与谱学习模块的全局连接模式，在时态图上实现多任务图属性预测，多任务分类AUC相对提升8.9%，回归MAE相对提升8.2%，训练时间减少22%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界演化网络可建模为时态图（TG），预测其未来属性对下游决策至关重要。但现有方法多为单任务预测，跨任务泛化与迁移到未见网络的能力未知，时态图多任务属性预测仍是开放难题。

Method: Hydra架构：将时序GNN提取的局部连接特征与谱学习模块捕获的全局连接模式相结合，在多任务目标下联合学习局部与全局信息。

Result: 多任务分类AUC相对最强基线提升8.9%；多任务回归三项任务均有竞争力，两项最优，MAE相对提升8.2%；相比时序迁移模型训练时间减少22%。

Conclusion: 首次系统证明时态图上的多任务可迁移学习有效，Hydra稳定取得最优表现，表明时态图多任务训练是通向可适应时态图基础模型的有前景方向。

Abstract: Real-world evolving networks are naturally modeled as temporal graphs (TGs), where capturing temporal dynamics is essential for predicting future graph properties that support downstream decision-making. Existing temporal graph methods have been developed primarily for single-task prediction, and little is known about their generalization across tasks or transfer to unseen networks. This leaves the challenge of multi-task graph property prediction in TGs largely open. We address this challenge by introducing Hydra, a novel architecture that integrates local connectivity features from temporal GNNs with a spectral learning module that captures global connectivity patterns. This design enables joint learning of local and global information under a multi-task objective. In multi-task classification, Hydra achieves an 8.9% relative gain in AUC over the strongest competitor. In multi-task regression, Hydra achieves competitive results in all three tasks, while obtaining the best results in two tasks with a 8.2% relative gain in MAE compared to the strongest baseline. Moreover, Hydra delivers these gains with a 22% reduction in training time compared to temporal transfer models. These results provide the first systematic evidence that multi-task transferable learning on temporal graphs is effective. By delivering consistent top-ranked performance, Hydra highlights multi-task training on temporal graphs as a promising direction toward adaptable foundation models for temporal graphs.

</details>


### [585] [Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11525)
*Siming Zhang,Zhehui Shen,Shijie Chen,Yansen Yu,Hang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"有效边界复杂度"作为冻结表征+线性探针下衡量标签预算的诊断指标,通过统计决策边界附近薄带内的样本质量并做类别平衡归一化,可缓存特征估计,并证明其一阶由边界法向拉伸/压缩决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迁移性/探针质量评分只刻画全局对齐、似然、间隔与校准,无法回答"表征看起来有用后还需多少标签才能学出下游边界"这一实际问题;边界附近的模糊区域正是稀缺标签代价最高的地方。

Method: 定义有效边界复杂度:度量学习边界周围薄带内的样本质量,并按类别平衡归一化(同时计入密集模糊区与预测类不平衡);在光滑表征映射下证明密度变化与切向表面变化在一阶相互抵消,只剩法向伸缩主导;由此给出缓存特征估计器——在一个划分上拟合探针,统计独立留出集中靠近边界的特征;并给出可微代理用于优化。

Result: 受控变换在74个映射上与预测规律吻合(中位相对误差0.38%);真实冻结特征上法向扰动同时改变边界质量和标签需求,切向对照保持一阶系数;可微代理在同等top-1效用下降低复杂度16-36%;CIFAR-100/Tiny-ImageNet上五路实验显示OvR接口骨干排序一致性Spearman 0.872,采集实验中初始边界质量与三种采样策略实现标签预算相关性0.779-0.830。

Conclusion: 边界质量可作为近并列表征的第二阶段诊断:成本低(缓存特征)、有理论支撑,且与骨干排序和实际标签预算强相关,适用于低标签迁移场景的表征选择与主动采集。

Abstract: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.

</details>


### [586] [Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12521)
*Julien Delaunay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个开放的确定性审计基准，系统评估"System 1"类型化决策模型在标定、跨问题干扰与事后归因忠实性上的表现，并与生成式System 2基线对比，给出五项关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System 1决策模型（单次前向输出类型化概率分布）已用于低延迟路由与自动分诊，但其统计标定性与事后可解释性尚未被刻画，缺乏公开、确定性的评测手段。

Method: 构建开放确定性审计基准，评测5个开源权重模型（0.8B–27B）及System 2基线（单token logprob打分、结构化JSON/CoT解码），覆盖NLI(e-SNLI)、句法捷径对抗(HANS)、合成临床分诊(N=900)、提示注入防御(Tensor Trust, N=250)与86例逻辑门触发套件；考察保标签扰动下的标定、跨问题干扰与归因忠实性。

Result: (1)供应商置信度实为闭式离散度变换（1−H(p)/lnK 或归一化margin），非经验准确率；(2)批量提问引发方向性跨题干扰（Tev1-0.8B翻转11.7%–22.4%，Tev1-4B仅0.1%–0.2%）；(3)≥4B模型更快且句法偏移下更标定（ECE_w 0.030–0.087，优于logprob 0.144与JSON 0.378）；(4)注入防御N=250下≥4B达0.988–0.998 AUROC、最高95.2%召回、0.0%误报、48–60ms；(5)单次推理使512联盟XAI可交互（1.3–3.2s/输入），S1-SHAP(logit link)缓解softmax饱和（OR门恢复89.3%–100% vs 概率空间57.1%–82.1%，p_adj=0.004）。

Conclusion: System 1决策模型在≥4B规模时兼具速度、标定性与注入防御优势，但小模型存在置信度非经验、跨题干扰严重等问题；确定性单次推理显著提升XAI可交互性，logit链路的S1-SHAP可改善归因忠实度。

Abstract: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).

</details>


### [587] [A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11526)
*Baiyu Su,Lizhang Chen,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用动力系统视角分析AdamW，证明其不动点等价于一个带约束与正则化优化问题的驻点，但并非所有不动点都稳定；稳定性敏感依赖于曲率、权重衰减与动量参数，即使一维情形也可能出现持续振荡。作者给出高维连续时间局部稳定的充分条件，并提出保持不动点的收敛性修正方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AdamW在深度学习中无处不在，但其动态行为理解不足：它究竟对应什么优化问题、何时能收敛，缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 采用动力系统分析方法：分析AdamW的隐式不动点目标（不动点=某约束+正则化问题的驻点），研究不动点在曲率、权重衰减、动量影响下的稳定性；从一维推广到高维，推导连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件；并提出一种保留原不动点的收敛性改进算法。

Result: 不动点对应特定约束正则优化问题的驻点；但稳定性并非普遍成立，一维即可出现不稳定平衡与持续振荡；高维情形给出局部稳定的充分条件；所提修正在保持不动点的同时实现收敛。

Conclusion: 澄清了AdamW关联的优化问题、其收敛可期望的条件，并说明其动力学分析可启发更可靠的优化器设计。

Abstract: AdamW is ubiquitous in deep learning, yet its behavior remains poorly understood. We analyze its dynamics through the lens of dynamical systems and show that AdamW admits an implicit fixed-point objective: its fixed points coincide with the stationary points of a constrained and regularized optimization problem. However, not all of these fixed points are stable under AdamW's dynamics, and stability depends sensitively on curvature, weight decay, and momentum parameters. Even in one-dimensional settings, equilibria may be unstable, and trajectories can exhibit persistent oscillations rather than convergence to them. We further extend the analysis to higher dimensions, deriving sufficient conditions for local stability of the continuous-time dynamics, and propose a convergent modification that preserves AdamW's fixed points. These results clarify what optimization problem AdamW is associated with, when its convergence can be expected, and how its dynamics could inspire more reliable optimizers.

</details>


### [588] [Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11529)
*Soyon Choi,Scott Alfeld,Meiyi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作进展论文提出了一个针对由多个ML模型组合而成的CPS/AI系统的攻击策略生成框架，研究如何将单个学习器的脆弱性组合成对整个系统的有效攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有大量工作证明单个ML算法可被操纵或欺骗，但现实系统（如信息物理系统）常由视觉、规划等多个ML模型组合以进行自动决策。目前尚不清楚攻击者如何利用对单个学习器的欺骗能力来攻击整体组合，这一空白需要填补。

Method: 构建一个面向数据操纵攻击者的框架，给出基本威胁模型，并将攻击表述为"状态到攻击"的映射（攻击策略）；提出计算最优攻击策略的方法，并讨论了后续扩展方向。

Result: 论文为工作进展性质，主要给出了框架、威胁模型与最优攻击策略计算方法的设计，并列出计划中的扩展，未报告完整实验结论。

Conclusion: 单个ML脆弱性可在组合系统中被放大为系统级攻击，需关注组合学习的安全性；作者希望借此激发讨论并促成该方向的新合作。

Abstract: There is a well-established body of work demonstrating that individual machine learning (ML) algorithms can be manipulated or deceived. However, in many real-world systems, multiple ML algorithms are composed to enable automated decision-making, particularly in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Often such systems use a composition of vision, planning, and other ML models to affect their internal state and ultimate take actions in the physical world. While there is a huge literature on the (in)security of ML algorithms, it is not immediately clear how an attacker might leverage their ability to trick individual learners when attacking the composition as a whole. We develop methods for creating an attack policy (a mapping from state to attack) for a data-manipulating attacker affecting a CPS or other state-machine-based AI compositions. We describe our framework, a basic threat model and corresponding methods for computing an optimal attack policy, as well as planned extensions. The goal of this work-in-progress paper is to stimulate conversation and forge new collaborations regarding the security of compositional learning.

</details>


### [589] [Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11531)
*Ambroise Odonnat,Theo Gnassounou,Laetitia Chapel,Romain Tavenard,Ievgen Redko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过超过14.4万次线性探测实验，系统分析视觉基础模型和大型语言模型的逐层逐模块表征，发现层与模块应联合选择，并提出简单固定的探测策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明探测最终层常非最优、中间层特征更好，但现有研究大多仅沿深度维度分析，把每个transformer block当作原子单元，忽视模块层面的差异。

Method: 对视觉基础模型（VFM）和大型语言模型（LLM）逐层、逐模块进行超过144,000次线性探测评估，联合比较不同层与模块（如残差流、前馈激活、归一化层等）的组合效果。

Result: 最佳"层-模块"组合相比固定残差流的最佳层带来显著更大提升；模块性能随层变化明显，说明有用表征不能仅用深度刻画。固定策略Act@100（视觉）和LN2@60（语言）在多数评估中优于基线，分别平均恢复最佳组合增益的42%和86%；视觉模型的增益随预训练与下游数据迁移难度增大而提高。

Conclusion: 探测表征时应联合考虑层与模块而非仅看深度；简单的固定模块选择策略即可有效提升下游性能，为表征分析提供新视角。

Abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

</details>


### [590] [Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12728)
*Brendan P. Murphy,Agustina Saenz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究临床多轮智能体中可验证奖励强化学习对序贯决策过程的影响，发现仅结果奖励会诱发过早承诺、单问题坍缩等不良程序，需引入过程奖励并区分自适应信息获取与奖励套利。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 被广泛用于提升语言模型推理，但其对"序贯决策程序"（问什么、何时停止、做什么）的影响研究不足；仅依赖最终可验证结果可能掩盖过程缺陷。

Method: 构建三个受控临床环境（药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查、剂量滴定），均含隐藏状态、查询成本、精确自适应 oracle 与确定性结果验证器；对比仅结果 GRPO 与对降低不确定性提问给稠密过程信用的变体，并测试探索/利用分离、监督预热及有偏监督数据等设置，跨 3 个训练种子评估。

Result: 仅结果 GRPO 常提升总体奖励却产生过早承诺、一问坍缩、罕见高风险病例失败；诊断任务中稠密过程信用提升 held-out 价值与中等病例支持度，且无高风险种子崩塌；探索/利用分离在最佳检查点进一步提高高风险支持，但低急症病例过度采集信息；过程信用最优强度依任务而变；监督预热后 RL 通过削减提问提分却损害高风险表现；RL 难以修复有偏监督数据带来的罕见行为缺失。

Conclusion: 可验证最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计须考虑达成答案的过程，评估须区分自适应信息获取与利用奖励漏洞的捷径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.

</details>


### [591] [UTOPI: Efficient Egocentric Long-Video Understanding in AR via User-Guided Token Pre-Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11562)
*Ziqi Wang,Su Chen,Qiance Tang,Jieyu Lin,Ziyun Li,Barbara De Salvo,Sai Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UTOPI是一个面向AR平台自我中心长视频的即插即用预压缩模块，结合用户运动信号做视角偏移不变剪枝、结合眼动追踪做前景优先保留，最高可压缩95%而保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解关注度上升，AR设备成为重要部署平台，但自我中心视频存在大量时间冗余，给资源受限的AR硬件带来内存和计算负担。

Method: 提出即插即用的预压缩模块UTOPI：1）利用用户运动信号估计帧间重叠，提出视角偏移不变（viewpoint-shift-invariant）的剪枝算法；2）利用眼动追踪传感器识别用户注视点，将受关注的前景内容与背景分离，并通过微调的神经网络调整机制优先保留前景。

Result: 在多个基准和多种模型骨干上，UTOPI实现最高95%的压缩率且保持性能。

Conclusion: UTOPI验证了利用AR设备自身传感信号（运动、眼动）进行视频预压缩的有效性，可在保持下游任务性能的同时大幅降低自我中心长视频的冗余与计算开销。

Abstract: As long-video understanding gains increasing attention, augmented reality (AR) devices are emerging as a compelling deployment platform. However, egocentric videos exhibit significant temporal redundancy, imposing substantial memory and computational burdens on resource-constrained AR hardware. To address this challenge, we introduce UTOPI, a plug-and-play pre-compression module designed specifically for egocentric long videos on AR platforms. First, we leverage user motion signals to estimate inter-frame overlap and propose a viewpoint-shift-invariant pruning algorithm. Second, we exploit eye-tracking sensors to identify user fixations, enabling the separation of attended foreground content from background and its preferential retention via a fine-tuned neural network-based adjustment mechanism. Across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, UTOPI achieves up to 95% compression while preserving performance. Code and project page are available at https://sai-lab-nyu.github.io/utopi/.

</details>


### [592] [Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11565)
*Bian Sun,Kevin Zhai,Mubarak Shah,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EARN，用历史经验对 LLM agent 的候选动作进行条件化复用与信用重分配，在固定交互预算下提升末端表现，在 Jericho/ScienceWorld/Crafter 的 31/33 设置中取得最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 可通过重复尝试的反馈改进决策而无需更新参数，但正信用会持续偏向只能重复达到相同分数的动作，即使存在更高分；且在固定交互预算下，末期探索新动作可能拉低表现。

Method: EARN 降低"重复达到历史同样分数"的动作信用，对达到更高分数的动作片段赋予更大信用，用这些信用调整 LLM 提议动作的概率；在最后若干 episode 中，若当前上下文与记录上下文匹配且动作仍可用，则直接回放存储的动作序列，绕过 LLM 候选生成。

Result: 以交互预算末四个 episode 平均分评估，EARN 在 33 个任务-预算设置中的 31 个取得最佳（含并列）；在 Jericho 各预算下，末四个 episode 中回放绕过 78.9–86.3% 的候选生成调用。

Conclusion: 经验的"条件复用 + 差异化信用"能兼顾探索进展与保留既有成绩，并显著降低末期推理开销。

Abstract: LLM agents can use feedback from repeated attempts to improve their decisions without updating model parameters. However, positive action credits can continue to favor actions that repeatedly achieve the same score, even when higher scores are achievable. Under a fixed interaction budget, trying new actions in the final attempts can also lower performance. We introduce EARN, a method that uses past experience to guide further progress and retain earlier performance through conditional reuse of effective action sequences. EARN reduces action credits for reaching scores repeatedly attained in earlier episodes and assigns larger credits to action segments that reach higher scores. These credits adjust the probabilities of LLM-proposed actions. During the final episodes, EARN directly replays stored actions when the current context matches the recorded context and the actions remain available, bypassing LLM candidate generation. We evaluate performance at the end of the interaction budget using the average score over the final four episodes. Across Jericho, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, EARN achieves the best score on this metric in 31 of 33 task--budget settings among the evaluated methods, including ties. Across the evaluated Jericho budgets, replay bypasses 78.9--86.3\% of candidate-generation calls in the final four episodes, averaged across games.

</details>


### [593] [Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11609)
*Sergei V. Kalinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个预算受限的多步结构-性能自主显微镜框架，结合显式科学奖励、动作成本、仪器观测模型、预实验知识迁移与独立于控制器的评估，在真实EELS数据集上验证了成像/谱学选择与重校准策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主显微镜若不仅能决定"在哪测"，还能决定"采什么信息、以何扫描速率、何时重校准"，就能把快速采集转化为科学进展；但缺乏预算约束下多步工作流的统一框架与可复现评估方法。

Method: 构建预算受限的多步结构-性能工作流框架：显式科学奖励、动作成本、仪器观测模型；将预实验知识（预测器精度与计算成本、经验学习成熟度函数用于加权模型奖励、漂移特性）迁移到在线实验；评估独立于控制器。在真实电子能量损失谱(EELS)数据上开展两组实验：①控制器选择成像 vs 谱学、图像尺寸、扫描速度；②存在漂移并需决定何时重校准。

Result: 响应发现与结构-性能学习偏好不同的代理模型与采集策略；简单采集规则构成强实用基线；独立误差分析揭示了模型不确定性何时不可靠；漂移实验中显式配准显著提升定位精度，并量化了其对谱学通量的代价。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了可复现的自主动实验设计、比较与审计方法，并明确了显微镜部署所需条件：可独立执行的动作、已表征的扫描与探测响应、带时间戳的配准遥测、完整的动作记录。

Abstract: Autonomous microscopy can turn fast acquisition into scientific progress when it decides not only where to measure, but also what information to acquire, at what scan rate, and when to recalibrate the instrument. We develop a budget constrained framework for such multistep structure-property workflows. It combines explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models, transfer of pre experiment knowledge into the online campaign, and evaluation kept independent of the controller. The transferred knowledge includes predictor accuracy and computational cost, empirical learner maturity functions that weight model-derived rewards, and drift characteristics established before controller training. Using a real electron energy-loss spectroscopy dataset, we run two complementary campaigns. In the first, the controller chooses between imaging and spectroscopy, image size, and scan speed. In the second, the instrument drifts and the controller also decides when to recalibrate. The campaigns show that response discovery and structure-property learning favor different surrogate models and acquisition strategies. They also show that simple acquisition rules form strong, practical baselines. Independent error analysis reveals where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal. In the drift campaign, explicit registration greatly improves positional accuracy, and the framework measures what this costs in spectroscopy throughput. Together, these results provide a reproducible way to design, compare, and audit autonomous experiments, and they define what microscopes must provide for deployment: independently executable actions, characterized scan and detector responses, timestamped registration telemetry, and complete action records.

</details>


### [594] [Daily Emergency Call Volume Forecasting using Univariate and Multivariate TimeGPT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11613)
*Feriel Fass,Djemel Ziou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用2101天真实急救呼叫数据检验时间序列基础模型TimeGPT的预测能力，发现其大规模预训练优势未能体现，单变量下SARIMAX、多变量下负二项/泊松回归等"轻量"方法表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 考察预训练时间序列基础模型TimeGPT在急救呼叫量（emergency call volumes）这一实际预测任务中的价值，验证"大规模预训练必然带来更优预测精度"这一假设是否成立。

Method: 使用2101天日度急救呼叫数据，设置单变量与多变量（引入时间、气象、人口、社会经济变量）两种情形，评估一步与七天多步预测；采用按时间顺序的训练/验证/测试划分防信息泄漏，网格搜索+早停调参，多误差指标评估，并与SARIMAX、泊松回归、负二项回归、XGBoost、MLP、LSTM对比。

Result: 单变量情形下SARIMAX整体表现最佳；多变量情形下负二项回归（NBR）与泊松回归（PR）最优；TimeGPT未取得领先表现。

Conclusion: TimeGPT的大规模预训练并不必然转化为急救呼叫量预测的更高精度，仅用现有数据训练的"精简"（frugal）方法在该应用中仍然更优。

Abstract: This study investigates the potential of TimeGPT, a pretrained foundation model for timeseries, for forecasting daily emergency call volumes. Real-world emergency call data, comprising 2,101 daily observations, are used to evaluate both univariate and multivariate forecasting settings under one-step-ahead and seven-day multi-step-ahead scenarios. The multivariate forecasting incorporates temporal, meteorological, demographic, and socioeconomic variables. A chronological training, validation, and test split is adopted to prevent information leakage, while hyperparameters are selected using the validation set through grid search and early stopping when applicable. Forecasting performance is evaluated using multiple error metrics. Its forecasting performance is compared with several established forecasting approaches, including Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Poisson regression (PR), Negative Binomial regression (NBR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The results show that SARIMAX achieves the best overall performance in the univariate setting. In the multivariate setting, NBR and PR provide best performance. These findings indicate that the large-scale pretraining of TimeGPT do not necessarily translate into superior forecasting accuracy for emergency call volumes. Frugal methods trained solely on the available data remain better for this application.

</details>


### [595] [GenISys: Integrated Ship Systems Design Using Subsystem-Conditional Tabular Diffussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11622)
*Noah J. Bagazinski,Faez Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GenISys 框架与 SCDDPM 模型，实现船舶各子系统同步条件生成，生成满足约束且低成本的散货船方案比例优于整体式和顺序式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 船舶设计需协调船体几何、结构、推进与运营等耦合子系统，在满足工程约束的同时平衡性能与成本。已有生成式 AI 多用于单一部件设计，缺乏对子系统间交互的整体建模，因此需要能生成集成系统的生成方法。

Method: 构建含 217,999 个提出设计（其中 16,247 个满足工程约束）的数据集；提出同步条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM），在生成过程中使各子系统模型相互响应；与整体式整船生成、顺序式子系生成对比，每种架构独立训练五次；以 5,000 海里航程需求下的单位货运成本为优化目标开展实验。

Result: SCDDPM 在 55.70% 的生成请求中产出既满足工程约束又达到统一低成本目标的方案，整体式模型为 51.10%，顺序式模型为 47.54%，分别多出 9.0% 与 17.2% 的合格设计，同时估计运输成本相近。

Conclusion: 结果表明生成式 AI 可通过对子系统的协同建模生成可行且高性能的集成系统，为早期散货船等复杂工程设计提供有效支持。

Abstract: Ship design requires coordinating coupled subsystems to satisfy engineering constraints and balance competing performance and cost objectives. Generative artificial intelligence has supported component design, but integrated ship generation must also account for interactions among hull geometry, structure, propulsion, and operation. This paper presents GenISys, a framework for generating integrated systems, demonstrated through early-stage bulk-carrier design. Its dataset contains 217,999 proposed designs, including 16,247 that satisfy the formulated engineering constraints. The proposed simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) generates subsystems together, allowing each subsystem model to respond to changes elsewhere during generation. Experiments compare this approach with monolithic whole-ship generation and sequential subsystem generation across five independent training runs per architecture. In a study targeting lower cost per tonne of cargo transported, designs were generated for a required voyage range of 5,000 nautical miles. SCDDPM produced designs satisfying the formulated engineering constraints and meeting a common low-cost target in 55.70% of generation requests, compared with 51.10% for the monolithic model and 47.54% for the sequential model. These correspond to 9.0% and 17.2% more qualifying designs, respectively, while maintaining similar estimated transport costs. These results show how generative artificial intelligence can coordinate subsystems to generate feasible, high-performing integrated systems.

</details>


### [596] [A Trust Region Approach for Learning Schrödinger Bridges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11649)
*Takeshi Koshizuka,Denis Blessing,Max Zimmer,Sebastian Pokutta,Lorenz Richter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究仅有未归一化目标密度、无目标样本情况下的Schrödinger Bridge数值逼近问题，提出一种信赖域版IPF以提升数值稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当目标分布样本不可得、仅给定未归一化密度时，常用的迭代比例拟合（IPF）及其变体常出现严重数值不稳定，根源在于底层控制问题病态、且最优解可能远离初始化点。

Method: 提出IPF的信赖域变体：约束每次更新与当前迭代点保持固定的KL散度；并证明该方法可解释为自适应步长的镜像下降（mirror descent）方案。

Result: 该约束显著提升了数值稳定性，并在多个具有挑战性的采样任务上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 信赖域IPF有效缓解了无样本、仅未归一化密度场景下Schrödinger Bridge求解的不稳定性，并提供镜像下降的理论视角。

Abstract: We study the numerical approximation of Schrödinger Bridges in the setting where samples from the target distribution are unavailable and only an unnormalized target density is given. In this regime, the widely used iterative proportional fitting (IPF) procedure (and its variants) often exhibits severe numerical instabilities, stemming from ill-conditioned underlying control problems and from the fact that the optimal solution may lie far from the initialization. To address these issues, we propose a trust region variant of IPF that constrains successive updates to remain at a fixed Kullback-Leibler divergence from the current iterate. This restriction significantly improves numerical stability. Moreover, we show that the resulting method admits an interpretation as a mirror descent scheme with an adaptively chosen step size. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on several challenging sampling tasks.

</details>


### [597] [Means vs. Foundation Models for Emergency Call Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11656)
*Feriel Fass,Djemel Ziou,Marie-Flavie Auclair-Fortier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究比较广义均值（Hölder均值HM与Lehmer均值LM）与微调TimeGPT在日度紧急呼叫量预测上的表现。实验显示二者整体预测性能几乎相同；短期（1、3天）广义均值略优于TimeGPT，7天时TimeGPT略优，但Diebold-Mariano检验表明各预测步长下差异均不具统计显著性，说明广义均值可达到与基础模型相当的竞争性预测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究简单统计方法（广义均值）能否在日度紧急呼叫量预测中达到大型时序基础模型TimeGPT的预测水平，从而为实际应用提供轻量、可替代的方案。

Method: 构建Hölder均值（HM）与Lehmer均值（LM）两类广义均值预测方法，与微调后的TimeGPT在1至7天预测步长上对比；使用真实紧急呼叫数据集，采用多种误差指标并以Diebold-Mariano检验判断差异显著性。

Result: HM与LM在各步长上性能几乎一致。短期预测中二者优于TimeGPT，1天与3天步长的MAE分别降低约1.24%和2.48%；7天步长时TimeGPT的MAE降低1.98%。但Diebold-Mariano检验显示各步长下方法间差异均不显著。

Conclusion: 广义均值可提供与能耗型（大规模）基础模型TimeGPT相当的竞争性预测性能，且统计上无显著差异，提示此类简单方法可作为轻量替代方案用于紧急呼叫量预测。

Abstract: This study investigates whether generalized means can achieve forecasting performance comparable to that of TimeGPT for daily emergency call volume prediction. Specifically, two families of generalized means, the Hölder means (HM) and the Lehmer means (LM), are evaluated against fine-tuned TimeGPT across forecasting horizons ranging from one to seven days. Forecasting performance is assessed on a real-world emergency call dataset using multiple error metrics, and Diebold-Mariano test. Experimental results show that HM and LM achieve nearly identical predictive performance across all forecasting horizons. For short-term forecasting, both generalized means outperform TimeGPT, with reductions of mean absolute error (MAE) approximately 1.24\% and 2.48\% at horizons of one and three days, respectively. Conversely, TimeGPT achieves a lower error at the seven-day horizon, with an descresing of MAE by 1.98\%. However, Diebold-Mariano tests reveal no statistically significant differences between the methods at the evaluated horizons. These findings suggest that generalized means can provide competitive forecasting performance compared with a energyvore foundation model.

</details>


### [598] [A Theoretical Reduction From Membership Inference to Reconstruction Attacks Against Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11680)
*Amnon Levi,Yuval Dagan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究从训练好的模型中恢复训练数据的"重构攻击"。作者给出一个通用归约：在对抗者设计难例的模型下，只要存在具有足够高召回率和极低假阳性率的成员推断测试，就能构造重构算法；并证明在随机凸优化(SCO)中，任何低超额风险学习算法都存在多项式时间的重构攻击，可恢复 Ω(n) 个训练点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解成员推断与重构攻击之间的本质关系，并研究在随机凸优化这类重要学习任务中，隐私泄露是否不可避免。此前两者常被分开研究，缺乏一般性归约，也不清楚在指数级大支撑域下重构是否可高效实现。

Method: 1) 提出通用归约：给定大小为 n 的训练集，若成员推断测试的召回率≥q(n)且假阳性率为 O(δ²/n²)，则可构造重构算法，以概率 1−O(δ) 仅输出训练点，期望恢复 Ω(n·q(n)) 个。该归约适用于任意学习算法。2) 针对 SCO，为使归约在指数级大支撑域上计算可行，采用支撑集被划分为多项式多个类别、每类含指数多个元素的结构化分布，使重构按类别而非全支撑迭代。3) 与已有的 SCO 成员推断结果结合。

Result: 证明了在 SCO 中，任何在所有分布上达到低超额风险的学习算法都容许一个多项式时间的重构攻击，即使底层分布支撑为指数级大，也能恢复 Ω(n) 个训练点。通用归约表明高召回、低假阳性的成员推断蕴含重构。

Conclusion: 成员推断可归约为重构，隐私泄露在学习可行性下具有普遍性；在 SCO 中重构攻击既可理论保证又可高效实现。

Abstract: We study reconstruction attacks, which recover training data from a learned model. In our adversarial model, the adversary designs a hard instance, drawn from a parameterized family of data distributions, and is given the parameter used to generate it. Our main contribution is a general reduction showing that, in this model, membership inference (determining whether a given datapoint was used for training) implies reconstruction: for a training set of size $n$, a membership test with recall at least $q(n)$ and false-positive rate $O(δ^2/n^2)$ yields a reconstruction algorithm that, with probability $1 - O(δ)$, outputs only training points, and recovers $Ω(n \cdot q(n))$ of them in expectation. This reduction applies to any learning algorithm. For stochastic convex optimization (SCO), we make the reduction computationally efficient over exponentially large domains via structured distributions whose support is partitioned into polynomially many categories of exponentially many elements each, so that reconstruction iterates over categories rather than the full support. Combining this with an existing membership inference result for SCO, we prove that any learning algorithm achieving low excess risk over all distributions admits a polynomial-time reconstruction attack recovering $Ω(n)$ training points, even when the underlying distribution has exponentially large support.

</details>


### [599] [Resolvent Ellipsoid for Minty Set Inclusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11691)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Gabriele Farina,Patrick Jaillet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究紧凸集上带集值算子的 Minty 集包含问题，在固定尺度约束预解（constrained-resolvent）oracle 模型下，提出基于几何分离原理与椭球法的 RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID 算法，实现多项式于 d 和 log(1/ε) 的黑盒复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Minty 集包含（SVI, 强变分不等式）问题是单调包含的理论核心，但现有方法多依赖梯度/算子查询或强假设。作者希望在更弱的"固定尺度约束预解 oracle"黑盒模型下，仍能得到关于维度和精度的多项式（poly(d, log(1/ε))）保证，填补单调包含在该模型下的复杂度空白。

Method: 研究几何化方法：查询锚点 a 时，oracle 返回预解点 x^+ 及 Yosida 向量 g_η(a)=(a−x^+)/η。论文证明每次 oracle 响应给出一个"尖锐二分"：要么返回点给出 ε-SVI 证书，要么 Yosida 向量为 Minty 集构造严格分离法向。即一次黑盒预解查询要么提供可验证候选解，要么给出有效几何割。将该分离原理与椭球法结合，设计 RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID 算法进行迭代。

Result: 在固定尺度约束预解模型下，算法以 O(poly(d, log(1/ε))) 次黑盒 oracle 调用计算出 ε-SVI。对单调包含问题，这是据作者所知首个在固定尺度预解模型下达到 poly(d, log(1/ε)) 黑盒保证的结果。

Conclusion: 通过"预解查询—分离割"的几何二分原理结合椭球法，作者为 Minty 集包含问题提供了高效黑盒算法，首次在固定尺度预解 oracle 模型下实现了多项式于维度与对数精度的复杂度，拓展了单调包含的可解性理论。

Abstract: We study Minty set inclusion on a compact convex set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ with a set-valued operator $A : \mathcal{X} \rightrightarrows \mathbb{R}^d$. Under the Minty promise, the goal is to compute $x \in \mathcal{X}$ and $u \in A(x)$ such that $\sup_{y \in \mathcal{X}} \langle u, x - y \rangle \le \varepsilon$. Our approach is geometric and we work in the fixed-scale constrained-resolvent oracle model, where a query at anchor $a$ is assumed to return a resolvent point $x^+$ together with the Yosida vector $g_η(a) = (a - x^+)/η$. We prove that each oracle response yields a sharp dichotomy: either the returned point provides an $\varepsilon$-SVI certificate, or the Yosida vector defines a strict separating normal for the Minty set. Thus, a single black-box resolvent query supplies either a certified candidate solution or a valid geometric cut. Combining this separation principle with the ellipsoid method, we obtain RESOLVENT-ELLIPSOID, an algorithm that computes an $\varepsilon$-SVI in $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\operatorname{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box oracle calls to the fixed-scale constrained resolvent. For monotone inclusions, our algorithm gives, to our knowledge, the first $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\mathrm{poly}(d, \log(1/\varepsilon))\right)$ black-box guarantee in the fixed-scale resolvent model.

</details>


### [600] [Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11696)
*Rafael Pina,Varuna De Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文用直接GPU能耗测量检验"批内/跨时间共享计算能否实关节能"这一问题：循环策略（MARL）上答案为否，MoE语言模型上答案为是，且粒度决定节省幅度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效神经网络的能耗主张常由运算次数（FLOPs）推断，而非实测，可能误导；作者希望用实测GPU能耗回答：批的行能否在批内与时间上共享计算，并带来可测量的节能。

Method: 在单一GPU类型上对两类批处理特性迥异的工作负载做直接能耗测量：GPU向量化多智能体强化学习中的循环策略，以及MoE语言模型（Qwen3-30B-A3B）。考察共享活动模式、冻结/训练掩码、测试时引导等共享手段，并提出持久性感知的OEA规则（batch-aware routing，约束每步新增专家数）。

Result: 循环策略上共享计算不成功：共享活动模式极少维持一步，冻结策略掩码失效，训练掩码仅因等价于窄GRU而有效，能耗为小型稠密策略的11倍；测试时引导在两种负载上均无增益。MoE上共享有效：Qwen3-30B-A3B上batch-aware路由在KL 0.05内少读25–31%专家权重，500条样本上基准变化在噪声内，融合前向下每token少用12–18%能耗。OEA在batch 32–64时每步新增专家比原生路由少约40%，但能耗尚未测量。

Conclusion: 能耗不能由运算计数推断，需实测；循环策略难以在批上共享计算，MoE则可通过批感知路由实现可测节能，粒度是关键。结论基于单一GPU类型的初步测量，作者明确说明了局限性，OEA的能耗节省仍待验证。

Abstract: Energy claims for efficient neural networks are often inferred from operation counts. We report direct GPU energy measurements on two workloads that batch very differently, recurrent policies in GPU-vectorised multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, and ask one question of both: can the rows of a batch be made to share computation, across the batch and over time, at a measured saving? On recurrent policies the answer so far is no. Shared activity patterns exist but rarely last one step, masking a frozen policy fails, and trained-in masks succeed only because a fixed mask is equivalent to a narrow GRU, at 11x the energy of a small dense policy in our implementation. Test-time steering adds nothing beyond re-picking on either workload. On MoE models the answer is yes, and granularity decides how much: on Qwen3-30B-A3B, batch-aware routing reads 25-31% fewer expert weights within KL 0.05, with benchmark changes within noise at 500 items, and uses 12-18% less energy per token on a fused forward. We also introduce persistence-aware OEA, a one-parameter rule that keeps the batch-aware cut with about 40% fewer new experts per step than native routing at batch 32-64, though its energy has not yet been measured. These are pilot measurements on one GPU type, and we state their limits.

</details>
