### [601] [Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11704)
*Peiyu Li,Pouya Hosseinzadeh,Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi,Shah Muhammad Hamdi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于策略学习的时间序列反事实解释框架，将生成问题建模为一步上下文赌博机，在预训练自编码器隐空间训练actor-critic，实现单次前向生成有效且合理的反事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列反事实解释面临复杂时间依赖，且传统逐实例优化计算低效；现有方法需为每个新输入迭代优化，难以扩展。

Method: 将反事实生成建模为一步上下文赌博机策略学习问题；在预训练自编码器隐空间中训练actor-critic智能体，学习可迁移策略以捕捉全局结构规律；推理时无需逐实例优化，单次前向即可生成反事实。

Result: 在13个UCR基准数据集上，多异常检测指标下均取得高有效性与强合理性。

Conclusion: 将反事实生成与逐实例优化解耦，为时间序列反事实解释提供高效可扩展的替代方案。

Abstract: Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.

</details>


### [602] [Variational Approach to Optimal IPS Estimator for Multi-logger Off-Policy Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11712)
*Joon Suk Huh,Junghoon Seo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对多日志策略上下文赌博机中的离策略评估,提出采样依赖权重的最优IPS估计器,并给出闭式解及DR扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agarwal et al. [2017]指出多日志策略下balanced IPS与weighted IPS各有胜负、无一致优者,因此需要一个最优权衡方案。

Method: 用变分法在无偏约束下最小化方差,求闭式最优采样依赖权重;仅需K×K矩阵和K维矩量;再引入条件奖励估计器得到双重稳健(DR)形式,并与Kallus et al. [2021]的半参数有效DR比较。

Result: 估计器无偏且在广义加权IPS类中渐近最优;量化了相对半参数oracle的效率损失;基准数据集上优于现有多日志IPS;DR形式在奖励模型一致时与Kallus估计器渐近方差相同,某些误设下仍保持半参数有效,实测误差常更低。

Conclusion: 以变分法导出的最优权重解决了多日志IPS的选择困境,IPS与DR两版本均具理论与实证优势。

Abstract: We study off-policy evaluation (OPE) in contextual bandits with data collected from multiple logging policies. Inverse propensity scoring (IPS) is a standard approach to OPE and extends naturally to the multi-logger setting. However, as highlighted by Agarwal et al. [2017], neither balanced nor weighted IPS consistently outperforms the other in this setting. We resolve this dilemma by deriving an optimal IPS estimator with sample-dependent weights that minimize variance subject to unbiasedness. Using a variational calculus approach, we obtain closed-form optimal weights, yielding an estimator that is unbiased and achieves asymptotically optimal variance within a generalized weighted-IPS estimator class. Instead of a reward model, the estimator needs only a $K\times K$ matrix and a $K$-vector of moments, where $K$ is the number of logging policies, and we quantify how much efficiency this costs relative to the semiparametric oracle. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our estimator generally improves on existing multi-logger IPS methods. We also extend our estimator to a doubly robust form by incorporating a conditional reward estimator. We compare the resulting DR extension with the semiparametrically efficient DR estimator of Kallus et al. [2021], both theoretically and empirically. We show that the two estimators achieve the same asymptotic variance when the conditional reward estimator is consistent, while our estimator can retain semiparametric efficiency under certain forms of reward misspecification. Empirically, the proposed DR estimator often achieves lower estimation error than the existing DR baseline.

</details>


### [603] [Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11717)
*Kevin L. McKee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FTN 从哺乳动物新皮层获得灵感，构造分布式随机专家混合体，用稀疏二值路由掩码在推理时按小样本支持集动态选择子网络，实现持续学习与知识迁移，缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ANN 存在灾难性遗忘：概念漂移或领域漂移时新训练会完全覆盖旧解，且要求每批数据近似代表全分布，代价高且不现实。

Method: FTN 建模为分布式随机专家混合体，推理时根据少量输入-输出对计算稀疏二值路由掩码；训练中每批重配置路由器，并用掩码重叠过滤的回放，形成部分训练的重叠子网络基。

Result: 在块序列持续学习与知识迁移任务上，FTN 保留旧解接近不相交掩码隔离效果，预更新 head-start 损失最低；掩码重叠几何反映概念共享结构。相关概念漂移下需支持集掩码重配置才能保持；领域漂移下分布式库加回放已足够，无需配置器。

Conclusion: 无关任务经基本分离的装配体路由，相关任务共享组件；支持集掩码配置贡献前向与后向迁移，FTN 提供了类皮层的持续学习与迁移机制。

Abstract: Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start loss among matched-architecture comparators. The learned mask-overlap geometry tracks the known concept-sharing structure where available. We show experimentally that under correlated concept shift, support-set mask reconfiguration is necessary even for retention. Under domain shift, the distributed bank with replay is sufficient to handle retention without the configurer. Forward transfer, or head-start, and backward transfer, are also contributed by support-set mask configuration.

</details>


### [604] [The Dark Matter of Clinical Data: An Identification Limit on Disentangling Physiology from Care Process in electronic health records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11726)
*Mohammad Shahin,Krittaphas Chaisutyakorn,Dimitrios Proios,David Restrepo,Vishala Mishra,Boya Zhang,Aadarsh Sivaraman,Sparsh Roy,Benet Fité Abril,Tina Yen-Ting Chen,Hyunjung Gloria Kwak,Andre Kurepa Waschka,Vinayak Mathur,Leo Anthony Celi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文形式化了EHR表示中"生理状态"与"临床测量过程（谁在何时被测）”纠缠的数据生成过程，证明两类试图解耦的策略：单数据集内对“检验值”与“开单”通道做信息分解，以及多站点表示-结局不变性，都不构成可识别的辨识策略，仅在特定条件下才可识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHR表示同时编码患者生理与决定"是否测量、何时测量、测量谁"的临床过程。既有工作（如PID分解检验值与开单信息、跨站点不变性检验）被视为可分离/可检验的因果或生物信号，但作者质疑这些做法在什么条件下真正可识别。

Method: 构建含潜在生理、开单意图、仅在测量时才存在的实验室值、学习表示与临床环境的生成模型。分析：(1) 单个数据集下"值"与"开单"通道的信息分解（在Williams-Beer公理与单射重编码不变性下推导PID）；(2) 构造观测等价但生物不变性判断相反的模型，论证跨站点不变性只是可伪证的联合假设含义，而非辨识策略；并给出可恢复识别的条件（全体检测、检验精确汇总结局相关生理、两个误差独立的检验等）。

Result: 单数据集下值/开单信息不可分离：未检测者的分布不可恢复，哨兵编码使开单指示子携带全部熵，PID被固定。跨站点表示条件结局不变性在检验失败或通过时均可由等价模型给出相反结论；二元生理下，当病例组合不同、表示有损且生理影响结局时必然发生。实例中生物机制不变却出现9.6个百分点跨站点差异。

Conclusion: 跨站点分析应被表述为对某一明确联合假设的检验，而非识别生物不变性；全文检测可移除开单门控，精确汇总或双独立误差检验可在特定条件下恢复识别。

Abstract: Representations learned from electronic health record (EHR) data encode patient physiology together with the clinical process that decides what is measured, when, and for whom. We formalize the data-generating process with latent physiology, ordering intent, laboratory values that exist only when measured, a learned representation, and clinical environments, and analyze two strategies for undoing this entanglement. First, no division of the information carried by laboratory "value" and "ordering" channels is identified from a single dataset: when ordering depends on the analyte, its distribution among untested patients is not recoverable, and a sentinel code for the undefined recorded value makes it carry all the entropy of the ordering indicator, fixing partial information decomposition (PID) for every redundancy measure satisfying the Williams-Beer axioms and invariant under injective re-encoding. Second, cross-site invariance of representation-conditional outcomes is a falsifiable implication of biological invariance taken jointly with exclusion and representation-sufficiency conditions, but not an identification strategy: we construct observationally equivalent models that disagree about biological invariance, whether the invariance test fails or passes. For binary physiology this happens exactly when case mix differs, the representation is lossy, and physiology affects the outcome. A worked example yields a 9.6-percentage-point cross-site gap under an unchanged biological mechanism. Tests performed for every patient remove the ordering gate, and measured tests can restore identification: biological invariance is identified when a test exactly summarizes outcome-relevant physiology, or, for binary physiology, when two tests with independent errors are available at sites with different case mix. Cross-site analyses should be reported as tests of a stated joint hypothesis.

</details>


### [605] [Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11752)
*Khurram Khalil,Khaza Anuarul Hoque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明"近满秩更新"与"低稳定秩变化"两种看似矛盾的谱性质其实相容，并刻画训练中更新方向：相邻检查点位移余弦在大规模RLVR中普遍为负，且优势函数系统（组相对优势 vs. 学习critic）会影响方向一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于语言模型后训练谱性质的报道存在冲突（更新近满秩 vs. 稳定秩变化很小），需要调和这些观察，并进一步刻画更新方向随训练的演化规律，尤其弄清RLVR类训练中相邻更新方向是否一致及其受何种因素影响。

Method: 1) 理论分析：对奇异值满足 σ_i ∝ i^{-α}（0<α≤1/2）的谱，证明随维度增大稳定秩相对固定能量所需秩可忽略；2) 对OLMo-2-7B的PPO注意力更新做完整SVD验证；3) 用全模型内积计算九个公开RLVR阶段共131对相邻检查点位移余弦；4) 四个模型族SFT对比；5) OLMo-2-1B受控实验（3对种子、2048 token响应上限）比较组相对优势与GAE学习critic。

Result: 三个PPO注意力更新稳定秩仅9.6-18.3，但需532-1,222个奇异分量才能覆盖80%能量；RLVR九个阶段共131对相邻更新余弦全为负（含PPO和GRPO轨迹）；SFT呈现配置依赖的对齐性，Mistral与FP32 Llama晚期余弦为负；受控实验中匹配60-rollout窗口下晚期平均余弦分别为+0.259（组相对）与+0.012（critic+GAE），配对差值-0.247（95%区间[-0.358,-0.137]）。

Conclusion: 谱集中度、能量覆盖率与轨迹方向是三个需区分的概念；二者的"矛盾"源于度量的不同；实际RLVR训练中相邻更新方向普遍相反，且优势函数系统在匹配条件下显著影响更新的方向对齐程度。

Abstract: Language-model post-training modifies weights through cumulative updates and successive displacements, yet existing studies report seemingly conflicting spectral properties: nearly full-rank updates and low stable-rank changes. We show these observations are compatible and characterize update directions during training. For singular values following $σ_i \propto i^{-α}$ with $0 < α\leq 1/2$, we prove that stable rank becomes negligible relative to fixed-energy rank as dimension increases. Full singular value decompositions of selected OLMo-2-7B updates confirm this separation: three proximal policy optimization (PPO) attention updates have stable ranks of 9.6-18.3 but require 532-1,222 singular components to capture 80% of their energy. We next compute consecutive checkpoint-displacement cosines from full-model inner products. Across nine publicly released reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) stages, all 131 adjacent pairs have negative cosines on their native checkpoint grids, including PPO and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning comparisons across four model families show configuration-dependent alignment, including negative late-training cosines for Mistral and FP32 Llama. Finally, a controlled OLMo-2-1B study with three paired seeds and a 2,048-token response cap compares group-relative advantages against a learned critic with generalized advantage estimation (GAE). At matched 60-rollout windows, late-training mean cosines are +0.259 and +0.012, respectively; the paired critic-minus-group difference is -0.247 (seed-level 95% interval [-0.358, -0.137]). These findings distinguish spectral concentration, energy coverage, and trajectory direction, and demonstrate that the advantage system influences directional alignment under matched training conditions.

</details>


### [606] [Payoff-Aware Prediction of Population Game Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11786)
*Kang Wang,Xiao Wang,Bo Li,Renzhe Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PA-RmD方法，用于在支付函数改变、新支付下轨迹数据缺失时预测种群博弈动态演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用中支付函数会变化，希望在新支付设计下、尚无该设计轨迹数据时预测种群轨迹；而标准动力学学习方法只拟合训练支付下的运动，未分离支付相关的激励与支付无关的响应结构。

Method: 基于Riemannian game dynamics框架，提出PA-RmD：将支付信息显式保留，并从数据中学习与支付无关的响应结构，从而实现支付感知的动力学学习与预测。

Result: 理论上证明所学模型保持固定支付下的Nash均衡，并在共享响应与支付覆盖条件下给出有限时间单步预测界；实验在合成零和博弈、势博弈及YouTube Trending多国数据集上验证方法在变化支付设计下表现良好。

Conclusion: 显式分离支付相关激励与支付无关响应结构是跨支付设计预测种群博弈动态的有效途径。

Abstract: Population game dynamics describe how aggregate behavior evolves in response to payoff signals. In many applications, the payoff function may change, and the goal is to predict the population trajectory induced by a new payoff design before trajectory data under that design are available. We study this problem as $\textbf{payoff-aware prediction of population game dynamics}$. Standard dynamics learning methods fit the motion observed under training payoffs, but do not separate the payoff-dependent incentive from the payoff-independent response structure needed for prediction under new payoffs. Building on the existing framework of Riemannian game dynamics, we propose PA-RmD, a payoff-aware learning method that keeps payoff information explicit and learns the payoff-independent response structure from data. Theoretically, we show that the learned model preserves fixed-payoff Nash equilibria and derive finite-time one-step prediction bounds under shared-response and payoff-coverage conditions. Empirically, we evaluate PA-RmD on synthetic zero-sum and potential games, as well as a YouTube Trending multi-country dataset, showing that our method performs well under changing payoff designs.

</details>


### [607] [APO2CS: Advantage-Aware Preference Optimization for Two-Level Constructive Search in Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11792)
*Kaixi Yang,Linbo Qiao,Wei Shang,Yanqi Shi,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出APO2CS，一种结合宏/微观双层监督的偏好优化目标，用于构造式神经组合优化求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于偏好的神经组合优化方法依赖二值成对标签，丢弃了解的质量差异幅度，且仅在完整解层面提供监督，监督信号稀疏。

Method: 提出优势感知的双层构造搜索偏好优化（APO2CS）。宏层面：用目标值差异导出的优势项丰富成对偏好；微观层面：比较部分轨迹，在序列构造过程中提供更密集的监督。该目标既可从零训练策略，也可微调预训练策略。

Result: 实验表明APO2CS提升了偏好学习在组合优化中的表达能力和搜索能力，并在多种组合优化任务上表现出强有效性与适应性。

Conclusion: APO2CS通过优势感知与双层监督有效改进偏好学习，可作为通用训练目标，兼具训练与微调能力及多任务适应性。

Abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as a promising alternative to reward-based training for neural combinatorial optimization. However, existing methods typically rely on binary pairwise labels, which discard the magnitude of solution-quality differences and provide supervision only at the complete-solution level. We propose Advantage-aware Preference Optimization for Two-level Constructive Search (APO2CS), a preference-based training objective for constructive neural solvers that integrates both macro-level and micro-level supervision. At the macro level, APO2CS enriches pairwise preferences with an advantage term derived from objective-value differences. At the micro level, it compares partial trajectories, thereby providing denser supervision throughout the sequential construction process. The resulting objective can be used either to train a policy from scratch or to fine-tune a pretrained one. Experimental results show that APO2CS improves the expressiveness and search capability of preference learning for combinatorial optimization, while demonstrating strong effectiveness and adaptability across multiple combinatorial optimization tasks.

</details>


### [608] [Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11808)
*Iasonas Nikolaou,Evimaria Terzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究了基数约束下带bandit反馈的在线单调次模最大化，提出首个对任意单调次模函数具有√T依赖的多项式时间算法，期望(1-1/e)-regret为O(k√(nT log(n/k)))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线次模最大化在bandit反馈下（每轮只观测所选集合的值）缺乏对任意单调次模函数、且关于时间T为√T级的多项式时间算法，本文填补此空白。

Method: 使用随机采样与精心构造的势函数，将在线次模最大化归约为概率单纯形上的在线线性优化。

Result: 算法达到O(k√(nT log(n/k)))的期望(1-1/e)-regret，且为多项式时间；据作者所知是bandit设定下首个具√T依赖的此类算法。

Conclusion: 通过归约到在线线性优化，可在bandit反馈下高效实现近最优（1-1/e）的在线次模最大化，且对一般单调次模函数成立。

Abstract: We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\!\left(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)}\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

</details>


### [609] [KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11827)
*Zhaoye Pan,Tao Li,Yunjie Guo,Guanpu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对非可分代价与耦合约束下的分布式在线凸优化，提出一种随机化KKT扰动感知通信机制，按各原/对偶通道对KKT算子的影响分配通信刷新优先级，在$O(T^{2/3})$期望静态遗憾与约束违反下显著降低每比特通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非可分耦合导致全分布式决策只能依赖局部信念估计全局信息，而现有信念共识方案每轮交换全维原-对偶状态，通信开销随联合决策维数与网络规模同时增长；现有事件触发机制按状态变化或共识误差触发，但等幅误差经KKT算子放大后扰动差异悬殊，并不合理。

Method: 提出随机化KKT扰动感知通信机制：每个代理维护对联合动作的局部信念与共享拉格朗日乘子并与邻居交换；原、对偶两条通信通道的触发概率取决于其对KKT算子扰动的估计，将坐标下降的自适应采样思想从"计算块分配"迁移到"信息通道分配"，扰动估计大的通道获得更高刷新优先级。

Result: 在标准正则性假设下，算法达到$O(T^{2/3})$期望静态遗憾与$O(T^{2/3})$期望累积约束违反；数值实验表明相比信念共识基线，每传输比特的学习性能与约束满足性能均更优。

Conclusion: 以KKT扰动为判据的通道级随机通信调度可在保持无遗憾与收敛保证的同时有效压缩通信量，为耦合约束分布式在线学习提供了通信高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. We therefore propose a randomized KKT-perturbation-aware communication mechanism, where the triggering of each agent's primal and dual communication channels depends on their impact on the KKT operator. The proposed mechanism transfers the adaptive-sampling principle of coordinate descent from allocating computation across decision blocks to allocating communication across information channels: channels with larger estimated perturbations receive greater priority for refresh. Under standard regularity assumptions, the resulting algorithm achieves $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected static regret and $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected cumulative constraint violation. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved learning and constraint-enforcement performance per transmitted bit over belief consensus baselines.

</details>


### [610] [MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11839)
*Shirley X. Yu,Amey P. Pasarkar,Adji Bousso Dieng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOOD 基准表明，现有事后 OOD 检测器在材料 GNN 上几乎等于随机（AUROC≈0.5），失效源于方法瓶颈与编码器瓶颈两类原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事后（post-hoc）OOD 检测方法主要在图像分类上验证，缺少证据说明它们能否迁移到材料性质预测的图神经网络上，而科学场景对 OOD 检测需求很高。

Method: 构建 MOOD 基准：15 个事后检测器 + 2 个监督诊断探针，覆盖 4 种 GNN 架构、5 个 MatBench 任务、15 种物理驱动的成分/结构分布偏移，共 264 个评测设置、13,000+ AUROC 测量（3 个编码器训练种子）。

Result: 1）全部 15 个检测器 AUROC 约 0.5，接近随机；2）失效分为方法瓶颈（监督探针可区分 ID/OOD 但无监督检测器失败，说明嵌入中含未被提取的信号）与编码器瓶颈（连监督探针也无法区分，说明冻结表示中不含相关信号）；3）当 OOD 预测误差大于 ID 误差时，距离型与密度型检测器的 AUROC 与该误差差距大小相关。

Conclusion: 科学领域的可靠 OOD 检测需要显式保留 OOD 相关信号的表示学习策略，尤其对当前 GNN 架构完全不编码可提取信号的任务。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in high stakes scientific applications, yet methods that flag OOD inputs without retraining the model have been validated almost exclusively on image classification. We introduce MOOD (Materials Out-of-Distribution Detection), a benchmark for evaluating whether these post-hoc OOD detectors transfer to graph neural networks (GNNs) on materials property prediction. MOOD evaluates 15 post-hoc detectors and 2 supervised diagnostic probes across 4 GNN architectures, 5 MatBench tasks, and 15 physically motivated compositional and structural shifts, yielding 264 evaluation settings and over 13,000 AUROC measurements across three encoder training seeds. Our evaluation reveals three key findings. First, current post-hoc detectors perform near chance; all 15 detectors achieve an AUROC around 0.5. Second, detector failures decompose into two regimes: method bottlenecks and encoder bottlenecks. Method bottlenecks arise when supervised probes can separate in-distribution (ID) from OOD samples but unsupervised detectors fail, meaning that the embeddings contain OOD signal that current detectors do not extract. Encoder bottlenecks arise when even supervised probes fail to separate ID from OOD samples, indicating that the relevant shift is not accessible in the frozen GNN representation. Third, when OOD prediction error exceeds ID error, the AUROC of distance-based and density-based detectors correlates with the size of that gap. Collectively, these findings indicate that reliable OOD detection in scientific domains requires representation learning strategies that explicitly preserve OOD relevant signal, particularly for tasks where current GNN architectures encode no extractable signal at all.

</details>


### [611] [Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11847)
*Yu Gu,Zijun Yu,Chi-Kuang Yeh,Xinyu Wang,Ziyang Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Conformal Severity Control (CSC)，一种利用ATC药物层级结构量化错配严重程度、并在患者层面控制严重程度的事后校准框架，用于药物推荐预测集，无需重训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物推荐（多标签预测）的预测集评估与校准方法主要依赖精确重叠指标，把所有漏预测药物视为同等严重，忽略了预测集与漏预测药物在药物层级结构中的接近程度。

Method: CSC利用解剖治疗化学（ATC）层级结构量化错配严重程度；作为事后(post-hoc)框架，在不重新训练预测器的情况下控制患者级严重程度，并同时支持平均严重度与上分位数严重度（针对最高严重度错配）两种控制方式。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV数据集上实验表明，CSC能够跟踪用户指定的严重度容忍度，并使预测集从远距离错配转向精确或接近的匹配。

Conclusion: 层级感知的严重度校准可改善药物推荐预测集的质量，CSC提供了一种无需重训练、可调控严重度容忍度的事后方案。

Abstract: Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.

</details>


### [612] [Identifiable but Hard to Estimate: Rotation in Equally Spaced Overcomplete ICA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11852)
*Wenjun Xiao,Yinghao Fang,Hanxin Chen,Sihan Jia,Vince D Calhoun,Yuda BI*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究二维过完备独立成分分析(ICA)中等间距混合列、已知源数与源律情形下估计公共旋转所需样本量，证明固定相对角精度所需的样本量随源数指数增长，并用半列间距两旋转间Hellinger距离平方的倒数刻画该规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过完备ICA中识别旋转的可辨识性与所需样本量之间的关系不清，特别是样本量随源数如何增长缺乏精确刻画，作者希望给出该增长率的紧致上下界以及可达该规模的显式估计器。

Method: 设定等间距混合列、已知源数、公共源律与列范数；对固定的非高斯四阶Gram-Charlier源律，将旋转视为列间距模意义下可辨识。作者以相隔半个列间距的两个旋转间的Hellinger距离平方的倒数来刻画样本量，并构造一个显式的径向加权相位估计器，利用观测半径避免角谐波均值中的抵消。同时推导单观测总变差距离的精确指数衰减率，并给出含噪二元源示例。

Result: 样本量在绝对常数意义下被刻画为半列间距两旋转间Hellinger距离平方的倒数，且该显式径向加权相位估计器在旋转族上一致地达到该规模；单观测总变差距离的精确指数衰减率被确定，从而给出样本量指数的界，但其精确值仍未解决。含噪二元源示例表明观测特征函数的精确零线上法向导数可指数级小。

Conclusion: 二维过完备ICA中估计公共旋转的样本量随源数指数增长，其规模由局部Hellinger距离精确刻画并可被显式估计器达到；样本量指数的精确常数仍是开放问题。

Abstract: How many observations are needed to estimate a common rotation in two-dimensional overcomplete independent component analysis? We study equally spaced mixing columns with known source count, common source law, and column norm. For a fixed non-Gaussian fourth-order Gram-Charlier source law, the rotation is identifiable modulo the column spacing. Yet the sample size for fixed relative angular accuracy grows exponentially with the source count. We characterize this sample size, up to absolute constants, by the reciprocal of the squared Hellinger distance between two rotations separated by half the column spacing. An explicit radially weighted phase estimator attains this scale uniformly over the rotation family, using the observation radius to prevent cancellation in the mean of an angular harmonic. We also determine the exact exponential decay rate of single-observation total variation for the same pair. This gives bounds on the sample size exponent; its exact value remains open. Finally, a noisy binary-source example shows how an exact zero line of the observed characteristic function can have an exponentially small normal derivative.

</details>


### [613] [DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11856)
*Bingzhang Wang,Mo Poorsartep,Yasaman Esfandiari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeltaForge 提出首个事后构建的驾驶 VLA 混合专家模型，仅用各领域专家权重与少量代理数据即把 N 个独立微调模型整合为单一多领域模型，成本接近单模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶 VLA 模型按领域逐个微调，产生大量专精专家，权值合并随异构领域增多而掉精度，稠密 MoE 路由又过于昂贵，缺乏低成本的事后整合方案。

Method: 利用同一基座微调时权重更新共享结构，对所有更新联合做 SVD，分解为跨域共享部分与极小的领域特定部分；路由器只在小的领域特定分量上工作。另设两个协同的 clip 级盲路由（分别对应 VLM 推理专家与 flow-matching 动态专家），用代理集软标签训练。

Result: 在城市、越野、高速六领域（轿车、卡车、ATV）上，精度接近各领域专家，超过所有合并、路由、集中式与联邦基线，参数与计算近单模型；新增领域只需投影到共享基，无需端到端重训；并能泛化到未训练过的领域组合。

Conclusion: 联合 SVD 分解共享结构 + 轻量盲路由是低成本合并异构驾驶 VLA 专家的有效路径，兼具可扩展性与组合泛化能力。

Abstract: Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.

</details>


### [614] [Are UFOs Real? Introducing Unified Factored Organizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11862)
*Thomas X. Sheppard,Alon Albalak,Joel Lehman,Kenneth O. Stanley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文质疑"低损失即好表征"的假设，提出统一因子组织者（UFOs）——通过建模其他网络表征中的规律性来正则化表征学习，显著加速transformer的grokking。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统梯度下降训练的网络虽能达到低损失，却学到"断裂纠缠表征"（FER），相关概念断裂、无关概念纠缠；而人类参与的开放式演化能获得更好的"统一因子表征"（UFR）。作者希望将UFR的优势自动化、可训练化。

Method: 提出UFOs：训练一个网络去建模其他网络表征中的规律性，然后让目标任务网络同时优化任务损失并与UFO学到的表征对齐（作为正则项）。在图像回归域（表征易解释）和模算术grokking任务上（训练带/不带UFO正则的transformer）验证。

Result: 图像回归域中网络学到定性更优的表征。模算术任务中，配合权重衰减，UFOs将有衰减基线所需grokking步数减少10倍以上；无权重衰减时相比无正则基线减少100倍以上。

Conclusion: UFOs若成立，提示一种新范式：损失函数本身可以被训练，以学习"好表征"的有效模型。

Abstract: Implicit in much research in deep learning is the assumption that if a network achieves low loss, then it must have learned a good representation of its training data. Recent work by Kumar et al. (2025, arXiv:2505.11581) questions this assumption, arguing that networks trained with conventional gradient descent achieve low loss despite learning fractured entangled representations (FER), leaving related concepts disconnected and unrelated concepts entangled inappropriately. Kumar et al. further show that dramatically better representations are possible: a network evolved through an open-ended, human-in-the-loop process learned unified factored representations (UFR) that capture the regularities of the domain far better than a counterpart with nearly identical outputs trained with conventional gradient descent. Inspired by UFR, this paper introduces unified factored organizers (UFOs), networks trained to model regularities in the representations of other networks. A network can then be trained both to achieve low loss on its task objective and to align its representations with the model learned by the UFO. Networks trained with UFOs are shown to learn qualitatively superior representations in an image-regression domain where representations are easily interpretable. To provide quantitative evidence for the impact of UFOs on representation learning, a transformer is trained with and without UFO regularization to grok a modular arithmetic problem set. When combined with weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 10x relative to weight decay alone. Without weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 100x relative to an unregularized baseline. If UFOs are real, they suggest a new paradigm where loss functions themselves are trained to learn an effective model of good representation.

</details>


### [615] [Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11863)
*Francisco M. López,Francisco Cruz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Hindsight Critics，通过对critic使用事后对齐的状态-动作转移训练，缓解观测延迟带来的部分可观测问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 感官延迟使环境状态与智能体观测产生时间错位，将马尔可夫控制问题变为部分可观测问题，希望在训练阶段缓解这种错位。

Method: 将Soft Actor-Critic做非对称扩展：critic在事后对齐（hindsight-aligned）的转移上训练，actor则在仅有延迟观测的情况下，从critic产生的特权价值估计中学习。

Result: 在DelayBench上与感知延迟和不感知延迟的基线对比，Hindsight Critics能在无需在部署时修改智能体观测的前提下部分补偿观测延迟。

Conclusion: 利用事后信息可在训练中部分弥补观测延迟，且不改变部署时的观测方式。

Abstract: Sensory delays create temporal misalignments between the state of the environment and the observations available to an agent, turning Markovian control problems into partially observable ones. In this work, we inquire whether such misalignments can be mitigated during training by using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. We introduce Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of the Soft Actor-Critic for reinforcement learning under partial observability. The critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions whereas the actor learns from the resulting privileged value estimates despite only having access to delayed observations. Comparisons against delay-aware and unaware baselines on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without requiring modifications to the agent's observations during deployment.

</details>


### [616] [When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11881)
*Anna Lazareva,Alexander Tarakanov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文表明将LWR守恒律作为物理先验可提升交通状态估计的数据效率：在传感器稀疏时物理信息估计器泛化优于纯数据驱动模型（含kriging），并用单一损失条件PINN免除逐走廊调参。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的交通状态估计依赖密集传感器，覆盖率下降时性能急剧退化；作者希望验证引入物理守恒律能否提升稀疏条件下的数据效率与泛化能力。

Method: 将Lighthill-Whitham-Richards (LWR) 守恒律作为物理信息先验嵌入估计器，在四条真实走廊（NGSIM、I-80、PeMS04、PeMS08）上用留出传感器做泛化评测；与经典/深度kriging、匹配的平滑先验、同模型的EKF对比；并提出一种损失条件PINN以避免逐走廊损失权重搜索。

Result: 物理信息估计器在留出传感器上泛化良好，数据驱动模型则过拟合已观测点；在两条冲击波丰富的走廊上出现明显交叉：留出85-90%传感器时物理方法领先无物理网络约26-38%，90%时领先最强经典kriging约10-21%；匹配平滑先验无法复现该增益，同LWR的EKF在冲击走廊上被超越；损失条件PINN匹敌20点搜索且成本约低5倍。

Conclusion: 增益来自守恒律被施加的方式而非单纯平滑性或滤波框架，物理信息先验能有效提升稀疏交通状态估计的数据效率，且损失条件PINN可降低成本。

Abstract: Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

</details>


### [617] [How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11887)
*Yong Hwi Song,Keon Myung Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文在冻结DINOv2/v3 patch token上测试单步世界模型的两种主张：小m的nearest-of-m（IMLE）足够，且严格proper的能量分数应替代硬最小值；结论是m=16的IMLE优于50步flow matching等方法，但能量分数生成器未能避免记忆化，且在连续高维结果上欠分散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比确定性特征预测器的模式平均问题与扩散/flow matching需每步数十次网络评估的高开销，评估"小m是否足够"及"是否应改用严格proper能量分数"这两个近期猜想。

Method: 在可枚举未来的基准上，用冻结DINOv2/v3 patch token训练单步世界模型；对比nearest-of-m（m=16）、50步flow matching、单步flow生成器与匹配参数量的能量分数生成器；将nearest-of-m目标解释为m个采样码本的期望失真，并预先记录三条预测再做实验；另做自rollout上的逐步匹配与消融。

Result: 模式类不确定性下m=16的nearest-of-m覆盖优于50步flow matching（约1/30延迟）、单步flow与能量分数生成器，rollout保持在token流形上；验证三条预测：记忆化强度由miss失真I(m)而非miss概率支配且能量分数提高m无法摆脱；模式概率随m扁平化，与已知最优差0.01内；连续高维结果欠分散，限制其在真实机器人视频上的应用。自rollout逐步匹配将长期误差降低约三分之一；规划成功率未提升，尽管风险估计准确。

Conclusion: 小m的nearest-of-m是高效且有效的单步随机世界模型目标，能量分数的替代主张不成立；但其记忆化与欠分散是固有局限，且准确风险估计并不自动带来规划收益。

Abstract: One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

</details>


### [618] [On the Global Convergence of Stochastic Adam for Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11905)
*Yihang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为Adam在宽两层神经网络训练中建立了线性收敛保证，涵盖全批量与minibatch梯度，并推广到求解Poisson方程的PINNs，给出比现有分析更紧的收敛结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam在实践中常使训练损失近乎为零，但NTK分析多集中于GD/SGD。Adam分析困难在于：一阶动量在迭代间耦合随机梯度，自适应二阶预条件子又依赖同一次更新使用的随机梯度。

Method: 对全批量Adam构造Lyapunov函数控制历史动量影响；对minibatch Adam采用精确虚拟迭代表示、随机梯度与自适应预条件子依赖性的条件分析，以及二阶矩估计的一致集中界。进一步将分析扩展到PINNs求解Poisson方程，处理微分算子与内部/边界点分开采样。

Result: 证明全批量Adam下经验损失几何衰减，minibatch Adam在高概率事件上受限期望意义下几何衰减；PINNs在确定性与随机Adam下均获得全局收敛保证，并刻画minibatch大小的影响。

Conclusion: 结果弥合Adam经验成功与理论理解之间的差距，并为PINNs提供更锐利的收敛保证，明确网络宽度与Adam参数的条件。

Abstract: The Adam optimizer is widely used to train neural networks with highly nonlinear and nonconvex objective functions. Remarkably, Adam often drives the empirical training loss nearly to zero. This phenomenon has been partially explained by neural tangent kernel (NTK) analyses of gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD). However, analyzing Adam presents additional challenges. Its first-moment momentum couples stochastic gradients across iterations, while its adaptive second-moment preconditioner depends on the same stochastic gradient used in the update. In this paper, we establish linear convergence guarantees for Adam in training sufficiently wide two-layer neural networks with either full-batch or minibatch gradients. For full-batch Adam, we construct a Lyapunov function to control the effect of historical momentum. For minibatch Adam, our analysis builds on an exact virtual-iterate representation, a conditional analysis of the dependence between stochastic gradients and adaptive preconditioners, and uniform concentration bounds for the second-moment estimates. We prove geometric decay of the empirical loss for full-batch Adam and geometric decay in restricted expectation on a high-probability event for minibatch Adam. Beyond regression, we extend our convergence analysis to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving the Poisson equation, where differential operators and separate sampling of interior and boundary points introduce additional challenges. We establish analogous global convergence guarantees for both deterministic and stochastic Adam under explicit conditions on network width and Adam's parameters, characterizing the effects of minibatch size on convergence. These results help bridge the gap between Adam's empirical success and its theoretical understanding, providing sharper convergence guarantees for PINNs than existing analyses.

</details>


### [619] [Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11910)
*Sina Barazandeh,Benjamin E. Lundell,Jose Lugo-Martinez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在自动化实验室等有硬截止时间的场景中，LLM 迟到的答案会被安全回退动作替代，本文指出应按"实际执行动作的价值+到达时间"联合评估，而非分开报告质量与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多在自动化实验室中规划并执行实验，实验在模型推理期间持续运行且需满足硬性截止时间。迟到答案会被回退动作取代，因此"答案与回退相同"则无价值，而"与回退不同"的答案往往需要更长推理时间。传统服务指标（质量、延迟分开报告）会高估推理（thinking）模式的价值，作者希望量化这一偏差。

Method: 构造合成样本决策任务（最优选择已知，运行时强制执行截止时间），比较同一 LLM 的快速模式（直接作答）与思考模式（先推理）。进行预注册的 1200 个新决策回放实验；并做单 GPU Qwen3-8B 并发请求突发实验（请求数 8→56，45 秒截止）。核心方法是对比"按时率×平均答案价值"的预测值与实际交付价值。

Result: 在 1200 决策预注册回放中，超时的思考答案价值约为按时答案的 5 倍；用按时率乘平均答案价值做出的预测，约为思考模式实际价值的 2 倍，该预测将思考相对快速模式的优势高估了 0.0241/决策，300 个新决策重复实验中高估 0.0191，两个 95% 置信区间均不含零。Qwen3-8B 突发实验中，请求数从 8 增至 56 时，满足 45 s 截止的思考答案比例从 79.2% 降到 1.4%，尽管总输出量增至三倍。

Conclusion: 评估面向实验室的 LLM 智能体时，应同时测量每个答案的价值与到达时间，并对实际执行的动作打分；分开报告质量与延迟会系统性高估推理带来的收益，在高并发下尤其严重。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly plan and run experiments in automated laboratories. These experiments keep running while the model reasons and run on schedules with hard deadlines. If an LLM-generated answer arrives late, the system executes a safe fallback action instead, such as rejecting a sample. This creates a systems problem that standard serving metrics do not capture. An answer that matches the fallback adds no value, and answers that differ from the fallback may require more reasoning time. Reporting answer quality and latency separately can therefore overstate the value of reasoning. We test this on synthetic sample decisions, where the best choice is known exactly and a runtime enforces the deadline. We compare one LLM's fast mode, which answers directly, with its thinking mode, which reasons first. In a prespecified replay of 1,200 new decisions, thinking answers that missed a deadline were worth about five times as much as on-time ones. Multiplying the on-time rate by the mean answer value predicted about twice the value that thinking delivered. This prediction overstated thinking's advantage over fast mode by 0.0241 per decision, and by 0.0191 in a repeat on 300 new decisions. Both 95% confidence intervals excluded zero. In a single-GPU Qwen3-8B experiment using simultaneous request bursts, raising the number of requests from 8 to 56 reduced the share of thinking answers that met a 45 s deadline from 79.2% to 1.4%, although total output tripled. Evaluations of LLM agents for laboratories should therefore measure each answer's value and arrival time together and score the action that actually runs.

</details>


### [620] [CRAFT-GBM: Selecting Best Features for Gradient-Boosted Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11914)
*Basil Kuok,Yi Zhou,Yao Xuan,Shuping Li,Ke-Wei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CRAFT-GBM，一个基于置信排序的自适应特征采样LightGBM扩展，用训练中积累的分裂增益证据动态决定每轮搜索哪些、以及多少特征，并提供统计保证。默认模式下训练时间降39.74%、测试损失降1.04%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有梯度提升树特征采样需预先固定特征数量，且基本忽略训练过程中积累的分裂增益证据，导致特征选择不够自适应、效率与效果受限。

Method: 将根分裂增益转化为有界观测，构建在自适应、非平稳训练历史下仍有效的时间一致联合置信界；默认内生化模式保留尚不能被排除为最优的特征，使K_t由训练历史涌现；指定特征比例f时按区间点估计排序并给出近似top-K保证；在LightGBM内实现并保留特征捆绑表示。

Result: 14个公开与合成数据集族、四种噪声增强设置下：完全内生化设置18个实验中每次拟合训练时间降39.74%、几何平均测试损失低1.04%；指定特征比例时，外生CRAFT-GBM训练时间缩减比随机特征采样多出最多13.52个百分点，且聚合测试损失不高于全特征LightGBM。

Conclusion: 累积训练证据可支撑带统计保证的自适应特征搜索，同时保留原生梯度提升的实用优势。以至少1-δ的概率在初始化后所有轮次联合保留期望增益最大的特征。

Abstract: Feature subsampling is used to accelerate gradient-boosted trees, yet standard approaches fix the feature count in advance and largely ignore the split-gain evidence accumulated during training. We introduce CRAFT-GBM (Confidence-Ranked Adaptive Feature Tracking), a native LightGBM extension that uses this evidence to adapt which---and, by default, how many---features are searched each boosting round. CRAFT-GBM transforms root-split gains into bounded observations and constructs joint time-uniform bounds valid under adaptive, non-stationary training histories. In its default endogenous mode, after initialization, CRAFT-GBM retains exactly the features that cannot yet be ruled out as best, letting the selected feature-set size $K_t$ emerge from training history rather than a pre-specified fraction. With probability at least $1-δ$, every feature with the largest expected gain is retained jointly across all rounds after initialization. When a feature fraction $f$ is specified instead, CRAFT-GBM ranks features by their interval point estimates and provides an approximate top-$K$ guarantee for feature budget $K_f$. We implement CRAFT-GBM within LightGBM while preserving its native feature-bundling representation, and evaluate it across 14 public and synthetic dataset families and four noise-augmented settings. In the fully endogenous setting, CRAFT-GBM reduces per-fit training time by 39.74\% with 1.04\% lower test loss in the geometric mean across all 18 RQ1 experiments. Under pre-specified feature fraction $f$, Exogenous CRAFT-GBM also yields aggregate training-time reductions up to 13.52 percentage points larger than random feature subsampling, with no increase in aggregate test loss relative to full-feature LightGBM. Accumulated training evidence can thus support adaptive feature search with statistical guarantees while retaining the practical advantages of native gradient boosting.

</details>


### [621] [LBSNet: Lightweight Brain State Modeling via Learnable Spectral Prototypes for EEG-Based Fatigue Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11916)
*Kun Jia,Zhenyu Cao,Hanlin Yu,Zeyuan Li,Yixuan Liu,Zhongye Xia,Sen Song,Zhiyuan Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量网络 LBSNet，用原型化脑状态建模把局部频谱结构与时间聚合关联，实现受试者独立的 EEG 疲劳检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 EEG 疲劳检测方法结合多频带建模与自适应时间处理，但"跨频带频谱结构应如何影响各时间区间贡献"这一问题探讨不足。

Method: 频带特异性时间卷积+共享空间投影+跨频带重校准提取紧凑多频带特征；将窗口内相对频谱活动编码为归一化描述子，与可学习频谱原型软匹配；用原型分配与原型重要性共同决定时间权重进行功率聚合。

Result: 在 SEED-VIG 与 SADT 的受试者独立实验中优于七个基线且计算开销低；消融与可视化支持原型引导的时间加权，原型显示随疲劳加深相对跨频带频谱状态逐渐重分布。

Conclusion: 原型引导的频谱-时间加权机制有效且轻量，学习到的原型具备可解释性，能刻画疲劳演化的频谱状态转移。

Abstract: EEG-based fatigue detection requires modeling spectral information across bands and its temporal variation. Recent methods combine multi-band modeling with adaptive temporal processing, yet how spectral structure across bands should influence the contribution of each temporal interval remains insufficiently explored. We propose LBSNet, a lightweight network that uses prototype-based brain-state modeling to link local spectral structure with temporal aggregation. LBSNet extracts compact multi-band features through band-specific temporal convolution, shared spatial projections, and cross-band recalibration. Within each window, relative spectral activity is encoded as a normalized descriptor and softly matched to learnable spectral prototypes. Prototype assignments and learned prototype importance jointly determine temporal weights for power aggregation, allowing the spectral pattern of each window to guide its contribution to the prediction. Subject-independent experiments on SEED-VIG and SADT show that LBSNet outperforms seven baselines while maintaining low computational cost. Ablation and visualization analyses support prototype-guided temporal weighting, while the learned prototypes reveal a gradual redistribution of relative cross-band spectral states with increasing fatigue. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zy0929/LBSNet.

</details>


### [622] [An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11921)
*Xian Yeow Lee,Ryoichi Takase,Ahmed Farahat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究预训练表格基础模型（TabFM）能否作为免训练动力学模型用于世界建模，将下一状态预测表述为对转移对的上下文回归，并系统比较其在不同系统中的优势与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型是模型强化学习与机器人规划的关键组件，但通常需要针对具体任务、依赖大量交互数据进行训练。作者想探索免训练的预训练先验能否替代任务特定训练。

Method: 把下一状态预测重构为基于转移对（transition pairs）的上下文回归，直接用预训练TabFM做预测；在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准上与从头训练的LSTM、MLP、高斯过程及全量数据训练模型对比，并做多步自回归展开实验。

Result: 在有限转移数据下，TabFM几乎在所有设置中优于从头训练的LSTM/MLP；在运动任务上优于同等数据拟合的其他回归器，而高斯过程在平滑低维系统上更准。但全量数据训练的模型在多数系统上仍明显更好。自回归展开对上下文长度高度敏感：短上下文迅速退化为平凡基线，长上下文显著改善并在一个运动任务上超过训练好的LSTM。推理速度比LSTM慢约三个数量级。

Conclusion: 当前阶段的免训练先验在数据稀缺且上下文充足时可作为有效预测器，但尚不能替代训练好的世界模型用于规划。

Abstract: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.

</details>


### [623] [Constrained Variational Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11936)
*Shuchang Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出H-CVPO，将CVPO的变分框架扩展到混合动作空间，实现离散模式与条件连续控制的联合约束优化，并在仿真混合控制任务中取得更优的奖励-代价权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合动作空间下的约束强化学习需在长时程代价约束下协调离散模式与模式条件下的连续控制；已有方法多在参数空间直接优化因子化策略，缺少CVPO式“非参数改进+参数投影”分离机制。

Method: 将CVPO扩展到混合动作空间：在有界性与严格可行性下，约束E步零对偶间隙，双最优在正温度时给出闭式混合动作联合目标分布（奖励-代价指数重加权）；利用精确混合KL分解构造因子化M步，分别在离散与条件连续信任域下拟合目标；近似更新时基于紧致域连续性证明对偶极小元存在性，并用残差可行性判断是否投影目标。

Result: 精确E/M更新下证明固定参考代理改进与条件奖励-代价界（含充分可行性裕度条件）；消融显示代价感知重加权对约束控制贡献显著；仿真混合控制实验表明相比混合动作基线取得更优奖励-代价权衡。

Conclusion: H-CVPO为混合动作空间约束RL提供了有理论保证的变分策略优化方法，兼顾可行性控制与性能，代价感知重加权是关键设计。

Abstract: Constrained reinforcement learning in hybrid action spaces must coordinate discrete modes and mode-conditioned continuous controls under long-horizon cost constraints. Existing constrained hybrid-action methods typically optimize factorized policies directly in parameter space, whereas Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (CVPO) separates nonparametric improvement from parametric projection in its original continuous-action formulation. We introduce Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending this variational framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, its constrained E-step has zero duality gap and, when the dual optimum is attained at positive temperature, yields a closed-form joint target distribution over hybrid actions through exponential reward-cost reweighting. Using the exact hybrid KL decomposition, we formulate a factorized M-step that fits both policy components to this target under separate discrete and conditional-continuous trust regions. For exact E/M updates, we prove fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds with a sufficient feasibility-margin condition. For approximate updates, we establish the existence of a dual minimizer under continuity on a compact domain and use residual-based admissibility to determine whether to project the target. Ablations identify cost-aware reweighting as an important contributor to constraint control. Extensive experiments in simulated hybrid-control environments show that H-CVPO achieves favorable reward-cost trade-offs compared with hybrid-action baselines.

</details>


### [624] [Decision Aware Origin-Destination Demand Estimation with Structurally Constrained Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11946)
*Xianzhe Wang,Yueyue Fan,Johannes Royset*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向决策的OD需求估计框架：先以网络物理约束构造可行需求区域，再在该区域内最小化下游决策遗憾，使估计结果兼具数据一致性与决策相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统OD估计以与观测流量、历史需求模式的拟合程度评判质量，但数据拟合好并不等于下游决策好，应同时考虑估计误差对决策质量的影响。

Method: 利用结构约束的交通数据刻画可行OD需求区域，并通过几何表示对该区域进行近似与正则化；在正则化区域内以凸替代函数逼近下游遗憾，构建可求解的决策感知优化问题。

Result: 数值实验表明，相较传统估计基准，该框架能持续降低下游决策遗憾。

Conclusion: OD估计应与下游决策质量对齐，兼顾数据一致性与决策相关性可带来实际决策收益。

Abstract: Origin-destination (OD) demand plays an important role in transportation system design and management applications. Conventional OD estimation methods typically judge estimation quality based on how estimated demand aligns with observed traffic data and historical demand patterns. We argue that data alignment alone is insufficient; how errors in OD estimates influence downstream decision quality should also be considered. This paper develops a decision aware OD demand estimation framework that leverages structurally constrained traffic data to characterize an admissible demand region, within which we identify OD estimates that would lead to least regret in the downstream decision. Therefore, our OD estimates are both data-consistent and decision-relevant. Methodologically, we approximate the admissible demand region induced by physical network constraints through a geometric representation, which regularizes the search over feasible OD estimates. Within this regularized region, we use a convex surrogate of downstream regret to obtain a tractable decision aware optimization problem. Numerical experiments show that the proposed framework consistently reduces decision regret relative to conventional estimation benchmarks, demonstrating the value of aligning OD demand estimation with downstream decision quality.

</details>


### [625] [Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11960)
*Guoqing Zhang,Rafik Hadfi,Takayuki Ito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究构建了一个"运营感知"的多模态ICU出院风险评估CDSS，融合多智能体+自进化RAG提取病程记录信息、科室工作量与入院流量等运营特征、连续生命体征及稀疏ICD/DRG编码，并通过端到端多模态微调（分层冻结+差分学习率）解决文本负迁移，在MIMIC-III 2万次ICU住院的20次独立实验中取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有30天非计划ICU再入院预测模型普遍假设风险仅取决于患者个体病理生理状态，忽略医院运营背景与资源容量；而实际出院决策是患者稳定性与床位周转压力之间的动态权衡。此外还面临病程记录模板噪声、严重类别不平衡（约10.5%再入院）和警报疲劳等问题。

Method: 提出运营感知多模态CDSS：1）多智能体协同抽取+自进化RAG去除病程记录模板噪声；2）构建科室工作量指标与入院流量特征，并与连续生命体征、稀疏医疗编码（ICD/DRG）联合建模；3）采用数据归一化、类别重加权与决策阈值校准应对不平衡与警报疲劳；4）提出Transformer端到端多模态微调架构，使用逐层参数冻结与差异化学习率。

Result: 基于MIMIC-III 20,000次ICU住院、20次独立运行：仅用生命体征在真实类别不平衡下预测能力有限（PR-AUC 0.1387±0.0086）；直接拼接原始文本嵌入会损害树模型（XGBoost/LightGBM PR-AUC降至0.3893和0.4030）；端到端多模态微调架构逆转文本负迁移，取得最佳AUROC 0.8288±0.0110、PR-AUC 0.4373±0.0310、F1 0.4757±0.0196。

Conclusion: 运营指标可提供独立的风险信号；多模态端到端微调优于简单特征拼接，为高实用性的临床决策支持工具奠定工程基础。未来可进一步验证于多中心数据并落地临床部署。

Abstract: Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. In 20 independent runs across 20,000 ICU stays from MIMIC-III, empirical findings demonstrate that: vital signs alone have limited predictive capacity under real-world class imbalance (PR-AUC of 0.1387 +/- 0.0086); directly concatenating raw text embeddings degrades decision tree performance (XGBoost and LightGBM PR-AUC drop to 0.3893 and 0.4030); whereas an end-to-end multimodal fine-tuning architecture (Transformer E2E FineTune) utilizing layer-wise parameter freezing and differential learning rates reverses text negative transfer, achieving the highest AUROC of 0.8288 +/- 0.0110, PR-AUC of 0.4373 +/- 0.0310, and F1-Score of 0.4757 +/- 0.0196. Operational indicators supply independent risk signals, laying an engineering foundation for high-utility clinical decision support tools.

</details>


### [626] [Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11962)
*Ching Lam Choi,Antonio Torralba,Phillip Isola,Stefanie Jegelka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用"能量谱"（数据集在归一化真实图像密度模型下的对数概率分布）作为合成数据的审计与筛选原则，并定义能量级分布距离（ELD）来比较真实与合成数据的能量分布，用于预测和提升预训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据可扩展视觉预训练，但现有筛选标准（如FID）只能部分解释哪些数据集能训练出强表征，亟需新的数据审计与筛选原则。

Method: 以归一化真实图像密度模型下的对数概率分布（能量谱）为视角；提出ELD指标度量真实与合成能量分布的差异；并据此对合成数据重采样与多源混合，使合成能量直方图匹配真实图像。

Result: 在多种合成数据集上，ELD能揭示FID遗漏的不匹配，且在CNN与ViT自监督设置下，对预训练性能的预测优于FID、LPIPS方差与特征空间召回；基于ELD的重采样与混合在保持多样性的同时改善下游迁移。

Conclusion: 能量谱是有效的合成数据审计与筛选原则，ELD可作为超越FID的预训练性能预测器与数据筛选工具。

Abstract: Synthetic data can scale visual pretraining, but current selection criteria only partially explain which datasets train strong representations. We propose using the energy profile of a dataset--the distribution of log-probability levels it occupies under a normalised real-image density model--as an audit and curation principle for synthetic data. To operationalise this view, we introduce Energy-Level Distribution Distance (ELD), which compares real and synthetic energy distributions. Real images span sparse high-likelihood scenes and dense low-likelihood textures, so useful synthetic data should cover this energy range rather than collapse to likely but low-variation samples. Across diverse synthetic datasets, ELD exposes mismatches missed by FID and predicts pretraining performance beyond FID, LPIPS variation, and feature-space recall, including across CNN and ViT self-supervised settings. We then use ELD to resample and mix synthetic sources, matching the real-image energy histogram while preserving diversity and improving downstream transfer.

</details>


### [627] [Pairwise distortion distribution for compression and quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11967)
*Carl Nuzman,Jeongmin Chae,Kursat Rasim Mestav,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出成对失真分布(PDD)及其极限成对维度(PD)，将相关积分推广到一般失真度量，用于指导数据压缩中的潜在维度选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据压缩中潜在维度的选择至关重要，但传统超参数优化代价高且依赖经验(ad hoc)。内在维度是良好替代，可将Renyi信息维度(RID)与率失真维度和随机码本压缩联系起来。

Method: 引入成对失真分布(PDD)及其渐近极限——成对维度(PD)，将相关积分(correlation integral)推广到一般失真度量。

Result: 证明PD是RID的界，且PDD为随机码本量化性能提供下界。

Conclusion: PDD/PD可作为压缩、量化和降维应用中潜在维度选择的实用指导。

Abstract: Choosing the latent dimension is a critical challenge in data compression, where conventional hyperparameter optimization is costly and ad hoc. Intrinsic dimension provides a good alternative, which connects information-theoretic notions such as Renyi information dimension (RID) to rate-distortion dimension and random codebook compression. In this work, we introduce the pairwise distortion distribution (PDD) and its asymptotic limit, pairwise dimension (PD), which generalize the correlation integral to general distortion measures. We show that PD bounds RID, and PDD provides a lower bound for random codebook quantization performance, which can guide a practical use for compression, quantization, and dimensionality reduction applications.

</details>


### [628] [ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11976)
*Sina Barazandeh,Arth Banka,Jose Lugo-Martinez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ShiftCache：针对indel变异的精确复用系统，利用indel后的DNA等于参考序列平移这一特性，对每个平移量只编码一次参考序列，供同窗口同shift的多个变异共享，从而大幅加速序列到功能模型的变异打分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AlphaGenome、Borzoi等序列到功能模型需通过比较参考与替代序列预测来打分变异。indel会使插入点后的DNA在不同pooling网格上位移，无法直接复用参考的编码器激活，导致计算昂贵（AlphaGenome Atlas对1亿+indel各需三次全模型前向）。但indel后的DNA实质等于参考序列平移，存在可复用空间。

Method: ShiftCache对每个shift的平移参考只编码一次，在同窗口、同shift的所有变异间共享；它复制变异可复用的每个编码器输出，其余部分按批处理tile重算。这是一种精确复用系统，并适配了逐层复用方法作为对比基线。

Result: 在共享多indel的AlphaGenome held-out窗口、单A6000严格fp32下：比去重密集执行快3.5–6.5倍，比逐层复用适配快1.6–2.7倍；对Borzoi和AlphaGenome两个已发表分析快3.5–4.1倍，对Enformer快2.6倍。每个变异用独立居中131kb窗口时仅快1.36倍；插入长度高度多样或大量分散编辑时可能慢于逐层复用或密集执行。精确性上，满足条件时与密集执行数学结果一致；默认AlphaGenome与Borzoi输出均在1e-5容差内，更大tile批、Enformer或H100上有少量值超容差。

Conclusion: ShiftCache通过跨同shift变异的精确激活复用，显著加速indel打分，且保持与密集执行一致的数值精度，但加速受窗口策略、插入长度多样性与硬件/批大小影响，存在适用边界。

Abstract: Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. We present ShiftCache, an exact reuse system that encodes each shifted reference once and shares it among all variants scored in the same window with the same shift. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. On held-out AlphaGenome windows shared by many indels, in strict fp32 on one A6000, ShiftCache is 3.5 to 6.5$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution and 1.6 to 2.7$\times$ faster than our adaptation of layer-by-layer reuse to indels. It is 3.5 to 4.1$\times$ faster than dense reimplementations of two published analyses with Borzoi and AlphaGenome, and 2.6$\times$ faster than dense execution with Enformer. Scoring each variant in its own centered 131 kb window makes ShiftCache only 1.36$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution, and highly diverse insertion lengths or many dispersed edits can make it slower than layer-by-layer reuse or dense execution. For encoders that meet our conditions, ShiftCache computes the same predictions as dense execution in exact arithmetic. On an A6000, every checked output of the default AlphaGenome and Borzoi runs matches dense execution within an absolute and relative tolerance of $10^{-5}$. With larger tile batches, with Enformer or on an H100, a small fraction of values exceeds this tolerance.

</details>


### [629] [MixRoute: Rethinking Single-Distribution Training for Generalizable Neural Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11977)
*Hang Yi,Ziwei Huang,Yining Ma,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出单分布训练的零样本泛化潜力被低估，提出Mix Normalization这一简单架构归纳偏置，并构建含179个数据集的路由问题泛化基准，提出MixRoute框架，仅用均匀分布训练即可在多种未见分布上达到最优零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NCO方法通过复杂多分布训练或元学习提升跨分布泛化，隐含假设单分布训练只能得到较弱的零样本基线；本文挑战该假设，探索更简洁的泛化途径。

Method: 构建涵盖三类代表性路由问题、179个细粒度数据集（覆盖节点坐标、需求、容量、时间窗等分布偏移）的综合基准；提出MixRoute神经框架，通过自适应融合不同粒度的归一化统计量来缓解各类分布偏移，仅在均匀分布上训练。

Result: MixRoute在广泛未见过分布上无需任何分布特定适配即实现持续的最优零样本泛化性能，验证了单分布训练结合归一化偏置的有效性。

Conclusion: 归一化可作为复杂训练-适配方案的一种简洁替代，用于零样本泛化；单分布训练的潜力可通过简单的架构归纳偏置充分释放。

Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) is a promising paradigm for solving routing problems, yet its generalization across diverse data distributions remains a critical bottleneck. Existing methods typically tackle cross-distribution generalization through complex multi-distribution training or intricate meta-learning schemes, implicitly presuming that single-distribution training yields a weak zero-shot baseline. In this paper, we demonstrate that the potential of single-distribution training has been substantially underestimated and can be unlocked by a simple architectural inductive bias: Mix Normalization. To approach this, we first construct a comprehensive benchmark spanning three representative routing problems and 179 fine-grained datasets, capturing diverse shifts in node coordinates, customer demands, capacity and time windows. Building on this benchmark, we propose MixRoute, a neural framework that adaptively combines normalization statistics at different granularities to mitigate varying distribution shifts. Trained exclusively on uniform distributions, MixRoute generalizes effectively to a wide range of unseen distributions without any distribution-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MixRoute consistently achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot generalization. Our work revisits normalization as a parsimonious alternative for zero-shot generalization against complex training-adaptation schemes.

</details>


### [630] [FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11979)
*Md Anwar Hossen,Ali Jannesari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FireGate 在训练前为每个任务更新加一个门控分类器，使任何有界行为分数在任务流上的变化量不超过门的触发率，从而在训练前即可给出灾难性遗忘的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法的遗忘只能在训练后用人为选定的基准测得，既滞后又依赖基准选择。作者希望在训练前就能对"选定提示分布上输出改变的比例"给出界限。

Method: 把每个任务的更新（如新 LoRA）放在门后，门是建立在模型冻结底层上的分类器，逐提示决定是否启用该更新；门不触发时模型计算与旧模型完全一致。用不可改变行为的无标签提示校准每个门，以 PAC 保证训练前固定触发率，与训练出的权重无关。

Result: 理论上，有界行为分数变化 ≤ 门的触发率；遗忘由门的误报率界定，代价是门的功效——存在与最佳检验功效相当的下界。在最多五任务的强化学习流中，门控训练保留早期任务，仅改变 3.3% 的留出聊天回复，而无门控为 91.8%；七个模型上新任务增益与训练前测得的新任务提示触发率相关。

Conclusion: FireGate 提供了训练前可证的遗忘上界，覆盖部署时的门控模型及校准所用提示分布，但不防御主动搜索可触发门的对抗提示。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a deployed language model on one task after another can change behaviour that should stay fixed, such as earlier skills, general chat or refusals. Today, such forgetting is found only after training, on the benchmarks someone chose to run. This work bounds, before training, how often its outputs change on chosen prompt distributions. FireGate places each task's update, such as a new LoRA, behind a gate, which is a classifier on the model's frozen lower layers that decides for each prompt whether the update is used. Where no gate fires, the model computes exactly what the old one computes. As a result, on any prompt distribution, every bounded behaviour score changes by at most the gates' firing rate there over a whole task stream. Calibrating each gate on unlabeled prompts of what must not change fixes that rate before training, with a PAC guarantee, whatever weights training produces. Forgetting is thus bounded by the gate's false-alarm rate, and its price is the gate's power: no update, gated or not, that changes as few protected outputs can change new-task outputs more often than the best test of that level tells new-task prompts from protected ones. On reinforcement-learning streams of up to five tasks, gated training keeps the earlier tasks and changes 3.3% of held-out chat responses, whereas ungated training changes 91.8%. Across seven models, the gain kept behind the gate follows its firing rate on new-task prompts, measured before training. The certificate covers the gated model as deployed, on the prompt distributions sampled for calibration, not against an adversary who searches for prompts that fire the gate.

</details>


### [631] [HyInv Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11997)
*Haowei Lin,Cai Zhou,Xiangxin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HyInv是一个1.96M参数的骨架条件图网络（编码器-解码器），由研究智能体Hyra 2.0训练（随机序自回归预训练+结构奖励强化学习），推理时用分组草稿-重写采样器，在多数据集多预测器组合上scTM超越全部10个基线，且速度提升约52倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向折叠需为给定骨架设计多样且可折叠的氨基酸序列，候选筛选对多样性、折叠质量和生成效率都有高要求，现有方法在效率与质量间难以兼顾。

Method: 模型为轻量（1.96M参数）骨架条件图网络，编码器-解码器架构；训练由Hyra 2.0智能体完成，先做随机序自回归序列建模预训练，再做结构奖励强化学习；推理采用分组draft-and-rewrite采样器，草稿与重写使用不同温度；工程上用BF16数值优化，并保留精确FP32路径。

Result: BF16实现为402残基骨架设计128条序列仅50.6ms（单张H20），约为参考采样器52倍；FP32精确路径8.7倍加速且可复现参考序列；在5个数据集、7个数据集-预测器组合上，平均scTM高于全部10个外部基线，多样性相当或更高，显著领先ProteinMPNN与ProteinZero V2。

Conclusion: 同一默认设置可支持de novo骨架、口袋约束库设计、保留催化位点的酶重设计及loop重设计；代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Inverse folding designs amino-acid sequences for a given protein backbone, and screening needs many candidates that are both diverse and well folded. We present HyInv, a 1.96-million-parameter backbone-conditioned graph network with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team: pretrained with random-order autoregressive sequence modeling, followed by structure-reward reinforcement learning. At inference, a grouped draft-and-rewrite sampler that uses separate draft and rewrite temperatures improves refolding TM-score at matched diversity. An optimized implementation with BF16 numerics designs 128 sequences for a 402-residue backbone in 50.6 ms on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, about 52 times faster than the reference sampler, and an exact FP32 path that returns the reference sequences is 8.7 times faster. Across five benchmark datasets and seven dataset-predictor combinations, HyInv reaches a higher average scTM than all ten external baselines at comparable or higher sequence diversity, with large margins over ProteinMPNN and ProteinZero V2. The same default setting supports de novo backbones, pocket-constrained libraries, enzyme redesign with the catalytic site kept, and loop redesign. We have released our code and model at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv.

</details>


### [632] [Reward-Estimated Hypergradient for Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Black-Box Follower](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11998)
*Shigeki Kusaka,Mikoto Kudo,Takumi Tanabe,Akifumi Wachi,Youhei Akimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RE-HG 在黑盒双层强化学习中用逆强化学习从跟随者轨迹恢复奖励，证明势函数塑形带来的HG偏差在多样化动力学聚合下抵消，并用特征协方差小特征值截断处理有限样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双层RL的Hypergradient方法假设白盒跟随者且奖励已知，但实际中领导者只能观测跟随者轨迹，无法获知其奖励函数。

Method: 提出Reward-Estimated Hypergradients（RE-HG）：通过IRL从轨迹中恢复跟随者奖励以计算HG；理论分析IRL仅能识别到potential-based shaping的偏差，并证明线性奖励下在足够多样动力学上聚合时偏差抵消；有限样本下对聚合特征协方差做小特征值截断，恢复可识别子空间。

Result: RE-HG估计的梯度与白盒Oracle对齐，性能相当；截断还能抑制HG爆炸，使RE-HG避免Oracle在尖锐奖励地形中陷入的局部最优。

Conclusion: 黑盒双层RL下基于奖励估计的HG是可行的，聚合与谱截断是消除塑形偏差、稳定估计的关键。

Abstract: Hypergradient (HG) methods for bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) typically assume a white-box follower whose reward is known. In practice, however, the leader rarely knows the follower's reward function and can only observe its trajectories. We address this black-box setting and propose Reward-Estimated Hypergradients (RE-HG), which recovers the follower's reward from these trajectories via inverse RL (IRL). Yet IRL identifies the reward only up to potential-based shaping, a transformation that leaves the follower's behavior unchanged but biases the HG. We prove that, for linear rewards, this bias cancels when IRL estimates are aggregated across sufficiently diverse dynamics, which the leader's own updates naturally supply. To handle finite samples, RE-HG truncates small eigenvalues of the aggregated feature covariance, restoring the identifiable subspace and stabilizing the estimation. Experiments show that RE-HG estimates gradients aligned with a white-box Oracle and achieves comparable performance; empirically, the truncation also suppresses HG explosions, letting RE-HG avoid local optima that trap the Oracle in sharp reward landscapes.

</details>


### [633] [HyPLM Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12000)
*Haowei Lin,Cai Zhou,Xiangxin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HyPLM-Flash是一个由研究智能体Hyra 2.0训练的6.5亿参数掩码蛋白语言模型，仅用726亿token（ESM-2 650M的0.73倍）达SOTA级精度，推理速度快1.9–2.7倍，刷新蛋白语言模型帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白语言模型（PLM）精度虽高，但训练与部署算力需求持续增长，亟需在精度与成本间取得更优平衡的高效模型。

Method: 以研究智能体Hyra 2.0训练650M参数掩码语言模型，使用726B token（ESM-2 650M数据的0.73倍，E1-600M/ESM C 600M的1/5–1/8）；配套含融合算子与INT8矩阵乘法的推理引擎。

Result: 单张H20 GPU约13万残基/秒，较同类600M编码器快1.9–2.7倍；32任务/28检查点对比中ProteinGym零样本Spearman为0.409，与ESM-2 650M、ESM C 600M、E1-600M统计持平，生物适应度得分为单序列自监督模型最高；长程接触精度超越ESM-2 15B与ESM C 6B；掩码损失更低。

Conclusion: 以极少训练与推理成本达到SOTA精度，确立PLM新帕累托前沿，并开源权重与推理引擎。

Abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are standard tools for variant-effect prediction, protein annotation and design, but the compute needed to train and serve them keeps growing. We present HyPLM-Flash, an efficient and open PLM trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team. HyPLM-Flash is a 650-million-parameter masked language model trained on 726 billion tokens, 0.73 times the data of ESM-2 650M and a fifth to an eighth of the data of E1-600M and ESM C 600M. It runs on an inference engine with fused kernels and INT8 matrix multiplication, embedding about 130,000 residues per second on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, 1.9 to 2.7 times faster than other 600M-class encoders. In a matched evaluation against 28 public checkpoints on 32 tasks, HyPLM-Flash reaches a ProteinGym zero-shot Spearman correlation of 0.409, statistically tied with ESM-2 650M, ESM C 600M and E1-600M, and the highest organismal-fitness score among self-supervised single-sequence models. It gives the best long-range contact precision of all models evaluated, including ESM-2 15B and ESM C 6B, and a lower masked-residue loss than ESM-2 650M, ESM C 600M and E1-600M on held-out sequences and on recently released PDB chains. Matching state-of-the-art accuracy at a fraction of the training and inference cost, HyPLM-Flash sets a new Pareto frontier for protein language models. We have released the model weights and the inference engine at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/hyra-results/tree/main.

</details>


### [634] [Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12010)
*Panagiotis Krokidas,Christos Lazaridis,Vassilis Sioros,Efi-Maria Papia,Vassilios Constantoudis,George Giannakopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FruBO：用CatBoost代理模型驱动的贝叶斯优化框架，在60万种多层莫尔条纹构型中高效找到全局最优，仅需1470次采样（约1.15小时），远优于随机搜索与高斯过程BO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型材料设计空间中存在稀有的高性能构型，随机试错或纯代表性ML采样都难以定位；传统高斯过程BO在计算昂贵、空间巨大时受显存限制难以扩展。

Method: 提出灵活的贝叶斯优化框架FruBO。案例：六层旋转六角晶格叠加形成的多层莫尔图案，目标为最大化孔径尺寸均匀性（Jain公平指数），构建含60万构型的基准。对比随机探索、GP-BO，以及使用轻量CatBoost代理与委员会式不确定性估计的BO。

Result: 随机采样需533,012次评估（约31小时）才找到全局最优；GP-BO在采集290个样本后因GPU显存耗尽而不可行；FruBO+CatBoost仅用1,470次采样、约1.15小时即找到全局最优。

Conclusion: 可扩展的代理模型能显著提升BO在大规模纳米材料设计空间中的可行性与效率。

Abstract: Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GPU memory exhaustion after 290 acquired samples. In contrast, FruBO with CatBoost identifies the global optimum after 1,470 acquired samples and approximately 1.15 hours. These results demonstrate that scalable surrogate models can substantially improve the feasibility and efficiency of BO in large nanomaterials design spaces.

</details>


### [635] [FocusBranch: Combinatorial Branch-and-Bound for $\ell_0$ Neural Network Robustness Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12024)
*Renwei Deng,Yang He,Linyi Li,Yuepeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FocusBranch是一个用于ℓ0鲁棒性验证的组合分支定界框架，通过节点抽象（焦点像素集S+层级l）使ℓ0球可分解、可分支，并自适应选择起始层级与分支策略以最小化验证时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ℓ0扰动下的局部鲁棒性验证本质是组合问题，需在所有稀疏扰动像素子集上推理。现有方法难以高效处理这种组合爆炸，缺乏可分解的分支结构与自适应的验证计划。

Method: 提出节点抽象（S, l），允许S之外最多ε−l个像素被扰动，统一两种分支机制：具体节点通过上影集固定更多扰动位置，超级节点通过覆盖设计用更少子节点覆盖大量扰动情形。通过在节点约束ℓ0球上具体化线性松弛证明节点安全，并对未知节点递归分支；同时采样各层级节点估计安全率与代价，选择预测验证时间最小的起始层级与分支策略。

Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上的全连接与卷积分类器实验表明，FocusBranch在不同架构上均能有效验证ℓ0鲁棒性，并优于当前最优验证器。

Conclusion: 将ℓ0球可分解化为带焦点集与层级的节点抽象，并结合覆盖设计与自适应层级选择，可有效缓解ℓ0验证的组合难题，实现跨架构的高效鲁棒性验证。

Abstract: Verifying the local robustness of neural networks under $\ell_0$ perturbations is inherently combinatorial, as it must reason over all sparse subsets of $ε$ perturbed pixels. This paper presents FocusBranch, a combinatorial branch-and-bound framework for $\ell_0$ robustness verification. The key insight is to make the $\ell_0$-ball decomposable and branchable using a node abstraction, which consists of a focus pixel set $\mathcal{S}$ and a level $l$, permitting at most $ε-l$ pixels outside $\mathcal{S}$. This abstraction unifies two branching mechanisms: concrete nodes branch through upper shadows to fix additional perturbed locations, while super nodes branch through covering designs to cover many perturbation cases with fewer child nodes. FocusBranch proves node safety by concretizing linear relaxations over node-constrained $\ell_0$-balls and recursively branches on unknown nodes. Rather than relying on a fixed verification plan, it samples nodes across levels to estimate safe rates and costs, then selects a starting level and branching strategy predicted to minimize verification time. Experiments on fully connected and convolutional classifiers for MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 show that FocusBranch verifies $\ell_0$ robustness effectively across architectures and outperforms state-of-the-art verifiers. The code is available at: https://github.com/simpl-group/FocusBranch.

</details>


### [636] [MambaPD: Bidirectional Selective State Space Model for Parkinson's Disease Detection from Resting-State EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12026)
*Ayesha Zulfiqar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MambaPD——一种用于静息态EEG帕金森病检测的双向选择性状态空间模型，并在受试者独立的交叉验证协议下与四种基线模型进行严格对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帕金森病通常在显著多巴胺能神经元丢失后才被诊断，而静息态EEG的α波减慢与相干性下降等异常出现更早。尽管许多已发表的EEG-PD检测器声称准确率超过95%，但它们多采用按epoch划分的数据集划分方式，导致受试者身份泄漏，性能被高估。

Method: 构建MambaPD模型，融合通道混合、patch token化与双向Mamba编码器（选择性状态空间模型）；在UNM与SanDiego两个公开数据集上，采用受试者独立的5折交叉验证（检查点在选择折上挑选），与TCN、带注意力的BiLSTM、EEGNet及patch Transformer四种基线对比。
