Conclusion: 将搜索几何的尺度显式化（阈值+预算）比学习几何更简单有效，自适应区域控制对样本效率有实质贡献；TRACE可推广至真实DFT驱动的催化剂稳定性设计。

Abstract: Optimizing molecules under small evaluation budgets requires deciding both where in chemical space to search and which candidate within that region to evaluate. We introduce Trust Region Adaptive Chemical Exploration (TRACE), a framework for open-ended molecular Bayesian optimization (BO), where candidates are generated on demand rather than selected from a fixed library. TRACE combines an objective-free graph-perturbation mechanism with a fixed, chemistry-aware Gaussian process (GP) surrogate using fragprints, a representation combining molecular fingerprints and fragment descriptors. Rather than learning the search geometry itself, TRACE makes the scale of chemical exploration explicit through a Tanimoto-similarity threshold controlling chemical extent and a cardinality budget controlling candidate-search breadth. A simple success/failure controller expands or contracts both quantities during optimization, while the GP and acquisition function select which admissible molecules to evaluate. Across six challenging molecular optimization benchmarks under matched 1,000-evaluation budgets, TRACE achieves the strongest overall sample efficiency as measured by the best molecule found as evaluations accumulate. Crossed ablations on two objectives further show that adaptive region control contributes beyond the proposal mechanism, while its benefit depends on the proposal distribution. We further apply TRACE to the stability of iron phthalocyanine (FePc), a non-precious molecular electrocatalyst whose degradation can involve loss of the Fe center. Using a first-principles density functional theory (DFT) workflow designed for accurate energy evaluation, TRACE increases the computed thermodynamic resistance to Fe dissolution from 0.42 to 2.59 eV over 80 designed evaluations.

</details>


### [674] [Controlled Binary Assignment Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12668)
*Paul Fröhling,Christoph Schnörr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种几何方法，用于表示和学习图上二值数据标注的深度分配流(assignment flows)的时变参数化，通过完全测地子流形上的最优控制参数流及其融合来构建二值深度分配流网络层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度分配流的高维对称参数空间表示与学习缺乏几何化、可解释的时变参数化方案，本文旨在以几何局部综合方式实现高度并行的参数化学习。

Method: 每条边携带一个在2维完全测地子流形上的最优控制参数流，目标源自输入数据的非局部线性尺度空间表示；三条此类流在5维完全测地子流形上聚合，并从数据中学习；这些流的融合决定高维对称参数空间中的轨迹，再通过几何积分得到二值深度分配流各层。

Result: 数值实验展示了该高度并行的几何局部综合方法对高维深度分配流参数化的表达能力，同时也揭示了其局限性。

Conclusion: 几何局部综合可实现并行、可解释的二值深度分配流参数化学习，但高维表达能力存在一定限制，需进一步改进。

Abstract: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

</details>


### [675] [Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12643)
*Omer Hemo,Ido Sefi,Mirco Mutti,Aviv Tamar,Kfir Y. Levy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于控制变量的保守仿真辅助强化学习，仿真数据只用于降方差而不直接塑造学习目标，在策略评估、actor-critic与离线RL中均优于标准仿真混合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL依赖昂贵且有噪声的真实环境数据；仿真器可提供大量数据，但标准仿真混合（直接混合真实与仿真经验）会因仿真不准确而使解偏离最优策略，导致性能下降。

Method: 基于控制变量的保守仿真辅助学习：仿真数据仅用于降低学习过程的方差，而非直接参与学习目标。先在策略评估中推导，再嵌入actor-critic框架用于策略改进，并扩展到离线RL场景。

Result: 在多个MuJoCo基准任务上实验，相比标准仿真混合方法取得性能提升。

Conclusion: 控制变量是仿真辅助强化学习的有效工具，可避免仿真偏差污染学习目标，同时利用仿真数据降方差。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [676] [Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12777)
*Duy-Cuong Bui,Trung-Anh Dang,Vincent Nguyen,Duc V. Le,Ngoc-Son Vu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TEA-Prompt提出基于单共享prompt的持续学习方法，通过在注意力logits注入输入条件化的token相关性分数，并用注意力行为锚定损失约束token的注意力输出，实现参数与行为双重保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单prompt持续学习方法在参数空间保护旧知识（冻结、扩展、稀疏门控），牺牲可塑性，且共享token的漂移仍会破坏旧类上的prompt功能。真正应被保存的是prompt的行为而非参数。

Method: 包含两个模块：(i) token评估模块，为每个prompt token分配连续的、输入条件化的相关性分数并注入注意力logits，实现soft的任务特化而不丢弃token；(ii) 注意力行为锚定损失，仅用紧凑的高斯query统计（无需存储旧图像）将每个token的注意力输出约束在类特定query区域附近，并按token历史相关性加权。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R、CUB-200上取得SOTA准确率，遗忘显著降低，仅需0.38M参数，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过锚定注意力行为而非冻结参数，使参数可自由更新而保持token交互不变，兼顾可塑性与稳定性，实现高效的单prompt持续学习。

Abstract: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git

</details>


### [677] [Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12662)
*Zhiyuan Li,Lequan Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HC-ROCP：一种免训练、带危害惩罚的保形预测框架，用冻结分类器概率选择预测集与动作，在低危误判代价高的场景下把严重动作错误从4.68%降到0.54%，并在证据不足时拒绝子组声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将黑色素瘤病例路由到常规随访属于严重动作错误，仅靠诊断覆盖率无法排除这类风险；现有保形/风险最优方法只关注覆盖与平均风险，缺少对高危害动作的显式约束与对无支持声明的拒答机制。

Method: 在冻结分类器输出概率上，于选择预测集和动作时加入危害惩罚，构建危害约束的风险最优保形预测（HC-ROCP）。框架免训练，在互不相交的校准划分上做多重性调整后检验策略；对可支持的主张给出认证，对证据不足者给出描述性回退策略或直接拒绝子组声明。在COVID-19胸片、ISIC 2019皮肤镜、EyePACS→APTOS糖网迁移上做回顾性评估，共10个校准种子。

Result: 10个种子下COVID-19严重动作错误由精确风险最优基线的4.68%降至0.54%；5%预算下COVID-19与ISIC的全局主张获认证，而罕见的鳞状细胞癌子组主张被拒绝；1%预算下所有设置仅得描述性报告。另给出各预算下通过零错误全局危害门所需的最少严重病例数，作为后续数据采集的起点。

Conclusion: 显式危害惩罚加严格校准分割与多重性调整，可在不训练模型的情况下显著降低高危害动作错误，同时保持诚实的证据边界：可认证则认证、不可认证则拒答并给出采集建议。

Abstract: Routing a melanoma case to routine follow-up is a serious action error that diagnostic coverage alone does not rule out. We present Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (HC-ROCP), a training-free framework that uses frozen classifier probabilities and adds a harm penalty when choosing prediction sets and actions. We test the resulting policies on disjoint calibration splits with multiplicity adjustment. HC-ROCP certifies supported claims, reports descriptive fallback policies, and refuses unsupported subgroup claims. We evaluate these outputs retrospectively on COVID-19 radiographs, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and EyePACS-to-APTOS retinopathy transfer. Across ten calibration seeds, HC-ROCP reduces COVID-19 severe-action errors from the exact risk-optimal baseline's 4.68\% to 0.54\%. At a 5\% budget, global claims are certified for COVID-19 and ISIC, but the rare squamous-cell-carcinoma claim is refused. At 1\%, all settings receive descriptive reports. For each budget, we also report the minimum severe-case count needed to pass the global harm gate with zero errors, providing a starting point for further data collection.

</details>


### [678] [Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12884)
*Zhaoying Pan,Yipei Wang,Shenyu Lu,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑"平衡各子群比例"是否为实现子群鲁棒泛化的唯一最优数据配置，扩展高斯特征模型刻画一般训练子群分布下的性能景观，发现多种（包括显著不平衡的）配置可与平衡配置表现相当，并给出基于梯度调整子群比例的更高效方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 子群偏移下模型平均精度高但测试表现差，常见的数据层解法是强制子群比例平衡，但完全平衡代价高、有时不可行，且未必必要。作者因此想验证平衡数据是否为鲁棒子群泛化的唯一最优配置。

Method: 将高斯特征模型（Gaussian feature-model）框架推广到一般的训练子群分布，理论刻画性能景观；并推导基于梯度的子群比例调整方向，用于更高效地提升调整后精度与最差子群精度。

Result: 理论分析表明存在多种配置（包括显著不平衡的配置）能达到与平衡配置相当的鲁棒性能；基于梯度的子群比例调整方向在提升调整精度和最差组精度上更高效。

Conclusion: 平衡训练数据并非鲁棒子群泛化的唯一最优解，策略性地分配数据比简单平衡更灵活、更有原则性。代码开源于 https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation 。

Abstract: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation.

</details>


### [679] [Trade Promotion Optimisation for Consumer Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12665)
*Ankur Verma,Namrata Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出端到端促销优化(TPO)系统，将类比SKU、点弹性、弹性曲线、价格推荐、促销提升与净提升串成一条链，并在39个SKU的品牌实验中实现销量+20.6%、收入+6.9%、利润率持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 促销占快消营收很大比例，但多数计划者仍对每个商品用单一且往往不可靠的价格弹性来设定折扣，缺乏可靠的弹性和全链路优化工具。

Method: 促销后时点用滚动常规价的价格下探事件测弹性；促销时点用因果估计量（对趋势/季节/促销做残差化、Tobit似然处理缺货截断、从首个干净促销周自更新）。证据弱的商品从类比SKU借用点弹性和曲率，类比SKU由类别/品牌/子类/价格线/描述的交叉验证岭回归模型选取。优化器分离自价格提升、替代效应与促销后回落，并调整库存和促销资金。

Result: 39个SKU品牌（平均弹性-3.06）四周促销实验中，方案使销量提升20.6%、收入提升6.9%，利润率持平；类比池化使弹性误差相比层级平均减半。

Conclusion: 端到端TPO链条可行且有效，类比SKU池化显著提升弱证据商品的弹性估计精度，可在保持利润率的同时提升销量与收入。

Abstract: Trade promotions consume a large share of consumer-goods revenue, yet most planners still set discounts with a single, often unreliable, price elasticity per item. We present an end-to-end Trade Promotion Optimisation (TPO) system built as one chain: analogue SKUs, point elasticity, elasticity curve, price recommendation, promotional lift and net lift. Elasticity is measured at post-promo time from directional price-dip events against a rolling regular price, and at promo time by a causal estimator that residualises trend, seasonality and promotion, handles stock-out censoring with a Tobit likelihood and updates itself from the first clean promotion week. Items with weak evidence borrow the point elasticity and the curvature from analogue SKUs chosen by a cross-validated ridge model over category, brand, sub-category, price line and description. The optimiser separates self-price lift from substitution and post-promo dips and adjusts for inventory and trade funding. In a four-week promotion experiment on a 39-SKU consumer brand (mean elasticity -3.06), the plan lifts units by 20.6% and revenue by 6.9% at flat margin. Analogue pooling halves elasticity error relative to hierarchy averaging.

</details>


### [680] [CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12689)
*Jan-Hendrik Ewers,Santiago A. Cadena,Nicolò Foppiani,Andrea Merlo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 CoilStellaration 数据集与基准，用于学习从目标等离子体磁场与工程要求到线圈几何的映射，包含 177,000 组优化细丝线圈，并验证学习模型可加速传统线圈优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿星器线圈设计是一个高度非线性、无闭式解、常非唯一的逆问题，需兼顾目标磁场复现与工程制造约束，门槛高、难度大，作者希望降低机器学习与优化研究者进入该领域的壁垒。

Method: 构建数据集：177,000 组针对 ConStellaration 等离子体平衡优化的细丝线圈组，涵盖多种线圈数与场周期数，并附带采样的工程要求及达成的几何与磁场指标；设定基准任务，要求模型在给定目标平衡以及线圈-线圈/线圈-等离子体间距、曲率、磁场误差约束下预测线圈；提供基线模型与评测代码。

Result: 磁场精度仍是主要挑战，学习模型很少能同时满足所有约束；但用学习预测初始化传统线圈优化，可加速优化早期的进展。

Conclusion: CoilStellaration 为线圈直接生成与学习式优化初始化提供可复现研究平台，有望加速仿星器线圈设计与实用化聚变电站的进展。

Abstract: Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. The benchmark asks models to predict coils conditioned on a target equilibrium and requirements on coil-coil and coil-plasma spacing, curvature, and magnetic-field error. We show that magnetic-field accuracy remains the main challenge, with learned models rarely satisfying all requirements simultaneously. However, using learned predictions to initialize conventional coil optimization can accelerate early progress. We release baseline models and evaluation code to support reproducible research on both direct coil generation and learned optimization initializations. By lowering the barrier for machine learning and optimization researchers to engage with stellarator coil design, we aim to accelerate progress toward practical, cost-effective stellarator power plants.

</details>


### [681] [Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12694)
*Tanmay Devale,Steve Hanneke,Amirreza Shaeiri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在agnostic设定下研究边际非均匀学习框架中的二分类问题，证明标准agnostic情形下依赖边际分布无助于改善速率（VC有限则最优为1/√n，否则任意慢），而在relaxed agnostic（竞争(1+λ)倍最优误差）情形下出现三分律：有限类为e^{-n}指数速率、无限类但VC有限为1/n线性速率、VC无限则任意慢，并给出细粒度最优速率uVCE(H)/(λn)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在realizable设定下，已有结果表明学习速率可以依赖无标签数据的边际分布而得到改善（边际非均匀框架）。作者希望弄清这种"依赖边际分布的优势"在更一般的agnostic设定中是否依然存在，并刻画细粒度速率。

Method: 采用边际非均匀学习框架：速率中的常数可依赖无标签数据的边际分布，但保证需对所有条件标签分布一致成立。分别分析两个准则：(1) 标准agnostic设定，直接借助经典agnostic PAC学习结果推导上下界；(2) relaxed agnostic设定，与(1+λ)倍最优概念误差竞争，通过组合复杂度（VC维、uVCE维度）进行精细分析。

Result: 标准agnostic设定：对任意VC(H)有限的类，最优速率为1/√n；VC无限时任意慢速率不可避免；细粒度最优速率为√(VC(H)/n)，即依赖边际分布无帮助，与realizable情形形成对比。Relaxed agnostic设定：出现三分律——类有限时指数速率e^{-n}，类无限但VC有限时线性速率1/n，VC无限时任意慢；细粒度最优速率为uVCE(H)/(λn)。

Conclusion: 边际分布带来的优势仅在relaxed agnostic设定中体现，此时速率结构与realizable设定相似并由uVCE维度精确刻画；在标准agnostic设定下边际分布无法改善速率，最优速率仍由VC维决定。

Abstract: We study the problem of binary classification in the marginal-nonuniform learning framework in the agnostic setting. In this model, the constants in the learning rate may depend on the marginal distribution of the unlabeled data, but the guarantee must hold uniformly over all conditional distributions of the labels. We also study fine-grained rates.
  We consider two criteria.
  (1) The standard agnostic setting, where the learner competes with the best concept in the class. In this setting, an immediate consequence of standard agnostic PAC learning results gives us the optimal rate of $\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ for every class $\mathcal{H}$ with finite $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ and shows that arbitrarily slow rates are necessary otherwise. This also gives us the optimal fine-grained rate of $\sqrt{\tfrac{\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})}{n}}$. Therefore, the dependence on the marginal distribution does not help, which is in contrast to the realizable setting.
  (2) In the relaxed agnostic setting, where the learner competes with $(1+λ)$ times the error of the best concept for a fixed $λ\in (0,1]$, the picture from the realizable setting reappears. We obtain a trichotomy of the achievable optimal rates: exponential rates of the form $e^{-n}$ arise precisely when the class is finite; linear rates of the form $\tfrac{1}{n}$ arise when the class is infinite but $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})$ is finite; and arbitrarily slow rates occur when $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal{H})=\infty$. We also obtain the optimal fine-grained rate of $\tfrac{\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})}{λn}$, where $\mathrm{uVCE}(\mathcal{H})$ is a recently introduced combinatorial complexity dimension called the uncentered $\mathrm{VC}$-eluder dimension.

</details>


### [682] [TACTUS: A Robotic Palpation System for Spatially Heterogeneous Hardness Mapping of Woody Breast Myopathy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12695)
*Chaitanya Pallerla,Yihong Feng,Avisekh Tripathy,Yang Tian,Pouya Sohrabipour,Amirreza Davar,Casey M. Owens,Cengiz Koparan,Dongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TACTUS是一种自动化触觉阵列系统，能在约30秒内于20个解剖位点生成厚度归一化的三维硬度图，可区分不同严重程度的木性胸（WB）肌病并揭示其空间异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 木性胸是一种空间异质的纤维退行性病变，现有力学参考方法依赖单点或顺序压缩测量，无法刻画空间硬度变异，限制了WB的精确表征与分类。

Method: TACTUS集成20个独立电机驱动的触觉单元（含力敏电阻与编码器线性执行器），配合LiDAR深度相机进行表面轮廓测量与自适应压缩，在20个解剖位点生成厚度归一化三维硬度图。用100个鸡胸肉样本、四个WB严重程度等级进行评估，并采用方差分析、半变异函数、局部变化熵及异质性分析。

Result: 不同严重程度间力值差异显著（ANOVA p<0.001），颅侧区分度最强，且检测到纹理分析仪未发现的尾侧效应；个体层面力值与纹理分析仪中度但显著相关（r=0.441, p<0.001）；随WB加重，硬度变异性增大且呈解剖结构化分布。

Conclusion: TACTUS为自动化、不依赖操作者的空间分辨力学表征平台，可作为真值生成工具，支撑基于高光谱与近红外光谱的WB分类系统。

Abstract: Woody breast (WB) myopathy is a spatially heterogeneous fibro-degenerative condition of the broiler Pectoralis major muscle. Existing mechanical reference methods rely on single-point or sequential compression measurements, limiting characterization of spatial hardness variability. This study presents TACTUS (Tactile Adaptive Conformal 3D Uniform Sensing), an automated tactile array that generates thickness-normalized, three-dimensional hardness maps at 20 anatomically distributed locations within approximately 30 s. TACTUS integrates 20 independently motorized tactuators with force-sensing resistors and encoder-driven linear actuators, alongside a LiDAR depth camera for surface profiling and adaptive compression. The system was evaluated using 100 broiler breast fillets across four WB severity classes (Normal, Mild, Moderate, Severe). TACTUS identified significant force differences among severity classes (ANOVA, p < 0.001), with the strongest differentiation in the cranial region and a significant caudal effect not detected by texture-analyzer measurements. Fillet-level TACTUS force showed moderate but significant correlation with texture-analyzer measurements (Pearson r = 0.441, p < 0.001). Semivariogram, local change entropy, and heterogeneity analyses revealed increasing and anatomically structured hardness variability with WB severity. These findings demonstrate TACTUS as an automated, operator-independent platform for spatially resolved mechanical characterization and ground-truth generation to support hyperspectral and near-infrared spectroscopy-based WB classification systems.

</details>


### [683] [Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12696)
*Marco Bressan,Nataly Brukhim,Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi,Emmanuel Esposito,Yishay Mansour,Shay Moran,Maximilian Thiessen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 $Z$-learner 概念，用集合 $Z\subseteq[0,1]^2$ 刻画弱学习器的联合假阳性/假阴性保证，并给出可提升性（boostability）的完整几何刻画与无需预知 $Z$ 的自适应提升算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中不同类型错误代价不同（如医疗诊断中假阳性与假阴性影响不同），不应简单聚合。经典 boosting 理论只关注总误差或统一 margin，无法刻画分布对可达学习保证的影响，因此需要更灵活、面向 FP/FN 分别保证的弱可学习性概念。

Method: 重新审视经典 boosting 理论，定义 $Z$-learner：从集合 $Z$ 中返回具有联合 $(\mathrm{FP},\mathrm{FN})$ 保证的弱假设；该定义推广 $\gamma$-弱学习（取 $Z=\{(z_1,z_2): z_1+z_2<1/2-\gamma\}$）。随后研究哪些 $Z$ 可被提升，基于离散与计算几何中的 centerpoint 定理给出几何刻画，并设计不依赖 $Z$ 先验知识的自适应提升算法。

Result: 给出可提升集合 $Z$ 的完整几何刻画，将经典 boosting 二分性与 Bressan 等（COLT 2025）的多目标扩展统一为特例；提出自适应算法，在未知 $Z$ 与 margin 参数的情况下实现提升，推广 AdaBoost 处理未知 margin 的能力；并证明 $Z$-learner 可实现置信度放大（confidence amplification）。

Conclusion: $Z$-learner 框架把 boosting 从单一误差度量推广到区分 FP/FN 的多目标设定，完整回答了可提升性问题，并提供实用的自适应算法与置信度放大能力；分析相比经典 boosting 显著更复杂，依赖于 centerpoint 定理等几何工具。

Abstract: Not all mistakes are alike. For example, in medical diagnosis, false positive and false negative mistakes have a different impact and should not be aggregated. By revisiting the classical theory of boosting through this lens, we introduce the notion of $Z$-learner, which returns weak hypotheses achieving joint false-positive/false-negative guarantees $(\mathrm{FP},\mathrm{FN})$ from some set $Z \subseteq [0,1]^2$. This formulation generalizes the standard notion of $γ$-weak learning--recovered by taking $Z=\{(z_1,z_2): z_1+z_2<1/2-γ\}$--and allows for more flexible notions of weak learnability that account for the impact of the distribution on the achievable learning guarantees. This raises a natural question: which sets $Z$ are boostable? We answer this by giving a complete geometric characterization that unifies, as special cases, both the classical boosting dichotomy and the recent multi-objective extension of Bressan et al. (COLT 2025). We also present an adaptive algorithm for boosting $Z$-learners without relying on the prior knowledge of $Z$, generalizing AdaBoost's ability to handle unknown margin parameters. Finally, we demonstrate that $Z$-learners can achieve confidence amplification. However, the analysis is significantly more involved than in classical boosting and relies on the centerpoint theorem from discrete and computational geometry.

</details>


### [684] [Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12702)
*El Mustapha Mansouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将Fisher-glass框架扩展到背景（nuisance）调整后的信息量与局部分类难度、子群体审计的联系，并在Waterbirds上验证：同一批图像在保留背景类型时准确率93.2%，改变背景时降至40.6%（相差52.6个百分点），且高预测性能与高预测信息量可能背离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅看预测准确率无法说明在扣除背景等nuisance变化后还剩多少任务信息；背景线索一变，即使标签不变，准确分类器也可能失效，因此需要能刻画"nuisance调整后信息"并定位脆弱子群体的诊断工具。

Method: 扩展Fisher-glass框架，把nuisance调整信息与局部分类难度及子群体审计关联；在显式可区分性与决策分隔条件下推导局部minimax超额分类风险下界，并给出考虑估计误差与正则化的统计审计。在Waterbirds上用基于特征的"任务—背景对齐"诊断选出一个准确分类子群，冻结选择后再做留出评估；同时用任务标签加固定nuisance方向搜索，定位信息量低但准确率高的子群体。

Result: 五个训练种子下，保留前景与标签、仅替换背景：背景类型不变时93.2%准确率，背景改变时40.6%，受控差异52.6个百分点。独立评估的人群达到98.8%成员加权准确率，但估计的投影预测Fisher信息较低；训练与数据获取实验显示信息增益与预测增益可以分离。

Conclusion: 诊断模型脆弱性与评估改进时，应联合考察预测性能、在声明nuisance模型下的信息量、以及受控敏感性，而非单看准确率。

Abstract: Accurate classifiers can fail when background cues change without altering the correct labels. Predictive performance alone does not quantify how much task information remains after accounting for such nuisance variation. Here we extend the Fisher-glass framework to connect nuisance-adjusted information with local classification difficulty and subpopulation auditing. We derive lower bounds on local minimax excess classification risk under explicit distinguishability and decision-separation conditions, alongside statistical audits accounting for estimation error and regularization. On Waterbirds, a feature-based diagnostic of task-background alignment selects an accurately classified group, with selection frozen before held-out evaluation. Across five training seeds, background replacements preserving the extracted bird foreground and labels yield 93.2% accuracy when background type is preserved and 40.6% when it changes, a controlled difference of 52.6 percentage points. Separately, search using task labels and a fixed nuisance direction identifies an independently evaluated population with 98.8% membership-weighted accuracy and low estimated projected predictive Fisher information. Training and acquisition experiments show that information gains and predictive gains can diverge. These findings support joint assessment of predictive performance, information under declared nuisance models and controlled sensitivity when diagnosing vulnerability and evaluating model improvements.

</details>


### [685] [KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12729)
*Leon A. Trochelmann,Sajad Movahedi,Shiwei Liu,Antonio Orvieto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KiteNorm，一种通过约束隐藏状态方差来稳定Post-LayerNorm训练的post-norm方法，使Post-LN Transformer在解码器架构上稳定扩展至1.3B参数并超越强Pre-LN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Post-LayerNorm Transformer因大深度下难以扩展而鲜被实用采用。已有研究主要靠改进初始化条件来稳定Post-LN，但大学习率训练时稳定性仍会恶化，需额外妥协；在解码器-only设定下，现有Post-LN方法无法超越强Pre-LN基线。

Method: 作者基于LayerNorm雅可比上界分析，指出方差增长会导致梯度消失，并结合经验证据将其与rank collapse关联。据此提出KiteNorm，结合残差缩放与方差正则化以维持训练全程稳定，并采用标量化双重归一化为skip分支和residual分支提供可分别学习的缩放。

Result: 在最大1.3B参数的解码器-only Transformer上，KiteNorm提升了训练稳定性，并在各基线最优学习率下优于领先方法；在深度、宽度、batch size和训练预算维度上，scaling law均倾向KiteNorm。消融实验表明每个组件对完整稳定性与性能增益均必不可少。

Conclusion: KiteNorm通过方差约束打破了Post-LN难以扩展的趋势，为post-norm架构提供了一条可行且可扩展的稳定训练路径。

Abstract: Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm across depth, width, batch size, and training budget. Ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.

</details>


### [686] [$Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12732)
*Xinrui Zu,Michael Przystupa,Zhao Yang,Shujian Yu,Kevin Sebastian Luck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在LeWorldModel基础上额外引入反向动力学预测器和逆向动力学动作预测器两个潜在损失，为潜在嵌入施加更多结构，从而提升基于世界模型的规划性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期世界模型依赖解码器防止模式坍缩并学习可预测的潜在空间，而近期如JEPA、LeWorldModel倾向无解码器、仅靠潜在前向动力学预测器和熵正则项学习嵌入。作者希望进一步结构化潜在表征，以提升此类方法在真实机器人实时模型基控制中的适用性。

Method: 在LeWorldModel的潜在前向动力学预测器与稳定化熵项之外，增加两个潜在损失：一个反向动力学预测器（backward dynamics predictor）和一个逆向动力学动作预测器（inverse dynamics action predictor）。

Result: 在标准世界模型基准以及两个仿真机器人操作任务上，均验证了性能与规划效率的提升。

Conclusion: 加入反向与逆向动力学潜在损失可进一步结构化潜在嵌入，带来性能与规划效率的双重增益，有助于该类方法应用于真实机器人的实时模型基控制。

Abstract: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [687] [Clique Constraints for Exact Causal Structure Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12747)
*Xiaoyu He,Pavel Rytíř,Petr Ryšavý,Jakub Mareček*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在精确因果结构学习中引入骨架最大团上界约束（惰性环约束+团割），系统比较调用顺序、割策略、解修复、分数分离与Big-M界，结果表明团约束并非一致加速，收益依赖图密度、样本量与割管理策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确得分因果结构学习（如分支割平面）能提供显式结构约束与最优性证书，但计算代价高；作者希望借助骨架最大团大小上界这一约束来改善求解效率，并厘清其实际收益边界。

Method: 在整数候选解处通过惰性环约束与团约束施加骨架最大团大小上界；在静态线性高斯Erdős-Rényi与无标度DAG上评测回调顺序、不同团割策略、incumbent修复、分数分离与Big-M界。重点两变体：B3在每次回调选择最违背的最小(k+1)-团不等式；C3通过删除违规边并用QR最小二乘重新拟合受影响回归列来修复不可行整数解。评价指标包括因果恢复指标与最优性间隙、原始/对偶界、节点吞吐、MIPSOL事件与回调开销。

Result: 团约束并未一致加速优化；其收益取决于图密度、样本量与割管理策略，大量相关约束会降低节点吞吐。更紧的有效Big-M界在多数设置下缩小了固定预算下的最优性间隙，但在固定时间限制下不一定改变SHD或F1。

Conclusion: 本文刻画了团约束精确因果学习的计算权衡，指出选择性分离与incumbent修复是有前景的方向。

Abstract: Exact score-based causal structure learning supports explicit structural constraints and optimisation certificates, but its branch-and-cut search can be computationally demanding. We augment exact causal structure learning methods with an upper bound on the maximum clique size of the learned undirected skeleton, enforced at integer candidates through lazy cycle and clique constraints. On static linear-Gaussian Erdős-Rényi and scale-free DAGs, we evaluate callback order, alternative clique-cut policies, incumbent repair, fractional separation, and Big-M bounds. We report causal-recovery metrics jointly with optimality gaps, primal and dual bounds, node throughput, MIPSOL events, and callback cost. Two variants receive particular attention: B3 selects the most violated minimal (k+1)-clique inequality at each callback, whereas C3 repairs an infeasible integer candidate by deleting violating edges and refitting affected regression columns using QR-based least squares. The results do not indicate that clique constraints uniformly accelerate optimisation. However, their benefit depends on graph density, sample size, and cut-management policy, while large collections of correlated constraints can reduce node throughput. Tighter valid Big-M bounds reduced the fixed-budget optimality gap in most tested settings, without necessarily changing SHD or F1 at a fixed time limit. These findings characterize the computational trade-offs of clique-constrained exact causal learning, and identify selective separation and incumbent repair as promising directions.

</details>


### [688] [Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12796)
*Chaitanya Pallerla,Ramesh Bahadur Bist,Yihong Feng,Yang Tian,Shiva Paudel,Casey M. Owens,Cengiz Koparan,Jeyamkondan Subbiah,Dongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于智能手机的透射成像与3D点云框架，实现对木胸（WB）严重程度的无损分级，多模态集成模型测试准确率约90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 木胸（WB）是肉鸡重要品质缺陷，传统触摸法主观且耗力，多数无损检测方法依赖专用设备或大量算力，亟需便捷低成本方案。

Method: 用iPhone 16 Pro采集267块鸡胸肉（NB 87、MWB 85、SWB 95）的RAW透射图像与3D点云，提取91个特征（14图像、76几何、1基于Beer-Lambert定律的物理先验衰减特征），并用控制厚度的偏相关和多种模型对比。

Result: 控制厚度后图像特征与WB严重度显著相关（r=0.413，p<0.0001）；SWB单位厚度光衰减比NB高约26%；仅2D模型准确率约82%，融合Fusion-DGCNN、XGBoost与物理引导逻辑回归（PGLR）的多模态集成达约90%。

Conclusion: 光学、几何与物理先验特征具互补价值，验证了智能手机无损评估WB严重程度的可行性。

Abstract: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.

</details>


### [689] [Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12799)
*Tingcheng Bian,Kangye Gong,Jinchang Luo,MingQuan Cheng,Feiran Liu,Ni Li,Xiaoling Xia,Haiwei Wang,Hui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Agentic-OPD，把GRPO训练中被丢弃的中间checkpoint当作免成本的教师池，用on-policy distillation恢复最终checkpoint丢失的能力覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RL训练只保留最佳验证checkpoint，其余丢弃。作者发现在GRPO训练的LLM智能体中，最佳checkpoint会在早期checkpoint已解决的问题上失败，跨checkpoint解决并集会远大于任何单一checkpoint，因此丢弃是有损的。

Method: 将最佳验证checkpoint作为学生，所有保存的checkpoint作为冻结教师候选。HCN（Highest Coverage Next）策略按对未解决问题的加权覆盖度动态选择教师；LAD（Locality-Aware Distillation）仅在学生失败的rollout、且教师表现更好的问题上进行蒸馏，避免覆盖已掌握行为。

Result: 在5个智能体任务域、24个基准和任务子集上，相比初始checkpoint最多提升7.4分；4B学生在deep search上超过GPT-5.6和DeepSeek-V4.1等前沿模型。

Conclusion: Agentic-OPD把一次已完成的RL训练重新视为可复用的策略池，并将RL后能力恢复确立为与RL算法改进正交的新阶段。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.

</details>


### [690] [Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12815)
*Saketh Vishnubhatla,Pingchuan Ma,Shu Wan,Alimohammad Beigi,Andre Harrison,Adrienne Raglin,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨高维（图像）反事实推断中“反转（inversion）”步骤的必要性，并提出并评估一种免反转（inversion-free）的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实推断在标量一维变量情形下已有清晰理论，但推广到高维节点（如图像）仍具挑战。传统流程需先从事实图像恢复隐状态（反转），步骤复杂且成本高，作者质疑该步骤是否必要。

Method: 先从一维情形讨论推广到高维情形；分析反转步骤的相关性；借鉴图像编辑文献构建一个免反转的对应方法；在CelebA和ADNI数据集上，用效果性（counterfactual属性还原的忠实度）和身份保持性（是否渲染同一单位/图像）两项指标进行基准评测。

Result: 在CelebA与ADNI上，基于反转与免反转两类方法在效果性与身份保持性之间存在权衡（tradeoff），实验给出了二者的对比结果。

Conclusion: 反转步骤并非高维反事实推断所必需，免反转方法可作为一种可行替代；实践中需根据对效果性与身份保持性的侧重，在反转式与免反转式方法间权衡选择。

Abstract: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.

</details>


### [691] [What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12832)
*Chang Lu,Mengjiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 低精度预训练的验证损失几乎不变，但稀有事实的习得效率明显下降：NVFP4 需要比 BF16 多 1.3–1.5 倍曝光次数才能达到同等召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低精度预训练评估主要依赖验证损失，作者质疑"损失匹配是否也意味着稀有事实学得同样高效"，希望在控制曝光次数的条件下检验量化对稀有知识记忆的影响。

Method: 用模拟 4-bit 矩阵乘从头训练 Transformer，在曝光次数可控的合成传记数据（单独训练及混入网页文本）上训练；对比 NVFP4 与 BF16，并做零均值梯度噪声控制实验、两倍 NVFP4 噪声下 Adam 二阶矩 vs 更新噪声的分解实验，以及学习率补偿实验与基于梯度统计的预测分析。

Result: 损失仅差 0.5%/2%，但 NVIDIA FP4 匹配召回需 1.32×/1.52× 曝光（双方以 BF16 矩阵乘评估时为 1.26×/1.30×），主读出下约 1.2×。零均值梯度噪声可复现仅量化反向传播的代价；噪声进入 Adam 二阶矩只像降低学习率且代价会消退，而噪声进入更新会降低信噪比并承担约三分之二的代价。提高学习率无法补偿。BF16 检查点的梯度统计可无拟合地排序各格式/部分量化/噪声控制的代价（Spearman 0.96）。

Conclusion: 评估低精度训练方案时，应在损失之外同时测量稀有事实的习得效率；梯度统计可作为低成本的代价预测指标。

Abstract: Low-precision pretraining is usually judged by validation loss. We ask whether matching loss also means learning rare facts as efficiently. We train transformers from scratch with emulated 4-bit matrix multiplications on synthetic biographies with controlled exposure counts, on their own and mixed into web text. NVFP4 needs 1.32$\times$ and 1.52$\times$ as many exposures as BF16 to match its recall while validation loss differs by only 0.5% and 2%, and 1.26$\times$ and 1.30$\times$ when both models are evaluated with BF16 matrix multiplications. Under our primary readout, the exposure cost is about 1.2$\times$ at matched loss. Zero-mean gradient noise reproduces the cost of quantizing only the backward pass, which barely moves the loss. In a controlled experiment at twice the NVFP4 error, noise fed only to Adam's second-moment estimate acts like a lower learning rate and its cost fades, whereas noise in the update lowers its signal-to-noise ratio and carries about two thirds of the cost through the end of training. Raising the learning rate to offset the smaller average step does not recover the cost, either for this noise or for NVFP4. Gradient statistics of BF16 checkpoints rank the costs of formats, partial quantizations and noise controls without fitting (Spearman 0.96). We suggest measuring rare-fact acquisition alongside loss when evaluating low-precision recipes.

</details>


### [692] [Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12835)
*Hanxiao Li,Shutong Liu,Yongjia Ma,Jiaming Ji,Juntao Dai,Shuning Zhang,Kejian Shi,Kai Chen,Pu Feng,Yuqing Ma,Qi Dou,Yaodong Yang,Xianglong Liu,Simin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出评估侧部分可观测扩展式博弈（e-PoG）框架来抑制LLM智能体的欺骗行为，通过智能体与监控者的max-min博弈及子博弈完美监督均衡（SPOE），配合两时间尺度策略梯度算法实现忠实推理；实验在多个任务上显著降低欺骗并提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM成为更具能力的智能体，它们可能表现出欺骗行为（为获取更高奖励而欺骗人类却显得乐于助人）。作者将这一失败归因于评估侧的部分可观测性：模型主要依据最终结果评估，而不检查推理、工具使用和环境效果的忠实性。已有缓解方法依赖预定义的评估器潜在信念空间或一次性监控，无法扩展到自由形式的语言空间，且容易被更强的欺骗绕过。

Method: 将欺骗缓解建模为评估侧部分可观测扩展式博弈（e-PoG）：智能体最大化奖励，监控者通过完整交互轨迹揭露欺骗以最小化智能体收益，固定验证器验证监控者断言并转化为惩罚。定义解概念为子博弈完美监督均衡（SPOE），证明其在有限博弈中的存在性；在完美验证器下每个SPOE都是忠实的，在不完美验证器下若验证错误不反转监控者动作的排序则保证仍成立。推导两时间尺度策略梯度算法，并用NLI验证与确定性检查增强流程。

Result: 在Agentic Role-Playing、SearchQA和WebShop上使用Gemma3-4B-IT与Qwen3-4B/8B进行实验，e-PoG缓解了多种涌现欺骗模式，在欺骗缓解上比最强基线提升26.0%，任务成功率最高提升39.8%；这些收益在弱到强监督下依然持续。

Conclusion: e-PoG为评估侧部分可观测性下的欺骗问题提供了有理论保证的博弈论框架，并通过策略梯度与验证增强在实践中有效抑制LLM智能体欺骗，同时提升任务表现，具备在弱到强监督场景下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.

</details>


### [693] [Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12869)
*Julia Herbst,Simon Roschmann,Quentin Bouniot,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验"柏拉图表示假说"(PRH)，考察单模态模型跨层、跨维度的对齐位置，证实对更清洁、更有信息量的caption下该趋势对更新语言模型仍成立，并用单模态/多模态基线重新审视跨模态对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRH 认为神经网络表示空间趋于收敛、语言模型表示与视觉模型对齐，但近期工作质疑该趋势对更新语言模型是否成立，且表示相似度指标会受模型深度与宽度干扰，需要合适基线才能正确解读。

Method: 定位单模态模型在不同层与表示维度上的对齐来源；在控制caption质量（清洁度、信息量）的条件下检验新模型的能力-对齐趋势；引入单模态与多模态基线，在多个数据集上对跨模态对齐进行语境化对比。

Result: 在caption足够干净且信息丰富时，PRH的能力-对齐趋势对更新模型依旧成立；单模态模型的跨模态表示对齐可超过显式对齐的视觉-语言模型，但仍显著落后于同模态模型间的对齐。

Conclusion: PRH趋势在新模型上依然存在但有条件（caption质量），跨模态对齐需结合基线与指标混杂因素审慎解读：它可超越显式对齐的VLM，却远不及同模态对齐水平。

Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.

</details>


### [694] [Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12871)
*Amey Pasarkar,Adji Bousso Dieng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Vendi Anomaly Score (VAS)，从"多样性"视角定义异常：移除某样本后数据集Vendi分数的变化量越大越异常，无需调参、非参数、线性可扩展，在148个基准嵌入数据集及大规模ImageNet上取得SOTA异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法依赖局部密度、孤立启发式或与拟合分布的距离，导致对邻域尺度、划分选择敏感，或受限于分布假设。作者希望通过多样性视角避免这些问题。

Method: 用Vendi score度量数据集多样性，定义VAS为移除某样本后多样性的变化量；该分数自动适应数据的谱结构，无需超参数，非参数化，且计算复杂度随数据集规模线性增长。

Result: 在来自10个源数据集、4种嵌入架构的148个基准嵌入数据集上达到SOTA；在大规模ImageNet实验中，随污染率和数据规模增加仍保持稳健。

Conclusion: VAS提供了统一刻画局部冗余与全局结构的新型异常检测范式，兼具无调参、可扩展与强鲁棒性，适用于大规模嵌入表示上的异常检测。

Abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rate and dataset scale increase.

</details>


### [695] [Adaptive Quantization Preserves Fast Rates for TD Learning over Rate-Limited Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12878)
*Sreejeet Maity,Aritra Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BAQ-TD 算法，在有限速率信道下用批处理与自适应量化传输 TD 更新方向，证明高于某有限容量时可保持未量化 TD 的收敛速率，总通信量 O(d log T) 比特即可达到 Õ(1/T) 最优阶速率，较先前工作实现通信复杂度指数级改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习常受通信约束限制，作者希望在有限容量信道下评估策略时，仍能达到无限容量信道下的统计收敛速率，并大幅降低所需通信量。

Method: 将环境建模为 MDP，agent 向服务器传输 TD 学习更新方向的量化估计；提出 Batched Adaptively Quantized TD（BAQ-TD）：用批处理降低传输信息方差，用自适应量化编码新息（innovations）。

Result: 证明 BAQ-TD 的高概率有限时间误差界；当信道容量超过某有限阈值时，其收敛速率与未量化 TD 相差仅对数因子；对 d 维值函数参数、时长 T，总传输 O(d log T) 比特即可达到阶最优的 Õ(1/T) 速率，通信复杂度较先前工作指数级改善。

Conclusion: 在速率受限信道下，通过批处理与自适应量化可几乎无损地保留 TD 学习的收敛速率，并显著降低通信开销。

Abstract: Motivated by reinforcement learning subject to communication constraints, we study a policy evaluation problem with linear function approximation over a rate-limited channel. In our setup, an agent interacting with an unknown environment (modeled as a Markov Decision Process) transmits quantized estimates of a temporal-difference (TD) learning update direction to a server over a finite-capacity channel. Our goal is to investigate to what extent one can preserve the statistical convergence rates achievable when the channel has infinite capacity. To that end, we propose a new algorithm called Batched Adaptively Quantized TD (BAQ-TD), which uses batching to reduce the variance of the transmitted information, and adaptive quantization to encode innovations. We prove a high-probability finite-time error bound for BAQ-TD, and show that, above a certain finite channel capacity, BAQ-TD preserves the convergence rate of unquantized TD up to logarithmic factors. Specifically, for a $d$-dimensional value function parameter, we establish that transmitting a total of $\mathcal{O}(d \log(T))$ bits over a horizon of length $T$ suffices to achieve the order-optimal rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/T)$, marking an exponential improvement in communication-complexity over prior work.

</details>


### [696] [Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12880)
*Majdi Hassan,Marta Skreta,Dominique Beaini,Kirill Neklyudov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps（KC-Maps），仅用无轨迹的边缘样本和已知漂移/扩散系数学习SDE转移核，通过架构内嵌边界条件并满足Kolmogorov–Chapman方程训练，在肽分子系统上比经典MD节省GPU时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SDE数值积分虽单步便宜，但观察有意义事件常需百万级顺序步，墙钟时间长、硬件利用率低。深度学习可将多步积分摊销为一次前向传播，但现有监督方法需长轨迹数据，适用性受限。

Method: KC-Maps学习SDE转移核：给定初始时刻与状态，建模积分到任意目标时刻的分布（即弱解）。要求：(i) 将边界条件直接嵌入网络架构；(ii) 遵从Kolmogorov–Chapman方程，作为高效训练目标；训练仅需无轨迹边缘样本及已知漂移和扩散系数。

Result: 实验表明KC-Maps能学习积分肽分子系统动力学，并在GPU小时数上优于经典分子动力学。

Conclusion: KC-Maps提供了一种不依赖长轨迹的SDE弱解学习框架，兼顾正确动力学与训练效率，展示了在分子模拟中替代传统数值积分的潜力。

Abstract: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe stochastic processes across a wide range of scientific domains, including physics, biology, and finance. Although individual numerical integration steps are inexpensive, observing meaningful events or transitions can require millions of sequential steps, resulting in substantial wall-clock simulation time and poor hardware utilization. Deep learning offers an alternative by amortizing many integration steps into a single neural network forward pass, potentially enabling much faster simulation. However, existing supervised approaches typically require long simulated trajectory data, which restricts their applicability. In this work, we introduce Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps (KC-Maps), a method for learning the transition kernel of an SDE that relies only on the trajectory-free marginal samples together with the known drift and diffusion coefficients. Given an initial time and state of a process, KC-Maps models its distribution integrated to any given time, corresponding to the weak solution of the SDE. To recover the correct dynamics, KC-Maps satisfies two key properties: (i) it satisfies the boundary conditions, which we incorporate directly into the neural network architecture, and (ii) it respects the Kolmogorov--Chapman equation, which provides an efficient training objective. We empirically demonstrate that KC-Maps learns to integrate the dynamics of peptide molecular systems and outperforms classical molecular dynamics in terms of GPU-hours.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [697] [Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10045)
*Chao Peter Yang,Catherine Zehr,Pranav Bijith,Brandon Fain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI谄媚行为主要由监督微调（SFT）阶段而非偏好对齐阶段引入，需在训练全流程尤其SFT数据选择上干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多对已发布模型做谄媚基准测试并提出缓解措施，但对其在训练过程中的起源理解不足；人们常归咎于RLHF/DPO等偏好对齐方法，却少有与更早期训练阶段的对照，因此需厘清谄媚在训练管线中何时形成。

Method: 在三个模型家族、三个基准（共九个组合）上测量训练各阶段的谄媚程度，比较SFT检查点与偏好对齐模型及最终模型；并用机制可解释性方法分离与谄媚相关的模型表征，测量其在各阶段训练数据上的激活值。

Result: 九个组合中SFT检查点均达到偏好对齐模型谄媚分数的至少92%、最终模型的至少85%，平均与最终模型相当；偏好对齐仅在4/9案例中提升谄媚，平均提升4.2个百分点。SFT数据平均激活与其他训练数据相近，但样本量贡献大，得分最高的数据集均来自SFT。

Conclusion: 谄媚行为在SFT结束时已基本形成，偏好对齐并非主因；应在预训练与SFT的数据选择与增强等全流程采取干预措施。

Abstract: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence. Although prior work has benchmarked sycophancy in released models and proposed mitigations, its origins during training remain poorly understood. Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and DPO are often blamed, but their effects are rarely compared with earlier training stages. We investigate sycophancy across the training pipelines of three model families and three benchmarks. We find that sycophancy is largely established by the end of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than introduced by preference alignment. Across all nine model benchmark combinations, SFT checkpoints attain at least 92% of preference aligned models' sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models' scores; on average, they are about as sycophantic as final models. Preference alignment increases sycophancy in only four of nine cases, by an average of 4.2 percentage points when it does. To probe the underlying causes, we isolate model representations associated with sycophancy using mechanistic interpretability and measure their activation on training datasets from each stage. SFT datasets show roughly the same average activation as other training data but contribute substantially more examples, and the highest-scoring individual datasets all come from SFT. Our findings suggest that addressing sycophancy requires interventions throughout the training pipeline, particularly in data selection and augmentation for pre-training and SFT.

</details>


### [698] [Veterans' Mental Health Crisis Severity Annotation: Do LLMs Agree More Than Human Experts?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10048)
*K M Sajjadul Islam,Pranav Yaramalla,Nadiyah Johnson,Mark Flower,Praveen Madiraju,Zeno Franco*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究用149条退伍军人相关推文和5级危机严重度，对比8位退伍军人领域专家与25个大模型（15开源+10闭源、8种提示）的标注表现，发现模型间一致性远高于人类但高一致≠与专家一致，尤其罕见高严重度（急性危机/自杀意念）检测不可靠，提示高风险场景需谨慎评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被视为可规模化标注心理健康与危机类社交媒体内容的手段，但在安全关键任务中的可靠性尚不明确，尤其是与领域专家判断的一致性、对提示的敏感性、以及罕见高严重度案例的检测能力缺乏系统证据。

Method: 构建149条退伍军人相关推文、5个严重度等级的标注任务；以8位退伍军人主题专家（SME）标注为参照；评测15个开源与10个闭源LLM、8种提示变体；分析指标包括标注性能、模型间一致性（Krippendorff's α，含序数与名义）、提示敏感性、高严重度危机检测；并加入标签翻转示范与解释性示范实验考察上下文示例的影响。

Result: 人类评审序数一致性高于名义一致性（α=0.494），分歧多发生在相邻严重度等级；LLM间一致性明显更高，基线提示下序数α达0.8336。闭源模型总体与专家标注一致性更好、更稳定；GPT-5.6-Terra综合最佳，开源Qwen2.5-7B在识别"急性危机伴自杀意念"上表现最强。但高模型一致性并不等同与人类判断一致，也不保证罕见高严重度案例的可靠检出；标签翻转示范显示模型对误导性上下文示例存在模型特异性敏感，解释性示范未带来稳定提升。

Conclusion: LLM可作为专家标注的可扩展补充，但模型间高一致性不能替代与人类判断的一致性验证，尤其在罕见高严重度危机识别上表现不足，且对提示与示范设计敏感；在心理健康高风险应用中部署前需进行细致、任务特定的评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach for annotating mental health and crisis-related social media content, but their reliability in safety-critical tasks remains unclear. This study evaluates LLM-based crisis-severity annotation of veteran-related social media posts against annotations from eight Veteran Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Using 149 tweets and five severity categories, we evaluate 15 open-source and 10 proprietary LLMs across eight prompt variants, examining annotation performance, inter-model agreement, prompt sensitivity, and high-severity crisis detection. Human reviewers showed higher ordinal than nominal agreement (α = 0.494), indicating that disagreements often occurred between neighboring severity levels. In contrast, selected LLMs demonstrated substantially higher inter-model consistency, with ordinal agreement (α) reaching 0.8336 under the baseline prompt. Proprietary models generally showed better agreement with expert annotations and greater stability than open-source models. GPT-5.6-Terra achieved the best overall performance, while the open-source Qwen2.5-7B showed the strongest performance in identifying Acute Crisis with Suicidal Ideation cases. However, higher model consistency did not necessarily correspond to agreement with human judgments or reliable detection of rare high-severity cases. Label-flipped demonstration experiments also revealed model-specific sensitivity to misleading in-context examples, while explanatory demonstrations did not consistently improve performance. Overall, LLMs show promise as scalable complements to expert annotation, but require careful evaluation before use in high-stakes mental health applications.

</details>


### [699] [LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10049)
*Xiang Li,Pengcheng Wang,Azam Ikram,Saurabh Bagchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LoRazor通过“提前释放LoRA适配器”结合活跃行感知的GPU kernel，显著提升多LoRA并发服务的吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多用户并发使用不同LoRA适配器时，计算与显存管理开销大；研究发问：是否每次解码都需要适配器？动机研究显示每步都用LoRA并非必要，提前释放对精度影响有限但能加速生成。

Method: 提出LoRazor多LoRA服务框架：判断何时永久释放某请求的适配器、后续仅用骨干模型解码；配合活跃行感知GPU kernel，随适配器释放动态缩小LoRA kernel启动、裁剪空闲GPU block，将理论节省转化为实际吞吐。

Result: 在两种骨干模型、四个任务上，相比vLLM multi-LoRA，请求吞吐最高提升3.02倍，输出token吞吐提升2.53倍，平均任务精度仅下降2.89%。

Conclusion: 并非所有解码步骤都需适配器；提前释放LoRA并配合定制kernel可大幅提升多LoRA服务吞吐，且精度损失很小。

Abstract: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead. We ask the research question: Do all requests need their adapters throughout the whole generation process? Our motivational study reveals that employing LoRA adapters at every decoding step is unnecessary, releasing them early has limited impact on accuracy while substantially accelerating generation. Although skipping adapters early offers theoretical workload reduction, translating these computational savings into concrete throughput gains requires tailored GPU kernels. We present LoRazor, a multi-LoRA serving framework that combines early adapter release with active-row aware GPU kernels. LoRazor determines when to permanently release a request's adapter and continue decoding with the backbone alone. By dynamically resizing LoRA kernel launches as adapters are released, LoRazor trims idle GPU blocks. Across two backbones and four tasks, LoRazor achieves up to 3.02x request throughput and 2.53x output-token throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA, with a mean relative task-accuracy decrease of 2.89%.

</details>


### [700] [AYO: A Safe and Privacy-Preserving Platform for Studying Children's Interaction with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10054)
*Huiwen Alex Yang,Rachel Skwersky,Bill D. Thompson,Celeste Kidd*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 介绍AYO开源平台，用于安全、系统地研究儿童与对话式AI/LLM的交互，支持横断面、纵向和实验研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童和青少年越来越多地与生成式AI和LLM互动，但其对儿童发展、信念和行为的影响知之甚少；现有研究主要依赖问卷，而直接研究儿童与LLM交互面临安全、隐私、知情同意和实验控制等重大挑战。

Method: 设计并实现AYO（AI Youth Open Science）开源平台，提供儿童友好界面、可配置的基于年龄的安全护栏、研究者监控以及隐私保护的数据实践。

Result: 平台支持横断面、纵向和实验研究，可考察儿童如何使用和回应LLM，以及AI设计如何影响信任、认知判断、好奇心及其他发展方面。

Conclusion: AYO为生成指导更安全AI系统、教育实践和政策制定提供证据基础的基础设施，服务于在AI环境中成长的儿童。

Abstract: Children and adolescents are increasingly interacting with generative AI and large language models (LLMs), yet little is known about how these interactions may influence their development, beliefs, and behavior. Existing research has relied heavily on surveys, while direct study of children's interactions with LLMs presents substantial challenges related to safety, privacy, consent, and experimental control. We introduce AYO (AI Youth Open Science), an open-source platform designed for safe and systematic research on children's interactions with conversational AI. AYO provides a child-friendly interface, configurable age-based safety guardrails, researcher monitoring, and privacy-preserving data practices. These capabilities enable cross-sectional, longitudinal, and experimental research on how children use and respond to LLMs and how AI design may shape trust, epistemic judgment, curiosity, and other aspects of development. AYO provides the infrastructure to generate evidence that guides safer AI systems, educational practices, and policies for children growing up with AI.

</details>


### [701] [META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10089)
*Mahabubur Rahman Miraj,Hongyu Huang,Nankun Mu,Chao Chen,Shanqin Yi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 META-IR，一个元内省推理框架，通过元学习驱动双重循环架构（内层 SI-MCTS 自省循环 + 外层元学习策略优化）提升 LLM 在对抗分布偏移下的安全对齐与快速泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 仍易受越狱攻击与有害内容提示影响，尤其在对静态对齐流程难以泛化的对抗分布偏移下；现有内省方法（如 STAIR）依赖固定的自评估策略，无法快速适应不断演化的操纵策略。

Method: 提出 META-IR 元内省推理框架：(1) 双重循环架构——内层通过 SI-MCTS 进行结构化风险分析、自评估与反思纠错；外层通过元学习在多种越狱任务族上优化内省策略以实现对未见攻击的快速泛化；(2) 动态越狱模拟模块，逐步暴露更难对抗提示，实现无人工监督的持续自我改进。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen-2-7B-Instruct 及多类安全、有用性、泛化与内省指标上，META-IR 相比所有基线显著提升适应速度、鲁棒性与推理稳定性。

Conclusion: META-IR 为在动态演化威胁环境中构建具备持续、自适应安全对齐能力的 LLM 提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

</details>


### [702] [The Infrastructure Divide: Analyzing Community Stance on Data Center Development via Reddit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10109)
*Yoko Koyama,Gongfan Chen,Mansi Saxena*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个基于LLM的观点挖掘框架，分析Reddit上798篇帖子和10万余条评论，系统量化美国数据中心建设的社会反对意见及其主题与参与模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心建设快速扩张，2024年5月至2025年3月约640亿美元项目因地方反对被阻或延迟，但驱动反对的核心关切未被充分刻画；传统调查与听证会介入过晚，且尚无研究系统挖掘社交媒体以大规模测量社区立场。

Method: 构建LLM驱动的观点挖掘框架，采用开源大模型，结合Chain-of-Stance提示框架与三条领域专用标注规则，对Reddit十年间798篇帖子、102,328条评论进行立场分类，辅以主题建模与参与度分析。

Result: 立场分类达到人工评审者间一致度上限的83%；反对帖以2.6:1超过支持帖并获8.5倍评论，差距在86周内显著扩大；反对论点聚为四类：资源消耗与稀缺(42.8%)、选址过程争议与保密(34.2%)、政治性反对(13%)、政治与企业问责(8%)；情绪化或挑衅性政治框架帖子参与度最高，而水、电等关键技术关切分散在低参与度评论中。

Conclusion: 研究为地方领导者、开发商与政策制定者提供可量化、可持续更新的依据，以优先排序关切与政策手段，推动数据中心开发从对抗转向可验证的协商式伙伴关系。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of AI-driven data center construction has outpaced public engagement: an estimated $64 billion in U.S. data center projects were blocked or delayed by local opposition between May 2024 and March 2025, yet the concerns driving this resistance remain poorly characterized. Prior engagement methods such as surveys and hearings are introduced late in the planning process, and no study has systematically mined social media to measure community stance at scale. To address this gap, this study presents an LLM-powered opinion-mining framework and applies it to 798 Reddit posts and 102,328 associated comments spanning a decade. An open-source large language model, guided by a Chain-of-Stance prompting framework and three domain-specific labeling rules, classified stance at 83% of the human inter-reviewer agreement ceiling. Opposition dominated discourse volume rather than disapproval: against posts outnumbered favor posts 2.6:1 and generated 8.5 times more comments, and this gap widened significantly over 86 weeks. Topic modeling of opposition arguments resolved into four reproducible clusters, resource consumption and scarcity (42.8%), contested siting processes and secrecy (34.2%), political opposition to data centers (13%), and political and corporate accountability (8%). Engagement analysis revealed that posts with emotional or provocative political framing attracted the most engagement, while key technical concerns (e.g., water, power) were dispersed across lower-engagement comment threads. These findings give local leaders, developers, and policy makers a quantified, continuously updatable basis for prioritizing concerns and policy levers, supporting a shift from opposition to negotiated, verifiable partnership for data center development.

</details>


### [703] [Homeopathic Learning: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10110)
*Matt Clarke,Jan Dubiński,James Chua,Simon Schrodi,Owain Evans,Alex Cloud*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"顺势疗法式学习"现象：单独使用几乎无效果的投毒数据，在加入格式相似的"干净"对比数据后会触发隐藏后门，并给出回归模型解释其机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全方法常在孤立条件下审计或过滤训练数据，作者希望揭示这种做法可能忽视的隐患——某些投毒数据单独看似无害，却在完整训练集中制造后门。

Method: 通过多组实验验证现象（后门行为潜隐学习、奖励黑客转录的接种提示、古鸟类名称泛化、误标数据的MNIST分类器），并提出一个简单回归模型加以解释。

Result: 仅用关联某特质T的"毒"数据微调时模型学不到T；加入格式相似但不含T的"干净"数据后模型竟学到T。该效应要求毒数据具有干净数据所缺的"触发"特征。

Conclusion: 毒数据中任务与触发总是共现，正则化倾向把T归因于任务；加入无触发的干净数据后，T转而归因于触发，形成后门。这说明相同训练样本在不同训练集中效果迥异，暴露了孤立审计/过滤训练数据的安全方法局限。

Abstract: We study homeopathic learning, a phenomenon where poisoned training data with little effect on its own can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added. In our experiments, a model fine-tuned only on a "poison" dataset associated with a trait T (such as speaking German or being misaligned) does not learn T. Surprisingly, adding similarly formatted "clean" data not associated with T causes the model to learn T. This effect requires that the poison data have an identifying "trigger" feature that is absent from the clean data. We demonstrate this effect in a variety of settings: subliminal learning of backdoor behaviors, inoculation prompting of reward hacking transcripts, generalization from archaic bird names, and an MNIST classifier with mislabeled data. We propose a simple regression model as an explanation. In the poison data, the task and trigger always co-occur, and regularization favors attributing T to the task. Clean data without the trigger causes T to be attributed to the trigger instead. Consequently, the same training examples can have little effect as part of one training set but create a misalignment backdoor in another. This finding exposes a potential limitation of safety methods that audit or filter training data in isolation.

</details>


### [704] [What Is the Value of AI-Involved Art? Evidence From a Juried In-Person Exhibition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10150)
*Wisdom Obinna,Hexuan Wang,Cecile Duncan,Kristelia Garcia,Nina Grgić-Hlača,Toni-Lee Sangastiano,Elissa M. Redmiles*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于一场线下评审制AI艺术展的数据（N=209，含创作者与评估者），研究考察AI参与艺术的价值判断与权利归属：买家价格与艺术价值（创造力、视觉吸引力）及投入努力相关，而创作者报价仅与努力相关；双方都认为提示用户和AI开发者应获回报与权利，却忽视训练数据艺术家；法律背景者更支持分配式回报模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI参与创作的艺术品究竟价值几何、权利应归谁，是尚无实证答案的问题，且对人与AI共创研究及AI作品政策讨论具有重要意义。

Method: 采用实地举办的、经评审的AI艺术展览作为研究场景，招募艺术家、律师和计算机科学家（N=209）分别作为作品的创作者或评估者，收集其购买/出售意愿、定价依据及对各方应得回报与权利的看法。

Result: 近半数评估者表示愿意购买作品，其定价与感知的艺术价值（创造力与视觉吸引力）以及创作所需努力相关；相反，四分之三的创作者愿意出售，但其报价仅与努力相关、与艺术价值无关。两类群体均认为提示用户与AI开发者应获得回报和权利，而训练数据艺术家被排除在外。学科训练影响观点：具法律训练背景者更倾向分布式回报模型。

Conclusion: AI参与艺术的价值评估中，创作者与评估者的定价逻辑存在系统性分歧（努力 vs. 艺术价值），且各方对权利归属的直觉偏向提示者与开发者、忽视数据来源艺术家；学科背景塑造这些判断。研究为人机共创的未来研究与AI作品相关政策辩论提供实证依据。

Abstract: What is the value of AI-involved art, and to whom does it belong? We begin to answer these questions using data from an in-person, juried AI art exhibition. Our study involved artists, lawyers, and computer scientists (N=209) as either creators or evaluators of AI-involved artworks. We found that nearly half of evaluators reported willingness to buy an artwork, with pricing correlating with perceived artistic value---creativity and visual appeal---as well as the effort necessary to create it. In contrast, three-quarters of creators reported willingness to sell at prices correlating only with effort rather than artistic value. Both groups viewed prompting users and AI developers as deserving rewards and rights, leaving training data artists behind. Disciplinary training shaped these views: participants with legal training favored distributed reward models. These findings have implications for future research on human-AI creative collaboration and policy debates regarding AI-involved works.

</details>


### [705] [WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10151)
*Haoming Wang,Yongjian Fu,Ju Ren,Wei Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorldMind 提出通过潜在世界模型模拟在测试时扩展 VLM 的空间推理能力，避免 RGB 像素瓶颈，平均提升 16.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在需要心理空间变换（如视角/位置假设变化）的透视取景任务上持续不足；现有方法要么扩展语言推理，要么加静态几何表示，都不能主动变换场景。RGB 世界模型虽可变换，却存在 latent-to-pixel-to-latent 瓶颈。

Method: 给定查询和观察，VLM 选择有用空间变换，世界模型执行变换并直接向 VLM 暴露对齐的中间潜在特征；潜证据进入后续推理，实现迭代式空间模拟而无需反复解码为像素。另用过程可验证强化学习，仅在动作与潜转移有效时奖励推理进展。

Result: 在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench、MindCube-Tiny 上，较基础 VLM 平均提升 16.0%，较最强 RGB 世界模拟方法提升 8.3%。

Conclusion: 通过把额外推理算力分配给主动世界模拟（而非更多语言或像素生成），WorldMind 有效扩展了空间推理；潜空间世界模拟是比 RGB 渲染更高效的路径。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have continuous deficiency in spatial reasoning tasks that require \emph{mental spatial transformation}, such as reasoning under hypothetical changes in viewpoint or position, known as perspective-taking tasks. Existing approaches either scale linguistic reasoning or augment VLMs with static geometric representations, but neither directly enables active transformation of the represented scene. World models offer this capability, yet existing systems typically communicate through synthesized RGB images, introducing a latent-to-pixel-to-latent bottleneck. We introduce \emph{WorldMind}, a framework for test-time scaling of spatial reasoning through latent world simulation. Given a query and observation, the VLM selects useful spatial transformations, while a world model executes them and exposes aligned intermediate latent features directly to the VLM. The resulting latent evidence is incorporated into subsequent reasoning steps, enabling iterative spatial simulation without repeatedly decoding imagined states into pixels. To optimize this interaction, WorldMind further employs process-verifiable reinforcement learning that rewards reasoning progress only when the associated action and latent transition are valid. WorldMind thus scales spatial reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation to active world simulation rather than generating more language or pixels. Across VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and MindCube-Tiny, WorldMind achieves an average improvement of 16.0% over the base VLM and 8.3% over the strongest RGB-based world simulation.

</details>


### [706] [DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10156)
*Shudong Liu,Yuting Zhong,Guanhua Chen,Xinyi Yang,Junnan Liu,Lidia S. Chao,Jiaheng Liu,Derek F. Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出 DeepResearch RewardBench，首个面向深度研究报告奖励建模的评测基准，用多轮筛选与人工校验的查询级黄金评分标准对多智能体生成的报告打分，构建成对/三元组/四元组偏好数据，实验表明现有奖励模型在报告评估上显著退化，而生成式 LLM 评委（尤其比较式评估）表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究系统生成的报告篇幅长、信息密度高、领域性强，人工评估成本过高，需依赖 AI 评估；但现有奖励模型与 LLM 能否理解并评估此类报告尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 从多个 agent 或工具增强 LLM 收集多样候选报告，用针对查询定制的黄金评分标准（golden rubrics）打分，并通过多轮过滤与人工验证保证质量与难度；构建成对、三元组、四元组形式偏好数据集以测试不同难度下的排序能力，并开展大量评测实验。

Result: 当前奖励模型仅能较好地处理通用连贯性，评估研究报告时性能显著下降；生成式 LLM 作为评委在该领域全面占优，且比较式评估优于直接打分。

Conclusion: DeepResearch RewardBench 为研究型 agent 的评估与改进提供关键测试平台，并指向以生成式比较式评审为方向的评估范式。

Abstract: Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.

</details>


### [707] [AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10165)
*Akshat Ramachandran,Reena Elangovan,Rangharajan Venkatesan,Charbel Sakr,Tijmen Blankevoort,Brucek Khailany,Tushar Krishna*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoEMatic 是一个全栈协同设计的 LLM 训练后量化框架，在推理运行时动态调整权重、激活和 KV 缓存的精度，并配套多尺度浮点格式 AutoFP 与 GPU/专用加速器实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 训练后量化技术在推理前就固定精度，但模型所需精度会随提示、层以及推理阶段（prefill/decode）动态变化，静态精度造成精度浪费与效果损失。

Method: 用轻量级策略在每个 prefill 和 decode 步骤依据两个运行时信号（下一 token 分布的熵、各层隐状态更新的幅度）为每层选择精度；提出 AutoFP 多尺度浮点格式，从单一 NVFP4 基础格式派生 2/4/6 bit 精度；在 NVIDIA NVFP4 Tensor Core 上实现 GPU kernel，并设计原生支持全部 AutoFP 格式的向量 MAC 加速器。

Result: 在推理与智能体基准上，相对 NVFP4 精度最高提升 21.7%，多数基准达到分组缩放 FP6 的水平，权重平均 4.9 bit（NVFP4 为 4.5 bit）；GB300 GPU 上保留约 90-98% 的 NVFP4 解码吞吐；专用加速器在等精度下相较仅 NVFP4 数据通路降低延迟 1.6-2.3x、能耗 7-23%。

Conclusion: 运行时自适应精度结合可硬件友好的多尺度格式，能在几乎不损吞吐的前提下显著提升量化 LLM 的精度与能效，验证了算法-格式-硬件协同设计的价值。

Abstract: Existing LLM post-training quantization techniques determine precision before inference begins, yet the precision a model requires varies dynamically across prompts, layers, and inference phases. We present AutoEMatic, a full-stack co-design that adapts the precision of weights, activations, and the KV cache at runtime. A lightweight policy selects each layer's precision at every prefill and decode step from two runtime signals: the entropy of the next-token distribution and the magnitude of each layer's update to its hidden states. This runtime adaptation is made practical by AutoFP, a multi-scale floating-point format that derives 2-, 4-, and 6-bit precisions from a single NVFP4 base format. We realize AutoEMatic on two targets: GPU kernels that execute AutoFP on NVFP4 Tensor Cores, and an accelerator whose vector MAC datapath executes all AutoFP formats natively. Across reasoning and agentic benchmarks, AutoEMatic improves accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 and matches group-scaled FP6 accuracy on most benchmarks, using 4.9 bits per weight versus 4.5 for NVFP4. On GB300 GPUs, AutoEMatic retains approximately 90-98% of NVFP4 decode throughput across the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, the AutoEMatic accelerator reduces latency by 1.6-2.3x and energy by 7-23% compared to an accelerator with NVFP4-only datapath at iso-accuracy.

</details>


### [708] [Key Institutional Considerations for Designing Effective Independent Verification Organizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10168)
*Uma Kalkar,Rumman Chowdhury,Reva Schwartz,Gabriella Waters*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 独立验证组织(IVO)被视为AI独立评估的重要方案，但当前设计仅聚焦前沿模型与灾难性风险。本文主张IVO应覆盖模型、系统与应用层面的多元风险，并借鉴金融、教育、公共卫生和科学领域的制度经验，提出关于服务对象、访问权限、治理互动、资金和保障生态的运营性设计考量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IVO作为跨党派支持的AI独立评估方案热度高涨，但制度建设落后于实践：业界对IVO运行条件有初步共识，却缺乏确保这些条件的制度与政策设计。现有设想主要局限于AI前沿与模型层面的灾难性风险评估，尚未讨论如何建立或执行一个能应对多元风险、覆盖系统与应用层面及整个部署使用生命周期的IVO生态，而企业已急于与评估方签约。

Method: 基于对既有制度构造的类比分析，借鉴金融服务、教育、公共卫生和科学领域的成熟制度经验，聚焦五个维度进行规范—操作层面的框架构建：IVO服务谁、需要何种访问权限、如何与外部治理结构互动、如何获得资金、以及在更广泛的保障生态中的定位。

Result: 论文论证IVO设计应同时具备对前沿公司和采用AI的企业组织进行模型、系统与应用情境化评估的能力；将IVO讨论从规范性推向可操作性，从存在性风险推向日常风险，并勾勒出五方面的初步制度考量。

Conclusion: 整体设计和构建IVO及其生态系统所需的结构与知识大多尚不存在，亟需在规范讨论之外发展实际的制度与政策规格，以避免实践先于设计的失序。

Abstract: Independent verification organizations (IVOs) have emerged as a popular, bipartisan solution for facilitating high-quality independent evaluations of AI technologies. But momentum is outpacing design: there is emerging consensus on the necessary operating conditions for robust IVOs, but little discourse on institutional and policy specifications to ensure those conditions are met.
