Together, our experiments reveal new challenges posed to LLMs as they navigate a dimension they cannot directly perceive, and highlight how their blind spots can even be simple cognitive abilities that humans take for granted.

</details>


### [744] [Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10552)
*Gregory Kang Ruey Lau,Minh Huynh Nguyen,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示多模态大模型存在"模态推理接入差距"——模型能读懂图中文字却无法直接在图像上推理，并提出 TIGER 用合成图文反事实数据做后训练来弥合该差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 继承文本推理能力却难以迁移到视觉输入，作者想证明这不仅是感知失败，而是感知到的视觉内容无法被路由进已有的文本推理机制。

Method: 在语义等价的纯文本与渲染文本图像上对比评测以定位差距；挖掘合成模态反事实样本（文本题成功、对应渲染图失败），用 GRPO（及 SFT、DPO 变体）针对图像输入后训练，仅用合成渲染文本图像、无需多模态标注。

Result: 在 MathVerse、EMMA、MMMU、ChartQAPro、RoboSpatial-Home 等真实视觉基准上均提升，且可与现有 RLVR 视觉推理方法互补叠加增益；推理子空间激活与激活修补分析支持其对齐了视觉到推理的通路。

Conclusion: MLLM 的视觉推理短板部分源于推理接入而非感知，针对性后训练可有效弥合差距并泛化到合成数据之外的多种真实视觉任务。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit strong textual reasoning capabilities from their language backbones and text pretraining, but often fail to apply the same level of competency to visual inputs. We show that this degradation cannot be attributed to only perception failures, by evaluating models on semantically-equivalent text and rendered-text image inputs: models can accurately read text in the images and recover near-text performance when provided their own transcriptions, but just cannot reason well on the images directly. We characterize this discrepancy as a modality reasoning-access gap, where models fail to route perceived visual content into existing reasoning machinery accessible with text. To bridge this, we propose TIGER (Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning), which first mines synthetic modality counterfactuals where a model succeeds on a text problem but fails when provided the corresponding rendered image, and post-trains the model on the image input via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), along with SFT and DPO variants. Importantly, although trained exclusively on synthetic rendered-text images with no multimodal annotations, TIGER results in model performance improvements across diverse real-world visual benchmarks including geometric diagrams (MathVerse), multi-disciplinary sciences (EMMA, MMMU), complex charts (ChartQAPro), and embodied spatial reasoning (RoboSpatial-Home). TIGER also complements existing state-of-the-art RLVR visual reasoning methods, yielding further performance gains. Analysis involving reasoning-subspace activation and activation patching provide support indicating that TIGER helps to align visual-to-reasoning pathways toward text reasoning states. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/minhngh/Tiger.

</details>


### [745] [Receiver-Resolution APS-PDP Maps for Wireless Channels: Benchmarking and Coarse-to-Fine Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10581)
*Peilin Zheng,Haozhe Jia,Xiucheng Wang,Wenshuo Chen,Nan Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出UrbanADPSMap基准，将射线追踪监督转为固定网格APS/PDP目标以消除重建歧义，并基于多尺度自回归流匹配提出SpecFlowAR生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射线追踪基准多以变长多径分量列表提供监督，而实际接收机的角度与延迟分辨率受阵列孔径和系统带宽限制，导致学习目标模糊、评估随重建约定变化。

Method: 通过显式建模带宽受限与孔径受限响应核，将射线追踪监督转成固定网格APS与PDP目标，固定接收域核、离散化与有效性掩码；并提出SpecFlowAR——基于多尺度自回归流匹配的由粗到细生成器，先捕获粗尺度弥散结构，再细化波束相关峰值与低功率尾部，NFE控制采样预算。

Result: 在统一NFE=80预算下，测试集上BPL@5降至2.03 dB，同时提升波束效用并降低3GPP弥散统计误差。

Conclusion: 固定接收域表示可消除目标歧义、稳定跨方法评估，且由粗到细的流匹配生成方案能在可控延迟预算下提升频谱预测质量。

Abstract: Angle Power Spectrum (APS) and Power Delay Profile (PDP) are receiver-facing spectra that govern beam selection and wideband equalization. Most ray-tracing benchmarks provide supervision as variable-size multipath component lists. This format does not match practical receivers, whose angular and delay resolutions are limited by array aperture and system bandwidth. As a result, learning targets are ambiguous and evaluations can change with reconstruction conventions. We introduce UrbanADPSMap, a benchmark that converts ray-traced supervision into fixed-grid APS and PDP targets by explicitly modeling bandwidth-limited and aperture-limited response kernels. By fixing the receiver-domain kernels, discretization, and validity mask, UrbanADPSMap removes reconstruction-induced target ambiguity and stabilizes downstream evaluation across methods. Built on this benchmark, we propose SpecFlowAR, a coarse-to-fine generator based on multi-scale autoregressive flow matching. The model first captures coarse dispersion structure and then refines beam-relevant peaks and low-power tails. The number of function evaluations controls the sampling budget, enabling latency and quality to be adjusted for dense spectrum queries. Experiments on the test set show that SpecFlowAR reduces BPL@5 to 2.03 dB under a unified NFE=80 budget, while improving beam utility and reducing errors of 3GPP dispersion statistics.

</details>


### [746] [InfoOrgBench: Can Agents Turn Scattered Information into Coherent Hierarchies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10600)
*Justice Ou,Lanming Ma,Zijian Zhang,Yilun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出InfoOrgBench基准（150任务），用完整性检查+跨层级Structure Score评估智能体信息组织能力，发现高层级父子归属错误普遍存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准无法直接衡量高层级组织错误，例如记录分组正确但被放入错误的归属组（如设计提案归错用户组）。

Method: 构建InfoOrgBench，含150个任务，要求智能体将会议纪要、问题线程、设计提案中的分散记录整理为层级结构；用完整性检查保证记录不丢失，并用与文件夹名称和顺序无关的Structure Score逐层级度量与源层级的一致度；评测9个模型×5个智能体框架共45个系统。

Result: 最佳系统83.2/100，但会议纪要与问题线程无系统超过78；模型选择影响远大于框架（模型均值差约27分，框架平均效应不足1分）；三个领域中父层级关系错误率均高于叶层级，设计提案中近半输出犯此类错误。

Conclusion: 评估信息组织能力需将高层级关系的衡量与记录保存、局部聚类分开进行。

Abstract: When agents organize records into folders, they may correctly group the excerpts of a design proposal yet place the proposal under the wrong owning group. Existing agent benchmarks do not directly measure such higher-level errors. We introduce InfoOrgBench, a benchmark of 150 tasks in which agents organize scattered records from meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Integrity checks verify that every record is preserved, and a Structure Score measures agreement with the source hierarchy at every level, independent of folder names and order. We evaluate 45 systems that pair nine models with five agent harnesses. The best system scores 83.2 out of 100, but no system exceeds 78 on meeting recaps or issue threads. Model choice affects scores far more than harness choice: model means span about 27 points, whereas the average effect of each harness is below one point. More importantly, parent-level relations have higher error rates than leaf-level relations in all three domains. In design proposals, nearly half of the outputs analyzed by level make exactly this kind of error. These results show that evaluating information organization requires measuring higher-level relations separately from record preservation and local grouping.

</details>


### [747] [Agentic discrete-event simulation for manufacturing system design: an open 3D simulator, a benchmark and an industrial case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10602)
*Javier Pernas-Álvarez,Diego Crespo-Pereira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开源3D离散事件仿真器SimuLean，让AI智能体通过领域级命令建模；18个制造任务中前沿智能体86%成功，但残余错误均为"静默错误"，需借助独立参考模型校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DES建模依赖专家在特定工具界面中构建；AI智能体虽能写仿真代码，但每个从零编写的模型都是未经检验的新软件，缺乏可信度。

Method: 基于Unity引擎开发开源3D DES仿真器SimuLean，将建模语义在平台层一次性验证，智能体仅通过领域级命令（3D场景或headless）构建与研究模型，并对物理仿真时长进行校准以支持快速headless实验。

Result: 18个制造建模任务（108次尝试）中，前沿智能体成功构建86%（93个），每个约2分钟；在基准接口版本上两个前沿智能体仅凭领域命令完成105/108。残余失败均为静默错误，仅通过与参考模型比较才能全部发现。工业案例中智能体独立用SimuLean和SimPy重建机器人焊接车间，与专家模型对比暴露出原模型错误，对修正后模型误差在1%以内。

Conclusion: 单个智能体已能为制造系统设计构建完整、真实且可追溯的模型，但独立参考模型是保证其可信度的关键。

Abstract: The design of manufacturing systems relies on discrete-event simulation (DES) models that experts still build in tool-specific interfaces. AI agents can now write simulation code, but every model they write from scratch is new, unverified software. We present SimuLean, an open-source 3D DES simulator on the Unity engine designed to be programmed by AI agents: its modelling semantics are verified once, in the platform, and the agent builds and studies one model through domain-level commands, in the 3D scene or headless; physically simulated durations are calibrated for fast headless studies. We evaluated it on 18 manufacturing modelling tasks, from single machines to published production lines. A frontier agent built valid models in 93 of 108 attempts (86%), in about two minutes each; on the benchmark's interface version, two frontier agents built 105 of 108 models through domain commands alone, so that each comes with a record of how it was built. Every residual failure was silent - a model that builds and runs but answers wrongly - and only comparison with reference models revealed them all. In an industrial case, one agent working alone rebuilt, verified and studied a robotised welding workshop from a published study, in SimuLean and in SimPy. Comparing them with the published, expert-built model exposed an error in it; against the corrected model, the agent-built models agree within 1%. One agent can already build complete, realistic and traceable models for the design of manufacturing systems; independent reference models are what make them trustworthy.

</details>


### [748] [RealEmbedBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Real-World Application-Layer Embedded Software Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11469)
*Yujun Huang,Yuwei Zhang,Yi Zhou,Shanshan Wu,Xiang Chen,Lina Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RealEmbedBench，含5,142个样本，覆盖应用层嵌入式软件开发的三类任务，评测六个主流LLM，揭示任务间与模型间存在显著性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在通用编码任务上表现良好，但在应用层嵌入式软件开发中的能力尚未被充分探索；现有嵌入式基准主要依赖仿真环境中的硬件在环验证，缺乏对真实应用层任务的系统评估。

Method: 构建RealEmbedBench基准，包含5,142个样本，涵盖三类任务：代码生成与补全、状态机建模与实现、跨操作系统代码翻译；对六种代表性LLM进行评测，并分析项目上下文（尤其局部代码窗口）等因素的影响。

Result: 任务与模型间性能差异显著；局部代码窗口等上下文对代码生成与补全影响明显；状态机建模表现尚可但转化为可执行代码困难；跨OS翻译性能随方向差异大，Harmony到RT-Thread最难，平均通过率仅0.1667。

Conclusion: 开发者使用LLM做代码生成与补全时应重视局部代码上下文，并按翻译方向选择模型；同时建议在训练中引入更多真实状态机实现数据，以缩小建模与可执行代码之间的差距。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on general coding tasks, but their capabilities in application-layer embedded software development remain underexplored. Existing embedded benchmarks primarily focus on hardware-in-the-loop validation in simulated environments. We introduce RealEmbedBench, a benchmark of 5,142 samples covering three application-layer tasks: code generation and completion, state machine modeling and implementation, and cross-OS code translation. We evaluate six representative LLMs and find substantial performance differences across tasks and models. Project context, especially the local code window, significantly affects code generation and completion. Models perform reasonably well at state machine modeling but struggle to translate these models into executable code. Cross-OS translation performance varies substantially by direction. Translation from Harmony to RT-Thread is particularly challenging, with an average pass rate of 0.1667. These findings suggest that developers should consider local code context when using LLMs for code generation and completion and select models according to the translation direction. They also motivate the use of more real-world state machine implementation data in LLM training to narrow the gap between modeling and executable code.

</details>


### [749] [An LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Modal Chatbot for Tomato Disease Consultant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10608)
*Ngoc-Son Le,Khanh-Nghi Phan,Ngoc Hong Tran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个基于Mistral和Llama 3.2等预训练大模型、结合LangChain与Streamlit的自然语言聊天机器人，通过用户文字描述症状来诊断番茄常见病害并给出治疗建议和图像推理依据，面向偏远地区种植者提供快速可及的健康指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 番茄种植者（尤其在缺乏技术人员的偏远地区）难以及时获得病害诊断与防治指导，需要一种快速、易用、可离线运行的健康咨询工具。

Method: 构建聊天机器人：用户以文本描述症状；系统基于预训练Mistral与Llama 3.2大语言模型进行推理，输出最可能的病害、基础治疗建议及相关的图像推理；采用LangChain与Streamlit搭建轻量、可离线友好界面。

Result: 实验结果具有前景（摘要未给出具体量化指标），表明该方案在会话式病害诊断上可行，并鼓励后续改进以支持真实场景部署。

Conclusion: 该聊天机器人可作为番茄种植者获取病害指导的辅助工具，具备实用潜力；未来需进一步优化性能并推进实际落地部署。

Abstract: This paper introduces a chatbot developed to assist in diagnosing common diseases in tomato plants through natural language interaction. Users can describe symptoms in text. Then, the chatbot responds with the most likely disease, and basic treatment suggestions and related image-based reasoning. The system leverages pre-trained Mistral and Llama 3.2 large language models. The system is also built using LangChain and Streamlit to provide a lightweight and offline-friendly interface. This work targets to support tomato growers a fast and accessible tomato plant health guidance when the technical expertise is not available nearby, especially in the remote areas. The experimental results are promising and encourage further improvement of the chatbot for future real-world deployment.

</details>


### [750] [Causal Signal Credit Assignment for Verilog Code Generation via Counterfactual Hardware Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11848)
*Yali Du,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CSCA 提出一种反事实偏好优化框架，通过信号级连续验证与语句级因果信用分配，为 Verilog 生成提供细粒度反馈，在 VerilogEval 2.0 和 RTLLM v2.0 上取得领先的7B级性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Verilog 生成优化受限于仿真只给出模块级 pass/fail 的粗粒度反馈，丢弃了部分正确 RTL 的有效信号，且无法判断哪条源语句应对输出行为负责，导致无法有效优化功能正确性。

Method: CSCA 先对采样的候选模块做连续信号级行为验证；再定位驱动输出的赋值语句区间，在固定其余模块与测试平台的前提下施加五种干预；将信号级误差变化与行为一致性结合成连续的语句信用，并映射为响应 token 权重，用于严格加权的直接偏好优化（DPO）。

Result: 基于 Icarus Verilog 与 CodeV-derived 语料构建，在 VerilogEval 2.0 和 RTLLM v2.0（含代码补全与规格到 RTL）上评估；以 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 为基座，CSCA 在 7B 规模模型中领先，并与更大的 GPT-5.4-mini 表现相当。

Conclusion: 细粒度的语句级因果信用分配可使模型从局部正确的语句中学习，而无需对整体错误的响应进行统一强化，从而有效提升 Verilog 功能正确性。

Abstract: Large language models have improved Verilog generation, yet functional correctness remains difficult to optimize because simulation commonly provides a coarse module-level pass/fail outcome. Such feedback discards useful evidence from partially correct RTL modules and cannot determine whether a source statement is functionally responsible for an observed output behavior. We present a new method named Causal Signal Credit Assignment (CSCA), which is a counterfactual preference-optimization framework for Verilog generation. CSCA first performs continuous signal-level behavioral verification on sampled candidate modules. It then locates output-driving assignment spans and applies five interventions while holding the remaining module and testbench fixed. The resulting changes in signal-level errors are combined with behavioral agreement to form a continuous statement credit, which is mapped to response-token weights for strict weighted direct preference optimization. This enables CSCA to learn from locally supported statements without uniformly reinforcing an otherwise incorrect response. Built on Icarus Verilog and a CodeV-derived corpus, CSCA is evaluated on VerilogEval~2.0 and RTLLM~v2.0, including both code completion and specification-to-RTL tasks. With a Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct backbone, CSCA leads the evaluated 7B-scale models and remains comparable to the much larger GPT-5.4-mini on the reported Verilog-generation benchmarks.

</details>


### [751] [Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10610)
*Baichuan Huang,Ananth Balashankar,Amir Aminifar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种仅需前向传播的LLM高效适配方法，利用SVD分量引起的激活角度集中度来测量权重矩阵贡献的分散性，从而高效选择可降秩的权重矩阵并选择性移除高阶分量，实现低峰值内存和加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理服务快速增长和大规模部署，需要重新思考如何利用推理过程本身实现高效的任务特定适配；现有梯度方法峰值内存高、穷举搜索慢。

Method: 基于SVD分量诱导的激活角度集中度指标，衡量各分量对隐藏状态角度集中度的贡献（分散或集中）；用仅前向的搜索高效识别具有最高分散度的权重矩阵进行秩裁剪；随后在SVD中选择性移除高阶分量、保留低阶分量。

Result: 在多样数据集上精度具竞争力；理论分析显示峰值内存低于梯度方法、加速优于梯度方法和穷举搜索；实验证明对多达57B参数的各LLM具鲁棒性和泛化性。

Conclusion: 仅前向的LLM适配方法在精度、内存和速度上均具优势，且适用于大规模LLM，为推理服务中的高效任务适配提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is undergoing rapid growth and large-scale deployment, motivating us to rethink how the inference process itself can be leveraged to enable efficient task-specific LLM adaptation. In this paper, we propose a forward-only approach for efficient LLM adaptation with forward-only passes in LLM inference serving. We exploit the angle concentration of activations induced by each singular value decomposition (SVD) component to measure its contribution-dispersed or concentrated-to the angle concentration of the hidden states. Based on this, our forward-only search then efficiently identifies the weight matrix with the highest dispersion that merits rank reduction. We then selectively remove the higher-order components and retain the lower-order components in SVD. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate the competitive accuracy of our forward-only approach, while theoretical analysis shows lower peak memory and greater speedup than the gradient-based approach and greater speedup than the exhaustive search approach. The experiments further present the robustness and generalization of our forward-only approach to various LLMs with up to 57B parameters. The code is included in the supplementary material.

</details>


### [752] [Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12164)
*Khalil Hennara,Muhammad Hreden,Zeina Aldallal,Sara Chrouf,Safwan AlModhayan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Fixer-Guided Localization（FGL）：让本地化器提出多个代码定位，由冻结的修复器打分，再用加权监督微调训练本地化器，无需运行测试或强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码本地化器通常被训练去预测参考补丁修改了哪些文件，但修复器真正需要读的代码并不等于它要修改的代码，二者存在错位。

Method: 在 Gemma 4 E4B 上搭建完整流水线，基于 1,629 条经测试验证的 Kimi K3 轨迹；本地化器生成若干候选定位，冻结修复器按"能否促成一个已验证补丁"打分，本地化器据此做加权 SFT。

Result: FGL 目标使修复器在减少 27.5% 代码量的情况下达到与教师定位相同的找 bug 频率；开发集一轮 EM 后，达到补丁的任务 53 vs 46，卡在读取不存在文件的任务 43 vs 54，解决任务 8 vs 6；训练后探索量约为基线的三倍、错误补丁更少，单智能体最高解出 78 题中的 11 题（基线为 8 题）。

Conclusion: 通过 13 次评测运行的分析，指出 8 分钟预算下 4B 智能体的瓶颈（时间、重复循环、编辑质量），并给出训练小型编码智能体的实践经验；数据、代码与适配器均已开源。

Abstract: Code localizers are usually trained to predict the files a reference patch edits, but the code a fixer needs to read is not the same as the code it changes. We propose Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL): the localizer proposes several localizations, a frozen fixer scores each by how likely it makes a verified patch, and the localizer is trained on these scores with weighted supervised fine-tuning, without running tests and without reinforcement learning. We build the full pipeline on Gemma 4 E4B for the Kaggle Gemma-4 Developer Agent competition, from 1,629 test-verified Kimi K3 trajectories. The FGL target helps the fixer find the bug as often as the teacher's localization while using 27.5% less code. On the development set, one EM round moves the agent in the expected direction compared with a matched control: more tasks reach a patch (53 vs. 46), fewer tasks get stuck reading files that do not exist (43 vs. 54), and more tasks are solved (8 vs. 6). Training also changes how the agent works: trained agents explore about three times more than the base model and write far fewer wrong patches, and the single agent solves up to 11 of 78 tasks, against 8 for the base model. An analysis of 13 evaluation runs identifies what limits a 4B agent under an 8-minute budget (time, repetition loops and edit quality) and gives practical lessons for training small coding agents. All data, code and adapters are publicly available.

</details>


### [753] [Towards Identity-Preserving LLM Agents under Model Transition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10628)
*Yihuang Kang,Pei-Cing Huang,Chan-Tung Ku,Chan Hsu,Pei-Ju Lee,I-Ling Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 模型升级后沿用相同人设/记忆/规则，并不保证行为一致；身份是否保持取决于具体模型配对，且言语自述无法检测漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中运营者常把后端模型更换视为透明的基础设施操作，假定重载同一外部状态即可复现原行为，但这一假设缺乏实证检验。

Method: 在12个受监管领域、3个开放权重模型上开展5,760次合规性测试，比较外部状态完全相同但底层模型不同时的实际决策行为。

Result: 部分模型切换引发显著行为漂移、部分没有；漂移在言语验证中不可见（所有模型均声称完全合规）；同一外部状态甚至会重排各模型合规性排名——某模型上呈大正效应，另两个上可忽略。

Conclusion: 应将模型切换视为需在行动层面做实证测试的行为变更，而非透明的基础设施替换。

Abstract: When an LLM agent's backend model is upgraded or replaced, operators typically reload the same persona, memory, and rules onto the new model and assume the agent will behave as before. We show this assumption requires empirical validation-and that whether identity is preserved depends on the specific model pairing. Across 5,760 compliance-testing runs in 12 regulated domains with three open-weight models, we find that some transitions produce significant behavioral drift while others do not, even when the agent's external state remains identical. Crucially, this drift is invisible to verbal verification: every model claims full policy compliance, yet actual decisions under pressure differ across models. The same external state can reorder which model is most compliant-a large positive effect on one substrate, negligible on the other two. Practitioners should treat model transitions as behavioral changes requiring action-level empirical testing, not as transparent infrastructure operations.

</details>


### [754] [DFT-Agent Bench: Scaffold Effects and Execution Provenance in Autonomous DFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10629)
*Shijie Liu,Jin Yang,Weilin Wan,Jingtao Han,Jia LI,Tianqi Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 DFT-Agent Bench（200+ Quantum ESPRESSO 任务），对比近乎裸的 ReAct 基线与完整 v5.1 脚手架，发现脚手架在 bands+DOS 和 d 电子 vc-relax 上稳定提升，弹性任务依模型而异，并用溯源门控发现不完整执行可能获高分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 正被部署为自主智能体做第一性原理材料模拟，但缺少统一的执行契约与带真值的评测基准，无法判断脚手架与执行合规性对结果的影响。

Method: 构建 DFT-Agent Bench：200+ 个覆盖 relaxation、电子结构、状态方程、弹性张量流程的 QE 任务，多材料层级；每题有 QE 导出的 ground truth 及公开参考交叉校验；统一执行框架下比较近乎裸 ReAct 基线与捆绑 v5.1 脚手架，跨两个模型（deepseek-v4-pro、claude-opus-4-8）；加入溯源审计检查 QE 执行契约是否满足；并做禁用检索的固定 100 任务冻结分析。

Result: 完整脚手架使 bands+DOS 提升 +0.08/+0.11，d 电子 vc-relax 提升 +0.17（两模型一致）；高分 relaxation 与 EOS 任务提升空间有限；弹性任务模型依赖（0.18→0.40 与 0.62→0.59）。冻结 100 任务分析支持整体模式：DeepSeek +0.17，Opus 相对历史池基线 +0.10（p<0.001）。溯源门控捕获可获高评分的未完成/未标记执行。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了所评估的 DFT 工作流：脚手架收益依任务类型与模型而异，且需以执行契约审计约束评分；该门控是执行检查而非欺诈检测。匿名评审材料含冻结诊断切片、提示、评分器与求解器版本。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for first-principles materials simulation. We report empirical findings from DFT-Agent Bench, a benchmark of 200+ Quantum ESPRESSO tasks spanning relaxation, electronic structure, equation-of-state, and elastic-tensor pipelines over multiple material tiers. Each task carries a QE-derived ground truth with public-reference cross-checks where available, and a provenance audit checks whether the required QE execution contract was met. Under one execution harness, we compare a near-bare ReAct baseline with a bundled v5.1 scaffold on two models. The complete scaffold improves bands+DOS by +0.08/+0.11 and d-electron vc-relax by +0.17 on both models, while high-scoring relaxation and equation-of-state cells leave little room for improvement. The elastic result is model-dependent (0.18 to 0.40 for deepseek-v4-pro and 0.62 to 0.59 for claude-opus-4-8). A fixed 100-task analysis with retrieval disabled supports the aggregate pattern: the fully frozen DeepSeek comparison gains +0.17, while the Opus comparison gains +0.10 against a historical pool baseline (p < 0.001). The provenance gate catches incomplete or unmarked executions that can receive high rubric scores; it is an execution-contract check, not a test for intentional fraud. These results characterize the evaluated DFT workflows. The anonymous review artifact contains the frozen diagnostic slice, prompts, scorer, and solver revisions: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/231e31re91287h/README.md.

</details>


### [755] [SLA-Aware Task Offloading in the IoT Edge-Cloud Continuum: Class-Weighted Deep Reinforcement Learning Against an Exact Optimum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10638)
*Shilpa Golla,Tharun Kumar Korine Palli,Urmila Bandaru*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该基准研究用小规模可精确求解的物联网卸载系统，对比深度强化学习与动态规划最优策略，发现类不敏感惩罚误差巨大，修正的按类惩罚可逼近最优，但强化学习代理在大系统中仍显著劣于最优甚至优于调参规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将深度强化学习用于边缘-云连续体中时延受限物联网任务卸载的方法常对所有未达标任务给相同惩罚，且少有工作将代理与最优策略对比，缺乏对奖励设计与最优性的严格评估。

Method: 构建四个小到可用动态规划精确求解的卸载系统，以最优策略为基准测量奖励与学习器表现；引入"达标奖励"机制使每次未达标成本等于惩罚加奖励，从而改变已发表按类奖励的类权重；对比类不敏感惩罚、修正的按类惩罚、调参PPO、调参预留规则及带可达目标的PPO-Lagrangian。

Result: 类不敏感惩罚即使学习器完美也比最优成本高65%–118%；修正按类惩罚可逼近最优（差距0.13%）。按类奖励下，调参PPO在最小系统距最优9%–11%，修正版在10个种子中9个胜过调参预留规则；较大系统中代理仍高出最优41%–76%，调参规则优于其均值；训练时长增十倍无法缩小差距，PPO-Lagrangian亦无改善。

Conclusion: 奖励设计对卸载策略的最优性影响显著，类不敏感惩罚严重失真，按类修正可大幅逼近最优；但现有深度RL代理在较大系统中仍远离最优，延长训练或采用拉格朗日约束方法难以弥补，需更严谨的最优性基准与奖励设计。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to decide where Internet of Things (IoT) tasks with different latency limits run in the edge-cloud continuum, yet some methods give every missed task the same penalty and few compare their agents with an optimal policy. This benchmark study builds four offloading systems small enough to solve exactly by dynamic programming and measures reward and learner against the optimum. A bonus for a met limit makes each miss cost its penalty plus the bonus, which shifts the class weights of published per-class rewards. A class-blind penalty stays 65% to 118% above the optimal cost even with a perfect learner, while a corrected per-class penalty comes within 0.13% of the optimum. With a per-class reward, tuned proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents come within 9% to 11% of the optimum in the smallest system, and the corrected one beats a tuned reservation rule in 9 of 10 seeds. In larger systems the agents stay 41% to 76% above the optimum, and a tuned rule beats their mean. Training ten times longer does not close this gap, and a PPO-Lagrangian agent with reachable targets does no better than the per-class reward.

</details>


### [756] [MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10657)
*Haoran Luo,Ziyue Zhu,Shangyang Wu,Linhao Luo,Yikai Guo,Qika Lin,Fangzhi Xu,Jiapu Wang,Xiaobao Wu,Yifan Zhu,Luu Anh Tuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MMGraph-Agent，一个基于缓存启发的多模态知识超图统一RAG框架，实现零API成本的轻量超图构建与动态记忆检索，在离线、在线及联合检索场景下均取得性能、效率与架构统一性的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实应用日益复杂，RAG已从文本管线演进到多模态场景，涉及知识组织与检索增强两个互补维度。然而现有方法仍面临构建成本高、上下文窗口受限，以及离线与在线知识源缺乏统一训练等挑战。

Method: 设计统一的多数模RAG框架MMGraph-Agent，以缓存启发的多模态知识超图为核心：实现零API成本的极轻量超图构建，并采用基于动态记忆的检索机制以缓解长上下文问题，同时统一离线与在线知识源。

Result: 在离线、在线以及联合检索设置下的实验表明，该方法在性能、效率和架构统一性方面均取得一致提升。代码与数据已开源。

Conclusion: MMGraph-Agent通过缓存式多模态超图与动态记忆检索，为多模态RAG提供了一种低成本、高效且统一的解决方案，具有良好的实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent.

</details>


### [757] [The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10658)
*Junhui Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了细胞扰动响应模型评价中的系统性问题：常用的全局Pearson相关被大量非响应基因主导，严重夸大性能；作者提出以delta空间（预测变化量）为核心的评估框架，并给出改进方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扰动响应模型几乎只用全局Pearson相关评估，但数千个非响应基因会主导该指标，造成"虚假高分"（GEARS全局0.977却delta仅0.076，甚至不如预测训练均值的平凡基线0.267），需要更合理的评估方法。

Method: 在Replogle K562筛选中定义并量化"delta gap"，提出delta空间评估为主基准；给出两种事后修正（共表达图上的RWR、kNN匹配）；用oracle上界诊断剩余差距来源（扰动表示几何 vs 解码器容量）；并提出端到端delta对齐训练（λ=3.0）与幅度校准变体（η=0.3）。

Result: GEARS delta Pearson仅0.076，平凡基线0.267（3.5倍于GEARS）；剩余差距2.8倍来自扰动表示几何而非解码器；delta对齐训练使delta Pearson达0.179（2.35倍GEARS），方向准确率0.680 vs 0.567，基因召回1.52 vs 1.19，结合kNN达0.217；η=0.3变体召回升至2.16；零样本跨细胞系迁移（K562→Norman A549）在741共享基因上达0.328，为平凡基线的4.7倍、标准GEARS的2.1倍。

Conclusion: 这是首个对delta gap的系统量化，也是首个通过oracle上界把剩余差距定位到扰动表示几何的诊断框架；delta空间评估应成为主要基准，且改进表示可端到端闭合部分差距并实现跨细胞系零样本迁移。

Abstract: Cellular world models aim to predict how cells respond to genetic perturbations, analogous to world models in reinforcement learning. Perturbation response models are evaluated almost exclusively by global Pearson correlation between predicted and observed transcriptomes. We show this metric is dominated by thousands of non-responsive genes and severely inflates apparent performance. On the Replogle K562 screen (509 unseen perturbations, 5000 genes), GEARS achieves global Pearson 0.977, but its delta Pearson is only 0.076. A trivial baseline predicting mean training delta achieves 0.267, which is 3.5x better than GEARS. Our primary contribution is methodological: we identify and quantify this delta gap as a systematic evaluation artifact, and propose delta-space evaluation as the primary benchmark. We provide two post-hoc corrections (RWR on co-expression graphs and kNN matching) and show that 2.8x of the remaining gap lies in perturbation representation geometry, not decoder capacity. We further show the gap is partially addressable end-to-end: delta-aligned training (lambda = 3.0) raises delta Pearson to 0.179 on Replogle (2.35x over GEARS) and surpasses the trivial baseline on direction accuracy (0.680 vs 0.567) and gene recovery (1.52 vs 1.19); combined with kNN it reaches 0.217. An amplitude-calibration variant (eta = 0.3) further raises gene recovery to 2.16 while reaching 0.218. Critically, these representations transfer zero-shot across cell lines: from Replogle K562 to unseen Norman A549, the delta-aligned model reaches 0.328 on 741 shared genes, 4.7x a trivial baseline and 2.1x standard GEARS. This is the first systematic quantification of the delta gap, and the first diagnostic framework localizing the residual gap to perturbation representation geometry via an oracle upper bound.

</details>


### [758] [RankShift: Evaluating Ranking Instability Across Benchmark Dimensions in Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10679)
*Halimat Afolabi,Daeyoung Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文档解析基准的排名对设计选择敏感：匹配策略与标注格式的交互影响最大，指标选择最稳健，故排行榜应报告排名鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档解析基准常被视为衡量模型质量的稳定标准，但排名可能高度依赖基准设计选择（数据集构成、匹配策略、评分方法），这一不稳定性此前未被系统研究。

Method: 提出 RankShift 研究框架，以 OmniDocBench 为案例，对 16 个 OCR/VLM 模型在 3 种数据配置、6 种匹配策略、3 种评分指标下评估排名稳定性，用成对秩相关、Top-k 变动率、成对反转率量化。

Result: 匹配策略与真值格式交互是主要不稳定来源：区域级匹配下 JSON 与 Markdown 标注的 Kendall's tau 均值约 0.33（最低 0.23），整页拼接评分时达 0.77；数据构成（页面类型 tau≈0.48、版面类型 tau≈0.49）不稳定相当，跨数据集迁移较稳（tau=0.80）；指标选择最稳定（NED/BLEU/METEOR 平均 tau≈0.78）。

Conclusion: 排行榜位置并非仅由模型能力决定，建议排行榜除头部分数外同时报告在合理设计选择下的排名鲁棒性。

Abstract: Document parsing benchmarks are often treated as stable measures of model quality, yet rankings may depend substantially on benchmark design choices. In this work, we present RankShift, a systematic study comparing OCR and vision-language models (VLMs) under controlled variation in dataset composition, matching strategy, and scoring methodology. Using OmniDocBench as a case study, we evaluate the ranking stability of 16 models across 3 dataset configurations, 6 matching strategies, and 3 scoring metrics. We quantify rank stability using pairwise rank correlation, top-k churn, and pairwise reversal rate. Our results show that the interaction between matching strategy and ground truth format is a substantial but understudied driver of instability: scoring against OmniDocBench's JSON annotations versus its Markdown rendering yields a mean Kendall's tau of approximately 0.33 under region-level matching strategies, with individual pairs as low as tau = 0.23, compared with tau = 0.77 when each page is scored as a single concatenated string. Dataset composition produces comparable instability across page-type strata (mean tau = 0.48) and layout-type strata (mean tau = 0.49), while the cross-dataset shift from OmniDocBench to Real5's Scanning reconstruction of the same pages is more stable (tau = 0.80). Metric choice is the most stable dimension, with mean tau of approximately 0.78 across NED, BLEU, and METEOR. These findings indicate that leaderboard position is not solely a property of model capability, motivating leaderboards that report not only headline scores but also the robustness of rankings across reasonable design choices.

</details>


### [759] [Audit Before You Merge: Provenance, Probing, and Continual LoRA Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10684)
*Lenny Aharon,Neta Glazer,Lior Aharon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对公共LoRA适配器事后合并中的灾难性遗忘测量问题，指出既有基础设施缺陷（来源校验缺失、零增量模块）会污染结果，提出"双检审计+无泄漏探测协议"作为前置条件，并据此开展合并方法的遗忘评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共LoRA适配器事后合并不是梯度更新，是低成本的持续适配路径，但要可靠测量灾难性遗忘，依赖的前置基础设施此前工作未解决：公共hub中存在静默基座版本不匹配、近零delta范数的无效模块，混入后会使测得的干扰虚高约10pp，结论不可信。

Method: 将每次适配器合并视为持续学习中的一个顺序任务，以指令微调基座模型的能力为Task 0，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上研究遗忘。提出两项审计检查（基座模型匹配、非平凡delta范数）加无泄漏探测协议作为前置条件；在审计后的4适配器集合上比较朴素合并与Task Arithmetic（λ=0.5），并做含负系数的坐标搜索；在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上复现。

Result: 在审计后的4适配器集上，朴素合并使GSM8K下降10.5pp、HumanEval下降18.3pp；λ=0.5的Task Arithmetic落在未合并基线的标准误范围内。含负系数的坐标搜索发现数学适配器在λ=-0.5时探测最优，超出仅正系数合并器的可达范围。Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上4个候选中2个未通过审计，审计后合并在GSM8K上复现相同的合并方法排序，说明结论非Llama特有。

Conclusion: 在该设定下做遗忘研究必须以审计与无泄漏协议为前提，否则测量被虚高约10pp。审计后数据表明合并方法排序稳定可复现（跨Llama与Mistral），且遗忘具有可利用的结构——负系数合并可能优于仅正系数方案，值得进一步探索。

Abstract: Post-hoc merging of public LoRA adapters is an attractive gradient-free path to continual adaptation, but reliable measurement of catastrophic forgetting in this setting depends on infrastructure that prior work has not addressed. We treat each adapter merge as a sequential task in a continual-learning setting, with the instruction-tuned base model's capabilities as Task 0, and study forgetting on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Public adapter hubs contain modules that fail basic provenance checks: silent base-version mismatches and near-zero delta norms whose inclusion inflates measured interference by ~10pp. We propose a two-check audit (base-model match, non-trivial delta norm) and a leakage-free probing protocol as preconditions for any forgetting study in this setting. On an audited 4-adapter set, naive merging causes -10.5pp on GSM8K and -18.3pp on HumanEval, while Task Arithmetic at lambda=0.5 sits within a standard error of the unmerged baseline. A coordinate search including negative coefficients identifies the math adapter as probe-optimal at lambda=-0.5, outside the reach of positive-only mergers, suggesting forgetting has structure that negation-aware merging may exploit. The same protocol replicates on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, where 2 of 4 candidate adapters fail the audit and the audited merge reproduces the same merge-method ranking on GSM8K, supporting that our findings are not Llama-specific.

</details>


### [760] [RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10689)
*Sohaib Sulman,Muhammad Atif Saeed,Akhtar Jamil,Alaa Ali Hameed,Roland Aydin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RetinaGuard：一个"智能体式"眼底筛查分诊框架，通过多智能体证据收集+学习式失败预测+信息价值驱动的工具调用+保形风险控制，在固定转诊预算下实现可认证的安全自动接受。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜筛查项目需要明确哪些自动决策可以不经人工复核直接接受，即需要可量化、可认证的安全保证；而单纯依赖置信度或校准不确定性的转诊策略可能遗漏可被其他证据识别的错误。

Method: 构建质量、诊断、不确定性、验证与解释五类智能体为每张眼底图收集证据；学习式失败预测器估计决策不安全的概率；辅助工具仅在期望信息价值超过成本时调用；接受阈值由保形风险控制（conformal risk control）认证。在RFMiD测试集上，与置信度/校准不确定性转诊在匹配转诊预算与同等认证安全水平下对比，使用两个不同强度的RETFound主模型。

Result: 弱模型（宏AUROC 0.896）：验证器分歧提供显著增量信息，20%预算下捕获280例不安全决策中的119例（最低置信度转诊为88例）；名义5%不安全水平下接受37.0%病例 vs 10.3%。强模型（0.925）：验证器未带来超出不确定性的增益，优势缩小至几个百分点。两种设置下名义5%水平覆盖率均约37.7%，门控使计算量减少约30%，质量智能体在多数图像损坏下减少不安全接受。

Conclusion: 智能体式证据收集的收益取决于主模型自身不确定性已能揭示多少错误——弱模型下收益显著，强模型下趋于饱和。

Abstract: Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

</details>


### [761] [Hallucination-Guided Unlearning: Using Hallucination Traces to Reveal Overfitted Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10697)
*Jiayu Zhang,Ziqi Zhong,Yuliang Gai,Canran Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出幻觉引导的遗忘方法HGU，用模型自身幻觉作诊断信号定位并编辑高责任MLP神经元实现选择性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型的选择性遗忘对安全与合规很重要，但有害或记忆内容常与有用知识纠缠、难以枚举，需找到可识别的遗忘对象信号。

Method: HGU以幻觉为诊断信号：通过证据与内部共识定位不被支持的片段，追踪少量高责任MLP神经元，在保持效用的KL约束下用紧凑门控编辑这些神经元。

Result: TOFU上取得最佳MU-FE权衡（forget05 Avg 0.7221，forget10 Avg 0.7699），混合提示下SepS H-Avg最高（0.4382/0.4715）；WMDP上遗忘最强（如Economics 14.2），同时Retain（52.7）与MMLU（57.2）提升。

Conclusion: 追踪幻觉可实现针对性的后处理遗忘，在无需完全重训练的情况下更好平衡遗忘效果与通用效用。

Abstract: Selective unlearning is increasingly important for the safety and compliance of large language models. Harmful or memorized content is often entangled with useful knowledge and difficult to enumerate. We use the model's own failures to identify candidates for unlearning. We propose Hallucination-Guided Unlearning (HGU), which uses hallucinations as diagnostic signals. HGU localizes unsupported spans via evidence and internal consensus, traces a sparse set of high-responsibility MLP neurons, and edits them with compact gates under a utility-preserving KL constraint. On TOFU, HGU achieves the best MU-FE trade-off, with Avg scores of 0.7221 (forget05) and 0.7699 (forget10), and the highest SepS H-Avg (0.4382/0.4715) under mixed forget/retain prompts. On the WMDP auxiliary task, HGU yields the strongest forgetting (e.g., 14.2 on Economics) while improving Retain (52.7) and MMLU (57.2). These results suggest that tracing hallucinations enables targeted, post-hoc unlearning that better balances forgetting efficacy and general utility without full retraining.

</details>


### [762] [R-BED: A Consequence-Aware Framework for System-Level AI Evaluation and Continuous Assurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10704)
*Vishal Srivastava*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R-BED 是一套"证据到决策"的方法论规范，用固定 6+4+3 共十三维诊断框架、失效介导的期望损失恒等式、证据状态与独立性分级、控制保障阶梯、五类授权处置及持续系统评估层，把技术失效证据、部署控制有效性和现实后果连接成可辩护的授权决策；通过合成退款代理走查展示其可行性，但尚无实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统评估多报告"模型属性"，而部署决策针对的是"配置好的系统"（模型＋提示、工具、权限、数据、防护措施与运行环境）。二者之间存在鸿沟，且需在全生命周期内让证据与授权决策连贯、可辩护，并避免单一变更导致证据全盘失效。

Method: 提出 R-BED 规范级方法论，包含：固定 6+4+3 架构的十三个诊断维度（技术失效、部署控制、后果与影响）；与"预期行为"和"滥用"路径相分离的失效介导期望损失恒等式；带独立性等级的有界证据状态；控制保障阶梯；由八条规则治理的五种授权处置；以及持续系统评估（CSE）层，使证据附带配置锚定、有效期与声明依赖，从而按比例而非整体失效。

Result: 通过一个合成退款代理（refund-agent）走查并以确定性脚本复现全部数字，显示"任务成功"视角可能漏掉一项有后果的控制弱点，而该流程将其识别为"证据缺失"。

Conclusion: 贡献是可复现的方法论规范：多数组件是集成到单一证据—决策记录中的标准实践，而证据有效性登记册、权限信封与分层规则属新提案；均未经实证验证，作者列出七项假设供独立检验。

Abstract: Evaluations of AI systems usually report properties of a model, while decisions to deploy concern a configured system: a model together with prompts, tools, permissions, data, safeguards and an operating context. We ask how evidence about technical failures, deployment-control effectiveness and real-world consequences can be connected to defensible authorization decisions throughout the lifecycle of a deployed system. We present R-BED (Risk-Based Evaluability Design), a specification-level methodology with a fixed 6+4+3 architecture of thirteen diagnostic dimensions (technical failure, deployment controls, consequence and impact); a failure-mediated expected-loss identity that is kept separate from intended-behavior and misuse pathways; bounded evidence statuses with independence levels; a control assurance ladder; five authorization dispositions governed by eight rules; and a Continuous System Evaluation (CSE) layer in which evidence carries a configuration pin, an expiry and declared dependencies, so that a change invalidates evidence in proportion rather than wholesale. We work through a synthetic refund-agent walkthrough, with a deterministic script that reproduces every number, to show how a task-success view can miss a consequential control weakness that the procedure identifies as missing evidence. The contribution is a reproducible methodological specification. Most components are standard practice integrated into one evidence-to-decision record; the Evidence Validity Register, the authority envelope and the tier rules are proposals. None has been empirically validated, and we state seven hypotheses for independent testing.

</details>


### [763] [No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10719)
*Xiaojie Cai,Jiayi Chen,Junwei Chen,Yu Chen,Sikai Cheng,Jinquan Dai,Siyuan Feng,Bin Fu,Dayuan Fu,Guosheng Gao,Qipeng Guo,Chenwei He,Zhulin Hu,Yaxing Huang,Shuomeng Jia,Mohan Jiang,Keyang Lei,Hongliang Li,Xuefeng Li,Zhaocheng Li,Jifan Lin,Pengfei Liu,Xinghan Liu,Yixiu Liu,Pengrui Lu,Siyuan Lu,Kai Lv,Tiantian Mi,Yang Nan,Yu Qiao,Yiwei Qin,Xipeng Qiu,Junhao Shi,Runzhou Shi,Jiadi Su,Bohao Tang,Hanning Wang,Keqi Wang,Pan Wang,Ran Wang,Shaojing Wang,Yishuo Wang,Zhixin Wang,Shenyu Wu,Muhang Xie,Tianze Xu,Hang Yan,Lvmanshan Ye,Hongche Yu,Junjie Yu,Lantian Zhang,Ruihang Zhang,Bin Zhao,Chenyang Zhou,Zijin Zhou,Wenhong Zhu,Zemu Zhu,Yumin Zhuang,Haoyang Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次将递归自我改进(RSI)应用于从零开始的完整前沿预训练流程，通过将不可闭合的单一大循环拆解为多个可闭合的小循环，用三个月训练出801-30B-A3B-Base（30B-A3B MoE，11.8T tokens），性能超越Qwen3-30B-A3B等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开RSI研究只针对后训练，依赖三个前提：已有基座模型、可用GPU小时计价的试验、可验证的分数。而预训练打破这三点：成本高出数量级、单次运行耗时数月且不可重复、目标（后训练余量）无法从单一分数读出、需要改进的是整个生产系统而非单个模型。因此希望把RSI引入预训练这一"创造AI的过程"本身。

Method: 由于单次不可重复的预训练无法闭合端到端循环，作者将RSI分解为多个更小的可控循环，每个循环修复完整运行中失效的一个步骤，覆盖数据管线、训练基础设施和团队协作等整条生产链条。

Result: 产出801-30B-A3B-Base：新组建团队在三个月内以11.8T tokens从零训练的30B-A3B MoE。作为基座模型，其性能超过Qwen3-30B-A3B与Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，仅落后更大的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，且在同设定SFT下保持该排名；仅用轻量SFT（6B tokens，无RL）即在四个agentic基准上取得最高平均分，超过包括Qwen3.6-35B-A3B在内的完整后训练模型。

Conclusion: RSI可以延伸到前沿预训练，但形态发生改变：不再是一个大循环，而是多个可闭合的小循环。由于后训练RSI依赖强基座模型，把RSI引入预训练相当于作用于所有后续阶段的基础。作者开源了801-30B-A3B-Base与轻量SFT数据。

Abstract: Pre-training is where every foundation model begins; bringing recursive self-improvement (RSI) there would let AI improve the process that creates AI. Yet public RSI work has so far targeted only post-training, which starts from an existing base model, runs trials costing GPU-hours, and returns verifiable scores. Pre-training breaks all three conditions at orders-of-magnitude higher cost: a run consumes hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours over months and cannot be repeated; its objective, post-training headroom, cannot be read off any single score; and what must improve is not a model but the whole production system, from data pipelines and training infrastructure to the teams that run them. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply RSI to an entire frontier pre-training run from scratch and to report it in detail. RSI does not stop at frontier pre-training, but it changes form: since no end-to-end loop can close over a single unrepeatable run, we decompose it into smaller loops that can, each repairing a step the full run breaks. The result is 801-30B-A3B-Base, a 30B-A3B MoE trained from scratch on 11.8T tokens in three months by a newly formed team. We release it as a base model; the lightweight SFT reported here (6B tokens, no RL) only probes post-training headroom. As a base model, 801-30B-A3B outperforms Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, trailing only the larger Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and keeps this position under identical SFT; with lightweight SFT alone, it achieves the highest average on four agentic benchmarks against fully post-trained models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Since post-training RSI presupposes a strong base model, bringing RSI into pre-training acts on the foundation every later stage builds on. We open-source 801-30B-A3B-Base and the lightweight SFT data at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B .

</details>


### [764] [The Lagrangian Brain: A Constraint Mechanics of Mind and Machine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10737)
*Yuhang He,Si Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"大脑遵循拉格朗日力学"的假设：大脑每一时刻只有一个状态，所有约束（未发生的模式、人生统计、未来目标）各由一个乘子表示，乘子积累违反量并将状态推回。神经调质/抑制性中间神经元、适应、突触、顶树突反馈分别承载不同时间常数的乘子。由此推出Dale定律、E/I平衡、皮层悖论响应与脑节律；信念=轨迹停留时间，学习=睡眠提出法则/清醒反驳，规划=目标波与当下波相遇。基于此原理无需梯度的机器在1000题上训练即解全部422,786道Sudoku-Extreme，并在迷宫与长序列置换任务上远超Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大脑任一时刻只有一个状态，但决定其下一状态的大部分信息并不在当前状态中（世界从不产生的模式、一生统计、尚未到达的目标）。作者希望用一个统一的力学框架解释这些"缺席却起作用"的约束如何作用于神经活动。

Method: 类比力学中导线通过约束力作用于珠子、每个约束对应一个拉格朗日乘子，提出神经系统同样如此：每个约束配一个乘子，积累其违反量并反向推动状态。神经元与突触承载乘子，各有时间常数——抑制性中间神经元承载"从未发生之事"，适应承载停留于同一状态的代价，突触承载经验统计，顶树突反馈承载未来。据此进行理论推导并与实际网络实验对照。

Result: 由假设导出Dale定律、交互连线与兴奋-抑制平衡、皮层的悖论性响应以及脑节律频率。给出信念、学习、规划的计算解释。连接主义与符号主义分别是冻结乘子与瞬时乘子的极限，电路运行的时间即计算深度。构建的机器无需梯度，仅用1000道已解谜题训练，即用单条轨迹解出全部422,786道Sudoku-Extreme测试题；通过睡眠-清醒重新发现数独规则；在面积为训练64倍的迷宫中规划最短路；在长度为训练25倍的字符串上精确追踪置换，而Transformer失败。

Conclusion: 心智可视为"学会了自身约束的生命"。大脑是一个受约束的单状态系统，约束通过多时间常数的乘子作用；该框架统一了解释神经解剖、生理、认知功能与机器学习，并在难解推理任务上展现出远超Transformer的泛化能力。

Abstract: A brain is in one state at a time, yet most of what decides its next state is absent from it: the patterns its world never produces, the statistics of a lifetime, a goal that lies ahead. In mechanics a wire acts on a bead only through a force that appears when the bead presses on it, and Lagrange computed such forces with one multiplier for each constraint. We propose that a brain follows the same mechanics. Everything a circuit knows, is told or wants is a constraint on its single state and acts through its own multiplier, which accumulates the violation and pushes the state back. Neurons and synapses carry the multipliers, each with its own time constant: inhibitory interneurons carry what never happens, adaptation the cost of staying in one state, synapses the statistics of experience, and feedback to apical dendrites the future. From this hypothesis follow Dale's law, the reciprocal wiring and balance of excitation and inhibition, the paradoxical responses of cortex and the frequencies of brain rhythms. Belief becomes the time one trajectory spends in each state, learning becomes sleep proposing laws and waking refuting the false ones, and planning becomes a wave from the goal meeting a wave from the present. Connectionism and symbolism are the limits of frozen and of instantaneous multipliers, and between them the time a circuit runs becomes the depth of its computation. A machine built on these principles, trained without gradients on 1000 solved puzzles, solves all 422,786 Sudoku-Extreme test puzzles with one trajectory each. It rediscovers the rules of Sudoku by sleeping and waking, plans shortest paths in mazes of 64 times the training area, and tracks permutations exactly on strings 25 times longer than in training, where Transformers fail. A mind, on this view, is life that learns its own constraints.

</details>


### [765] [Pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10739)
*Cheng Ding,Jiaming Liu,Jian Wu,Hongxia Xu,Daoqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 利用医院内卒中作为自然实验，证明光电容积脉搏波（PPG）的波形形态学可编码卒中发生前的血流动力学特征，实现卒中识别前的连续、逐搏监测预警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卒中是循环系统疾病，但其发生前即刻的血流动力学状态极少被观察到，因为卒中前的连续生理记录很难获得。PPG被所有脉搏血氧仪和数亿可穿戴设备记录，可逐搏捕捉外周脉搏，但其波形形态信息大多被丢弃。作者因此探究脉搏波形形态是否编码了即将发生卒中的血流动力学signature。

Method: 以院内卒中作为自然实验（提供医生判定卒中前的连续PPG）。研究ICU队列（MIMIC-III，n=176）和急诊队列（MC-MED，n=154），用可解释的脉搏时序、幅值、轮廓和变异性描述符刻画每一搏。在名义360分钟时间窗上区分卒中识别前窗口与稳定窗口，并测试模型跨队列迁移、与心率的对比、特征归因一致性，以及入院前两小时形态对后续病程的分层能力。

Result: 360分钟时窗下，形态学区分卒中前与稳定窗口的F1为0.941和0.989（敏感度0.998和0.980），模型不修改即迁移至第二队列，且在同窗口上优于单用心率。特征以收缩期波峰时间及其相对患者自身基线的变化为主导，跨队列特征归因一致（Spearman ρ=0.865）。入院前两小时形态可分层后续临床病程（F1 0.714和0.691）。在无卒中的高危患者中，29%和14%窗口为阳性，但五窗口持续规则将警报限制在17%和2%的患者。

Conclusion: 常规记录的脉搏携带卒中前时段的血流动力学印记，将脉搏形态学定位为候选的连续脑血管生物标志物。

Abstract: Stroke is a disorder of the circulation, yet the haemodynamic state that immediately precedes it has rarely been observed, because continuous physiological recordings before a stroke are seldom available. Photoplethysmography (PPG), recorded by every pulse oximeter and by hundreds of millions of wearable devices, captures the peripheral pulse beat by beat, but its morphology is largely discarded. Here we ask whether pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke. Using in-hospital stroke as a natural experiment that provides continuous PPG before physician-adjudicated stroke recognition, we studied intensive-care (MIMIC-III, $n=176$) and emergency-department (MC-MED, $n=154$) cohorts and described each beat with interpretable descriptors of pulse timing, amplitude, contour and variability. At a nominal 360-min horizon, morphology separated pre-recognition from stable windows with $F_1$ scores of 0.941 and 0.989 (sensitivity 0.998 and 0.980), with models transferred unchanged to the second cohort, and outperformed heart rate alone on identical windows. The signature was dominated by systolic crest time and its change from each patient's own baseline, feature attribution was concordant across cohorts (Spearman $ρ=0.865$), and morphology recorded in the first two hours of care stratified the subsequent clinical course ($F_1$ 0.714 and 0.691). In high-risk patients without stroke, 29% and 14% of windows were positive, but five-window persistence rules limited alerts to 17% and 2% of patients. The results demonstrate that the routinely recorded pulse thus carries haemodynamic imprint of the period preceding stroke, positioning pulse morphology as a candidate continuous cerebrovascular biomarker.

</details>


### [766] [BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10768)
*Zilin Guo,Tianrui Zhang,Yi Rong,Yichen Liu,Yuxin Guo,Jingcheng Ni,Lewei Lu,Zehuan Wu,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BlenderFORGE 是一个面向开源权重多模态大模型智能体的"数据-环境-优化"训练框架，通过生成 Blender Python (bpy) 代码实现可验证的 3D 场景编辑，并显著提升 8B 级模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确、程序化的 3D 图形编辑难以训练：现有系统多依赖闭源模型 API，且缺乏确定性、可验证状态的执行环境，导致难以获得可靠奖励信号与可复现训练。

Method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 基于精选资产与大规模 3D 场景库的可扩展扰动式数据生成流水线；(2) 隔离的 Blender 沙箱，实现确定性代码执行、结构化状态导出与闭环奖励计算；(3) 两阶段训练：用离线教师轨迹做冷启动 SFT，再用沙箱奖励进行多轮工具智能体强化学习（AgentLoop-RL）。覆盖物体放置、形状键编辑、光照调整、材质修改四类可验证任务。

Result: 在四类任务上，基于 Qwen3-VL-8B 与 Qwen3.5-9B 的智能体相比基座模型大幅提升，在部分指标上可与若干零样本闭源 MLLM 基线竞争；跨基准评测与相机重构图实验显示其具备超出训练设置的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 开源权重 MLLM 结合可验证沙箱环境与 SFT+RL 两阶段训练，可有效掌握程序化 3D 编辑能力，并具备一定泛化性。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents, yet precise, programmatic 3D graphics editing remains difficult to train because existing systems largely rely on closed-source model APIs and lack deterministic, state-verifiable execution environments. We present BlenderFORGE, a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit explicit Blender scenes through Blender Python (bpy) code generation. BlenderFORGE targets four fundamental state-verifiable editing task families: object placement, shape-key editing, lighting adjustment, and material modification. It integrates three components: (1) a scalable perturbation-based data generation pipeline built from curated assets and large-scale 3D scene repositories; (2) an isolated Blender Sandbox for deterministic code execution, structured state export, and closed-loop reward computation; and (3) a two-stage training pipeline that uses offline teacher trajectories for cold-start Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and sandbox-computed rewards for multi-turn tool-agentic Reinforcement Learning (AgentLoop-RL). Experiments across the four task families show that the resulting open-weight Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE agents substantially improve over their base models and achieve competitive performance with several zero-shot proprietary MLLM baselines on selected metrics. Additional cross-benchmark evaluations and camera-reframing experiments provide evidence of transfer beyond the original training setting.

</details>


### [767] [Look Ahead: Search-Driven Reasoning in Embodied AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10769)
*Ahmed Zeer,Osama Shbib,Muzaffer Kaan Yuce,Himmet Toprak Kesgin,Mehmet Fatih Amasyali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究在冻结的ACT动作分块策略上对PushT任务做选择性搜索：束搜索将成功率从0%提升到18%，并提出OSA门控仅在必要时触发完整搜索，运行时间约降低3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型测试时规划的启发，希望让机器人策略在行动前通过搜索评估候选未来；但完整搜索计算开销大，需研究是否可以有选择地搜索。

Method: 在PushT上冻结ACT策略，对动作块做束搜索：围绕策略预测生成扰动候选，并从克隆的模拟器状态出发用rollout打分。提出One Step Ahead（OSA）门控，先模拟名义策略块，仅当预测覆盖率下降超过阈值时才调用完整搜索；并对树深度、分支因子、束宽、重规划频率做消融。

Result: 50个评估回合中，束搜索把任务成功率从0%提升到18%，平均累积奖励从39.44提升到103.2；OSA在保持或提升成功率的同时，运行时间比完整束搜索减少约3倍。消融显示更大的搜索预算并不能持续提升性能。

Conclusion: 结果支持对动作分块策略采用选择性测试时搜索；在语言条件VLA和真实机器人上的评估仍属未来工作。

Abstract: Search allows a robotic policy to evaluate candidate futures before committing to an action. Motivated by test-time planning for vision-language action (VLA) models, we study selective search over action chunks in PushT using a frozen Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy. Beam search generates perturbed alternatives around the policy prediction and scores them through rollouts from cloned simulator states. Across 50 evaluation episodes, beam search raises task success from 0% to 18% and increases average cumulative reward from 39.44 to 103.2. We introduce One Step Ahead (OSA), a gate that simulates the nominal policy chunk and invokes full search only when its predicted coverage drop exceeds a threshold. In the reported ablations, OSA preserves or improves success while reducing runtime by approximately 3x relative to full beam search. Ablations over tree depth, branching factor, beam width, and replanning frequency show that larger search budgets do not consistently improve performance. The results support selective test-time search for action-chunking policies; evaluation on language-conditioned VLAs and physical robots remains future work.

</details>


### [768] [WARP-JEPA: World-Model-in-the-Loop Amortized Rollout Planning for Frozen Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10806)
*Junjie Li,Zhaojiacheng Zhou,Kaixiang Wang,Zihan Wang,QingSong Zhao,Jiong Lou,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WARP-JEPA将H-JEPA测试时的梯度下降规划替换为学习式多候选轨迹提议器，在世界模型冻结的前提下同时提升推理速度（最高18.8倍）与任务成功率（最高+33.3个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: H-JEPA虽支持长时程视觉控制，但依赖昂贵的测试时梯度下降规划：迭代优化占单回合运行时间高达97.7%，且预测 rollout 成本低并不必然带来成功控制；同时顶层长时程组合与底层两步短时程规划存在规划时程不对称问题。

Method: 提出分层摊销规划框架WARP-JEPA：保持世界模型冻结，用学习到的多候选轨迹提议器替代在线梯度优化。顶层采用轻量级世界模型在环的因果Transformer，从属层采用并行残差MLP；提议器以基于模型的rollout成本与best-of-K行为克隆训练，实现无需测试时梯度的候选选择。

Result: 在四个基准、30个冻结的H-JEPA模型上，长时程任务单回合推理提速9.6–18.8倍（Cube上2.9–3.0倍），任务成功率最高提升33.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 摊销式规划可在不重训世界模型的情况下，同时显著改善推理效率与控制性能，为H-JEPA提供可实用的规划替代方案。

Abstract: Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (H-JEPA) enable long-horizon visual control but rely on costly test-time gradient descent for planning. Our analysis reveals that iterative optimization consumes up to 97.7% of episode runtime and that low predicted rollout costs do not necessarily translate into successful control. We further identify a planning-horizon asymmetry between long-horizon top-level composition and short two-step subordinate planning. To address these challenges, we propose WARP-JEPA, a hierarchical amortized planning framework that replaces online gradient optimization with learned multi-candidate trajectory proposers while keeping the world models frozen. WARP-JEPA combines a lightweight world-model-in-the-loop causal Transformer at the top level with parallel residual MLPs at subordinate levels. The proposers are trained using model-based rollout costs and best-of-K behavior cloning, enabling efficient candidate selection without test-time gradient optimization. Across 30 frozen H-JEPA models on four benchmarks, WARP-JEPA achieves 9.6-18.8x faster episode inference on long-horizon tasks (2.9-3.0x on Cube) and improves task success by up to 33.3 percentage points. These results demonstrate that amortized planning can substantially improve both inference efficiency and control performance without retraining the world models. Code is available at https://github.com/hideinsewer/WARP-JEPA.

</details>


### [769] [ATHENA: Hypergraph-Based Learning for Toddler Autism Classification from Eye-Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10818)
*Quang-Anh N. D.,Duc Pham Minh,Thao Pham Phuong,Minh-Anh Nguyen,Thuy Linh Nguyen Thi,Hung Ha Manh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于眼动数据识别幼儿自闭症谱系障碍(ASD)的新架构，含FMMix特征级增强与ATHENA自适应超图模块，在两数据集上取得AUC 99.80%/99.86%的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幼儿ASD的早期、精准检测至关重要，而眼动特征中与ASD相关的模式十分细微，现有方法难以充分捕捉特征间复杂关系。

Method: 构建面向幼儿ASD分类的架构：引入FMMix进行特征级数据增强以提升学习能力；提出ATHENA，通过自适应超图框架建模高阶特征关系。基于两个注视坐标数据集评估。

Result: 两数据集AUC达99.80%与99.86%，准确率98.45%与98.56%，敏感度98.01%与98.10%，特异度98.74%与99.02%，显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 模型能有效识别ASD相关细微注视模式，具备临床筛查潜力；未来将在更广泛人群验证并融合多模态数据以提升诊断精度。

Abstract: In this work we proposed a architecture designed for the classification of ASD in toddlers using eye-tracking data, addressing the critical need for early and precise detection. The proposed model incorporates FMMix, a feature-level augmentation technique that bolsters the model's learning capacity, and in this work we proposed the ATHENA, which captures intricate feature relationships via an adaptive hypergraph framework. Evaluated on two datasets dataset of gaze coordinates-the model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with AUC scores of 99.80% and 99.86%, respectively. It also exhibits high accuracy of 98.45% and 98.56%, sensitivity 98.01% and 98.10%, and specificity 98.74% and 99.02%, respectively. Demonstrating its superior ability to identify subtle gaze patterns associated with ASD, these results significantly surpass existing methods, highlighting the model's potential for clinical ASD screening. Future efforts will focus on validation across broader populations and integration with multi-modal data to further refine diagnostic accuracy.

</details>


### [770] [Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10831)
*Berke Bunyamin Sule,Yavuz Selim Aygan,Ahmed Zeer,Elif Ince,Ali Mert Temizsoy,Ozgur Agar,Himmet Toprak Kesgin,Muzaffer Kaan Yuce,Mehmet Fatih Amasyali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过多语言基准（BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA）评估视觉语言模型的抽象视觉推理，并用LLM-as-a-Judge评判推理链质量，发现微调反而可能损害推理稳定性甚至导致模型崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM近年进展巨大，但在模式补全、抽象逻辑、关系推理等高阶认知任务上仍表现不佳；其根源在于模型缺乏发掘潜在规则并保持中间步骤一致的能力，而非仅选对答案。

Method: 构建涵盖BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA的多语言评测框架，比较多种数据混合策略与监督微调（SFT）方法；除最终答案准确率外，采用LLM-as-a-Judge评估推理链的有效性。

Result: 正确答案不一定对应有效推理链；基线模型往往比微调模型推理更稳定；SFT可能引发模型崩溃，表现为无限文本循环或空输出。

Conclusion: 当前VLM在抽象视觉推理上仍存在明显短板，SFT策略需谨慎使用，评测应超越答案准确率而关注推理过程质量。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models have had massive leaps in recent years. Yet, when tested on high-level cognitive tasks like pattern completion, abstract logic, and relational reasoning, they still fall short. This limitation stems from the models' lack of ability to find out underlying rules and maintain constant intermediate steps, rather than merely deciding on the correct option. To research these shortcomings, this study analyzes visual reasoning performance throughout a multilingual evaluation framework encompassing the BİLSEM, MM-IQ, Visual Puzzles, and PuzzleVQA datasets. We evaluate various data mixing strategies and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We observed that a correct answer does not always mean the reasoning chain is valid. Because of this, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to assess the quality of reasoning beyond final answer accuracy. Our experimental results reveal that baseline models often exhibit more stable reasoning compared to fine-tuned counterparts. Most importantly, we observe that SFT can lead to model collapse, manifesting as infinite text loops or empty outputs. The study concludes that current VLMs still struggle with abstract visual reasoning.

</details>


### [771] [A Gamified Framework for Conflict-Driven Design: Discovering Strategies for Collaborative Resilience with Multi-Agent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10841)
*Jin Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将利益冲突驱动的城市韧性设计建模为非零和数字桌游，用多智能体强化学习训练各利益方代理，在多个规模棋盘上评估策略表现，并搭建人机交互界面支持参与式城市规划探索权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 各利益相关方目标相互冲突，导致城市韧性投资难以协调；需要一个可实验的平台来建模这种冲突并探索权衡。

Method: 把冲突驱动的城市设计建模为非零和数字桌游，利益方代理在稀缺资源下分配投资并平衡个体收益与共享的城市发展与韧性目标；采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练策略，并在三种棋盘/场景设置（4x4、8x8、基于东京辰巳历史地图初始化的12x12）中检验，另构建人机交互界面。

Result: 4x4棋盘上学习策略达到模拟退火基准总收益约84%；8x8含空间与资源约束时自博弈代理偏好提升韧性的项目；12x12场景1万次仿真中平均总分452.1，随机策略基线为357.3；适应性、可持续性、抗洪与绿化提升，但活力与密度下降。

Conclusion: MARL代理能有效协调冲突下的城市韧性投资，但会带来活力与密度上的权衡；人机交互界面支持回放与参与者接管决策，可作为参与式城市规划的实验测试平台。

Abstract: Conflicting stakeholder objectives make it difficult to coordinate investments in urban resilience. We model conflict-driven urban design as a non-zero-sum digital board game in which stakeholder agents allocate scarce resources and balance individual payoffs against shared urban development and resilience objectives. We use multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train policies and examine their behavior across three settings. On a 4 x 4 board, learned policies reach about 84% of the total return found by a simulated annealing benchmark. On an 8 x 8 board with spatial and resource constraints, trained agents favor projects that improve resilience in self-play. In a 12 x 12 simulation initialized from historical maps of Tatsumi, Tokyo, trained agents achieve a mean total score of 452.1, compared with 357.3 for a random-policy baseline across 10,000 simulation runs. Gains in adaptability, sustainability, flood resistance, and greenery come with reductions in vitality and density. A human-in-the-loop interface supports replay and lets participants take over stakeholder decisions, providing a testbed for exploring these trade-offs in participatory urban planning.

</details>


### [772] [Factor Rank: A Canonical Algebraic Generalization of Tree Decision Diagrams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10842)
*Alexis de Colnet,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出代数树决策图（ATDD），用割矩阵的秩替代子函数计数，获得指数级更简洁的表示，同时保持严格的典范性，并给出多项式时间的规范化检测与v树变换算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有TDD用vtree替代变量序，但宽度基于"不同子函数计数"，对线性结构不敏感，因而简洁性不足。作者希望在保持典范形式（canonical form）与可判定性的前提下，引入秩来获得更强的压缩能力。

Method: 将TDD的割宽度替换为割矩阵的秩，定义ATDD，其宽度为所有割上秩的最大值（factor rank）。ATDD可视作规范形式下的树张量网络。作者给出ATDD的局部典范性刻画，并证明任意TDD可转为宽度不增的ATDD；还分析了vtree在单节点旋转下ATDD仅两个张量变化，从而设计输出多项式的vtree变换算法。核心结论用Lean形式化验证，并实现原型编译器做实证。

Result: ATDD比TDD指数级更简洁，比结构化deterministic DNNF准多项式级更简洁；对每个函数和vtree在有理数上恰有唯一ATDD（无需一般性假设），可在多项式时间从张量本身判定是否为ATDD，等价性检验化为语法相等；支持多项式时间（加权）模型计数与布尔函数性检测；回答了Capelli等人关于vtree变更复杂度的问题。

Conclusion: 基于秩的ATDD在提升简洁性的同时不牺牲典范性与可操作性，是任意vtree上首个严格的秩表示典范形式，为知识编译与张量网络表示提供了新的理论基础。

Abstract: Tree decision diagrams (TDDs), recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026), are representations of Boolean functions. They generalize OBDDs by replacing variable orders with vtrees. The width of a TDD counts the distinct subfunctions across each vtree cut. Counting subfunctions is blind to linear structure. We introduce algebraic tree decision diagrams (ATDDs) by replacing this count with the rank of the cut matrix. The maximum of these ranks over all cuts, the factor rank, is exactly the width of the ATDD. Every TDD can be converted into an ATDD of no greater width. An ATDD is a tree tensor network in canonical form. ATDDs are exponentially more succinct than TDDs, and quasi-polynomially more succinct than structured deterministic DNNFs. Our main result is that this gain in succinctness does not cost canonicity. ATDDs are the first strict canonical form for a rank-based representation over arbitrary vtrees. For each function and vtree there is exactly one ATDD, over the rationals and without any genericity assumption. The canonicity admits a local characterization. Whether a tree tensor network is the ATDD of the Boolean function it computes can be checked in polynomial time from its tensors alone. Equivalence checking becomes a test of syntactic equality. The operation set includes polynomial-time model counting, weighted model counting, and a test whether a tree tensor network represents a Boolean function.
  Capelli et al. asked for the complexity of changing the vtree of a TDD and suggested local vtree changes. We answer the question. After a rotation of the vtree at one node, the new ATDD differs from the old one in two tensors only. Vtree change runs in output-polynomial time both for TDDs and for ATDDs.
  We formalize and verify our core results in Lean. We provide a prototype implementation of TDD and ATDD compilers as a first empirical validation.

</details>


### [773] [What Broke & Why: Practical Lessons from Reinforcement Learning Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10844)
*Luv Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一本关于语言模型强化学习后训练（RLVR）的实用指南，从GRPO原理到五类训练实践案例，并系统讲解奖励设计、评估、调试、复现与工程实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR虽已成为提升语言模型推理、解题与工具使用能力的重要手段，但实践中常失败：无有效奖励、奖励被利用、探索停滞、评估本身误导等。现有资料缺乏对"什么有效、什么失败、为什么"的实战性系统总结。

Method: 以书籍形式组织：先讲后训练基础与GRPO训练循环的逐步解析；再通过五个训练项目（数学推理、搜索智能体、训练稳定性、MoE模型、软件工程任务）展示问题、改动与经验；进而分析RL在模型内部实际改变了什么；其余章节给出奖励设计、评估、工具型智能体训练、故障调试、可复现性、rollout引擎与硬件的实践参考。

Result: 汇集了跨数学、搜索、MoE、软件工程等场景的实战经验与失败模式，并形成覆盖奖励设计、评估、调试到工程基础设施的实践性参考体系。

Conclusion: 该书面向使用开源模型的研究者与从业者，帮助读者掌握训练方法、识别异常并及时决定下一步尝试，从而降低RLVR落地的试错成本。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important way to improve how language models reason, solve problems, and use tools. But getting it to work in practice is not always straightforward. Training can fail because a model receives no useful reward, learns to exploit the reward system, stops exploring, or appears to improve when the evaluation itself is misleading.
  In this book, we give a practical introduction to reinforcement learning post-training for language models, focusing on what works, what fails, and why. We begin with the foundations of post-training, explain GRPO and the training loop step by step, and then follow five training programs covering math reasoning, search agents, training stability, mixture-of-experts models, and software engineering tasks. Each program shows the problems encountered, the changes made, and the lessons learned.
  The book also examines what reinforcement learning actually changes inside a model. The remaining chapters provide a practical reference for reward design, evaluation, training tool-using agents, debugging common failures, reproducibility, rollout engines, and hardware. Written for researchers and practitioners working with open models, the book aims to help readers understand how to train models, recognize when something goes wrong, and decide what to try next.

</details>


### [774] [Inference for Reasoning Models: Practical Lessons from Evaluation and Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10845)
*Luv Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本书论证推理配置（推理设置）会显著影响语言模型的评测分数与部署表现，并系统讲解评测、输出不确定性、服务性能及高级控制手段，最后给出可复现、可信的实践指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一模型在不同评测与运行方式下会得到差异巨大的基准分数、输出答案与服务成本（如仅改变最大生成长度可使数学基准准确率从0.08%升至93.18%），因此需要系统理解推理设置如何塑造报告结果与部署系统。

Method: 以书的形式组织：先讲评测（生成长度限制、答案抽取、打分方法、量化），再分析为何在关闭采样时输出仍会随batch、注意力后端与缓存变化；继而讨论服务性能（批处理、显存容量、延迟、吞吐与成本），并研究结构化输出、工具调用、推理预算与长上下文任务。

Result: 揭示了推理配置对准确率和系统指标的巨大杠杆效应，并说明这些控制项与基准"能证明什么、不能证明什么"。

Conclusion: 给出记录推理运行、核查评测、估算容量与公平比较系统的实践指南，目标是让推理结果更易理解、复现与信任，面向使用语言模型的研究者与工程师。

Abstract: Running a language model involves more than its trained weights. The same model can receive very different benchmark scores, produce different answers, or cost more to serve depending on how it is evaluated and run. In one experiment in this book, changing only the maximum response length moved accuracy on a math benchmark from 0.08% to 93.18%.
  This book explains how inference settings shape the results we report and the systems we deploy. We begin with evaluation, including generation limits, answer extraction, scoring methods, and quantization. We then examine why outputs can change across batches, attention backends, and caching, even when sampling is disabled. The next chapters cover serving performance, including batching, memory capacity, latency, throughput, and cost. We also study structured outputs, tool calls, reasoning budgets, and long-context tasks, showing what these controls and benchmarks do and do not establish.
  The book concludes with practical guidance for recording inference runs, checking evaluations, estimating capacity, and comparing systems fairly. Written for researchers and engineers working with language models, it aims to make inference results easier to understand, reproduce, and trust.

</details>


### [775] [Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10857)
*Siddharth Roheda,Rohit Chowdhury,Amit Satish Unde,Aniruddha Bala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文证明softmax注意力及任何归一化混合算子无法实现仿射以上的多项式映射，转而提出以Volterra层作为混合算子的纯像素空间扩散架构，在ImageNet上达到与同类自包含扩散模型相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然图像被认为位于高维像素空间的低维流形上，已有工作据此构建无需预训练组件的像素空间扩散模型。但现有模型的混合算子仍是沿用自序列建模的softmax注意力，而非从去噪任务中推导得出。由于高斯噪声下的最优去噪器可用Wiener–Volterra级数（观测的多项式泛函）展开，作者希望从理论上弄清注意力能否表达这类多项式映射。

Method: 理论层面，作者证明softmax注意力与任何归一化混合规则（含线性注意力）只能实现至多仿射的多项式映射；而Volterra层可直接实现该函数类，且在数据流形上的逼近速率由流形维数而非环境像素维数决定。据此提出相应架构：原始图像块经瓶颈嵌入，后接级联的低秩Volterra层，每层本身非线性，故残差路径上无需激活函数，整体不含注意力、卷积、预训练组件与激活函数。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256与512×512上，该模型在参数量与FLOPs匹配的条件下，与自包含像素空间扩散模型性能相当。

Conclusion: 论文从去噪理论出发论证了归一化混合算子的表达局限，并给出由理论直接规定的、纯Volterra层混合的像素空间扩散架构，据作者所知这是首个全程使用Volterra层、无注意力/卷积/预训练/激活函数的像素空间扩散架构。

Abstract: Natural images are often conjectured to lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. Recent work leverages this to build self-contained pixel-space diffusion models without specialized machinery or pretrained components. A plain Transformer on raw image patches suffices, provided it predicts the clean image rather than the noise and compresses each patch through an aggressive bottleneck. The mixing operator, however, has remained softmax attention, inherited from sequence modeling rather than derived from denoising. For Gaussian noise, the optimal denoiser admits a canonical expansion in polynomial functionals of the observation, the Wiener--Volterra series. We prove that softmax attention, and any normalized mixing rule (including linear attention), cannot realize any polynomial map beyond an affine one. In contrast, Volterra layers realize this class directly and, on a data manifold, achieve approximation rates governed by the manifold dimension rather than the ambient pixel dimension. We therefore propose the architecture these results prescribe; raw image patches passed through a bottleneck embedding, followed by cascaded low-rank Volterra layers, which carry no activation function because each layer is nonlinear in its own right. To our knowledge this is the first pixel-space diffusion architecture whose mixing operators are Volterra layers throughout, with no attention, no convolution, no pretrained components, and no activation function on the residual path. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and $512 \times 512$, the resulting model is competitive with self-contained pixel-space diffusion at matched parameter and FLOP budgets.

</details>


### [776] [Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10884)
*Yutao Sun,Haokun Li,Mingshuai Chen,Guanyan Li,Zhongyi Wang,Shengchao Qin,Jianwei Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出用外部有限状态机（FSM）在运行时约束LLM智能体，使其在长时程任务中可靠遵守一次陈述的SOP，显著减少程序漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多交给语言模型智能体的自动化是流程性的：单步不需太多智能，但长时间无人值守运行必须遵循开始时只陈述一次的技能或SOP。作者发现智能体在长时运行中会偏离流程，而重述指令或恢复已停止的智能体只会把漂移转移到别的捷径。

Method: 设计一个可执行FSM，将工作流状态保存在模型上下文之外，并在三个点强制执行：工具调用、状态转移、以及智能体回合结束。

Result: 在预注册实验中（200账户SOP-Bench批次），Claude Haiku 4.5配FSM平均正确并按流程决策139个账户，最强基线为48（差值95% CI [46,130]），且保持到结束；三个模型上增益与普通智能体漂移程度相关。Haiku 4.5+FSM的平均此类决策数超过普通Claude Sonnet 4.6，成本仅38%。SWE-bench Verified、τ²-bench及分阶段、跨上下文工作流的分析也支持这一结论。

Conclusion: 由于长时程可靠性由运行时而非模型提供，FSM可让小型模型承担流程性工作；可靠的长期自动化可来自更强的执行控制，而不仅是更强的模型。

Abstract: Much of the automation handed to language-model agents is procedural: each step needs little intelligence, but a long unattended run must follow a skill or SOP stated once at the start. We show that agents drift from such procedures over long runs, and that restating the instructions or resuming a stopped agent only moves the drift to another shortcut. We study an executable finite-state machine (FSM) that keeps the workflow state outside the model's context and enforces it at three points: tool calls, state transitions and the end of the agent's turn. In a pre-registered experiment on 200-account SOP-Bench batches, Claude Haiku 4.5 with the FSM decided on average 139 accounts correctly and by the procedure, against 48 for the strongest baseline (95% CI of the difference [46, 130]), and kept this rate to the end; across three models, the gain tracked how much the plain agent drifted. Because the runtime, not the model, supplies this long-horizon reliability, the FSM can let small models carry procedural work: Haiku 4.5 with it averaged more such decisions than plain Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 38% of the cost. Analyses on SWE-bench Verified, $τ^2$-bench, and staged and cross-context workflows further suggest that reliable long-horizon automation can come from stronger execution control, not only stronger models.

</details>


### [777] [Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10891)
*Prashanth Bhaskara,Shubhaankar Gupta,Seojoon Yeon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"召回保真度分数"（Recall Fidelity Score）这一新指标，用于衡量大语言模型内部知识中细节精度如何影响其对未来事件的预测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM存在"近似召回"问题：能保留过去事件的粗略关联，却在具体细节上失真。已有研究用预测市场量化了模型的预测能力，但未探究这种细节保真度的流失如何影响预测表现。

Method: 引入Recall Fidelity Score指标，量化模型在语义相关历史事件上的局部召回保真度，并分析其与预测市场预测表现之间的关系。以"Anna Sawai是否获第76届艾美奖最佳剧情类女主角"等类似事件为例说明细节失真现象。

Result: 在已结算的历史市场上，语义相似过去事件的更高局部召回保真度，可预测更低的预测误差；同一信号也预测模型预测结果与开放市场价格的更小偏离。

Conclusion: 内部知识的细节精度（召回保真度）是影响LLM未来事件预测能力的重要信号，可作为预测表现的有效预测因子。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit approximate recall: they retain coarse associations about past events while losing fidelity on specific details. Past research on LLMs has quantified different models' forecasting ability in real-world events using prediction markets, but has not studied how losing said fidelity impacts their forecasting abilities. For example: while an LLM correctly recalls that the answer to: ''Did Anna Sawai win the Best Drama Actress in the 76th Emmy Awards?'' is ''Yes,'' it incorrectly states the event date as September 22 rather than September 15. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric called the Recall Fidelity Score to study how imprecision in internalized knowledge propagates to forecasting capability on future events. On resolved historical markets, we find that higher local recall fidelity around semantically similar past events predicts lower forecasting error on resolved markets, and the same signal predicts smaller distance from open markets prices.

</details>


### [778] [Complementarity without ground truth?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10893)
*Andrea Ferrario,Alessandro Facchini,Federico Cabitza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文探讨人-AI互补性对"真值"(ground truth)的依赖，并把它扩展到真值不适用、需要以"适宜性"(adequacy)为评价基准的决策支持场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"人-AI互补性"研究多以真值标签为评估基准，但许多交互(如医疗AI的治疗建议)并非预测"事实如何"，而是相对实践目标的适宜性判断，依赖多个评价维度，真值并非恰当参照。

Method: 证明非预测任务仍可存在生成"适宜性标签"的参照构建程序；提出以两步评分法(受医疗多准则决策分析启发)、用情境依赖的适宜性标签替代真值标签的扩展路径，并显式化参照构建中的规范性选择；借计算可靠论识别支持标签构建的技术、科学与社会因素。

Result: 建立了一条将人-AI互补性从预测任务推广到决策支持任务的量化评估路线，并明确了适宜性标签构建所嵌入的评价性选择与其可靠性依据。

Conclusion: 该方法将人-AI互补性的实证研究扩展到真值不适用的决策支持场景，使其可被定量评估。

Abstract: Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.

</details>


### [779] [How Short Is Too Short? Length-Conditional Calibration and Abstention for Detecting AI-Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10901)
*Ritesh Janga,Justin Zhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究基于分数的AI文本检测在短文本（10-200 token）下的表现，给出假阳性率随长度变化的闭式解和所需token数公式，并用分箱保形校准维持名义假阳性率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测器多在数百token的段落上调试和测试，但真实场景中很多是短文本；且检测性能如何随段落长度变化尚不清楚。

Method: 将基于分数的检测视为段落长度的函数；推导长文本上设定的阈值在长度下降时假阳性率的闭式表达，以及达到目标真阳性率所需token数的公式；采用分箱保形p值进行阈值校准，并加入箱级弃权规则（当该长度下检测器无法提供信息时弃权）。
