*SuGil Choi,Mooseop Kim,Chi Yoon Jeong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对EEG基础模型中随机掩码重建与位置编码的两个局限，提出基于图卷积网络（GCN）的条件位置编码以显式建模通道间相关性，并设计自适应掩码策略调节重建难度，在十个基准数据集上取得SOTA或竞争性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型多采用掩码patch重建，但纯随机掩码会使高相关通道的信息性patch不被掩蔽，导致网络对弱相关通道或序列依赖利用不足；同时transformer类模型性能受位置编码影响，而位置编码在NLP/CV中研究充分却少有工作针对EEG信号特性进行适配。

Method: 提出基于图卷积网络（GCN）的条件位置编码方法，显式建模通道间相关性；并提出自适应掩码策略，通过调制被掩码patch重建的难度来增强表征学习。据称是首次将图表示引入条件位置编码并在EEG基础模型预训练中引入自适应掩码。

Result: 在十个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提GCN位置编码与自适应掩码策略单独使用及组合使用时均达到SOTA或竞争性性能，验证其在EEG基础建模中的有效性。

Conclusion: GCN条件位置编码与自适应掩码可有效弥补随机掩码与通用位置编码在EEG基础模型中的不足，二者互补且可组合，为EEG基础模型的预训练设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models have emerged as promising paradigms for decoding brain activity through large-scale self-supervised pretraining. Notably, most existing approaches employ masked patch reconstruction, in which randomly selected EEG patches are masked and recovered by the network. However, purely random masking may limit representation learning as informative patches from highly correlated channels often remain unmasked, causing the network to underutilize weakly correlated channels or serial dependencies. Furthermore, because these models are typically based on transformer architectures, their performance is influenced by the choice of positional encoding. Although positional encoding has been extensively explored in natural language processing and computer vision, few studies have adapted it to the unique characteristics of EEG signals. To address these limitations, this study introduces a conditional positional encoding method based on graph convolutional networks (GCNs) to explicitly model inter-channel correlations, along with an adaptive masking strategy that enhances representation learning by modulating the difficulty of masked patch reconstruction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to integrate graph-based representations into conditional positional encoding and introduce adaptive masking within EEG foundation model pretraining. Experimental results on ten benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed GCN-based positional encoding and adaptive masking strategies, both individually and in combination, achieve state-of-the-art or competitive performance, highlighting their effectiveness in EEG foundation modeling.

</details>


### [815] [When Should AI Overturn a Human Decision? Controversy at the 2026 World Cup and a $\sqrt{2/π}$ Solution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11819)
*Amir Ali Ahmadi,Parsa Alavi,Radeen Alavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一个显式的最大似然规则，用于融合裁判的二元判罚与VAR的数值测量（越位边缘），当两者冲突时决定是否改判，阈值约为√(2/π)·σ_AI²/σ_H。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 足球中人类裁判做二元判断（越位/不越位），AI（VAR）给出数值测量，两者冲突时缺乏明确的统计学判据来决定是否推翻判罚。

Method: 将真实越位边缘视为固定未知量，假设人类感知与AI测量各含独立加性高斯误差（标准差σ_H、σ_AI），推导最大似然改判阈值；并扩展到存在系统偏差的情形，证明估计存在唯一性，说明只需阈值比较而无需数值求解。

Result: 零均值、已知标准差时改判阈值为√(2/π)·σ_AI²/σ_H；只有当VAR测得的边缘超过该阈值才推翻“不越位”判罚，而非仅仅越过越位线；给出数值示例及从校准数据估计误差参数的方法。

Conclusion: 结论该规则可推广到满足同样模型的人机二元分类融合问题；论文定位为教学性文章，便于具备基础概率与微积分的学生探索AI相关研究问题。

Abstract: We study how to combine a human binary call (a referee's offside or onside decision) with an AI numerical measurement (VAR's estimate of an attacker's position relative to the offside line). We derive an explicit maximum-likelihood rule that determines when the referee's call should stand and when a conflicting VAR measurement should overturn it. Our model treats the true offside margin as fixed and unknown and assumes independent additive Gaussian errors in the human's perception and the AI measurement. When both errors have zero means and known standard deviations $σ_H$ and $σ_{AI}$, respectively, the reversal threshold is $\sqrt{2/π}\,σ^2_{AI}/σ_H$. An onside call is overturned precisely when VAR's measured offside margin exceeds this threshold---not merely because VAR places the attacker beyond the offside line. We also derive the rule when either source has a systematic bias. We prove that the maximum-likelihood estimate of the true margin exists and is unique, while the final binary decision requires only a threshold comparison, without computing that estimate numerically. We illustrate the rule through numerical examples and show how to estimate the error parameters from calibration data. The same analysis applies beyond soccer to binary classification problems in which a human call and an AI measurement satisfy the stated model. This paper is intended for educational purposes: we aim to illustrate how undergraduate students and advanced high school students familiar with basic probability and calculus can investigate research questions in AI and its applications.

</details>


### [816] [ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11825)
*Nan Wu,Hong Yee Hung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AcrossVAM3.0 是一个离线系统，将文本、图像或单目 RGB 视频转换为带版本的点表示，并可结合视频生成、动态重建与单目 SLAM，在单 GPU 上以 17.14 GB 峰值显存完成资源受限的场景构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法组合视频生成、动态重建和单目 SLAM 时需要一致的坐标系统、对缺失输出的显式处理以及可预测的内存占用，作者希望提供一个协调层不含神经参数、资源可控的统一离线系统。

Method: 冻结模型在单 GPU 上顺序执行；地图修正可同步更新相机、点与轨迹；协调层不引入神经参数。针对严格跨窗口匹配导致长程轨迹覆盖下降的问题，提出多假设自适应表面链（MHAC），保留多个候选匹配与显式缺失状态，并在独立开发数据上选择超参数。

Result: 三次输入模式运行峰值 GPU 显存不超过 17.14 GB；16 场景视频套件全部得到 4D 重建，15 个得到非空 SLAM 地图。在冻结的十视频留出集上，MHAC 相对位置基线将 Average Jaccard 提升 0.1394（95% bootstrap 区间 [0.1074, 0.1689]）；在 265 个 RoboTAP 视频上平均配对增益 0.0610（[0.0510, 0.0715]），215 胜、1 平、49 负。

Conclusion: 结果支持资源受限的场景构建与外部跟踪增益，但未验证度量尺度、语义身份或高保真新视角渲染能力。

Abstract: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.

</details>


### [817] [Correct Answers from Insufficient Histories: A Controlled Study of Agent Memory Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11840)
*Quan Xue,Zerui Yang,Chaorui Zhang,Haolin Ruan,Xueyan Niu,Xuanyu Zheng,Xiyuan Wang,Weixi Zhang,Wei Han,Bo Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文用可执行设备日志区分"答案与参考答案一致"和"可见上下文是否足以确定答案"，发现强模型常在信息不足时仍给出匹配答案，说明现有评测会把运气当作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体/记忆评测只看最终答案是否与参考答案一致，但当读取者看到的上下文不足以推出答案时，仍可能"碰巧"匹配成功，从而高估系统能力。作者希望把"参考一致""证据充分性证明""上下文恰当行为"三者分开测量。

Method: 基于可执行设备日志设计协议：用两条合法历史产生字节完全相同的可见上下文但答案不同来认证"不充分"；用公开时序与查询截断来认证"充分前缀"。在80条确认历史上测试Qwen3-32B与DeepSeek-V4-Flash（固定输入复制），各发1600次请求，统计匹配、适当弃答，并估计紧凑CSV对恰当性的效应；另做独立的裁判（judge）研究与确定性基线对照。

Result: 203个不充分原始前缀实例中，Qwen3-32B匹配87个隐藏参考答案却仅7次适当弃答；DeepSeek-V4-Flash匹配85个、弃答21次。紧凑CSV的恰当性提升不显著：Qwen +3.16pp，聚类95%区间[0.00,6.57]；DeepSeek +2.46，[-1.84,6.94]。裁判研究正确率99.38%但仍存在支撑错误与截断；确定性基线在所有构造案例上全部正确。

Conclusion: 结果是对两种托管读取者配置的评测诊断，而非通用记忆系统或自然语言证据评估的增益证明：高匹配率很大程度上掩盖了证据不足下的过度作答。

Abstract: An answer can match the reference for a complete agent history even when the reader's visible history does not determine it. We study this distinction using executable device logs. Our protocol separates reference agreement, certified evidence sufficiency, and context-appropriate behavior. Insufficiency requires two legal histories yielding byte-identical visible contexts but different answers; public chronology and query cutoffs certify sufficient prefixes. On 80 confirmation histories, Qwen3-32B matches 87 hidden references among 203 insufficient raw-prefix instances, with only seven appropriate abstentions. A fixed-input DeepSeek-V4-Flash replication matches 85 and abstains on 21 of the same 203 instances. Each reader makes 1,600 requests. Compact CSV's estimated appropriateness effects remain inconclusive: +3.16 percentage points, clustered 95% interval [0.00,6.57], for Qwen and +2.46, [-1.84,6.94], for DeepSeek. A separate held-out judge study achieves 99.38% correctness but retains support errors and truncations; a deterministic baseline solves all constructed cases. These results support an evaluation diagnosis across two hosted reader configurations, not gains for a general memory system or natural-language evidence assessment.

</details>


### [818] [MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11846)
*Gwangseon Jang,Sieun Yun,Dong Ho Lee,Kyong-Ha Lee,Chanuk Lim,Jin Woo Choi,Han Seul Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLM不作预测器而作"分类学生成器"，通过生成化学有意义的环境划分并做不变特征选择，提升材料性质预测的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料性质预测中OOD泛化是核心难题，模型需外推到训练分布之外的新化学体系。LLM虽有科学推理能力，但直接用于定量预测效果有限，需重新界定其角色。

Method: 系统评估LLM多种辅助角色，发现仅基于分类学(taxonomy)的分组能稳定改进kNN+GBT基线的OOD表现。据此提出MOTIF：LLM生成候选分类学，将材料划入化学上有意义的环境；用仅训练集的伪OOD验证筛选有效分类学；在接受的分类学内做不变特征选择，最后跨分类学门控聚合。

Result: 2D卤化物钙钛矿带隙预测OOD MAE由0.122降至0.111 eV；冻结dev/test协议下电子带隙0.123→0.117 eV，光学带隙0.181→0.173 eV。并在3D钙钛矿太阳能电池效率、Matbench结构划分等数据集验证可迁移性，优于专家分组、规则启发式和聚类基线。

Conclusion: LLM最强价值不在于预测，而在于发现数据结构；MOTIF通过分类学生成+不变特征选择+门控聚合可稳定提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains a central challenge in materials property prediction, where models must extrapolate to novel chemistries beyond the training distribution. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong scientific reasoning, their direct use for quantitative prediction remains limited. To address this, we systematically evaluate multiple roles for LLM assistance, finding that only taxonomy-based grouping consistently improves OOD generalization over a strong kNN+GBT baseline. Building on this, we here propose MOTIF, a framework that leverages LLMs not as predictors, but as generators of candidate taxonomies that partition materials into chemically meaningful environments. These taxonomies are evaluated via training-only pseudo-OOD validation, and only those that improve generalization are retained. Invariant feature selection is then applied within each accepted taxonomy, followed by gated aggregation across taxonomies. We evaluate on 2D halide perovskites, where bandgap prediction must generalize across distinct organic spacer families. On this benchmark, MOTIF reduces mean OOD MAE from 0.122 to 0.111 eV. Under a frozen dev/test protocol, the deployable configuration further improves errors from 0.123 to 0.117 eV (electronic bandgap) and from 0.181 to 0.173 eV (optical bandgap). Beyond this primary task, we validate transferability across additional materials datasets, including 3D perovskite solar cell efficiencies and Matbench benchmarks with structure-based splits. Across domains, MOTIF consistently improves robustness under distribution shift, outperforming expert-defined groupings, rule-based heuristics, and clustering baselines, while remaining competitive with strong classical selection methods. These results demonstrate that LLMs are most effective not as predictors, but as tools for discovering structure in data.

</details>


### [819] [LEGION: Benchmarking Language Agents on Sparse-Signal Investigation Under Adversarial Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11896)
*Samuel Joseph Amouyal,Ofek Glick,Yaniv Menasherov,Eyal Fisher,Ohav Barbi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Legion 基准框架（含随机企业遥测模拟器 Legion-Sim、74 个对抗场景库 Legion-Bench 及评估协议），用于评估自主语言模型代理在稀疏信号、大量无关信息下的发现型任务能力，并揭示当前代理低精确率的系统性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主语言模型代理越来越多被用于发现型任务，此类任务信号稀疏、检索到的信息大多无关。但现有基准因信号密集、环境协作性强、真值往往只需几次工具调用即可获得，无法评估这一真实场景，因此需要新的基准框架。

Method: 构建 Legion 框架：耦合随机企业遥测模拟器 Legion-Sim、分层组织的 74 个专家设计对抗场景库 Legion-Bench，以及同时评估调查效率与检测准确率的评估协议；场景注入全新模拟公司，可独立控制混淆因素密度与事件量。在两家模拟公司上测试五种代理架构。

Result: 五种代理架构召回率高（0.82–0.88），但精确率偏低（0.61–0.72）；代理无法找全攻击的全部入侵指标，或将真实指标误判为攻击相关指标（在网络安全调查中至关重要）；失败在不同推理层级间一致，并在混淆密度与事件量变化下持续存在。

Conclusion: 当前语言模型代理在稀疏信号发现型任务中存在系统性精确率缺陷。作者开源 Legion、场景库、常见架构性能结果及可复现与扩展流水线。

Abstract: Autonomous language-model agents are increasingly deployed on discovery-driven tasks where signal is sparse and most retrieved information is irrelevant. Current benchmarks fail to evaluate this regime due to dense signals, cooperative environments, and ground truth typically being only a few tool calls away. We introduce Legion, a benchmark framework coupling a stochastic enterprise-telemetry simulator (Legion-Sim) with a tiered library of 74 expertly-crafted adversarial scenarios (Legion-Bench) and an evaluation protocol that scores investigation efficiency alongside detection accuracy. Scenarios are injected into freshly simulated companies, allowing independent control over confounder density and event volume. We test five agent architectures on two simulated companies and find that while recall is high (0.82-0.88) precision lags behind (0.61--0.72). They fail to find all of the indicators of compromise of the attack or mistake genuine indicators with attack related ones, which is critical in the context of cybersecurity investigation. Failures are consistent across reasoning tiers and persist across confounder density and event volume. We release Legion, the scenario library, performance on common agent architectures, and pipeline for reproducibility and extension.

</details>


### [820] [Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11898)
*Zikai Zhou,Zhengpeng Xie,Shitong Shao,Lichen Bai,Tianhao Zhang,Bojun Cheng,Zeke Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DA-DMD利用DMD训练中已有的teacher–fake分歧幅度作为诊断信号，在高噪声区间动态调节更新强度，无需额外模型即可提升少步扩散生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DMD改进多聚焦于增强监督或修改优化机制。作者提出互补性问题：DMD能否利用训练中已产生的信号自我诊断更新？观察到高噪声区间中大的teacher–fake分歧与高能量更新一致，说明分歧不仅决定移动方向，也隐含更新激进度信息。

Method: 提出Disagreement-Aware DMD（DA-DMD）：仅在高噪声区间激活，依据teacher–fake分歧持续调制更新强度。复用DMD训练已有量，无需额外模型、评估器或推理改动；在选定区域外精确退化为原始DMD，仅通过选中样本降低更新能量，并在极端分歧下呈现redescending影响。

Result: 多个扩散骨干上一致提升少步生成且推理成本不变。SD3.5-L上HPSv2从28.23提升至30.93，相对DMD2平均胜率64.4%。

Conclusion: teacher–fake分歧具有"方向+强度"双重作用，可作为DMD的自诊断信号；DA-DMD是一种即插即用、零额外开销的改进方案，实验验证其有效性。

Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation~(DMD) enables strong few-step diffusion generation by matching the student distribution to a pretrained teacher. Existing improvements to DMD often augment its supervision or modify its optimization machinery. We ask a complementary question: \emph{can DMD diagnose its own updates using signals already produced during training?} DMD inherently computes the discrepancy between a pretrained teacher and a fake model tracking the student distribution, but conventionally uses it primarily to determine the distribution matching direction. We find that the magnitude of this teacher--fake disagreement provides additional diagnostic information. Across extensive experiments, large disagreement in the high-noise regime consistently coincides with substantially higher-energy DMD updates. This reveals a dual role of disagreement: it determines not only \emph{where} the student should move, but also provides an intrinsic signal of \emph{how aggressively} the update should be applied. Based on this observation, we introduce Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation (DA-DMD), which activates only in the high-noise regime and continuously modulates the update strength according to teacher--fake disagreement. DA-DMD reuses quantities already available during DMD training and requires no additional model, evaluator, or inference-time modification. We show that it exactly recovers vanilla DMD outside the selected region, reduces update energy only through selected samples, and exhibits redescending influence under extreme disagreement. Across multiple diffusion backbones, DA-DMD consistently improves few-step generation at the same inference cost. On SD3.5-L, DA-DMD improves HPSv2 from $28.23$ to $30.93$, while achieving a $64.4\%$ average win rate over DMD2.

</details>


### [821] [Layer Roles Matter: Mitigating Modality Imbalance in Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Adaptive Layer Profiling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11907)
*Pengyu Huang,Peipei Song,Beier Zhu,Zhiyuan Han,Jinpeng Hu,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析MER模型中模态失衡的两种失败模式（单模态过度依赖、跨模态利用不足）以及MLLM层在处理多模态情感时的隐式功能分层，提出无需训练的层感知模态重平衡框架LAMR，依据量化指标自适应定位层角色并分别施加干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM用于多模态情感推理时，模态异质性导致模态失衡与情感理解缺陷。现有方法未区分失衡的不同成因与模型的层功能差异，需分析并提出对应干预策略。

Method: 提出LAMR：先用两个量化指标进行自适应层角色刻画——模态熵（ME）衡量模态贡献分散度，跨模态强度（CMI）衡量跨模态交互强度；据此在“稳定层”增强模态均衡、在“整合层”增强跨模态传播，无需额外训练。

Result: 在两个综合MER基准上的大量实验表明，LAMR在多种MLLM骨干上有效缓解模态失衡并提升情感推理性能，且无需额外训练。

Conclusion: 层功能分层与模态失衡类型的对齐式干预是提升MER的有效途径，LAMR提供了一种通用、免训练的重平衡方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning (MER) requires perceiving and integrating emotion cues from multiple modalities. Recent advances increasingly leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to enhance reasoning capacity. However, due to the inherent heterogeneity in conveying emotions across modalities, these models often suffer from modality imbalance and confront flawed emotion understanding. In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis on MER models and uncover two key empirical insights. (i) In MER, modality imbalance manifests two distinct failure modes: unimodal over-reliance and insufficient cross-modal utilization, which call for different intervention strategies. (ii) MLLM layers exhibit implicit functional hierarchies in multimodal emotion processing, playing separable roles in stabilizing unimodal representations and integrating cross-modal information. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Layer-Aware Modality Rebalancing (LAMR) framework by explicitly aligning intervention strategies with layer roles. Specifically, we first introduce two quantized metrics for adaptive layer role profiling. In each layer, Modality Entropy (ME) measures the dispersion of modality contributions, and Cross-modal Intensity (CMI) captures the strength of cross-modal interactions. Then, we respectively enhance modality equilibrium in stabilization layers and cross-modal propagation in integration layers. Extensive experiments on two comprehensive MER benchmarks demonstrate that LAMR effectively mitigates modality imbalance and improves emotion reasoning across diverse MLLM backbones, without additional training.

</details>


### [822] [CHORD: Multi-resolution Compression for Multimodal Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11913)
*Bibhus Luitel,Payal Mohapatra,Subrata Biswas,Ekata Poudel,Sunwoong Kim,Qi Zhu,Bashima Islam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CHORD 是一种面向异构多模态时间序列的由粗到细压缩器，用残差级联和有限标量量化让压缩包大小事先已知，并可从单一载荷解码多种时间分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴、移动与 IoT 平台持续产生大规模多模态时间序列，同一份记录常被多个下游模型以不同时间分辨率重复使用。现有方法各有局限：符号化/误差有界压缩器重建准确但分辨率在压缩时固定；学习式编解码器只针对单一信号域；离散分词器不考虑码率。

Method: 提出粗到细压缩框架：残差级联按时间尺度由粗到细组织数据，并用受 shapelet 启发的原子合成修正；共享通路提供跨模态可复用合成基，私有通路保留传感器专属形态容量；有限标量量化固定每个模态和尺度的位宽，使编码前即可预知载荷大小；尺度 dropout 训练每个粗到细前缀成为有效的重建工作点。

Result: 在七个可穿戴感知与预测基准上，8x 目标码率下 CHORD 与未压缩分类准确率平均差距仅 0.62 个百分点，为所有压缩方法中最小，且所有分辨率均由同一载荷解码得到。

Conclusion: CHORD 实现了小体积、跨分辨率可用且码率可预先确定的压缩表示，在多模态时间序列任务上优于现有压缩方案。

Abstract: Wearables, mobile devices, and IoT platforms generate multimodal time-series data continuously and at scale, making efficient storage and transfer a primary concern. The same recordings are reused after collection by many downstream models, often at different temporal resolutions, so a compressed representation should be small, useful across resolutions, and produced at a bit rate known in advance. Prior work meets parts of this: symbolic and error-bounded compressors reconstruct accurately but fix resolution at compression time, learned codecs target one signal domain, and discrete tokenizers reconstruct without accounting for rate. We introduce CHORD, a coarse-to-fine compressor for heterogeneous multimodal time series. A residual cascade orders each payload from broad to fine temporal scales and synthesizes corrections through learned shapelet-inspired atoms. A shared pathway supplies a reusable synthesis basis across modalities, while private pathways retain capacity for sensor-specific morphology. Finite scalar quantization fixes the bit width of every modality and scale, so payload size is known before encoding, and scale dropout trains each coarse-to-fine prefix to be a valid reconstruction operating point. Across seven wearable-sensing and forecasting benchmarks, CHORD stays within 0.62 points of uncompressed classification accuracy on average at the 8x target, the smallest gap of any compressed method, with all resolutions decoded from one payload.

</details>


### [823] [Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11929)
*Zichuan Fu,Junjia Qi,Wenlin Zhang,Yimin Deng,Shirong Wang,Jinyang Li,Xian Wu,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SoMem框架，让LLM智能体用普通链接文档自组织外部记忆，在三个长对话基准上超越最强基线2-3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体部署后权重固定，新信息须存入外部记忆；现有方法依赖预定义记录与固定组织规则，难以适应不断演进的任务与交互，故探究智能体能否用普通文档自主组织记忆。

Method: SoMem将记忆存于链接文档中：智能体自主决定摘要内容、如何归类相关信息、何时修订已有主题，每条摘要均链接回原始交互作为证据；运行时校验更新，并自动派生时间、关系与近期记忆视图；查询时智能体自主选择搜索与阅读内容，沿文档链接并查看原始证据。

Result: 在LoCoMo、BEAM-100K、LongMemEval-S上分别比最强基线高2.66、3.10、2.00个百分点；构建的记忆可跨模型复用，增加推理投入还能进一步提升答案质量。

Conclusion: 验证了智能体通过普通文档组织和使用持久记忆的可行性，代码已开源。

Abstract: In most LLM agents, weights are fixed after deployment, so new information must be retained in external memory. Existing approaches often rely on predefined records and fixed organizational rules, which cannot readily accommodate evolving tasks and interactions. This raises the question: can LLM agents organize their own memory using ordinary documents? We introduce self-organized memory (SoMem), a framework that stores memory in linked documents. The agent decides what to summarize, how to group related information, and when to revise existing topics, and every summary it produces stays linked to the original interactions as evidence. The runtime validates updates and automatically derives temporal, relational, and recent-memory views from the organized content. At query time, the agent chooses what to search and read, following document links and inspecting original evidence as needed. On LoCoMo, BEAM-100K, and LongMemEval-S, SoMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.66, 3.10, and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. The constructed memory can be reused across models, and additional reasoning effort can further improve answer quality. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of agents organizing and using their own persistent memory through ordinary documents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Qi202/SoMem.

</details>


### [824] [ChainCheck: Near-Perfect Evidence-Sufficiency Scores Can Conceal Sensitivity to Construction Artifacts -- Paired Conditional Contrasts that Expose an Evaluation Confound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11965)
*Hyojung Han,Ryangkyung Kang,Youngeun Kim,Seung-Hun Jeon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChainCheck 是一项评估有效性审计：在证据充分性基准中，编辑文本制造的"断链"可被仅看表面痕迹的基线（不看推理链的模型评分、单一字符串匹配）近乎完美地识别，故高分与正交叉控制分数不能证明多跳推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证据充分性基准（判断证据集推理链是否完整）常用"编辑文本"方式构造断链反例，作者怀疑这类近满分成绩甚至正的交叉控制分数可能源于编辑痕迹而非多跳推理能力，需要审计评估的有效性。

Method: 提出 ChainCheck 审计框架：将验证器认证的反事实单元与"仅依赖伪迹"的基线配对。在 2,214 对 HotpotQA 上做探索性交叉控制，与 11 个系统比较链敏感统计量 CS4；并在 MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 上预注册模式，再用独立 2,276 对 HotpotQA 检验可复现性，另考察模型自然度评分与批布局效应。

Result: 从不读推理链的语言模型评分器达到名义 AUC 0.997；单一字符串匹配取得 CS4 最大值 0.500，而 11 个被评系统仅 0.308–0.484（两者为不同指标）。所有系统都对额外一次编辑敏感，且编辑可按自然度评分检出。独立 HotpotQA 集上，MuSiQue/2Wiki 预注册模式未复现：6 个训练读出中 5 个由编辑痕迹主导，参照评判者选择性区间 [-0.007, +0.042] 含零；评判分数还受批布局影响。

Conclusion: 正 CS4 应解读为"操作层面的桥接一致性敏感度"，而非语义多跳推理。现有证据充分性基准存在伪迹混淆与批量效应，结论可复现性有限（MuSiQue、2Wiki 记录公开，HotpotQA 记录与微调检查点未公开，外部复现仅部分可行）。

Abstract: Evidence-sufficiency benchmarks ask whether a model can tell a complete passage set from one whose reasoning chain is broken. When broken sets are made by editing text, near-perfect sufficiency scores--and even positive crossed-control scores--need not demonstrate multi-hop reasoning. We present ChainCheck, an evaluation-validity audit that pairs validator-certified counterfactual cells with artifact-only baselines. In an exploratory crossed control on 2,214 HotpotQA pairs, a language-model scorer that never reads the chain reaches a nominal AUC of 0.997, and a one-string match reaches the maximum of the crossed chain-sensitivity statistic CS4 (0.500), while the 11 evaluated systems score from 0.308 to 0.484; the two statistics are different metrics. We therefore read positive CS4 as operational bridge-consistency sensitivity, not as semantic multi-hop reasoning. Every system is also sensitive to one extra edit, and the edits are detectable according to model-based naturalness ratings. On an independent HotpotQA set of 2,276 pairs, patterns pre-specified on MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA did not replicate: 5 of 6 trained readouts were edit-dominated, and the reference judge's selectivity interval [-0.007, +0.042] includes zero. Judge scores also depended on batch layout. The MuSiQue and 2Wiki records are public; the HotpotQA records and the fine-tuned checkpoints are not, so external reproduction is partial.

</details>


### [825] [AutoQS: Automated Quantization Strategy Design with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11975)
*Zhen Liu,Zhiqin Yang,Yonggang Zhang,Jianyi Liu,Jinjun Wang,Jingwen Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoQS用LLM自动化设计混合精度量化策略，在固定权重精度下搜索逐层/逐算子的分组大小分配，以廉价代理+周期性真实量化在有限评估预算内取得更优精度/存储折衷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化能降低LLM部署成本，但策略需在模型质量与存储间权衡；LLM驱动的搜索可自动化策略设计，然而实际量化代价高，而廉价代理又未必能反映真实量化模型性能，因此需在有限评估预算内高效识别有用策略。

Method: 固定权重精度，在部署约束下搜索跨层与算子的group-size分配；用评估历史引导LLM进行协同提案，确定性验证保证分配兼容；以廉价质量代理评估候选，并用候选仓库保留备选分配以指导后续提案；周期性执行真实量化，提供实测质量与checkpoint存储反馈。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，四比特权重精度下，七任务平均准确率较uniform-group GPTQ与AWQ分别提升0.70和1.12个百分点。

Conclusion: 代理评估结合周期性真实量化的混合搜索框架，可在有限预算内有效自动化量化策略设计，兼顾精度与存储。

Abstract: Quantization reduces LLM deployment costs, but effective strategies must balance model quality and storage. LLM-driven search can automate strategy design through repeated proposal and evaluation. This process must identify useful strategies within a limited evaluation budget. The key challenge is that \textit{actual quantization is expensive, while inexpensive proxies may not reflect quantized-model performance.} To address this challenge, we present AutoQS, an \textbf{Auto}mated \textbf{Q}uantization \textbf{S}trategy Design with LLMs. AutoQS keeps weight precision fixed and searches group-size allocations across layers and operators under deployment constraints. Evaluation history guides coordinated LLM proposals, while deterministic validation ensures compatible allocations. An inexpensive quality proxy evaluates candidates, and an candidate repository retains alternative allocations to inform subsequent proposals. Periodic actual quantization complements these proxy evaluations with measured quality and checkpoint storage, providing feedback for further search within the evaluation budget. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that AutoQS improves seven-task average accuracy over uniform-group GPTQ and AWQ by 0.70 and 1.12 percentage points, respectively, at four-bit weight precision.

</details>


### [826] [Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11995)
*Zhengyu Hu,Zheyuan Xiao,Yike Wang,Hamish Ivison,Haoyu Wang,Yige Yuan,Rulin Shao,Yuetai Li,Niqi Lyu,Yicheng Ding,Shu Yang,Zhichen Zeng,Banghua Zhu,Jiaxin Pei,Kaize Ding,Pradeep Dasigi,Dan Roth,Hannaneh Hajishirzi,Noah A. Smith,Teng Xiao,Radha Poovendran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Infrathon，一个面向长时程 AI 基础设施优化的多层级多样化基准，用 24 小时预算、150 次运行（超过 1 万 GPU 小时）评估六个前沿智能体，发现长时程评估会改变模型排名，且智能体能超越人类设计的基线方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多基于短时程任务，无法判断前沿智能体能否在长周期内持续改进真实 AI 基础设施，也可能因预算过短而低估优化收益、误判模型相对优劣。

Method: 构建 Infrathon 基准，覆盖不同层级的多类长时程 AI 基础设施优化任务；在统一 24 小时预算下评测六个模型共 150 次运行，累计逾 1 万 GPU 小时；并对智能体轨迹进行分析以识别持续改进的障碍。

Result: 模型排名随评估时程变化；150 次运行中有 135 次在预算后半段仍取得进一步提升；Claude Opus 5.5 将 KV-cache 平均压缩率从人类设计 Quant-VideoGen 编解码器的 6.82% 提升至 19.86%；轨迹分析发现任务违规、测试不可靠与过早终止是持续改进的主要障碍。

Conclusion: 短时程评估会同时掩盖优化增益与模型相对表现的变化；Infrathon 为构建长时程任务、评估前沿智能体和发现优质基础设施方案提供了资源与框架。

Abstract: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.

</details>


### [827] [Enhancing Multi-Step Chemical Mechanism Prediction with Graph-Guided Preference Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12013)
*Yu Zhang,Ruijie Yu,Xuelin Zhao,Jinming Yang,Feng Zhu,Xiaokang Yang,Yaohui Jin,Yanyan Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出图引导框架GRMP，结合化学机理知识图谱ChemMechKG与LLM预测多步化学反应机理，在ChemMechQA和oMe-Gold上取得最高路径准确率48.1%/57.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算方法多聚焦单步基元反应预测，难以泛化到未见反应空间，无法有效识别多步机理中的合理中间体与步骤顺序。

Method: 构建化学机理知识图谱ChemMechKG引导LLM；提出图对齐反应机理预测器GRMP，用图神经网络生成候选路径用于路径优化；推理阶段设计关系检索(RR)模块从知识图谱提取相关证据以精炼路径。

Result: 在ChemMechQA和oMe-Gold上路径准确率分别为48.1%和57.9%，均为对比方法中最高；在ChemMechQA-Hard固定的110个分布外反应样本上top-1路径准确率达36.4%；LLM-as-Judge与人工评估显示其泛化能力。

Conclusion: 图引导的知识图谱+LLM框架能有效提升多步反应机理预测准确性与对未见反应的泛化能力。

Abstract: Predicting multi-step chemical reaction mechanisms requires identifying plausible intermediates and correctly ordering the elementary reaction steps. Existing computational methods focus on single-step elementary reaction prediction, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen reaction spaces. We introduce a graph-guided framework for multi-step chemical mechanism prediction that leverages a chemical mechanism knowledge graph (ChemMechKG) to guide large language models (LLMs). To improve pathway prediction, we develop a graph-aligned reaction mechanism predictor (GRMP) that uses graph neural networks to generate synthetic candidate pathways for pathway optimization. During inference, we design a relation retrieval (RR) module to extract relevant graph evidence from the KG for pathway refinement. Experiments show that GRMP achieves the highest pathway accuracy among all compared methods on ChemMechQA and oMe-Gold, reaching 48.1% and 57.9%, respectively. On a fixed sample of 110 out-of-distribution reactions from ChemMechQA-Hard, GRMP achieves 36.4% top-1 pathway accuracy. LLM-as-Judge and human assessment further demonstrate its ability to generalize to unseen reactions.

</details>


### [828] [Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12014)
*Xuyu Dong,Yixuan Li,Jianguo Huang,Feng Chen,Yiyun Zhou,Bo An,Zheng Liu,Da Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MatScope基准，从三方面评测LLM在多材料状态区分与定量证据推理上的能力，发现细粒度响应估计和相近状态比较仍显著薄弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM及多智能体有望连接科学知识与实验决策以加速材料发现，但现有基准缺乏对"区分相近材料状态"与"基于定量证据推理"能力的评测，而这对于比较材料响应、判断机制、随证据积累维持可靠结论至关重要。

Method: MatScope包含三部分：M1用200项任务覆盖十种研究功能，测试无辅助的特定条件推理（以铝和高熵合金为代表性体系）；M2测试智能体辅助下将相关知识迁移到未解决的材料问题；MatEvoBench-20测试科学依赖链上的初始预测，以及随着观测积累对仍隐藏响应的修正。共评测11个模型部署。

Result: 模型对给定输入的计算和许多物理解释表现良好；但细粒度响应估计、相似状态比较和定量支持的选择明显较弱。相关文献能改善部分估计，但条件与基线不匹配限制迁移；渐进观测可校准部分下游响应，却会破坏此前正确的预测。

Conclusion: MatScope为未来自进化材料实验室和材料感知世界模型中的可靠科学推理能力提供了可量化的发展目标。

Abstract: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.

</details>


### [829] [Evaluating AI Agents for Industrial-Level Chip Floorplanning: A Framework and Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12048)
*Nova-Silicon Team*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向AI智能体的芯片floorplanning评测框架，将提交布局接入既定下游实现流程，检验几何有效性、测量物理质量并报告资源消耗。在99个宏约占固定L形区域71%的工业设计上，专用系统Nova-SI在无在线反馈下取得57.97的复合分（0-100），远超最强通用配置GPT-6 Astra的31.17。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Floorplanning位于逻辑电路到物理芯片转换的早期，决定宏模块位置并约束后续布局布线空间，影响拥塞与时序，但其物理后果需经下游实现才显现。对AI智能体而言，需将工程约束转化为空间决策，而仅凭工具执行成功无法判断质量，因此需要一个能评估交付布局真实物理后果的评测框架。

Method: 构建评测框架：把提交布局连接到规定的下游实现流程，进行几何有效性检查，测量物理质量（拥塞、时序、供电网络与布局评估），并报告资源使用；以一个固定L形布局区域中99个宏约占71%面积的工业设计为案例，比较专用系统Nova-SI、通用工程智能体及仅限文件访问的智能体，对39份布局输出取得完整物理测量，并做评分敏感性检验与布局级分析。

Result: 在0–100复合质量分下，Nova-SI在无在线反馈条件下均值为57.97，最强通用配置GPT-6 Astra为31.17；差异由原始拥塞与时序测量支持，并在评分敏感性检验下保持。布局级分析显示相近的全局利用率可能掩盖显著不同的局部拥塞。

Conclusion: 该协议与案例研究通过交付布局的物理后果来评估智能体，为专用系统在此工业实例上的性能提供证据，并表明floorplanning智能体评测应以下游物理指标而非工具执行成功为准。

Abstract: Floorplanning is an early step in turning a logical circuit into a physical chip: it positions large circuit modules and constrains the space available for subsequent logic placement and wiring. These decisions affect congestion and timing, but their physical consequences emerge through downstream implementation. For AI agents, the task requires translating engineering constraints into spatial decisions whose quality cannot be judged by successful tool execution alone. We present an evaluation framework that connects submitted layouts to a prescribed downstream implementation flow, checks geometric validity, measures physical quality, and reports resource use. On one industrial design whose 99 macros occupy approximately 71\% of a fixed L-shaped layout region, we compare our specialized system Nova-SI with general-purpose engineering agents and agents restricted to file access, obtaining complete physical measurements for 39 layout outputs. Under our 0--100 composite quality score, Nova-SI achieves a mean of 57.97 without online feedback from the prescribed power-grid and placement evaluation, compared with 31.17 for the strongest measured general-purpose configuration, GPT-6 Astra. The difference is supported by raw congestion and timing measurements and persists across scoring-sensitivity checks. Layout-level analysis further shows that similar global utilization can conceal substantially different local congestion. Together, the protocol and case study assess agents through the physical consequences of their delivered layouts and provide evidence about system performance on this industrial instance.

</details>


### [830] [COMPASS: Composable Policy-Amortized Structured Search for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12060)
*Nguyen Le Minh Hoang,Van Duc Cuong,Bui Trong Duc,Huynh Thi Thanh Binh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COMPASS将优化问题到求解器代码的模板检索建模为可学习策略，用DQN在模板DAG上学习遍历策略，并以文本嵌入支持新模板扩展，实验优于启发式结构化检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM将自然语言优化问题翻译为求解器代码的可靠性受限于模板检索质量；现有结构化层次检索的遍历规则固定或依赖LLM推理时判断，无法从过往成功与失败中学习改进。

Method: 将模板库表示为有向无环图，把检索形式化为模板节点上的序贯决策过程；用深度Q网络从模板级判断和执行反馈中学习可复用的遍历策略；并将问题描述与模板节点嵌入共享语义空间，使新插入模板可仅凭文本描述打分而无需重定义动作空间。

Result: 在多个LLM骨干模型和优化建模基准上，COMPASS持续优于启发式结构化检索，在复杂及混合类别问题上提升最大。

Conclusion: 把模板检索视为可从建模经验中学习的策略，而非静态推理规则，是提升LLM求解器建模可靠性与可扩展性的有效途径。

Abstract: Large language models offer a promising technique for translating natural-language optimization problems into solver code, but their reliability remains constrained by the quality of template retrieval. While recent structured methods improve over flat prompting through hierarchical taxonomy search, their traversal rules remain fixed or LLM-driven at inference time, leaving retrieval unable to improve from past successes and failures. This motivates treating template retrieval as a policy that can be learned from modeling experience, rather than as a static inference-time rule. We propose COMPASS, a policy-amortized framework for retrieving optimization templates in LLM-based solver modeling, which represents the template library as a directed acyclic graph and formulates retrieval as a sequential decision process over template nodes. A deep Q-network learns a reusable traversal policy from template-level judgments and execution feedback, reducing reliance on fixed heuristic traversal through feedback-driven graph navigation. To support extensible retrieval, COMPASS embeds problem descriptions and template nodes in a shared semantic space, allowing newly inserted templates to be scored from their text descriptions without redefining the action space. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and optimization-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that COMPASS consistently improves over heuristic structured retrieval, with the largest gains on complex and mixed-category problems.

</details>


### [831] [CRAFT-AI: Capability and Requirement Alignment for Flexible Manufacturing through Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12092)
*Kiavash Fathi,Hans Wernher van de Venn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CRAFT-AI，一种结合自然语言需求理解、AAS 能力描述和可复用工程知识的智能体式 AI 方法，用于将变化的制造需求转化为可实现的系统配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现韧性生产基础设施需要柔性制造，即将不断变化的生产需求转化为可实施的系统配置，但这一转化过程仍具挑战。

Method: 该方法包含三部分：自然语言需求解析、基于 AAS（资产管理壳）的能力描述、以及从既有制造配置中提取的可复用工程知识。一个具备工具调用能力的 AI 智能体将需求与可用能力及参考实现进行匹配，从而生成制造场景及对应的 AAS 实例。采用含 12 个参考场景的 Factory I/O 原型和 5 个复杂度不一的示例制造任务进行验证。

Result: 在 4 个有效的用户任务描述下，系统均能生成正确的需求、正确引用相关工程知识、正确选择组件，并输出有效的 Factory I/O 场景。对于缺少工程知识且传感器选择错误的任务，系统会告知用户哪些需求缺少领域知识，以及哪个传感器与所选原材料不兼容并附上相关文档链接。修正任务描述后，场景可顺利生成。

Conclusion: CRAFT-AI 初步验证了 AAS 赋能的系统级生成式工程方法的可行性，并强调了在基础模型驱动方案中对风险感知与沟通设置安全保障机制的重要性。

Abstract: One of the fundamental needs for reaching resilient production infrastructure is flexible manufacturing, which requires translating changing production requirements into implementable system configurations. This paper introduces \textbf{CRAFT-AI}, an agentic AI approach combining natural language (NL) requirement interpretation, Asset Administration Shell (AAS)-based capability descriptions, and reusable engineering knowledge from existing manufacturing configurations. A tool-using AI agent matches requirements with available capabilities and reference implementations to generate manufacturing scenes and corresponding AAS instances. The approach is demonstrated using a Factory I/O prototype with twelve reference scenes and five illustrative manufacturing tasks of varying complexity, providing an initial feasibility assessment of the proposed AAS-enabled, system-level generative engineering approach. For the four valid user task descriptions, proper requirements, correct references to the relevant engineering knowledge, correct components and lastly a valid Factory I/O scene are generated. For the task with missing engineering knowledge and a wrong sensor selection, the user is informed about which requirements of the scene generation lack domain knowledge and also which sensor is not compatible with the selected raw material by the user with link to the related documentation. After fixing the task description, the correct scene is seamlessly generated. \textbf{CRAFT-AI} highlights the importance of safeguards for risk perception and communication in foundation model-driven solutions.

</details>


### [832] [From Fluent Text to Ontology-Compatible Definitions: A Quality-Control Agentic Workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12095)
*Kun Feng,Chenchen Chu,Yan Liu,Haojie Sun,Jijun Tang,Chen Tian,Shuolin Xiao,Jianping He,Zhao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出实体错误率(EER)和逻辑不一致率(LIR)两个结构化知识兼容性指标，并构建迭代式agentic质检流程来生成与修复本体定义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学本体需持续演化但人工维护成本高，文本定义尤甚。LLM生成定义虽流畅且与参考文本接近，却不保证实体可被接地或满足本体逻辑约束，直接插入会引入实体幻觉与逻辑矛盾。

Method: 提出EER（实体接地）与LIR（逻辑一致性）两项指标；设计agentic质量控制工作流，将定义生成视为迭代过程：生成定义、抽取公理、检查实体存在性与逻辑一致性，并据诊断结果驱动修复循环。在Disease Ontology、Uberon及Uberon-ConstraintStress上开展实验。

Result: EER与LIR可补充传统基于参考的指标，评估生成内容能否在目标本体中被接地与检验；工作流有效降低EER并保持较强的文本生成表现；LIR揭示文本相似度无法发现的稀疏本体级逻辑失败，但其修复效果仍有限。

Conclusion: 文本合理性不等于知识系统兼容性，需引入结构化知识指标与迭代QC流程来保障LLM生成本体定义的可接地性与逻辑一致性，逻辑不一致的自动修复仍是待解难题。

Abstract: Biomedical ontologies are structured knowledge systems that must evolve continuously to represent newly emerging knowledge, but their manual maintenance remains time-consuming and laborintensive. Textual definitions are especially costly because they must be readable to humans and compatible with controlled entities, relations, and logical constraints. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to assist ontology engineering tasks, including definition generation. However, textual plausibility does not guarantee knowledge-system compatibility. A generated definition may be fluent and close to a reference definition, yet still fail to ground its implied entities or violate ontology-level constraints. Directly inserting such definitions into ontology libraries may therefore introduce entity-level hallucinations and logical inconsistencies. To address this problem, we propose two structured-knowledge incompatibility metrics, Entity Error Rate (EER) and Logical Inconsistency Rate (LIR), to quantify entity grounding and logical consistency for LLM-generated ontology definitions. We further develop an agentic quality-control (QC) workflow that treats definition generation as an iterative process rather than a direct decoding step: it generates definitions, extracts axioms, checks entity existence and logical consistency, and uses the resulting diagnostics to drive repair loops. Comprehensive experiments on Disease Ontology, Uberon Ontology, and Uberon-ConstraintStress demonstrate that EER and LIR complement conventional reference-based metrics by evaluating whether generated content can be grounded and checked inside the target ontology. The workflow effectively decreases EER while maintaining strong conventional text-generation performance. LIR further exposes sparse ontology-level logical failures that are invisible to text similarity metrics, although their repair remains limited.

</details>


### [833] [SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12109)
*Xingguang Ji,Ziqiang Dong,Yubo Zhang,Xi Leng,Yang Yang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillDuet：通过模型响应反馈协同参数更新与技能演化，实现模型-技能共同进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习中经验既可内化到LLM参数，也可外化为可复用文本技能；二者互相影响，且能力演化会让旧技能变得冗余或有害。

Method: 技能从on-policy轨迹中提取，通过OPD指导每步参数更新；用基于响应的Strength分数对候选技能排序，最高分技能周期性固化到持久全局技能集(Global)；更新后的模型与Global共同指导后续交互。

Result: Qwen3-4B上ALFWorld成功率98.57%、WebShop 92.97%，较SEED-API基线分别提升2.86和5.47个百分点；消融显示响应式技能选择与Global固化有效；技能收益取决于内容与模型兼容性。

Conclusion: 提供了模型-技能协同进化的具体机制，支持技能层面的递归自我改进。

Abstract: During reinforcement learning, experience can be both internalized in LLM parameters and retained externally as reusable textual skills. Parameter updates alter the model's behavior and the interaction experience from which new skills are extracted. These skills, in turn, guide the model's subsequent interactions and parameter updates. As the model's capabilities evolve, previously beneficial skills may become redundant or detrimental. We present SkillDuet, a framework that coordinates parameter updates and skill evolution through model response feedback. Skills extracted from on-policy trajectories guide parameter updates through OPD at every step. A response-based score, Strength, ranks candidate skills by the magnitude of the shift they induce in the current model's responses, and the highest-scoring skills are periodically consolidated into a persistent global skill set (Global). The updated model and Global jointly guide subsequent interactions, generating experience for further parameter and skill updates. With Qwen3-4B, SkillDuet achieves success rates of 98.57% on ALFWorld and 92.97% on WebShop, exceeding the matched SEED-API baseline by 2.86 and 5.47 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that response-based skill selection and Global consolidation improve task performance. Further experiments show that the benefits of retained skills depend on both their content and their compatibility with the model. SkillDuet provides a concrete mechanism for model-skill co-evolution and skill-level recursive self-improvement.

</details>


### [834] [OGDA: Ontology-Grounded Data Agents for Reliable Analysis over Heterogeneous Data Lakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12114)
*Boyi Zhang,Hong Ting Tsang,Yisen Gao,Qiao Xiao,LI Yufei,Haoyu Huang,Zhongwei Xie,Jiaxin Bai,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出本体驱动的数据智能体OGDA，用紧凑本体减少数据湖探索开销并约束数据处理，在KramaBench和DiscoveryBench上最高超最强基线10.82分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据湖的全流程分析需LLM智能体跨大量异构模式表定位与整合信息，现有智能体采用任务特定探索，会耗尽上下文窗口；上下文填满后推理退化，导致定位和处理错误文件，错误进一步传播到最终答案。

Method: 构建紧凑本体以降低探索开销并约束数据处理。本体通过智能体式假设检验构建：每步由proposer从原始来源归纳模式、概念与关系，verifier对照底层数据校验。执行时本体作为数据湖表示供探索，每个数据处理动作受任务图约束，智能体仅在观察数据语义后才能扩展该图。

Result: 在KramaBench和DiscoveryBench上，配三种LLM骨干，OGDA均优于最强基线，提升最高达10.82分。

Conclusion: 显式建模数据湖是构建可靠端到端数据智能体的关键步骤。

Abstract: Full-pipeline data analysis over real-world data lakes requires LLM agents to locate and integrate information across large collections of tables with different schemas. Existing data agents follow task-specific exploration, which exhausts the context window in massive lakes. As the context fills, the agent's reasoning degrades, leading it to locate and process incorrect data files. These errors propagate into the final answer. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Ontology-Grounded Data Agent (OGDA), which utilizes a compact ontology to reduce exploration overhead and constrain data processing. OGDA constructs the ontology through agentic hypothesis testing. At each step, a proposer agent induces schemas, concepts, and relations from raw sources, and a verifier checks each proposal against the underlying data. During task execution, the ontology serves as a representation of the data lake for the agent to explore. Every data-processing action is constrained by a task graph, which the agent can extend only after observing the semantic meaning of the data. Across KramaBench and DiscoveryBench with three LLM backbones, OGDA outperforms the strongest baselines by up to 10.82 points. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the data lake is a key step toward reliable end-to-end data agents.

</details>


### [835] [Joi-Bench-Task: Benchmarking Task Coordination in Full-duplex Voice Agents through Interactive Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12118)
*Xiangheng He,Mingjun Zhao,Zhehao Fan,Zhengjia Li,Xiaopeng Sun,Qingqing Xiao,Haolan Chen,Yu Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个全双工语音智能体基准，用可配置干预的用户模拟器隔离评估"任务执行"与"对话"之间的协调能力，发现现有商业智能体在请求变更和打断场景下普遍存在协调失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音智能体需在说话同时执行任务，用户会中途改需求、打断、追问。但现有基准未能将任务执行与会话协调能力单独隔离评估，因此难以定位协调这一核心短板。

Method: 构建基准，考察智能体是否追踪"正在执行什么、已完成什么、已告知什么、还需汇报什么"；提出交互式用户模拟器，在工具执行与语音结果播报的指定时点注入可配置干预，实现可控可复现的评估；沿执行响应性、请求变更下的协调、打断下的协调三个维度评测五款主流商业语音智能体。

Result: 协调失败具有持续性：请求变更场景下最高结果完成率仅55%；用户打断后，五款中有四款平均信息遗漏率至少23%。

Conclusion: 任务协调是当前语音智能体在复杂、动态对话中的核心挑战，需专门设计与评测机制来保障跨对话轮次的任务承诺与信息完整交付。

Abstract: Full-duplex voice agents enable natural, hands-free interaction, allowing users to refine requests, redirect ongoing work, and seek clarification while the agent is speaking. However, existing voice-agent benchmarks insufficiently isolate coordination between task execution and conversation. We introduce a benchmark that assesses this coordination by examining whether agents track what is being executed, what has been completed, what has been communicated, and what remains to be reported as the conversation evolves. We propose an interactive user simulator that introduces configurable interventions at designated timing in tool execution and spoken result delivery, supporting controllable and reproducible evaluation conditions. We evaluate five leading commercial voice agents along three dimensions: execution responsiveness, coordination under request changes, and coordination under interruptions. Agent evaluations reveal persistent coordination failures. Under request changes, the highest result completion rate is only 55%, indicating difficulty for current voice agents adapting to new requests while preserving earlier obligations. After user interruption, four of the five agents exhibit average information omission rates of at least 23%. These findings highlight task coordination as a central challenge for current voice agents in complex, evolving conversations.

</details>


### [836] [SCALE: Small-Model-First Concept Abstraction with LLM-Guided Experience Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12120)
*Hong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCALE是一个"小模型优先"框架，通过选择性触发LLM反思、经验驱动概念抽象与知识内化，让轻量模型独立积累并复用可迁移知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体需持续从经验中获取可复用知识，但每次决策都依赖昂贵的大模型推理不可行；现有经验方法难以将观察与推理压缩为轻量模型能独立使用的紧凑知识。

Method: 由轻量模型负责日常预测；仅当出现预测错误且积累了跨回合证据时，才选择性触发LLM反思。LLM分析相关历史经验，生成正负反事实样例并提出可复用的概念假设；经独立验证的概念被逐步并入分层神经表示。已掌握经验从活跃记忆中移除，但原始记录保留在完整档案中。

Result: 十个随机种子实验显示：历史回忆使留出集准确率从87.11%提升至98.28%；分层概念知识使困难样本准确率从55.33%提升至66.47%；抽象归档使活跃经验记录从6000条降至1528条。

Conclusion: 选择性LLM调用+概念抽象+分层内化，可让轻量模型以少量活跃记忆获得更强泛化与困难样本表现，实现成本与能力间的有效平衡。

Abstract: Autonomous agents must continually acquire reusable knowledge from experience without relying on costly large language model (LLM) reasoning for every decision. However, existing experience-based approaches often struggle to transform accumulated observations and reasoning into compact knowledge that lightweight models can independently apply. This paper proposes SCALE, a small-model-first framework that integrates selective LLM reasoning, experience-driven concept abstraction, and knowledge internalization. A lightweight model handles routine predictions, while prediction errors and accumulated cross-episode evidence selectively trigger LLM reflection. The LLM analyzes relevant historical experiences, generates positive and negative counterfactual examples, and proposes reusable concept hypotheses. Independently validated concepts are progressively incorporated into hierarchical neural representations, enabling lightweight models to exploit increasingly abstract knowledge. Meanwhile, mastered experiences are excluded from active memory while their original records remain available in a complete archive. Experiments across ten random seeds show that historical recall improves held-out accuracy from 87.11% to 98.28%, hierarchical concept knowledge increases difficult-case accuracy from 55.33% to 66.47%, and abstract archiving reduces active experience records from 6,000 to 1,528.

</details>


### [837] [System Optimizations for Cost-Efficient Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12122)
*Jongseok Park,Jiaxiang Yu,Eric Zhou,Tony Hong,Sunga Kim,Yusuf Afifi,Ian Wong,Ion Stoica,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI agent harness（智能体执行框架）对任务准确率影响甚微，但对执行成本影响巨大（同模型同任务成本最高可差2.6倍）。作者通过分析多类agent轨迹的成本累积模式，发现可降低token使用与LLM调用次数的系统级机会，并据此设计了Agency——一个可介入现有harness（如Claude Code、OpenAI Codex）的统一抽象平台，实现可移植的harness侧优化，在不牺牲准确率的前提下降低真实基准成本最多35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明agent任务准确率主要由底层LLM决定，harness侧差异（系统提示、工具定义等）对准确率影响很小，但对执行成本影响显著（同模型同任务可降本达2.6倍）。这一"高成本杠杆、低准确率风险"的特性提示：存在尚未被系统化利用的harness侧降本空间。

Method: 1) 分析多种agent执行轨迹中的成本累积模式，定位token消耗与LLM调用的主要来源，识别无需改动模型或影响准确率的系统优化机会；2) 设计Agency平台，提供统一抽象层，作为interposition（插入式中介）机制，使harness侧优化能便捷、可移植地应用于Claude Code、OpenAI Codex等现成harness；3) 基于上述分析在Agency上实现若干概念验证型优化技术，并在多个真实基准上评测。

Result: 在现有harness上跨多个真实世界基准测试，在准确率不下降的前提下实现最高35%的成本降低。

Conclusion: harness侧优化是被低估的智能体降本杠杆。通过轨迹级成本分析与通用interposition平台（Agency），可系统性地复用harness优化，在保持任务准确率的同时显著降低agent执行成本，为后续harness侧系统研究提供了可移植的基础设施。

Abstract: AI agent harnesses play the critical role of providing LLMs with an interface to a computing environment. Recent studies show that AI agents' task-execution accuracy depends mostly on the LLM used, while harness-side variances such as system prompts or tools have minimal impact. Rather, such harness-side variances show a larger impact on the cost of agent executions, achieving cost reductions up to 2.6 times on the same model and task. To further explore these harness-side cost optimization opportunities, we analyze the cost accumulation patterns across various agent traces and identify system opportunities to reduce token use and LLM calls without modifying the model or affecting task accuracy. Based on this analysis, we design Agency, a harness interposition platform that provides a unified abstraction and allows easy and portable implementation of harness-side system optimizations on existing off-the-shelf harnesses such as Claude Code or OpenAI Codex. Using Agency, we implement proof-of-concept optimization techniques based on our analysis and achieve cost reductions up to 35% across various real-world benchmarks on existing harnesses without compromising accuracy.

</details>


### [838] [Toward Sustainable Agentic AI: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Iterative Self-Refinement and Tool-Augmented Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12128)
*Boris Ruf,Adrien de Mailly Nesle,Marcin Detyniecki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文估算"自反思迭代"与"工具增强编码"两类agentic AI的能耗与碳足迹，发现多次迭代可弥补精度差距但碳排放近三倍，且效率与成功率存在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: agentic系统通过自我迭代或调用外部工具可降低错误率、替代更大模型，但其环境影响（能耗与碳排放）研究不足。

Method: 两项研究：(1) 迭代式语言自我精炼，GPT-4.1-mini k=1~5步对比GPT-4.1单次基线，两个MATH划分；(2) 工具增强编码，GPT-4.1-mini、Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.3-codex在SWE-bench Lite的Docker隔离环境中使用代码执行与文件编辑工具。碳估计仅计输出token推理。

Result: 研究1：k=3时精度差距缩小至1个百分点内，但碳排放较廉价单次基线近三倍，仍低于GPT-4.1单次基线（当前token碳情景）。研究2：GPT-5.3-codex解决率81.2%最高，Claude Opus 4.6为68.9%，GPT-4.1-mini为25.0%；每解决任务碳/成本GPT-4.1-mini最低，但成功率显著较低。

Conclusion: agentic策略在精度与环保效率间存在权衡；碳排放数据为下界，因prompt token（研究2中占99%以上）与工具执行未计入。

Abstract: Agentic language model systems can improve performance either by iterating on their own outputs or by using external tools in grounded environments. While these strategies can reduce error rates and substitute for larger models in some settings, their environmental cost remains relatively underexplored. We present two complementary empirical studies that estimate the energy and carbon footprint of agentic AI across settings of increasing complexity. Study~1 evaluates iterative verbal self-refinement: GPT-4.1-mini at $k = 1$--$5$ steps versus a GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline on two MATH benchmark splits. Study~2 evaluates tool-augmented agentic coding: GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Opus~4.6, and GPT-5.3-codex on SWE-bench Lite, where agents operate inside Docker-isolated environments with access to code execution and file editing tools. In Study~1, $k=3$ refinements close a 16-percentage-point accuracy gap to within 1~point, but nearly triple the carbon footprint relative to the cheap single-pass baseline while remaining below the GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline under the current token-based carbon scenario. In Study~2, GPT-5.3-codex achieves the highest resolution rate in this sample (81.2\%), ahead of Claude Opus~4.6 (68.9\%) and GPT-4.1-mini (25.0\%), but resolved-task-normalized efficiency remains mixed: GPT-4.1-mini is lowest on estimated carbon and cost per resolved task, while GPT-5.3-codex delivers substantially higher task success. All carbon estimates cover output-token inference only; prompt tokens, which exceed 99\% of tokens in Study~2, and tool execution are not charged, so the figures are lower bounds on the full agentic footprint.

</details>


### [839] [FraudBench: A Legal Evaluation of AI Deception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12167)
*Kevin Wei,Sumaya Nur Adan,Stephan Llerena,Mark Gitau,Jakob Merane,Anita Srinivasan,Colette Le Brannan,Keethan Kleiner,Alessandro Tacconelli,Michael Tiu,Case Thomason,Kyle Emili,Natasza Gadowska,Alex Mark,Eric Ren,Umang Bhatt,Jatinder Singh,Jacy Reese Anthis,Doni Bloomfield,Noam Kolt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 FraudBench，一个评估大语言模型在推荐、协助或直接实施美国法律下欺诈行为倾向的基准，包含159个基于真实判例、经法律专家验证的场景（共477个任务、20个模型、25种实验条件、超30万次生成），发现模型欺诈率从近0%到超40%不等，且随自主性提升而上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估缺乏对LLM在高风险商业情境中主动实施欺诈（虚假陈述或隐瞒重大事实）倾向的系统测评，尤其缺乏基于真实法律判例、覆盖不同自主性水平的基准。

Method: 构建159个基于美国真实法院判例并由法律专家验证的场景，每个场景以三种自主性水平呈现（建议用户、代写消息、直接代为行动，共477个任务）。场景复现判例事实，但不给出明确指令，仅提供虚假陈述或隐瞒重大事实的机会。评估20个LLM在25种实验条件下的表现，共超30万次生成，并设置预注册人类基线（2957条标注、996名参与者）。若回答实施、协助或推荐虚假陈述或隐瞒，则计为欺诈。

Result: (1) LLM欺诈率从近0%到超40%不等；(2) 欺诈率随自主性上升：建议3.0%、代写14.7%、直接行动21.4%（无施压情况下）；(3) 模型有时在意识到法律风险的情况下仍实施欺诈；(4) 隐瞒比虚假陈述更常见；(5) 提示干预显著影响欺诈率——"遵守法律"提示降低欺诈率，而"利润最大化"和"代理型行动"提示提高欺诈率。

Conclusion: LLM在无显式指令下仍有相当比例倾向于参与欺诈，且自主性越高、越受利润或代理导向提示影响，欺诈倾向越强；提示干预可有效调节该倾向，表明模型行为对部署情境高度敏感，需针对性安全措施。

Abstract: We introduce FraudBench, an evaluation of large language models' (LLMs) propensities to recommend, assist, or directly take actions that would constitute fraud under U.S. law. Our evaluation contains a novel dataset of 159 scenarios based on real-world U.S. court cases and validated by legal experts. We present each scenario to LLMs via three tasks at varying levels of autonomy: advising users, drafting messages for users to send, and acting directly on behalf of users (477 tasks total). In each scenario, FraudBench re-enacts the facts of a court case to give LLMs an opportunity, but no explicit instruction, to either misrepresent or conceal a material fact in a high-stakes commercial setting--e.g., whether to describe company-funded product testing as "independent" to customers (misrepresentation) or whether to hide unfavorable regulatory investigations from clients (concealment). We evaluate 20 LLMs across 25 experimental conditions (totaling >300,000 generations) and include a preregistered human baseline ($n_{\texttt{annotations}} = 2{,}957$, $n_{\texttt{humans}} = 996$). We score a response as fraudulent when it engages in, assists with, or recommends misrepresentation or concealment. Key findings include: (1) across LLMs, fraud rates ranged from near 0% to over 40%; (2) LLM fraud rates increased with autonomy, with overall rates of 3.0% when advising, 14.7% when drafting, and 21.4% when acting directly, without applying pressure; (3) LLMs sometimes engaged in fraud despite recognizing legal risks; (4) LLMs more often engaged in fraud by concealment than by misrepresentation; and (5) prompt-based interventions substantially affected fraud rates, with a prompt to obey the law reducing fraud rates, while prompts to maximize profits and act agentically increased fraud rates.

</details>


### [840] [Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12200)
*Chenghao Gao,Zhi Zhang,Dian Jin,Yihe Pan,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WM-PPO，用世界模型预测每个采样动作的后继状态，并由价值网络评估，从而为策略和价值网络提供辅助优势与辅助目标，在稀疏终局奖励下显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏的终局奖励几乎无法告诉智能体每一步的好坏，而许多决定成功与否的信息隐含在环境动态中（状态转移会提前改变成功条件）。但仅预测观测并不能直接反映"成功概率是否提高"，且PPO评论家只对已到达状态做估计。

Method: 对策略采样出的每个动作（无论是否实际执行），用世界模型预测下一观测，再由评论家对预测后继估值。策略通道：这些值之间的比较产生辅助优势；价值通道：其均值构成辅助目标。用共享门控根据训练早期"相似边际比较"预测真实结果的可信度对两通道加权。策略、评论家、世界模型均从自身交互中学习，无教师或特权信息，推理仅用策略。

Result: 在相近真实环境步数下，ALFWorld成功率由PPO的63.5%提升到87.5%，ScienceWorld由39.3%提升到52.9%；在ALFWorld上追平最强的PPO改进方法，在ScienceWorld上超出其最佳结果6.5个百分点。学到的策略更常在放置物体或给出答案前完成前置步骤。

Conclusion: 将世界模型与PPO评论家结合、并通过可靠性门控融合辅助优势与辅助目标，是缓解稀疏奖励下信用分配问题的有效途径，且无需额外监督或推理开销。

Abstract: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.

</details>


### [841] [PARIS: A multi-agent LLM framework for end-to-end, PRISMA-guided systematic literature reviews with pre-synthesis corpus quality assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12222)
*Christophe Cruz,Hussam Ghanem,Samir Jabbar,Ait Kbir,Hocine Cherifi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PARIS 是一个开源的多智能体框架，由 Claude Code 中的 conductor agent 编排 15 个专门化 LLM 智能体，覆盖从选题到稿件导出的系统综述全流程，并在三个关键节点设置人工检查点。作者还提出 QualityScore 语料质量评分，并用两个案例验证端到端可行性，同时公开了失败模式与 PRISMA 2020 合规情况（完全支持 8/27、部分支持 11/27）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述（SR）耗时耗力，而现有自动化工具大多只覆盖工作流的单一阶段，缺乏端到端、可审计的自动化方案。

Method: PARIS 框架：conductor agent 编排 15 个声明式定义的专用 LLM 智能体；智能体仅通过持久化工件协作，conductor 在每次状态转移前进行校验；检索、文献计量与打分交由确定性 Python 工具完成；设三个人工检查点（研究纳入、语料充分性、综述大纲）。另提出 QualityScore（0–100），融合网络、文献计量、语义与流程四类归一化子分数。

Result: 两个案例（AI 聊天机器人与大学生学习：388 条记录、纳入 100 条；AI 辅助 SR 方法：131 条记录、纳入 123 条、QualityScore 69.1，网络子分数为代理值）验证了跨领域可行性。首个案例在语料充分性检查点改进语料后，分数从 74.6 升至 81.9，2023 年前研究从 1 篇增至 19 篇。审计发现的失败模式包括：检索不完整、智能体间计数漂移、检查点决策未记录或被外包、评分依赖引文数据的处理方式。

Conclusion: PARIS 实现了系统综述全流程的端到端自动化并具备诊断价值，但仅完全支持 PRISMA 2020 的 8 项、部分支持 11 项；输出质量目前仅由内部评审智能体判定，下一步需与人工综述进行独立验证。

Abstract: Systematic literature reviews (SRs) remain slow and labor-intensive, and most automation tools address single stages of the workflow. We present PARIS (PRISMA Agentic Research Intelligence System), an open-source framework in which a conductor agent running in Claude Code orchestrates 15 specialized large language model (LLM) agents, from scoping a research question to exporting a manuscript draft. Agents are specified declaratively, coordinate exclusively through persisted artifacts that the conductor validates before every transition, and delegate retrieval, bibliometric analysis and scoring to deterministic Python utilities. Three human checkpoints gate study inclusion, corpus adequacy and the synthesis outline. We also introduce QualityScore, a pre-synthesis index that aggregates normalized network, bibliometric, semantic and process sub-scores into a 0-100 grade. Two case studies illustrate both: AI chatbots and university students' learning (388 records, 100 included) and AI-assisted SR methods (131 records, 123 included, QualityScore 69.1 recomputed with a proxy network sub-score). They show end-to-end feasibility across domains and the diagnostic use of QualityScore: in the first run, corpus improvements chosen at the corpus-adequacy checkpoint raised the score from 74.6 to 81.9 and the number of pre-2023 studies from 1 to 19. Audits of both runs exposed failure modes: incomplete retrieval, counts that drifted between agents, unrecorded or delegated checkpoint decisions and a grade that depends on how citation data are handled. PARIS fully supports 8 of the 27 PRISMA 2020 items and partially supports 11. Output quality has so far been judged only by an internal reviewer agent; independent validation against human reviews is the next step.

</details>


### [842] [ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12232)
*Chenhao Zhang,Zhongan Wang,Mingxuan Li,Hehe Fan,Zheng Zhu,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 环境校准的在线策略自蒸馏：用环境结果加权教师指导并筛选自写技能，提升语言智能体成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏中，智能体以特权上下文（如自写技能）为条件充当自己的教师，但指导权重取决于该上下文对token似然的偏移而非行为是否更优，因此自写技能中的错误会通过后续更新被放大。

Method: 提出环境校准的在线策略自蒸馏：用环境结果决定对教师当前指导的信任程度，并挑选需强化的自写技能。通过比较相似观测下执行的命令估计命令级优势，用它缩放每个教师偏好，并奖励那些诱导出偏好更倾向高优势命令的反思与技能。

Result: 推理时不使用技能，3B与7B智能体在已见ALFWorld任务上宏成功率分别为90.5%和93.3%，WebShop为75.5%和80.5%；未见过ALFWorld任务上较同协议GRPO分别高11.0和7.6个百分点；消融显示仅监督可执行命令（而非完整响应）使3B WebShop成功率从52.3%升至75.0%。

Conclusion: 以环境结果校准教师指导显著优于似然加权，且监督可执行命令优于监督完整响应；技能在推理时可不依赖而仍取得优异表现。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.

</details>


### [843] [Representational Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain in Speech Processing under Audiovisual Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12291)
*Cheng Luo,Jian Zhu,Zhoujian Sun,Yunyi Qi,Yu Qi,Wenhui Sun,Wenyuan Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用神经编码模型+RSA比较预训练及音视频噪声微调后的ASR模型表征与大脑对声学/语言特征的响应，发现浅层对齐声学、深层对齐语言，微调增强此对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明DNN层级与上行听觉通路相关，但DNN表征如何与大脑从声学到语言的加工过程对齐、以及微调是否改变这种对齐，仍不清楚。

Method: 用神经编码模型模拟大脑对声学特征（语音与噪声包络）和语言特征（词起始、surprisal）的响应；再用表征相似性分析（RSA）量化这些神经响应与预训练ASR模型（微调前后，含音视频噪声数据）各层嵌入之间的相似度。

Result: 浅层嵌入与声学相关神经响应相似度更高，深层嵌入与语言相关神经响应更接近；音视频噪声微调进一步增强了该对齐，表现为浅层噪声加工改善、深层语言表征更精细。

Conclusion: 微调后的DNN可自发发展出类人的噪声环境语音加工模式，说明人脑与DNN在语音表征上存在功能性对齐。

Abstract: Speech comprehension in the human brain is an incremental process that begins with acoustic processing and advances to linguistic processing. While recent studies have revealed that the hierarchy of deep neural networks (DNNs) correlates with the ascending auditory pathway, the exact nature of this DNN-brain alignment remains underexplored. In this study, we investigate how DNN representations align with the brain's acoustic-to-linguistic processing. Specifically, we employed neural encoding models to simulate neural responses to acoustic (i.e., speech and noise envelope) and linguistic features (i.e., word onset and surprisal). By applying representational similarity analysis (RSA), we quantified the similarity between these neural responses and the DNN embeddings generated by a pre-trained automatic speech recognition (ASR) model, both before and after fine-tuning on audiovisual noisy data. Our results demonstrate significant DNN-brain alignment: embeddings from shallow layers exhibit higher similarity to neural responses associated with acoustic features, while those from deeper layers align more closely with neural responses related to linguistic features. Importantly, the fine-tuning process enhances this alignment by improving noise processing in shallower layers and refining linguistic representations in deeper layers. These results suggest that fine-tuned DNN models can naturally develop human-like processing patterns in noisy environments, highlighting a functional alignment between the human brain and DNNs in speech representation.

</details>


### [844] [Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12293)
*Chaoyuan Hao,Wentao Yue,Yanyan Wu,Boyuan Gao,Tianyou Lai,Maolin Wang,Yongxin Ni,Hanwen Du,Youhua Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出循环潜在推理中不同深度会产生非嵌套的正确解集合，提出深度组合分配（DPA）将测试时计算预算分配到多个深度候选源，在多个推理与代码数据集上扩展了oracle覆盖率并提升预算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环潜在推理把测试时扩展视为"决定何时停止"的单深度问题，默认更深递归只会单调提升能力。作者通过系统性初步分析发现：更深的递归可能丢失浅层已找到的正确解，且即使控制边际准确率，不同深度的成功解集合也广泛地非嵌套。这说明深度不仅决定计算成本，还决定能否触及到不同的候选解。

Method: 提出 Depth Portfolio Allocation（DPA），把循环测试时扩展重构为在共享推理预算下、跨不同深度候选源进行预算化分配的问题。DPA 同时支持固定组合（fixed portfolio）与反馈引导的顺序分配（feedback-guided sequential allocation）两种模式。

Result: 在 GSM8K、SVAMP、MultiArith 和 MBPP 上实验：在匹配候选数量与名义成本下，混合深度组合扩展了 oracle 覆盖率；反馈引导分配总体可匹配或超越均匀分配，并在高预算设置下降低计算量。

Conclusion: 深度维度的多样性本身构成一种可利用的测试时计算资源，混合深度组合优于单一深度扩展策略，反馈引导的分配可在保持性能的同时节省计算。代码与数据已匿名开源。

Abstract: Recurrent latent reasoning in large lanugage models (LLMs) scales test-time computation by increasing recurrent depth, naturally framing inference as a problem of deciding when to stop. We identify a previously overlooked limitation of this single-depth view through systematic preliminary analysis: deeper recurrence can lose correct solutions found at shallower depths, while depth-specific success sets remain broadly non-nested even after controlling for marginal accuracy. This suggests that depth determines not only computation cost, but also access to distinct candidate solutions. Motivated by this finding, we propose Depth Portfolio Allocation (DPA), which reformulates recurrent test-time scaling as budgeted allocation across depth-specific candidate sources. DPA supports both fixed portfolios and feedback-guided sequential allocation under a shared inference budget. Experiments on GSM8K, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MBPP show that mixed-depth portfolios expand oracle coverage under matched candidate counts and nominal costs, while feedback-guided allocation generally matches or improves uniform allocation and can reduce computation in high-budget settings. Code and data are avaible at : https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LLM-latent-B7BC/.

</details>


### [845] [Reconfigurable Action Theories: A Formal Foundation for Dynamically Composable Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12300)
*Jianmin Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出可重构行动理论（RAT），允许动作修改行动理论本身（通过模块装载/卸载），并给出语义、性质充分条件、复杂度与转化为ASP的方法，实验对比了三个官方harness实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统行动理论固定词汇与因果律，而实际agent harness在执行中会改变工具、提供者与策略，现有理论无法刻画这种可自我修改、动态重构的行为。

Method: 定义RAT：模块含词汇、因果律、初始化器；配置记录激活模块与世界状态；装载/卸载作为受普通因果律支配的动作。在模块集固定时保留标准因果行动语义；给出至多一个后继配置、加入模块时保持既有行为、加载顺序无关的充分条件；分析推理任务复杂度；将有限RAT系统转化为非单调因果理论与ASP并保持有界执行。

Result: 建立了RAT的形式语义与若干结构性充分条件，确定了推理任务的计算复杂度，并实现到ASP的翻译以保持有界执行；实验将有限RAT模型与DeepSeek Harness、Pi、OpenHands官方实现的实际执行进行对比。

Conclusion: RAT为形式化检验组件变更如何影响harness的可用动作、行为与可达目标提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.

</details>


### [846] [PACE-ECG: Patient-Aware Contrastive ECG Pretraining; Leveraging Longitudinal Structure for Transferable Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12307)
*Riccardo Cavarra,Lupo Lovatelli,Shaheim Ogbomo-Harmitt,Jakub Grzelak,Adelaide De Vecchi,Andrew King,Oleg Aslanidi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PACE-ECG，结合同一患者时间相邻记录的对比学习与临床引导多任务监督的ECG预训练框架，在跨系统长期预后任务上显著优于SOTA且模型小41倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生理信号基础模型多在同域解释性任务上评测，其跨医疗系统的纵向临床预后迁移能力尚不明确。

Method: PACE-ECG：对同一患者时间相邻记录做对比学习，并加入临床引导的多任务监督；在MIMIC-IV及两个外部HEEDB队列上冻结表征，评估心梗后全因死亡与心衰预测，对比DeepECG-SSL及两个对照基线，并做匹配消融。

Result: 在两个任务上均优于DeepECG-SSL：同域AUROC死亡+1.9%、心衰+4.0%；HEEDB-Boston +5.6%/+10.3%；HEEDB-Atlanta +6.9%/+11.0%；编码器小41倍、预训练数据更少。消融显示患者-时间配对较通用自监督在外部队列提升7.0%/9.4%（Boston）与8.9%/9.3%（Atlanta）。

Conclusion: 预训练目标设计与模型和数据规模同样关键地影响下游迁移；仅凭同域性能不足以证明ECG基础表征的临床泛化性。

Abstract: Foundation models for physiological signals are commonly evaluated on in-domain interpretation tasks, but their ability to transfer to longitudinal clinical prognosis across healthcare systems remains uncertain. We developed PACE-ECG, an ECG pretraining framework that combines contrastive learning across temporally neighbouring recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision. We evaluated frozen ECG representations for post-myocardial-infarction all-cause mortality and incident heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and two external HEEDB cohorts, comparing the proposed representation with DeepECG-SSL, a state-of-the-art model, and two control baselines. Across both downstream tasks, the proposed model outperformed DeepECG-SSL in-domain (AUROC +1.9% for mortality and +4.0% for heart failure) and on external populations in HEEDB-Boston (+5.6% for mortality +10.3% for heart failure) and HEEDB-Atlanta (+6.9% for mortality +11.0% for heart failure) while using an encoder 41 times smaller and a fraction of the pretraining data. A matched ablation showed that patient-temporal pairing improved external mortality and heart failure AUROC over generic self-supervision by 7.0% and 9.4% on HEEDB-Boston and 8.9% and 9.3% on HEEDB-Atlanta. These findings indicate that pretraining-objective design greatly influences downstream transfer alongside model and data scale, and that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to establish the clinical generalisability of ECG foundation representations.

</details>


### [847] [AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12333)
*Yichen Shi,Zhiyuan Wang,Jianing Cui,Yao Lai,Jinting Zhang,Zhuofu Tao,Hongyang Wang,Zhiping Yu,Ting Jung Lin,Lei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AMSchem 是一个免训练、验证器引导的智能体框架，能把 AMS 网表自动转成人类可读的原理图，并为 LLM 模拟设计工具提供结构化视觉反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网表只编码连接关系而非视觉呈现，人工转原理图耗时且依赖专家习惯；同时 LLM 设计工具缺乏视觉反馈，只能"盲改"看不到的电路。

Method: 将电路感知的视觉规划（DrawingIntent）与可执行的原理图几何（SchematicIR）解耦，配合局部化视觉反馈与有界、重新验证的修复补丁，并用确定性验证器全程保证器件保留、引脚-网络一致性与几何正确性。

Result: 构建 AMSchem-Bench（64 个电路、12 类）；40 电路子集上 gpt-5.5 达 85.0% 有效率（直接生成仅 32.5%）；作为视觉反馈模块可解决 AnalogCoder 中全部 13 个失败案例（跨 5 个模型），显著提升成功率。

Conclusion: AMSchem 有效弥合网表到原理图的鸿沟，并可作为即插即用的视觉反馈组件增强 LLM 模拟电路设计。

Abstract: For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\% validity (vs. 32.5\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

</details>
