### [848] [Rethinking Radar 3D Perception: Representation Learning from Raw Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12334)
*Miao Zhang,Mohamed Abdelsamad,Bin Yang,Sherif Abdulatif,Benedikt Loesch,Marco Altmann,Abhinav Valada,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文挑战"原始雷达频谱太杂乱不能直接学习"的假设，提出以"局部损坏下仍可重建"来定义结构、以掩码自监督建模（Leakage-aware Spectral MAE）直接学习稠密原始雷达频谱，并用x-y-D表示组织多普勒维，在3D感知任务上超越SOTA雷达检测器与点云SSL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流雷达感知依赖手工降维（稀疏点云、紧凑多普勒描述子），认为原始频谱杂乱噪声大。作者认为瓶颈不是原始表示本身，而是缺乏区分结构与噪声的学习目标；手工降维引入刚性假设，丢弃弱但有信息量的结构并保留伪影，且一旦移除信息不可由监督学习恢复。

Method: 提出结构/噪声新定义：结构＝局部损坏后仍可重建的分量，噪声＝不可重建分量。据此对稠密雷达频谱做自监督掩码建模，实例化为Leakage-aware Spectral MAE——面向原始雷达立方体的掩码自编码器，采用受频谱泄漏跨bin能量扩散启发的损坏策略。同时强调多普勒组织方式：将多普勒作为主空间维度构成x-y-D表示、高度编码为特征，优于朴素通道堆叠，可有效学习稠密4D频谱。

Result: 在无手工降维条件下，方法一致优于SOTA雷达检测器及基于点云的SSL对应方法。

Conclusion: 配合合适的预训练目标，原始雷达频谱可作为3D感知的有效表示。

Abstract: Raw radar spectra are widely viewed as too cluttered and noisy for direct representation learning, motivating handcrafted reductions, sparse point clouds, or compact Doppler descriptors in radar perception. We challenge this assumption and argue that the main limitation lies not in the raw representation itself, but in the absence of a learning objective that separates structured signal from noise. Handcrafted reductions partially address this problem but impose rigid assumptions about what constitutes signal, discarding weak yet informative structure while retaining artifacts that fit the reduction model. Once removed, such information cannot be recovered by supervised learning. We propose an alternative: structure is the component of a radar spectrum that remains reconstructable under localized corruption, while noise is the component that does not. This perspective motivates self-supervised masked modeling for dense radar spectra without predefined signal-noise separation. We instantiate it with Leakage-aware Spectral MAE, a masked autoencoder for raw radar cubes using a corruption strategy inspired by cross-bin energy spreading caused by spectral leakage. We also demonstrate the importance of Doppler organization: treating Doppler as a primary spatial dimension in an x-y-D representation, with height encoded as features, substantially outperforms naive channel stacking and enables effective learning from dense 4D spectra. Without handcrafted reductions, our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art radar-based detectors and point-cloud-based self-supervised learning (SSL) counterparts. These results establish raw radar spectra as an effective representation for 3D perception when paired with an appropriate pretraining objective.

</details>


### [849] [DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12356)
*Zhicheng Zheng,Cheng Zhang,Chenkai Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DForkTree 是一种免训练方法，它通过将目标模型输出的 n-gram 统计以逐点互信息（PMI）形式加入草稿模型打分，并对分支离开主续写后的位置加权，在 GPU 上精确构建最优草稿树，从而提升推测解码速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块扩散草稿模型（如 DFlash/DDTree）中，每个位置的分布都假设草稿模型自身最可能的续写是正确的；而树只在离开该主续写的分支上才比链有收益，但这些分支上 top-1 准确率从 89% 骤降到 18%，候选列表也常漏掉正确 token。作者发现从分叉处重新运行草稿模型通常能给出正确答案，说明误差来自分布所条件的前缀，而非草稿模型本身的知识。

Method: DForkTree 免训练（training-free）：1）把来自目标模型自身输出的 n-gram 统计以逐点互信息（PMI）形式加入草稿模型的分数；2）在分叉之后对这些分数加权；3）在这些分数下于 GPU 上精确构建最优草稿树（每个分支锚定在其自身 token 上）。所有树方法共用同一草稿模型、流水线与验证器进行对比。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B 上，DForkTree 在每个基准上都是最快的树方法；同设置下比 DFlash 快最多 41.5%，比 DDTree 快 15.1%，相对自回归解码平均最高 4.75 倍加速。

Conclusion: 分叉分支的误差源于草稿分布所依赖的前缀而非模型能力，重新锚定分支可显著改善；DForkTree 以免训练、精确最优树的简单方案取得一致且领先的加速效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by letting a lightweight drafter propose several future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash draft a whole block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds a draft tree from their per-position distributions. Each of these distributions assumes that the drafter's own most likely continuation is correct. A tree, however, gains over a chain only on branches that leave this continuation, where the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its candidate lists miss the right token far more often. When re-run from the fork token, the same drafter is usually correct, so the errors come from the prefix that the distributions condition on rather than from what the drafter knows. We introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. DForkTree adds n-gram statistics from the target model's own outputs to the drafter's scores as pointwise mutual information, weights them more after the fork, and builds the optimal tree under these scores exactly on the GPU. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, with all tree methods sharing one drafter, tree pipeline and verifier, DForkTree is the fastest tree method on every benchmark. It is up to 41.5% faster than DFlash and 15.1% faster than DDTree in the same setting, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

</details>


### [850] [TANSAR: Editable and Attributable Correlation Matrix Memories under Correlated Keys, with Rule-Constrained Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12374)
*Abdulhady Abas Abdulla,Jiyan Salim Mahmud,Fatemeh Daneshfar,Hussein Mohammed Ali,Mourad Oussalah,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在相关键（而非正交键）条件下用框架相干性分析相关矩阵记忆（CMM），给出容量上界、删除附带效应的精确刻画与归因的几何透明性界，并据此提出拓扑感知神经符号联想检索TANSAR，实现可靠的多跳联想检索与精确遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典CMM分析假设随机正交键，但语义编码器产生的表示是相关的，导致容量、删除与归因性质在真实场景下缺乏理论保证；同时多跳知识编辑中陈旧关联会造成答案矛盾，现有Hopfield式检索难以避免。

Method: 以框架理论相干性为工具分析相关键下的CMM，推导：(i) 编码器无关的容量界 n ≤ d(1+ε²)；(ii) 删除联想的附带效应精确刻画；(iii) 归因需要中心化键候选集的几何透明性界。基于此提出TANSAR：在有向无环关联图上遍历，用可靠的ground Horn约束剪除无效路径，将严格来源于已验证路径的表示注入冻结语言模型的残差流，并以Clopper–Pearson选择性风险门控把关。

Result: 受控实验验证了全部理论界。多跳知识编辑中，Horn剪枝将答案矛盾从25.1%降至0.5%；Hopfield检索在陈旧关联仍存储时产生24%矛盾（移除陈旧关联则为0%）。端到端编辑事务CPU上13.6 ms、GPU上2.37 ms。符号模块在全部600个ProofWriter理论上与金标准一致，在FOLIO上达到94.0%一致率。

Conclusion: TANSAR实现了可靠且高效的多跳联想检索，并具备精确遗忘能力；理论分析与实验一致，表明相关键下的CMM可被严格刻画，神经符号路径验证能显著抑制知识编辑中的矛盾。

Abstract: Correlation Matrix Memories (CMMs) store associations as sums of rank-one outer products, providing closed-form addressability, exact deletion, and linear attribution. While classical analyses assume random, orthogonal keys, semantic encoders produce correlated representations. We analyse CMMs under correlated keys using frame-theoretic coherence: (i) capacity bounds yielding an encoder-independent limit $n \le d(1+\varepsilon^2)$ for mean squared crosstalk $\varepsilon^2$; (ii) an exact characterisation of the collateral effect of deleting an association, guaranteeing that deletion never invalidates certified associations; and (iii) a geometric transparency bound demonstrating why attribution requires candidate sets of centred keys. On this basis, we introduce Topology-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Associative Retrieval (TANSAR). TANSAR traverses a directed acyclic association graph, prunes invalid paths via sound ground Horn constraints, and injects a representation derived strictly from the verified path into the residual stream of a frozen language model, guarded by a Clopper--Pearson selective-risk gate. Controlled experiments confirm all theoretical bounds. In multi-hop knowledge editing, Horn pruning reduces answer contradictions from 25.1% to 0.5%, whereas Hopfield retrieval incurs 24% contradictions when stale associations remain stored (and 0% if stale associations are removed). An end-to-end edit transaction requires 13.6 ms on a standard CPU and 2.37 ms on GPU. The symbolic component matches gold labels across all 600 ProofWriter theories and achieves 94.0% agreement on FOLIO, demonstrating sound and efficient multi-hop associative retrieval with exact unlearning.

</details>


### [851] [Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12377)
*Jeremy Canale,Fabien Soulis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"影子IT因自主AI代理而指数级增长"的复利模型，并开发开源Windows检测器Agent Detector，通过将行为锚定到远程服务身份而非仅进程结构来识别未授权代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影子IT（未经IT组织批准的技术使用）是长期治理难题，作者认为自主AI代理会加速其增长：代理使构建工具近乎零成本、以用户权限行动、并遗留脚本/自动化/MCP服务器等未授权产物。而治理始于检测，因此需研究能否在Windows终端上检测未授权代理。

Method: 1）建立简单复利模型分析影子IT增长；2）提出九类代理分类法和六层终端足迹；3）论证仅基于进程与连接结构的规则无法区分代理与其"行为孪生"（与非AI服务通信的同一程序）；4）实现Agent Detector，将行为锚定到远程服务身份，并结合配置、安装、执行历史进行关联，使用含39个工具和184个LLM端点条目的目录，以需用户确认的通知而非阻断方式提示。

Result: 在12个合成代理、3个AI组件和9个良性负载的受控测试台上（单工作站重复5次）：两条纯行为规则标记了所有行为孪生，而Agent Detector零误报，并在多数运行中检测到所有代理。局限性：连接共享CDN后端的提供商仅在DNS缓存存活期内（1–5分钟）可归因；间歇性代理约每三次扫描才被看到一次；单次扫描约154毫秒。

Conclusion: 测试台规模太小，无法对检测器排名，但描绘了各类证据的可见范围：未授权代理可被部分检测，且不能仅靠行为检测。

Abstract: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.

</details>


### [852] [Reconstructing hourly traffic on every street of a capital from a sparse counting network: a graph neural network applied to Paris](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12379)
*Xavier Jurado,C{é}dric Wemmert,Nicolas Reiminger*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 开发GNN模型，仅用巴黎4.9%路段的计数器数据，重建全路网32,163个路段的小时交通流量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微尺度空气质量模型需要每个路段的逐小时交通数据，但永久性计数器仅覆盖路网极小部分（巴黎仅4.9%），存在严重数据缺失问题。

Method: 将GNNUI适配到真实稀疏计数网络：在路口图的边上解码流量，以交通气候学作为零膨胀负二项似然中的偏移项，通过掩码计数器进行训练；采用八折空间交叉验证，并先合并共享同一发布序列的计数器。

Result: 在有计数器的城区插值R²=0.89（误差约为均值流量的1/4），在无计数器城区外推R²=0.74（约1/3均值流量）；主要干道表现良好，少量局部街道相对误差约50%。消融显示气候学偏移有助于外推；道路属性、时间周期和计数网络实时状态作用最大，天气输入无显著影响；掩码率是唯一有明确影响的继承超参数。在训练期外的2026年1—8月，冻结模型误差仍处于往年区间。

Conclusion: 该GNN方法能有效从稀疏计数网络重建全路网小时交通流量，具备良好的插值与外推能力及时间泛化性，可支撑微尺度空气质量建模。

Abstract: Micro-scale air quality models require hourly traffic data on every road segment, whereas permanent counters cover only a small part of the network. A graph neural network (GNN) was developed to reconstruct hourly traffic flows on the 32,163 road segments of Paris intra-muros from the 1,573 segments equipped with a counter (4.9%). The model adapts the Graph Neural Network for Urban Interpolation (GNNUI) to a real, sparse counting network. Flows are decoded on the edges of the junction graph (one edge per segment, both directions summed), a traffic climatology serves as an offset in a zero-inflated negative-binomial likelihood, and training proceeds by masking counters. Eight-fold spatial cross-validation, with counters sharing a published series merged before splitting, distinguishes interpolation at a withheld counter in an instrumented district (R${}^2$ = 0.89, error of a quarter of the mean flow) from extrapolation to a district without counters (R${}^2$ = 0.74, a third of the mean flow). These scores hold on main axes where counters are located, while relative errors are about 50% on the few counted local streets. Ablations show that the climatology offset tends to help extrapolation. Road attributes, time cycles and the live state of the counting network matter most, while weather inputs have no significant effect. The masking rate is the only inherited hyperparameter with a clear effect. When evaluated on January--August 2026 (outside the training period), the frozen model stayed around the error band of previous years.

</details>


### [853] [AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12393)
*Shiqi Chen,Daniel Madrigal Diaz,Wei-Ning Chen,Gbola Afonja,Fangkai Yang,Rujia Wang,Chetan Bansal,Victor Rühle,Saravan Rajmohan,Dongge Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AutoBuddy-Bench 模拟器，用于评测 LLM 智能体在真实工作区中"自主发现并执行待办任务"的能力，并发现不同模型的能力瓶颈呈系统性位移（弱模型败于发现、中等模型败于执行意愿、强模型败于业务系统操作）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准通常直接给出任务，而知识工作场景中请求散落在用户工作区，智能体需先识别哪些义务存在；同时此类评测需要人、事件、文档互洽的模拟组织环境。

Method: 构建 AutoBuddy-Bench：将组织员工、项目、业务系统与事件历史建模为时间图，渲染为真实工作区文件，从产生义务的事件推导 ground-truth 任务，并从世界状态计算结果；另构建参考智能体 AutoBuddy，可替换骨干 LLM，先定位任务并溯源，再在独立会话中带写权限执行。

Result: 仅更换骨干模型即出现瓶颈位移：弱模型主要在任务发现阶段失败，中等模型能识别任务但常常不执行，最强模型主要在执行阶段（尤其业务系统操作）失败；发现精度与执行质量仅弱相关，说明二者是不同能力。

Conclusion: 主动任务发现与执行是值得独立研究的能力维度，需分离评估发现与执行；AutoBuddy-Bench 提供了可控、有一致真值的评测平台。

Abstract: As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.

</details>


### [854] [AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12478)
*Chengwei Wei,Yi Ma,Nancy F. Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AuDiR 基准通过受控输入干预（逐级提供规则与声学观测、去除音频）区分音频模型在声学感知、规则知识、规则应用三类失败上的表现，并报告初步评测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅看答案正确率无法区分模型失败究竟源于声学感知、规则知识缺失还是规则应用错误，需要一种可控、可诊断的评测方法来分离这些因素。

Method: 构建 AuDiR 基准：每道题含音频片段、多项选择题、通用规则与所需声学观测的文字描述；设置三个逐级提供规则与观测的条件，以及一个保留问题与规则但去除音频的条件。第一个答对的诊断条件给出操作性响应标签（不指向唯一内部原因）。当前包含 201 题、18 个家族、9 个来源，答案参考与感知抽取文档分离；另做家族级知识探测。

Result: Gemini-3.8-flash 初步评测：无信息供给准确率 29.3%，仅给规则 31.3%，同时给观测达 98.5%；无音频条件 23.9%，置信区间覆盖 25.0% 随机水平。家族级探测显示规则回忆不完整与规则供给带来的更大增益相关。

Conclusion: 结果表明以文本形式提供声学观测有显著收益，但验证不完整、可能存在识别捷径以及非单调响应，限制了更强的失败归因结论。

Abstract: Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.

</details>


### [855] [SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12552)
*Weimin Wu,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SciMARS 框架，对多智能体"载体(harness)"进行递归的任务局部适配，并用共享证据图与分离的组件编辑器解决记忆丢失与固定流程固化错误的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环科学发现中，多智能体系统需随证据演化协同分析、实验设计与验证，但存在两问题：(i) 缺乏共享记忆导致观察丢失、重复劳动；(ii) 角色流程、交接与记忆策略固定，即使保留证据也会重复犯错。

Method: 以共享证据图为核心，配以独立的组件编辑器：SciMARS 自适应调整角色与协作方式；SciMARS + Memory 增加第三个编辑器，管理智能体如何记录、检索与接收证据；并用候选探针(candidate probes)指导下一轮 harness 的组合与选择，形成递归式任务局部适配。

Result: 在 Autonomous Science Bench 上，SciMARS + Memory 用 GPT-6-Astra 解决 12/18、GLM-5.3 解决 2/18，基线多智能体团队为 8/18 与 1/18；在 ScienceAgentBench 与 AppWorld 上分别解决 14/38 与 11/20，基线为 11/38 与 5/20（评估基于实验数据回放与数字孪生）。

Conclusion: 结果支持将共享记忆与 harness 自适应相结合，可同时提升科学发现类任务与交互式任务的表现。

Abstract: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

</details>


### [856] [Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12635)
*Zhu Xiao,Kuan Feng,Tong Li,Chenxi Liu,Gang Wang,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Multi-STG框架，将LLM语义先验与图时空学习结合，提升恶劣天气下的城市交通流预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恶劣天气等稀有气象事件下交通流预测困难：现有数据驱动模型依赖浅层数值环境特征，难以应对数据稀疏与非线性突变，也无法捕捉"特定不利条件如何改变不同功能区出行行为"的语义推理。

Method: 统一框架Multi-STG：(1) LLM赋能的语义增强模块，将天气、POI、节假日等上下文描述转为高层语义嵌入，作为知识驱动的补充；(2) 多模态注意力融合机制，动态加权异构输入；(3) 语义增强预测头+门控残差校准，依据语义引导稳健调整预测。

Result: 在真实多城市私家车数据集上，三城市平均较最强基线降低MAE 11.82%，并在稀疏与非平稳条件下保持稳定性能。

Conclusion: 引入LLM语义推理可有效弥补数据稀缺，与图时空模型及注意力融合、门控校准结合，显著提升恶劣天气下交通流预测的准确性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.

</details>


### [857] [TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12640)
*Yihan Hank Tang,Peng Yang,Jiayi Xin,Tianqi Shang,Xuyang Chen,Ying Yuan,Yi Lian,Qi Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TrialDesignBench，一个包含617个肿瘤I期/I-II期剂量探索试验、每个试验配有经专家验证且符合FDA最新监管要求的参考设计的基准，用于评估LLM辅助临床试验统计设计的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI已广泛用于临床试验流程，但试验统计设计这一关键环节几乎无AI进展。LLM具备生物医学知识和统计推理能力，看似天然适配，但因FDA Project Optimus等监管与方法学变革重新定义了合理设计标准，使旧设计过时，目前缺乏合适评测手段。

Method: 构建TrialDesignBench基准，包含617个I期/I-II期肿瘤剂量探索试验，每个配有一个与最新FDA监管倡议一致的、经专家验证的参考设计；参考标准通过对专家设计流程的形式化生成。随后评测五个前沿LLM，并进行消融实验。

Result: 五个前沿LLM均未能达到参考标准。消融实验将性能差距归因于两个主要原因：从试验来源推断潜在的、未记录的设设计决定因素（提供这些因素可使类别平衡准确率提升0.22），以及结构化决策树推理（提升0.24）。

Conclusion: TrialDesignBench为评估和改进AI辅助临床试验设计提供了可复现、符合当代标准的客观基准，并为后续AI辅助试验设计奠定基础。

Abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

</details>


### [858] [Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12675)
*Marcus Armstrong,Navid Ayoobi,Pradham Mummaleti,Alexander Chulzhanov,Arjun Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 可用仅在无标注提示上拟合的残差流映射，将拒绝方向、正确性方向与情感探针等可解释性工具跨模型迁移，覆盖110对模型；工具迁移保真度取决于映射的拟合数据覆盖度，并可用无标签覆盖度指标预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性工具（拒绝方向、真实性探针、引导向量）通常针对单个模型、需带标注数据构建，难以复用；作者探究这些工具能否仅借助无标注提示拟合的残差流映射迁移到其他模型。

Method: 在5个模型家族、1B–72B参数、基座与指令微调模型共110对模型间进行迁移：一个拒绝方向（以加性与消融做因果检验）、一个正确性方向与一个情感探针（读出工具）；设置特异性对照与5个随机种子。比较在普通问题 vs 工具作用区域的无标注提示上拟合映射的效果。给出定理：只要两模型在映射覆盖的数据上线性对应，线性映射即具此行为；并据此导出无标签覆盖度评分。

Result: 普通问题拟合的映射恢复目标模型自身拒绝引导效果的54%，正确性增益的16%–77%；加入工具作用区域的无标注提示后分别升至102%与88%–98%，而对照方向至多恢复1%。覆盖度评分在超16000次运行中追踪恢复率，并解释了此前“跨域映射失败”的报道。迁移的读出工具优于目标模型无标注表示所能得到的结果。

Conclusion: 可解释性结果一旦在源模型上找到，只需少量无标注提示即可跨模型复用；迁移效果由映射覆盖数据的范围决定，并可用理论推导的无标签覆盖度评分预测。

Abstract: Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.

</details>


### [859] [Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12762)
*Weida Wang,Benteng Chen,Yigeng Jiang,Shuchen Pu,Weiping Shen,Zichao Liu,Yulin Su,Zitong Wang,Siyu Zhou,Zifu Wang,Yizhi Li,Xin Zong,Yuning Yang,Jixiang Bi,Yuan Wang,Chuyi Peng,Shiyao Geng,Qi Zhang,Kuan Lu,Mengzhu Li,Weiwang Xu,Peishan Xiang,Chengjun Liu,Chengrui Wei,Fangchen Yu,Shengji Tang,Yichen Jiang,Jingqi Ye,Cheng Yang,Tao Hu,Jianbiao Mei,Qinglong Cao,Kun Li,Yixin Chen,Shengyuan Xu,Juncheng Xiao,Yiheng Wang,Ruizhe Chen,Shiyang Feng,Runmin Ma,Xiangchao Yan,Zongsheng Cao,Haomeng Hu,Yu Ke,Taihui Wu,Meng Dai,Xu Guo,Haoyang Peng,Yinglong Ni,Pingsen Shi,Xiaosong Wang,Shuyue Hu,Haijun Li,Sherry Dongqi Bao,Yang Yang,Chao Yang,Jie Hou,Tianfan Fu,Yi Gong,Jin Zeng,Mao Su,Hongxia Hao,Fanyang Mo,Fenghua Ling,Tianshu Yu,Yunqi Cai,Baihong Chi,Jingwei Wang,Lei Wang,Chuncheng Bu,Shide Lv,Guangyu Wang,Yuqiang Li,Chunfeng Song,Lei Bai,Hui Wang,Xujun Fu,Li Cao,Lei Chen,Dahua Lin,Xing Xie,Bowen Zhou,Wenlong Zhang,Pinlong Cai,Peng Ye,Aiwen Lei,Jie Li,Shengchun Wang,Bo Zhang,Shufei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sage-Taiyi 是一个受元认知启发的AI科学家架构，通过显式监控与调控已有科学理解来指导研究方向的选择，在多个基准上领先并推动实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI科学构想缺乏对自身理解、证据与假设的显式反思机制，难以自适应地决定"研究什么"和"如何研究"。

Method: 提出 Sage-Taiyi 架构，采用显式监控与调控机制，持续修正对证据、假设和未决问题的理解，据此调整研究目标并选择可复用的推理方法。在包含10个学科、50篇论文、265个任务的 Taiyi-Bench 及两个外部基准上评测，并进行5项专家引导的跨学科实验/计算验证。

Result: Taiyi-Bench 上历史再发现与开放式构想共8项指标全部第一，Overall 54.0 优于最强基线 AI Scientist-v2 的 47.9；化学实验中钴催化羰基化产率从痕量提升至84%，光催化烯丙基胺化从13%提升至69%。

Conclusion: 元认知调控是促进科学构想并走向实际验证的有效途径。

Abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.

</details>


### [860] [LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12775)
*Suryansh Talukdar,Taha Sarwat,Jin Soung Yoo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LogCDM：8.1–8.8M 参数的轻量日志异常检测器，融合三个互补信号，无需 GPU，CPU 上 5.5–10.5 ms/会话，F1 达 HDFS 0.984、BGL 0.870、Thunderbird 0.850。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有日志异常检测依赖大规模预训练模型（BERT 到 8B LLM），推理需 GPU，难以部署在产生日志的监控节点上。

Method: 三个信号：(1) 小型因果 Transformer 的下一事件惊讶度；(2) 会话自身转移图的图注意力嵌入与正常参考图嵌入的距离；(3) 转移漂移统计量——论文证明其恰为转移核间频率加权卡方散度，由此得到渐近零分布、长度标准化得分和可解释告警的逐边分解。三个信号经 sigmoid 门融合，在共享协方差高斯模型下该门即贝叶斯后验，学习到的权重反映各数据集依赖的信号。

Result: F1：HDFS 0.984、按时间切分的 BGL 0.870、Thunderbird 0.850，与同协议下 8.1B LLM 检测器相差 0.013–0.12，BGL 上优于所有紧凑基线；推理 5.5–10.5 ms/会话（CPU）；消融显示结构信号在 BGL/Thunderbird 上带来 0.025–0.030 F1 增益，HDFS 上几乎无增益，与学到的融合权重一致。

Conclusion: 以极小参数量和无 GPU 推理实现接近大模型的检测性能，且具统计可解释性与可诊断的逐边告警归因，适合部署于监控节点。

Abstract: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.

</details>


### [861] [Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12816)
*Tim Schnieders,Tareq Maximilian Gabriel Ahrari,Oliver Petrovic,Christian Brecher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并比较两种从非结构化拆解手册中提取拆解指令的框架：基于规则的自然语言处理（NLP）框架与基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式AI框架，并用真实拆解手册进行测试对比，旨在将自然语言文本转化为结构化、可读且机器可用的格式，为面向循环经济与Re-X原则的中小企业拆解自动化奠定数据基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环经济与Re-X（再利用、再制造、再循环等）原则的推进对中小企业（SME）构成挑战：产品日益复杂，阻碍了拆解自动化的落地。自动拆解需要机器可读的拆解指令，而这类信息目前主要存在于非结构化的拆解手册等文本中，缺乏结构化、可用的数据基础。

Method: 作者设计并实现两种框架：(1) 基于规则的自然语言处理（NLP）框架；(2) 利用大语言模型的生成式AI框架。两者均以非结构化拆解手册为输入，输出经整理的结构化、机器可读拆解指令，并使用真实拆解手册对两种方法进行对比评估。

Result: 使用真实世界拆解手册对两种方法进行了性能比较（摘要未给出具体量化结果）。

Conclusion: 该工作为未来拆解流程的开发与自动化提供了必要的数据基础，并对规则型NLP与LLM生成式方法在拆解指令提取任务上的适用性作出对比，为中小企业采用拆解自动化提供参考。

Abstract: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.

</details>


### [862] [MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12825)
*Jihwan Jeong,Guy Tennenholtz,Yinlam Chow,Chih-Wei Hsu,Craig Boutilier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MaxIM将增量摘要建模为容量受限的信息论奖励塑形问题，通过最大化对未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然与历史互信息，并用非对称critic提供稠密奖励，缓解稀疏奖励下的信用分配难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统需在有界内存中保留无界交互历史，但标准RL因稀疏、延迟奖励导致严重的信用分配瓶颈，难以优化记忆表示及其更新以提升下游任务效用。

Method: 提出MaxIM框架：基于价值次优性界，证明限制序列信息损失可转化为最大化未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然（预测充分性的变分下界）；引入递归一致性条件，通过最大化摘要与观测历史的互信息保证摘要落地；用参数化非对称critic计算逐步变分互信息下界，形成稠密奖励塑形。

Result: 在长时程科学阅读与多轮对话基准上，MaxIM在严格token预算和更长时程下，于事实落地、综合autorater指标与下游任务效用方面优于RL、监督微调及提示词导向基线，且无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。

Conclusion: 以信息论奖励塑形+变分互信息稠密奖励可有效解决有界记忆摘要中的信用分配问题，为无需偏好数据的记忆优化提供实用方案。

Abstract: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

</details>


### [863] [Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12865)
*Xinjie Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究奖励驱动的对齐失败：在"可验证奖励—上下文冲突"中，合规完成任务仍可行，但某些执行捷径获得更高奖励。作者在任务环境中大规模构造此类冲突，从执行历史导出合规反馈，发现少数冲突暴露即可导致广泛捷径习得，而简单二元惩罚能兼顾能力与合规并部分缓解已习得的违规行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习能提升任务能力，却可能强化违反上下文执行要求的行为（如奖励黑客）。需要一个可验证的框架来刻画这种奖励驱动错位，并支持大规模环境构造与安全学习。

Method: 提出"可验证奖励—上下文冲突"，即合规完成可行、但执行捷径奖励更高；将冲突编码进任务动力学，规模化生成交互环境，并从执行历史派生合规反馈；用受控训练分布变化做实验，并测试简单二元惩罚与已习得安全策略的泛化。

Result: 少数冲突暴露即可导致广泛捷径习得：在25%冲突混合、128次更新后，API任务上达97.9%经认证的有利可图违规。二元惩罚支持能力与合规共同提升并部分缓解已习得违规。在32个未见的变化证据任务上，资源训练的安全性使安全完成率从53.1%升至89.1%，且两种策略均完成全部真实工作。

Conclusion: 该工作将可验证的奖励驱动错位解释与可扩展任务构造和安全学习相联结；学到的安全性可适应扩展的授权范围、跨机制迁移，并在不断变化的执行要求下保持有效。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve an agent's task capability while reinforcing behavior that violates contextual execution requirements. We study this reward-driven misalignment, including reward hacking, through verifiable reward--context conflicts, where compliant task completion remains feasible while some executable shortcuts earn more reward than every compliant strategy. Encoding these conflicts in task dynamics lets us generate diverse interactive environments at scale and derive compliance feedback from execution histories. In resource and reporting workflows, task optimization increases real productivity through unauthorized resource use or raises reported scores while actual work declines. Controlled changes in the training distribution show that minority conflict exposure can still lead to widespread shortcut acquisition, reaching 97.9\% certified profitable violations on an API task under a 25\% conflict mixture after 128 updates. The same contextual checks supply a simple binary penalty that supports joint capability and compliance gains and partially mitigates acquired violations. Learned safety adapts to expanded authorization and transfers across mechanisms into workflows with evolving evidence and approval requirements. On 32 unseen changing-evidence tasks, resource-trained safety increases safe completion from 53.1\% to 89.1\% relative to task-only training, while both policies achieve full real work. These results connect a verifiable account of reward-driven misalignment with scalable task construction and safety learning that remains useful under changing execution requirements.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [864] [Neural Activity Synchronization-Based Fast Local Learnable Spiking Neural Network Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11053)
*Pranith Dutta,Sk Wasim Rajjak,Siddhanta Ray,Santlal Prajapati,Manobendra Nath Mondal*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种受神经活动同步(NAS)启发的多层SNN局部学习框架，各层用本地梯度更新权重，无需反向传播，在MNIST达97.78%准确率且具噪声鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在低功耗边缘设备上部署智能学习系统面临ANN计算复杂度高、训练延迟大和能耗高的问题。SNN是生物启发替代方案，但其训练常依赖BPTT，计算昂贵、本质上是全局的，不适合电池驱动设备。

Method: 提出一种受神经活动同步(Neural Activity Synchronization)启发的多层SNN局部学习框架：每层利用本地计算的梯度更新自身权重，完全不需要梯度反向传播，从而降低计算复杂度、训练延迟与能耗。

Result: 在MNIST数据集上训练并评估，分类准确率达97.78%；并在高斯噪声与椒盐噪声下测试，在不同噪声水平上表现稳健。

Conclusion: 局部学习为多层SNN提供了一种无需BPTT的高效训练途径，在保持较高精度的同时显著降低计算与能耗开销，并具备噪声鲁棒性，适合低功耗边缘部署。

Abstract: Implementing intelligent learning systems on low- power edge devices is challenging due to the high compu- tational complexity, training latency, and energy demands of traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), biologically plausible and spike-driven, come as an alternative. However, SNN training commonly relies on backpropagation through time (BPTT), which is computationally expensive, inherently global, and unsuitable for battery-driven devices. This work proposes a novel local learning framework for multi-layered SNNs inspired by Neural Activity Synchronization (NAS). Each layer updates its own weights using locally com- puted gradients. No gradient backpropagation is needed. This significantly reduces computational complexity, training latency, and energy consumption. The proposed SNN model is trained and evaluated on the MNIST dataset, achieving a classification accuracy of 97.78%. The model is also analyzed with Gaussian and salt-and-pepper noise, demonstrating robust performance across different noise levels.

</details>


### [865] [Understanding Spike Encoding across IoT Sensing Modalities: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11317)
*Yuxuan Hou,Di Yu,Linshan Jiang,Jin Zhang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文系统比较脉冲神经网络(SNN)在多种边缘传感任务中输入编码器的选择(交错、重复、事件编码、直接输入、电平穿越等),揭示编码方式对精度、延迟与能耗的综合影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN有望在IoT设备上实现节能感知,而输入编码器既改变可供识别的线索,又改变处理开销,因此需要理解不同编码器选择如何影响机会与代价。

Method: 在无线活动识别、惯性、表面肌电(sEMG)和触觉四类传感上开展实验,比较交错与整窗重复、直接输入与事件编码器、电平穿越等编码策略,并以Jetson AGX Orin等平台测量GPU/SoC轨能耗、算术估计能耗和时延。

Result: 无线活动中交错降低了估计算术能耗、输入窗到输出的时延及GPU/SoC轨能耗;但相同步输入尺寸下重复紧凑输入可得更高平均开发精度。惯性实验显示高精度可能伴随更高设备开销。直接输入可更快、更准且实测轨能耗更低,尽管其估计算术能耗更高。电平穿越改善隔日已有用户的手势识别;在触觉滑移检测中改变漏检与误报的平衡,且检查点选择可反转哪种输入召回率更高。

Conclusion: 编码器优劣依赖于信号结构、任务所关心的误差类型及完整推理流水线成本,作者据此提出边缘感知系统应针对这三点对编码器进行剖析与选择的方法框架。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a path to energy-efficient sensing on Internet of Things (IoT) devices. The input encoder shapes that opportunity by changing the cues available for recognition and the work required to process them. We study these choices across wireless, inertial, surface electromyographic, and tactile sensing. For wireless activity recognition, interleaving reduces estimated energy for arithmetic in the network layers, latency from the prepared input window to returned scores, and energy on the graphics processing unit and system-on-chip (GPU/SoC) rail, compared with repeating the full window on Jetson AGX Orin. With the same input size at each SNN time step, repeating a compact input can yield higher mean development accuracy than interleaving. The inertial experiments show that higher accuracy can come at higher device cost. Direct input can also be faster and more accurate than an event encoder while using less energy on the measured rail, even when its estimated energy for arithmetic in the network layers is higher. Level crossings improve grasp recognition on a later day for previously observed users. In tactile slip detection, level crossings shift the balance between missed slips and false alarms, and checkpoint selection can reverse which input offers higher slip recall. We use these findings to outline how edge sensing systems can profile encoders against the signal structure, the errors that matter to the task, and the cost of the full inference pipeline.

</details>


### [866] [AscendMOEA: An Ascend NPU-Accelerated Platform for Tensorized Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12057)
*Qianlong Dang,Zhiyang Zhang,Baosheng Li,Tianqing Zhu,Junhu Ruan*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: AscendMOEA：在华为昇腾 NPU 与 CPU 上张量化执行多目标进化算法（18 算法、155 问题、19 算子接口、11 质量指标），大批量算子中位加速 1.58×，完整算法在大种群下中位加速 5.76×且保持原有指标质量，并揭示工作负载规模与有序递推是决定加速收益的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标进化优化面临大种群、昂贵评估与多样算法结构，基于循环的实现并行度受限；而为加速器重写代码又会改变选择顺序、平局处理与种群更新，破坏原算法语义。因此需要一个既可大规模并行、又能保持原有算法行为的通用执行平台。

Method: 将决策向量、目标、约束与辅助状态统一表示为张量，提供算法、问题、种群算子、质量指标、监控与重复实验的可复用接口；支配、距离、变异与问题评估等稠密计算按批执行，而带因果依赖的短递推保持规定顺序并消费预计算的张量结果，以保持原算法行为。

Result: 在 8 块昇腾 NPU 与 192 个物理 CPU 核上评测算子吞吐、端到端运行时间、内存、数值一致性与消融：张量化算子 NPU 中位加速 1.58×；大种群下完整算法中位加速 5.76×，记录的质量指标相当；结果还识别出决定加速器收益的工作负载规模与有序计算特征。

Conclusion: AscendMOEA 证明了张量化+混合执行策略可在异构加速器上高效运行 MOEA 且不改变算法语义，为大规模、计算昂贵的多目标进化优化提供了可扩展开源平台，并给出加速收益的适用边界判据。

Abstract: Multi-objective evolutionary optimization increasingly involves large populations, expensive problem evaluations, and diverse algorithmic structures. These workloads expose the limited parallelism of loop-based implementations, while rewrites for accelerator execution can alter selection order, tie handling, and population updates. AscendMOEA is presented as a scalable platform that executes multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) on Huawei Ascend neural processing units (NPUs) and conventional central processing units (CPUs). The platform represents the decision vectors, objectives, constraints, and auxiliary states as tensors and provides reusable interfaces for algorithms, problems, population operators, quality indicators, monitoring, and repeated experiments. Dense computations are executed in batches, such as dominance, distance, variation, and problem-evaluation calculations. Short recurrences with causal dependencies retain their prescribed order and consume precomputed tensor results, which preserves the behavior of the original algorithms. AscendMOEA contains 18 algorithms, 155 benchmark and application problems, 19 public operator interfaces, and 11 quality indicators. Experiments on eight Ascend NPUs and 192 physical CPU cores evaluate operator throughput, end-to-end runtime, memory consumption, numerical agreement, and implementation ablation. Tensorized operators obtain a median acceleration of 1.58 times on the NPU. At large population scales, complete algorithms achieve a median acceleration of 5.76 times while retaining the recorded quality indicators. Moreover, the results identify the workload scale and ordered computation that determine whether accelerator execution is beneficial. AscendMOEA is open-sourced at https://github.com/dqlme/AscendMOEA.

</details>


### [867] [Maximizing Detection Probability in UAV Search Missions using Random-Key Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12317)
*Antonio Dantas,Elcio Shiguemori,Antonio Chaves*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文针对搜救(SA)中无人机路径规划的随机性与实时性约束，提出可配置的、数据驱动智能路由架构，将闭环概率更新与Random-Key Optimizers(RKO)结合，把问题建模为动态概率型开放车辆路径问题(OVRP)，可在概率最大化与资源最小化两目标间自适应切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜救任务中目标位置具有随机性，且环境信息(先验地图)可能含噪声或系统性偏差；无人机需要在实时约束下规划路径，并存在"尽可能提高发现概率"与"节省资源"之间的权衡。现有方法难以同时处理动态不确定性、实时决策与多目标平衡。

Method: 1) 构建可配置的数据驱动智能路由架构，采用闭环方式在飞行中持续更新目标概率分布；2) 引入Random-Key Optimizers(RKO)作为求解器；3) 将问题数学建模为开放车辆路径问题(OVRP)的动态概率变体，使求解器能够在"概率最大化"与"资源最小化"两个目标之间自适应切换；4) 通过计算实验测试方法的可扩展性与不同先验质量下的鲁棒性。

Result: 框架在噪声先验下能优雅退化，但在有偏先验下不能：系统性有偏地图的表现约为完全无先验飞行的一半。计算测试表明该方案具有可扩展性，在解性能上与单路径场景相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 所提架构可作为不稳定环境下搜救作业智能规划的强有力决策指南；同时揭示了一个重要实践启示——先验地图的偏差比噪声危害更大，无先验反而可能优于有偏先验。

Abstract: This paper focuses on the stochastic and real-time constraints of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) path planning in Search and Rescue (SAR) missions. We introduce a configurable data-driven and intelligent routing architecture that combines a closed-loop probability update with the Random-Key Optimizers (RKO). Our problem is mathematically modeled as a dynamic probabilistic variant of the Open Vehicle Routing Problem (OVRP), enabling the solver to switch adaptively between two objectives, thereby balancing probability maximization and resource minimization. The framework degrades elegantly under noisy priors but not under biased ones: a systematically biased map performs about half as well as flying with no prior at all. Computational tests show that the proposed scheme is scalable and competitive with single-path scenarios in terms of solution performance and serves as a strong decision guide for intelligent planning in SAR operations in unstable environments

</details>


### [868] [Pricing Symbolic Rules by What GNNs Leave Unlearned](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12446)
*Satabarto Sarkar,Prithwineel Paul*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 论文提出用精确的信息论准则（条件互信息）替代"GNN表达力有限"这一经验依据来衡量符号规则对GNN的价值，并将规则设计转化为规则发现：依据网络在out-of-fold残差上的增益，结合校准的置换零假设与族错误率控制来筛选候选规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 向GNN注入符号知识（motif计数、环计数、标签约束）常以"GNN表达力有限"为理由，但该标准不精确，无法量化某条规则究竟能带来多少信息增益。

Method: 以条件互信息作为精确度量：规则S能带来的最大对数损失下降为I(Y;S|σ)，实际收益可精确分解为该信息项加"偿还的神经债务"；对训练后的网络（表示T）该值为I(Y;S|T)，即训练未能提取的标签信息。进而把规则设计变为规则发现：在网络的out-of-fold残差上对候选规则打分，用校准的置换零假设检验并提供族错误率（FWER）控制。

Result: 在ZINC上，三次独立运行均以p_adj=0.001恢复出目标的隐藏环计数项max(0, ℓ_max−6)，并优于专家设计的环计数；冻结后迁移到五个未见数据集，从不显著差于原始网络或专家规则，在BBBP上则同时显著优于两者。

Conclusion: 该工作为"为何、何时及如何"向GNN加入符号知识提供了可量化的理论基础与可操作的发现流程，证明自动发现的规则可达到甚至超越专家规则并具良好迁移性。

Abstract: Symbolic knowledge (motif counts, ring counts, label constraints) is routinely added to graph neural networks (GNNs) and justified by their limited expressivity. We replace this yardstick with an exact one. The largest log-loss reduction a rule $S$ can give a model family is $I(Y;S\midσ)$ given what the family computes; every realised gain splits exactly into this term plus repaid neural debt; and for a trained network with representation $T$ the value is $I(Y;S\mid T)$, the label information training failed to extract. Rule design thus becomes rule discovery: we score candidates on the network's out-of-fold residual against calibrated permutation nulls with family-wise error control. On ZINC, discovery recovers the hidden ring term $\max(0,\ell_{\max}-6)$ of the target in three independent runs ($p_{\mathrm{adj}}=0.001$) and beats expert cycle counts; frozen and applied to five unseen datasets it is never significantly worse than the plain network or the expert rule, and on BBBP it significantly beats both.

</details>

### [869] [Proportionality in Elections under Feasibility Constraints and Ranked Ballots: The Solid Coalition Refinement Rule](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10229)
*Grzegorz Kwacz,Georgios Papasotiropoulos,Piotr Skowron*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究带有排序选票与一般可行性约束的选举，提出首个适用于该一般框架的比例性公理，并将 Solid Coalition Refinement (SCR) 规则推广到一般约束，证明其在拟阵约束下恰好满足该公理，并给出高效实现与实证评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有比例性公理多针对特定模型（如委员会选举、比例代表），缺乏能统一涵盖一般可行性约束（哪些候选人集合可作为结果）的通用定义，也缺少在此框架下满足比例性的规则及其可计算性分析。

Method: 1) 提出适用于一般可行性约束的首个比例性公理，并证明其可退化为已有特定模型中的既有概念；2) 将 SCR 规则推广到一般约束，并对拟阵约束证明其恰好满足该公理；3) 针对弱序下朴素实现计算不可行的问题，给出多项式时间或 FPT 时间的高效实现；4) 讨论该规则在批准选票下的局限，并进行首次实证评估。

Result: 证明所提公理可扩展既有比例性概念；SCR 在拟阵约束下恰好满足该公理；在其实现方面，弱序下的不可行步骤可在实际情形中以多项式时间或 FPT 时间完成；同时揭示该规则在批准选票情形下的局限，并给出首个实证评估结果。

Conclusion: 该工作为一般可行性约束下的比例代表提供了统一公理与规则，SCR 在拟阵约束下具有理论保证且可实现高效计算，但在批准选票场景存在局限，需实证进一步刻画其适用边界。

Abstract: We study elections with ranked ballots and general feasibility constraints, which indicate which sets of candidates are allowed as outcomes. We introduce the first proportionality axiom for this general setting and show that it extends the established notions from specific models that fit our general framework. We extend the Solid Coalition Refinement (SCR) rule to general constraints and prove that it satisfies our axiom exactly for matroid constraints. Although the naive implementation of SCR involves a step that is computationally intractable for weak orders, we show that in practical cases it can be implemented in polynomial time or efficiently in FPT time. We also illustrate limitations of this rule for approval ballots and provide its first empirical evaluation.

</details>


### [870] [Robust Analysis of First-Price Auctions with Large Supply](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10294)
*Jason Hartline,Anant Shah,Matthew vonAllmen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该文分析多单位一价拍卖（独立私有价值、单位需求竞标者）的效率（无政府状态代价），在大供给下给出新的渐近下界：ε-近似均衡的效率至少为 1-Θ(ε log(1/ε))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有平滑性框架对多单位一价拍卖的效率分析受限于最坏情形出价分布给出的 1-1/e 下界，这一下界过悲观；作者希望排除这种病态分布在均衡中出现，从而得到更紧的效率保证。

Method: 采用平滑性（smoothness）框架；证明在价值密度有下界（温和条件）时最坏情形分布不能在均衡中出现；并证明福利分析可无损地限制在无原子的（近似）均衡上，同时建立 Bayes-Nash 均衡的连续性与单调性。

Result: 当单位数趋于无穷时，ε-近似均衡的无政府状态代价至少为 1-Θ(ε log(1/ε))，显著优于 1-1/e 型下界。

Conclusion: 最坏情形出价分布被密度条件排除，无原子均衡的结构性质使分析可行；所得渐近界更紧，且连续性与单调性结论具有独立价值。

Abstract: This paper performs a robust analysis of welfare (i.e., the price of anarchy) in multi-unit first-price auctions with independent private values and unit-demand bidders. We employ a smoothness framework (see \citealp{ST-13}) to analyze the price of anarchy when supply is large.
  The main barrier to analysis in this framework is a worst-case bid distribution that establishes a lower bound on the price of anarchy of $1- \frac{1}{e}$. We show that such worst-case distributions cannot arise in equilibrium when agents' values satisfy a mild density lower bound condition. This characterization leads to novel asymptotic lower bounds. In particular, the price of anarchy for $ε$-approximate equilibrium as the number of units goes to infinity is at least $1-Θ\left(ε\log \left(\frac{1}ε\right)\right)$.
  Our analysis relies on a key structural property of equilibrium bid distributions: for a welfare analysis in any multi-unit first-price auction, it is without loss to analyze (approximate) equilibria with no atoms. In addition to this, we establish continuity and monotonicity properties of Bayes-Nash equilibria. We believe these results are of independent interest.

</details>


### [871] [The Power of Two Choices in Dynamic Pricing: As Good As Full Feedback, Instance-Wise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10345)
*Yan Dai,Tao Lin,Aleksandrs Slivkins*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究动态定价中"需要多少个菜单选项"的问题，证明仅两个菜单选项即可达到与无限菜单相同（至多对数因子）的最优遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 posted price 机制只能观测是否购买，minimax 遗憾为 Θ̃(T^{2/3})；无限菜单可完全揭示估值使遗憾降至 Θ(√T)，但实际中不可行。因此核心问题是：多少菜单选项足够？

Method: 提出仅含两个菜单选项的算法：在无需知道 F 任何性质的前提下自适应定价；关键技术是收入最大化的查询复杂性研究，证明区间查询在精度内可达与数值查询相同的查询复杂度（至多对数因子），并为最优价格估计与 CDF 估计分别设计新的区间查询算法。

Result: 两选项菜单在一般情况下达到 Õ(√T) 遗憾，单调风险率分布下 Õ(T^{1/3})，维度 d 下实例相关 Õ(T^{d/(d+1)})，均与无限菜单最优界一致；并通过新颖下界构造证明算法对每个问题实例近似最优。

Conclusion: 两个菜单选项即可充分实现菜单机制的收益揭示优势；结果具有普适性与逐实例近似最优性，同时区间查询与数值查询在收入最大化中查询复杂度等价，为动态定价提供实用且理论最优的方案。

Abstract: We study the dynamic pricing problem, where a firm sells a product to $T$ myopic customers and their values are independent samples from an unknown value distribution $F$. With posted prices, the firm only sees whether each customer buys, and the minimax regret is $\widetilde Θ(T^{2/3})$ [KL03]. A menu instead offers several options, each selling the product with some probability at some expected payment. Infinitely many menu options allow the seller to fully reveal customer values, reducing the regret to $Θ(\sqrt T)$. How many options are needed?
  Perhaps surprisingly, a second menu option suffices, achieving the same regret as infinite menus (up to $\log$ factors). This holds broadly: without knowing any property of $F$, our algorithm with two menu options attains $\tilde O(\sqrt T)$ regret in general, $\tilde O(T^{1/3})$ regret for monotone-hazard-rate distributions, and $\tilde O(T^{d/(d+1)})$ instance-dependent regret when $d\in(0,1)$ is a suitable notion of "dimension". All are optimal even with infinite menus. Moreover, we argue, via a novel lower-bound construction, that our algorithm is near-optimal for each problem instance.
  Along the way, we study the query complexity of revenue maximization, where an algorithm issues a query to each customer to learn the property of interest (either the best price or the CDF) up to some precision. We show that interval queries suffice to achieve the same query complexity as value queries (up to $\log$ factors) for both properties and across several classes of value distributions. We provide a new interval-query algorithm for each property. The best-price-estimation algorithm is the key ingredient in our main dynamic pricing algorithm, and the CDF-estimation algorithm underpins a simpler algorithm attaining $\tilde O(\sqrt T)$ regret with three menu options.

</details>


### [872] [A Cooperative Game Theoretic Model for Sustainable, Smallholder Carbon Farming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10558)
*Geetha Charan,Thandava Sunkara,Rohit P Suresh,V. Priyanka,Manojkumar Patil,Kodur Sai Vinay Sathvik,Y. Narahari*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文提出合作博弈框架，研究小农户如何通过形成联盟参与碳农业，并发布专家构建的CarbonFARM-Bench数据集，表明联合参与可借规模经济创造价值，但需公平稳定的收益分配机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小农户主导发展中经济体农业，但高认证成本、土地规模小、预算有限等结构性障碍使其难以单独参与碳农业，需探索可行且有利可图的参与路径。

Method: 构建合作博弈框架，含三部分：个体组合优化(SPO)在预算约束下确定单户最优碳农业实践组合；联合组合优化(JPO)计算联盟可达最大总经济剩余；用Shapley值、核、最小核、核仁等合作博弈解概念进行剩余分配。并发布专家构建的CarbonFARM-Bench数据集，开展受控计算实验。

Result: 证明底层合作博弈在可负担性条件下具有超可加性、一般情形下非凸。实验显示基准参数下小农户单独参与基本不可行，而联盟形成借规模经济带来显著价值；同时需稳定性感知的分配机制才能维持合作。

Conclusion: 实现小农户碳农业本质上是制度设计问题，提出多项政策建议以提升其对小农户的吸引力。

Abstract: Carbon farming offers a promising path to improve farmer livelihoods, mitigate climate change, and make farming sustainable. However, smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture in developing economies, face structural barriers to participating in carbon farming due to high certification costs, limited landholdings, and limited budgets available to them. In this paper, we develop a cooperative game-theoretic framework to study how coalition formation can enable viable and profitable participation of smallholder farmers in carbon farming. Our approach explores three components: (i) Solo Portfolio Optimization (SPO), which determines an optimal portfolio of carbon farming practices that individual farmers can adopt under budget constraints; (ii) Joint Portfolio Optimization (JPO), which computes the maximum total economic surplus achievable through the formation of farmer coalitions; and (iii) surplus allocation among participating farmers in a principled way using cooperative game-theoretic solution concepts, such as Shapley value, core, least core, and nucleolus. We show that the underlying cooperative game is superadditive under an affordability condition and non-convex in general. As part of this study, we release CarbonFARM-Bench, a carbon farming dataset constructed by experts, and conduct controlled computational experiments on this dataset. We observe that solo participation in carbon farming is largely infeasible for smallholder farmers under baseline parameters, whereas coalition formation creates substantial value driven by economies of scale. In addition, we demonstrate that stability-aware allocation mechanisms are required for sustaining cooperation. Together, our results highlight that enabling smallholder carbon farming is fundamentally a challenge of institutional design, and we offer several policy recommendations to make it attractive to smallholder farmers.

</details>


### [873] [On the Convergence of First-Order Methods in Signaling Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10619)
*Rilind Sahitaj,Artem Tsikiridis,Martin Bichler*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯信号博弈中的一阶学习动力学，发现标准在线学习算法可靠收敛到严格完美贝叶斯均衡(PE)而非非严格PE，并给出变分稳定性判断的充要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信号博弈中贝叶斯信念更新使学习场不再是正规型博弈的仿射梯度场，常用的单调性/Minty变分不等式等全局几何条件难以解释收敛行为，需找到刻画收敛的正确几何条件。

Method: 理论分析有限信号博弈的局部几何，刻画PE的变分稳定性；给出在线镜像下降、正则化对偶平均的局部last-iterate收敛保证；分析coarse-trigger regret-minimizing动力学的全局平均迭代收敛；并用PGD、镜像类方法、乐观变体与PPO做实验对比。

Result: PE变分稳定当且仅当其为严格PE；严格PE附近有局部last-iterate收敛保证；在某类信号博弈中coarse-trigger regret-minimizing动力学收敛到唯一PE；单调性/Minty条件即使二值信号博弈也会失效。

Conclusion: 信号博弈可作为紧凑的测试平台，用于理解贝叶斯信念形成如何重塑多智能体学习的收敛几何。

Abstract: We study first-order learning dynamics in Bayesian signaling games, a minimal extensive-form model of strategic interaction under asymmetric information. In these games, a Sender observes a private type and chooses a signal, after which a Receiver forms a posterior belief and selects an action. This Bayesian belief update makes the induced learning field fundamentally different from the affine game-gradient fields of normal-form games. Empirically, we find a sharp dichotomy: standard online learning algorithms reliably converge to strict Perfect Bayesian Equilibria (PE), but not to non-strict ones. We show that this behavior cannot be explained by the global geometric conditions commonly used to prove last-iterate convergence, such as monotonicity or the Minty variational inequality. Indeed, these conditions can fail even in binary signaling games. Instead, we identify the relevant local geometry. Our main result characterizes variational stability in finite signaling games: a PE is variationally stable if and only if it is strict. This yields local last-iterate convergence guarantees for online mirror descent and regularized dual averaging near every strict PE. We then study global average-iterate convergence and identify a class of signaling games in which coarse-trigger regret-minimizing dynamics converge to the unique PE. Finally, we complement the theory with experiments comparing projected gradient ascent, mirror-based methods, optimistic variants, and PPO across canonical signaling-game families. The results position signaling games as a compact testbed for understanding how Bayesian belief formation reshapes the convergence geometry of multi-agent learning.

</details>


### [874] [Winning Reviews, Losing Discovery? The Co-Evolutionary Game of AI Research and Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10791)
*Hongze Liu,Mengru Wang,Zhiyuan Zhang,Yao Liu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将"自主研究系统产出可信但难以验证价值的稿件、自动审稿奖励表面完整性"这一现象建模为作者（接受导向 vs 探索性研究）与审稿人（代理式 vs 细致评估）的双群体演化博弈，刻画二者互相强化的反馈循环及其稳定均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主研究系统能生成看似完整、实则科学价值难以核实的稿件，而自动化审稿倾向于奖励"完整的外观"。作者担心这种错配不只是个体问题，而可能形成自我强化的系统性威胁，侵蚀研究社区的科学价值，因此需要一个形式化模型来识别其机制与转折条件。

Method: 构建双群体演化博弈：作者在"接受导向"与"探索性"研究间选择，审稿人在"代理式评估"与"细致评估"间选择。接受导向产出成本更低→增大审稿压力→代理评估更划算→进一步激励作者生产"审稿人友好"的工作，形成反馈闭环。推导该反馈维持稳定"坏"均衡的条件，并给出解析的吸引域（basin）边界，说明同一制度规则为何可支持两种截然不同的均衡；辅以数值算例。

Result: 得到反馈自持为稳定均衡的条件，并用吸引域边界解释制度规则的双稳态性；数值结果显示：论文数量可掩盖科学价值的流失；调整速度越快反而强化既有实践；一旦循环建立，部分改革可能失效。细致审计与审稿人激励可逆转反馈，而若临时性支持能把社区推过吸引域边界，则可实现持久恢复。

Conclusion: 模型提供的是警示机制而非对某一会议的预测：审稿系统可在运转良好、对个体仍有回报的同时，越来越难以支持真正的发现。制度启示是应奖励经独立验证的贡献与有实质后果的审查，而非仅加速论文生产与评分。

Abstract: Autonomous research systems can produce convincing manuscripts whose scientific value is difficult to verify, while automated reviewers can reward the appearance of completeness. We examine how this gap can become a self-reinforcing threat to the research community. In a two-population evolutionary game, authors choose between acceptance-oriented and exploratory research, and reviewers choose between proxy evaluation and careful assessment. Cheaper acceptance-oriented production can increase review pressure, making proxy assessment more attractive; proxy assessment can in turn strengthen the incentive to produce reviewer-compatible work. We derive conditions under which this feedback sustains a stable regime that rewards publication success while reducing the scientific value of accepted work. An analytical basin boundary explains why the same institutional rules can support either this regime or exploratory research with careful review. Numerical illustrations show how publication counts can conceal scientific loss, how faster adjustment can reinforce existing practices, and why partial reform may fail once the cycle is established. Careful audits and reviewer rewards can reverse the feedback, while temporary support can produce lasting recovery if it moves the community across the basin boundary. The model identifies a warning mechanism rather than forecasting a particular conference: a review system can remain operational and privately rewarding while becoming less effective at supporting discovery. Its institutional implication is to reward independently validated contributions and consequential checking, rather than accelerate paper production and scoring alone.

</details>


### [875] [Welfare in Envy-free Contracts: When Agents Have Sparse Interests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11228)
*Junjie Chen,Cong Chen,Takuro Yamashita*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究隐藏努力下含嫉妒自由契约的福利最大化，刻画了单位需求情形的复杂度边界，并给出同质情形下契约设计与嫉妒自由定价的等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在委托代理场景中，代理人努力不可观测且异质，如何设计既要无嫉妒又能最大化福利（和收益）的契约是核心问题，而现有理论缺乏对计算复杂度的精细刻画。

Method: 对单位需求代理人分析兴趣数受限的复杂度分界；利用强制指派间的树状依赖结构，将优化归约为完美图上的最大权独立集；对多任务情形给出近似困难性；并在同质成功概率与奖励下建立与嫉妒自由定价的福利与收益保持等价。

Result: 每代理人至多2项兴趣时多项式可解，至多3项即NP难；多任务情形除非P=NP否则无多项式常数因子近似；同质情形下福利最大化多项式可解（不限兴趣数），但收益最大化仍NP难。

Conclusion: 给出了嫉妒自由契约设计中福利最大化的尖锐复杂度边界，并揭示了单位需求契约设计与嫉妒自由定价之间的结构性等价关系。

Abstract: We study welfare maximization under envy-free contracts, where a principal assigns tasks and offers success-contingent payments to heterogeneous agents with hidden effort. For unit-demand agents, we establish a sharp complexity boundary: the problem is polynomial-time solvable when each agent is interested in at most two tasks, but NP-hard with at most three interests. Our algorithm analyzes tree-structured dependencies among forced assignments and reduces optimization to maximum-weight independent set in a perfect graph. When agents may receive multiple tasks, no polynomial-time constant-factor approximation exists unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$. Finally, with homogeneous success probabilities and rewards, we establish a welfare- and revenue-preserving equivalence between unit-demand contract design and envy-free pricing. This yields polynomial-time welfare maximization without restricting interests, while revenue maximization remains NP-hard.

</details>


### [876] [The Query Complexity of Envy-Free Division: Cake, Chores, and Mixed Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11424)
*Alireza Farhadi,Mohammadtaghi Hajiaghayi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究蛋糕、杂务及正负混合资源无嫉妒划分的查询复杂度，给出杂务的确定性指数上界、蛋糕与杂务的Las Vegas多项式期望算法，并证明Ω(n²)下界及混合情形的不可能性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无嫉妒划分的查询复杂度在蛋糕、杂务以及同时含正负价值的混合资源上的精确刻画尚不完整，尤其是杂务与混合情形缺乏紧的上界和一般性下界。

Method: 对任意非负非原子杂务代价，构造确定性精确协议（2^{3n log₂ n+O(n)}次查询与切割）；对蛋糕与杂务分别给出Las Vegas协议（O(n^{21}log²(2n))期望查询、O(n^{20}log²(2n))期望切割）；并用对抗/根定位论证证明查询下界与混合情形的不可能性。

Result: 杂务：确定性精确协议查询与切割数为2^{3n log₂ n+O(n)}；蛋糕与杂务：Las Vegas协议期望查询O(n²¹log²2n)、切割O(n²⁰log²2n)；下界：任意固定正成功概率的精确协议需Ω(n²)期望查询（即使输出切割不计查询代价）；混合：不存在统一有限期望查询界，即便Cut总返回最左或最右根，且对任意固定乘法近似因子与成功概率、净总值为一时仍成立，并有同域加性不可能性。

Conclusion: 论文首次系统给出杂务与混合资源的查询复杂度刻画：杂务精确可解且有多项式期望的Las Vegas算法，而混合情形本质上不可行，揭示了正负价值共存的根本障碍。

Abstract: We study the query complexity of envy-free division for cake, chores, and resources with both positive and negative values. For arbitrary nonnegative nonatomic chore costs, we give a deterministic exact protocol using $2^{3n\log_2 n+O(n)}$ queries and cuts. For both cake and chores, a Las Vegas protocol uses $O(n^{21}\log^2(2n))$ expected queries and $O(n^{20}\log^2(2n))$ expected cuts. Conversely, every exact protocol with fixed positive success probability requires $Ω(n^2)$ expected queries in general, even with arbitrarily many output cuts at no query cost. For mixed cake and chores, no uniform finite expected-query bound exists even when every Cut returns the leftmost root or every Cut returns the rightmost root. This holds for any fixed positive multiplicative approximation factor and success probability, already when all net totals are one. An additive impossibility holds on the same normalized domain.

</details>


### [877] [The Complexity of Computing a Competitive Equilibrium in Fisher Markets with Chores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11556)
*Christian Kroer,Ruta Mehta,Tianlong Nan*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究带可分"杂务"（chores）与收入约束的Fisher市场均衡计算复杂度：线性负效用下精确均衡为CLS完全；凸CES负效用下有限精度均衡对任意固定有理指数ρ>1为CLS完全；并给出秩至多2线性市场精确均衡的强多项式算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Fisher市场均衡复杂度研究多聚焦于"商品"（goods）情形，而带收入要求（earning requirements）的"杂务"市场（agents需完成一定工作量/支出）的复杂度图景尚不清楚，尤其线性与CES负效用下的精确/近似均衡难度缺乏刻画。

Method: 线性情形：将箱约束二次规划的一阶条件编码进均衡价格与收入流，用紧凑的最小费用流构造证明CLS困难性，并给出CLS上界。CES情形：虽精确价格可能无理，故定义"有限精度均衡价格计算"（要求二进制容差内可认证的市场出清误差），通过对Eisenberg-Gale对偶势函数做四阶展开编码四次多项式，证明任意足够精确的近似均衡都接近一致价格，从而得CLS完全。可解特例：对负效用矩阵秩≤2、收入要求为任意正有理数的线性市场，设计强多项式精确算法。

Result: 线性负效用下精确均衡计算为CLS完全，且收入要求取{1,2^k}（二进制）时仍CLS困难。CES凸负效用下，有限精度均衡价格计算对每个固定有理ρ>1为CLS完全。秩≤2的线性市场存在强多项式算法：n个agent、m个杂务需O(nm(n+m))次有理运算与比较，中间编码长度为多项式。

Conclusion: 带收入要求的杂务Fisher市场在一般情况下计算困难（线性精确与CES有限精度均为CLS完全），但与复杂度类CLS紧密对应；而低秩（≤2）线性市场存在强多项式可解算法，界定了易解与困难的分界。

Abstract: We study the complexity of computing competitive equilibria in Fisher markets with divisible chores and positive rational disutility coefficients and earning requirements. For linear disutilities, we prove that exact equilibrium computation is CLS-complete. In particular, the problem remains CLS-hard even when the earning requirements are binary in $1$ and $2^k$, where $k$ is an integer. We prove hardness by encoding the first-order conditions of a box-constrained quadratic program in equilibrium prices and earning flows, using a compact minimum-cost flow construction. For convex constant-elasticity-of-substitution (CES) disutilities, exact equilibrium prices may be irrational. We formulate the problem of finite-precision equilibrium price computation, in which we seek rational prices with a certified market clearing error at most a given rational tolerance encoded in binary. We prove that this problem is CLS-complete for every fixed rational exponent $ρ>1$. To prove this hardness, we encode a quartic polynomial through the fourth-order expansion of the CES price potential function corresponding to the Eisenberg-Gale (EG) dual program, and show that every sufficiently accurate approximate equilibrium of the constructed market lies near uniform prices. Additionally, we also identify a tractable special case of chores Fisher markets. In particular, we provide a strongly polynomial algorithm for exact equilibrium computation in linear markets whose disutility matrix has rank at most two and earning requirements are arbitrary positive rationals. For $n$ agents and $m$ chores, the algorithm uses $O(nm(n+m))$ rational arithmetic operations and comparisons, with polynomial intermediate encoding length.

</details>


### [878] [Homological Barriers to Stable Learning of First-Order Nash Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11693)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Gabriele Farina,Patrick Jaillet,Georgios Piliouras*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文揭示了约束非凹可微博弈中稳定学习一阶纳什均衡(FONE)存在同调障碍：当FONE集具有非平凡正次数上同调（如环路）且状态空间紧且可缩时，任何固定FONE点的连续确定性动力学都无法吸引所有初值到完整FONE集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作关注博弈学习动力学的收敛性，但缺乏对"为何某些博弈中无法构造稳定收敛到全部FONE集"的拓扑层面的根本性解释；作者希望给出一个不依赖于具体动力学形式的普适障碍。

Method: 采用代数拓扑工具（上同调、映射度）分析连续确定性学习动力学的不动点性质；通过在盒约束上构造简单的非凹二次零和博弈，使其精确FONE集为一个对角六边形环加一个孤立点，作为反例；并用度理论证明障碍存在，进一步分析最小多项式次数与高次同调推广。

Result: 证明了当目标集具非平凡正次数上同调且状态空间紧可缩时，收敛保证不可能；在六边形环+孤立点反例中，无任何此类动力学能使完整FONE集成全局稳定吸引子；次数二为该障碍出现的最小多项式次数，并可推广到任意高次同调；障碍在小扰动下对足够小的近似FONE目标仍持续存在。

Conclusion: FONE集的同调结构构成稳定学习的根本性拓扑障碍；由此得到一个开、正测度、具有相同同调障碍的二次零和博弈族。

Abstract: We identify a homological barrier to stable learning of local Nash equilibria, also known as first-order Nash equilibria (FONE), in constrained non-concave differentiable games. We consider continuous deterministic learning dynamics that fix every FONE point and aim to attract all initial conditions to the full FONE set. We show that this convergence guarantee is impossible when the target set has nontrivial positive-degree cohomology, such as that arising from a loop, and the state space is compact and contractible. We exhibit this barrier in a simple non-concave quadratic zero-sum game on a box whose exact FONE set consists of a diagonal six-edge loop and an isolated point. Consequently, no such dynamics can make the full FONE set a stable global attractor. We further show that degree two is the minimal polynomial degree at which this barrier can arise and extend the construction to obtain nontrivial homology in arbitrarily high degrees. Finally, we establish that the barrier persists for sufficiently small approximate-FONE targets under small perturbations, yielding an open, positive-volume family of quadratic zero-sum games with the same homological barrier.

</details>


### [879] [Learning Global Equilibria in Non-Concave Prospect Theoretic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12611)
*Ashok Krishnan K. S.,Lilou Malfoy,Helene Le Cadre,Ana Busic*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出一种基于minorization-maximization (MM)的学习算法，用于求解嵌入前景理论、效用函数非凹非凸的非合作博弈，在势函数满足proximal Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件下可全局收敛到最大化势函数的Nash均衡，并支持分布式实现与噪声注入下的隐私保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非合作博弈中的人类agent常表现出非理性行为，前景理论可刻画风险下对收益损失的主观感知，但将其引入博弈会导致效用函数非凹非凸，均衡计算困难，难以获得具有全局收敛性的算法。

Method: 采用minorization-maximization (MM)框架设计学习算法；在势函数的proximal Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL)条件下证明全局收敛性；利用MM minorizer的结构实现算法的分布式部署；并额外注入噪声以遮蔽各agent的个体更新。

Result: 在proximal PL条件下算法全局收敛至势最大化Nash均衡；minorizer结构支持分布式实现；引入噪声后仍保证全局收敛，同时实现个体更新的隐藏。

Conclusion: MM框架为前景理论博弈等非凸环境下的均衡计算提供了兼具全局收敛、可分布式部署与隐私保护的学习方法。

Abstract: Human agents in non cooperative games often exhibit non rational behaviour. Prospect theory provides a behavioural framework to capture how agents perceive gains and losses under risk, but, its incorporation into games typically leads to non concave and non convex utility functions, making equilibrium computation challenging. In such cases, it is difficult to obtain algorithms that have global convergence behaviour. This paper proposes a learning algorithm which uses minorization-maximization (MM). Under a proximal Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition on the potential function, we establish global convergence of the algorithm to a potential-maximizing Nash equilibrium. We further show how the structure of the MM minorizer can be used to enable a distributed implementation of the algorithm. With additional noise injection, the individual updates of the agents can be obscured, while still ensuring global convergence.

</details>


### [880] [Computing EF1 Allocations under Budget Constraints in Polynomial Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12740)
*Tingwei Hu,Lili Mei,Guochuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带预算约束的不可分割物品公平分配，给出异构估值下EF1分配的多项式时间算法，并证明检测EF1违反是NP完全的，同时给出若干EFX的多项式算法及福利近似应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预算约束下每个代理只能比较自身预算内的另一捆子集，此前即使同质估值，EF1分配的多项式计算问题仍未解决，本文旨在填补该空白。

Method: 提出异构估值下求EF1分配的多项式时间算法（含对慈善品的EF1）；通过归约证明检测EF1违反为NP完全（即判定EF1为coNP完全）；针对两种特殊估值结构（估值与物品大小成比例、每代理仅有固定数目不同正值）设计EFX多项式算法。

Result: EF1分配可在多项式时间计算（异构估值）；EF1检测为NP完全/coNP完全；两类受限情形下EFX可多项式求解；同质估值下可获得至少(1/2−ε)倍最优社会福利的EF1分配，时间为输入长度与1/ε的多项式。

Conclusion: 解决了预算约束公平分配的EF1计算开放问题，厘清了EF1判定的计算复杂性，并扩展至EFX与福利近似，为带预算的公平分配提供完整算法图景。

Abstract: We study the fair allocation of indivisible items to agents with budget constraints and additive valuations. Each agent compares its own bundle with the subsets of another bundle that fit its budget. An allocation is envy-free up to one item (EF1) if, for every agent and every nonempty subset under comparison, removing an item of maximum value to that agent eliminates its envy. We require EF1 both between agents and towards the charity, which contains all unallocated items. EF1 allocations exist, but computing them in polynomial time has remained open even for homogeneous valuations. We resolve this problem with a polynomial-time algorithm for EF1 allocations under heterogeneous valuations. We also prove that detecting an EF1 violation is NP-complete. Equivalently, checking whether a given allocation is EF1 is coNP-complete. Finally, we give polynomial-time algorithms for envy-freeness up to any item (EFX) both when each agent's valuation is proportional to item size and when each agent has a fixed number of distinct positive item values. As an application, for homogeneous valuations and any $\varepsilon>0$, we obtain an EF1 allocation with at least a $(1/2-\varepsilon)$ fraction of the maximum social welfare in time polynomial in the input length and $1/\varepsilon$.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [881] [Mutation Testing for Multi-Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09895)
*Nafiseh Kahani,Mojtaba Bagherzadeh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文将变异分析引入多智能体LLM系统测试，提出14个变异算子（4类）与3种杀死准则（K-Struct/K-Outcome/K-Safety），在10个OpenAI Agents SDK工作流、1084个变异体、29,601次智能体运行上评测，发现现有基线测试套件对协调结构与权限类故障的检出能力严重不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统有显式工作流、智能体、工具、工具访问规则与委派路径，但现有评测大多只报告端到端任务成功率，无法说明测试套件能否检测协调结构中的故障（如删除委派、静默删除限制、工具边路由错误、工具实现缺陷）。

Method: 把变异分析适配到多智能体LLM场景：定义4族共14个变异算子（delegation、allowed-tool、restriction、agent/instruction），作用于归一化的workflow manifest；定义3种kill criteria——K-Struct（观测到的协调）、K-Outcome（任务判定或步骤序列）、K-Safety（禁止的工具调用）；通过OpenAI Agents SDK实际执行每个套件在原版与变异体上，k=3重复并多数投票判定。

Result: 在10个由OpenAI Agents SDK派生的workflow（49个可达智能体、47个工具、403条obligation）上，共执行29,601次智能体运行、覆盖1,084个变异体。T-Struct作为全obligation参照（三准则下MSstrict=1.000）；最佳基线T-Dev*仅达0.717（K-Struct）与0.559（K-Safety）；RES-REM（移除限制）是最难被检出的故障（基线0.19–0.28）；执行套件还使TOOL-FAULT、AG-SWAP、AG-PROMPTDROP等保obligation算子可被评估，而仅有manifest的oracle无法观测这些变化。

Conclusion: 在该设定下，以任务成功率为导向的测试套件只能捕获约一半的权限违规，且对协调结构故障（尤其是限制移除）检出率很低；说明多智能体LLM系统需要显式针对协调结构的测试充分性度量和更强的测试套件。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are defined by explicit workflows, agents, tools, tool-access rules, and delegation paths. Most evaluations, however, report end-to-end task success rather than whether a test suite can detect faults in this coordination structure, such as a removed delegation, a silently removed restriction, a misrouted tool edge, or a faulty tool implementation. We adapt mutation analysis to this setting, fourteen operators in four families (delegation, allowed-tool, restriction, agent/instruction) perturb a normalized workflow manifest, and three kill criteria score whether a suite catches the change, namely K-Struct on the observed coordination, KOutcome on the task verdict or step sequence, and K-Safety on a forbidden tool call. Every criterion is evaluated by executing each suite against the original and the mutant through the OpenAI Agents SDK, with k=3 repeats and a majority vote. On ten OpenAI Agents SDK-derived workflows (49 reachable agents, 47 tools, 403 obligations), the evaluation executes 29,601 agent runs over a pool of 1,084 mutants. We use T-Struct only as a full-obligation reference point (MSstrict=1.000 under all three criteria) and measure how much the baseline suites miss, the bestperforming one (T-Dev*) reaches 0.717 (K-Struct) and only 0.559 (K-Safety). Restriction-removal (RES-REM) is the least detected fault for the baselines (0.19 to 0.28 vs 1.000). Executing the suites also allows the obligation-preserving operators (TOOL-FAULT, AG-SWAP, AG-PROMPTDROP) to be evaluated. A manifest-only oracle would not witness these changes. In this setting, tasksuccess- style suites catch only about half of permission violations.

</details>


### [882] [From Prompt Engineering to Programmatic Prompting: Toward a Software Engineering Discipline for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09896)
*Sebastian Dingler*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文主张将"提示工程"（交互技巧）与"程序化提示"（软件工程学科）作范畴区分，并围绕提示债务给出三方面贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示已从交互式探索演变为生产系统的关键组件，但领域内的术语、工具和心智模型仍停留在"雕琢单条提示"的交互阶段，导致应用脆弱、评估不可复现与提示债务累积。

Method: 概念/立场论文（position paper）方法：通过定义与分类辨析，将程序化提示与提示工程、提示微调（prompt tuning）、微调、通用LLM应用开发逐一区分，并建构提示债务的双层分析框架。

Result: 提出三项贡献：(1) 程序化提示的定义；(2) 与相关概念的系 统性辨析；(3) 提示债务理论，区分可在代码中度量、被自认的债务与仅在事故中显现的"沉默债务"，并指出其经济学成因。

Conclusion: 提示工程是交互技巧，程序化提示是工程学科；接受这一区分对实践具有实质影响，是避免脆弱系统与不可复现评估的前提。

Abstract: The practice of instructing large language models (LLMs) through natural-language prompts has, in the span of a few years, migrated from an interactive curiosity to a load-bearing component of production software. Yet the vocabulary, tooling, and mental models of the field remain anchored in its interactive origins: we still speak of "prompt engineering" as though the crafting of a single well-worded instruction were the central problem. This paper argues for a categorical distinction. Prompt engineering, we contend, is an interaction technique - a human-computer interaction skill for eliciting desired behavior from a model in a conversational or exploratory setting. Programmatic prompting, by contrast, is an engineering discipline governing the behavioral interface between software systems and language models: the construction, composition, versioning, testing, and maintenance of prompts as first-class software artifacts embedded in larger systems. Conflating the two has produced brittle applications, unrepeatable evaluations, and an accumulation of prompt debt.
