We make three contributions: (1) a definition of programmatic prompting; (2) a systematic differentiation of programmatic prompting from prompt engineering, prompt tuning, fine-tuning, and general LLM application development; and (3) an account of prompt debt that distinguishes the self-admitted debt measurable in code from the silent debt that surfaces only as incidents, and identifies its economic cause. Our thesis is simple to state and consequential to accept: prompt engineering is an interaction technique; programmatic prompting is an engineering discipline.

</details>


### [883] [Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10015)
*Hongcheng Gao,Weiheng Li,Yipeng Wei,Yu Lei,Shuo Sun,Yi Li,Yajiao Wang,Jie Luo,Jianwei Wen,Xinyi Zhou,Hongda Li,Yibing Zhang,Henghui Sun,Yufan Zhou,Tianfang Hao,Naihao Xue,Hailong Qu,Jingjing Zhou,Peng Xu,Yongzheng Wei,Yichen Zhu,Ziying Wang,Yibo Wang,Jianshu Zeng,Yuhang Lei,Zeqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Micius-Flash 是一个 270 亿参数、原生多模态、长上下文（256K）的工程领域大模型，通过知识树驱动的数据飞轮与多教师在线策略蒸馏构建，并在硬件代码与半导体智能体基准上显著超越同规模基线，同时开源并配套工业级工具框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向科学与工程（尤其半导体、硬件设计）领域缺少专用、可多步工具调用的大模型；现有同规模基线在硬件代码与半导体智能体任务上表现不足。

Method: 1) 构建知识树驱动的数据飞轮：知识树构建与扩展→数据合成→质量校验与难例增广；2) 基于该数据训练半导体知识与推理、硬件编码、半导体多模态理解及智能体专家模型；3) 用 Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation（MOPD）在模型自生成序列上做多专家能力融合；4) 开发 Micius Harness 接入 EDA、KiCad 及执行环境。

Result: 在 20+ 数据集、约 1.5 万条记录上：硬件代码基准平均 64.2%（超同规模基线 15.0 分）；半导体专用智能体基准 62.4%（超基线 17.2 分）；PCB 设计、芯片设计流程自动化、软件开发案例显示其能利用工具反馈完成多步规划、调试与迭代验证。

Conclusion: Micius-Flash 验证了"知识树数据飞轮 + 多教师蒸馏 + 工业工具框架"路线在工程智能体上的有效性，并以开源形式推动科学与工程智能体发展。

Abstract: We introduce Micius-Flash, a 27-billion-parameter model for engineering with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window. We design the Micius data pipeline as a knowledge-tree-driven data flywheel comprising three stages: knowledge tree construction and expansion, data synthesis, and quality validation with hard-example augmentation. From this data, we train expert models for semiconductor knowledge and reasoning, hardware coding, and semiconductor multimodal understanding, along with agentic experts. Subsequently, we employ Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) to supervise training on sequences generated by Micius itself, thereby integrating the capabilities of these expert models into a unified model. On more than 20 datasets with about 15K records, Micius-Flash averages 64.2% on hardware code benchmarks, 15.0 points above a same-size baseline. It scores 62.4% on a semiconductor-specific agent benchmark, exceeding the same-size baseline by 17.2 points. We further develop Micius Harness for industrial applications, connecting the model to specialized tools, including EDA tools and KiCad, as well as execution environments. Case studies in PCB design, chip design workflow automation, and software development demonstrate the model's ability to use tool execution feedback for multi-step planning, code debugging, and iterative verification. We release Micius as an open-source model to advance the development of agents for science and engineering.

</details>


### [884] [How Much Skill Orchestration Can LLM Agents Compile Away? Execution-Grounded Specialization for Token-Efficient Skill Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10022)
*Jiayi Ni,Zac Wang,Alex Zhang,Zheng Liu,Roopa Prabhu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 SkillCache：将一次已完成的技能调用编译为参数化的程序+自然语言步骤"胶囊"（capsule），复用前重放校验，并由计划执行器驱动，仅在必要时交还模型控制权，从而实现技能的自动加速与跨模型迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 每次调用可复用技能时都要重新解读技能并重建编排流程，浪费开销；而零样本的技能特化（无执行证据）会因对运行时绑定的错误假设导致计划脆弱、恢复代价高。

Method: 先分析零样本技能特化的缺陷，据此提出单轨迹（one-trace）技能特化方法 SkillCache：把一次完成的调用编译为含程序与自然语言步骤的参数化胶囊；复用时先重放（replay）验证，再由 plan executor 执行，必要时把控制权交回模型，并保留原始技能用于恢复。

Result: 在 Claude Code 环境下、87 个 SkillsBench 任务上，同一请求的热执行相比基线：Claude Sonnet 4.6 减少 81% token、Opus 4.8 减少 74%，奖励相当；在受控请求变更下胶囊仍有效；胶囊可跨模型迁移，使三个开放权重模型平均奖励提升 12–25 个百分点，同时 token 减少 72–81%。

Conclusion: 基于执行证据的编译是高效重复使用技能与跨模型迁移的可行路径；一次轨迹即足以生成稳健的参数化胶囊。

Abstract: Reusable skills guide large language model (LLM) agents through recurring requests, but each invocation still requires the model to interpret the skill and reconstruct its orchestration. Can agents automatically compile this orchestration into an executable fast path without human intervention? We first study zero-shot skill specialization, which compiles without execution evidence, and find that despite the skill's procedural guidance, incorrect assumptions about runtime bindings can make generated plans brittle and recovery costly. This motivates SkillCache, a one-trace skill specialization method that compiles a completed invocation into a parameterized capsule of programs and natural-language steps, replays it before reuse, and drives it with a plan executor that returns control to the model only when needed, keeping the source skill for recovery. With the Claude Code harness, warm execution of the same request reduces tokens on 87 SkillsBench tasks by 81% with Claude Sonnet 4.6 and by 74% with Claude Opus 4.8 at comparable reward, and capsules stay effective under controlled request changes. Capsules also transfer across models, raising three open-weight models' mean reward by 12-25 percentage points while reducing their tokens by 72-81%, suggesting that execution-grounded compilation is a promising approach to efficient repeated skill use and cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [885] [Executable Specifications as First-Class Independent Verification and Validation Artifacts for Quantum Information and Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10023)
*Ragib Shahariar Ayon,Shibbir Ahmed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文主张将可执行规约（executable specifications）作为量子信息与机器学习（QIML）系统独立验证与确认（IV&V）的一等工件，并分析迁移现有规约推断与评估方法所面临的挑战，指出未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行规约能让软件假设显式化并可检查，但在量子信息与机器学习（QIML）领域的作用尚未被充分探索；缺乏对QIML系统进行独立验证与确认的有效手段。

Method: 立场/展望性分析：论证可执行规约应作为QIML系统IV&V的一等工件；借助静态分析、测试、仿真、运行时检查提供QIML行为证据，并用契约式设计（Design by Contract）表明量子态、测量和统计性质可表达为可检查条件。

Result: 识别出将传统软件与机器学习中的规约推断及评估方法迁移到QIML时的若干挑战：缺乏可推导通用规约的证据、跨阶段与概率性行为、混合工作流的仓库级推理、以及弱行为oracle。并据此刻画了研究方向：QIML语料库、规约语义、仓库级分析、规约评估。

Conclusion: 可执行规约是QIML系统IV&V的有前景路径，但需在语料构建、规约语义、仓库级分析和规约评估四个方面开展进一步研究以应对上述挑战。

Abstract: Executable specifications make software assumptions explicit and checkable, yet their role in quantum information and machine learning (QIML) remains underexplored. We argue that executable specifications should be treated as first-class artifacts for independent verification and validation (IV&V) of QIML systems. Static analysis, testing, simulation, and runtime checking can provide evidence about QIML behavior, while Design by Contract shows that selected quantum-state, measurement, and statistical properties can be expressed as checkable conditions. However, adapting existing methods for specification inference and assessment from conventional and machine-learning software to QIML raises several challenges, notably limited evidence for deriving generalizable specifications, cross-stage and probabilistic behavior, repository-scale reasoning across hybrid workflows, and weak behavioral oracles. We characterize these challenges and identify research directions for QIML corpora, specification semantics, repository-level analysis, and specification assessment.

</details>


### [886] [Between Spark and Silicon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10025)
*Zihao Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该观点文章认为硬件敏捷性的真正单位不是更快的RTL生成，而是"被接受的设计变更"，且该变更须由最新、有范围界定、可独立治理的证据支撑；文章通过回顾可执行验证、设计生成器、集成实现与智能体设计自动化的发展，区分历史能力、厂商宣称与最新基准结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式智能体使"硬件设计=对话+编译"的设想流行，但作者指出更快的RTL生成并不等于更快且可辩护的工程决策，因此需要重新界定硬件敏捷性的核心衡量单位。

Method: 观点/立场论文（perspective），非实证实验。通过文献与技术发展回顾，对可执行验证、设计生成器、集成实现、智能体设计自动化四条脉络进行梳理，并对历史能力、厂商营销宣称与近期基准评测结果做批判性区分。

Result: 提出核心论点：硬件敏捷性的操作性单位应为"被接受的设计变更"，其成立依赖三类证据属性——时效性（current）、范围明确（scoped）、独立治理（independently governed）；并指出仅靠生成速度提升不足以支撑可辩护的工程决策。

Conclusion: 硬件设计自动化评价应从"生成速度"转向"变更被接受的速度与证据质量"，需要以可审计、可治理的验证证据体系作为智能体硬件设计的落脚点。

Abstract: Generative agents make it easy to imagine hardware design as a conversation followed by compilation. Yet faster register-transfer-level (RTL) generation does not ensure a faster, defensible engineering decision. This perspective argues that the operative unit of hardware agility is an accepted change supported by current, scoped, and independently governed evidence. We revisit key developments in executable verification, design generators, integrated implementation, and agentic design automation, distinguishing historical capabilities from vendor claims and recent benchmark results.

</details>


### [887] [NINJA: A Navigator-Inspector Joint Architecture for Context-Efficient Issue Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10027)
*Wenkai Fang,Shunyu Liu,Wei Luo,Zihao Wu,Yang Zhou,Tongya Zheng,Wotao Yin,Jialie Shen,Leszek Rutkowski,Mingli Song,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NINJA: a hierarchical Navigator-Inspector architecture for context-efficient issue localization, with two-stage agentic fine-tuning.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing agent-based issue localization methods use a single agent with growing context, so long-context accumulation compresses reasoning space; the flat exploration structure also fails to balance file-level breadth and function-level depth.

Method: Decompose repository exploration into global navigation and local inspection: a navigator keeps the global search state, does file-level search and dispatches entry files; independent inspectors do function-level exploration in separate contexts and feed suspicious locations back. A two-stage agentic fine-tuning strategy strengthens global coordination and local exploration.

Result: Across multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones, NINJA consistently outperforms competitive baselines; fine-tuned Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct surpasses closed-source Claude-Haiku-4.5.

Conclusion: Hierarchical navigator-inspector collaboration with independent contexts resolves the context-bloat and breadth-depth trade-off, and fine-tuning further boosts open-source backbones to strong performance.

Abstract: Recent advances in agent-based methods have demonstrated strong promise for issue localization, a critical prerequisite for software issue resolution. However, most existing agent-based methods rely on a single agent with a growing context, where long-context accumulation compresses the effective reasoning space. Meanwhile, the flat exploration structure hinders the balance between file-level breadth and function-level depth. To address these limitations, we propose NINJA, a hierarchical Navigator-Inspector Joint Architecture for context-efficient issue localization. NINJA decomposes repository exploration into global navigation and local inspection: the navigator maintains the global search state, performs file-level search, and dispatches selected entry files, while inspectors independently conduct function-level exploration around the assigned files in separate contexts. Through multi-round interactions, inspectors return suspicious locations as feedback, and the navigator updates the global state to decide whether to continue exploration or finalize localization. This hierarchical design balances file-level breadth with function-level depth, while independent inspector contexts prevent local exploration traces from accumulating in a single growing context. To further strengthen both global coordination and local exploration, we introduce a two-stage agentic fine-tuning strategy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones show that NINJA consistently outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, after fine-tuning, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct surpasses the strong closed-source Claude-Haiku-4.5 model. Our code is available at https://github.com/wantbook-book/NINJA.

</details>


### [888] [Ninada: Sub-Clause Split-Graph VITS Streaming and Capability-Routed 24 kHz Speech Synthesis Across Twelve Scripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10035)
*Hemanth HM*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Ninada是一个开源24 kHz多语言TTS系统，通过能力路由的48个checkpoint舰队（桌面WebGPU用HiFi-GAN v1、移动WASM用NOLA iSTFTNet），配合内存内ONNX切分与12帧halo流式合成，显著降低启动延迟与显存峰值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端VITS模型ONNX导出为整句单次前向，导致TTFA达数秒且激活内存激增；客户端部署还面临四类瓶颈：每语言138.8 MB float32权重挤占浏览器缓存、移动WebGPU卷积着色器编译卡顿6-14 s且慢于实时(1.44×RTF)、WASM pthread池在big.LITTLE上屏障停顿、移动端Web Audio在AudioWorklet争用与iOS WKWebView限制下掉帧或静音。

Method: 构建覆盖英语、古典梵语及十种印度语言（共12种语言）的48-checkpoint路由舰队：24个HiFi-GAN v1专家（27.9 MB W8A32+FP16 ONNX）用于桌面/WebGPU，24个蒸馏c8c8_384 iSTFTNet专家（21.7 MB ONNX，经NOLA双窗ConvTranspose1d精确逆STFT、无复数运算，声码器MAC减少2.64×）用于移动WASM，另加0.0 MB零依赖Klatt回退。运行时在<15 ms内于内存中把单个ONNX拆为prior、flow与加窗声码器子会话，以12帧halo与升余弦交叉淡化实现流式。

Result: 在N=480条留出24 kHz录音上，达到3.22 dB 0-8 kHz MCD（移动iSTFTNet为3.09 dB；24音色蒸馏MCD为1.33 dB，对比1526.8 MB 16 kHz Meta MMS舰队的5.17 dB），8-12 kHz误差6.07 dB；桌面WebGPU可听启动89-155 ms，Pixel 10 Pro XL上538-649 ms零欠载流式、0.75-0.76×RTF。

Conclusion: 分片流式ONNX与按设备能力路由轻量专家，可在浏览器与移动端实现低延迟、低内存、跨Indic脚本的高质量TTS，且优于大型多语言基线。

Abstract: End-to-end VITS text-to-speech models synthesize natural speech in a single forward pass, yet standard ONNX exports execute monolithically over an entire clause, delaying Time-To-First-Audio (TTFA) to several seconds and spiking activation memory. Client-side deployment across Indic scripts faces four further bottlenecks: 138.8 MB float32 checkpoints per language strain browser caches, mobile WebGPU stalls for 6-14 s compiling convolution shaders while still running slower than real time ($1.44\times$ RTF), small WebAssembly pthread pools stall at barriers on big.LITTLE mobile CPUs, and mobile Web Audio pipelines drop frames or mute output under AudioWorklet contention and iOS WKWebView rules.
  We present Ninada, an open-source 24 kHz TTS system covering English, Classical Sanskrit, and ten Indian languages (sa, en, hi, kn, mr, bn, ta, te, ml, gu, pa, or) across a capability-routed 48-checkpoint fleet: 24 studio HiFi-GAN v1 specialists (27.9 MB W8A32+FP16 ONNX) for desktop/WebGPU and 24 distilled c8c8_384 iSTFTNet specialists (21.7 MB ONNX, $2.64\times$ fewer vocoder MACs via an exact NOLA dual-window ConvTranspose1d inverse STFT with zero complex ops) for mobile WASM, plus a 0.0 MB zero-dependency Klatt fallback. At runtime, Ninada splits a single ONNX file in memory in $< 15$ ms into prior, flow, and windowed vocoder sub-sessions streaming 12-frame halos with raised-cosine crossfades. On $N = 480$ held-out 24 kHz studio utterances, Ninada achieves 3.22 dB 0-8 kHz MCD (3.09 dB mobile iSTFTNet; 1.33 dB 24-voice distillation MCD, vs. 5.17 dB for the 1,526.8 MB 16 kHz Meta MMS fleet) and 6.07 dB 8-12 kHz error, delivering 89-155 ms audible startup on desktop WebGPU and 538-649 ms zero-underrun streaming at 0.75-0.76x RTF on a physical Google Pixel 10 Pro XL.

</details>


### [889] [SPRING-5: Measuring Tool Documentation Repair for LLM Agents by Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10040)
*Guan Zheng Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 SPRING-5 基准，以调用成本（而非仅任务准确率）评估工具文档自动修复方法，并配套三项有效性仪器；结果显示批量重写优于在线自进化，但优势经曝光校正后不可检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具文档自动修复方法多以任务准确率为评估标准，缺少对调用成本的度量与评估效度保障，容易掩盖高成本失败模式，难以公平比较不同方法。

Method: 构建 SPRING-5：20 个工具族、344 个任务，每任务含刻意退化的规范、人工撰写的诚实规范、确定性后端与答案键；以理想调用路径为基准计费，错误答案按满额预算计费，并并列报告"每正确任务的调用数"。设三项有效性仪器：(1) 构建期上限断言（诚实规范须达理想路径）；(2) dud 规则（更强模型冷启动即可解决的族视为无效族）；(3) 直接测量的噪声底（字节相同规范两次评估的 95% 因子 0.64–1.56，约八分之一比较仅因噪声越过常规胜出阈值）。对比四类方法：仅 schema、在线自进化循环、全训练转录批量重写、带正确性标签的变体。

Result: 2,644 次基线会话中，54% 的错误答案无拒绝调用、无拒答、无重试。构建期断言仅在一个族上系统性失败；dud 规则捕获 4 个族；廉价噪声估计受未编辑族偏差影响。成本差距闭合比例：仅 schema 1%、在线自进化 13%、批量重写 33%、带标签变体 58%。批量法相对在线循环的优势在曝光对齐后不可检测。5 与 10 个工具在上下文时效应仍在、基线成本不变，仅机器撰写描述导致调用错工具。BFCL 上 62% 的留出查询已可由随附文档回答，解释其中的汇合零效应。

Conclusion: 评估工具文档修复须以成本为核心并辅以有效性仪器；批量重写看似更优可能源于训练曝光差异而非方法本身；已有基准（如 BFCL）的文档已足够好，会掩盖方法差异。代码、数据与运行记录已公开。

Abstract: Methods that repair tool documentation automatically are mostly evaluated on task accuracy. We report a benchmark that scores them on cost. SPRING-5 is 20 tool families and 344 tasks, each with a deliberately degraded specification, a hand-written honest one, a deterministic backend and an answer key, scored on calls charged against the ideal call path. A wrong answer is charged the full call budget, so this cost index largely tracks the completion rate, and we report calls per correct task beside it, which carries no such charge. Over 2,644 baseline sessions, 54% of wrong answers arrive with no rejected call, no refusal and no retry. The benchmark carries three validity instruments. A build-time ceiling assertion requires the honest specification to reach the ideal path and fails systematically on only one family. A dud rule names the families a stronger model solves cold and catches four. A directly measured noise floor shows that two evaluations of a byte-identical specification differ by a 95% factor of 0.64 to 1.56, so about one comparison in eight crosses a conventional win threshold on noise alone, and the cheap way of estimating that floor is biased by which families happen to go unedited. Against these instruments, a schema-only method closes 1% of the baseline-to-ideal cost gap, an online self-evolution loop 13%, one batch rewrite over every training transcript 33%, and a variant given correctness labels 58%. The batch advantage over the loop is the evidence it reads: held to the loop's exposure it is no longer detectable. With five and ten tools in context the effect survives, the baseline cost does not change, and only machine-written descriptions sent calls to the wrong tool. On BFCL, 62% of held-out queries are already answered from the shipped documentation, which explains a pooled null there. Code, data and runs are released.

</details>


### [890] [From Delegation to Action Approval: An Exploratory Study of Developers' Practices in Collaborating with AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10058)
*Yinan Wu,Dominik Wermke,Ze Shi Li,Kathryn Thomasset Stolee,Bowen Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对203名AI编码代理使用者的调查发现：即使开发者仔细审查代码，也常常不细审就批准代理操作；代理自主性在开发者间差异大于任务间差异；监管代理仍是心理负担；开发者要求代理可界定、可观测、可回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理不仅生成代码，还会执行shell命令、读取文件等不体现在代码中的动作。开发者需决定委派什么、批准哪些操作，但这种决策方式与所需精力尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 对203名使用AI编码代理的开发者进行问卷调查，分析其代码审查行为、操作批准行为、自主性授予模式、工作负荷感受及对更多自主性的期望条件。

Result: 61%会仔细审查大部分或全部生成代码的开发者，仍经常在未仔细审查的情况下批准至少一类代理操作；了解安全或隐私事件/可疑做法的开发者更常如此。自主性在开发者之间的差异大于不同开发任务之间的差异。开发者虽报告工作负荷变轻，但监管代理依然耗费心力。超过半数的反馈希望代理具有可界定、可观测或可回退特性，而不仅是更可靠。

Conclusion: 随着代理承担更多编码工作，挑战转向如何支持监管代理的开发者：需要帮助开发者有效评估与批准代理操作，并提供可界定、可观测、可回退的代理设计。

Abstract: Developers now collaborate with AI coding agents that write code and take actions on their behalf. Beyond reviewing this code, developers decide what to delegate and which agent actions to approve. Some of these actions, such as running shell commands or reading files, can have effects that never appear in the resulting code. How developers make these decisions and how much effort this requires are not well understood. To better understand this collaboration, we surveyed 203 developers who use AI coding agents. We found that careful code review does not necessarily extend to action approval: 61% of developers who carefully reviewed most or all generated code still often approved at least one type of agent action without close review. Developers aware of security or privacy incidents or concerning practices did so more often than those who were not. We also found that autonomy varied more between developers than between development activities. Although developers reported a lighter workload, supervising agents remained mentally demanding. When asked what would make them grant more autonomy, developers wanted more than reliability: more than half of their responses called for agents that are bounded, observable, or reversible. Our findings suggest that as agents take on more of the coding, the challenge shifts toward supporting the developers who supervise them.

</details>


### [891] [Done Is Not Correct: Measuring Silent Failures and Self-Verification Calibration When LLM Agents Take CAD Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10063)
*Carson Rodrigues,Clive Rodrigues,Aravind Reddy G*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文发布了一个衡量LLM生成参数化CAD代码"语法成功但语义错误"的基准与测试框架，提出并测量"静默失败率"和"完成声明校准"两个新指标，并通过工具化"测量-再声明"流程显著降低静默失败、提升声明精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体从自然语言规格生成参数化CAD代码时，语法成功与语义正确脱钩，现有CAD基准缺乏对"看似成功实则错误"的直接度量，也无静默失败率和完成声明校准的量化指标。

Method: 构建含13个规格任务的基准与测试框架，每个需求映射到B-rep的机器可检查属性，由内核按公布容差带判定，并提供参考解与完整分级尝试语料；自审计oracle提取静默失败率与完成声明校准；跨4厂商4个模型（每架构156次尝试）对比单次生成、强制"测量-再声明"的工具循环、规划-编码-检查流水线，并做消融、置信度校准与oracle加固分析。

Result: 单次agent在98%尝试上声称完成，静默失败率14.1%；工具循环将静默失败降至3.2%、声明精度由64%升至96%，消融显示变化源于声明契约而非反馈；规划-编码-检查以更低覆盖率匹配精度但无成功率增益；单次设置置信度失准(ECE 0.32)，验证下三/四模型变得有信息量；oracle加固使519条复评判决中18条由通过转为失败、无反向；专家盲审在唯一歧义任务之外推翻3/18静默失败；容差带四倍缩放后对比仍成立。

Conclusion: 语义正确性需通过机器可检查的测量而非模型自述完成声明来保证；"测量-再声明"契约是降低静默失败的关键机制，基准、oracle与语料可支撑后续CAD代码生成的可信评估。

Abstract: When a large language model (LLM) agent writes parametric CAD code from a natural-language specification, syntactic success decouples from semantic correctness. We release a benchmark and harness that measure this gap directly: 13 specification tasks whose every requirement maps to machine-checkable properties of the produced B-rep, measured by the kernel against published tolerance bands, with reference solutions and the full graded attempt corpus. The exact, self-audited oracle isolates two quantities no prior CAD benchmark reports: the silent-failure rate (a valid, renderable solid, an explicit completion claim, and at least one failed semantic check) and completion-claim calibration. Across four models from four vendors (156 attempts per architecture), single-shot agents claimed completion on 98% of attempts and were silently wrong on 14.1%; a tool-use loop that enforces measure-then-claim cut silent failures to 3.2% and raised claim precision from 64% to 96%, and a four-model ablation attributes the change to the claim contract rather than the feedback. A planner-coder-checker pipeline matched that precision at lower coverage with no success gain. Stated confidence was miscalibrated single-shot (ECE 0.32) and became informative under verification for three of four models. Hardening our own oracle flipped 18 of 519 regraded verdicts from pass to fail and none in reverse; a blind expert audit overturned 3 of the 18 silent failures outside the one ambiguously specified task; and fourfold scaling of every tolerance band leaves the contrast intact.

</details>


### [892] [Autonomous Code Review: Hidden-Test Results on GitHub Issues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10098)
*Adam Shakhabov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对12个历史GitHub issue（5 C#、5 JavaScript、2 Python）做回顾性基准：由有界终端agent产出初始补丁，再由跨提供方（OpenAI GPT-6.1-Sol 与 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5）模型评审并由作者模型裁决/修订，用同一隐藏评测器检验初稿与终稿。计划48条工作流，完成40条，仅4条通过且均为评审前已通过，无人从失败转为通过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验一个自主的跨提供方代码评审步骤，是否真能改变"为真实issue所写代码"通过隐藏测试的结果，即评审环节对最终正确性的实际增益是否成立。

Method: 回顾性基准设计，12个真实历史issue跨5个仓库、三种语言；两个方向的作者—评审配对（GPT-6.1-Sol与Claude Sonnet 5.5），每issue各跑两次，共48条计划工作流。流程为：有界终端agent生成初始补丁→跨提供方模型评审→作者模型对发现项裁决并可选修订→同一隐藏评测器对初稿和终稿分别打分。

Result: 48条计划中40条完成，8条在获得完整评测结果前终止；完成的40条里4条通过，且这4条在评审前就已通过；完成的工作流中未出现任何从失败到通过（或反向）的通过/失败状态转换。

Conclusion: 在所测设置下，跨提供方自主评审步骤并未改变隐藏测试的通过结果——仅观察到保持型（通过者仍通过），无一例修复失败案例；评审对最终正确性的可测增益为零。样本量小（12个issue、40条完成工作流）且存在提前终止，需谨慎外推。

Abstract: Can an autonomous cross-provider review step change whether code written for a real issue passes hidden tests? We report a retrospective benchmark of 12 historical GitHub issues (five C#, five JavaScript, and two Python) from five repositories. Two directed author--reviewer pairs, OpenAI GPT-6.1-Sol and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5, each ran twice per issue, yielding 48 planned workflows. A bounded terminal agent produced an initial patch; a cross-provider model reviewed it; the author model adjudicated findings and could revise the patch. The same hidden evaluator assessed initial and final patches. Forty workflows completed, while eight terminated before a complete evaluator outcome. Four completed workflows passed, and all four already passed before review. No initial-to-final pass/fail transitions occurred among completed workflows.

</details>


### [893] [Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10304)
*Vladimir Dobrovolskii,Ibragim Badertdinov,Alexander Golubev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 Longtail-SWE，一个覆盖 13 种小众编程语言、共 202 个 issue 解决任务的仓库级基准，并用 solver–judge–repairer 流水线构建高质量任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级基准覆盖的编程语言生态有限；在小众语言中，候选任务稀缺且常因描述模糊或测试缺陷被过滤掉，导致大量有价值的工程问题被误弃。

Method: 构建 202 个任务、覆盖 Clojure、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、F#、Haskell、Julia、Kotlin、Lua、OCaml、R、Scala、Swift 等 13 种语言。采用 solver–judge–repairer 流水线：solver 尝试解题，judge 结合解题轨迹与测试结果审查任务，指导修复测试与任务描述，从而剔除错误拒绝合法实现或错误接受错误解的测试，同时保留任务难度与原始要求。

Result: 评测九种模型配置（含前沿模型），分析任务解决性能、重复尝试的一致性与资源消耗，并公开全部基准实例、可执行环境、完整构建与评测工具、agent 轨迹，以及一组更简单的任务以供小模型评测。

Conclusion: Longtail-SWE 扩展了仓库级基准的语言覆盖，并通过可修复式构建流程保证任务质量，为小众语言生态下的代码智能体评测提供开放资源。

Abstract: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems. We introduce Longtail-SWE, a benchmark of 202 issue-resolution tasks across 13 languages with limited coverage in existing repository-level benchmarks: Clojure, Dart, Elixir, Erlang, F#, Haskell, Julia, Kotlin, Lua, OCaml, R, Scala, and Swift. Its construction uses a solver--judge--repairer pipeline: a solver attempts each candidate task, and a judge reviews the task together with the solver's trajectory and test results to guide revisions to tests and task descriptions. These revisions aim to correct tests that reject valid alternative implementations or accept incorrect solutions while retaining challenging tasks and preserving their intended requirements. We evaluate nine model configurations, including frontier models, and analyze task-solving performance, consistency across repeated attempts, and resource usage. We release all benchmark instances, executable environments, complete construction and evaluation tooling, and agent trajectories, together with an additional set of easier tasks to support evaluation of smaller models.

</details>


### [894] [Retention Horizons of Volatile Stores in iOS and Android Extractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10309)
*Daniel Kwaku Ntiamoah Addai,Sanders Larweh Tetteh,Selorm Adjabeng,Kingsley Albert Egyir*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统测量了iOS与Android各类数据存储的"留存视界"，发现视界因存储机制差异从数分钟到数年不等，并指出单设备测试与"最早记录"存在误导风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 取证中能否回答"某一天的"问题取决于各存储可回溯的时间范围，但公开说法常基于单台测试设备，缺乏跨机制、跨平台的系统测量。

Method: 对48份完整文件系统提取和7份bug报告，测量8个iOS与7个Android存储的留存视界（最旧记录到采集时刻的时长），仅保留时钟与采集时间一致的设备（26台Apple、13台Android手机），并按各自存储的边界机制进行对照分析。

Result: 视界从数分钟到数年，遵循各存储的边界机制：unified log Persist流中位2.5天；interactionC在25台中18台达166–170天；Android各存储符合源码限制（usage statistics 10.2天、DropBox 3.1天、通知1.5天）；bug报告日志最多3.1小时。"最旧记录"三次误导：某knowledgeC流回溯两年而其余中位29天；脱离WAL读取interactionC在18/25台显示更旧记录；7份bug报告中4份顶部有最长16.6天的杂散旧行。

Conclusion: 留存视界属于具体存储、具体版本与具体设备的属性，不可用单一设备或单条最旧记录外推；取证结论需按存储机制分别评估。

Abstract: Whether an extraction can answer a question about a given day depends on how far back each store reaches, yet public statements rest on single test devices. We measured the retention horizon, the time from a store's oldest retained record to acquisition, for eight iOS and seven Android stores on 48 full file system extractions and seven bug reports, keeping devices whose clock agreed with the acquisition time (26 Apple devices, 13 Android phones). Horizons ranged from minutes to years and followed the mechanism that bounds each store. The unified log Persist stream reached a median of 2.5 days; interactionC reached 166 to 170 days on 18 of 25 devices. Android stores stayed within their source-code limits (usage statistics 10.2 days, DropBox 3.1, notifications 1.5); bug-report logs reached 3.1 hours at most. The oldest record misled three times: one knowledgeC stream reached back two years, the others a median of 29 days; interactionC read without its write-ahead log showed older records on 18 of 25 devices; and four of seven bug reports began with stray lines up to 16.6 days old above a body of 3.1 hours or less. A horizon belongs to a store, a release and a device.

</details>


### [895] [Device-Life Boundary Indicators and the Classification of Restored Versus Native Records on Android](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10312)
*Daniel Kwaku Ntiamoah Addai,Selorm Adjabeng,Kingsley Albert Egyir,Sanders Larweh Tetteh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 手机屏幕上的日期并不代表设备本身的使用起点；本文测量了14份Android全文件系统镜像、7份错误报告和33份iOS镜像中各类痕迹所确定的"设备生命起点"，发现首次开机证据与用户设置证据之间能相差中位数98天，且大量消息日期早于首次开机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机展示多年前的通话、消息和照片，可能是近期才设置并从旧手机迁移过来的，因此屏幕日期无法界定设备本身的生命周期。哪些痕迹能确定这一起点、各痕迹间一致性如何、以及可见内容中有多少早于起点，此前均未被测量。

Method: 读取14份Android全文件系统提取（12台三星，Android 10至16）、7份bug报告和33份iOS提取（作为探测）。比较首次开机记录、用户设置证据、迁移工具在消息上留下的creator字段等时间边界，并在合成数据集上验证标注误差与边界误差的关系。

Result: 所有Android设备均记录了首次开机，但首次用户设置证据中位数晚98天（0–563天）。13台含消息的设备中7台存在早于首次开机的消息，其中5台为多数；系统镜像外的应用中24%以"恢复安装"方式安装。以用户设置为边界可召回46,968条迁移消息中的46,967条，首次开机边界仅94%–100%。合成数据上标注误差随边界误差变化。

Conclusion: 只有当一条记录被证明是在该设备上创建的，其日期才能用于确定设备时间线；首次开机并非可靠的生命起点边界，应优先采用用户设置等更晚的边界。

Abstract: A phone that shows calls, messages and photographs from years ago may have been set up recently and carried them over from an earlier handset, so its screen dates do not date the device's own life. Which traces fix where that life begins, how well they agree and how much of what is visible predates it is unmeasured. We read 14 Android full file system extractions (12 Samsung; Android 10 to 16), seven bug reports and 33 iOS extractions (a probe). Every Android device recorded a first boot, but the first evidence of user setup came a median of 98 days later (0 to 563). Of the 13 devices with messages, 7 held some dated before the first boot, a majority of them on 5; 24% of the apps outside the system image were installed as restored. Against the creator field that a migration tool leaves on messages, a boundary at user setup recalled all but 1 of 46,968 such messages, the first-boot boundary 94 to 100%. On synthetic fixtures, the labelling error followed the boundary error. A date on a record dates the device only once the record is shown to have been created on it.

</details>


### [896] [Caleta: An Evidence-Oriented Trust Layer for Reproducible Local Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10324)
*Joan-Marc Fisa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Caleta 是一个围绕 llama.cpp 的 Apache-2.0 进程监管与证据层（非新推理引擎），通过版本化清单、制品校验、受限代理与无提示词执行记录等机制，将"隐私/可复现/可验证"拆解为显式契约；在 Windows CPU 上用 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 完成真实端到端验证，并给出描述性性能数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地 LLM 推理常被笼统声称"私有、可验证、可复现"，但未区分这些说法背后的技术含义。作者希望把完整性、来源认证、隐私控制与操作系统隔离等概念分开，并以显式契约的形式落地，避免概念混淆与过度承诺。

Method: 以 llama.cpp 为推理引擎，构建进程监管与证据层：版本化 manifest、精确大小 + SHA-256 校验、受控后端构建、受限的 OpenAI 兼容代理、无提示词执行记录、基准报告及小型一致性（conformance）测试套件。评估方式包括静态检查、22 个单元测试、Ubuntu/macOS/Windows 的确定性端到端测试，以及 Windows CPU 上固定版本的真实模型实验（Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M，llama.cpp b11981）。

Result: 真实实验验证了制品校验、启动、模型列举、非流式与 SSE 流式对话及一致性测试。三次独立基准调用共产生 15 个成功的 warm 请求、零失败；该配置下 TTFT 中位数 18.066 ms，解码吞吐中位数 54.394 tokens/s。作者明确声明这些数据仅为描述性，不证明跨引擎优越性、输出质量、能效或硬件泛化性能，并公开原始 JSON、命令与环境元数据。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是把若干机制组合成显式契约，从而清晰区分完整性与来源认证、隐私控制与 OS 隔离，而非追求推理性能突破。遗留问题包括签名 manifest、检查/使用时间竞态（TOCTOU）替换、操作系统层隔离、代理开销测量及更广的实验矩阵。

Abstract: Local large language model (LLM) inference is often described as private, verified, or reproducible without separating the technical claims behind those terms. This paper presents Caleta, an Apache-2.0 process supervisor and evidence layer around llama.cpp rather than a new inference engine. Caleta combines versioned manifests, exact-size and SHA-256 verification, controlled backend construction, a restricted OpenAI-compatible proxy, prompt-free execution records, benchmark reports, and a small conformance suite. Its contribution is the composition of these mechanisms into explicit contracts that distinguish integrity from authenticated provenance and privacy controls from operating-system isolation. We evaluate the implementation through static checks, 22 unit tests, deterministic end-to-end tests on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows, and a pinned real-model experiment on Windows CPU using Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M and llama.cpp b11981. The real experiment validates artifact verification, startup, model listing, non-streaming and server-sent-event chat, and conformance. Three independent benchmark invocations produced fifteen successful warm requests with no failures. In this single configuration, median time to first token was 18.066 ms and median decode throughput was 54.394 tokens/s. These descriptive measurements do not establish cross-engine superiority, output quality, energy efficiency, or hardware-general performance. Raw JSON, commands, and environment metadata are published. Remaining challenges include signed manifests, time-of-check/time-of-use replacement, operating-system containment, proxy-overhead measurement, and broader experimental matrices.

</details>


### [897] [Mismeasuring the Life of a Line of Code: Lessons Learned the Hard Way](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10530)
*Pavel Gurov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究120个TypeScript仓库中3250万行代码，指出代码寿命（含AI生成代码）分析中的十种常见方法论陷阱，并给出修正后的结论与检查清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码行寿命研究（包括AI代理写的代码）依赖许多看似技术性的选择：何时算一行"消失"、存活行如何处理、是否合并项目、如何评估模型。这些选择会实质性地影响结论，但常被忽视。

Method: 在120个TypeScript仓库的3250万次代码行"诞生"数据上，针对十个方法学选择，对比"最初/常见做法"与"修正后"的结果，并区分出其中六个是作者自身的错误。

Result: 十个选择全部改变（或将改变）结论：把移动/重写行算作死亡使中位寿命从3.0年降至1.3年；把任何修改算作死亡会掩盖本可预测的结果（项目内一致性从0.71降到0.56）；对观测寿命做回归丢弃四分之三的行；让被重写行保持"在险"使保护效应随年龄增长；行同时诞生与删除，独立性假设导致15个效应中9个虚假显著，按文件划分使一致性从0.61虚高到0.71。修正后：删除依赖行龄和项目，但模型几乎无法在项目内排序（局部修改可排序，0.71）；项目新增行前1%的修改率为基线的2.3倍。

Conclusion: 每种陷阱都留下可识别的症状，作者据此提供了一份检查清单，用于指导更严谨的代码寿命与AI代码评估研究。

Abstract: Studies of how long lines of code live, including lines written by AI agents, rest on choices that look technical: when a line counts as gone, what to do with lines still alive, whether to pool projects, and how to evaluate a model. We studied 32.5 million line births in 120 TypeScript repositories and got several of these choices wrong at first. For ten of them, we compare the result as we first computed it, or as commonly done, with the result after correction. All ten change conclusions, or would have. Six were our own mistakes. Counting moved and rewritten lines as dead shortens a line's median life from 3.0 years to 1.3. Counting any change as a death hides an outcome that can be predicted: within-project concordance falls from 0.71 to 0.56. Regressing observed lifetimes discards three quarters of the lines. Keeping rewritten lines at risk makes protective effects grow with age. Lines are born and removed together, so treating them as independent misleads twice: nine of fifteen effects look significant only under that assumption, and a split by file makes a barely predictable outcome look good (within-project concordance 0.71 instead of 0.61). After the corrections, removal depends on a line's age and project, but our models could barely rank it within a project. Local revision they could rank (0.71). Obvious cases aside, the top 1% of a project's new lines are revised at 2.3 times the base rate. Each pitfall leaves a symptom; we give a checklist.

</details>


### [898] [What extraction cannot slim, and whether function injection can: a pre-registered study of 580 Java repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10545)
*Daniel Sagenschneider*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文检验函数注��（Function Injection）能否拆解单出口抽取法（Extract Method）无法处理的长方法。对580个开源Java仓库、3,026,902个方法（168,466个长方法）的扫描显示：22.8%的长方法无法用单出口抽取简化；预注册假设"其中≥25%只能靠函数注入拆解"被反驳（22.2%，95%CI 20.3–24.3）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Extract Method是长方法的标准修复手段，但存在结构限制：抽取出的片段无法提前return、一个片段只能返回一个值、某些方法被"打结"导致任何切分都被阻断，因而部分长方法无单出口解法。作者希望验证函数注入（OfficeFloor机制：每段成为由框架注入并编排的函数，可提前return、可传多个值）是否能拆解这些"卡死"的方法。

Method: 框架作者预注册假设检验；对580个开源Java仓库（均固定在AI编程助手普及前）做分层随机抽样，用发布版工具（成本模型在抽样前已固定）扫描3,026,902个方法，其中168,466个为长方法（≥26行）；并对两类方法都无法拆解的四分之一卡死方法做探索性阅读归类。

Result: 单出口抽取无法简化22.8%的长方法；预注册假设（≥25%的卡死方法只能由函数注入拆解）被反驳，实测22.2%（95%CI 20.3–24.3）。近半卡死方法是提前返回型（计划视为常规可修复），其中四分之三按现状即可被拆分。在抽取可行的场景，注入方案成本更低：对比"抽取包成单一函数"为29.0%，对比普通抽取为17.2%，且几乎都是函数直序列。探索性阅读发现，两类都无法拆解的方法中约三分之一是表格与字面量（因数据而非逻辑而长），其余多被循环内的跳转、过大无法切分的嵌套语句或值过多所阻断。

Conclusion: 函数注入并非抽取法的普遍替代品，但在成本上常有优势，尤其对提前返回型方法；仍有约四分之一卡死方法两者皆无法拆解，主要源于数据密集或结构性障碍。作者提出三项后续注册研究：将方法类别写成工具规则、按类别细化、以及在AI辅助编写代码上重复相同度量。

Abstract: A method of 26 code lines or more reads as a Long Method, and Extract Method is the usual fix. Some long methods have no single-exit fix: a return cannot leave an extracted piece, a piece hands back one value, and some methods are knotted so that every cut is blocked. Function injection, as the OfficeFloor framework does it, cuts differently: each piece becomes a function the framework injects and sequences, an early return ends a function, and a function hands on several values. The framework's author pre-registered a test of whether it takes apart what extraction cannot. A stratified random sample of 580 open-source Java repositories, each pinned before AI coding assistants were in general use, was scanned by released tools whose cost models were fixed before the sample was drawn: 3,026,902 methods, 168,466 of them long. Single-exit extraction cannot slim 22.8% of the long methods. The registered hypothesis, that at least a quarter of those stuck methods are ones only function injection takes apart, is refuted: 22.2% (95% CI 20.3 to 24.3). Nearly half of the stuck methods are early-return methods the plan counts as conventionally fixable, and the split takes three in four of those apart as they stand. Where extraction would do, the split chooses injection and costs less for 29.0% against extraction wrapped as one function and 17.2% against plain extraction, almost always as a straight sequence of functions. An exploratory reading of the quarter of the stuck methods that neither takes apart finds a third of it tables and literals, long for their data rather than their logic, and most of the rest blocked by a jump inside a loop, by a nested statement too large to cut, or by values too many for any cut. Three registered studies are proposed: the classes as rules in the tools, a refinement per class, and the same measures on code written with AI assistants.

</details>


### [899] [Safe by Accident: Crash-Testing LLM-Written Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10585)
*Afridi Mahmud,Md. As-Aid Rahman,Rifat Shahriyar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LLM写成的后端代码在"单次运行、单环境"评估中表现出的崩溃安全性，很大程度上来自sqlite3库的默认事务机制，而非代码本身的设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码评测只运行一次、只在单一环境下运行，只要通过即给分，这种"信用"可能属于运行环境而非代码本身，因此需检验LLM写的数据库代码在更严格的事务配置下是否仍具崩溃安全性。

Method: 在每次数据库、文件、邮件调用前注入崩溃并模拟操作员重跑，在Python sqlite3的两种事务模式（默认 vs. autocommit）下对比；覆盖10个模型、24个后端任务、9,100个解法，并测试提示模型连接处于autocommit模式、以及显式要求崩溃安全（crash safety）的效果。

Result: 默认模式下通过全部崩溃的数据库代码中，54%在autocommit模式下半更新（每个模型均如此），包括看似事务实则无事务的 conn: 块；告知autocommit对本地代码模型无影响，API模型不安全比例降30个百分点；要求崩溃安全对所有模型都有帮助，强模型能修复几乎所有不安全代码，但常只在被要求时才写出安全代码。

Conclusion: LLM数据库代码表面的崩溃安全性多来自库的默认事务而非自身设计，单次单环境评估会系统性高估其鲁棒性，需用更严苛配置的二次测试加以区分。

Abstract: Evaluations of LLM-written code run it once, in one environment, and credit the code with whatever passes. We show that this credit can belong to the environment. We crashed LLM-written backend code just before each database, file and email call, re-ran it as an operator would, and judged the result under two transaction modes of Python's sqlite3: the default, in which the library quietly opens a transaction, and autocommit, in which it does not. Across 9,100 solutions from ten models on 24 backend tasks, more than half (54%) of the database code that survives every crash in the default mode is left half-updated in autocommit mode. This holds for every model, and it hides in ordinary code, including with conn: blocks that look like transactions but open none. Telling the model that its connection is in autocommit mode does not change what the local code models write, while the API models' unsafe share falls by 30 points. Asking for crash safety helps every model, and strong models repair nearly all unsafe code, but often write safe code only when asked. Thus, much of the crash safety that LLM-written database code appears to have is borrowed from the library rather than designed into it, and a second test under a less forgiving configuration reveals the difference.

</details>


### [900] [SIExBench: A Benchmark for Automated Repair of Sensitive Information Exposure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10776)
*Mingming Zhang,Xu Wang,Jian Zhang,Dihao Fan,Xiangxin Meng,Chunming Hu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出SIExBench，首个专门针对敏感信息暴露(SIEx)缺陷自动修复的基准，含161个执行验证实例，最佳修复系统仅解决39.1%，且62.1%的失败尝试产生"看似有效但仍暴露信息"的不完整补丁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件系统常处理凭据、个人记录等敏感信息，SIEx缺陷可导致严重且不可逆的泄露。但已有研究多聚焦于"检测"而非"修复"，且现有仓库级问题修复基准未专门覆盖此类缺陷，缺少系统评估自动修复能力的平台。

Method: 构建SIExBench基准：从64个广泛使用的Python/Java仓库中收集161个执行验证的实例，每个实例包含问题报告、缺陷版本快照、开发者补丁、可执行的暴露测试与回归测试以及缺陷特征标注。随后用3个LLM驱动6种修复系统（共18种配置）进行评测，系统分析整体效果、按缺陷特征的性能及失败机制。

Result: 最强配置仅解决39.1%的实例，40.4%的实例被全部18种配置均未能解决；更关键的是，62.1%的失败尝试生成了仍留有敏感信息暴露的有效补丁，说明暴露清除不彻底是核心挑战。系统常生成看似合理、改动了相关代码却未完全消除暴露的补丁。

Conclusion: 有效修复必须确保关闭所有通往敏感信息暴露的相关路径。SIExBench为系统评估与推进SIEx缺陷自动修复研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Modern software systems routinely process credentials, personal records, and other sensitive information. A sensitive information exposure (SIEx) defect makes such information accessible to an unauthorized actor and can cause serious and often irreversible disclosure. However, prior research has focused largely on detecting such exposures rather than repairing the underlying defects, and existing repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks do not specifically target this defect class. We present SIExBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to automated repair of SIEx defects. SIExBench contains 161 execution-verified instances from 64 widely used Python and Java repositories, each with an issue report, buggy repository snapshot, developer patch, executable exposure and regression tests, and defect characterization.
  We evaluate six repair systems with three LLMs, yielding 18 configurations, and systematically analyze their overall effectiveness, performance across defect characteristics, and failure mechanisms. The strongest configuration resolves only 39.1% of the instances, while 40.4% remain unresolved by all 18 configurations. More importantly, 62.1% of unsuccessful attempts produce a valid patch that still leaves sensitive information exposed, making incomplete exposure removal a central challenge. Systems often generate plausible patches and modify relevant code without fully eliminating the exposure, indicating that effective repair must ensure that all relevant paths to sensitive-information exposure are closed. Overall, SIExBench provides a foundation for systematically evaluating and advancing automated repair of sensitive information exposure defects.

</details>


### [901] [Patch correctness in automated program repair: A five-dimensional evidence framework and cross-benchmark audit from classical repair to coding agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10837)
*Shuai Wu,Yanna Feng,Yufang Li,Xue Li,Zhijun Wang,Bolun Liu,Weilin Cai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出五维证据画像与报告协议，审计测试反馈如何支撑修复补丁正确性主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试是自动程序修复的核心反馈，但"测试通过"常被等同于"补丁正确"，报告口径不一致，需系统性审计。

Method: 构建39个基准与评估工件（32篇主要实证研究、1份机构技术审计、6个分类基线）的审计数据集，对33项主要贡献按五维编码：测试来源与暴露、行为范围、预言基准与依赖、执行完整性、标签裁定；并做四个对比审计案例。

Result: 改变候选群体、预言规则或执行预算会显著改变报告检出率；增加测试可暴露遗漏故障，但也会误拒有效替代补丁或在固定预算下降低正确修复产出。

Conclusion: 仓库级审计需区分问题复现与补丁判别、自动差异检测与需求裁定；提出保留不确定判断、并同时记录验证成本与故障检出/有效补丁保留的报告协议。

Abstract: Tests guide automated program repair and determine which candidate patches are reported as successful. Repository-level coding agents extend this feedback loop by generating tests and revising code after observing execution results. This technical report introduces a five-dimensional evidence profile and reporting protocol to audit how test observations support patch-correctness claims across classical repair systems and coding agents. We assemble an audit dataset of 39 benchmark and evaluation artifacts: 32 primary empirical studies, one institutional technical audit, and six prior taxonomic baselines. We code the 33 primary contributions along five dimensions: test provenance and exposure, behavioral scope, oracle basis and dependence, execution integrity, and label adjudication. The central distinction separates checks visible during repair search from evidence reserved for final assessment. Four worked comparative audits show how changed candidate populations, oracle rules, or execution budgets alter reported detection rates. Additional tests can expose missed faults while rejecting valid alternatives or reducing correct-repair yield under a fixed budget. Repository-level audits separate issue reproduction from candidate-patch discrimination and distinguish automated discrepancy detection from requirements-based adjudication. An evidence matrix links each coded decision to supporting passages and records shared benchmark ancestry. We specify a reporting protocol for repair benchmarks and maintenance pipelines that retains uncertain judgments and records validation cost alongside fault detection and valid-patch retention.

</details>


### [902] [Hybrid Source Code Change Impact Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10958)
*Katharina Stengg,Christian Macho,Martin Pinzger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文构建了人工标注的变更影响分析数据集（263个提交、22个Java项目、1,931个变更实体），并提出结合静态影响分析与LLM推理的katIA方法（单提示katIA-SP与三智能体katIA-MA），CE匹配F1最高达33.3%，较SOTA提升约2个百分点以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIA方法普遍存在精度或召回率偏低的问题，增加开发者人工验证负担；同时多数方法所用数据集与实验设置存在偏差，导致报告结果不可靠。

Method: 首先人工标注263个提交中的1,931个变更代码实体以弥补数据集缺陷；随后提出katIA，将静态影响分析作为初筛，再用LLM做精化：katIA-SP使用单一提示精化初始静态影响集，katIA-MA使用三个专门化智能体；并在自建数据集上对比三种LLM。

Result: katIA-SP+Gemini 2.5 Flash的F1为FQN匹配22.4%、CE匹配27.0%（较SOTA提升2.0个百分点）；katIA-MA进一步提升至FQN 29.1%、CE 33.3%。代价是生成时间中位数从0.570s增至11.214s、token从1,235增至6,462。Gemini 2.5 Flash在三种LLM中最稳定。

Conclusion: 静态影响分析与LLM精化相结合（尤其多智能体变体）可有效提升代码变更影响分析性能，性能提升值得额外开销。

Abstract: Change impact analysis (CIA) helps developers identify code entities impacted by their initial changes. While several approaches for CIA were proposed, they still struggle with either low precision or low recall, thereby increasing manual effort for developers to verify the results. Furthermore, limitations in the used datasets and experimental setups can bias the results reported by many CIA approaches. In this paper, we first address the dataset limitations by manually labeling 1,931 changed code entities stemming from 263 commits of 22 open-source Java projects. Next, we introduce two variants of katIA, our code change impact analysis approach that combines static impact analysis with the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The first variant uses a single prompt (katIA-SP) for refining an initial static impact set while the second variant uses three specialized agents (katIA-MA). The evaluation with our curated dataset shows that katIA-SP with Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved an F1-score of 22.4% when matching impacted entities by their fully qualified names (FQN) and 27.0% when matching them by their class and entity names (CE). The latter shows an improvement of 2.0 percentage points over the state-of-the-art. This score is further improved by katIA-MA which, using Gemini 2.5 Flash, yields an FQN-matching F1-score of 29.1% and a CE-matching F1-score of 33.3%. While these improvements come at the cost of increased median generation time from 0.570 s to 11.214 s and median token usage from 1,235 to 6,462 tokens, the improved performance justifies the additional cost. The comparison of three LLMs using katIA-SP finds that Gemini 2.5 Flash is the most consistent model. These results indicate that combining static impact analysis with LLM-based refinement, particularly with the multi-agent variant, can improve code change impact analysis.

</details>


### [903] [Advancements in Cloud-Native Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study of Reliability and Scalability across Cloud-Native, Edge-Native and AI-Enabled Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11040)
*Shrinivass Arunachalam Balasubramanian*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 一项遵循PRISMA 2020的系统映射研究，检索筛选出2017–2026年的1,794篇一次研究与95篇二次研究，按13类分类法归类并做五级证据分级，发现可靠性证据以原型/试验床为主（66.2%），生产级证据集中在少数方向，边缘原生系统、共享韧性基准与可靠智能体运维是主要空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云原生系统已扩展到网络边缘并承载AI负载（含AI智能体），但关于其可靠性与可扩展性的证据分散且质量不均，缺乏系统性的证据梳理与分级评估。

Method: 采用PRISMA 2020系统映射流程：2026年10月11日进行5次OpenAlex检索（云原生系统、边缘AI、面向运维的智能体AI、智能体应用可靠性、物理AI），另补充早期探索检索的189条记录；去除301条重复并应用自动同行评审venue规则后，对4,611条记录按书面标准与五级相关性量表筛选；纳入1,794篇一次研究与95篇二次研究，所有决策公开于Dataset S1；每篇一次研究归入13类分类法，并按模拟、原型/试验床、生产数据、生产部署、不可判定五级证据评级。

Result: 在1,003篇证据等级可判定的研究中，66.2%使用原型或试验床，18.0%为模拟，仅15.8%使用生产数据或生产部署。93篇核心综合研究显示：级联故障预防、基于trace/图的根因分析、预测性自动扩缩容已有生产部署，冷启动缓解有生产trace评估；边缘可靠性与物理AI主要依赖模拟和试验床；AI智能体可靠性采用工具锚定诊断、显式安全属性、trace驱动修复与负载感知调度，但实证研究表明智能体框架仍较脆弱。

Conclusion: 结论仅限于所记录的文献语料。主要空白为边缘原生系统的生产级证据、共享韧性基准以及可靠的智能体运维。

Abstract: Cloud-native systems now extend to the network edge and host artificial-intelligence (AI) workloads, including AI agents, but evidence on their reliability and scalability is scattered and uneven. We report a PRISMA 2020 systematic mapping study with an evidence-graded synthesis. Five logged OpenAlex searches on 11 October 2026 covered cloud-native systems, edge AI, agentic AI for operations, reliability of agentic applications and physical AI; 189 records from an earlier exploratory search were added separately. After 301 duplicate removals and an automated peer-review venue rule, 4,611 records were screened against written criteria and a five-level relevance scale. The review includes 1,794 primary studies from 2017-2026 and 95 secondary studies, with every decision released in Dataset S1. Each primary study was assigned to a 13-category taxonomy and graded as simulation, prototype or testbed, production data, production deployment, or not determinable from the abstract. Of 1,003 studies with a determinable level, 66.2% used prototypes or testbeds, 18.0% simulations and 15.8% production data or deployments. A 93-study synthesis core, appraised from indexed abstracts, shows production deployments of cascading-failure prevention, trace- and graph-based root-cause analysis and predictive autoscaling, and production-trace evaluations of cold-start mitigation. Edge reliability and physical AI rely mainly on simulations and testbeds. AI-agent reliability uses tool-grounded diagnosis, explicit safety properties, trace-driven repair and workload-aware scheduling, while empirical studies show that agent frameworks remain fragile. Conclusions are limited to the documented corpus. The principal gaps are production evidence for edge-native systems, shared resilience benchmarks and dependable agentic operations.

</details>


### [904] [Application-Defined Abstractions to Separate Numerical Intent from Computation Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11100)
*Elena Aschmann,Anshu Dubey,Mohamed Wahib,Jens Domke*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出以"不可变核心算术组件"隔离数值意图的思路，借助大语言模型辅助生成周边代码，将Flash-X中的Spark流体求解器降至具体实现，验证了LLM生成代码可正确且性能可移植。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC领域希望将数学形式的数值算法转译为跨平台高性能代码，但现有可移植性框架仍要求代码遵循框架惯用法且需大量重构；LLM虽可自动化生成代码，却缺乏正确性保证。

Method: 改变问题提法：先将代码的数值意图表达为与周边代码隔离的不可变核心算术组件，使周边代码可由LLM安全生成。以Flash-X中的Spark可压缩流体力学求解器为案例，用LLM辅助设计抽象并嵌入求解器；经正确性验证后，用同样由LLM辅助构建的工具确定性地降低为具体实现，数值驱动与应用接口代码由LLM生成。

Result: 生成的求解器在Flash-X中以及为实验搭建的独立环境中均得到运行验证，结果表明该方法能产出正确且性能可移植的代码。

Conclusion: 通过将不可变核心算术组件与LLM生成的周边代码分离，可在保证正确性的同时实现性能可移植性，是一条可行路径。

Abstract: In High-performance Computing the holy grail has been to translate numerical algorithms expressed in mathematical notation into code that performs well across a range of platforms. A variety of portability frameworks have abstracted data layout, parallelization and orchestration from application's view, however, the resulting format is still code that conforms to the idioms of the framework. Additionally, substantial refactoring is typically needed to achieve performance goals. Increasing sophistication of Large Language Models (LLMs) naturally raises the question whether they can be used to make application codes and/or solvers both portable and performant. The obstacle is the lack of correctness guarantee in LLM produced code. In this paper we pose the question differently -- can we start with expressing numerical intent of the code into an immutable core arithmetic component isolated from the surrounding code such that the surrounding code can be safely generated by the LLMs? We answer this question by using Spark, a mature compressible hydrodynamics solver in Flash-X, a multiphysics software system. We use LLM assistance in devising the abstractions and embedding them in the solver. Once properly verified, the resulting solver is lowered to concrete realization deterministically with tools also built with LLM assistance. The driver of the numerics and the code for interfacing with the application are generated by the LLMs. The resulting solver is exercised within Flash-X and with a separate environment we built for this experiment. Our results show that this is a viable approach for producing correct and performance portable code.

</details>


### [905] [Beyond Code Translation: Agentic Android-to-HarmonyOS Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11192)
*Yinghang Ma,Wuyang Dai,Song Wang,Filipe Cogo,Zhen Ming,Jiang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: A2HTrans：一种面向 Android→HarmonyOS 端到端应用迁移的智能体框架，通过功能感知任务分解、依赖排序、工具增强验证与迭代修复，提升项目级迁移的完整性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的迁移方法主要在方法或文件级别翻译代码，忽视项目级依赖与工作流协同；同时 ArkTS 资源稀缺、迁移后应用缺少足够测试，导致端到端迁移易出错。

Method: 将应用分解为功能感知的迁移任务，基于依赖分析确定优先级，并在统一执行流程中编排翻译、验证与迭代修复；采用工具增强验证策略，结合编译器语法检查、LLM 语义验证与自动修复。

Result: 在 14 个不同规模与领域的 Android 应用上（底层模型 Claude-Sonnet-4.6），相比 Claude Code，功能完整性提升 8.3%，行为正确性提升 8.0%，迁移时间减少 28.8%。

Conclusion: 结构化的智能体执行流程能显著提升项目级跨平台软件迁移的可靠性与效率。

Abstract: Migrating Android applications to HarmonyOS is an important yet challenging software engineering task. Existing large language model (LLM)-based migration approaches primarily translate code at the method or file level, overlooking project-wide dependencies and workflow coordination. Moreover, ArkTS, the primary language for HarmonyOS, is relatively low-resource, and migrated applications often lack sufficient tests for reliable verification, making end-to-end migration error-prone. We present A2HTrans, an agentic framework for end-to-end Android-to-HarmonyOS application migration. Rather than performing isolated code translation, A2HTrans decomposes applications into functionality-aware migration tasks, prioritizes them through dependency analysis, and orchestrates translation, validation, and iterative repair within a unified execution workflow. To improve migration reliability, A2HTrans employs a tool-augmented verification strategy that combines compiler-based syntax checking with LLM-based semantic validation and automated repair. We evaluate A2HTrans on 14 Android applications spanning diverse sizes and domains using Claude-Sonnet-4.6 as the underlying migration model. Compared with Claude Code, A2HTrans preserves 8.3% more functional completeness, improves behavioral correctness by 8.0%, and reduces migration time by 28.8%. These results demonstrate that structured agentic execution substantially improves the reliability and efficiency of project-level cross-platform software migration.

</details>


### [906] [NumericalDiff: Numerical Program Differencing via Value-Based Trace Alignment and Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11213)
*Xiang Chen,Huanhuan Xia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NumericalDiff 是一种基于执行的方法，通过记录赋值级数值事件、用容差感知的最长公共子序列对齐执行轨迹，并可选进行单点中间值替换后的重执行，来诊断同一计算任务不同实现间的数值差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一计算任务的不同数值程序（因执行栈、程序表示或程序逻辑不同）会产生不同数值行为，而仅比较源文本和最终输出诊断信息有限：数值差异会沿对应计算传播，不同执行也可能产生相同输出，因此需要更细粒度的诊断手段。

Method: 记录赋值级的数值事件形成执行轨迹；用与变量名、源码位置无关的容差感知最长公共子序列对齐轨迹；可选地将某个中间值替换为对应值后重执行，从而在原始执行与全部单点干预执行中，按字典序最大化匹配事件、最小化未匹配事件。支持 NumPy、PyTorch、JAX、C、C++、Fortran、Octave 等前端。

Result: 在 36 个受控案例、共 675 个配对/输入实例（36 个执行栈、588 个程序表示、51 个程序逻辑）上评估：24 个算子注入实例全部暴露轨迹差异，其中 3 个最终输出在容差内相等；441 个规范跨表示实例全部实现完整轨迹对齐；51 个程序逻辑实例中干预改善 24 个对齐，宏平均匹配覆盖率由 0.4210 提升至 0.6513。

Conclusion: 基于值的轨迹对齐与重执行能够界定异构实现间传播的数值差异，表明赋值级事件对齐是诊断数值偏差的有效手段。

Abstract: Numerical programs implementing the same computational task can exhibit different numerical behavior because of their execution stacks, program representations, or program logic. Source text and final outputs alone provide limited diagnostic information: numerical differences can propagate through corresponding computations, while distinct executions can produce equal outputs. We present NumericalDiff, an execution-based method that records assignment-level numerical events, aligns traces using a tolerance-aware longest common subsequence independent of variable names and source locations, and optionally reexecutes after replacing one intermediate value with its counterpart. Among the original and all single-intervention executions, it lexicographically maximizes matched events and minimizes unmatched events. NumericalDiff supports code comparison across language and framework front ends, currently including NumPy, PyTorch, JAX, C, C++, Fortran, and Octave. We evaluate NumericalDiff on 36 controlled cases comprising 675 pair/input instances: 36 execution-stack, 588 program-representation, and 51 program-logic instances. All 24 operator-injection instances expose trace differences, including three with tolerance-equal final outputs, while complete trace alignment is achieved for all 441 canonical cross-representation instances. Within the 51 program-logic instances, intervention improves 24 alignments and raises macro-average matching coverage from 0.4210 to 0.6513. The results show that value-based trace alignment and reexecution can delimit propagated numerical differences across heterogeneous implementations.

</details>


### [907] [Replay Fidelity in LLM Agent Evaluation: Randomness, Hidden State, and Test Oracles in AppWorld](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11216)
*You Liu,Quanchao Lu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文审计AppWorld语料中71个失败执行，用284次隔离定码重放评估重放保真度，揭示"声明设置重放"与"随机数重置重放"间的资格差距源于隐藏的数据库/机制状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体评估的可复现性取决于重放保真度——即执行轨迹中哪些部分被重建、控制与比较。这对智能体调试、失败分析以及有状态工具调用的反事实评估至关重要，但此前缺乏对重放资格的边界性实证刻画。

Method: 对固定历史AppWorld语料中全部71个失败执行进行审计，执行284次隔离的定码重放尝试；采用打印输出、pre-oracle数据库增量与原生判定/测试计数三类校验；在每次交互前重置随机数生成器；开展机制研究（含JWT凭证相等性程序与对齐控制）与一个12例BFCL试点以检验公开状态、返回值与判定检查。

Result: 重放声明设置可通过42例，交互前重置RNG可通过68例；该26例差距在数据库/oracle校验下缩小至4例（1例端点未知）。机制研究发现4处输出与判定一致但实体化状态不一致的情形；一对被允许的端点中相同API调用返回一致但行级效果不同，共用的未来Python RNG在两次配对重复中消除了该确定性差异。JWT凭证相等性程序暴露认证/写入差异。10例受影响的post-oracle导出案例均可通过保留输出追踪器的原生导出恢复参考比较，且不改变原缓存内容。BFCL试点未发现差异。

Conclusion: 本文贡献是对重放资格、隐藏状态与测试判定整合的有界实证刻画，明确不估计调试器准确率、修复收益或方法排序失真；同时保留资源截断与基础设施偏差。研究强调仅凭输出与判定一致不足以确认重放保真，需同时校验机制级状态。

Abstract: Reproducibility in large language model (LLM) agent evaluation depends on replay fidelity: which parts of an execution trace are reconstructed, controlled, and compared. This matters for agent debugging, failure analysis, and counterfactual evaluation of stateful tool use. We audit all 71 unsuccessful executions in a fixed historical AppWorld corpus using 284 isolated fixed-code replay attempts. Reconstructed declared settings admit 42 cases under printed-output, pre-oracle database-delta, and native-verdict/test-count checks; resetting the random-number generator before each interaction admits 68. The 26-case gap contracts to four under database/oracle checks, with one endpoint unknown. Mechanism studies identify four materialized-state discrepancies despite matching outputs and verdicts. In one admitted endpoint pair, an identical API call yields matching responses but different row effects; common future Python RNG removes that deterministic difference in two paired repetitions. A separate JWT credential-equality program and alignment controls expose authentication/write differences, with missing repetitions retained. For all 10 affected post-oracle export cases, native export from retained output trackers restores the reference comparison without changing original cached contents. A purposeful 12-case BFCL pilot shows no discrepancy under its tested public-state, return, and verdict checks. We preserve resource censoring and infrastructure deviations. The contribution is a bounded empirical characterization of replay eligibility, hidden state, and test-oracle integration, without estimating debugger accuracy, repair gains, or method-ranking distortion.

</details>


### [908] [AWS Serverless Infrastructure from WebAssembly Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11293)
*Philipp Vollmer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"从代码生成基础设施"（infrastructure from code）方案，从 WebAssembly 接口类型（WIT）自动派生 AWS 基础设施与权限，并用两个解释器（一个生成 S3 桶定义与最小权限 IAM，一个作为 Lambda 运行时提供 S3 能力），实现代码与基础设施的一致性及基于能力的安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Serverless 应用的基础设施定义与代码常常松散耦合，导致一大类错误：引用的基础设施组件可能并不存在；同时应用与其权限也难以保持同步。

Method: 以 WIT（定义 WebAssembly 组件接口的语言）作为唯一来源来供应云基础设施；限定在"AWS Lambda 函数访问 S3 桶"的基础场景。实现两个 WIT 解释器：其一从 WIT 推导 S3 桶的 IaC 定义与最小权限 IAM 策略；其二为通用运行时，将组件作为 Lambda 运行并通过能力方式暴露 S3 访问。并形式化了一致性属性（桶存在、Lambda 权限正确），给出解释器满足这些属性的证据。

Result: 证明所提解释器满足一致性属性；展示该技术可避免若干云组件部署失败，而基线方案在同一任务上失败；结合 WebAssembly 运行时的严格沙箱，额外获得了针对 AWS 基础设施访问的基于能力的安全实例。

Conclusion: 从代码派生基础设施能消除代码与基础设施/权限脱节的问题，并在沙箱之上形成基于能力的安全模型；当前工作局限于 Lambda+S3 的示例，属于概念验证。

Abstract: The infrastructure definitions and the code for serverless applications are often only loosely connected. This yields a large error class: the referenced infrastructure components might not exist. It is also hard to keep the application and its permissions in sync. To address this problem we present an infrastructure from code solution where we provision cloud infrastructure from Wasm Interface Type (WIT) - the language defining the interface of WebAssembly components. We limit ourselves to the basic example of an AWS Lambda function accessing S3 buckets. We build two interpreters for the WIT language: one that derives the definition of S3 buckets as infrastructure as code and least-privilege IAM permissions, and a generic runtime that runs the component as a Lambda function and provides access to the S3 buckets as capabilities. We formulate consistency properties that ensure the existence of the S3 buckets and correct permissions of the Lambda, and provide evidence that our interpreters satisfy them. We show how selected failures for deployment of such cloud components can be prevented using our technique and how a baseline setup fails at this task. Together with the strict sandboxing of the WebAssembly runtime we achieve an instance of capability-based security for access to AWS infrastructure as a further result.

</details>


### [909] [SWHForest: A Structural Curation and Search Layer for Large-Scale Code Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11439)
*Federico Pennino,Andrea Gurioli,Maurizio Gabbrielli,Paolo Ferragina*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SWHForest 为基于指针的代码语料库提供一个开源的结构化索引层和公开数据集：单遍解析每个文件为 AST 后丢弃源码、仅保留结构摘要，从而支持先用 SQL/索引交集合筛选出匹配文件、再只下载幸存候选，显著降低策展成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练代码模型依赖海量代码语料，但研究者实际只需精选子集（选文档良好的文件、过滤重复样板、审计基准污染、检索特定代码模式）。现代语料库通常只发布文件指针和基本属性而非源文本，缺少通用的结构层来选择下载哪些文件，导致策展子集必须先下载并解析数百万文件、再丢弃其中的绝大部分。

Method: 提出 SWHForest 开源框架与公开数据集，在不重新分发源码的前提下为任意基于指针的语料库提供结构层。对归档做单遍处理：把每个文件解析为 AST，随即丢弃源文本，仅保留结构摘要；查询可本地执行，也可由归档提供方以服务端过滤 API 暴露，通过 SQL 或索引交集先选出匹配文件，只下载存活候选。

Result: 在 Stack-Edu 最大的十种语言上（5210 万个唯一文件、3.41 亿个定义）评测：SWHForest 可在毫秒级回答策展查询，下载量降低 46–72%，并将实时结构检索从按语言逐流式处理的数小时压缩到数秒或数分钟。

Conclusion: SWHForest 填补了指针式代码语料库缺失的结构层，以「先筛选后下载」的方式大幅降低策展成本，且无需重新分发源码，为代码语料库的策展与检索提供了实用、可扩展的基础设施。

Abstract: Pre-training code language models relies on massive code corpora usually streamed over the internet. However, researchers rarely need a multi-terabyte archive in its entirety; instead, their workflow centers on curated subsets: selecting well-documented files, filtering out repetitive boilerplate, auditing for benchmark contamination, or retrieving specific code patterns. Yet, because modern corpora are typically published as file pointers and basic attributes rather than source text, no general structural layer exists to select which files to download: curating a subset requires downloading and parsing millions of files first just to discard most of them. We present SWHForest, an open-source framework and public dataset that provides this missing structural layer for any pointer-based corpus without redistributing source code. A single pass over the archive parses each file into an AST and immediately discards the source text, keeping only its structural summary. Queried locally or exposed by archive providers as a server-side filtering API, SWHForest selects matching files first (via SQL or index intersection) and downloads only surviving candidates. Across the ten largest languages of Stack-Edu (52.1M unique files, 341M definitions), SWHForest answers curation queries in milliseconds while cutting downloads by 46-72%, reducing live structural searches from hours of per-language streaming to seconds or minutes.

</details>


### [910] [MicroSim: Contrastive Graph Neural Networks for Binary Code Similarity Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11486)
*Moussa Moussaoui,Tarik Houichime,Abdelghani Souhar,Abdelalim Sadiq*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MicroSim 用 IDA Pro Hex-Rays 微码构建函数图，并以对比式 Siamese 图神经网络做二进制代码相似性检测；在 TREX 跨优化等级、类不相交划分下取得 0.9972 ROC-AUC 与 0.9762 MCC，优于 Gemini、SAFE、jTrans 及 BoW 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二进制代码相似性检测需要在跨优化等级、且训练/测试不共享函数键的严格条件下仍保持判别力；现有方法（Gemini、SAFE、jTrans）较少在类不相交的跨优化协议下系统比较，且孪生分类与排序检索之间的性能落差缺乏分析。

Method: 1) 以 IDA Pro Hex-Rays 微码为每个函数构建图表示；2) 用对比式 Siamese 图神经网络比较图对；3) 在 TREX 跨优化基准（849,072 个函数级微码图，-O0 至 -O3）上采用类不相交划分评估；4) 对照 Gemini、SAFE、jTrans（同划分重训）与无结构 BoW 基线；5) 分析图 Transformer 上成对分类与排序检索的差距，引入 CSLS 与统一去并列评估；6) 5 个随机种子下比较成对余弦嵌入损失与 InfoNCE 损失。

Result: ROC-AUC 0.9972、MCC 0.9762，高于 Gemini（0.9332）、SAFE（0.9752）、jTrans（0.9740）与 BoW（0.9484）。CSLS 使 GraphGPS 的 MRR 从 0.2542 升至 0.2559（R@1 = 0.1639，R@10 = 0.4561），且严格满足理论 MRR 上界。5 种子等算力下，成对余弦损失 ROC-AUC 略高但不显著（Δ = -0.0256，95% CI [-0.3282, +0.2770]），而 InfoNCE 在阈值化分类与排序检索上显著更好。

Conclusion: 微码图表示加对比式 Siamese GNN 在严格类不相交跨优化协议下达到高相似性检测性能；CSLS 可修正成对分类与检索评估间的偏差，InfoNCE 更适合阈值分类与检索任务，而余弦损失仅在成对 ROC-AUC 上略有优势且不显著。

Abstract: We present MicroSim, a system for binary code similarity detection that represents each function as a graph built from IDA Pro Hex-Rays microcode and compares such graphs with a contrastive Siamese graph neural network (GNN). We evaluate on the TREX cross-optimization benchmark, a corpus of 849,072 function-level microcode graphs spanning optimization levels -O0 through -O3, under a strict class-disjoint split in which no function key is shared between train and test. Under this protocol, MicroSim reaches 0.9972 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and 0.9762 Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), outperforming Gemini (0.9332 ROC-AUC), SAFE (0.9752), and jTrans (0.9740) retrained on the same split, as well as a structure-free Bag-of-Words (BoW) baseline (0.9484). We analyze the gap between pair classification and ranked retrieval in graph transformers, showing that Cross-domain Similarity Local Scaling (CSLS) under unified tie-resolved evaluation raises GraphGPS mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.2542 to 0.2559 (R@1 = 0.1639, R@10 = 0.4561), strictly satisfying the theoretical MRR upper bound. Finally, over 5 seeds with equal compute, the pairwise cosine-embedding loss attains a slightly higher ROC-AUC (Δ = -0.0256, 95% confidence interval [-0.3282, +0.2770]), whereas the supervised-contrastive information noise-contrastive estimation (InfoNCE) loss is significantly better on thresholded classification and ranked retrieval.

</details>


### [911] [CRUSTPairs: A Cross-Language Dataset of Paired C and Rust Solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11711)
*Vojtech Hejlek,Leonardo Jesus Almeida,Alneu de Andrade Lopes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 CRUSTPairs 数据集：1857 对竞赛编程的 C/Rust 整题实现，经规范化、去重、按零样本跨语言嵌入相似度分层，附来源与许可信息；并揭示跨语言检索的难点与微调后的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: C-to-Rust 迁移是活跃议题，但缺少在"同一问题的完整解"层面配对的 C/Rust 数据集，无法支撑跨语言检索与迁移研究。

Method: 从竞赛编程档案中抽取实现对，做规范化与去重，用零样本跨语言嵌入相似度将难度分层，并记录每条数据的来源与许可；以 TF-IDF、预训练代码模型、微调模型三种检索基线评测，并通过重命名全部用户标识符做消融，定位模型依赖的线索。

Result: 共享标识符上的 TF-IDF 达 MRR 0.21，反超预训练代码模型的 0.19；后者在最难四分之一数据上仅为随机水平的 1.7 倍。微调后达 0.79，最难部分提升 10 倍。去掉标识符后微调模型保留 96–97% 准确率，预训练模型仅保留 66%（低于词法基线），且在结构差异大的对上，微调模型无标识符反而更好。

Conclusion: CRUSTPairs 为 C→Rust 跨语言研究提供可追溯基准；结果表明强预训练代码模型在跨语言检索上可能被词法基线击败，而微调学到的是可迁移的结构性知识而非表面标识符。

Abstract: C-to-Rust migration is an active agenda, but no dataset pairs the two languages at the level of whole solutions to a shared problem. We present CRUSTPairs, 1857 C/Rust implementation pairs drawn from competitive programming archives, normalised, deduplicated, and stratified into difficulty tiers by zero-shot cross-language embedding similarity, with perrecord provenance and licensing. Cross-language retrieval is hard on this data, and harder than a single baseline would suggest: TF-IDF over shared identifiers reaches MRR 0.21 and so beats a pretrained code model at 0.19, which on the hardest quarter of the data scores 1.7x chance. Finetuning reaches 0.79, and lifts that hardest quarter 10x. Renaming every user identifier settles what is being learned: the finetuned models keep 96-97% of their accuracy without them, while the pretrained model keeps 66\% - less than the lexical baseline does - and on structurally divergent pairs the finetuned models are better without identifiers than with them.

</details>


### [912] [Decalage: Uncovering the Gap Between Model-Generated Reasoning and Actual Code Implementation in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11721)
*Saif Uddin Mahmud,Afsana Tasnim,Ahmed Ryan,Md Rayhanur Rahman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究小语言模型在"带推理的代码生成"工作流中加入安全指令的效果：安全指令大幅改变推理文本，但代码仅部分改变，推理不能被信任需与代码对照核查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic代码生成常要求模型先解释推理再写代码，加安全指令被视为提升安全性的常见做法；但小模型本地低成本运行有吸引力，安全指令究竟改变了什么尚不清楚。

Method: 用四个1.5B–3B开源代码模型，针对11份公开需求文档的166个章节生成C++，分别使用通用提示与安全提示。测量推理内容（验证、资源处理、威胁）与代码变化（词法检测的检查存在率、stub比例、编译率、推理与代码一致性），并进行两轮编译器反馈修复，用cppcheck与ESBMC检查，另由两名标注者手工核验。

Result: 安全提示使相关推理占比翻倍以上，但未见对含安全内容需求有更大提升；有函数体与推理的函数中含可识别检查的比例从23%升至39%；超四分之一函数仍为stub，编译率低，推理提到检查的函数中一半以上实际无检查；两轮修复后仍有80%以上章节不可用；cppcheck与ESBMC无法在有可用代码上区分两种提示。

Conclusion: 对小模型而言，安全指令广泛改变推理但只部分改变代码，推理应与代码对照核查而非直接信任。

Abstract: Agentic code generation often asks a model to explain its reasoning before it writes code, and a common way to make such a workflow safer is to add a security instruction to the prompt. We test what that instruction does in small language models, which are attractive because they run locally and cheaply. Four open code models of 1.5B to 3B parameters generate C++ from 166 sections of eleven public requirements documents, once with a general prompt and once with a secure prompt. The secure prompt more than doubles the share of reasoning about validation, resource handling and threats, and we find no evidence that the rise is larger for requirements with security content. The code changes only in part. Among functions with a body and reasoning, the share with a check that our lexical test recognises rises from 23% to 39%, but more than a quarter of the functions remain stubs, compile rates stay low, and half or more of the functions whose reasoning mentions a check contain no such check. Two rounds of compiler-feedback repair leave more than 80% of sections unusable, and neither cppcheck nor an exploratory ESBMC run separates the prompts on the usable code. A hand check by two annotators supports the stub measure and the direction of the reasoning result. For small models, a security instruction changes the reasoning broadly but the code only in part, so the reasoning should be checked against the code rather than trusted.

</details>


### [913] [Feeling Easier, Working Harder: Cognitive Load in AI-Assisted Code Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12019)
*Maryangela White,Maximilian Rose,Matthew Buckman,Amy McDonnell,Francisco Ortega,Bianca Trinkenreich*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过3x2被试内实验(n=20)与tDRT实时测量,揭示AI辅助阅读代码会显著增加客观认知负荷(+11.2%反应时)但主观负荷感知无变化,形成"隐性认知成本"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者大量时间用于阅读代码,生成式AI被寄望降低阅读难度,但人机交互本身构成双任务环境,可能引入难以捕捉的额外认知负荷。现有研究缺乏对AI辅助下实时认知工作负荷的客观测量,且自我感知与客观负荷可能失配。

Method: 20名计算机专业新手学生参与3x2被试内研究,阅读不同长度Java代码片段(有/无AI辅助),随后完成无AI的理解测验。阅读与测验阶段均用Detection-Response Task(tDRT)连续采集认知负荷,并与测验后NASA-TLX和SEQ主观量表对比,辅以定性访谈分析理解策略。

Result: AI辅助显著提高客观认知负荷,tDRT反应时增加11.2%,但主观感知负荷无变化。两种条件下理解成绩均较高,未发现AI提升理解的证据(天花板效应限制了检验力)。定性上,参与者对AI"有条件信任":复杂片段会核对AI输出,简单代码直接信任;多数人认为阅读过程未变,但部分人转向略读或以AI解释替代阅读代码本身。

Conclusion: 开发者无法准确感知使用AI工具时投入的认知资源,存在"双任务代价"。研究提示需在软件工程工具与教育设计中显式考虑这一隐性认知成本,并为客观测量认知负荷提供方法参考。

Abstract: Software developers spend significant time reading and understanding code, increasingly supplemented by generative AI. While these tools aim to reduce the difficulty of reading code, interacting with them introduces a dual-task environment that may impose extraneous cognitive load that is challenging to capture. This study investigates how access to generative AI affects developers' real-time cognitive workload, code comprehension performance, and self-perceived code comprehension strategies. We conducted a 3x2 within-subjects study with 20 novice CS students reviewing Java code snippets of varying lengths with or without AI assistance, followed by an AI-unassisted comprehension quiz. Cognitive workload was continuously captured using a Detection-Response Task (tDRT) during both reading and quiz phases, and compared to post-quiz NASA-TLX and SEQ scores. AI assistance significantly increased objective cognitive workload, raising tDRT reaction times by 11.2%, yet participants' perceived workload remained unchanged. Code comprehension scores were high under both conditions, with no evidence that AI assistance improved comprehension at the difficulty levels evaluated; a ceiling effect limited power to detect benefits on harder tasks. Qualitatively, participants reported trusting the AI conditionally -verifying its output against their own reading for more complex snippets, but directly trusting it for simpler code- and, while many felt their reading process was unchanged, a notable subset shifted toward skimming or reading the AI's explanations in place of the code itself. These findings reveal that developers do not accurately perceive the cognitive resources they expend when managing AI tools. This study provides evidence of added cognitive effort associated with using generative AI, pointing towards a need to account for this dual-task penalty in software engineering tools and education.

</details>


### [914] [SWE-Time: Benchmarking Temporal Repository Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12083)
*Shijun Xiao,Xinrong Chen,Hao Liu,Wensheng Zhang,Yongqiang Tang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SWE-Time 基准，把"仓库随时间演化"本身作为推理对象，分回顾性（历史回归分析）与前瞻性（变更前状态下预测意图变更）两个方向，并用 RealWorld-to-Verifiable 框架将真实开发者查询与历史证据转为可验证任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码理解基准把仓库视为静态快照，只扩展推理的"空间范围"（从局部代码到整个仓库），却未探索模型如何理解仓库的"时间演化"。作者认为时间维度是代码理解中一个独立且困难的维度。

Method: 构建 SWE-Time 基准，包含两个互补的时间推理方向：（1）回顾性——通过历史回归分析理解仓库演化；（2）前瞻性——从变更前的仓库状态推断预期变更。同时提出 RealWorld-to-Verifiable Construction Framework，把真实开发者查询与历史证据转成可验证的评测任务。共在 65 个 GitHub 仓库的 1,661 个案例上评估了 15 个编码智能体。

Result: Claude Code 中的 Claude Opus 4.8 取得最高 SWE-Time 平均分 61.9，仍有较大提升空间。受控分析表明历史代码证据与开发者意图都很重要，而跨仓库状态保持一致推理仍然困难。

Conclusion: 结果表明仓库演化是代码理解中一个独特且具有挑战性的维度，现有模型在时间维度上的能力明显不足，为后续研究提供了新的评测方向。

Abstract: Repository-level code-understanding benchmarks have progressively expanded the spatial scope of reasoning, from local code to entire repositories, while largely treating each repository as a static snapshot. However, how models reason about repository evolution over time remains largely unexplored. We introduce SWE-Time, a benchmark for temporal repository understanding that makes repository evolution itself the reasoning target. SWE-Time evaluates two complementary temporal directions: retrospective understanding of repository evolution through historical regression analysis and prospective understanding of intended changes from pre-change repository states. To enable realistic yet reliable evaluation in these settings, we introduce the RealWorld-to-Verifiable Construction Framework, which transforms real-world developer queries and historical evidence into verifiable evaluation tasks. We evaluate 15 coding agents on 1,661 cases from 65 GitHub repositories. Within Claude Code, Claude Opus 4.8 achieves the highest SWE-Time Avg. of 61.9, leaving substantial headroom. Controlled analyses highlight the importance of historical code evidence and developer intent, while consistent reasoning across repository states remains challenging. These results highlight repository evolution as a distinct and challenging dimension of code understanding.

</details>


### [915] [LiveWorkspace: Externalizing Visual Understanding as Persistent Shared State for Screenshot-to-Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12112)
*Shijun Xiao,Zonghui Yang,Xinrong Chen,Hao Liu,Wensheng Zhang,Yongqiang Tang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 LiveWorkspace，将截图到代码中的视觉理解外化为"共享视觉状态"(Shared VS)，统一目标与当前实现的表示，支撑生成-执行-修改全流程，性能与编辑成功率均优于对照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Screenshot-to-Code 任务需要编码智能体在代码生成、执行与迭代修改中持续维持视觉理解，但现有方法缺乏贯穿全流程的一致、可复用的视觉理解载体。

Method: 构建视觉编程 harness：从截图构造 Target、从浏览器执行恢复 Current，二者采用同一实现无关的 schema（视觉层级、节点属性、布局关系）；通过结构化 Diff 与实现绑定指导代码修改；用户编辑则更新 Target 并复用对齐回路。

Result: 相同 GPT-5.2、相同模型调用次数与分阶段预算下，Design2Code 端到端 Avg 提升 1.8 分、ScreenBench 提升 2.0 分；Shared VS 可跨不同编码器复用并改善迭代修复；100 个受控编辑案例中编辑成功率达 93.0%。

Conclusion: 结果支持将视觉理解视为贯穿代码生成、执行与修改的持久共享工作状态。

Abstract: Screenshot-to-Code requires coding agents to sustain visual understanding across code generation, execution, and revision. We introduce LiveWorkspace, a visual coding harness that externalizes this understanding as Shared Visual State (Shared VS), an implementation-independent representation of visual hierarchy, node attributes, and layout relations. LiveWorkspace constructs and retains \textit{Target} from screenshots and recovers \textit{Current} from browser execution in the same schema. Structured Diff and implementation bindings guide code modifications; user edits update \textit{Target} and reuse the alignment loop. Using GPT-5.2 for both methods, LiveWorkspace improves end-to-end Avg by 1.8 points on Design2Code and 2.0 on ScreenBench over a control with matched model-call counts and stagewise budget limits. Further experiments demonstrate reuse of constructed Shared VS across coders and improvements in iterative repair. LiveWorkspace also achieves 93.0\% edit success across 100 controlled editing cases. These findings support treating visual understanding as a persistent shared working state throughout code generation, execution, and modification.

</details>
