### [916] [A Cost That Practice Accuracy Hides: Worked Solutions in Self-Generated Training Data and the Compositional Use of New Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12225)
*Jiantong Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在2B参数推理模型中，仅凭规则表自生成训练目标比"规则表+程序化示例解"更能促进新学规则的组合复用，尽管两者前向准确率相同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 示例解能让自生成训练目标更短更省，但练习操作上的准确率可能掩盖模型能否复用新学规则。作者想探究训练目标来源（仅规则表 vs 含示例解）对规则可组合复用的影响。

Method: 让2B参数模型学习两条人造定量规则；训练目标分别来自"仅规则表"或"规则表+程序编写的示例解"，按最终答案正确性筛选，微调与评估时移除辅助材料。训练题只需单段前向使用，评估则要求同一规则跨两段顺序复用（组合），并用程序校验的数值签名做前瞻测试与独立目标库复现。

Result: 六轮后，仅规则表目标在组合上领先24.3个百分点（CI 14.6–34.0）；未见参数值上前向准确率相同（87.5%），但组合为58.3% vs 23.6%（差34.7点）。第二目标库复现方向（+14.6点）。将短示例解训练增至十轮使差距缩小至16.3点，第二库降至6.2点且预设检验不成立。六轮时示例解策略捕获token更少、更新时间更短，但每次组合成功所需生成token多2.6倍。

Conclusion: 选择捕获上下文时需同时检验新规则如何复用及其推理成本，而非仅依赖前向准确率。

Abstract: A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.

</details>


### [917] [ForgeSystem: An Architecture for Demand-Specific Artefact Production with AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12288)
*Qingfeng He,Zhui Zhu,Yaojian Chen,Shangzhan Li,Leshan Li,Tingjian Zhang,Qian Xie,Yuxuan Li,Xu Han,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"锻造(Forge)"范式：由AI智能体为特定需求定制软件，并给出可复现的生产系统ForgeSystem，在训练框架、解码超核、计算内核三类任务上验证其可行性与收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用软件以牺牲特定需求的性能与效率换取灵活性，而为特定需求定制软件虽能避免这些损失，却需专家投入大量时间精力。AI智能体为按需定制生产软件提供了新可能，但需要一套可重复的生产流程，并需判断经济上是否值得（累计专门化收益超过构建、验证与维护总成本）。

Method: 提出Forge生产范式与ForgeSystem系统，由三部分组成：控制层（决定每项需求由哪个制品服务、是否锻造、何时锻造及起始点）、forge loop（生产与验证迭代直至候选制品通过验证）、RSI递归自我改进循环（利用积累的生产记录提供起始点、优化harness并训练模型）。在训练框架、解码megakernel及单个计算核上实现。

Result: 锻造训练引擎达参考框架模型FLOPs利用率的1.047–1.332倍；锻造megakernel在13种配置下相对SGLang取得几何平均1.21倍解码加速；锻造内核在22种配置中的18种匹配或超过专家库，并满足任务特定质量要求。对照实验表明显式质量要求能引导智能体采取保持训练质量的优化。

Conclusion: 按需锻造可作为一种可重复的软件生产模式，其经济性取决于专门化收益与总成本之比。文中还讨论了通过服务路由逐步过渡到Forge的路径，以及需求定制化生产可能如何使价值积累与信任向生产系统转移。

Abstract: General-purpose software serves many different demands, but this flexibility costs performance and efficiency on any specific demand. Software tailored to a specific demand avoids these losses, yet developing it requires substantial time and effort from human experts. AI agents offer an alternative: they can design, implement and test artefacts tailored to individual demands. We call this production paradigm Forge. Forging for a demand is economically justified when the cumulative benefit of specialisation exceeds the total cost of construction, verification and maintenance. To make Forge a repeatable production process, we propose ForgeSystem, which consists of a control layer, a forge loop and a recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop. The control layer selects which artefact serves each demand and decides which demands to forge, when to forge them and from which starting point; the forge loop iterates between production and verification until a candidate artefact passes verification; and the RSI loop draws on accumulated production records to supply starting points, refine the harness and train models. We implement ForgeSystem for training frameworks, decoding megakernels and individual computational kernels. Forged training engines reach 1.047-1.332x the model-FLOPs utilisation of their reference frameworks, forged megakernels achieve a geometric-mean decoding speedup of 1.21x over SGLang across thirteen configurations, and forged kernels match or exceed expert libraries in eighteen of twenty-two configurations, while satisfying task-specific quality requirements. Controlled comparisons show that explicit quality requirements steer agents towards optimisations that preserve training quality. We also discuss a gradual transition to Forge through service routing, and how demand-specific production may shift value accumulation and trust towards production systems.

</details>


### [918] [From Formal Methods to Fuzzing and Back](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12338)
*Alastair F. Donaldson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 作者回顾从形式化方法转向模糊测试的个人历程，通过GPUVerify与GraphicsFuzz两个项目探讨二者以oracle问题为思想纽带的关系，并提出Keystone项目探索大规模形式化方法的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化方法虽能提供数学保证但难以扩展，而模糊测试虽缺乏原则性却实用高效。作者希望厘清二者的联系，并探索生成式AI能否帮助形式化方法真正规模化。

Method: 个人叙述式研究，结合GPUVerify（GPU内核验证）与GraphicsFuzz（GPU编译器随机化测试）项目经历，以oracle问题为线索分析形式化方法与模糊测试的边界工作。

Result: 模糊测试可应用于大型系统并有效发现真实bug；oracle问题为二者提供了理论连接；在GPU语言设计中仍有针对性地使用形式化方法。

Conclusion: 形式化方法与模糊测试并非对立，可互补结合；生成式AI或成为形式化方法规模化的关键，通过Keystone项目验证其实际可实现程度。

Abstract: For the first twelve years of my career in computer science I mainly worked on formal methods. I had been drawn to the field as an undergraduate by its promise of a way to build software with strong, mathematically based correctness guarantees. But after many years of struggling to make formal methods scale, I was seduced by randomised testing---also known as fuzzing. Fuzzing is much less principled than formal methods, but it just works: it can be readily applied to very large systems, and it is extremely effective at finding real bugs that developers care about and fix. In this personal account I trace my path from formal methods to fuzzing, by way of the GPUVerify project on verifying GPU kernels and the GraphicsFuzz project on randomised testing of GPU compilers. I argue that the oracle problem provides an intellectual link between fuzzing and formal methods, describe my continuing, targeted uses of formal methods in the domain of GPU programming language design, and discuss work at the boundary between formal methods and fuzzing. Finally, I reflect on whether generative AI might be the missing ingredient that allows formal methods to scale, and set out my plans for large-scale formal methods via the Keystone project, through which my collaborators and I aim to find out how much of that promise can be realised in practice.

</details>


### [919] [Exploring public-private data sharing practices through the lens of Open Data Ecosystems: A multiple case study on municipal and regional freight logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12440)
*John Larsson,Johan Linåker,Per Runeson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文基于瑞典三个案例，探讨市政与区域末端货运物流中公私数据共享（ODE-PPF）如何提升效率，识别出平台设计、角色分工、敏感数据、数据质量与采购流程等相互关联的社会技术要素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 货运量预计增长并加剧空气污染，亟需通过提升效率减排；数据共享被视为开放数据生态中多方协作优化货运规划与运营的关键途径，但公私数据共享在末端物流中的实践机制尚不清晰。

Method: 采用长期参与式过程后的多案例研究，覆盖三个案例；通过初始会议、半结构化访谈收集数据，进行主题分析，并通过后续工作坊进行验证。

Result: 发现数据共享受平台设计、行动者角色、敏感数据处理、数据质量及采购流程等相互交织的社会技术因素塑造；据此构建行动者模型与概念模型，并提出七条命题草案作为后续研究基础。

Conclusion: 数据共享是末端物流实现整合与价值创造的核心机制，依赖技术与非技术（组织）层面的互动；公共主体可作为中立的“基石型行动者”，通过治理实践（如采购）协调生态并促进数据共享。

Abstract: Background: Freight transport is expected to increase, contributing to air pollution. There is, therefore, a critical need for increased efficiency that can reduce emissions. Data sharing is one approach, where actors within Open Data Ecosystems (ODE) collaborate and share data among stakeholders to plan and operate more efficient and sustainable freight transport.
  Aim: In this study, we explore how public-private data sharing practices in municipal and regional last-mile freight logistics in Sweden may improve efficiency.
  Method: Following a prolonged participation process, we conducted a multiple-case study involving three different cases, built upon initial meetings, semi-structured interviews, supported by a thematic analysis, and validated through a follow-up workshop.
  Results: The findings show that data sharing in public-private freight logistics (ODE-PPF) is shaped by interrelated socio-technical aspects, including platform design, roles of actors, handling of sensitive data, data quality, and procurement processes. We synthesize our findings in an actor model and a conceptual model, highlighting how these aspects contribute to the functioning of ODE-PPF, and derive seven proposition sketches as a foundation for future research.
  Conclusion: Data sharing is a central mechanism enabling integration and value creation in last-mile logistics. It depends on the interaction between technical and organizational aspects. Public actors can undertake a key role as a neutral keystone actor by orchestrating the ecosystem and facilitating data sharing through governance practices such as procurement.

</details>


### [920] [Surrendering and Reclaiming Judgment: How Software Engineering Students Experience AI Reliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12646)
*Nathan Cassee,Umit Akirmak,Luiz Guerra,Margaret-Anne Storey,Neil Ernst*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文通过探索性案例研究，追踪43名高年级软件工程学生在整学期团队架构项目中与AI协作的经历，构建出"将判断权让渡给AI"与"运用人类判断"两大主题，警示过度依赖AI会侵蚀新手开发者的判断力、所有权感与动力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI正重塑软件开发，也改变学生学习软件架构的方式。既有研究多聚焦小型编程练习或学生对AI的感知，鲜有关于学生在大型团队项目中学习软件架构时如何体验AI的证据，因此需要深入探究这一空白。

Method: 采用探索性案例研究，招募43名高年级软件工程学生，在整个学期的团队式软件架构项目中持续使用AI。数据来源为问卷与焦点小组，并运用Braun与Clarke的反身性主题分析法对焦点小组转录稿和开放式问卷回答进行分析。

Result: 得到两个主题。其一"将判断权让渡给AI"：随着用AI做架构与实现，依赖不断加深，最终放弃判断，陷入自己创建却无法理解的代码库，进而更依赖AI，并伴随羞愧、挫败与情感疏离，形成恶性循环。其二"运用人类判断"：部分学生保留或重获判断力，其基础是知识与经验，并配以具体策略；宽松的截止期限以及一次关于AI协作的讲座与实验课为其获取知识、重获判断提供了空间。

Conclusion: 鉴于行业对初级开发者的期望与AI的广泛采用，这些一手经验可帮助软件工程教育与产业以更恰当的方式引入AI，从而维护新手开发者的判断力、所有权感与内在动力。

Abstract: Software architecture is one of the skills novice developers must master to succeed in industry, and as AI disrupts software development, it is also transforming how students learn architecture. Existing work on how students and novices work with AI has mostly focused on small programming exercises or on students' perceptions of AI, so little is known about how students experience AI as they learn software architecture in larger team projects. We report on an exploratory case study of 43 senior software engineering students who used AI throughout a semester-long, team-based software architecture project. We combined surveys with focus groups and analyzed the focus group transcripts and the open survey responses through Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis. We constructed two themes. The first, Surrendering Judgment to AI, traces how participants' reliance on AI deepened as they used it to architect and implement their systems, until they surrendered their judgment and became stuck in a codebase they had created but could not understand, which made them rely on AI even more. Participants described feeling ashamed, frustrated, and emotionally disconnected from their work, a toll that, in our reading, left them with even less reason to break their reliance. The second, Applying Human Judgment, centers on participants who kept or reclaimed their judgment: the knowledge and experience it rested on, and the strategies they used to apply it. Participants' accounts suggest that relaxed deadlines and a lecture and lab on working with AI gave them room to acquire knowledge and reclaim judgment. Given the expectations placed on junior developers and the widespread adoption of AI, we believe these first-hand accounts can help software engineering education and industry adopt AI in ways that preserve novice developers' judgment, ownership, and motivation.

</details>


### [921] [WasmLens: Automatic Glass-Box Instrumentation for Composed WebAssembly Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12710)
*Michiel Van Kenhove,Ewout Verlinde,José Santos,Filip De Turck,Bruno Volckaert,Merlijn Sebrechts*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 针对WebAssembly组件模型黑盒组合难以观测的问题，提出按组件维护span栈的wasi:otel/tracing改设计（已被上游采纳），并据此构建自动插桩工具WasmLens，从组合图推导插桩点、向已组合二进制注入追踪中间件，实现零配置端到端追踪；插桩代价可加且随组合深度线性增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WebAssembly组件模型支持语言无关的组件组合，但现有追踪会将组件内部产生的span都挂到同一宿主级父上下文上，从而“压平”执行层级，无法重建跨组件边界的调用关系；同时组件通常以黑盒形式部署，集成方无法修改或检查其内部，进一步加剧观测困难。

Method: 1) 重新设计wasi:otel/tracing，使运行时为每个组件维护独立的span栈，在不修改组件接口与源码的前提下恢复跨边界的父子span关系；2) 在该设计之上实现WasmLens：从组合图自动推导插桩点，并将追踪中间件注入已组合完成的二进制，无需开发者配置即可获得端到端追踪。

Result: 在6个组件边界下，自动插桩将平均请求延迟从238μs提升至454μs；将边界穿越次数从6增至11后，延迟进一步升至514μs，即每次穿越增量约12μs，其中10.4μs归因于插桩本身。表明插桩开销是随组合深度可加，而非与基线执行时间成比例。

Conclusion: 按组件维护span栈的设计可恢复黑盒组件组合的跨边界层级追踪，且已被上游采纳；WasmLens证明了在黑盒场景下零配置自动插桩的可行性，其开销随组合深度线性可加，为WebAssembly组件的可观测性提供了实用方案。

Abstract: The WebAssembly Component Model enables language-independent composition of independently developed components, but complicates observability. Existing tracing support flattens execution hierarchy by attributing every span created inside a composition to a single host-level parent context, so execution across component boundaries cannot be reconstructed. The problem is amplified because components are typically deployed as black boxes whose internals cannot be modified or inspected by the system integrator. To address these limitations, we propose a revised wasi:otel/tracing design in which the runtime maintains a per-component span stack, restoring parent-child relationships across component boundaries without changing component interfaces or source code. This change has since been adopted upstream. Building on this design, we present WasmLens, an automatic instrumentation tool that derives instrumentation points from a composition graph and injects tracing middleware into already composed binaries, yielding end-to-end traces for black-box compositions with no developer configuration. This automatic instrumentation raises mean request latency from $238$ $μ$s to $454$ $μ$s across six component boundaries. Raising the expected number of boundary crossings from 6 to 11 further increases latency to $514$ $μ$s, an incremental cost of $12$ $μ$s per crossing, of which $10.4$ $μ$s is attributable to instrumentation. These results show that instrumentation overhead is additive in composition depth rather than proportional to baseline execution time.

</details>


### [922] [Will AI mess my RTL? A snapshot-based approach to verifying AI-written RTL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12712)
*Bernat Homs,Oscar Palomar,Miquel Moreto,Marcelo Orenes-Vera*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SVApshot 是一个全自动框架，利用 LLM 为 RTL 模块生成并迭代修正 SystemVerilog 断言（SVA），通过"快照"方法把设计当前功能固化为形式化断言回归套件，用于验证未来（人或 AI）的改动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 用于 RTL 硬件开发日益增多，LLM 辅助创建和修改设计时需要确保改动不破坏原有功能。传统验证依赖人工，成本高且不可扩展，因此需要自动化、全面的验证手段来建立对 AI 驱动工作流的信任。

Method: 提出全自动 SVApshot 框架：1) 新颖的 snapshot 方法，将设计当前功能捕获为完整的形式断言集合，形成回归套件；2) 自动去重检测；3) 断言集扩展；4) 基于 LLM 引导调试并结合形式验证反馈，迭代修复失败断言；全过程无需人工介入。

Result: 在多种 RTL 模块上的实验表明，复杂模块可获得高覆盖率，并成功检测出人工注入和 AI 引入的 bug。框架还可自动生成形式化测试平台，用于以断言为基础的细粒度评分来评测硬件设计 LLM，超越二值 pass/fail 指标。

Conclusion: SVApshot 实现了无需人工的自动化 SVA 生成与修正，为 AI 驱动的 RTL 开发提供可靠的回归验证手段，并为 LLM 硬件设计能力评测开辟了基于断言的新范式。

Abstract: With the growing interest in using AI (Artificial Intelligence) for RTL (Register-Transfer Level) hardware development, robust and comprehensive verification has become more important than ever. As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly assist in creating and modifying RTL designs, ensuring that these changes preserve existing functionality is paramount for building trust in AI-driven workflows. We present SVApshot, a fully automated framework that leverages LLMs to generate and systematically attempt to correct SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) for RTL modules, completely removing the human from the generation loop. SVApshot introduces a novel snapshot methodology that captures the current functionality of a design as a comprehensive set of formal assertions, creating a regression suite for validating future changes--whether made by humans or AI. The framework features automated duplicate detection, assertion set expansion, and iterative repair of failing assertions using LLM-guided debugging with formal verification feedback. Our experimental evaluation across diverse RTL modules demonstrates high coverage for complex modules, with successful detection of both manually-injected and AI-introduced bugs. Additionally, this framework opens the door for automatic generation of formal testbenches to benchmark LLMs for hardware design, moving beyond binary pass/fail metrics towards nuanced assertion-based scoring.

</details>


### [923] [Inference Validation for Regulated AI: Building a Decision Pipeline on NVIDIA AIPerf](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12737)
*Dev Akre,Roman Bobalo,Manoj Dobbali*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MasterControl 提出内部验证工具 Runway，围绕 NVIDIA AIPerf 构建受治理的 LLM 推理配置决策流水线，实现测量、实验设计与合规审计的职责分离，并报告三项实测发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在受监管行业部署大模型，仅追求最快推理引擎不够，还需在服务客户前提供配置满足合同与法律义务的证据，而现有工具缺乏这种治理与审计能力。

Method: 将关注点分离：AIPerf 负责可信测量，Runway 负责其前的实验设计与其后的合规、成本与审计决策；并设计使缓存与审计成为同一机制的存储模型。

Result: 三项发现：TensorRT-LLM 与 vLLM 的排名随并发量反转；更新更贵的 GPU 实例按请求成本可能更便宜；投机解码在不同引擎负载下表现不同，故引擎配置可胜过引擎选择本身。

Conclusion: 受监管场景下的推理选型需以可审计的证据驱动，配置调优与实验设计的价值可与引擎选择相当，Runway 提供了可复用的治理框架。

Abstract: Deploying large language models in regulated industries requires more than picking the fastest inference engine: it requires evidence that a configuration meets contractual and legal obligations before it serves a single customer request. We describe Runway, an internal validation harness built at MasterControl that builds a governed decision pipeline around NVIDIA AIPerf. The key insight is separating concerns: AIPerf provides the trusted measurement, while Runway provides the experiment design that comes before it and the compliance, cost, and audit decisions that come after. We describe the architecture and the storage model that makes caching and audit one mechanism. We report three findings from Runway sweeps: TensorRT-LLM and vLLM rankings invert with concurrency; a newer, pricier GPU instance can be the cheaper one per request; and speculative decoding behaves differently across engines under load, so engine configuration can outweigh engine choice.

</details>


### [924] [Coding Agents in KVM: Practical Containment and User Control with Limited Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12823)
*Yutaka Nagashima*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: KVM-Agent 是一个开源系统，用可替换的 Ubuntu 虚拟机为编码智能体提供宽权限沙箱，兼顾自主性、隔离性与用户控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体需要广泛权限才能高效工作，但这会暴露用户数据与基础设施；商用云工作区虽可隔离，却带来厂商锁定和用户控制力下降，且需在资金、算力、人力约束下权衡自主性、强制隔离和用户控制。

Method: 对上述权衡进行分析，并提出 KVM-Agent：开源实现，自动化大部分环境搭建与资源配置步骤；在可替换的 Ubuntu 虚拟机内给智能体宽权限，同时把宿主机管理留在 VM 之外；支持多种编码智能体应用、模型服务与远程任务委派。

Result: 保留了用户熟悉的工作流与选择自由，代价是虚拟机资源开销、维护成本，以及 VM 内可访问密钥和允许的网络访问带来的残余风险。

Conclusion: KVM-Agent 提供了一种不依赖特定厂商、用户可控的智能体隔离方案，在自主性与安全性之间取得务实平衡，但并非零风险，需接受资源、维护和残余安全成本。

Abstract: Coding agents often need broad authority for productive development work, but granting that authority can expose users' data and infrastructure. Off-the-shelf cloud workspaces can help contain agent activity, but reliance on provider-specific platforms can lead to vendor lock-in and reduced user control. Researchers and engineers must therefore balance agent autonomy, enforced containment, and user control within available financial, computational, and human resources. We analyze these trade-offs and present KVM-Agent, an open-source implementation that automates most setup and provisioning steps. It gives agents broad authority inside replaceable Ubuntu VMs while keeping host administration outside those VMs and supporting multiple coding-agent applications, model services, and remote job delegation. The approach retains familiar workflows and user choice at the cost of VM resources, maintenance, and residual risks from secrets accessible inside the VMs and permitted network access.

</details>
